title: Data Center Engineer Officer
description:
*Job Description :*

* Manage and supervise the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in the Data center.
* Identify risks and perform IDC vendor operation and maintenance quality assessment.
* Liaise with IDC vendor for all maintenance and project work, to identify and mitigate risk.
* Review monthly report sent by IDC vendor and attend the meeting.
* React to any incident, to identify, evaluate and report impact to our IT equipment. Propose solution to mitigate the impact.
* As a technical professional for all facilities-related issues within the Data center of Asia-Pacific , escalating to the headquarter (HQ) technical team as needed.
* Perform RCA (Root Cause Analysis) of critical equipment failures.
* Troubleshoot and report of facility and Data server-level events within internal SLA.
* Create and deploy new standard practices for technicians and IDC vendor support teams.
* Provide training and guidance to operation team, such as Method of Procedure (MOP), Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), Emergency Operating Procedure (EOP).
* Ensure all EHS procedures are adhered to by vendor and Company staff.
* Communicate complex technical information to a non-technical audience.

*Requirement*

* 3+ years of relevant work experience in a data center or other critical environment or 5+ years of technical training or experience with relevant data center facilities equipment.
* Bachelors or above in applicable engineering field or mechanical or electrical.
* Preferred have Electrical or mechanical License.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Solid leadership and organizational skills.
* Proven self-starter.
* Ability to prioritize in a complex, fast-paced environment.
* Good speaking and writing in English.

Job Type: Contract
Contract length: 12 months

Pay: Rp15,000,000 - Rp25,000,000 per month



Ability to commute/relocate:
* Jakarta: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Education:
* S1 (Required)

title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
**THE ROLE**

As a foundational member of our engineering team, you'll be involved in end-to-end development on features across our web product.

We have a frequent cadence of shipping new features and a close connection to our market.  With 650k monthly active users spending hundreds of thousands of hours on the platform, each contribution and feature you ship will have a meaningful impact for the users.

Since we're a startup, you'll have to be willing to get your hands dirty with (and learn) everything across the stack: API design, devops, frontend, data engineering, algorithms, AI, startup engineering, analytics, etc.  You'll also mentor junior software engineers.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**

- 8+ years of experience building web apps

- Clean simple code, even when solving complex problems

- Good systems design and architecture knowledge

- Good knowledge of the software life cycle, including code reviews, testing, team organization

- Ability to balance business concerns with engineering considerations

- Ability to learn new tech quickly

- Experience mentoring junior engineers

- Experience interacting with multiple stakeholders

- Enjoyable to work with

**TECHNOLOGY STACK**

- Python, PostgreSQL, FastAPI, Redis, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Tailwind, AWS, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Pinecone, GPT-4

  **EXAMPLE PROJECTS**

- Craft plan to measure and improve our search engine

- Improve and migrate our data model for the content we host

- Migrate our NLP algorithms over to use LLMs

- Do thorough, prompt code reviews

- Implement developer tools to help with code quality

**Job Type** : Full-Time

**Location** : 100% remote

**US-based comp range** \*: $140k-$185k

**Latin America-based comp range\*** : $105k-$140k (USD)

**Canada-based comp range\*:** $125k-$165k (USD)

\* Plus equity (cost of living agnostic)

**TO APPLY**

[Please click here to apply](https://up.codes/careers?utm_source=YC-Work-at-a-Startup) - we only look at candidates who apply directly. 

### Technology:
 Tech Stack
=======
 - Python 3
 - Typescript
 - Flask
 - Postgres
 - Redis
 - Heroku
 - AWS

Why Join Us?
=========

 - Our product is already at 250,000 monthly active users. To put that in perspective, there are ~1.5M architects and structural engineers in the US, so  already have a significant chunk of the market.

 - This is one of the construction industry's worst problems and we're the only ones solving it.

 - We're a YCombinator company, backed by Liquid 2 and Foundation Capital. We've been approached for acquisition more than once, but declined because  believe this could become something big.

 - The work is meaningful. Cheaper construction means more affordable housing, airports, hospitals, schools, etc. Oh and we're fighting the good fight (try googling "Can the Law be Copyrighted?")

 -  believe the best perk is working with talented colleagues, so we're keeping the team small and experienced / talented.


Example Projects
============

 - Create an internal tool that allows contractors to write formulas to identify when a building code section applies for a user's building, so  can help them find relevant information.

 - Add users' bookmarked code snippets onto blueprint PDFs (and have some kind of UI for them specifying the right area in the PDF or detect automatically).

 - Create Rap Genius-style annotations on sections of building code, to better explain it.

 - Past project example: for links to other building code sections, create a preview modal that pops up similar to Wikipedia's previews.

title: Data Analyst - Merchant Risk
description:
Xendit provides payment infrastructure across Southeast Asia, with a focus on Indonesia, the Philippines and Malaysia. We process payments, power marketplaces, disburse payroll and loans, provide KYC solutions, prevent fraud, and help businesses grow exponentially. We serve our customers by providing a suite of world-class APIs, eCommerce platform integrations, and easy to use applications for individual entrepreneurs, SMEs, and enterprises alike.
Our main focus is building the most advanced payment rails for Southeast Asia, with a clear goal in mind — to make payments across and within SEA simple, secure and easy for everyone. We serve thousands of businesses ranging from SMEs to multinational enterprises, and process millions of transactions monthly. We’ve been growing rapidly since our inception in 2015, onboarding hundreds of new customers every month, and backed by global top-10 VCs. We’re proud to be featured on among the fastest growing companies by Y-Combinator.
About the Job
We are looking for a Risk Analyst to help us design and implement risk solutions for our existing portfolio of merchants across all operating countries. You will develop and maintain the risk rules for early detection of emerging fraud trends, ongoing risk scoring and monitoring of merchants, and investigating risk-related incidents.
The role requires strong data analytics skills and ability to explain complex situations and concepts through data-driven storytelling. The person will be tasked with designing rules and strategies and derive operating thresholds leveraging data analytics extensively.
The role will require coordination with teams within Risk and across Xendit and managing senior stakeholders in country offices. You will need to educate the stakeholders on risk matters, partner with them on solutions and act as a consultant for new product and business decisions. You will be a key member of the team working in a fast-paced environment on impactful assignments with very driven teammates and will see tangible results of your efforts.
Minimum Qualifications
5+ years of experience in data analysis, data science or risk management in financial services
Solid understanding of risk concepts and demonstrated experience in risk analytics
Strong data analysis skills including defining problem statements, data prospecting, data cleaning, structuring the analysis, etc.
Excellent communication and ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audience
Strong knowledge and experience with analytical tools and languages such as Python, SQL, etc.
Preferred Qualifications
Degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, engineering, etc.
Credit Card risk management experience strongly preferred
Experience working in an unstructured environment with uneven data availability and reliability
Responsibilities
Design proactive fraud and credit risk identification and mitigation strategies
Design and implement risk rules and maintain high levels of recall and precision
Partner with other Risk teams to optimize rules performance
Track and report key performance indicators for portfolio risk management
Do whatever it takes to make Xendit successful

title: Data Scientist - Risk Platform
description:
**Job Description**  

We’re looking for fresh graduates with experience in manipulating datasets and building statistical models for credit risk by leveraging machine learning techniques. You will partner with business, product, and engineering team to explore, determine, analyze, propose, and solve some of the most challenging business problems in lending and reduce risk. You will perform deep-dive exploration and analysis to find improvements in our existing framework. You will be submerged in a fast-paced environment working tightly in a strong team of data scientists and experience firsthand our robust data infrastructure.

**Responsibilities**

* Perform features selection, parameter binning, and optimize custom predictive machine learning models for credit risk scoring
* Query, process, cleanse, and verify the integrity of data used for analysis
* Analyze key metrics to determine risk and explore areas for improvements
* Create reports and dashboards to monitor model impact and performance
* Help build the variety of data ingredients needed to do modelling effectively
* Maintain the credit risk model platform which is utilized by the team
* Provide advice and guidance on potential efficiency gains and new state-of-the-art credit risk modelling methodologies

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor degree in an analytical or quantitative discipline (e.g. math, statistics, engineering, computer science), however other disciplines will be considered
* Experienced in using statistical computer languages such as R, Python SAS, SQL, or advanced MS Excel skills is a plus.
* Have good communication skills and able to work together in a team
* Excellent problem-solving skills and have the drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
* Willingness to learn new skills independently and have a strong sense of project ownership
* Not afraid to get your hands dirty to explore data and build statistical models

description:
We are looking for a talented and experienced Software Development Engineer in Test to join our team at Moladin Financial Services. As a Software Development Engineer in Test, you will ensure the highest quality possible of our software delivery by implementing and maintaining test automation scripts. Working alongside product managers and developers, you will also enhance our quality engineering process by identifying gaps and implementing solutions to address them. If you are passionate about software quality, have a deep understanding of test automation best practices, and thrive in a collaborative environment, we want to hear from you!
Responsibilities
Design and implement comprehensive test plans and test cases for backend and frontend development.
Improve and maintain automation test coverage to reduce manual effort during day-to-day quality engineering.
Identify edge cases and ensure software robustness before production deployment.
Work closely with product managers, designers, developers, and fellow quality engineers to design test suites.
Be involved in the entirety of the software development journey right from the inception of new features.
Create exhaustive documentation of test reports to provide complete visibility to the stakeholders.
Mentor the team by having tech discussions and knowledge-sharing sessions.
Actively contribute to the hiring and onboarding process.
Own the quality of Moladin deliverables in the form of services, web applications, and mobile applications.
Requirements
More than 2 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year in software test automation.
Experience in web and mobile application testing using test automation frameworks such as Cypress or WebdriverIO.
Familiar with test management tools such as Allure TestOps, JIRA, or TestRail.
Exposure to the Agile development process, CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, and cloud infrastructure on Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform.
Knowledge of software performance and security testing is a plus.
Prior experience in the financial services industry is preferred.

*Job description*

Digital Avenues has been servicing clients from across the world *since 1999*. Over the years, we have developed large-scale and complex products from *startups to Fortune 100 companies* as well as some of the top universities in the world. The startups we have worked with have given us the opportunity to experiment with and implement new technologies, and this among many other factors have helped some of our clients to win awards as well as become publicly listed companies.

When it comes to technology, *we enjoy experimenting with and implementing new ideas* - whether it be large scale adtech platforms, fintech solutions or blockchain implementation. More than 95% of our clients are US based and our teams are spread across India, Philippines, Indonesia, Singapore and the US. If you enjoy challenges and are looking to be a part of a team that prides itself in solving complex problems, then Digital Avenues is the place for you.

*Job Summary:*

To develop dynamic web applications and services on the Microsoft .NET platform.

*Job Responsibility:*

● Code, test and debug best in class software programs on the MS .NET Platform, which includes front-end,

middle-tier and back-end applications and services

● Provide input into the architecture and design of software solutions

● Support the development of estimates

● Active involvement in all phases of software development life cycle including analysis, design,

development, testing and support

● Maintain accurate and up to date documentation of code and its changes

● Provide assistance to junior developers

● Take ownership of the quality and timeliness of deliveries

● Adhere to Software Development policies and guidelines

*What’s in it for you?*
* Be part of a *highly agile and adaptive global team* of top talents
* Work on *challenging projects* and develop solutions for clients from USA, UK and APAC
* Work on a *variety of technologies and domains* like Adtech, Fintech, Blockchain, eCommerce, BI, Serverless and Cloud computing
* *Don’t get lost in the crowd*. Make a difference by contributing and adding value to all phases of the development lifecycle. Participate in key decisions and share your ideas for change
* Immense potential to *upskill and innovate*
* A flexible work environment leading to a *healthy work life balance*

*Specification / Skills / Experience:*

In addition to possessing good communication skills, being self-motivated, focused on delivery and paying attention

to detail, the candidate should have excellent knowledge and experience in the following technologies/areas:

Primary skills (Must have):

● C# with good understanding of OOPS, design patterns and multi-threading

● ASP.Net MVC, RESTful services, WCF, JQuery, Java Script, Vanilla JS

● Good knowledge of SQL Server & T-SQL

● Strong analytical and problem solving skills

● Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements

*Secondary skills (Nice to have):*

● .Net Core Framework

● HTML/CSS

● React

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
*PT. Wine Adore Indonesia* is looking for _Machine Learning Engineer_ with qualification skills bellow :

*Educational Background*: A bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, mathematics, statistics, engineering, or a related field provides a strong foundation. Some roles may require a Ph.D. for research-oriented positions.

*Strong Understanding of Machine Learning Algorithms and Concepts*: In-depth knowledge of various machine learning algorithms such as linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, random forests, support vector machines, neural networks, clustering techniques, etc.

*Programming Skills*: Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in machine learning such as Python, R, or Julia. Additionally, understanding data structures, algorithms, and software development principles is crucial.

*Data Manipulation and Preprocessing*: Ability to work with large datasets, clean data, preprocess it, and perform feature engineering to extract relevant features for model training.

*Machine Learning Libraries and Frameworks*: Experience with popular machine learning libraries and frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, Keras, etc.

*Deep Learning*: Understanding and experience in deep learning techniques, including neural network architectures like CNNs (Convolutional Neural Networks), RNNs (Recurrent Neural Networks), GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks), etc.

*Knowledge of Data Visualization Tools*: Proficiency in data visualization tools like Matplotlib, Seaborn, or Plotly to analyze and present insights from data effectively.

*Understanding of Model Evaluation and Validation*: Ability to evaluate and validate machine learning models using appropriate metrics and techniques such as cross-validation, hyperparameter tuning, and model selection.

*Experience with Deployment and Productionization*: Knowledge of deploying machine learning models into production systems and understanding concepts like containerization (e.g., Docker) and cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform).

*Problem-Solving Skills*: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify business problems, choose appropriate algorithms, and optimize models for performance.

*Collaboration and Communication*: Ability to work in a team environment, communicate complex technical concepts effectively to non-technical stakeholders, and understand the business implications of machine learning models.

*Continuous Learning and Adaptability*: The field of machine learning evolves rapidly, so staying updated with the latest research papers, techniques, and tools is essential.

While having a formal education in relevant fields can be beneficial, many machine learning engineers also acquire skills through online courses, self-study, participating in Kaggle competitions, working on personal projects, or contributing to open-source projects. Building a strong portfolio showcasing your machine learning projects can greatly enhance your prospects in this field.

title: Backend Developer Financial Services - Indonesia
description:
Youtap Technology Limited seeks a talented Backend Developer to join their Financial Services team. Youtap is a global financial services company that provides digital banking and payment solutions to consumers and merchants worldwide. As a Backend Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and secure backend systems that power our digital banking and payment applications.

At Youtap, we are passionate about delivering innovative solutions that empower individuals and businesses to transact digitally. Our white-label technology enables financial institutions, corporations, and digital banks to digitize their customer base and provide seamless online and in-store sales experiences.

**Youtap has multiple projects to integrate its platforms into the open-source MIFOS Apache Fineract financial services platform and seeks someone with experience in developing MIFOS and Apache Fineract solutions.**

### Responsibilities

* Develop, test, and maintain backend systems and APIs using Java, Spring Framework, and other frameworks and technologies as required.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams including frontend developers, product managers, and designers to define and implement new features and enhancements.
* Experience with cloud-based technologies including Kubernetes, Helm and Docker.
* Ensure the security, scalability, and performance of the backend systems.
* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues and bugs.
* Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.
* Stay up-to-date with industry trends and best practices in backend development.
* Maintain documentation of the backend systems and APIs.

### Requirements
    * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in backend development with a focus on financial services.
* In depth understanding of MIFOS / Apache Fineract development.
* Solid understanding of Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate, and PostGreSQL.
* Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and cloud technologies.
* Knowledge of security principles and best practices in backend development.
* Familiarity with agile software development methodologies.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

### Benefits
    We offer competitive salary packages and a pleasant working environment.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for smart people. You should be able to learn quickly and work independently - we'll help you as best as we can, but you must be tenacious and resourceful enough to figure out things you don't know how to do.

You’ll be in charge of all deployment related activities across several hosting providers – Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, Government Private Cloud and on-prem installations. You will work with a team to help establish best practices and manage all deployment and DevOps processes for our organization. Most of our deployments will require set up of CI/CD in AWS/Azure.

*Responsibilities*
Candidates can be expected to:
* Co-ordinate with Software Developers, QA and Project managers to deploy web applications (new applications and upgrades to existing software).
* Build documentation and SOPs to follow during deployments.
* Set up and manage Development, UAT and Production Environments.
* Manage releases from Development -> UAT -> PROD environments.
* Prepare backups/recovery processes and procedures and plan for Disaster Recovery.
* Work with System Architects to plan and implement CI/CD pipelines for government, public and private cloud infrastructures.
* Automate deployments to different types of architectures including microservices, serverless, monolithic and containerized.
* Research, propose, document and execute the adoption of DevOps, testing and code quality best practices.
* Administer and manage DevOps tooling.

*Requirements*
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or related fields.
* At least 1 year of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.
* Comfortable with Windows and Linux Server environments.
* Ability to write scripts to automate processes.
* In depth experience working with AWS or Azure.
* Great communication (verbal and written) and interpersonal skills.
* Network engineers who’d like to make the jump to DevOps are welcome.
* *This role is based in Bandung, Indonesia and on-site presence is required.*

Experience in the following is a plus:
* Monitoring tools
* CI/CD automation tools
* Server orchestration
* Government Private Cloud or Government Commercial Cloud
* DevOps and CICD pipelines
* Containerisation (eg. Docker)
* AWS and Azure Certifications

_We seek your understanding that only shortlisted candidates will be notified._

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: From Rp5,000,000 per month



Ability to Relocate:
* Bandung: Relocate before starting work (Required)

Kandidat akan bekerja sama dengan engineer lainnya untuk memastikan performa dan availability tetap terjaga, serta melakukan troubleshooting terhadap permasalahan yang terjadi.

- Menjaga kestabilan layanan server internal perusahaan

- Standby on call hari libur untuk eskalasi permasalahan server

- Mendampingi marketing dalam proses aanwijzing dan pembuktian kualifikasi

- Memastikan koordinasi pekerjaan dilakukan baik di divisinya atau dengan divisi lain

- Harus dapat mengoperasikan dan troubleshoot sistem operasi Windows maupun Linux.

- Diutamakan berpengalaman dalam membangun layanan Micro Services (Docker, Kubernetes)

description:
We are looking for a talented and experienced Lead Software Development Engineer in Test to join our team at Moladin Financial Services. As a Software Development Engineer in Test, you will ensure the highest quality possible of our software delivery by implementing and maintaining test automation scripts. * Ensure the successful implementation of company testing tools within squads.
* Participate in discussions to determine changes in the company's quality process.
* Demonstrate problem-solving skills and the ability to be a technical resource while also being involved in managerial activities.
* Align and prioritize between product delivery and quality engineering OKR.

    * Preferred experience in financial services, Payment, Loyalty services and Industrial with OpenAPI features.
* More than 2 years of experience in software testing, with at least 1 year in software test automation.
* Have a minimum of 1 year of experience leading a team in a related field.
* Able to fluently use SQL queries.
* Demonstrate ability to do separation of API Tests and UI Tests.
* Experience in web and mobile application testing using test automation frameworks such as Cypress, WebdriverIO, Playwright or any Javascript Test Automation Tools.
* Familiar with test management tools such as Allure TestOps, JIRA, or TestRail.
* Exposure to the Agile development process, CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, and cloud infrastructure on Amazon Web Services or Google Cloud Platform.
* Knowledge of software performance and security testing is a plus.
* Knowledge of basic Kubernetes, docker, Firebase, and NoSQL is a plus.

title: Microsoft Azure .Net DevOps Lead Engineer
description:
As a Senior Azure .NET DevOps Engineer, you will be at the forefront of our engineering process, driving the adoption and optimization of Azure Lighthouse and .NET technologies to streamline and enhance our DevOps practices.

The Candidate will also have a background in Java development, preferably with exposure to Springboot and PostgreSQL.

### Requirements
    **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Azure Lighthouse Management**: Implement, manage, and optimize Azure Lighthouse to efficiently oversee and govern multiple Azure environments.
* **.NET Development:** Develop and maintain .NET applications, services, and APIs. Ensure code quality and implement best practices in software development.
* **DevOps Practices Implementation**: Establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines, automate deployment processes, and integrate cloud services using Azure DevOps.
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**: Develop and maintain IaC using tools like Terraform or ARM templates to ensure scalable and repeatable environment setups.
* **Performance Tuning and Monitoring**: Utilize Azure monitoring tools to track performance, diagnose issues, and ensure system reliability and security.
* **Collaboration and Leadership**: Work closely with cross-functional teams, including development, operations, security, and business units, to ensure alignment of DevOps strategies with business goals.
* **Continuous Learning and Improvement**: Stay abreast of emerging Azure and .NET technologies, and continuously assess and implement improvements to our DevOps practices.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Proven experience as an Azure Developer or similar role.
* Strong knowledge of Azure cloud services, including Azure App Services, PostGreSQL Database, Azure Lighthouse, Kubernetes etc.
* Knowledge of AWS Cloud Services is a plus.
* Experience with programming languages such as Java.
* Understanding of DevOps practices and experience with Azure DevOps tools.
* Familiarity with database technologies.
* Ability to troubleshoot and optimize Azure solutions.
* Excellent communication and team collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Azure and .Net certifications (e.g., Azure Developer Associate).
* Experience with container orchestration services like Kubernetes and Docker
* Knowledge of microservices and serverless architectures.

### Benefits
    * Competitive salary package
* Great working environment
* Opportunities for career advancement and professional development

description:

Candidates who thrive in a fast-paced environment, steps up to face challenges, and are able to deliver results, are welcome to apply. We are looking for candidates who are interested in doing Implementation and Operation for Cloud Infrastructure.

* Has minimum 2 years experience working with AWS services and architecture.
* Proven experience in:  
 Writing infrastructure code using Terraform.  
 Site Reliability Engineering practices and incident management.  
 Building and managing both Windows and Linux servers in cloud environments.  
 Managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
* Strong scripting and automation skills (e.g., Python, Bash and PowerShell).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* **Only Indonesian may apply**

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS Certified (AWS Solutions Architect, AWS SysOps Engineer).
* Experience with other cloud providers (e.g., Azure, Google Cloud Platform).
* Knowledge of other Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., Terraform, Terragrunt).
* Familiarity with containerization technologies other than Kubernetes (e.g., Docker).

description:
*Job Description:*

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Cloud Engineer with a minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the cloud industry, particularly in Microsoft Azure. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining Azure-based cloud solutions, ensuring the highest levels of reliability, security, and scalability.

*Responsibilities:*

- Develop cloud infrastructure solutions which includes multi/hybrid cloud design and implementation

- Implementing cloud-native frameworks for enterprise infrastructure

- Develop and implement accordance to cloud adoption framework

- Design, operations, and support of public/hybrid cloud infrastructure with cloud native security paradigm

- Routine daily performance monitoring, analysis and maintenance

- Ensuring the proposed cloud architectures and solutions are exhibit scalability, maintainability, performance, and security and compliant with industry standard and customer needs

- Documentation on SoP, SoW, UAT, internal How-To

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to address and resolve complex problems

- Any other ad-hoc duties assigned.

*Requirements:*

- Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- Minimum of 2 years of hands-on experience in the cloud industry with a specific focus on Microsoft Azure.

- Certified in Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent are highly desirable.

- Proficiency in PowerShell and/or other scripting languages for Azure automation.

- Strong understanding of Azure security features, identity and access management, encryption, and compliance.

- Have experience related to Oracle DB, Mongo DB, PostgreSQL DB, Redis, Kafka, Elasticsearch database platforms

- Experience in SRE and Cloud Native DevOps is a plus

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

- English is a must

Job Type: Full-time

Salary: Rp18,000,000 - Rp22,000,000 per month



Experience:
* Cloud related: 2 years (Required)

Language:
* English (Required)

* Microsoft Azure Certifications (Preferred)

* Jakarta (Required)

title: DevOps Support Engineer (Eastern Time Zone)
description:
### The Role:

As a DevOps Support Engineer at Porter, you'll play a pivotal role in helping us deliver an excellent user experience for hundreds of startups.

You'll be expected to directly communicate with users while diving into Kubernetes and user infrastructure, leveraging your communication skills to provide top-notch support for our developer users. This role is not just about addressing technical issues; it's about empowering our users to make the most out of Porter.

### You will:

- Be on-call during Eastern Time to ensure users receive timely support, adhering to our commitment to excellence and reliability.
- Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to Kubernetes, Helm, and Docker, ensuring our users experience minimal downtime.
- Offer expert advice and solutions to our users, helping them navigate challenges and optimize their use of Porter within their own cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).
- Collaborate with our engineering team to relay feedback from users, driving improvements in Porter's functionality and usability.

### Who we're looking for:
We're in search of a candidate who thrives in fast-paced environments and is adept at juggling multiple tasks. Your ability to communicate with technical users will be key to success in this role. A strong foundation in DevOps principles and Kubernetes is essential.

### Tech stack:

- Core Technologies: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker
- Programming Languages: Familiarity with Go is a plus
- Infrastructure: Experience with AWS, GCP, or similar cloud services

Our team is anchored in NYC, but this specific role is fully remote as long as you can work on an East Coast TZ.

Interested? Email your resume to jobs at porter.run and let us know why you would be a great fit for this role.

*Skills*: Kubernetes

### Technology:
 Web: React (styled-components), TypeScript
Backend: Go, Kubernetes and Helm APIs, Postgres, Redis
Infrastructure: AWS, GCP

Our DevOps team is a team of around 8 people which is a central team that helps other tech stakeholders like software engineers, and QA teams. Our vision and goal is to build secure, reliable, scalable, maintainable, and cost-efficient infrastructure.


*About the role*


As our next DevOps you will be working with another Tech team to help build modern, secure, reliable, scalable, maintainable, yet cost-effective infrastructure. And while constantly improving our knowledge and skills in the field of Cloud Infrastructure Engineering.

* Fun to work with and a team player
* Eager to learn (self-learning and from others), share and grow
* Self motivated and able to inspire and motivate people

description:
**What We Do**

At Coda, we break down barriers between publishers and their audiences by thinking outside of the app. Coda is trusted by 300+ top digital content publishers – including industry giants Activision Blizzard, Bigo, Electronic Arts, Riot Games, and Zynga – to grow revenue, profit margins, and customer engagement in 60+ markets with ease. For publishers, this means less lift, more players and more payers. For players, Coda’s solutions allow them to pay for play their way.Our winning formula? A laser-focused, pragmatic attitude coupled with an unwavering commitment to excellence. We are customer-centric, creative, and solution-oriented, always delivering to our users the top-tier entertainment content they want at competitive prices.If you’re ambitious, bold and ready to take your career to the next level, get in touch!

**Responsibilities**

* **Zendesk Expertise**:
* Proficient in Zendesk.
* Set up and configure Zendesk to optimize workflow efficiency for the customer support team.
* Provide support and training to team members on Zendesk functionality.
* **CS Channel Tools Management:**
* Manage and maintain various customer support channel tools, ensuring seamless integration and functionality.
* Collaborate with team members to identify and implement improvements to CS tools and workflows.
* **Help Page Development:**
* Create and update comprehensive help pages for Codashop.com, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and user-friendliness.
* Develop content to address common user queries, technical issues, and troubleshooting guides.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to align help page content with product updates and changes.
* Utilize HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other web development tools to build and enhance help pages.
* Ensure the responsiveness and optimal performance of help page layouts on various devices.

**Requirements**

* Experience with Zendesk is a must.
* Proven experience in web development, content creation, and management, with a focus on help pages or technical documentation.
* A bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
* Proficient in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and basic web development tools.
* Experience working with JSON scripts
* Experience working with content management systems (CMS).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Additional language proficiency is a plus.
* Ability to translate technical information into user-friendly content.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot user issues effectively.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with a global team.
* Ability to adapt to changes in technology and industry trends.

**Working at Coda**

Joining the Coda team means diving into a fast-paced, challenging, and exciting world. With Codans spread across over 30 countries around the world, our highly collaborative environment breaks down time zones and cultural barriers, empowering you to chase innovative ideas, contribute to Coda’s growth, and make a lasting impact. If you have a passion for pushing boundaries, and thrive on continuous improvement through experimentation, we'd love to hear from you!

**Our Perks\*WFH / Hybrid Support:** Get a monthly allowance to cover your working expenses and keep you connected.

**Wellness Boost**: Stay healthy with resources for physical and mental well-being with our flexible benefits and Employee Assistance Program - because you matter!

**Customized Benefits**: Tailor your benefits with our flexible plan.

**Growth Opportunities**: Unlock your potential through clear progression paths.

**Skill Development**: Access training resources to fuel your personal and professional growth.

**Volunteer Time Off**: Enjoy paid time off to make a difference in the world through volunteering.

**Family Care**: Take advantage of paid Family Care Leave to bond with your family, while our selected Flexible Benefits also cater to your family's needs.

*\*Benefits are reviewed and updated on a yearly basis*

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, embracing the unique qualities of every individual, regardless of gender, race, age, religion, disability, or other local protected classes. Our goal is to foster an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome and valued.

Due to the large number of exceptional applications we receive, we can only reach out to shortlisted candidates. If you don't hear from us, rest assured there may be another opportunity at Coda that aligns better with your unique abilities. Remember to check our Careers Page for more exciting job openings!

**Title:** ***DevOps Engineer (Remote)***

**Experience Required:** ***1.5+ Years***

We are seeking an experienced DevOps Engineer with expertise in Linux, Docker,  
Docker Compose, CI/CD pipelines, and AWS services such as EC2, RDS, ECS and  
Load Balancers to join our remote team. If you have a minimum of 1 year of hands-  
on experience in deploying and managing cloud-based infrastructure, automating  
workflows, and optimising systems for scalability and reliability, we want to hear from  
you.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and maintain Docker-based containerization strategies using

Docker and Docker Compose for streamlined application deployment.

* Develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment

processes, ensuring rapid and reliable software delivery.

* Configure, deploy, and manage AWS services including EC2 instances, RDS

databases, and Load Balancers to support scalable and resilient applications.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimise infrastructure, improve

deployment processes, and enhance system reliability.

* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to

ensure high availability and performance of production environments.

* Stay abreast of emerging technologies and best practices in DevOps, cloud computing, and automation to drive continuous improvement initiatives.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* Minimum of 1.5 year of hands-on experience working with Docker, Docker Compose,

and container orchestration tools.

* Proficiency in building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using popular tools such as

Jenkins, Github actions.

* Strong knowledge of AWS services, including EC2, RDS, Load Balancers, S3, and

Networking(VPC).

* Experience with either shell scripting or python.
* Experience with Databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK

stack, or CloudWatch.

* Solid understanding of networking concepts, security best practices, performance

and cost optimization in cloud environments.

* Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with team

members across different disciplines.

If you are passionate about building scalable, resilient, and secure cloud infrastructures in WEB-3 space, we encourage you to apply.

title: Mobile Developer (React Native)
description:
BIOTA Smart Home is a cutting-edge technology company committed to revolutionizing modern living through innovative smart home solutions. Our technology seamlessly integrates into lifestyles to provide convenience, security, and energy efficiency. We prioritize customer-centric design and strive to create user-friendly experiences in our products and services. Our mission is to transform homes into intelligent, connected spaces that offer comfort and peace of mind.

**Opportunity**

As a full-time on-site Mobile Developer (React Native) located in Jakarta, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining our smart home application using React Native. You will work closely with our cross-functional team to implement new features, enhance the user experience, and ensure the reliability and performance of our mobile app.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain our smart home application for iOS and Android platforms using React Native.
* Collaborate with the design and product teams to implement new features and user interface enhancements.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices and coding standards.
* Optimize application performance and ensure compatibility across different devices and screen sizes.
* Conduct code reviews, identify bugs, and troubleshoot issues to ensure the quality and reliability of the mobile app.
* Stay updated on the latest trends and technologies in mobile app development to continuously improve our application.

### Requirements
    * 2-3 years of proven experience as a Mobile Developer with expertise in React Native or React.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Web Development, or related field.
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, ES6, and TypeScript.
* Experience with mobile app development for both iOS and Android platforms.
* Knowledge of mobile app design principles, user interface guidelines, and best practices.
* Familiarity with RESTful APIs, JSON, and web services integration.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a team environment.
* Good communication skills and the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

**Why Join Us**

BIOTA offers an innovative and dynamic work environment where creativity and initiative are encouraged. Join us to be part of a talented team driving the future of smart home technology. Come and join the growing BIOTA team as a Mobile Developer to make the world a better place to live in, one home at a time.

description:
PT. Aptana Citra Solusindo yang merupakan salah satu unit bisnis Perusahaan Kurniawan Group yang bergerak di bidang Digital Marketing atau Periklanan, saat ini kami membutuhkan kandidat untuk posisi Data Engineer penempatan di Kota Makassar dengan kualifikasi sebagai berikut :

* Setidaknya 1+ tahun pengalaman langsung dalam data engineering
* Lulusan sarjana di bidang Ilmu Komputer, Informatika, Sistem Informasi, dan Teknik atau bidang yang relevan lebih diutamakan
* Pengetahuan tingkat lanjut tentang Python dan SQL (Java & Scala lebih disukai)
* Memiliki kepribadian dan minat yang berorientasi pada Big Data & Data Warehouse
* Familiar dengan teknologi big data seperti Hadoop ecosystem (map-reduce, spark, Kafka) lebih disukai

Job Desc:

* Merencanakan, merancang, dan mengembangkan data warehouse
* Mengubah data mentah dari berbagai sumber menjadi informasi yang dapat digunakan untuk analisis dan pengambilan keputusan bisnis
* Menjamin kualitas data untuk data warehouse
* Membangun dan Mengelola proses ETL/ELT/Data Pipeline Ingestion dari berbagai Sumber Data
* Pemeliharaan desain data, arsitektur dan Aliran Data
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim (Ilmu Data & TI) untuk mengintegrasikan data dari berbagai sumber ke dalam centralized data warehouse dan menerapkan model prediktif ke dalam production environments

Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu, Kontrak  
Panjang kontrak: 6 bulan

Gaji: Dari Rp3.500.000 per bulan

Pendidikan:

* D1-D4 (Diutamakan)

* Data Engineer: 1 tahun (Diutamakan)

title: Junior Data Analyst / Data Entry (Working hour follow US Time)
description:
**Key Responsibilities and Tasks**

* Mine and analyze data from company databases to drive optimization and improvement of product development, marketing techniques and business strategies.
* Deliver flexible, reusable and well-maintained core data repositories.
* Developing templates and methodologies to ensure data requirements are accurately and completely captured and can be effectively communicated to other data stakeholders.
* Conducting data profiling to analyze quality of incoming data & advising on any data cleansing rules.
* Use accelerated delivery methodologies to ensure data initiatives provide timely business value.
* Perform data entry of information, and make corrections, as required.
* Create tailored proposals for current and prospective clients.
* Manage and enhance daily/weekly/monthly reporting to provide results and context to deliver actionable insights, not just reporting data.
* Manage, prioritize, and respond to ad-hoc requests.
* Uncover and identify opportunities to improve the customer experience by leveraging statistical approaches against multiple sources of data including internal sales/transactions, CRMs, and external 3rd party data/benchmarks.
* Research, design and implement reporting infrastructure that leads to automated and flexible reporting.
* Perform data maintenance tasks when required to ensure ongoing data integrity.
* Deliver excellence in the analysis of qualitative data used in management reports.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Good verbal and written communication skills; able to effectively present analytics data to Business and Marketing users.
* Driven to understand the relationship between data and the business.
* Strong work ethic, results oriented, and accuracy / attention to detail are critical.
* Demonstrated initiative, able to work both independently and as a team member.
* Proven track record developing and maintaining complex data artifacts
* Able to clearly communicate complex methodologies and approaches to stakeholders, peers and management.
* Excellent knowledge of, and demonstrable experience with Microsoft Excel, Google Sheets, Google Docs with an emphasis on using advanced functions and macros.
* Experience in data manipulation with Python will be considered a strong asset.

Job Types: Full-time, Fresh Graduate

Salary: Rp5,000,000 - Rp7,000,000 per month

Language:

* English (Required)

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Flipside is a commercialization engine that powers blockchain growth. We activate 100,000+ analysts to produce insights, drive narratives, and transact, building emotional connection and a strong and active community that supports token price and chain growth. We make that possible by curating best-in-class data and making that data available entirely for free. Founded in 2017, Flipside works with partners such as Solana, Near, Flow, Avalanche, SEI, Aptos, Blast, Vertex. The company is backed by leading investors including Republic Capital, True Ventures, Galaxy Digital, M13, and more.


The Data Analytics Team at Flipside Crypto is looking for an Analytics Engineer to help us build out our suite of analytics products.  

As an Analytics Engineer at Flipside Crypto, you will serve in a highly cross functional role and be responsible for creating detailed analytics product specifications and metric definitions for customers, as well as partnering with engineering and data science teams to deliver reports, and data models and data visualizations.


**\*\*This role will be fully remote and off-shore, international candidates are also encouraged to apply!\*\***


**Responsibilities:**

  

* Write SQL or other querying code to extract and manipulate data from database systems to create reports and data visualizations using proprietary Flipside applications
* Partner with Product and Data Science to design and define analytics product specifications
* Ensure accuracy of data results and analytic methods through testing and validation of underlying report data and coordinate closely with Data Product on issue resolution
* Learn about the top Blockchains and Protocols in order to model a data framework needed to do proper analysis of their use cases.
* Become an expert on customer blockchain projects and serve as the main point of contact for data questions as well as mentor other analysts
* Help build data models that are in line with analytics product specifications in Python and in SQL
* Work with Blockchain Communities on Discord in order to gather insights as well as give support
* Accepting and giving out constructive feedback and willingness to switch priorities based on the team's needs


**You are a fit if:**

  

* You possess a strong analytical background that includes 3+ of experience working with complex data sets
* You are have experience working with and are a subject matter expert with Blockchain Data (experience with Cosmos/IBC data a plus)
* You are comfortable creating your own intermediary tables and thrive in ambiguity
* You have a background in data modeling and are familiar with star schema and dimensional modeling
* You are self directed and capable of driving projects forward to meet deadlines
* You have great communication skills (verbal and written) and are able to present your ideas to a wide audience
* You have a strong background in writing SQL (Snowflake, Athena, Hive, Postgres, SQL Server)
* Are familiar using ETL pipelining tools like DBT
* You have an analytical mindset


Check us out (https://flipside-crypto.gitbook.io/working-at-flipside/the-company/our-mission-and-vision)


We welcome all qualified persons to apply regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience.

description:
**About Autobahn Security**

  

Autobahn Security is a technology start-up with a vision to make cybersecurity and vulnerability management accessible to all businesses. Our SaaS product has been developed by some of the world's finest cybersecurity researchers and experts. Our SaaS tool allows both cybersecurity experts and non-experts to embark on a journey to implement effective vulnerability management in their business.


**Job Brief**


Autobahn Security hiring is in full swing!! We are seeking exceptional QA Automation Engineers to help us build the Autobahn Security cyber security solution and deliver an exceptional user experience. We are looking for someone who does not only write automated tests but can decide what needs to be automated on which level, select appropriate tools for that, and create new automated test solutions of different test types. This role will also work closely with the DevOps team to help integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines. The QA Automation Engineer will work within a squad (sprint team), ensuring a high degree of test automation for the squad's product domain.  

  



**Responsibilities**


* Be the go-to person in automation related activities and processes
* Act as a sparring partner for Product Owner, e.g. with regards to acceptance criteria
* Plan, design, and implementation of automated test cases
* Manual test execution for new features which don't have automated tests yet
* Continuously improve our test automation stack and processes
* Expand our Web UI Automation and API Automation
* Perform reviews of other contributors' code
* Help other team members in automation related topics

**Requirements:**


* Strong knowledge & experience in a QA/tester role in a high-performing Agile development environment
* Relevant experience in web UI test automation with a modern test stack, e.g.: CodeCept.js, WebDriver.io, Cypress
* Extended knowledge of API testing tools and approaches, e.g. Postman/Newman, supertest
* Knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, Python
* Experience as QA in agile product development teams
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, GIT, Sauce Labs, and Test Management tools
* Experience with any of the following would be a plus: Docker, Kubernetes, BitBucket


**Benefits**


* You will have a high degree of freedom to shape the technology of Autobahn Security and the opportunity to extend your proven leadership skills, working closely in an international environment with seasoned entrepreneurs
* Flat hierarchy – we value everybody's input and contribution
* Bright, motivated, and international colleagues
* Opportunity for non-stop learning from our world-leading security experts
* Private healthcare insurance
* ClassPass membership
* A modern office with all-you-can-drink coffee in the kitchen

description:
Data Scientist  
Do you have a passion for uncovering insights from data and applying machine learning (ML) to solve problems in the dynamic world of finance?

We are seeking a highly motivated and independent Data Scientist to join our growing team!

In this role, you will:

- Play a key role in driving data-driven decision making across the financial organization.

- Work collaboratively with stakeholders across various business units to understand their needs and translate them into actionable data solutions.

- Communicate complex findings in a clear and concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Stay up-to-date on the latest advancements in ML and financial technology (FinTech).

- A strong understanding of fundamental algorithms and data structures (e.g., sorting, searching, trees, graphs).

- Experience working with programming languages like Python and R.
- Solid foundation in statistics and probability.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
- A passion for learning and staying informed about the latest trends in data science and finance.
- A high degree of autonomy and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Experience with financial data and regulations.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).
- Experience developing and deploying ML models in production environments.

+ Strong proficiency in automated configuration management tools, notably Ansible.
+ Practical knowledge of containerization concepts, including Docker.

**Job Title:** Lead Data Engineer (AWS SageMaker Expertise)

**Location:** Jakarta, Indonesia (Full-Time)

**Company Overview:** Join our team at NorthBay, a US-based software company and AWS Premier Consulting Partner specializing in AWS Cloud, AI/ML, Big Data, and IoT solutions. We are dedicated to delivering innovative and scalable technology solutions to our clients worldwide.

**Job Description:**


We are looking for a talented Lead Data Engineer with specialized expertise in AWS SageMaker to join our team in Jakarta, Indonesia. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering, cloud computing, and machine learning, with a focus on leveraging AWS SageMaker for scalable and efficient model development and deployment. Fluency in both Bahasa and English languages is required for effective communication with our diverse team and clients.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in data engineering, with a proven track record of designing and implementing scalable data solutions.
* Expertise in AWS services, particularly AWS SageMaker, S3, Glue, Lambda, and EC2, with a deep understanding of cloud computing concepts and best practices.
* Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience in building and optimizing data pipelines using frameworks such as Apache Spark or AWS Glue.
* Hands-on experience with machine learning algorithms, model training, and deployment, preferably using AWS SageMaker.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
* Excellent communication skills in both Bahasa and English, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* AWS certifications related to machine learning or big data.
* Experience working with other cloud platforms such as Azure or Google Cloud Platform.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and tools for automating infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD).
* Knowledge of containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the design, development, and maintenance of scalable data pipelines and architectures for processing, storing, and analyzing large volumes of data.
* Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and implement solutions that meet business objectives.
* Architect, implement, and optimize machine learning workflows using AWS SageMaker, including data preprocessing, model training, tuning, and deployment.
* Develop and maintain automated processes for model monitoring, evaluation, and retraining to ensure model accuracy and performance over time.
* Stay updated on emerging technologies and best practices in data engineering and machine learning on AWS, and proactively recommend improvements to our infrastructure and processes.
* Mentor junior team members and promote knowledge sharing within the team to foster a culture of continuous learning and growth.

description:

Assist in methodology research, data processing, and documentation to conduct independent self-guided exploration of research and frame open-ended industry questions, including, but not limited to:* Conducts statistical analyses to develop strategies,
* Builds predictive models and machine-learning algorithms,
* Identifies data patterns and trends,
* Proposes solutions and strategies to business challenges,
* Presents information using data visualization techniques, and
* Documents all processes and research.
* Discover new opportunities to optimize the business through machine learning and/or statistical modelling.
* Assist the design and development of analytical projects designed to understand key business behaviors that drive customer acquisition, retention, and engagement through machine learning and/or statistical modelling.
* Assist in the implementation of client analytics solutions with the internal Project Coordinator.
* Develop and maintain client analytics reports.

 **Leadership Responsibilities:*** Commits to personal learning and growth.
* A drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques.

 **Qualifications and Requirements**:* Tangibles
* 1-2 years of professional experience in Data Science fields. Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* Mandatory: Experienced using programming languages (at least Python and SQL) to manipulate data and draw insights from large data sets.
* Intermediate Mathematical, Statistical, and/or Machine Learning skills required, and their real-world advantages/drawbacks.
* Knowledge and/or experience in working with structured and/or unstructured data sets.
* Knowledge and/or experience in Data Architecture and Engineering is a plus, especially Google Cloud Platform.
* Familiar with Data Visualization Tools, Google Data Studio is a plus.
* Character.
* Problem-solving skills, structured thinking and a scientific approach are required.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision and keep supervisors informed.
* Ability to work well in a team environment.
* Ability to communicate in clear and concise terms.
* Willing to learn new skills and able to do so independently.
* Ability to take initiative.

description:
### **Description**

  

**Tripledot Studios** was founded by a team of industry veterans from some of the biggest names in mobile games such as King, Peak Games, Facebook, and Product Madness.  

We are now a 500 person mobile games studio, headquartered in London, with offices in Warsaw, Barcelona, Minsk, Jakarta and Melbourne.  

* The Financial Times awarded Tripledot the **Fastest Growing Business** in Europe in 2022
* Tripledot won **Tech Growth Business of the Year** 2021 and 2023
* PocketGamer just awarded us **Best Mobile Developer** 2023

  


We are a record breaking, chart-topping mobile games studio that is currently leading in the Casual mobile gaming space.  

Our guiding principle as a team is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.  

The studio is filled with people who love taking things apart and figuring out how they work. We enjoy problem-solving and most importantly, we **LOVE** making games!
  

**Take a look at our games:** iOS Store + Google Play  

### **About the job**

 **Role Overview**  

As a Data Analyst within our organisation, you'll play a pivotal role in synthesising data into actionable insights for both our Product (game) teams and central business functions.  

You'll craft datasets, metrics, reports, and visualisations that inform strategic decisions and drive our company's success. Your work will involve analysing a broad spectrum of data, from internal and external sources, to support business stakeholders and influence the direction of our products and strategies.  

What sets this role apart is the opportunity to collaborate closely with senior leaders, game designers, product owners, and data engineers, ensuring that analytics best practices are woven into the fabric of our game development and business operations.  

You'll own the analytics process end-to-end, from data source identification to delivering insightful outputs, and designing processes for ongoing support and maintenance. **Key Responsibilities**
Support business stakeholders within the Product (game) teams, as well as central business functions (such as HR), by creating datasets, metrics, reports, visualisations for presentations, models, forecasts, automation scripts and documentation using SQL, Looker and Google Sheets. Analyse, evaluate and form independent judgments on the outputs. Work with a wide variety of data from different sources - internal and external, structured and unstructured.  

* 
Work with game designers, feature designers and product owners to develop and report on key in-game events and ensure best practices are met in analytics development.  
* 
Understand stakeholder teams' data / analytics requirements and work with the Data Engineering team and dev team as needed to deliver the required outputs, owning the process end-to-end from data source identification to delivery.  
* 
Design and implement processes to ensure outputs are continually supported and maintained. Investigate any data issues and address questions that are raised by stakeholders.  
* 
Work together with other data team members to ensure consistency in metric definitions, implementation of analysis/BI best practices and efficient use of data outputs.  
* 
Create clear and detailed documentation on the deliverables.  
* 
Manage timelines to meet deadlines and communicate progress to relevant stakeholders in a timely manner.  
* 
* Advise stakeholders on use of data tools and analysis / visualisation methodologies. Contribute to the Data Science, Business Intelligence and Data Engineering community through sharing knowledge and mentoring.
  

  

### **Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

 **Required:**

title: Data Analyst
description:
**About Dropsuite**

Dropsuite (listed DSE:ASX) safeguards business information. We are a global, fast-growing, partner-centric company building secure, scalable, and highly usable cloud backup technologies for businesses. Our mission is to help business stay in business. Dropsuite performs billions of backups per day for organizations in more than 100 countries around the globe.  



  

Dropsuite is known for its team of ‘hungry owners.’ We are hungry to win and tenacious, but at the same time we all are owners: we do not cut corners and always seek to do the right thing. We are experts in what we do, are highly customer focused and we *love* solving problems. We play as a team, where respect is one of our key values and we see helping others as a priority.  



  

**What will you be doing:**

* Understand business requirements and create reports/data frameworks to report critical information needed by the business
* Collect data from multiple sources, ensure data quality, find data discrepancy and fix data issues
* Build dashboards/reports as per business logic
* Validate data consistency across multiple reports
* Build insights from reports to measure key KPIs for the company
* Analyse trends and notify key users when key KPI numbers seem incorrect
* Provide data to stakeholders as an when required
* Continually work with the data team to provide updates on missing data or erroneous data
* Basic project management to maintain list of activities/improvements
Communicate changes and new developments with business users  
* 

  

**Our ideal candidate has:**

* 5-7 years of experience in building reports/dashboards through analytics tools, including **PowerBI**
* Good knowledge of data visualization and how to represent data in a meaningful manner
* Experience of managing data consistency and integrity
* Ability to build scalable reports for millions of rows
* Experience in deriving insights from data
* Experience in stakeholder management
* Strong attention to detail
* Good English communication skills
* Good interpersonal skills
Values that are aligned with us being a team of experts, problem solvers and collaborators, who are highly customer focused, dependable and trustworthy  
* 

  

**A big plus if you have**

* Experience of statistical methodologies and data analysis techniques
* Experienced in PowerBI dashboard building
Knowledge of SAAS industry-specific KPIs  
* 

  

**What we offer**

* Competitive compensation
* Long term incentives (e.g., Stock options or performance shares – subject to performance)
* Health insurance
* Social Security (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan)
* Hybrid working model
* 12 Days of Annual Leave
* Growth opportunities
Work in a global company with meaningful work, highly skilled colleagues and an amazing culture  
* 

  

If the above excites you and you are the person we are looking for; please submit your CV, your availability and desired salary **.** We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.  



  

**Posting Statement**

Dropsuite is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.  



  

***Please note that only applicants residing and eligible to work in Bandung Indonesia will be considered.***

**About the Role**



You will be part of the data team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in collecting, organising and analyzing data to support our strategic decision making, and reporting to internal and external stakeholders. In particular, you will need to create and maintain reports of our lending activities for regulators. You will need to query large data and use various statistical techniques to interpret the results in order to provide insights to improve our business operations.


**What You Will Do**


* Create dashboards and reports to provide regular updates on key metrics to enable leaders to monitor the company’s performance. The reports will be focused on the company’s lending business, and some of them will need to be formatted according to regulatory requirements.

* Perform deep dive analysis in collaboration with Strategy team stakeholders to investigate topics of strategic interest to the company
* Translate analytics output into clear and actionable insight, and give advice or recommendation based on the insights generated by the analysis
* Work with Data Engineering teams to establish required internal and external data sources, including designing the data warehouse for optimal organisation of the data
* Documenting analytics and business requirements related to assigned tasks.

* Bachelor Degree, in Statistics, Mathematics or Computer Science
* Minimum 1 years experience as Data Analyst
* Proficient in one of database languages (ex : postgreSQL, mySQL, prestoSQL, etc.)
* Have a knowledge on basic statistics
* Have experience in using BigQuery, Tableau or any data platform
* Ability to collaborate and manage stakeholders effectively
* Able to communicate in English
* Strong commercial sense, analytical and attention to detail
* Experience in banking or lending businesses will be a huge plus

**Data Analyst II (Contract Based)** **-** **JAK006H****Company****:** Worley**Primary Location****:** IDN-JKT-Jakarta City**Job****:** Data Analysts**Schedule****:** Full-time**Employment Type****:** Employee**Job Level****:** Experienced**Job Posting****:** Mar 8, 2024**Unposting Date****:** Apr 7, 2024**Reporting Manager Title****:** Senior Director - Digital Solutions
:  

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**



Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.?



Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.



We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.


**What you'll do**



As Data Analyst II, you will be responsible for:


* Collaborating with data scientists, analysts, front end developers and other stakeholders to understand and meet their data needs.
* Designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure and pipelines that support data-driven applications and analytics.
* Managing and monitoring data pipeline performance and troubleshooting any issues that arise.
* Work with a wide variety of data types and sources including structure, unstructured, semi-structured and sensor data
* Optimising and scaling data storage and processing systems.
* Ensuring data quality and consistency across different systems and platforms.
* Developing and implementing data security and privacy controls.
* Quickly build prototypes and proofs-of-concept to prove value of propostions
* Working with other teams within the organisation, such as Solutions Factory (DevOps and data systems), PMO, and project teams. Understand customers’ challenges, agree and deploy solutions.
**What you'll have:**
* Undergraduate/Masters degree in STEM or other numerate subjects. Plus 3 or more years relevant working experience.  

PhD in a relevant field (Computer Science, Industrial Analytical Systems etc) plus one year commercial experience
* Azure or AWS certified developer is prefferedDeep understanding of cloud-based data platforms (Azure SQL DB, Azure Synapse, ADLS, AWS, Hadoop, Spark, Snowflake, No-SQL etc).
* Proficient scripting in programming languages such as Java, Python, Scala
* Expert in SQL
* Good basic understanding of the main types of ML model with particular reference to the required data structures, formats and hygiene.
* Au fair with how current machine learning tools and platforms (Python, IBM, Knime, Github, R, Spark, Weka, Amazon ML, Azure ML etc) integrate as part of the analytical ecosystem
* Experience with the tools used to validate, monitor and deploy ML models (Tensorflow, ML Flow, AWS Studio, Docker, Kubernetes etc).
* Experience in processing of IOT/Sensor Data to solve problems in an industrial setting


**Moving forward together**



We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.



We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.



And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.



Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: Mobile Developer Intern
description:
**Role Description**

Doctor Tool is looking for a **Mobile Developer Intern** to join our team in Jakarta, Indonesia. This is an on-site internship role where you will work alongside experienced developers and be involved in the development of mobile applications. You will be expected to engage in day-to-day tasks such as designing, developing, and testing applications for mobile devices.

**Qualifications**

* Currently undergraduate or Freshgraduate in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field
* Strong proficiency in React Native framework, JavaScript, and/or TypeScript.
* Experience in developing mobile applications for both iOS and Android platforms.
* Knowledge of automated testing frameworks for mobile applications.
* Can-do attitude, ability to multitask and good time management skills
* Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
* Strong communication and teamwork abilities.
* Demonstrated experience in mobile application development through academic projects, personal projects or work experience preferred.
* ***Willing to Work From (WFO*****) Office at Otista, East Jakarta**

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain mobile applications for iOS and Android platforms using React Native.
* Collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend developers to translate requirements into functional and intuitive mobile app features.
* Implement responsive and attractive user interfaces using React Native components and third-party libraries.
* Optimize mobile applications for performance, speed, and scalability.
* Conduct thorough testing and debugging of mobile apps to ensure quality and a seamless user experience.
* Stay up-to-date with emerging trends and best practices in mobile app development and React Native ecosystem.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define and refine mobile app architecture and design patterns.
* Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and ensure adherence to coding standards.
* Continuously improve mobile app development processes and practices.

Job Type: Internship  
Contract length: 3 months

Salary: Rp1,500,000 per month

description:
* Develop strategic technology solutions
* Pioneering Indonesia Technology Solutions practices


### **About Our Client**


Our client is a global Technology company with presence across multiple continents - currently strengthening their Indonesian presence through Tech Solutions business.


### **Job Description**


A Solutions Architect will be responsible for:


* Solution Design: Architect and design end-to-end solutions that meet business goals, comply with regulatory standards, and incorporate industry best practices. Define system architecture, components, interfaces, and integration points for optimal functionality and performance.
* Technology Evaluation: Assess and identify emerging technologies, frameworks, and platforms for potential enhancements and optimizations.
* Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, clarify objectives, and strategize solutions. Effectively communicate architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Risk Management: Proactively identify risks within the architecture and develop strategies to mitigate them. Ensure compliance with industry regulations and security standards.
* Quality Assurance: Establish and enforce architectural standards and quality assurance processes to maintain solution integrity and reliability.

### **The Successful Applicant**


A successful candidate will have:


* Possess 5-8 years of IT experience, with 2-3 years in a Presales/Solution Architect role.
* Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science/Engineering or Software Engineering.
* Fluency in English, Mandarin, and/or Bahasa Indonesia.
* Experience in Finance, government, new energy, AI.
* Expertise in enterprise architecture principles, methodologies, and best practices.
* Proficient in designing and implementing scalable, distributed systems using cloud technologies.
* Knowledge of microservices architecture, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and API management platforms.
* Familiarity with DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools (Jenkins, Terraform, Ansible).
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.

Competitive salary & benefit
