title: Manager Data Analyst
description:
**Reporting of the role:**


This role reports to Team Lead – Knowledge \& Insights


**3 best things about the job:**


* An enjoyable environment that combines the best of your skills whilst at the same time being part of the largest marketing services group in the world


* Working within a network of hundreds of analysts worldwide in areas such as statistics, optimization, machine learning, programming, Campaign Reporting, marketing mix modelling, Causal analysis, Attribution modelling and Forecasting.


* Work diversity that involves liaising with internal and external stakeholders across a range of disciplines, solving business problems for clients


**In this role, your goals will be:**


**In three months:**


* Be up to speed with the Advanced Analytics team value proposition and able to articulate this confidently
* Started to build relationships with the key decision makers in the team and agency
* Build data sets for modelling related work including data manipulation, data cleansing, and organization.

**In six months:**


* Providing structured data to your line manager
* Confident using our available range of tools and software to organize data
* Started to work on your own allocated projects and ad hoc requests

**In 12 months:**


* Become a key support for your line manager and peers
* Fully work on a project under your line manager’s guidance from start to end including delivery of results
* Become a nominated champion in your area of expertise

**What your day looks like at Wavemaker:**


* Using data analysis techniques to identify insights, identify opportunities and solve business problems for clients
* Proactively build, clean and manage datasets
* Using data analysis techniques to identify insights
* Orchestrate automation of tasks to speed up solutions for clients
* Keep up to date with advances in marketing/media analytics \& trends
* Constantly provide support to your line manager and peers and respond to ad hoc request
* Making sure that projects are on track as per deadlines
* Engage with other internal Wavemaker teams to share knowledge
* Build strong relationships with several mid\-level clients
* Generate monthly reports with accuracy and on time.
* Identify, analyze, and interpret media trends or patterns.
* Responsible for consolidating all media investment and GRPs data.
* Acquire data from secondary data sources and maintain databases/data systems.
* Perform post\-analysis of categories and provide valuable insights.
* Work closely with vendor partners on data delivery and usage.

**About Indonesia**
Indonesia is one of the fastest growing and most dynamic markets in the world, with a population in excess of 260 million. It’s stable political climate and increasing consumer disposable income has meant that Indonesia is now firmly on the radar for MNCs seeking to invest in emerging markets.
Whilst the Indonesian media landscape is still dominated by terrestrial TV, with 65% of all advertising spend, digital is now poised to go through a period of exponential growth. There are more than 70 million internet users in Indonesia and 70% of them are accessing the web via mobile. As a marketer, the opportunity to transform a media landscape on such a scale is unprecedented in the APAC region.
GroupM APAC is committed to fostering a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our people are our strength, so we respect and nurture their individual talent and potential.

title: Data Analyst
description:
INDICO is a digital technology subsidiary company of Telkomsel, Indonesia's leading digital telecom company. INDICO plays a strategic role as a holding company that houses current and prospective vertical digital business portfolios, including Kuncie (edu\-tech), Fita (health\-tech), and Majamojo (game). Moving forward, INDICO aims to explore opportunities in multiple verticals adjacent to Telkomsel's digital businesses. As a digital platform company, INDICO aims to leverage Telkomsel's digital assets and capabilities to create a flywheel effect of innovations to develop cross\-sectoral digital solutions that will empower Indonesia's digital economy.  

  

INDICO believe we can reach beyond to empower Indonesians and enable businesses through our strong core values of EPIC WAY (Excellence, Positivity, Impactful Collaboration, Customer First, Walk the Talk, Accountability, Yes\-if Mindset).

**About The Role**


As a Data Analyst at INDICO, you will play a critical role in overseeing data\-driven decision\-making for INDICO product and business lines, which include digital goods commerce, engagement platform, Edutech, HealthTech, and game publishing businesses. This position offers a unique opportunity to work with cross\-entity data across a variety of industries, driving impactful business outcomes and product development. You will collaborate with multiple business units to plan, strategize, and accelerate growth, leveraging complex data to provide actionable insights that support informed decisions, as well as build and expand the data analyst organization.

**What will you do but not limited to:**

* Collaborate with Indico and its subsidiaries to plan, strategize, and drive growth through data\-driven insights.
* Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to support business and product decisions.
* Develop and deploy dashboards to track key metrics for different business units, including Edutech, Healthtech, and Game Publishing.
* Conduct both regular and ad\-hoc analysis to support strategic decision\-making and special projects.
* Present analysis and reports to stakeholders in a clear and effective manner.
* Partner with Product and Data Engineering teams to enhance data pipelines and ensure data accuracy across multiple entities.
* Track and measure the impact of data\-driven strategies, providing regular updates on their effectiveness.

Work with cross\-functional teams to define success metrics, evaluate data, and deliver actionable insights across Indico and its subsidiaries.  
* 

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.).
* Proficiency in SQL for querying and data manipulation.
* Experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) for dashboard creation.
* Experience with Python or R for advanced data analysis
* Familiarity with machine learning algorithm and tools is a plus
* 3\+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, or a related role.
* Effective communication and storytelling skills to present data\-driven insights to various stakeholders.

title: Front-End E-Commerce Web Developer
description:
Job Description:

Slush Digital, a Bali\-based digital agency, is looking for a skilled and detail\-oriented Front\-End Developer with strong experience in e\-commerce platforms to join our team. This role will focus on building and optimising e\-commerce websites using Shopify and WordPress/WooCommerce. The ideal candidate will have a sharp eye for design execution, excellent technical knowledge, and a solid understanding of how to deliver high\-conversion, seamless shopping experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

* Website Development: Build and maintain custom front\-end themes for e\-commerce websites, and utilise high\-performing existing Shopify themes where appropriate.
* Responsive Design Implementation: Ensure responsive and cross\-browser\-compatible development to deliver seamless user experiences across all devices.
* 3rd Party Integration: Set up and configure third\-party apps, plugins, and APIs, including payment gateways on WooCommerce (experience with Doku or similar is preferred).
* Performance Optimisation: Optimise front\-end performance to ensure fast load times, SEO readiness, and smooth customer interactions.
* Collaboration: Work closely with designers, back\-end developers, and project managers to implement creative and functional designs that meet client expectations.
* Troubleshooting: Identify and resolve front\-end issues related to site performance, design inconsistencies, and integration problems.
* Technology Awareness: Stay up to date with the latest trends, updates, and best practices in e\-commerce development, including platform changes and performance tools.

Requirements:

* Platform Experience: Proven experience developing websites using Shopify and WordPress/WooCommerce.
* E\-Commerce Knowledge: Strong understanding of e\-commerce best practices, including user experience (UX) and conversion optimisation.
* Technical Proficiency: Solid skills in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Liquid (for Shopify), and experience with popular page builders such as Elementor.
* Plugin \& App Integration: Experience installing and configuring third\-party payment gateways and shipping plugins, particularly for WooCommerce. Experience with Doku is a plus.
* CMS Customisation: Comfortable working with theme customisation, child themes, and basic back\-end structures in WordPress.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities with a proactive approach to debugging and optimisation.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English. Comfortable liaising with internal teams across multiple departments.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively within a team, communicate clearly, and take ownership of assigned tasks.

Preferred Skills:

* Experience with headless CMS or Shopify Hydrogen.
* Familiarity with SEO principles related to front\-end implementation.
* Basic understanding of back\-end development (PHP/WordPress).
* Familiarity with version control systems like Git.
* Experience with e\-commerce product customizer/mockup software.

Why Join Us?

* Work on exciting e\-commerce projects across various industries and international markets.
* Collaborate with a passionate and skilled digital team.
* Flexible, creative environment with opportunities for growth.
* Access to the latest tools, technologies, and learning resources.
* Be part of a fast\-paced agency where your contributions make a real impact.

Application Details:

Please submit your CV and portfolio of e\-commerce projects you’ve worked on. Highlight your experience with Shopify, WordPress/WooCommerce, and any notable plugin or payment gateway integrations you’ve handled.

We look forward to finding a proactive and skilled developer to join our growing team!

Language:

* english (Required)

title: AI Creative Prompt Engineer
description:
**About us**
============


Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer\-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about\-us/

**About the role**
==================


We are seeking an experienced and talented AI Prompt Engineer to join our Ad Labs team at Ruby Labs. This full\-time role is crucial for scaling our ad production using AI tools for video and image generation. You will report directly to the Ad Creative Director and collaborate closely with our creative and technical teams to develop innovative advertising creatives.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **AI Creative Leadership:** Oversee the use of AI tools to produce ad creatives (static images and videos), enhancing scalability and efficiency. Lead the entire AI\-generated creative process from concept to execution.
* **Strategic Collaboration:** Partner with the Ad Creative Director and creative teams to transform advertising concepts into high\-quality, ready\-to\-launch AI\-generated visuals and videos.
* **Innovative Development:** Remain at the cutting edge of AI technology, proactively exploring and integrating new tools and methods to elevate ad quality and streamline production processes.
* **Performance Optimization:** Continuously monitor and analyze the effectiveness of AI\-generated ads, utilizing performance data to drive creative improvements and report on outcomes.

**Qualifications**
==================

* **Experience:** At least 1 year of experience in an AI\-focused role, bonus points if it is within the advertising or creative industry.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficient with AI content generation tools like Sora AI, Midjourney, Runway, Arcads, ElevenLabs, Pika AI, ChatGPT, among others. Strong understanding of the advertising production process.
* **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI, Marketing, or related field preferred.
* **Portfolio:** Must submit a portfolio showcasing past projects with AI tools, ideally related to advertising.

**Location**
============


Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============


Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work\-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well\-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company\-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top\-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1dHF4ctKlez75whdn\-ybUwP5d5Wr0BdwVrorrm\_fM40Q/preview

Be part of our fast\-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================

* **Application Submission:** Provide your CV along with a portfolio showcasing a variety of AI\-generated projects.
* **Recruiter Screening (30 minutes):** Discuss your background, experience, and fit for the role.
* **Task Assignment:** Demonstrate your skills with AI tools through a practical task related to ad production.
* **Final Interview (60 minutes):** Meet with the Ad Creative Director and CEO to discuss your vision for the role and potential impact at Ruby Labs.

**Life at Ruby Labs**

description:
A Data Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data infrastructure and pipelines that enable an organization to collect, store, and analyze large volumes of data. They play a crucial role in ensuring data is accessible, reliable, and ready for analysis by data scientists, analysts, and other stakeholders.

* Design data models and schemas for efficient data storage and retrieval.
* Implement processes to ensure data accuracy and quality.
* Utilize tools like Hadoop, Spark, and distributed computing to process large datasets.
* Work with cloud providers like AWS, Azure, or GCP to store and process data in the cloud.
* Develop dashboards and reports using visualization tools like Tableau to support data\-driven decisions.
* Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data requirements and deliver data solutions.

description:
**Reporting of the role:**


This role reports to Team Lead \- Knowledge \& Insights

**3 best things about the job:**

* An enjoyable environment that combines the best of your skills whilst at the same time being part of the largest marketing services group in the world
* Working within a network of hundreds of analysts worldwide in areas such as statistics, optimization, machine learning, programming, Campaign Reporting, marketing mix modelling, Causal analysis, Attribution modelling and Forecasting.
* Work diversity that involves liaising with internal and external stakeholders across a range of disciplines, solving business problems for clients

**In this role, your goals will be:**

**In three months:**

* Be up to speed with the Advanced Analytics team value proposition and able to articulate this confidently
* Started to build relationships with the key decision makers in the team and agency
* Build data sets for modelling related work including data manipulation, data cleansing, and organization.

**In six months:**

* Providing structured data to your line manager
* Confident using our available range of tools and software to organize data
* Started to work on your own allocated projects and ad hoc requests

**In 12 months:**

* Become a key support for your line manager and peers
* Fully work on a project under your line manager’s guidance from start to end including delivery of results
* Become a nominated champion in your area of expertise

**What your day looks like at Wavemaker:**

* Using data analysis techniques to identify insights, identify opportunities and solve business problems for clients
* Proactively build, clean and manage datasets
* Using data analysis techniques to identify insights
* Orchestrate automation of tasks to speed up solutions for clients
* Keep up to date with advances in marketing/media analytics \& trends
* Constantly provide support to your line manager and peers and respond to ad hoc request
* Making sure that projects are on track as per deadlines
* Engage with other internal Wavemaker teams to share knowledge
* Build strong relationships with several mid\-level clients
* Generate monthly reports with accuracy and on time.
* Identify, analyze, and interpret media trends or patterns.
* Responsible for consolidating all media investment and GRPs data.
* Acquire data from secondary data sources and maintain databases/data systems.
* Perform post\-analysis of categories and provide valuable insights.
* Work closely with vendor partners on data delivery and usage.\\

**About Indonesia**
Indonesia is one of the fastest growing and most dynamic markets in the world, with a population in excess of 260 million. It’s stable political climate and increasing consumer disposable income has meant that Indonesia is now firmly on the radar for MNCs seeking to invest in emerging markets.
Whilst the Indonesian media landscape is still dominated by terrestrial TV, with 65% of all advertising spend, digital is now poised to go through a period of exponential growth. There are more than 70 million internet users in Indonesia and 70% of them are accessing the web via mobile. As a marketer, the opportunity to transform a media landscape on such a scale is unprecedented in the APAC region.
**GroupM APAC is committed to fostering a culture of diversity and inclusion. Our people are our strength, so we respect and nurture their individual talent and potential.**

title: Data Analyst
description:
INDICO is a digital technology subsidiary company of Telkomsel, Indonesia's leading digital telecom company. INDICO plays a strategic role as a holding company that houses current and prospective vertical digital business portfolios, including Kuncie (edu\-tech), Fita (health\-tech), and Majamojo (game). Moving forward, INDICO aims to explore opportunities in multiple verticals adjacent to Telkomsel's digital businesses. As a digital platform company, INDICO aims to leverage Telkomsel's digital assets and capabilities to create a flywheel effect of innovations to develop cross\-sectoral digital solutions that will empower Indonesia's digital economy.  

INDICO believe we can reach beyond to empower Indonesians and enable businesses through our strong core values of EPIC WAY (Excellence, Positivity, Impactful Collaboration, Customer First, Walk the Talk, Accountability, Yes\-if Mindset).

**About The Role**

As a Data Analyst at INDICO, you will play a critical role in overseeing data\-driven decision\-making for INDICO product and business lines, which include digital goods commerce, engagement platform, Edutech, HealthTech, and game publishing businesses. This position offers a unique opportunity to work with cross\-entity data across a variety of industries, driving impactful business outcomes and product development. You will collaborate with multiple business units to plan, strategize, and accelerate growth, leveraging complex data to provide actionable insights that support informed decisions, as well as build and expand the data analyst organization. 

**What will you do but not limited to:**

* Collaborate with Indico and its subsidiaries to plan, strategize, and drive growth through data\-driven insights.
* Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets to support business and product decisions.
* Develop and deploy dashboards to track key metrics for different business units, including Edutech, Healthtech, and Game Publishing.
* Conduct both regular and ad\-hoc analysis to support strategic decision\-making and special projects.
* Present analysis and reports to stakeholders in a clear and effective manner.
* Partner with Product and Data Engineering teams to enhance data pipelines and ensure data accuracy across multiple entities.
* Track and measure the impact of data\-driven strategies, providing regular updates on their effectiveness.
* Work with cross\-functional teams to define success metrics, evaluate data, and deliver actionable insights across Indico and its subsidiaries.

### Requirements
    * Bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.).
* Proficiency in SQL for querying and data manipulation.
* Experience with BI tools (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) for dashboard creation.
* Experience with Python or R for advanced data analysis
* Familiarity with machine learning algorithm and tools is a plus
* 3\+ years of experience in data analysis, data science, or a related role.
* Effective communication and storytelling skills to present data\-driven insights to various stakeholders.
extracted_skills: Python, Machine Learning, Data Science, SQL, Data Engineering, Power BI

title: Partner Solutions Architect
description:
Datadog is an enterprise SaaS company featured in Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte's Fast 500 Technology list, and Forrester's Intelligence Application and Service Monitoring Wave as a leader. Our team works with a best\-of\-breed product that solves real problems for our customers and partners.



We are Datadog's in\-house product experts. The Partner Solutions team contributes to Datadog's worldwide growth by enabling our partner ecosystem to deliver value for our customers. We share our technical and product expertise with partners through demos, presentations, workshops, and ongoing support. Partner Solutions is a growing global team that collaborates constantly to share knowledge and continuously advance our technical skillset.



The Partner Solution Architect (PSA) is a Datadog expert who will work closely with Datadog's Director of Partner Solutions Architects, and is aligned to our Channels \& Alliances business segment. The PSA is responsible for supporting a variety of technical initiatives and activities for our partners (for example: cloud migration, application modernization, DevOps transformation). They are accountable for the outcome of these initiatives, and frequently collaborate with both Datadog and Partner resources to drive success. The PSA is a trusted technical advisor for our Partner channel.


*At Datadog, we place value in our office culture \- the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work\-life harmony that best fits them.*


**What You'll Do:**


* Ensure the successful onboarding, training, enablement, and certification of partner technical resources;
* Participate in periodic joint business planning and review sessions to ensure direct alignment between Datadog and Partner technical teams;
* Collaborate internally to support Partner technical initiatives such as end\-customer demonstrations and proofs of value; partner team enablement workshops; assessment, advice, and coaching on lead practices;
* Advocate on behalf of Partners' technical concerns (use cases, feature requests, support issues, e.g.) with Datadog internal teams and personnel, helping to bring those concerns to resolution;
* Analyze and understand Partner service offerings on a regular basis and provide recommendations to enhance the value of those services through greater or improved adoption of Datadog features and capabilities;
* Collaborate with Datadog's product management, engineering and technical services teams to help identify and prioritize new features and capabilities;
* Continuously help curate and evolve lead/best practices for Datadog platform adoption and success.
  


**Who You Are:**


* Possess a solid technical grounding with hands\-on experience of IT Development and/or Operations
* Has a demonstrable track\-record and never\-ending passion for learning; successful candidates for this position typically have 10\+ years of experience in a customer or partner facing technical role
* A self\-starter, tech\-savvy professional with solid business acumen; ability to articulate Datadog value from server room to boardroom;
* Confident presentation skills; fluency in Bahasa; fluency in English required if not a native speaker
* Desired hands\-on experience in two or more of the following areas:
* + Observability: Datadog, Splunk, AppD, New Relic or Dynatrace
	+ Public Cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or Alibaba
	+ Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, Cloud Foundry
	+ Dev/Scripting: Python, Javascript, Ruby, Perl, PHP, Go
	+ Config Mgmt: Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, Chef
	+ CI / CD: Jenkins, Gitlab
* Additional considerations:
* + Previous experience working in a technical role for or supporting channel partners (Systems Integrators, Managed Services Providers, e.g.)
	+ Previous experience using Datadog and/or other cloud monitoring tools (APM,
	+ Infrastructure, Logs, Synthetics, NPM)
	+ Previous experience with root\-cause\-analysis, troubleshooting, debugging

*Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.*


**Benefits and Growth:**


* Best\-in\-breed onboarding
* Generous global benefits
* Intra\-departmental mentor and buddy program for in\-house networking
* New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)
* Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing
* An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks

  

  

*Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.*


**About Datadog:**



Datadog (NASDAQ: DDOG) is a global SaaS business, delivering a rare combination of growth and profitability. We are on a mission to break down silos and solve complexity in the cloud age by enabling digital transformation, cloud migration, and infrastructure monitoring of our customers' entire technology stacks. Built by engineers, for engineers, Datadog is used by organizations of all sizes across a wide range of industries. Together, we champion professional development, diversity of thought, innovation, and work excellence to empower continuous growth. Join the pack and become part of a collaborative, pragmatic, and thoughtful people\-first community where we solve tough problems, take smart risks, and celebrate one another. Learn more about \#DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.


**Equal Opportunity at Datadog:**



Datadog is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. Here are our Candidate Legal Notices for your reference.


**Your Privacy:**



Any information you submit to Datadog as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Datadog's Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

title: Data Engineer – T24014
description:
**What will you do?**

* Design, develop and deploy data tables, views and marts in data warehouses, operational data store, data lake and data virtualization.
* Perform data extraction, cleaning, transformation, and flow. Web scraping may be also a part of the work scope in data extraction.
* Design, build, launch and maintain efficient and reliable large\-scale batch and real\-time data pipelines with data processing frameworks.
* Integrate and collate data silos in a manner which is both scalable and compliant.
* Collaborate with Project Manager, Data Architect, Business Analysts, Frontend Developers, Designers and Data Analyst to build scalable data driven products.
* Be responsible for developing backend APIs \& working on databases to support the applications.
* Work in an Agile Environment that practices Continuous Integration and Delivery.
* Work closely with fellow developers through pair programming and code review process.

**What are we looking for?** 

* Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Computer or Electronics Engineering, Information Technology or related disciplines.
* Proficient in general data cleaning and transformation (e.g. SQL, pandas, R, etc) to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
* Proficient in building ETL pipeline (e.g. SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), AWS Database Migration Services (DMS), Python, AWS Lambda, ECS Container task, Eventbridge, AWS Glue, Spring).
* Proficient in database design and various databases (e.g. SQL, PostgreSQL, AWS S3, Athena, mongodb, postgres/gis, mysql, sqlite, voltdb, cassandra, etc).
* Experience in cloud technologies such as GPC, GCC (i.e. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Experience and passion for data engineering in a big data environment using Cloud platforms such as GPC, GCC (i.e. AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
* Experience with building production\-grade data pipelines, ETL/ELT data integration.
* Knowledge about system design, data structure and algorithms.
* Familiar with data modelling, data access, and data storage infrastructure like Data Mart, Data Lake, Data Virtualisation and Data Warehouse for efficient storage and retrieval.
* Familiar with rest api and web requests/protocols in general.
* Familiar with big data frameworks and tools (e.g. Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, RabbitMQ).
* Familiar with W3C Document Object Model and customized web scraping (e.g. BeautifulSoup, CasperJS, PhantomJS, Selenium, Nodejs, etc).
* Familiar with data governance policies, access control and security best practices.
* Comfortable in at least one scripting language (e.g. SQL, Python).
* Comfortable in both windows and linux development environments.
* Interest in being the bridge between engineering and analytics.

Job Types: Full\-time, Contract  
Contract length: 12 months

*Note: Partly is headquartered in Christchurch, New Zealand, but has employees across NZ, AU, UK, US, SEA and the EU. This position is to be based remotely from the Philippines/ Indonesia.*

**Our story**
=============


Partly's mission is to connect the world's parts and we're doing that by building the first global platform for replacement parts, starting with auto parts. Our big vision is to accelerate the world towards a sustainable future where waste is eliminated and all replacement parts are universally searchable, accessible and available to all.


Founded by ex\-Rocket Lab engineers, we utilise bleeding\-edge technology to solve challenging but exciting problems that make a huge impact in a $1\.9 trillion industry. We've more than tripled our team over the last 12 months and expect to double in size again over the coming 12 months. We're a global team spanning both Europe and Australasia.


We provide a scalable digital infrastructure solution to some of the world's largest businesses and the most exciting startups. Partly's solutions are integrated across hundreds of companies globally, providing the backbone for cataloguing and managing parts online.


Our investors in Blackbird Ventures (Canva, CultureAmp etc.), Square Peg, Octopus Ventures, Hillfarrance, Icehouse, Peter Beck (Rocket Lab), Akshay Kothari (Notion Co\-Founder) and Dylan Field (Figma Co\-Founder).


We're continuing to build a world\-class team and ensuring Partly is a place where people can do the best work of their lives. We're proud of the culture we've built at Partly, and our values are lived throughout every experience.

**This role**
=============


In this role, you will work alongside other members of our development team to build out Developer and QA tools and to support our customers with integrations.


This is an opportunity to work in an extremely fast\-paced environment and take on rewarding challenges and responsibilities.

**What will you do**
====================

* You'll be working on Developer and QA tooling.
* You will be developing systems and integrations for internal and third\-party sales channels
* This is an opportunity to become an expert in the extremely complex and underserved auto parts domain

**Your skills**
===============

* 1\+ years of experience developing software
* Competency in working with relational databases
* Firmly grounded computer science and engineering fundamentals, including data structures, concurrency, architecture, and design patterns.
* Strong communication and collaborative skills, both written and verbal
* (Bonus) Experience with Rust
* (Bonus) Experience with automotive parts
* (Bonus) Experience integrating with sales channels such as Shopify, eBay


Please note: if you don't have all the skills/experience listed above but believe you could be outstanding in this role, please still consider applying. Many folks, especially those from underrepresented or marginalised groups, often count themselves out. Please allow us to learn more about you and why you're exceptional!

**Benefits**
============

* **Competitive base salary plus equity**. Even though we’re a small startup, we offer competitive salaries and great equity.
* **Parental leave and flexible return to work**. After returning to work, primary carers can work 4\-day weeks for 100% of their pay for the first twelve weeks. For secondary carers, we offer 10 days of leave at full pay.
* **Flexible working hours**. We’re office\-first, but are flexible with hours and working from home when you need to.
* **A brand new architecturally designed office in Christchurch CBD**. With free snacks, drinks on tap, two different coffee machines, social areas, and one of the best cafes in Christchurch 50m away.
* **Monthly team lunches** to celebrate our wins and enjoy each other's company outside the office.
* **Ergonomic workspace**. Sit\-stand desks, ergonomic chairs, quiet spaces, and collaboration spaces to suit all kinds of working styles.

description:
Thousands of companies build better software products with the help of Canny’s customer feedback platform. As a **Software Engineer** at Canny, you will play a central role in shaping our product's future, building new features, and refining our platform to offer an unparalleled user experience.


  
We are...


* Fully remote with no office
* 16 people, spread across 4 countries (US, Canada, Mexico, Spain, Turkey)
* Bootstrapped (no outside funding) and profitable


 


**What you'll do at Canny**:


* Collaborate with the product and design teams to develop and implement new features that address user needs.
* Optimize and refine existing code to improve performance, scalability, and maintainability.
* Troubleshoot, identify, and resolve software defects to ensure a smooth user experience.
* Participate in code reviews, fostering a culture of quality and collaborative learning.
* Keep up\-to\-date with industry best practices and technologies to maintain Canny’s edge in the market.
* Contribute to technical documentation, ensuring ease of use and understanding for future reference.


 


**Tech you’ll use every day:**


* Our stack \- TypeScript, ReactJS, Node.js, MongoDB
* DevOps \- AWS, GitHub, CircleCI, MongoDB Atlas
* Slack \- team and some customer communication
* Canny \- tracking user feedback 🙂
* Missive \- email collaboration
* ClickUp \- project management


 


**Compensation \& Benefits:**


* Base salary, competitive in all major cities
* Bonus program (8% of base salary, varies on performance)
* Regular Compensation Reviews (conducted semi\-annually)
* Equity grant (RSUs)
* 20 paid vacation days, 15 paid holidays, and unlimited sick leave.
* Benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance
* In\-person team retreats twice a year


 


Join us at Canny and be a part of a team passionate about build high quality software products. We look forward to reviewing your application!


Experience you'll bring to Canny:
* 3\-5 years of professional, full stack software engineering experience.
* Production experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript, React, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* You are self\-motivated and have strong organizational skills
* A collaborative spirit, adept at fostering relationships with the product, engineering, and customer\-facing teams.
* Experience working autonomously and as a part of a small, preferably remote, team.
* You have demonstrated the ability to onboard and integrate with an organization long\-term:


	+ within the last 5 years, you've worked at one company for at least 2 years


 


**Bonus:**
* Experience building enterprise and/or SaaS software

* In your application, please submit your resume, an optional cover letter, and explain your motivation for wanting to join Canny (we genuinely value understanding why you're drawn to us!).

* For some extra flair, share a link to your favorite GIF.



**Location:**


* This role requires working North American hours to best serve our customers and coordinate with the team.

title: Data Engineer Consultant (Junior & Senior) 1
description:
**About EY:**


EY, a global leader operating in more than 150 countries delivers unparalleled service in **Consulting** and assists clients to transform and upskill their capabilities.

  

We serve our clients to build a better working world, helping them to create long\-term value for people and society and build trust in the capital markets. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we work towards our ambition to be the best employer.

  

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

  

We look forward you to joining us in the **EYDS AI and Data** team:

 **Ideally, you must have:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or above in Information Systems, Computer Science, Informatics, Electronics and Communications, or related disciplines.
* Minimum 1\-2 years (for Associate level) and 3\-5 years (for Senior level) in data engineering.

 **Job description:**

* Design and implement scalable data pipelines to support data processing and analytics.
* Conduct user acceptance test, user training.
* Develop and maintain ETL processes using Microsoft Azure Data Factory and Azure Databricks.
* Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data requirements.
* Ensure data quality and integrity throughout the data lifecycle.
* Optimize data storage and retrieval processes for performance and efficiency

 **Technical skill:**

* Python/Scala for data processing, ETL, and automation
* Data pipeline design and implementation
* Data modelling
* ETL development and maintenance
* Data quality and integrity management
* Optimizing data storage and retrieval
* User acceptance testing (UAT) and training
* Collaboration with data teams

 **Tools:**

* Azure Data Factory
* Azure Databricks
* Azure Cloud Platform
* SQL\-based databases

 **The opportunity:**


You will help our clients navigate the business and technology transformation vision. We’ll look to you to provide our clients with a unique business and technology perspective on how technology can transform and improve their entire organization – starting with key business issues they face. This is a high\-growth, high\-visibility area with plenty of opportunities to enhance your skill set and build your career.

 **Your key responsibilities:**


You’ll spend most of your time working with a wide variety of clients and your colleagues to deliver the latest trends, practices, technologies, and architecture to design, build and maintain scalable and robust solutions that unify, enrich, collaborate and deliver value.

 **Skills and attributes for success:**

* Outstanding team player
* High level of motivation
* Strong work ethic
* Self\-starting attitude
* Independent and able to manage and prioritize workload
* Ability to quickly and positively adapt to change
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, client service, and technical writing skills, coupled with excellent executive presence.
* Significant experience in managing and delivering medium to large teams on complex programs and projects.
* Assessing, designing, architecting, and developing solutions leveraging the latest technologies and trends to exceed the business requirements
* Unifying, enriching, and delivering value to derive insights and opportunities
* Leveraging in\-house and partners \- platforms and solutions as needed and recommending and building new platforms/solutions as required to exceed business requirements
* Communicating findings, recommendations, and opportunities to improve platforms and solutions
* Demonstrating a deep understanding of technology, concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches
* Seeking out information to learn about emerging methodologies and technologies
* Clarifying problems by driving to understand the true issue
* Looking for opportunities for improving methods and outcomes
* Collaborating, influencing, and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
* Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making
* Proven track record of sales and delivery in a consulting context with established client relationships and experience

 **What we look for:**


We’re interested in passionate individuals with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends. If you have a genuine passion for helping businesses achieve their full potential, then these role(s) are for you.

 **What we offer:**

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, on your way
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs

  

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

  

EY is an equal opportunity, affirmative action employer providing equal employment opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, or any other legally protected basis, including arrest and conviction records, by applicable law.

  

EY is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with special needs. If you are a qualified individual with special needs and need assistance applying online or need to request an accommodation during the interview process, please speak to our HR executives, and we will be happy to help you.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure (Platform - Networking)
description:
Ready to be pushed beyond what you think you’re capable of?


At Coinbase, our mission is to increase economic freedom in the world. It’s a massive, ambitious opportunity that demands the best of us, every day, as we build the emerging onchain platform — and with it, the future global financial system.


To achieve our mission, we’re seeking a very specific candidate. We want someone who is passionate about our mission and who believes in the power of crypto and blockchain technology to update the financial system. We want someone who is eager to leave their mark on the world, who relishes the pressure and privilege of working with high caliber colleagues, and who actively seeks feedback to keep leveling up. We want someone who will run towards, not away from, solving the company’s hardest problems.


Our [work culture](%22https:/www.coinbase.com/mission%22) is intense and isn’t for everyone. But if you want to build the future alongside others who excel in their disciplines and expect the same from you, there’s no better place to be.



The mission of the Platform Product Group engineers is to build a trusted, scalable and compliant platform to operate with speed, efficiency and quality. Our teams build and maintain the platforms critical to the existence of Coinbase. There are many teams that make up this group which include Product Foundations (i.e. Identity, Payment, Risk, Proofing \& Regulatory, Finhub), Machine Learning, Customer Experience, and Infrastructure.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Networks team to design, implement, and maintain our cloud\-based network infrastructure. This team is a part of our Infrastructure org in our Platform Product Group. The mission of the Platform Product Group is to build a trusted, scalable and compliant platform to operate with speed, efficiency and quality. Our teams build and maintain the platforms critical to the existence of Coinbase.


  
**What you’ll be doing (ie. job duties):**
* Architect, design, deploy, document and manage our Cloud\-based network infrastructure. This includes all ingress and egress, both internal and external.
* Implement customer\-focused abstractions that simplify and standardize the way we offer our cloud services, topologies and implementations.
* Coding IP tables and software defined networking
* Lead and defend technical decisions providing design justification, coordination, and identifying value and requirements for other teams in the organization.
* Learn and continue to foster an understanding of the long\-term needs of our infrastructure.
* Communicate to gather requirements and evangelize the Cloud offerings, and to understand gaps and improvements.
* Produce professional documentation and diagrams to clearly and concisely communicate concepts and architectures to infrastructure colleagues, in addition to our users.
* Manage and assist in the resolution of complicated technical problems and incidents, provide appropriate communication and escalation.
* Support and maintain our current infrastructure offerings to maintain a high level of service and availability to the rest of the organization.
* Develop strong and effective working relationships with the rest of the Infrastructure organization, Security, IT, business partners, stakeholders and vendors
* Keep up to date with current developments and best practices within our domain and make bold and forward\-looking recommendations.


**What we look for in you (ie. job requirements):**


* At least 5\+ years network engineering experience in industry
* Built systems on public cloud providers such as AWS, GCP or Azure
* Showcase strong proficiency within a modern tech stack, like Ruby, Go for languages and gRPC \+ Protobuf for communication.
* Showcase proficiency with low\-level primitives such as IP converged networks, AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct connect, IAM role management and implementation
* Know what high quality code — and software engineering processes — look like and know how to foster an environment that creates them.
* Exhibit our core values: clear communication, positive energy, continuous learning, and efficient execution.
* Flexibility to adapt and pivot in a dynamic and demanding environment where change is the only constant.
* Ability to set priorities and balance multiple deadlines.


**Nice to haves:**


* Crypto\-forward experience, including familiarity with onchain activity such as interacting with Ethereum addresses, using ENS, and engaging with dApps or blockchain\-based services.


Job \#: P61150


\*Answers to crypto\-related questions may be used to evaluate your onchain experience.





**Pay Transparency Notice:** Depending on your work location, the target annual salary for this position can range as detailed below. Full time offers from Coinbase also include target bonus \+ target equity \+ benefits (including medical, dental, vision and 401(k)).
Pay Range:
$186,065—$218,900 USD



Please be advised that each candidate may submit a maximum of four applications within any 30\-day period. We encourage you to carefully evaluate how your skills and interests align with Coinbase's roles before applying.


Commitment to Equal Opportunity
Coinbase is committed to diversity in its workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation or any other basis protected by applicable law. Coinbase will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.  For US applicants, you may view the Know Your Rights notice [here](%22https:/www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2022-10/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights_10_20.pdf%22).  Additionally, Coinbase participates in the [E\-Verify program](%22https:/static-assets.coinbase.com/e-verify.pdf%22) in certain locations, as required by law. 


Coinbase is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the employment process, please contact us at accommodations\[at]coinbase.com to let us know the nature of your request and your contact information.  For quick access to screen reading technology compatible with this site [click here to download](%22https:/chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/chromevox/kgejglhpjiefppelpmljglcjbhoiplfn%22) a free compatible screen reader [(free step by step tutorial can be found here)](%22http:/www.chromevox.com/tutorial/%22).


Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants
Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available [here](%22https:/www.coinbase.com/legal/applicant_privacy_notice%22). By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. **Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?**

**Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.**

You will:

* Provide support and training to enable effective use of sales systems.
* Maintain and optimize systems for sales (including functionalities for customer management, tour planning, promotion planning, listing maintenance, shelf audit and reporting).
* Provide support to users with specific technical problems in cooperation with IT service providers.

* Proven experience as a Data Analyst.
* Strong proficiency in Python and Power BI.
* Experience working with transaction, distributor, product, and outlet data.
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

* Experience with other data visualization tools.
* Experience with database management.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
About the job

The Senior Full Stack Developer will be responsible for the design, development, and maintenance of full\-stack web applications, focusing on both backend and frontend technologies. The position requires expertise in Node.js, Python, and cloud\-based solutions using AWS. The role involves collaborating with cross\-functional teams to implement scalable and secure solutions, optimizing system performance, and adhering to industry best practices.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and microservices using Node.js.
* Implement backend services with Python and frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or
* Flask.
* Develop modern, responsive frontends using frameworks such as React.js, Vue.js, or Angular.
* Manage databases, primarily focusing on DynamoDB, with experience in relational
* databases like PostgreSQL or MySQL.
* Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement CI/CD pipelines and ensure scalability, security, and system availability.
* Write and maintain unit and integration tests to ensure code quality.
* Participate in system architecture design, providing technical recommendations for business requirements.
* Optimize existing systems for performance and scalability.
* Adhere to development best practices, including code reviews and security protocols.
* Provide mentorship to junior developers as needed.

**Requirements**

* 5\+ years of experience as a Full Stack Developer.
* Strong proficiency in Node.js with frameworks like Express.js.
* Advanced expertise in Python with frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.
* Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and frontend frameworks like React.js, Vue.js, or Angular.
* Experience with DynamoDB and relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL).
* Proficiency with Git and familiarity with Agile methodologies.
* Experience with automated testing tools like Jest, PyTest, or similar.
* Expertise in Docker and Kubernetes for microservices orchestration.
* Strong experience with AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB).
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipeline implementation.
* Solid understanding of AWS cloud architecture and the ability to implement scalable solutions

Job Type: Full\-time

Expected hours: 20 per week

* Competitive USD Salary

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Founded in 2014, we strive to create something magical in SEMISOFT with a limited number of core team members. We have grown our portfolio to numerous game genres published on a variety of platforms. Please check out our games at Steam, GOG, Playstation, Nintendo Switch, Xbox, Google Play Store, and Apple Appstore!

 **Job Description**

About the Role:  
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to support our game development and live operations teams, automated infrastructure and deployment pipelines. You will ensure our online services and game backend are reliable, scalable, and secure.

You’ll work closely with developers and infrastructure teams to help us deploy faster, minimize downtime, and deliver seamless experiences to millions of players.

We expect you posses  

* Advanced knowledge of Linux
* Experience with continuous integration/delivery implementation (Gitlab, Jenkins, Bitbucket) and DevOps practices
* Previous experience with IaC tools (Terraform, Ansible)
* Experience working in cloud environment (AWS, Azure)
* Good understanding of the core components of AWS EKS, Azure Aks, Kubernetes
* Knowledge of Docker (building images, optimization, scaling, automation, registry, clustering)
* Great problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
* Good English

We would appreciate you have  
+ Experience with Python/Perl (or any other scripting language)  
+ General understanding of how API works  
+ Knowledge of network (firewalls, protocols and routing)

 **Qualifications**

**Technical Skills:**

* 2+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
* Proficiency in managing cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Strong scripting skills (e.g., Bash, Python, or Go).
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
* Knowledge of networking, security best practices, and system administration.

**Nice-to-Have for Game Industry:**

* Experience with multiplayer server infrastructure (e.g., Photon, PlayFab, Nakama, or custom game servers).
* Familiarity with game engine build pipelines (Unity, Unreal).
* Understanding of backend scaling for high-traffic environments (MMOs, battle royale, etc.).
* Knowledge of CDN and latency optimization for global game delivery.

title: Kubernetes DevOps Engineer (Middle)
description:
**Salary Range: Rp.8.000.000 - Rp.12.000.000**

**About Lyrid**

Lyrid is building the future of cloud infrastructure—open, distributed, and Kubernetes-powered. We’re a product-driven company on a mission to make cloud deployments seamless, portable, and vendor-neutral. Our platform abstracts the complexity of infrastructure across public clouds, edge environments, and bare metal—powered entirely by CNCF tools.

We don’t use managed services. We build everything from the ground up using open-source technologies. And we’re looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who thrives in that world—to help us architect, scale, and evolve the Lyrid platform itself.

**Why This Role Matters**

As one of the early platform engineers at Lyrid, you’ll work directly on the core systems that power our multi-cloud orchestration platform. You’ll shape the architecture, evaluate new CNCF projects, and contribute to building a platform used by startups and enterprises alike.

**What You’ll Do**

* Architect and operate multi-cloud, Kubernetes-native infrastructure that powers Lyrid’s core products
* Own GitOps workflows (ArgoCD, Flux), infrastructure templating (Helm/Kustomize), and multi-cluster rollout strategies
* Drive adoption of observability stacks using Prometheus, Loki, OpenTelemetry, and other CNCF projects
* Evaluate, test, and integrate emerging CNCF tools—we actively explore the edge of the ecosystem
* Collaborate with engineering and product teams to ship features that depend on scalable, secure, and fast infrastructure
* Contribute to Lyrid’s Infrastructure-as-Product mindset by codifying and packaging infrastructure capabilities for customer use

**We’d Love to See**

* 2+ years working with Kubernetes in production (across public cloud or bare metal)
* Experience with Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm, or similar CNCF-native tools
* Comfort designing fault-tolerant systems, debugging distributed issues, and scaling infrastructure
* Startup or product company experience is a big plus—especially where you’ve built something from scratch

Bonus: Exposure to projects like Rook-CEPH, Percona, GRPC, KeyCloak, Harbor, Elastic (we’re always exploring new CNCF tools)

**Culture Fit at Lyrid**

This isn’t your typical DevOps role. We are:

* Open-source first – we build with and contribute to CNCF technologies
* Builder-driven – if you prefer assembling primitives to consuming black-box services, you’ll thrive here
* Cloud-agnostic – AWS, Azure, GCP, edge, bare metal—it doesn’t matter as long as it runs Kubernetes
* Explorers – we actively explore and integrate bleeding-edge CNCF tools and patterns

If you’re excited by the idea of building infrastructure platforms as products—not just operating them—you’re the kind of person we want on our team.

p.s. we are crazy fun to work with! we are truly just a bunch of jokers and we joke around A LOT (like a lot a lot). you'll be surprised by how chill we all are BUT we also make sure our jobs are done cause we all got bills to pay lol :')

title: Junior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
description:
**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Ensure the availability and reliability of services in accordance with defined SLA/SLO/SLI by continuously monitoring production systems and applications, and implementing effective alerting mechanisms.
2. Handle production incidents through participation in on-call rotations. Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to prevent recurrence and improve incident response processes and documentation.
3. Develop automation for deployment, scaling, failover, and monitoring, using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, Chef, or Puppet. Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support seamless software delivery.
4. Monitor and proactively improve system performance. Work closely with development teams to ensure systems are scalable and resilient, and conduct regular benchmarking and stress testing.
5. Plan future system capacity based on projected growth, and optimize cloud or data center resources to ensure cost efficiency.
6. Implement and monitor operational security measures, including patching, access control, and audit logging. Collaborate with the security team to comply with industry standards such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2, and manage sensitive data securely.
7. Collaborate with both Development and Operations teams by adopting a DevOps mindset. Facilitate a smooth release process and contribute to system design and architectural discussions.
8. Build and maintain observability systems that include logging, metrics, and tracing using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, OpenTelemetry, or the ELK stack. Ensure observability is integrated into both development and operational pipelines.
9. Maintain clear and thorough documentation for systems, operational procedures, and incident postmortems. Share knowledge regularly to improve team capabilities and foster a culture of continuous learning.

**Requirements:**

*This job might be fit for you if*

1. Have 1–3 years of experience as an SRE, DevOps Engineer, or in a similar software engineering role.
2. Possess strong programming skills and experience with scripting languages, especially Shell scripting.
3. Have a solid understanding of Linux operating system internals, filesystems, disk/storage technologies, and networking.
4. Have mandatory experience working with AWS and/or other cloud platforms.
5. Proficient with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions (mandatory).
6. Have hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, Chef, or Puppet.
7. Have mandatory experience working with Docker and containerization technologies.
8. Experienced in analyzing, monitoring, and troubleshooting large-scale, high-traffic distributed systems.
9. Have good knowledge of distributed service architectures, including load balancing, service discovery, caching, and tracing.
10. Have familiarity with security tools such as Sonar, Trivy, and Aqua Security (considered a plus).

description:

Jakarta, Jakarta Raya, Indonesia

**Job ID:**

R0096687

2025-06-18

**Company Name:**

PT. HITACHI SAKTI ENERGY INDONESIA

**Profession (Job Category):**

Engineering & Science

**Job Schedule:**

Full time

**Remote:**

No

**Job Description:**

**The opportunity:**

We are looking for a dynamic SCADA Engineer with high technical acumen passionate about working on SCADA EMS/GMS Projects in power utility environment. Exciting opportunity in learning and delivering SCADA Power Network Management technology for major power generation utility with state-of-the-art control center infrastructure environment.

**How you'll make an impact:**

- You will be working closely with Project Technical Lead for delivery of project deliverables at customer site.
- You will configure Network Manager SCADA Database/HMI/displays, maintenance of the SCADA and Front-End System, historical archiving and report creation and management of SCADA Applications – Alarm/Events, SOE, Trends, Operator Notes, monitoring/Control, Historical Playback.
- You will support EMS/DMS Engineer in application tuning, supervise installation of IT hardware, servers, workstations and displays, testing SCADA Applications at different stages of Project Life Cycle and backup/ Image handling on servers and workstations and patch management.
- You will be supporting SCADA EMS expert during System Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).
- You will coordinate for delivery of customer trainings and workshops, follow up with client/consultant for status of design file approvals and comments and assist in problem solving and providing solutions.
- You will cooperate with other teams in different business units and locations, must have people skills, in particular the ability to work with both international customers and suppliers as a SCADA/EMS/DMS Systems Engineer and consistent reporting of updates from site.
- You will be responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

**Your background:**

- You hold a Bachelor of Engineering degree in Electrical/Electronics/Telecommunication/Computer Science/IT.
- Minimum 10 years of overall experience, with 5 years in SCADA Control Centre environment for utilities.
- SCADA, IT background (Virtualization, Database, Network, Cyber Security), Front End Configuration (FEP) Networking, Database & Display. Knowledge of IEC 60870 104, IEC 60870 101, IEC 60870-5-103, DNP 3 serial, DNP 3 Ethernet, HNZ, ICCP protocols and CCNA certification. IT-Infrastructure with knowledge of Servers, Virtualization, Networking, Cloud Infrastructure Firewalls and workstations.
- Exposure to Cyber Security. Experience in Control Centre SCADA configuration, tuning & testing, experience in Control Centre System Maintenance and preference will be given for experience of working in Indonesia Control Centre environment, knowledge of power systems engineering and control systems. Control Centre SCADA system knowledge of any OEM Hitachi Energy/ABB, Siemens, Areva/Alstom, GE, Schneider. Knowledge of SCADA Control Centre Application (Hitachi Energy / ABB NM knowledge is an advantage).
- MS-Office: Word, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, willingness to travel, work and coordinate with teams in multiple time zones. Customer engagement, communication and presentation skills and Self-starter caliber who could own tasks through to completion.
- Proficient in English and Indonesian, able to communicate in an international setting where you will need to collaborate with people from APAC, SWEDEN & USA. Capable of translating technical documents from English to Indonesian and vice versa.

Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

title: Network Security Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**PT. Nusa Network Prakarsa**
is a leading provider of cost-effective solutions for building and maintaining network infrastructure. With a professional team experienced in IT sales and technical aspects, we cater to small to medium-sized businesses with new sealed, open box, used, and refurbished systems. Based in Jakarta, Indonesia, Nusa Network is known for its industry leadership and dedication to serving its valued client base.

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a
**proactive and skilled Network & Security Engineer**
to join our team in a
**hybrid work environment**
. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in
**deploying and managing firewalls, Web Application Firewalls (WAFs), and mail security gateways**
. A valid
**NSE4 or PCNSA**
certification is required, while
**NSE7 or PCNSE**
will be considered a strong advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Install, configure, and maintain:
* **Firewalls**
  (Fortinet FortiGate, Palo Alto)
* **Web Application Firewalls (WAFs)**
  (e.g., FortiWeb, Imperva, Cloudflare)
* **Mail Security Gateways**
  (e.g., FortiMail, Cisco ESA, Proofpoint)
* Manage VPNs, NAT policies, ACLs, and network segmentation.
* Monitor and respond to network and security incidents.
* Conduct system performance tuning and troubleshooting.
* Maintain and update documentation of network configurations and policies.
* Collaborate with internal teams to enforce security best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* **2–3 years**
  of experience in network and security engineering.
* **Must have at least one**
  of the following certifications:

**Fortinet NSE4**

**Palo Alto PCNSA**

* Proven experience in:
* Firewall deployment and configuration in enterprise environments.
* WAF and mail security gateway implementation.
* Working with network protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing).
* Strong troubleshooting, analysis, and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)**

* Additional certifications:

**Fortinet NSE7**

**Palo Alto PCNSE**

* Familiarity with security standards and frameworks (e.g.,
  **ISO/IEC 27001**
  ).
* Experience with SIEM tools (e.g., FortiAnalyzer, Splunk, Wazuh).
* Exposure to
  **cloud security**
  (e.g.,
  **Azure NSG**
  ,
  **AWS Security Groups**
  ).

**Working Conditions**

* **Hybrid Work Model:**
  3 days onsite (Jakarta office), 2 days remote per week.
* Flexibility for off-hour work during system maintenance or incident response.

title: Flutter Mobile | Web Developer
description:
If you are an experienced mobile developer, are fluent with Dart and Flutter, and aching to stay at the forefront of mobile and cloud technologies, this opportunity might be for you.

Our Client is one of the largest energy companies in South East Asia and we are developing their Customer-facing system, front-to-back. An exciting and challenging enterprise architecture using Flutter mobile and Flutter Web for all of its front-end components.

On this project, your duties and responsibilities will include:

* participating in the overall design of the platform architecture using Flutter, Dart, REST and pub-sub middleware connectivity
* developing new screens and components using Dart
* occasionally integrating native platform functionalities (iOS and Android) into the cross-platform codebase
* sharing progress and issues on Agile/Scrum team dynamics
* liaising with management, client and beta users
* occasionally mentoring and advising junior team members.

Due to the intense nature of the work involved, we can only accept candidates who will commit to work with us on a full-time basis (40 hours a week). Both the project and role are **not** suitable as a side gig.

  

Minimum Qualifications: We are looking for a skilled and passionate Flutter/Dart Developer with:

* 5 to 7 years of software development experience as a mobile, web, or full-stack developer
* At least 3 years of experience with the Flutter framework and toolchain, and with the Dart language
* Familiarity with mobile UX design and Interaction Design principles
* A solid understanding of object-oriented programing principles and design patterns
* Experience with unit testing, CI/CD and mobile build tools
* Familiarity with at least one commercial cloud platform: AWS, Azure, GCP
* An ability to understand software requirements, problem-solve, deliver and test quality code with minimal supervision
* Experience with collaborative development in distributed teams
* At least working knowledge of the English language

Direct experience or knowledge of one or more of the following is highly desirable:

* server-side Dart (e.g. Conduit), memory management, cross-isolate communications, etc.
* native Android and iOS development
* Python (with data science, parallel computing packages) or JavaScript/TypeScript
* relational databases (e.g. Postgres) and SQL, document databases (e.g. Mongo)
* messaging middleware (e.g. RabbitMQ, Kafka).

  
We are a boutique software consultancy with offices in Singapore, the UK, and the Philippines. We specialise in enterprise platforms that perform well, scale better and are easy to maintain. We use state-of-the-art mobile, web, and distributed/cloud computing technologies. Our Clients include established companies and start-ups in the financial services, energy, telecoms and media sectors, in the US, Europe and Asia. Robust delivery and Client satisfaction are only one side of the story - we aim to give our Software Consultants an environment where they can grow, be productive, and be happy. We love to work as a Team but we want individual talent and aspirations to shine. We are currently 100% remote.
extracted_skills: Python, Data Science, SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, iOS, Android, AWS, Azure, GCP, CI/CD

title: Cyber Security Analyst Head – Level 2 (Red Team Lead / Offensive Security)
description:
Job Title: Head Cyber Security Analyst – Level 2 (Red Team Lead / Offensive Security)

**Location**
: Jakarta, Indonesia

**Type**
: Full-time (On-site / Hybrid)

**Reports To**
: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)

**About ZENTARA**

ZENTARA is an elite cybersecurity startup designing next-generation defense and intelligence tools. As we build our red team from zero, we’re looking for an 
**offensive security leader**
 who can simulate real-world adversaries, train future pentesters, and lead high-impact red team ops.

**Role Overview**

As the Head of Red Team, you’ll lead offensive security for ZENTARA’s internal systems and for clients. From adversary simulation and custom tooling to ethical exploits and breach & attack simulations — you will guide how we ethically break, learn, and improve our defenses.

You will report directly to the CISO and collaborate with the Blue Team (Head L1), R&D, and client delivery units to test assumptions, measure response, and close gaps.

**Key Responsibilities**

**▸ Offensive Operations**

* Plan and execute full-scope red team engagements (external, internal, physical)
* Lead all penetration testing: web, mobile, API, cloud, infrastructure
* Build TTP emulation based on APTs and MITRE ATT&CK chains

**▸ Threat Simulation & Adversary R&D**

* Develop or modify custom exploits, payloads, or C2 infrastructure for internal use
* Guide R&D team in developing red-team-enabling tools and platforms
* Coordinate purple team exercises with Blue Team and test detection logic

**▸ Compliance-Aware Offense**

* Ensure all engagements align with legal, ethical, and compliance boundaries (ISO, NIST)
* Simulate attacks in a controlled way without risk to systems or data
* Support audits and client documentation with risk impact assessments

**Leadership & Mentorship**

* Build and manage a team of offensive security professionals (pentesters, malware analysts, red teamers)
* Mentor juniors and generalist L2s into specialized offensive roles
* Provide executive reports on offensive results, gaps, and improvement recommendations

**Minimum Qualifications**

* **5+ years**
   in offensive security, red teaming, or advanced penetration testing
* Hands-on with tools like 
  **Burp Suite Pro, Metasploit, Cobalt Strike, Nuclei, Nmap**
* Experience in scripting, exploit development, and APT simulation

**Required Certifications**

Candidates 
**must hold at least three**
 of the following offensive security certifications:

* **OSCP**
   – Offensive Security Certified Professional
* **OSWE**
   – Offensive Security Web Expert
* **OSCE**
   / 
  **OSEP**
   – Offensive Security Exploitation certifications
* **OSEP**
  - Offsec Experienced Penetration Tester
* **CRTA**
  - Certified Red Team Analyst
* **CPENT**
  - Certified Penetration Testing Professional
* **eWPTxV2**
  - eLearnSecurity Web application Penetration Tester eXtreme
* **CND**
  - Certified Network Defender
* **CRTP**
   – Certified Red Team Professional
* **GPEN**
   – GIAC Penetration Tester
* **CEH-**
   Certified Ethical Hacker

***Applications without valid certifications will not be considered.***

***You will be asked to provide evidence during the screening process.***

* Deep familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK, PTES, OWASP Top 10
* Experience coordinating purple team or detection bypass efforts

**Why Join ZENTARA?**

* Design the offensive strategy of Indonesia’s most ambitious cybersecurity company
* Work with real-world threat data and highly sensitive environments
* Get the freedom to innovate — and the team to scale your vision
* Competitive salary + THR + BPJS + Leave + Growth bonuses
* A seat at the table shaping how ZENTARA grows, hires, trains, and scales

**How to Apply**

Please send your 
**CV and cover letter**
 to: 
**ceo@zentara.id**

Subject Line: Application – Head Security Analyst L2 – [Your Name]

In your cover letter (no more than 300 words), briefly answer the following:

1. What types of offensive engagements have you led (e.g., web, mobile, APT simulation)?
2. Which offensive security tools are you most comfortable with, and why?
3. Describe a red teaming challenge you solved creatively.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

**Job summary**

Lead red team ops at ZENTARA. Simulate real threats, build tools, and drive offensive security strategy.
