description:
We are currently looking for exceptional and experienced Indonesian Senior DevOps Engineers to join our Awesome FlexiDev Engineering Team.

**In this role you will:**

* Run day-to-day DevOps activities, working closely with the engineering team.
* Provide technical support. Engage directly with clients regarding infrastructure, incidents, outages, and change management.
* Produce and maintain system specifications and documentation by conferring with users; analysing workflow, access, information, and security requirements; and designing systems infrastructure.
* Automate and improve development of build and release pipelines.
* Establish systems by planning and executing the selection, installation, configuration, and testing of cloud-based infrastructure, defining system and operational policies and procedures.
* Maintain system performance through systems monitoring and analysis, and performance tuning; troubleshoot systems hardware, software, networks and operating and system management systems; design and run system load/stress testing; report application issues to vendors; patch management and general maintenance.
* Secure systems by developing systems access protocols, through various controls, monitoring and evaluation; establish and test disaster recovery policies and procedures.
* Upgrade systems by conferring with vendors as regards services; developing, testing, evaluating, and installing enhancements and new software.

**General requirements:**

* **Minimum 10 years of experience**
  in a related field is required for this position
* **Fluent in English**
  – both oral and written communication skills
* Strong competency in operating
  **Azure Cloud infrastructure or AWS**
* Strong competency with
  **Container Concepts**
  (Docker, Kubernetes, Azure App Services, etc.)
* Strong knowledge of computer networking (IP, DNS, HTTP, SSL, TLS)
* Strong knowledge of web server operations (Nginx, Apache)
* Familiar with SQL Server Databases
* Experience with Source Control (Git, Bitbucket, etc.)
* Experience with
  **Pipeline Automation (CI) & Orchestration (CD) (such as Azure DevOps Pipelines and Jenkins)**

**At FlexiDev we offer our teams a range of comprehensive benefits:**

* **Full-time permanent opportunities**
   that allow you to 
  **work remotely**
   from virtually any suitable work location.
* Competitive salaries and comprehensive healthcare coverage through BPJS for all our employees.
* High-spec device allocation to your remote workplace as standard.
* Support from highly experienced industry leaders within Indonesia and in other countries.
* Professional development through 
  **weekly Business English**
   classes, which include both private and group programs. The training you receive strengthens effective communication within teams.
* The opportunity to work with international clients.
* Weekly drop-in Discussion and Sharing sessions, covering interesting topics that reflect our team’s needs and passions. This reflects our 
  **core values**
   of 
  **sharing knowledge**
  , 
  **intellectual growth**
  .
* A collaborative project environment with supportive teammates.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a highly skilled
**Senior DevOps Engineer**
to maintain and optimize the infrastructure and deployment pipelines for our AI-powered applications. This role focuses on ensuring high availability, cost-efficiency, and operational excellence across all components of a SaaS or PaaS infrastructure. You will play a key role in defining and implementing infrastructure best practices, driving automation, and enabling engineering teams to ship code confidently at scale. Must be excellent in a cloud provider its services, ranging from databases, load balancers, VPCs, compute instances, and data warehousing.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**• Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**

Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation to support repeatable, version-controlled infrastructure deployment.

•
**Cloud Computing**

Create and maintain cloud infrastructure. Must be an expert in infrastructure architecture, such as serverless deployments, Kubernetes clusters, image registries, ETL pipelines, and data warehousing.

•
**Containerization & Deployment Automation**

Build and manage containerized environments using Docker, supporting efficient, portable, and consistent application deployments across environments.

•
**CI/CD Pipeline Engineering**

Maintain and improve CI/CD systems to support automated testing, container building, deployment orchestration, and release workflows for AI and web applications.

•
**Monitoring, Observability & APM**

Implement and maintain full-stack observability tools, including application performance monitoring (APM), infrastructure telemetry, and distributed tracing for proactive alerting and debugging.

•
**Operational Excellence**

Drive best practices for high-availability design, failover strategies, performance tuning, and cloud cost optimization.

•
**Security-First / Zero Trust**

Create and enforce a secure environment using best practices, such as using a secret management software, secretless methods of authentication, and managing configurations in systems.

•
**Mentorship & Technical Leadership**

Mentor engineers on DevOps tools and workflows, promote a culture of automation and ownership, and serve as the subject matter expert on infrastructure and deployment strategy.

•
**Team Collaboration**

Work closely with AI/ML engineers, backend, and product teams to ensure seamless infrastructure integration and deployment flows.

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Must-Have Skills:**

• 5+ years of experience in DevOps or infrastructure engineering

• Strong experience with cloud platforms: AWS, GCP, and/or Alicloud

• Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation

• Deep expertise in Docker and container-based deployment strategies

• Advanced skills in Linux system administration and Bash scripting

• Strong experience with CI/CD platforms and automation workflows

• Hands-on knowledge of observability stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog, New Relic)

**Nice-to-Have Skills:**

• Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure and GPU workload management

• Experience implementing autoscaling and spot instance optimization strategies

• Exposure to Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms

• Knowledge of distributed systems and service reliability practices (SRE)

description:
Fondasys is a forward-thinking IT service provider dedicated to empowering businesses to grow through innovative, scalable, and user-centric web applications.

We are looking for a talented Fullstack Developer with expertise in Next.js and headless CMS to join our team and help us push the boundaries of modern web development. As a Fullstack Developer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance web applications. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver robust, scalable, and visually appealing solutions that meet our clients' needs.

Responsibilities

* Develop and maintain modern, responsive, and scalable web applications using Next.js.
* Integrate and manage Headless CMS solutions (e.g., Strapi, Sanity, Payloadcms & Directus ) to enable dynamic content management.
* Optimize applications for maximum speed, scalability, and SEO performance.
* Implement server-side rendering (SSR) and Incremental Static Regeneration (ISR) using Next.js.
* Build reusable components and libraries for future use.
* Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs and implement them with high-quality code.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across the stack.
* Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in Next.js, Headless CMS, and web development.

Requirements

* 1 years experience in Nextjs
* 1 - 2 year experience in React
* Experience in APl integration
* Understanding of git and version control.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills
* Familiarity with headless CMS
* Familiarity with database systems (e.g., PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
* Understanding of web performance optimization techniques.
* **Good to have:**
  Expertise with UI/UX Design using Figma.

What we Offer

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Flexible working hours and remote work options.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* A collaborative and innovative work environment.
* The chance to work on exciting projects with cutting-edge technologies.

How to Apply

If you’re passionate about building modern web applications and have the skills we’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you! Please send your resume, portfolio, and a brief cover letter to millenno@fondasys.com

title: Data Engineer
description:
As an Enterprise Data Engineer, you’ll be instrumental in the development and maintenance of Data pipelines for the Finance Function of GoTo that supports Accounting, Planning and Taxation functions to automate various processes and providing data required for finance reporting.

### **What You Will Do**

* + Design end-to-end scalable data infrastructure, including Data Warehouse (DWH) and analytics architecture.
  + Build and maintain integrated data pipelines that support complex business and financial operations.
  + Develop high-quality code and scripts using SQL and Python for data processing and automation.
  + Create and optimize data solutions such as databases, dashboards, and analytics tools to meet evolving business needs.
  + Conduct system and integration testing, ensuring compliance with organizational standards for metadata and access protocols.
  + Implement robust data quality checks and monitoring systems for efficient data collection, storage, and retrieval.
  + Collaborate with Engineering and cross-functional teams to align on data architecture, governance, and best practices.
  + Analyze complex datasets to uncover insights, resolve issues, and support data-driven decision-making across domains.
  + Drive innovation by contributing to open-source projects and advancing internal data tools and practices.

### **What You Will Need**

* + 2+ years of experience as a Data Engineer with a degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Informatics, or a related field.
  + Strong knowledge of big data stacks and tools, including:
  + **- Big Data DBs:** MaxCompute (AliCloud), BigQuery (GCP), Azure (MS)
  + **- Distributed systems:** Spark, Hadoop, Presto, Hive
  + **- Message queueing:** Kafka, NSQL
  + **- Databases:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, Cassandra
  + **- Data pipeline tools:** Airflow
  + **- Languages:** Python, Java, C++, Scala
  + Proficient in SQL, data programming, and building relational database queries.
  + Deep understanding of data architecture, database structures, warehousing, and data mining concepts.
  + Skilled in designing, building, and optimizing scalable data pipelines and infrastructure.
  + Experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred) and UNIX environments.
  + Ability to implement robust data quality checks, monitoring, and automation processes.
  + Strong analytical skills for investigating issues and identifying patterns in complex data sets.
  + Excellent communication and teamwork skills in cross-functional and international settings.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Junior)
description:
**Job Description**

We are seeking a highly skilled SRE Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in delivering exceptional managed services to our clients. As a key member of our engineering team, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining robust and scalable infrastructure solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS).

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, build, and maintain highly available, scalable, and performant platform components and shared services.
* Define, monitor, and report on key Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) relevant to platform health and customer experience.
* Identify and eliminate single points of failure across the infrastructure.
* Participate in a rotating on-call schedule to provide after-hours support and incident response as needed.
* Implement and improve monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to gain deep visibility into platform health, resource utilization, and potential issues
  *including those triggered by customer activity*
  .
* Automate repetitive operational tasks ("toil") related to platform management, provisioning, scaling, and healing.
* Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and CI/CD pipeline to manage the platform infrastructure consistently and reliably.
* Participate in incident response, troubleshooting, and resolution efforts for platform issues.
* Collaborate with Customer Success teams to diagnose and resolve complex platform issues that may be related to customer-specific configurations or usage.
* Contribute to the architectural design and evolution of the platform, focusing on resilience, multi-tenancy best practices, and supportability under varying customer loads.
* Perform capacity planning to ensure the platform can handle anticipated customer growth and usage patterns.

**Qualifications:**

* at least 2+ years of Site Reliability Engineer, DevOps Engineer, or similar role supporting production systems.
* Experience working with cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Alibaba, Azure).
* Strong understanding of monitoring, logging, and alerting principles and tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog).
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Pulumi).
* Solid scripting and automation skills (Python, Go, Bash).
* Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Swarm, Kubernetes).
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and practices.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, databases, and distributed systems.
* Experience participating in on-call rotations.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.
* A passion for automation and continuous improvement.
* A proactive approach in problem identification and resolution - don’t wait around, grab & fix it.
* A learning attitude.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certifications in GCP or AWS.
* Experience working directly with customer-facing teams.
* Experience defining and tracking customer-facing SLOs.
* Experience providing self-service tooling or observability insights to customers.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization strategies.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
**Junior Data Analyst | Help Us Turn Data Into Decisions @ Grivy**

Are you obsessed with data, dashboards, and decoding customer behavior? Want to make an impact in a fast-paced, data-hungry startup? At Grivy, we’re looking for a Junior Data Analyst who’s ready to grow fast, learn faster, and turn raw numbers into actionable gold.

At Grivy, we bridge the gap between brands and consumers with intelligent, real-time marketing solutions. You’ll be part of a dynamic team that thrives on insight, creativity, and impact.

**Role:**

As a Junior Data Analyst at Grivy, you will be responsible for analyzing data, executing campaigns, and supporting the data-driven decision-making process. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless data workflows and contribute to the technical setups needed to run successful campaigns.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Perform detailed data analysis for multiple campaigns weekly, and create corresponding campaign analysis documents.
* Implement integrations with media platforms like Meta and manage data flows with paid media agencies and retailers.
* Use GitHub and CircleCI to manage data workflows and automate processes.
* Analyze large datasets using BigQuery and Firestore, ensuring efficient data flows across platforms.
* Provide visual insights through Looker, aligning data with campaign strategies and business objectives.
* Submit change requests and bug reports, contributing to feature development by working with the outsourced engineering team.
* Collaborate with sales, campaign teams, and external partners to align data strategies with overall business goals.
* Assist in technical setups, configurations, and tracking mechanisms for campaigns to ensure accurate data flow and execution.
* Participate in briefings for new campaigns, providing data-driven feedback on campaign feasibility and potential success based on historical data.
* Communicate insights effectively to internal stakeholders and clients, ensuring a clear understanding of data’s role in campaign success.
* Advise clients and internal teams on data-driven improvements and insights to optimize campaign performance.

﻿

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
* 2 years of relevant experience, ideally in data analysis or digital marketing.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools (Python, SQL) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience with data visualization tools (Looker or similar).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience working with large datasets.
* Excellent communication skills to explain data insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

title: Data Ops Engineer
description:
Veyor is a unique and rapidly growing cloud based mobile platform for managing complex construction activity in the field. Veyor connects the full construction workforce with the supply chain in real time enabling the efficient management of highly dynamic environments. The platform incorporates scheduling, live tracking, safety processes and valuable data collection and analysis for optimisation of projects and future planning. The platform has also been embraced by Shopping Centres and Airports to manage their daily loading dock operations.
  
  
We're looking for a skilled and motivated Cloud Infrastructure & Data Engineer to join our SaaS company, built entirely on AWS. In this role, you'll be instrumental in maintaining and evolving our existing CloudFormation-defined infrastructure, as well as building and optimizing our critical ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes.
  
  
If you're passionate about robust, scalable cloud solutions and enjoy the challenge of turning raw data into actionable insights, we want to hear from you!
  
  
**The Role**

* Maintain, optimize, and troubleshoot our existing AWS environment, which is fully defined and managed through CloudFormation scripts. You'll ensure high availability, performance, and cost-efficiency.
* Be an iInfrastructure as Code (IaC) Champion. Author, update, and review CloudFormation templates for provisioning new resources and modifying existing ones, ensuring best practices and security standards are met.
* Maintain and enhance the Data Pipeline. Develop, and maintain robust and efficient ETL pipelines to move and transform data from various sources into our data stores.
* Identify and implement improvements to our data ingestion and processing workflows, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Work closely with our development and product teams to understand their infrastructure and data needs, providing expert guidance and implementing effective solutions.
* Proactively monitor the health and performance of our AWS infrastructure and data pipelines, responding to incidents and resolving issues promptly

**Ideal Profile**

* You possess a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar field.
* You are an AWS Certified DevOps Engineer—Professional.
* You have proven experience with a wide range of AWS services (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, VPC, IAM, CloudWatch, SQS, SNS).
* You have expert-level proficiency in authoring, deploying, and managing AWS infrastructure using CloudFormation.
* You have strong Python programming skills that are essential for both infrastructure automation and data engineering tasks.
* You have working knowledge of working with SQL and NoSQL databases
* You demonstrated experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL processes, ideally with tools and frameworks relevant to AWS (e.g., AWS Glue, Lambda, Step Functions).
* You have a strong analytical mindset with excellent troubleshooting and debugging skills.
* You have the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You are enthusiastic about collaborating with a cross-functional team in an agile environment.

**It's Preferable If You Have**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect—Associate.
* AWS Certified Data Engineer—Associate.
* Experience with other IaC tools like Terraform
* Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and technologies.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure deployments

**What's on Offer?**

* Competitive salary and equity in an fast growing startup with global growth strategy
* Join a company with Global Growth across APAC, America and EMEA
* Flexible working options

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

Indas Technologies adalah sebuah startup yang mendorong industri menjadi lebih cerdas dengan mengimplementasikan teknologi mutakhir. Kami sedang mencari Senior Data Engineer yang berpengalaman untuk bergabung dalam tim data kami. Kandidat ideal memiliki keahlian dalam teknologi big data seperti Apache Spark, pemrosesan data skala besar, data warehousing, serta integrasi database Oracle. Pengalaman dan sertifikasi cloud (AWS, GCP, atau Azure) sangat diutamakan.

Posisi: Senior Data Engineer

Lokasi: Jakarta, Indonesia

Tipe Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu

Tingkat Pengalaman: Senior

Tanggung Jawab:

* Membangun dan memimpin tim data engineering dari awal.
* Merancang dan membangun pipeline data yang skalabel dan andal.
* Mengembangkan proses ETL/ELT menggunakan Apache Spark.
* Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan solusi data warehouse untuk memastikan kualitas dan ketersediaan data.
* Melakukan integrasi data dari berbagai sumber termasuk database Oracle dan API eksternal.
* Bekerja sama dengan tim data analyst, data scientist, dan engineer lainnya untuk mendukung inisiatif berbasis data.
* Menjamin keamanan dan kepatuhan data sesuai standar perusahaan.
* Melakukan deployment dan monitoring solusi data di lingkungan cloud (AWS, GCP, atau Azure).

Kualifikasi:

* Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.
* Pengalaman kerja minimal 5 tahun di bidang data engineering.
* Menguasai Apache Spark dan arsitektur data pipeline.
* Memiliki pemahaman kuat tentang SQL dan konsep data warehousing, terutama dengan Oracle.
* Berpengalaman menggunakan platform cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Memiliki sertifikasi cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure) menjadi nilai tambah utama.
* Pengalaman dengan tools seperti Apache Airflow, DBT, atau sejenisnya merupakan nilai tambah.

Nilai Tambah:

* Pengalaman dengan platform data streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, dll).
* Kemampuan scripting dengan Python atau SQL untuk keperluan data engineering.

Mengapa Bergabung dengan Kami:

* Kesempatan untuk bekerja dalam tim yang inovatif dan teknologi mutakhir.
* Lingkungan kerja fleksibel dan mendukung pengembangan karier.
* Paket kompensasi dan benefit yang kompetitif.

Cara daftar

Mohon kirimkan CV dan perkenalan singkat ke jobs@indas.ai. Kami nantikan kandidat terbaik yang ingin ikut berkontribusi memajukan industri di Indonesia.

title: Site Reliability Engineer (Marketplace) - Sea Labs
description:
**About The Team**
The Engineering and Technology team is at the core of the Shopee platform development. The team is made up of a group of passionate engineers from all over the world, striving to build the best systems with the most suitable technologies. Our engineers do not merely solve problems at hand; We build foundations for a long-lasting future. We don't limit ourselves on what we can or can't do; we take matters into our own hands even if it means drilling down to the bottom layer of the computing platform. Shopee's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience it first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do.
  
  
**About Team**
The mission of SRE (Site Reliability Engineer) team is to ensure the efficient and sustainable operation of Shopee 24x7, as well as to build and maintain large-scale, highly available, high-performance distributed systems based on system availability and performance. It is formed by combining traditional software engineering and technical operation. The SRE team needs to dive deep into the Shopee development lines to ensure that the system is highly scalable under rapid evolution of the System. From the perspective of stability and performance, it includes the design of business development, components of the basic platform (middleware, container scheduling, caching, object storage, etc.), OS optimization, data center and network optimisation. We optimise the inefficient and complicated operation in the traditional operation and maintenance mode through engineering and service means, and are committed to building a sound monitoring system to improve the efficiency of incident handling.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Deep dive into development lines, learn and understand the mechanism of every application component, and promote product scalability, stability, and performance
* Set up, manage, and maintain Shopee product/middleware/big-data applications and services
* Perform regular and ad-hoc server-side deployments, make improvements of the performance, and troubleshoot
* Design and develop automated technical operation platform
* Manage Capacity and Resource
* Responsible for the full-chain stress test to enhance the performance and remove redundancy of applications
* Prepare routine operation documentation

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or related fields
* More than 2 years of relevant experience (candidates with no working experience are welcomed to apply)
* Extensive and hands-on knowledge with Linux operating systems (Ubuntu, CentOS, etc.)
* Highly familiar with Computer Network (TCP/IP, DNS, etc.), Computer Organisations, and OS
* Hands-on experience with at least one of the programming languages: Bash, Python, Go
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to thrive in a dynamic work environment
* Passionate and possess a strong sense of responsibility
* Fast learning ability and a good team player
* Agile and detail-oriented

**Skills Below Are Optional But Preferred**

* Experience with automation tools like Ansible, SaltStack
* Experience with monitoring tools like Prometheus, Zabbix, Grafana etc
* Experience with load balancing tools like LVS, Nginx, Openresty or HAProxy
* Experience with container technology such as Docker, Kubernetes
* Experience with High Availability system design and Server Deployment Process
* Experience with SRE
* Experience with Ops Paas platform or Ops automation platform (ie:CMDB)

title: Senior QA Engineer (Automation)
description:
We are looking for a Quality Assurance Engineer who is meticulous and purpose-driven to ensure that the quality of any software product developed internally lives up to customers and organization standards.

You will need to be a fast learner to understand business requirements of each software and to plan and execute a series of automated and manual tests to ensure an error-free, seamless, and secure platform experience for end-users. Good command of English and the willingness to ask questions is a must.

As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you are responsible for the quality of each software product shipped by the tech team. If you are driven to succeed and uphold high standards in your work, we want to speak with you!

On the job as Quality Assurance Engineer, you will be required to:

* Business Requirements: Understand business requirements for each software product and analyze and test the built software to ensure that it follows ALL business requirements and functionalities
* Change time-line: so QA can write test cases concurrently based on product design;
* Gemini / GPT: to create possible test cases
* (SH: to write user stories)
* Test Plans: Create detailed test plans, document test cases and executing them to ensure that test software products are error-free
* Some proposed actions to create “error-free” products: Bug bash (developers, designers, project managers to “bash”), bug triage, site integration tests (SIT) >> involving multiple team members test at the same time
* Testing: Perform manual and automated tests - functional, regression testing to ensure robust and error-free software products
* Improve workflows: Test and analyze user-interface workflows for each end-user group to ensure seamless ease of use, suggesting improvements to work flows where necessary
* Software Security: Uncover vulnerabilities as a “malicious actor” in the software to ensure secure user interface and that its data and resources are protected from intruders
* Bug Reporting & Tracking: Execute tests with appropriate techniques and documenting testing failures, follow-ups and regression-testing using trello and appropriate tools
* Future:
* Perform load and API (KIV) testing to ensure robust software products
* Root Cause Analysis: Analyze high impact defects for root causes

Your lead responsibilities will also to be:

* Have ownership of software product quality as a poor quality products shipped to market has negative impact on the company’s reputation and future revenues
* Develop positive mindset to ensure seamless, error-free experience for end-users
* Research new tools, technologies and testing processes that help improve QA efficiency
* Implement performance monitoring on end systems and suggest improvements
* Manage up to 3 software projects at any one time
* Maintain professional communications with tech team at all times
* Ask questions when not clear
* Follow up closely with front-end and backend software engineers to ensure that high priority bugs are fixed expediently
* Reinforce team spirit to be a results-focused tech team and celebrating wins together
* Recruiting A\* software QA engineers to join the team
* Suggest L&D materials for the tech team to improve together as a team

What You Will Learn

* Work closely with product owners, designers and software engineers to create high quality and error-free software products
* Building an A\* team
* Hands-on experience and opportunities to explore related areas such as vulnerability assessments and penetration testing

Career Progression

* As a Quality Assurance Engineer, you can progress to be a Quality Assurance Manager, where you set and enforce software quality standards for the development team
* You may also decide to move into a Product Manager role to oversee products throughout each stage of its life cycle and translate business strategies into technical requirements including specifications for software development.

description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
As a User-Centric Analytics (UCA) team member, your role involves understanding, analyzing, and predicting the behavior of users (passengers, drivers, and merchants). This knowledge is critical in driving user engagement strategies, enhancing user experience, and contributing to overall business growth.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
As a senior or lead data scientist, we expect you to be an individual contributor who leads the project end-to-end, from gathering requirements and bridging the gap, to building and deploying a model, and delivering impact for various teams. The primary responsibilities for this role include building user-level prediction models for Competitive Index and High Net Worth Individuals, which require an advanced understanding of statistics and AI/machine learning. As a data scientist specializing in user-level prediction models, your role will be crucial in optimizing user engagement and retention, which are key strategies for driving business growth and profitability. You will report to Data Analytics Manager and based in Jakarta office.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Develop and implement predictive models to understand and forecast user behavior and engagement. This involves utilizing various machine learning and AI, as well as statistical modeling techniques.
* Analyze and interpret massive or sparse datasets of transactional, behavioral, and millions of user interactions on our platform to understand user behavior and trends that can inform business strategies.
* Continually improve user-level models through iterative enhancements, ensuring they remain effective and relevant.
* Ensure the scalability of models to handle larger datasets or more features.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with software engineers, product managers, marketing, and country teams to translate business needs into data solutions.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or other related fields.
* 4 to 5+ years of experience in large-scale Machine Learning systems, with a background in Machine Learning, Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Familiarity with the concept of MLOps Lifecycle, which refers to the process of managing and automating the lifecycle of machine learning models, including data preparation, model training, model evaluation, and model serving.
* Proficiency in ML Modeling with ML Frameworks such as Tensorflow and PyTorch.
* Proficiency in Causal Inference or other statistical methods, and Python.
* Hands-on experience with one or more big data processing frameworks such as Spark.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

Otten Coffee, Indonesia's largest coffee-commerce platform, is transforming the coffee industry through technology. **#MengopikanIndonesia #10YearsBrewingtheFuture**

Otten Coffee offers you a rare opportunity to join the Data Team in constructing the baseline of a scalable and impactful data-driven system in an e-commerce and retail platform. We have a
**limitless data playground**
for you to explore insights, learn the business models from multiple perspectives, tackle business problems to optimize cost and improve revenues, and also to build machine learning, even AI pipelines to support the company's initiatives. We go above and beyond in the Indonesian coffee industry with seamless shopping and coffee experiences.

**hungry to learn, self-motivated, easy-going, friendly, and has high curiosity**
, you’ll be glad to apply to Otten Coffee. Let’s learn and grow together.

* Learn the business models in depth through the business owners perspective to provide actionable suggestions in order to support the business’ growth and tackle business problems.

* Initiate the machine learning system from end-to-end, from the data collection, preprocessing of the data, building of the model, validation of the model, and serving the model in production together with other Data Scientists.
* Construct data infrastructure models, automate data acquisitions and transformations then conduct data analysis to support other departments requirements alongside with other Data Scientists.
* Merging different data sources and reformatting or processing the data using ETL tools.
* Support for occasional in-depth data analysis prompts from C-level management and other departments leaders.
* Sharing complex ideas verbally and visually in an understandable manner with non-technical stakeholders.

**Requirements**

* Min. 2 years of relevant experience in Data Science or similar fields.
* Excellent understanding of business operations and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
* Strong expertise in Python and skilled in data science basics (math/statistics, algorithms, data prep, feature selection, and so on).
* Proficient in data manipulation and analysis using SQL.
* Experience with Cloud-based tech stack and Docker. GCP will be preferred.
* Experience building end-to-end machine learning pipelines.
* Knowledge of data pipeline infrastructure.
* Experience with BI Tools (e.g. Superset, Data Studio, Tableau, Power BI, etc)

* Strong analytical skills, statistical reasoning, and team communication.
* Fast learner with initiative and curiosity.

description:
Founded in 2015, PasarPolis is Southeast Asia’s undisputed insurtech leader in Indonesia that is challenging industry norms and rebuilding insurance experience by making insurance accessible and affordable for everyone through harnessing technology to deliver innovative and practical products, with a purchase and claims experience that is seamless and fast.

Pioneers of the Insurtech sector in Indonesia, the company’s objective is to democratize insurance by empowering all consumers through PasarPolis’ platform, partners have access to a highly scalable AI-powered platform that facilitates easy onboarding, flexible product creation, and a claims portal. Following the company’s positive consumer response in Indonesia, PasarPolis has now expanded to other Southeast Asian markets, including Thailand and Vietnam.

PasarPolis has demonstrated exponential policy growth since closing of its Series A round in August 2018 participated by three Indonesian biggest unicorns - Gojek, Tokopedia and Traveloka - with the number of monthly policies issued growing more than 80 times ever since. The Company has successfully expanded across the region. To date, we are currently present in Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, and we have an R&D Center in India.

In August 2020, PasarPolis completed a US$54 million Series B funding round, which is considered the largest Series B funding recorded for an insurtech firm in Southeast Asia, and potentially it is also the biggest disclosed investment round for insurtech firms in the region. The round included participation from LeapFrog Investments, SBI Investment, Alpha JWC, Intudo Ventures, Go-Ventures and Xiaomi Ventures and will be used to support the company’s growth plan. In February 2021, PasarPolis secured US$5 million funding from World Bank’s sister organization International Finance Corporation (IFC).

All of the above milestones are only achievable due to the trust of all our key stakeholders, including our wonderful PasarPolis talented and hard-working team members who continue to provide outstanding contributions, care and service, day in and day out! In PasarPolis we believe that employees are valuable capital for the organization. This year, PasarPolis became a winner of HR Asia Best Company to work for by HR Asia Awards. We are looking forward to welcoming you to join us in our diverse, passionate and innovative team by delivering insurance for all through technology.

**Skills Required for Front end developer:**

**Must have:**

Join the Insurtech revolution with PasarPolis! We are looking for exceptional talents to come help us leverage technology to disrupt the insurance industry. With the largest insurtech funding in the region and 3 Indonesian unicorns as part of our investors roster (Gojek, Tokopedia & Traveloka) we are disrupting the insurance industry by:

1. Creating easy to understand insurance products
2. 2. Redefining how and where insurance products are purchased
3. 3. Enabling simple and hassle-free claim process
4. We are also using machine learning, big data analysis, and data science to build automated risk assessment.

**Job Description**
·

* Development of frontend services and taking responsibility for scalability and reliability of them.
* Translate and drive technology vision into action and world class product, as well as constantly solve problems and set strategy for our existing products as well as future product ideas.
* You are also expected to share knowledge to other engineers.
* Drive the business and help drive and focus execution in line with our core objectives.
* Work closely with QA Engineers for immediate bugs/issues resolution.
* Explore new techniques, technologies and software development approaches to improve the existing system to keep up with the latest trend in software development

**Minimum Qualifications**

· Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or equivalent

· 1-3 years of experience in software engineering/development and building Web Services

· Experienced in JavaScript + ReactJS

· Good understanding of React/Angular, and Webpack

· Familiar with application life cycle management tools such as JIRA, Bitbucket/Git, etc and also CI/CD tooling.

· Familiar with Agile Software Development and SCRUM.

* **Mandatory Required Skills**
  · JavaScript + ReactJS and MySQL

title: Security & Infrastructure Engineer (Data Center Company)
description:
**About the Job:**

We are looking for a highly skilled
**Security & Infrastructure Engineer**

to join our client's team in supporting and securing their critical infrastructure. You will play a vital role in ensuring operational efficiency, system security, and compliance across the company's IT environment. This position offers a chance to work in a high-impact industry with strong growth opportunities and long-term stability.

**Qualifications:**

* Possess experience in Networking, Firewall, WAF, OWASP, and vulnerability assessment.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in the same field. Capable of multitasking to manage multiple projects.
* Experience with FortiGate or SonicWall.
* Self-motivated and resourceful; able to focus on delivering results while managing various tasks.
* Excellent communication skills in both spoken and written English.

**Responsibilities:**

* Apply a risk-based approach to prioritize security efforts within the Infrastructure and Operations teams. Follow up with team members on deliverables, communicate status, and liaise with global security teams and management.
* Provide security-related input to the processes, deployments, and changes of the Infrastructure and Operations teams.
* Develop, deploy, administer, support, and remediate security tools and processes to meet business requirements. Leverage concepts such as automation, templating, multiple inheritance, error handling, and code reuse to ensure efficient and straightforward operation.
* Troubleshoot and remediate errors and failures related to security events, applications, networks, storage, and more. Perform root cause analysis for major incidents.
* Provide support and expertise to other systems and network engineers and administrators, acting as a backup or "secondary" for other areas of responsibility, such as server administration.
* Ensure the security and compliance of systems, processes, and solutions with internal standards, industry compliance standards, and best practices.
* Analyze and report accurately and regularly on gaps, risks, failures, efficiencies, improvements, coverage, licensing, and more.
* Interact with technical and non-technical staff from various business units to assess needs, communicate options, and design and implement suitable solutions.
* Deploy OS or application patches on Windows or Linux servers.
* Support and collaborate with Support Services staff to quickly address workstation and end-user security events.
* Create and maintain documentation related to job functions and the environment, including architecture, integrations, code, and application settings. Complete knowledge transfer within the team and mentor other team members.
* Follow team processes and contribute to the refinement of processes and other duties as assigned.

title: IT Cloud Engineer
description:
IT Cloud Engineer bertanggung jawab atas perancangan, implementasi, pengelolaan, dan pemeliharaan infrastruktur cloud untuk memastikan sistem berjalan dengan
**aman, efisien, dan andal**
. Posisi ini akan bekerja sama dengan tim IT, developer, dan DevOps untuk mendukung
**migrasi ke cloud**
, integrasi layanan, serta optimalisasi kinerja sistem cloud.

**Kualifikasi Umum:**

* Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 di bidang Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.
* Pengalaman minimal 2–3 tahun di bidang cloud engineering atau posisi serupa.
* Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat tentang arsitektur cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
* Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun kolaboratif dalam tim.
* Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan dokumentasi teknis yang baik.

**Keterampilan Teknis (Technical Skills):**
**Platform Cloud (salah satu atau lebih):**

* **AWS (Amazon Web Services):**
  EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda, CloudFormation.
* **Microsoft Azure:**
  Virtual Machines, Azure AD, App Services, ARM Templates.
* **Google Cloud Platform (GCP):**
  Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, GKE.

**Virtualisasi & Containerization:**

* Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift.

**Infrastructure as Code (IaC):**

* Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, atau CloudFormation.

**Jaringan & Keamanan Cloud:**

* VPN, firewall, load balancing, IAM, security groups, zero trust architecture.

**CI/CD dan DevOps Tools:**

* Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD.

**Scripting & Automation:**

* Bash, Python, PowerShell, atau bahasa scripting lain yang relevan.

**Monitoring & Logging:**

* Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor.

**Tanggung Jawab:**

* Merancang dan membangun infrastruktur cloud yang
  **scalable**
  ,
  **secure**
  , dan
  **high-availability**
  .
* Melakukan deployment, konfigurasi, dan manajemen layanan cloud.
* Mengotomasi provisioning dan deployment menggunakan tools seperti Terraform atau Ansible.
* Menjamin aspek
  **keamanan, backup, dan compliance**
  pada sistem cloud.
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim DevOps/Developer untuk pipeline CI/CD dan integrasi sistem.
* Melakukan monitoring sistem cloud dan troubleshooting bila terjadi gangguan.
* Menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan SOP terkait infrastruktur cloud.
* Berpartisipasi dalam proses migrasi dari sistem on-premise ke cloud.

**Nilai Tambah (Nice to Have):**

* **Sertifikasi Cloud:**
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps / DevOps.
* Microsoft Azure Administrator / Architect.
* Google Cloud Certified Professional.
* Pengalaman dalam implementasi hybrid cloud atau multi-cloud.
* Pengetahuan mengenai optimisasi biaya (cost optimization) di lingkungan cloud.
* Familiaritas dengan standar keamanan seperti ITIL, ISO 27001, NIST.
* Pengalaman dalam perencanaan disaster recovery dan arsitektur high availability.

title: GoTo Financial - Senior Software Engineer - Devops
description:
**About The Role:**
As Nasi Goreng is to the people of Indonesia, engineers are to GoTo Financial: sustaining and nourishing the longevity of our business from the inside out. As our Data Science Engineer, you'll be an integral player within the Data Science Engineering team. You'll ensure our Data Scientists in the various GoToFinancial sub-teams have all the resources they require to achieve their goals. You’ll employ your stellar software engineering skills and expertise in the infrastructure operations field in efforts to productionize their processes. Your work will directly influence the performance of our Machine Learning and Data Science models throughout the company and help in taking data oriented decisions in different interests of business growth, risk etc.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Write great quality, scalable, and maintainable code
* Manage data science infrastructure to streamline model development and deployment.
* Build or setup tooling for feature engineering for near real-time models.
* Monitor and provide support to infrastructure and production models
* Mentor team members by conducting code reviews and knowledge sharing
* Containerisation and deployment of microservices on Kubernetes.
* Collaborate with the data science team and business teams to understand their requirements

What you will need
  
  

* At least 3-6 years of relevant devops engineering experience with solid Computer Science fundamentals
* Experience working in IAC tools like Terraform and Ansible
* Good understanding of containerisation, Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience in any one of the programming languages Golang, Java or python.
* Experience in distributed systems, and backend systems engineering.
* Solid understanding of distributed system fundamentals and ability to troubleshoot issues in a larger distributed infrastructure, including concepts from unit-level (e.g. operating system, resources management) to systems level (e.g. networking, observability, high-availability).
* All professional experience within a Linux / Unix environment
* Strong analytical skills, the ability to work effectively in cross-functional teams, meticulous attention to detail, self-motivation, adaptability, and a strong sense of ownership
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills

**About The Team:**
Our Data Science Engineering team is a group of talented data scientists and software engineers stationed in Bangalore and Jakarta. Enabling data science teams for the next 100 million GoTo users is our top priority; our efforts will build the confidence of users in the GoTo ecosystem. By doing this we impact different business verticals across the whole GoTo ecosystem like growth, risk management etc. We work and collaborate with different teams (DevOps, Data Engineering, Product Engineering, Data Science etc) across the GoTo ecosystem to build the most reliable and feature rich platform for GoTo financial data scientists.
  
  
Most recently, our team worked on a model to detect ATO using different technologies like distributed graphs, Kafka, Postgres and XGboost data science models. Currently we are working with the data science team on the next iteration of the ATO Detection model for feature engineering using billions of data points in near real time.
  
  
We’re a high-performing, tight-knit team who are committed to the safety and growth of the company, as well as each other’s personal growth and wellbeing. We also have weekly showcase sessions where we present our latest tool we are using and product we are building.
  
  
**About GoTo Group**
GoTo Group is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia with its mission to “Empower Progress’ by offering technological infrastructure and solutions for everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy. The GoTo ecosystem consists of on-demand transportation services, food and grocery delivery, logistics and fulfillment, as well as financial and payment services through the Gojek and GoTo Financial platforms.It is the first platform in Southeast Asia that hosts these crucial cases in a single ecosystem, capturing the majority of Indonesia’s vast consumer household.
  
  
**About Gojek**
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.
  
  
**About GoTo Financial**
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.
  
  
*GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.*

* Sandbox environments
* Strong analytical and communication skills.

* Willingness to work in shifts and adapt to system implementation timelines.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Data Analyst**

**Who We Are**

Seven Clean Seas is an ocean-impact social enterprise dedicated to combating plastic pollution while fostering sustainable livelihoods. We build Ocean Impact Projects and empower communities to turn the tide on plastic pollution. We work with organisations to tackle upstream plastic consumption and to fund downstream plastic waste management through plastic credit mechanisms - an initiative that Seven Clean Seas is leading alongside a handful of other key market players. 

We are seeking a
**Data Analyst**

to enhance our in-house technical capabilities and provide support for internal and external sustainability projects and deliverables. 

**The Role:**

We are seeking a Data Analyst to enhance our technical capabilities and support both internal and external sustainability projects. In this full-time role based in Bali, Indonesia, you will report to Oliver Kade (UK Country Manager & CTO) and work closely with our team to provide data-driven insights. Your work will help track and amplify our impact, improve our tools, and inform strategies that further our mission of plastic waste reduction.

**Responsibilities**

1. **Data Analytics for Sustainability Projects:**

   Conduct data analytics for client ESG and sustainability projects, translating raw data into actionable insights and reports.
2. **Impact Tracker Development:**

   Support the development of our in-house impact-tracker web application,
   *Periscope*

   , ensuring data accuracy and useful feature enhancements.
3. **Dashboard & Model Building:**

   Build professional dashboards and predictive models using Google Sheets and data visualisation tools, enabling clear communication of project metrics and outcomes.
4. **Client Support & Presentations:**

   Assist in preparing analytical content for client meetings and presentations, clearly conveying findings and providing evidence-based recommendations.
5. **Web Application Development**

   : Work with our third-party developers to advise on the ongoing development and improvement of our client impact tracker.

**Requirements:**

* **Experience**

  : 2–4 years of relevant experience in data analysis, preferably in a sustainability or ESG context.
* **Education**

  : A degree in data analytics, software engineering, sustainability, or a related field.
* **Technical Skills**

  : Basic knowledge of Python and SQL, along with familiarity with using data visualisation tools (e.g., Google Sheets, Power BI, Looker).
* **Analytical Ability**

  : Strong attention to detail with a scientific approach to data. Competency in statistical analysis and excellent problem-solving skills are a must.
* **Communication**

  : Clear communication skills, with the ability to support client interactions and confidently deliver presentations of your findings.



**What We Offer**

* **Competitive Compensation:**

  A competitive salary with growth opportunities in a rapidly scaling organisation.
* **Purpose-Driven Mission:**

  The chance to be part of a purpose-driven team creating a measurable environmental impact every day.
* **Dynamic Workplace:**

  A dynamic, entrepreneurial startup environment with a clear path for career progression and professional development.
* **Tropical Lifestyle:**

  The opportunity to live and work in beautiful Bali, surrounded by a passionate, close-knit team who genuinely care about each other and the mission.

**Considerations:**

* This role is an office-based role in our Indonesian headquarters.
* A three-month probationary period applies.

title: HR Data Analyst intern
description:
Kopi Kenangan established in 2017; currently we have close to 900 retail outlets across Indonesia and we are the first SEA F&B Unicorn since 2022.

We are looking for a **HR Data Analyst Intern** to support our People team in managing data-driven initiatives. This internship is ideal for university students who are passionate about HR analytics and have strong Excel and project management skills.

You will work closely with HR professionals and multiple stakeholders to collect, analyze, and visualize data, as well as help manage the progress of ongoing HR projects such as performance management, Objective Key Result (OKR) management, compensation-banafit data calculation, and so on.

**Ideal Candidate Profile:**

* Currently pursuing a **Bachelor’s degree** in any field on final-year or those in their **3rd/4th year** preferred.
* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Excel** (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, charts, data cleaning).
* Understanding of HR concepts is a plus.
* Basic knowledge of data visualization tools (e.g., **Power BI**, **Tableau**) is a plus.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Able to manage multiple tasks or projects under minimal supervision.
* Effective communication skills (written and verbal).
* Collaborative and proactive approach to problem-solving.

**Job Role:**

* Support data collection and validation for HR reports (e.g., headcount).
* Track and help coordinate timelines, deliverables, and reporting for HR-related projects.
* Assist in documenting project updates, meeting notes, and status reports.
* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (People & Culture, Talent Acquisition, Learning & Development, etc) to understand data needs and deliver actionable insights.

**More about Kenangan Brands**

Kenangan Brands owns multiple brands:

* Kopi Kenangan, a much loved coffee chain store with close to 900 outlets across Indonesia;
* Kenangan Coffee Malaysia, launched in 2022 has more than 100 coffee chain stores across Malaysia;
* Kenangan Coffee Singapore, launched in 2023, have 8 stores; and
* Kopi Kenangan Hanya Untukmu, our Ready-To-Drink FMCG subsidiary.

Job Type: Internship  
Contract length: 3 months

Application Question(s):

* What semester are you in?

title: Gojek - Data Analyst - Driver Experience & Fulfillment
description:
**About The Role**
As Driver Experience & Fulfillment Data Analyst, you’ll play a crucial role in analyzing all available driver’s data for the business to utilize in deciding their next steps. Working in a fluid, fast-paced environment, where the latest cutting-edge software technologies are at your disposal, you’ll research and analyze driver’s insights and current driver’s trends to create robust business reports that will improve the overall driver’s experience in the apps. Your work will also provide the necessary data and insights for our local teams to further their experimentations and better optimize their products and services to driver’s preferences and needs.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Develop and maintain driver’s related dashboards to monitor key metrics and compare achievements against targeted goals.
* Analyze various data points, detect anomalies and spot trends to drive business and strategic decision-making on driver’s initiatives.
* Collaborate with the BI, Data Science, Marketing, Strategy and Product Management teams to ensure alignment on data analysis, methodologies, insights, and recommendations and proactively escalate issues to relevant stakeholders.
* Analysis on the competitive intelligence insights and findings.
* Create automated weekly reporting & business forecasting
* Create compelling presentations for insights & strategy recommendations.
* Be the go-to person on anything related to the multiple health metrics and analysis.

**What You Will Need**

* A BS/MS in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Statistics or equivalent experience
* 3+ years of experience within one or more of the following fields: Business Analytics, Strategy and Planning, Consulting, Growth or relevant functions
* Comfortable analyzing large amounts of raw data with an obsession to detail and accuracy of data
* Able to uncover the story and relationship behind the numbers and communicate the insights to a wider audience
* A proactive team-player who can work under pressure and tight deadline
* Proficiency in multiple analytic, database, and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker Studio, etc.) along with strong knowledge of SQL
* A scientific and hypothesis-driven thinking process with the ability to create a structured way of problem solving with MECE issue trees and impact sizing
* Strong project management skills to manage complex projects and to prioritize and effectively collaborate with multiple internal and external stakeholders

**About The Team**
You play a pivotal role to improve the quality life of drivers which have direct correlation to customer experience. Though everyday will be very challenging balancing the expectations from drivers (thru regions) and business team but you feel great satisfaction as you are directly creating a social impact.
  
  
**About GoTo Group**
GoTo Group is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia with its mission to “Empower Progress’ by offering technological infrastructure and solutions for everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy. The GoTo ecosystem consists of on-demand transportation services, food and grocery delivery, logistics and fulfillment, as well as financial and payment services through the Gojek and GoTo Financial platforms.It is the first platform in Southeast Asia that hosts these crucial cases in a single ecosystem, capturing the majority of Indonesia’s vast consumer household.
  
  
**About Gojek**
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.
  
  
**About GoTo Financial**
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.
  
  
*GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.*

description:
**Location:**

Jakarta, Indonesia

**Job Description:**

The primary role of this position will be a key player in building innovative products that encompass the future of data management, visualization, and analytics in our industry. Developers work as part of a multi-disciplinary team in an Agile/DevOps environment. You will be able to deliver high-quality code and be able to build reliable and scalable applications.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

Web Developer will be responsible for day-to-day coding and development activities. This will include relevant Unit Testing using various Unit Testing tools, as applicable in an Agile and DevOps Environment. This will also include working efficiently with the respective teams and giving consistent results that align well with business needs. The developer must be reliable, should show a high-level of understanding, have an innovative attitude, and be able to meet objectives in a timely manner. They should demonstrate an ability to pro-actively communicate progress and requirements to the technical lead and manager as required. The correct individual will be highly driven and motivated, and be able to meet new and demanding targets consistently and successfully as required.

* Write well-organized and sustainable code.
* Design new software and perform modifications/maintenance to existing software.
* Present ideas for software improvements.
* Work closely with other team members to achieve common goals.
* Identify and communicate best development practices.
* Debug/Troubleshoot deployed software.
* Document requirements and implementation.
* Work closely with other developers and other staff (including but not limited to Product Manager, Operations, Testers, etc.).

* Proven experience in Angular 2+ (preferably up to date with latest releases).
* Experience in using NodeJS.
* Experience in HTML/CSS.
* Work experience in the development of frameworks and web platforms are key to this position.
* B Tech/MCA/M Tech in Computer Science or related field.
* More than 1 year of relevant experience.
* Good interpersonal skills.
* Knowledge and experience of working with Agile development methodologies.

**Preferred Qualification:**

* Experience in React (React.js).
* Experience in Event-Driven Programming including experience with RabbitMQ, Kafka, or other message brokers.

* Experience working with CI/CD processes and technologies.

23 June 2025

**Closing Date:**

22 July 2025

**Codingo Singapore** is Singapore's no. 1 Assignment Help Platform. Initially focusing only in coding, we are now expanding into various fields! Thus, we require a lot of manpower to fulfill the fields that we are not established in.

We are seeking a motivated Mobile Developer with expertise in Flutter and Dart to contribute to a range of innovative mobile application projects. The ideal candidate is passionate about building high-quality, efficient, and user-friendly mobile solutions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Develop Mobile Applications:** Design, code, and maintain mobile applications using the Flutter framework.

* **Integration:** Connect mobile applications with backend services and RESTful APIs.
* **Quality Assurance:** Conduct thorough testing, troubleshooting, and debugging to ensure optimal performance.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Stay updated with the latest industry trends and best practices to refine existing applications and implement new features.

**Required Skills and Qualifications:**

* **Technical Proficiency:** Strong experience with Flutter and Dart.
* **Mobile Development Fundamentals:** Solid understanding of mobile application architectures and development methodologies.
* **API Integration:** Familiarity with integrating RESTful APIs and working with third-party libraries.
* **Version Control:** Proficient in using Git or similar version control systems.
* **Problem-Solving:** Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.
* **Communication:** Strong written and verbal communication skills.

title: IT Cloud Engineer
description:
🎯
**Deskripsi Pekerjaan:**

IT Cloud Engineer bertanggung jawab atas perancangan, implementasi, pengelolaan, dan pemeliharaan infrastruktur cloud untuk memastikan sistem berjalan dengan aman, efisien, dan andal. Posisi ini akan bekerja sama dengan tim IT, developer, dan DevOps untuk memastikan keberhasilan migrasi cloud, integrasi layanan, dan optimalisasi kinerja sistem cloud.

✅
**Kualifikasi Umum:**

• Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 di bidang Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.

• Pengalaman minimal 2–3 tahun di bidang cloud engineering atau posisi serupa.

• Memiliki pemahaman kuat tentang arsitektur cloud (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).

• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun kolaboratif dalam tim.

• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan dokumentasi yang baik.

☁
**Keterampilan Teknis (Technical Skills):**

• Pengalaman dengan salah satu atau lebih platform cloud berikut:

§ AWS (Amazon Web Services) – EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, VPC, Lambda, CloudFormation.

§ MicrosoK Azure – Virtual Machines, Azure AD, App Services, ARM Templates.

§ Google Cloud Pla`orm (GCP) – Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud Functions, GKE.

• Pengalaman dengan virtualisasi dan containeriza9on:

§ Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShiK.

• Penguasaan Infrastructure as Code (IaC):

§ Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, atau CloudFormation.

• Pemahaman mengenai jaringan dan keamanan cloud:

§ VPN, firewall, load balancing, IAM, security groups, zero trust.

• Pengalaman dalam penerapan CI/CD pipelines dan DevOps tools:

§ Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD.

• Kemampuan scripting dengan Bash, Python, PowerShell, atau sejenisnya.

• Familiar dengan sistem monitoring/logging:

§ Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, CloudWatch, atau Azure Monitor.

🛠
**Tanggung Jawab:**

• Mendesain dan membangun infrastruktur cloud yang scalable, secure, dan high-availability.

• Melakukan deployment, konfigurasi, dan manajemen layanan cloud.

• Melakukan automasi provisioning dan deployment dengan tools seperti Terraform atau Ansible.

• Memastikan keamanan, backup, dan compliance sistem cloud.

• Bekerja sama dengan tim DevOps/Developer untuk pipeline CI/CD dan integrasi sistem.

• Melakukan monitoring sistem cloud dan troubleshooting jika terjadi gangguan.

• Membuat dokumentasi teknis dan SOP terkait infrastruktur cloud.

• Berpartisipasi dalam migrasi sistem on-premise ke cloud (cloud migration).

💡
**Nilai Tambah (Nice to Have):**

• Sertifikasi Cloud:

• AWS Certified Solutions Architect / SysOps / DevOps

• Microsoft Azure Administrator / Architect

• Google Cloud Certified Professional

• Pengalaman hybrid cloud atau multi-cloud setup.

• Pengetahuan tentang cost optimization di cloud environment.

• Familiar dengan ITIL, ISO 27001, atau standar keamanan lainnya.

• Pengalaman dalam disaster recovery planning dan high availability architecture.
extracted_skills: Python, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, IaC, Ansible, CI/CD, Linux, Cybersecurity, Git

title: Data Analyst Manager
description:
**Job Overview:**

The Business Data Analyst & Compliance Manager will work within a Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) company that specializes in providing risk management services to clients. This role involves overseeing risk assessment processes, implementing fraud prevention measures and ensuring compliance with regulations on behalf of the clients.

The Business Data Analyst & Compliance Manager will act as the key point of contact for clients, delivering tailored solutions to protect their operations and ensure a secure environment.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct risk evaluations of client systems and processes, identifying vulnerabilities in user platforms, payment systems and user activities.
* Develop and recommend customized risk mitigation strategies to address client-specific challenges.
* Monitor client transactions to detect fraudulent activities, money laundering or other suspicious behavior.
* Assist clients in maintaining compliance with laws and regulations across different jurisdictions.
* Use advanced fraud detection tools to identify potential risks in client systems.
* Develop and implement anti-fraud measures, such as KYC (Know Your Customer) and AML (Anti-Money Laundering) protocols, tailored to client needs.
* Investigate fraud incidents for clients and provide detailed reports with actionable recommendations.
* Analyze data from client operations to identify patterns, anomalies and trends that may indicate risks.
* Prepare detailed risk management reports for both internal stakeholders and clients, outlining findings and recommendations.
* Maintain accurate records of all incidents and actions taken on behalf of clients.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients regarding risk management services.
* Provide regular updates and insights to clients on risk-related matters.
* Lead and mentor junior members of the risk management team within the BPO organization.
* Work collaboratively with cross-functional teams including Data, IT, Operation, and Finance to support client operations.
* Contribute to the development of best practices and protocols for risk management services.

**Job requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Risk Management, Finance, Data Science or a related field.
* 3-5 years of experience in
  **risk management**
  ,
  **fraud prevention**
  , or compliance, preferably in the
  **gaming**
  or
  **financial services**
  industries.
* **Willing to relocate to Manila, Philippines**
  .
* Any nationalities are welcome to apply.
* Familiarity with BPO operations and client service management is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Expertise in
  **fraud detection tools**
  and
  **risk assessment methodologies**
  .
* Comprehensive knowledge of AML and KYC protocols relevant to the online gaming industry.
* Excellent organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Proficiency in Data Analytics Tools such as Tableau, Python, and risk management software.
* Certification in Risk Management or Compliance (e.g., CAMS, CRM) is advantageous.
* Experience with cryptocurrencies or blockchain technology is a plus.

**Benefits:**

* Relocation Flight Ticket & Transportation
* Company Accommodation/Housing Allowance
* Annual leave: 24 days
* Medical Leave: 10 days
* Medical & Insurance Coverage
* Daily Meals (on-duty)
* Flight Ticket
* Online/Onsite Trainings & Career Development

title: Associate AI Engineer
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
As an Applications Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will provide essential support and monitoring services for our clients' critical software applications, including ErP and Middleware technologies. You will be the go-to problem solver, proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving application-based incidents to ensure that we consistently meet our Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Your day will include monitoring and managing client applications, responding to service requests, and resolving low-complexity incidents to keep our clients' applications running smoothly. You will work on the first line of support, ensuring that any issues are quickly identified and resolved or escalated as needed. Your role includes executing approved maintenance activities such as patching and making configuration changes.
  
  
Communication is key in this role. You will provide support to clients via phone or chat, ensuring that their needs are met efficiently and effectively. Additionally, you will create and update knowledge articles to help streamline processes and improve service delivery. Opportunities for work optimization, including automation and process improvements, will be a focus of your responsibilities.
  
  
Occasionally, you might also contribute to project work and be involved in implementing and delivering disaster recovery functions and tests. Your proactive approach and positive outlook will ensure that our clients always have a smooth and efficient experience.
  
  
**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Entry-level experience in managing platforms such as Windows Server Administration, Linux Server Administration, Virtualization Administration, Server Hardware, and Storage Administration.
* Basic knowledge of infrastructure and technology within supported technical domains (e.g., ErP, Windows, Linux, SQL, Oracle Middleware, and Webserver).
* Strong planning skills, with the capability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* A client-focused mindset, with the ability to understand and prioritize client needs.
* The ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Active listening skills, including paraphrasing, probing for further information, and refraining from interrupting.
* A positive outlook, even when working under pressure or putting in longer hours as needed.
* A bachelor’s degree in information technology/computing, or equivalent work experience.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
