title: IT Cloud Engineer
description:
PT MNC OTT Network (Vision+) is a rapidly growing Over-the-Top (OTT) digital media company. We are looking for professional and dedicated individuals to join us as:

🎯
**IT Cloud Engineer**

📍 Location: MNC Tower, Central Jakarta

🕒 Type: Full-time (Full WFO)

Working hours : Monday - Friday

Time: 09.00 - 18.00 WIB

**JOIN ASAP!!**

🧰
**Job Description / Main Responsibilities**

* Design cloud architecture (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS) for OTT systems (web, mobile, TV apps)
* Build infrastructure with high availability, autoscaling, and disaster recovery principles
* Deployment of OTT stack including microservices, database, CDN integration
* Manage services in AWS / GCP / Azure (e.g. EC2, S3, RDS, CloudFront, EKS, BigQuery, Firebase, etc)
* Ensure cost efficiency (cloud cost optimization) and proper resource management
* Using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Pulumi, CloudFormation for automated provisioning
* Version control of the entire cloud configuration (GitOps)
* Create and manage CI/CD pipelines for OTT backend and frontend applications
* Integration with container tools (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm)
* Setup monitoring stack: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Stackdriver, Datadog
* Logging for streaming performance analysis (latency, buffering, errors, throughput)
* Implement security best practices: data encryption, IAM roles, VPC, audit logs
* Ensure compliance to industry standards (ISO 27001, SOC 2, etc)
* Implementation of DRM system for digital content (Widevine, FairPlay, PlayReady)
* Support DevOps, QA, and Developer teams for application troubleshooting in cloud environment
* On-call rotation to resolve production issues (incident handling)

🧠
**Qualifications / Requirements**

1. Bachelor's degree in Informatics Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent
2. Certifications (value added):

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect / DevOps Engineer
* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect
* Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate

🛠️
**Technical Skills (Hard Skills)**

1. Experience min. 2-5 years in cloud computing and infrastructure
2. Real-world experience using AWS / GCP / Azure
3. Mastery of Docker, Kubernetes, Helm
4. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automation tools
5. Use of Terraform / Ansible / Pulumi
6. Experience managing Linux/Unix based systems
7. Knowledge of video streaming architecture: HLS, DASH, CDN, DRM, load balancing

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Are you looking for a supportive, collaborative workplace with great teams and inspiring leaders? You’ve come to the right place. We’re looking for ambitious people who share our values and want to make every day better for people around the world. If this sounds like you, and the career below sounds exciting, we’d like to hear from you.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
The customer is the focus of everything we do, and millions of end users rely on our products daily. We believe in the value of empowering with the resources to solve critical problems for the future of our business, which is why we need you.
  
  
**What motivates you?**

* You obsess about customers, listen, engage and act for their benefit
* You think big, with curiosity to discover ways to use your agile mindset and enable business outcomes
* You thrive in teams, and enjoy getting things done together
* You take ownership and build solutions, focusing on what matters
* You do what is right, work with integrity and speak up
* You share your humanity, helping us build a diverse and inclusive work environment for everyone

**We Are Looking For Someone With**

* An advanced degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or another quantitative field.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience utilizing data science to solve high-impact business problems, with a specific recent focus on building business and productivity solutions.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis, machine learning, and data manipulation techniques, particularly in the context of understanding customers and scaling globally.
* Strong programming skills in languages such as Python, R, or SQL, with experience in prompt engineering and relevant packages like LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, Llamaindex and more.
* Practical experience with big data processing frameworks and platforms such as Azure, Databricks, Spark, with a focus on leveraging these technologies for building and scaling Generative AI solutions using Open AI services.
* Excellent communication skills – able to translate sophisticated data science concepts to technical and non-technical partners, specifically within the context of building Generative AI solutions using Open AI services and scaling across Asia.
* Track record of implementing AI solutions into production with tangible business value, particularly related to business generation and productivity or cost optimization.

**Nice To Haves**

* Ability to build and manage relationships with the key internal stakeholders

**On The Job You Will**

* Collaborate with Data engineers and IT Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to understand source data and utilize large datasets to prepare and optimize data for building Generative AI solutions using Open AI services to enhance our products and services and scaling it globally.
* Develop and implement advanced machine learning models to address complex business challenges, leveraging various algorithms and techniques, with a specific emphasis on utilizing Open AI services for building Generative AI solutions.
* Work closely with partners to gather requirements, design data models, and implement tailored solutions.
* Standardize processes, techniques, and tools into best practices for other data scientists.
* Drive the adoption of data and AI driven solutions by influencing and partnering with key stakeholders.
* Innovate and explore creative methods to source and utilize structured and unstructured data for building data and AI driven solutions. Stay updated on industry trends and advancements in AI/ML, with a specific focus on leveraging OpenAI services to continuously enhance our products and services and scaling efforts.

**Our commitment to you**

* Our mission; to be a part of making Decisions Easier and Lives Better
* A leadership team dedicated to your growth and success
* A bold ambition and set of goals to be a leader in driving transformation in our industry
* Our best. Every day.

Learn more about opportunities with us at jobs.manulife.com
  
  
Every career at Manulife provides the opportunity to learn new skills and move your career forward. Ready to make an impact somewhere? What are you waiting for? Apply today!

Manulife Financial Corporation is a leading international financial services provider, helping people make their decisions easier and lives better. To learn more about us, visit https://www.manulife.com/en/about/our-story.html.

At Manulife/John Hancock, we embrace our diversity. We strive to attract, develop and retain a workforce that is as diverse as the customers we serve and to foster an inclusive work environment that embraces the strength of cultures and individuals. We are committed to fair recruitment, retention, advancement and compensation, and we administer all of our practices and programs without discrimination on the basis of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, religion or religious beliefs, creed, sex (including pregnancy and pregnancy-related conditions), sexual orientation, genetic characteristics, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, or any other ground protected by applicable law.
  
  
It is our priority to remove barriers to provide equal access to employment. A Human Resources representative will work with applicants who request a reasonable accommodation during the application process. All information shared during the accommodation request process will be stored and used in a manner that is consistent with applicable laws and Manulife/John Hancock policies. To request a reasonable accommodation in the application process, contact recruitment@manulife.com.

Hybrid

team:

* Azure Databricks

You will help our clients navigate the business and technology transformation vision. **Your key responsibilities:**
You’ll spend most of your time working with a wide variety of clients and your colleagues to deliver the latest trends, practices, technologies, and architecture to design, build and maintain scalable and robust solutions that unify, enrich, collaborate and deliver value.

* Outstanding team player
* High level of motivation
* Strong work ethic
* Self-starting attitude
* Independent and able to manage and prioritize workload
* Ability to quickly and positively adapt to change
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, client service, and technical writing skills, coupled with excellent executive presence.
* Significant experience in managing and delivering medium to large teams on complex programs and projects.
* Assessing, designing, architecting, and developing solutions leveraging the latest technologies and trends to exceed the business requirements
* Unifying, enriching, and delivering value to derive insights and opportunities
* Leveraging in-house and partners - platforms and solutions as needed and recommending and building new platforms/solutions as required to exceed business requirements
* Communicating findings, recommendations, and opportunities to improve platforms and solutions
* Demonstrating a deep understanding of technology, concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches
* Seeking out information to learn about emerging methodologies and technologies
* Clarifying problems by driving to understand the true issue
* Looking for opportunities for improving methods and outcomes
* Collaborating, influencing, and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
* Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making
* Proven track record of sales and delivery in a consulting context with established client relationships and experience

**What we look for:**
We’re interested in passionate individuals with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends. If you have a genuine passion for helping businesses achieve their full potential, then these role(s) are for you.
  
  
**What we offer:**

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, on your way
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs

title: Data Engineer II
description:
As a mid-level data engineer (DE II) you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the infrastructure required to collect, process, and store large amounts of data. You will collaborate with data scientists, business intelligence, and other stakeholders to ensure data is correct, accessible, reliable, and optimized for performance.

**Responsibilities:**

* Produce reliable data for stakeholders by reviewing collected data APIs, troubleshooting, and processing data into the data mart
* Propose and collect requirements from users for data pipeline creation, sourcing data based on the stakeholder needs
* Build and maintain machine learning pipelines and deployment
* Develop APIs by collecting requirements, sourcing relevant data, creating pipelines, and cataloging and formatting data accordingly
* Improve structured planning for model deployment through research, testing, and documenting technical specifications (TSD)
* Maintain discussions with stakeholders, provide documentation, and collect feedback
* Optimize and implement integrations effectively based on stakeholder feedback and testing results
* Design, build, and manage scalable data pipelines and ETL processes
* Develop and maintain the data infrastructure (e.g., data warehouses, data lakes)
* Monitor and maintain data pipelines to ensure real-time and batch data processing

**Requirements**

* At least have 3+ years experience in the same position
* Strong experience with SQL and relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* Experience with ETL tools and data pipeline frameworks (e.g., Apache Airflow).
* Proficiency in a programming language such as Python, Java, or Scala.
* Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., GCP) and related data services.
* Experience with version control (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
* Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Familiarity with data governance, security, and privacy principles.

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. Come join the Consumer Experience (CX) Engineering team - we work on a diverse set of consumer problems spanning across core experiences that power the UX navigation and transaction funnels, search and discovery of content and services, user lifecycle covering user growth, engagement and loyalty and the critical platform mission of mobile application developer experience. We are on an exciting mission to connect consumers to Grab's marketplace by allowing them to discover and engage with Grab's services and partners.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
We are looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to join the CX Team. You will ensure deliverables, spanning across multiple key services powering end-to-end user journeys going from the login screen to the home and activity pages of the Grab app. These services are one of the top entry points for Grab services, with millions of visitors every day across 8 countries in total. You will report to the Engineering Manager, and you will be based fully on-site in our Jakarta office.

* Design, develop, and maintain innovative iOS applications focused on enhancing consumer experience
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features

* Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization
* Contribute to the entire app lifecycle, from concept and design to App Store submission
* Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
* Stay up-to-date with the latest iOS development practices and new technologies

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
**Tugas & Tanggung Jawab**

* Membangun perangkat lunak yang scalable dan robust dengan mengembangkan fitur baru, melakukan debugging, serta mengoptimalkan aplikasi.
* Mengembangkan dan mengusulkan produk atau fitur baru dengan memantau perkembangan industri.
* Membuat kode untuk aplikasi web fungsional yang dapat diakses melalui perangkat desktop dan mobile browser.
* Mengimplementasikan keamanan dan perlindungan data pada aplikasi.
* Mendesain dan mengimplementasikan solusi penyimpanan data yang efisien.
* Berkolaborasi dengan desainer, manajer produk, dan administrator sistem untuk mengidentifikasi serta membangun fitur baru.
* Melakukan monitoring, maintenance, dan perbaikan aplikasi untuk memastikan performa dan fungsionalitas aplikasi tetap optimal.
* Berkontribusi dalam analisa dan problem solving terhadap permasalahan dan kebutuhan perusahaan.
* Membuat dokumentasi teknis untuk setiap aktivitas pengembangan.

**Persyaratan Jabatan**

* Minimal
  **4 tahun pengalaman**
  dalam pengembangan perangkat lunak.
* Pengalaman di industri
  **FinTech**
  atau pengembangan
  **core banking**
  menjadi nilai tambah.
* Pengalaman dalam pengembangan aplikasi berbasis microservices (bukan monolithic).
* Mahir dalam backend development menggunakan
  **PHP (Laravel/Hyperf)**
  atau
  **Golang**
  (framework lain diperbolehkan selama berbasis microservices).
* Mahir dalam frontend development menggunakan
  **React.js**
  (minimal),
  **Next.js**
  menjadi nilai tambah.
* Pengalaman menggunakan salah satu database relasional
  **(MySQL atau PostgreSQL)**
  , serta pengalaman dengan NoSQL
  **(minimal MongoDB)**
  .
* Pengalaman menggunakan
  **Redis**
  sebagai cache dan message broker, serta
  **RabbitMQ**
  untuk event-driven architecture.
* Memahami dan mampu mengimplementasikan RESTful API dan RPC.
* Familiar dengan sistem versioning seperti Git (Bitbucket, GitHub, GitLab).
* Pengalaman dengan Docker dan Kubernetes (setup dan/atau pengelolaan environment).
* Mampu menulis kode yang bersih, efisien, dan terdokumentasi dengan baik.
* Pengalaman dengan unit testing dan integration testing (tools/framework bebas).
* Domisili atau bersedia bekerja di wilayah
  **BSD Tangerang (onsite).**

* Work closely with quantitative analysts, risk teams, product managers, and engineers to deliver data-driven solutions.
* Perform statistical analysis, A/B testing, and model validation to support strategic decisions.
* Build dashboards and visualizations to present complex analyses to stakeholders clearly.

* Advanced knowledge of SQL and working with large datasets.
* Solid understanding of financial products, markets, and risk principles.
* Excellent communication skills to explain technical results to non-technical audiences.

**Company Description**

AJARI Technologies is an AI solutions company empowering industries and revolutionizing outcomes through advanced machine learning. Our focus is on high-level education technology through digital learning, and we aim to deliver tailored solutions that are engaging, dynamic, and effective. Our team of experts is committed to optimizing processes for companies across various industries and harnessing the full potential of AI to elevate possibilities.

**Role Description**

The Machine Learning Engineer will be responsible for the following activities:

As a Machine Learning Engineer at our tech AI company, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and deploying advanced machine learning models and systems that directly contribute to our education and human service assistance initiatives. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams of engineers, data scientists, educators, and product managers to create intelligent solutions that transform the way people learn and receive assistance. Your responsibilities will include:

* Researching, designing, and implementing machine learning algorithms and models tailored for education, learning enhancement, and human service assistance.
* Collecting, cleaning, and preprocessing data from various sources to train and validate machine learning models.
* Developing and optimizing natural language processing (NLP) algorithms for interactive and context-aware communication with users.
* Collaborating with data scientists to analyze large datasets, derive insights, and improve model performance.
* Enhancing existing models and developing new approaches to personalize and adapt learning experiences based on individual user behavior and preferences.
* Integrating machine learning solutions into existing platforms and applications, ensuring seamless user experiences.
* Staying current with the latest advancements in machine learning, AI, and education technology to drive innovation within the company.
* Interpret our customers’ needs, and extract value from their data using GCP and its suite of tools.
* Be involved in pre-sales activities as well as building upon our customers’ cloud infrastructure, creating analytics in the cloud.
* Advocate for Google Cloud Platform and all of its products: Vertex AI, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, etc.
* Understanding the customer's requirements and suggesting a product or service accordingly.
* Demonstrating the product and services.
* Develop new products or integrations as required.

**Qualifications:**

* Experience in one or more development languages, such as Java, Python (is a must), Go, PHP or similar.
* Experience in drawing UML diagrams.
* Enjoys programming in a test driven, agile methodology.
* Expert knowledge of database and data analysis technologies, including relational and NoSQL databases, data warehouse design, BI reporting and dashboard development.
* Experience in Hadoop Ecosystems.
* Min. 3 years of experience within DS/ML practice.
* Experienced with Cloud Infra, SQL, Airflow, MLflow, FiSt feature store (cust flow)

That is exactly what we are tackling as t-fam! Making sure that our 50+ million users have the best experience in crafting their own adventure.

#LI-EP1

### **Your Main duties in flying with us :**

* Build and extend our backend code based on SOLID Principle and Clean Code
* Build APIs that serve our frontend apps – Benchmark and improve performance
* Maintain and extend our test suite Refactor and improve existing code to incorporate better patterns
* Document and write about the work
* Create unit test and implement self test to make sure the code is running well
* Assist technical lead to review and follow up code that have been developed.

### **Mandatory belongings that you must prepare :**

* Bachelor degree or equivalent, preferably in Computer Science/Information Technology
* Min. 5 years of working experience as Softaware Engineer or equivalent
* Knows how to analyze log
* Experience working with System Design
* Experience build high scalable API
* Experienced in using Java or Golang (Golang is Mandatory)
* Experience working with RDBMS or NoSQL
* Experience working with Redis and Memcached
* Experience with Elastic Search
* Experience with CI/CD, TDD, Refactor/Rewrite system
* Experience with Event-Driven Architecture such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
* Experience with Git Flow
* Experience with Docker
* Experience with Kubernetes is a plus
* Experience SaaS industry, Open API is a plus
* Good sense of prioritization and product knowledge/product ownership
* Critical thinking, fast learner, and excellent communication skills
* Well-motivated, responsible for the deadline, and can work under pressure

In the event that you haven’t received any updates after 3 weeks, your data will be kept and we may contact you for another career destination. Meanwhile, discover more about tiket.com on Instagram, LinkedIn, or YouTube.

title: Associate AI Engineer
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
As an Applications Managed Services Engineer (L1) at NTT DATA, you will provide essential support and monitoring services for our clients' critical software applications, including ErP and Middleware technologies. You will be the go-to problem solver, proactively identifying, investigating, and resolving application-based incidents to ensure that we consistently meet our Service Level Agreements (SLAs).  
  
Your day will include monitoring and managing client applications, responding to service requests, and resolving low-complexity incidents to keep our clients' applications running smoothly. You will work on the first line of support, ensuring that any issues are quickly identified and resolved or escalated as needed. Your role includes executing approved maintenance activities such as patching and making configuration changes.  
  
Communication is key in this role. You will provide support to clients via phone or chat, ensuring that their needs are met efficiently and effectively. Additionally, you will create and update knowledge articles to help streamline processes and improve service delivery. Opportunities for work optimization, including automation and process improvements, will be a focus of your responsibilities.  
  
Occasionally, you might also contribute to project work and be involved in implementing and delivering disaster recovery functions and tests. Your proactive approach and positive outlook will ensure that our clients always have a smooth and efficient experience.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Entry-level experience in managing platforms such as Windows Server Administration, Linux Server Administration, Virtualization Administration, Server Hardware, and Storage Administration.
* Basic knowledge of infrastructure and technology within supported technical domains (e.g., ErP, Windows, Linux, SQL, Oracle Middleware, and Webserver).
* Strong planning skills, with the capability to anticipate and adapt to changing circumstances.
* A client-focused mindset, with the ability to understand and prioritize client needs.
* The ability to communicate and work effectively across different cultures and social groups.
* Active listening skills, including paraphrasing, probing for further information, and refraining from interrupting.
* A positive outlook, even when working under pressure or putting in longer hours as needed.
* A bachelor’s degree in information technology/computing, or equivalent work experience.

**Workplace type****:**

Hybrid Working

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

**Company Description**

PT. Indonesia Indicator is a strategic intelligence company that focus on Big Data and AI. We provide intelligence insight and forecasting using Osint (Open Source Intelligence) Dataint (Data Intelligence) and Humint (Human Intelligence) to make a better decisions.

We are looking for
**"Full Stack Developer"**
position for working onsite at Bintaro, South Tangerang.

**Role Description**

As a Full Stack Developer, you will be responsible for building end-to-end web and mobile solutions — from designing databases and developing APIs, to implementing responsive user interfaces. You’ll work closely with cross-functional teams to develop scalable applications, ensure code quality, and maintain optimal performance across platforms.

This role requires a strong understanding of both frontend and backend technologies, the ability to translate UI/UX designs into working features, and the initiative to troubleshoot and improve systems proactively. If you're passionate about technology, love solving complex problems, and enjoy building products that impact users directly — we'd love to have you on our team.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design and manage RESTful APIs and both SQL & NoSQL databases.
* Develop web and mobile applications based on Figma designs.
* Work with frontend frameworks such as ReactJS, VueJS, Angular, NextJS, or Flutter.
* Implement CRUD operations, API integrations, authentication & authorization.
* Apply clean code principles, design patterns, and standard project structure.
* Conduct manual testing and unit testing, and use monitoring tools (Postman, JMeter, Sentry, APM).
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, QA testers, and AI/backend teams to refine product functionality.
* Use Git for version control and code collaboration.

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field is required, with a minimum of 1-2 years of relevant experiences.
* Proficient in web & mobile development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Typescript, Dart, SASS).
* Experienced with databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch).
* Familiar with tools like Node.js, NPM, Webpack, and package managers.
* Understands the basics of AI/ML and how it applies to backend systems.
* Experienced with API testing/documentation tools like Postman and Swagger.
* Knowledge of API security, session management, and token-based authentication.
* Able to translate Figma designs into responsive and user-friendly apps.
* Proficient in Git (clone, add, commit, push, pull) and branching workflow.
* Bonus: familiar with generative tools like ChatGPT to streamline development.

description:
**Location: Remote (Indonesia)**

**Experience: 5 - 8 Years**

**Employment Type: Full-time (Remote)**

***About Frigga***

Frigga is a cloud and DevOps R&D company dedicated to helping startups build, scale, and manage their cloud-native infrastructure. By combining powerful automation tools with expert engineering teams, Frigga enables organizations to streamline CI/CD processes, enhance observability, reduce cloud costs, and strengthen security. Our services include DevOps consulting, managed infrastructure, 24/7 support, and cloud cost optimization. Frigga stands out by providing both the technology and talent needed to run high-performing, scalable systems. Through our Frigga Cloud Suite, a Kubernetes management tool, we simplify cloud operations and ensure they meet the highest software standards. With our deep-tech cloud hub, we go beyond managing cloud components, optimizing them to deliver a fully automated DevOps experience. Join us to be at the forefront of cloud technology innovation!

***Key Responsibilities***

**Infrastructure Management**

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
* Develop and manage Terraform modules for consistent infrastructure provisioning across multiple environments.
* Automate server configuration and application deployment using Ansible playbooks.
* Monitor and optimize cloud costs while maintaining performance standards.

**CI/CD Pipeline Development**

* Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, building, and deployment.
* Implement GitOps workflows and best practices for version-controlled infrastructure.
* Set up automated testing frameworks for infrastructure code validation.
* Ensure zero-downtime deployments and effective rollback strategies.

**System Operations & Monitoring**

* Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions using tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK Stack.
* Perform capacity planning and performance tuning for applications and infrastructure.
* Troubleshoot production issues and implement preventive measures.
* Maintain detailed system documentation and runbooks for operational procedures.

**Security & Compliance**

* Implement security best practices in infrastructure design and deployment.
* Manage secrets, certificates, and access controls across environments.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards (e.g., SOC2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and internal security policies.
* Conduct regular security assessments and vulnerability management.

**Collaboration & Leadership**

* Collaborate closely with development teams to optimize application deployment strategies.
* Mentor junior team members and contribute to technical decision-making.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response procedures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives and adopt emerging technologies.

***Required Skills & Experience***

* **5 - 8 years of hands-on DevOps**
  /SRE experience in production environments.
* **Terraform**
  : Advanced proficiency in writing, testing, and maintaining Terraform configurations.
* **Ansible**
  : Strong experience with Ansible for configuration management and automation.
* Cloud Platforms: Expertise in
  **AWS, Azure, or GCP .**
* Containerization: Experience with
  **Docker**
  and
  **Kubernetes**
  for container orchestration.
* Proficiency in Python, Go, or similar programming languages for automation.
* Experience with YAML, JSON, and configuration file management.
* Familiarity with API integration and webhook implementations.
* Knowledge of infrastructure testing frameworks like Terratest or InSpec

description:
As a
**Data Analyst Intern**
in AlloFresh, you’ll collaborate with data professionals and cross-functional teams to turn raw data into meaningful insights. You’ll craft intuitive dashboards, automate reporting workflows, and play a key role in our data-driven decision-making. On top of these, you’ll get mentored by our data scientists.

**What You’ll Do**

**Dashboard Development**

* Build customized dashboards using tools like Metabase and Apache Superset
* Translate stakeholder needs into insightful, easy-to-use visualizations.
* Ensure data is accurate, relevant, and actionable.

**Reporting Automation**

* Automate key metrics reporting across different teams
* Write SQL scripts and maintain reporting pipelines.
* Monitor data pipelines to ensure consistent accuracy and delivery.

**Data Insights & Analysis**

* Perform data exploration to uncover trends and opportunities.
* Support ad-hoc requests with well-structured insights.
* Present findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

**What You’ll Learn**

* Practical experience with industry-standard visualization tools.
* How to build scalable, automated data solutions.
* How data powers strategy in a tech-driven, fast-growing business.
* Exposure to diverse functions while being mentored by experienced professionals.

**Who We’re Looking For**
**Basic Qualifications**

* Strong Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Looker, Metabase, Tableau, Power BI, Superset).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication—especially translating data into clear business insights.
* High attention to detail and a passion for data integrity.

**Preferred Extras**

* Familiarity with Python (Pandas, Matplotlib, Sklearn).
* Knowledge of data warehousing (BigQuery, Snowflake).
* Understanding of basic statistical concepts.

This role is ideal for someone eager to dive into data and see their impact in real-world industry. If you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow—
**we’d love to meet you.**

title: AI Engineer/Senior Data Scientist
description:
We are hiring an AI Engineer / Senior Data Scientist to build practical, high-impact AI solutions using large language models (LLMs), machine learning techniques, and computer vision. This role focuses on operationalizing pre-trained models to solve real-world business problems across NLP, RAG pipelines, and OCR use cases.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify use cases, gather requirements, and deliver tailored AI solutions.
* Integrate LLMs from providers (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic) to deliver structured outputs and build interactive chatbot experiences.
* Design and implement advanced prompt engineering techniques such as chain-of-thought prompting, few-shot prompting, and role-based system prompts.
* Utilize frameworks like LangChain or LlamaIndex to orchestrate workflows, manage memory, and integrate tools.
* Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to enhance contextual accuracy of AI responses.
* Design and deploy AI/ML pipelines for structured and unstructured data, including text and image-based inputs.
* Apply OCR techniques using tools such as PaddleOCR for document processing.
* Evaluate and analyze AI model performance, recommending improvements as needed.
* Build and maintain scalable Python APIs using FastAPI to support AI-driven services.
* Deploy and monitor applications on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), ensuring performance, security, and efficiency.
* Maintain clean, version-controlled codebases and follow best practices in testing and CI/CD.
* Document experiments and pipelines, and communicate results through dashboards or reports.
* Stay updated on advancements in LLMs, RAG, OCR, and cloud technologies, and propose innovative solutions.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelors in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Proficiency in Python and experience with libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, and Scikit-learn.
* Experience with FastAPI for API development.
* Familiarity with LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Gemini, Claude) and prompt engineering.
* Knowledge of NLP, embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval architectures.
* Experience with OCR tools like PaddleOCR and image preprocessing.
* Experience deploying models using cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and in teams.

* Experience in a fast-paced startup or product-focused environment

We are looking for an experienced Software Engineer to join our engineering team at GoTo Financial. You will be responsible for designing and building high-performance fintech applications. As a senior engineer, you will work on our flagship products across GoTo, including Gojek, GoPay, ensuring our millions of users get the best experience.

### **What You Will Do**

* + Develop Java backend applications for the company, including web applications and server-side applications
  + Be responsible for participating in the entire software development process, from requirement analysis to design, development, testing, deployment, monitoring and address production incidents. Ensuring that our software products run efficiently and stably. The most significant thing is taking responsibility for results
  + Architect and engineer robust, high-performance systems that can effortlessly handle scale, maintain reliability, ensure security, and gracefully handle faults
  + Craft and refine our product vision into iterative Minimum Viable Products (MVPs), refining them as needed for scalability and adaptability
  + Stay at the forefront of technology trends, continuously evaluating and incorporating new tools and methodologies to supercharge our development efforts.

### **What You Will Need**

* + Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science or a related major
  + 5+ years of Java development experience, with a preference for those with experience in large-scale project development
  + Strong understanding and practical application of SOLID principles, Clean Code practices, and design patterns for maintainable and scalable software
  + Be familiar with the Spring ecosystem, including Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Spring Cloud etc
  + Be familiar with Linux operating systems, understand database principles, and be proficient in using databases like MySQL, Postgres and Oracle
  + Familiar with messaging system like RabbitMQ and KafkaKnow container orchestration technologies like Docker and Kubernetes, and be able to use them for application deployment and management
  + Capable of independently driving and delivering projects of various complexity, while effectively collaborating with stakeholders
  + Possess strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to mentor and support junior developers in their growth and development

**About the Team**

Our team works to provide responsible and sustainable financial services to millions of Indonesians. Partnering with other teams in GoPay and Gojek, we aim to build the best experience for our users looking for a convenient and safe way to access credit. Though we’re spread across Indonesia, India, and Singapore, we enjoy collaborative development with fast feedback cycles and prefer making pragmatic decisions despite working under many business and regulatory constraints. We work in a highly supportive work environment where we never hesitate to help each other out, unblock barriers, and have fun along the way. We love bonding over our catch-up sessions, where we learn about each other's cultures.

**About GoTo Group**

GoTo Group is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia with its mission to “Empower Progress’ by offering technological infrastructure and solutions for everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy. The GoTo ecosystem consists of on-demand transportation services, food and grocery delivery, logistics and fulfillment, as well as financial and payment services through the Gojek and GoTo Financial platforms.It is the first platform in Southeast Asia that hosts these crucial cases in a single ecosystem, capturing the majority of Indonesia’s vast consumer household.

**About Gojek**

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

**About GoTo Financial**

GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

*GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.*

title: Software Engineer in Test
description:
**About The Role**

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) to join our Quality Engineering team in building a highly secure and reliable stablecoin platform. In this role, you will design and implement automated tests across our backend APIs and web-based systems using Java, Selenium, and TestNG. You'll work closely with software engineers, product managers, and compliance experts to develop high-impact test suites that safeguard the integrity and compliance of our products.

**What You Will Do**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable automated test suites for web and backend components using Java, Selenium, and TestNG.
* Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code for functional, integration, and regression tests.
* Work closely with development teams, QA, and product managers to integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline.
* Analyze product requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to define test strategies for high-impact features.
* Develop test coverage for financial transaction flows, compliance logic, and blockchain integration points.
* Investigate, isolate, and document bugs with detailed reproducible steps.
* Identify quality risks and proactively raise concerns during planning and design.
* Support manual testing efforts when required, particularly for complex compliance features or edge cases.

**What We Are Looking For**

* At least 2 years of experience in QA automation or SDET roles.
* Proficient in Java, with strong knowledge of Selenium WebDriver and TestNG.
* Experience testing RESTful APIs using tools like Postman, REST Assured, or custom frameworks.
* Familiarity with Git, CI tools (GitHub & GitHub Actions), and build tools like Maven or Gradle.
* Strong understanding of test design patterns, test data management, and test automation best practices.
* Experience working in Agile or Scrum teams, participating in planning and story refinement.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills.

**About StraitsX**

StraitsX is the pioneering payments infrastructure for digital assets space in Southeast Asia developed by Singapore-based FinTech Xfers, which is a Major Payment Institution licensed by the Monetary Authority of Singapore for e-money issuance (now part of Fazz).

StraitsX offers personal and business accounts to deposit, hold and withdraw funds as well as to connect their accounts to digital asset platforms. Business accounts can also access B2B API-enabled payments rails for digital asset platforms and issues the Singapore Dollar-backed stablecoin, XSGD.

**What We Offer**

At StraitsX, we offer you a workplace that's both exciting and challenging. You'll be part of a team where you're encouraged to speak up, share your ideas, and really make a difference. Our environment is supportive and open. Plus, you'll get lots of guidance and support from our coaching culture, helping you grow and get better in your role everyday.

Most importantly, joining us means you're on board with a company that's a rocket ship. We're quickly becoming a big name in digital asset payments in our region, already having major licenses in Singapore and Indonesia. And we're just getting started.

If you want to be part of something exciting and go on an amazing journey with us, StraitsX is the place for you!

description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced frontend engineer to join our engineering team at GoTo Financial. You will be responsible for designing and building high-performance fintech applications, focussing on building the best possible user experience. You will work on our flagship products across Goto, including Gojek, GoPay, Gopay Merchant, Tokopedia, and TikTokShop, ensuring our millions of users get the best experience.

### **What You Will Do**

* + Work with our product team to solve requirements related to customer journeys Web and mobile Flutter
  + Lead projects to implement features across multiple apps
  + Improve the customer experience for our existing apps by optimizing the usability, performance, and code quality
  + Contribute to architecture decisions across teams and shape the technical direction
  + Mentor and grow other developers to build a culture of learning and innovation
  + Participate in production support and respond to alerts and escalations in customer support

### **What You Will Need**

* + 3-5 years of mobile app development in web
  + Knowledge of building apps in Next.js (preferred), React, and Vue.js
  + Experience architecting and maintaining a consumer-facing app, including release planning, monitoring, and testing practices
  + Familiar with the entire SDLC, and Agile project management practices like Scrum
  + Strong sense of good UI and UX best practices
  + (Bonus) Experience with backend development using Java/Kotlin/Nodejs/Go etc

**About the Team**

Our team works to provide responsible and sustainable financial services to millions of Indonesians. Partnering with other teams in Goto, we aim to build the best experience for our users looking for a convenient and safe way to access credit. Though we’re spread across Indonesia, India, China, and Singapore, we enjoy collaborative development with fast feedback cycles. Our aim is to make pragmatic decisions despite many business and regulatory constraints. We work in a highly supportive work environment where we never hesitate to help each other out, unblock barriers, and have fun along the way. We love bonding over our catch-up sessions, where we learn about each other's cultures.

**About GoTo Group**

GoTo Group is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia with its mission to “Empower Progress’ by offering technological infrastructure and solutions for everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy. The GoTo ecosystem consists of on-demand transportation services, food and grocery delivery, logistics and fulfillment, as well as financial and payment services through the Gojek and GoTo Financial platforms.It is the first platform in Southeast Asia that hosts these crucial cases in a single ecosystem, capturing the majority of Indonesia’s vast consumer household.

**About Gojek**

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

**About GoTo Financial**

GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

*GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.*

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
### About Meridia

Meridia is an AgTech company specialised in field data within complex smallholder-heavy agri-commodity supply chains such as cocoa, coffee, palm oil, rubber and soy.

Meridia Verify®, its flagship SaaS product, verifies supply chain field data in real time – and validates compliance with frameworks such as the EUDR (EU Deforestation Regulation). With Verify, companies can reduce commercial and reputational risk, minimise supply chain disruption and accelerate evidence-based decision-making for strategic sourcing, procurement and trade.

Meridia’s mission is to improve the veracity of datasets driving decision making in global agri-commodity supply chains. Its purpose is to build transparent and inclusive supply chains that afford smallholders a level playing field.

See [https://www.meridia.land](https://www.meridia.land/) for more information on our work.

### Job Description

As a Lead Data Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical expert responsible for architecting, implementing, and optimizing complex data engineering solutions while mentoring more  junior data engineers. You will lead the development of scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that power Meridia's SaaS products, ensuring high-quality data processing for global, multinational business customers.

You will be based in Indonesia and will work closely with our teams in The Netherlands, as well as with colleagues across Indonesia. You will report to the Data Manager in Indonesia.

### Responsibilities

The Lead Data Engineer has the following areas of work and responsibilities:

**Technical Leadership**

* Lead the design and implementation of robust, scalable ETL pipelines for geospatial data processing using technologies like Airflow, AWS, Google Cloud, and relational databases, and guide Data Engineering team on adoption and maintenance
* Architect data infrastructure solutions and data models for metadata to standardize large-scale geospatial datasets from multiple academic, government, and commercial sources into a consistent centralized data lake
* Accountable for driving technical decision-making for data engineering tools, frameworks, and best practices across the Data team while considering cost, resourcing, and effort for ongoing maintenance
* Ensure adherence to software engineering best practices and ProdEng Principles by Data Engineering team including code review, testing, documentation, version control, and repository management

**Team Leadership**

* Mentor and guide junior data engineers, providing technical guidance, ensuring the ProdEng principles are being followed and career development support
* Lead code reviews and ensure high standards of code quality, organization, and reproducibility
* Foster knowledge sharing within the team through technical presentations and documentation
* Collaborate with the Data Manager on resource allocation and project planning
* Act as a technical liaison between the data engineering team and other departments

**Core Data Engineering Skills**

* **Expertise in building, optimizing, and maintaining scalable ETL/data pipelines**, especially for large and complex geospatial datasets, using modern orchestration and workflow tools such as Apache Airflow.
* **Proficient in cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud Platform)**, with hands-on experience architecting data storage, transformation, and metadata solutions in a secure and cost-effective manner.
* **Strong SQL and data modeling skills**, with experience designing relational and NoSQL databases to support data integrity, interoperability, and analytics use cases.
* **Skilled in Python and relevant data engineering frameworks** (e.g., Pandas, PySpark, DBT) for automating data ingestion, cleaning, standardization, and geospatial transformation.
* **Solid understanding of data governance and best practices** in version control (e.g., Git), documentation, data quality assurance, reproducibility, and collaboration in cross-functional data teams.

**Domain knowledge and research**

* Develop domain knowledge of relevant land cover datasets and guide GIS team on dataset creation using software and scripting tools
* Contribute to our (internal) data catalogues, manuals, dictionaries, glossary and broader set of terminology in a coherent way across countries, products and projects.
* Identify new opportunities for improvement, solve bottlenecks and tackle efficiency issues

### Learning and Development

The ideal candidate should be eager and willing to learn and grow in the role. You will be engaged in on-the-job training and development to learn about the land rights sector and our data systems and workflows. You will be mentored by our Data & Methodology team in Indonesia and senior colleagues in Lithuania and the Netherlands.
### Requirements
    The ideal candidate has/is:

* 8+ years of experience in data and 5+ experience building data pipelines
* **Deep curiosity for solving real-world problems** in agriculture, sustainability, and supply chain transparency, with a mission-driven mindset aligned with Meridia’s purpose.
* **Strong analytical thinker** with a strategic approach to designing efficient, scalable, and maintainable data solutions in resource-constrained environments.
* **Excellent communicator and collaborator** who can explain technical data concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across cultures and disciplines.
* **Agile and adaptable**, able to quickly learn new technologies, frameworks, and evolving compliance requirements in a fast-paced SaaS environment.
* **Integrity and accountabilit**y, consistently ensuring data privacy, security, and compliance with relevant legal and industry frameworks (such as EUDR).
* **Proactive, accountable, and a reliable team player**
* Full working proficiency in English

**The following are an advantage:**

* Familiarity with European Union Deforestation-free Regulation (EUDR) forestry and deforestation definitions
* Demonstrated projects or case studies involving forest monitoring or land-use analysis
* Start-up or scale up experience.
### Benefits
    The benefits package includes:

* Market rate salary commensurate with your skills and competencies

* Four-day work week
* A remote working position
* Being part of a fast-growing impact venture with an informal, professional work culture
* A laptop and an external monitor for your work
* Annual employee led Learning & Development budget
* Being part of a fast-growing impact venture with an informal, professional work culture
* Engaging with team members, clients and users in various other countries

The ideal starting date is **August 2025.**

***Please note that only applications submitted through Workable will be reviewed.***

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to jobs@meridia.land for more information about this position.

description:
**AI Engineer (Applied LLMs & RAG Systems)**

📍 Location: Remote (Singapore/SEA time zone preferred)

🕒 Type: Full-Time | Immediate Join

About the Role

We’re building Dx – an AI-powered medical assistant trusted by thousands of doctors across Asia to deliver credible, fast, and clinically relevant answers.

We’re looking for an AI Engineer to help us build and scale the intelligent systems that power Dx. This is a backend-leaning role focused on developing real-world applications of large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic workflows in production.

You’ll work closely with product, design, and medical teams to ship features that matter. Your work will directly impact how clinicians interact with and trust AI in their day-to-day practice.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and implement LLM-based features using frameworks like \*\*LlamaIndex, Transformers, LangChain\*\*, or similar
* Build and optimize \*\*retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)\*\* pipelines using \*\*PgVector, MongoDB, Timescale\*\*, and other stores
* Develop \*\*agentic workflows\*\* that support reasoning, chaining, and background tasks using tools like \*\*Celery, RabbitMQ\*\*, or Temporal
* Architect scalable backend systems using \*\*Python (Flask/FastAPI)\*\* with async capabilities
* Collaborate with frontend engineers (Angular/NextJS) to deliver seamless user experiences
* Ensure strong observability, performance, and code maintainability across AI features
* Continuously evaluate and iterate on LLM performance, prompt strategies, and data flows

**Who we’re looking for**

**Must Have:**

* 5+ years of experience in software engineering with strong Python skills
* Proven experience working with 
  **LLMs**
   and building real-world AI features
* Hands-on experience with 
  **vector databases**
   (PgVector, FAISS, Pinecone, etc.)
* Familiarity with 
  **RAG architectures**
   and information retrieval techniques
* Experience with 
  **asynchronous task queues**
   and backend orchestration frameworks
* Solid knowledge of 
  **Postgres, MongoDB**
  , and optionally 
  **TimescaleDB**

**Nice to have:**

* Familiarity with 
  **TypeScript**
  , Node.js, Firebase/Supabase, or frontend frameworks
* Experience with 
  **containerization**
  , CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure (e.g., AWS, GCP)
* Prior exposure to regulated environments such as 
  **healthcare or fintech**
* Open-source contributions or prior work in AI tooling and infra

**Why join us?**

* Join a 
  **fast-moving team**
   building AI for real-world clinical impact
* Work on production-grade LLM workflows used across Asia
* Collaborate with top medical experts, engineers, and designers
* Operate with full ownership in a 
  **remote-first, async-friendly**
   environment
* Build with purpose — everything we ship helps doctors deliver better care

**Our Culture**

While we have been growing fast, we are still small enough that everyone makes a pivotal difference. We care less about hours worked and more about the outcome — and the impact you make. We have worked hard to create an autonomous working culture with an emphasis on work/life balance and a fun-working environment.

**Team guiding principles:**

* Always in BETA — Constantly ask ourselves: “How can I do this better?” — even when it works just fine.
* All in for doctors — All decisions are focused on improving the value-add and user experience for doctors.
* Move the mountain — Grit and determination in being the best we can be despite the obstacles: help build and drive the future.
* Integrity is our bond — Honouring our commitment to our stakeholders, to each other, and to the communities in which we operate.

**Viktor Kyosev: viktor@docquity.com**

title: Data Analyst for CEO Office
description:
**Who are we?**

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

**How did we manage to do that?**

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

**How did it all start?**

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank) in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform, Tunaiku.

**Our philosophy, mission, and vision**

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who ‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

**More about the bank with startup culture environment**

Consist of 1000+ people, you will meet people who love to grow, dream big, and actually have fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it, have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

**Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!**

The Data Analyst will initially support the CEO’s office, focusing on strategic projects and decision-making processes. The role involves analyzing complex data sets to provide actionable insights, preparing reports, and presenting findings to the executive team. Over time, the individual will transition into a Functional Analyst role, working closely with specific departments to optimize their operational and strategic outcomes.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with the CEO’s office to identify business challenges and opportunities, formulate analytical approaches, and deliver data-driven insights.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and other analytical tools to monitor key performance indicators and business metrics.
* Conduct deep-dive analyses to solve complex business problems, translating data into actionable recommendations.
* Prepare and present clear, concise, and compelling analytical presentations for both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior executives.
* Collaborate with various departments to understand their data and analytics needs as preparation for the transition to a Functional Analyst role.
* Participate in cross-functional projects to gain a comprehensive understanding of the organization’s operations and strategic goals.
* Stay updated with industry trends, tools, and best practices in data analysis and business intelligence.

### **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Business Analytics, or related field.
* Proven experience in data analysis, business analytics, or a related role.
* Strong proficiency in data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, Python, R) and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to derive insights from large and complex data sets.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts to a non-technical audience.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously.
* A team player with a proactive attitude and the ability to work independently.

### **Career Path**

* This role offers a unique opportunity to start in the CEO’s office and transition into a Functional Analyst role, aligned with the individual’s interests and the organization’s needs. This pathway is designed for those passionate about using data to drive strategic decisions and operational efficiencies across different facets of the organization.

title: SENIOR SOFTWARE Test Engineer (Technical) | PRODUCT R&D, INNOVATION & OWNERSHIP
description:
**About CSG**
CSG is a multinational organisation headquartered in the United States with more than 5000 employees in countries around the world.
  
  
We’re a SaaS platform company that helps some of the world’s most recognizable brands solve their toughest business challenges. Our innovative solutions and trusted experts enable companies to create customer experiences that set them apart.
  
  
At CSG, you're more than your resume. We want your diverse perspective and unique background to help us enrich the work we do together. We believe that by channelling the power of all, we make ordinary customer and employee experiences extraordinary. This is your opportunity to join one of our high-performing teams. Channel the power of YOU and begin the journey to becoming a CSGer.
  
  
**Our product & team**
This role is within the team that designs and develops CSG Quote & Order, a cutting-edge order management and quoting (CPQ) platform. Built using the latest technology, our platform modernizes industries like telecommunications and banking.
  
  
Our team promotes a collaborative culture where everyone’s contributions are valued, and diversity is celebrated. We prioritize continuous learning and improvement to keep our product competitive, and ensure CSG remains an exciting workplace.
  
  
Due to growing demand from high-profile customers, our team is expanding in 2025 and that's where you come in!
  
  
**About Our Technology**
Our product adopts a microservice architecture for scalability and flexibility, using Kafka for event streaming and PostgreSQL for data storage. We use Kubernetes to orchestrate our containers, allowing us to offer cloud (AWS & Azure) and on-premise deployment options of our platform. Our infrastructure is maintained by a state-of-the-art gitops/IaC pipeline.
  
  
In short, we have a really modern platform, and we take our testing very seriously!
  
  
Our testing process leverages automation for both UI and API testing, significantly improving test coverage and efficiency. With Cucumber, we create automation scripts that utilise the behaviour-driven development (BDD) methodology. This allows us to write tests in a straightforward, human-readable format, promoting better understanding and collaboration across our team. Our automation scripts are managed using Git and undergo peer review before being released into the wild.
  
  
**About The Role**
Joining our team as a Senior Technical Test Engineer you will collaborate with our cross-functional team to effectively test features/technology for the CSG Quote & Order product to maintain & improve quality standards. You will develop and execute tests using modern tools such as Karate (API), Cypress (UI) and k6 (Performance).
  
  
Over time, you’ll become a Subject Matter Expert for our software, enabling you to make an impact on user experience and product design within our team.
  
  
In your first 90 days, you’ll get comfortable with our system, join a squad, build strong relationships with the team, and get involved in new feature development to deliver high quality outcomes for our customers.
  
  
Hi, I'm Zandile Vanqa, your Recruiter and guide to joining CSG. At CSG, you're more than your resume. We want your diverse perspective and unique background to help us enrich the work we do together. We believe that by channeling the power of all, we make ordinary customer and employee experiences extraordinary. Channel the power of YOU and begin the journey to becoming a CSGer.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Compose complex test plans, execute tests, document the results and understand the output.
* Use the latest tools like Karate (API), Cypress (UI) and k6 (Performance) to accelerate our test cycles.
* Work to connect our automation tools into our CI/CD pipelines.
* Participate in agile ceremonies such as planning, reviews, stand-ups, demos, retrospectives, etc.
* Be part of a multi-skill squad with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Developers and other Software Testers.
* Evaluate new tools, frameworks, and trends to keep us at the forefront of innovation and productivity.
* Lead small groups of testers as per project needs.

**Role Requirements**
We’re all about diverse skills and experiences, so even if you don’t tick every box, we encourage you to apply!
  
  

* 5+ years of Software Test Engineer experience or someone with software development experience who is looking for a test engineering role.
* Knowledge in software testing; research, design, methodologies/processes, implementation and documentation.
* Experience with Test Automation: Writing and maintaining automation test scripts.
* Highly effective at communicating in English, experience collaborating across multiple teams and a strong comprehension of written/verbal material.
* It's a plus if you are familiar with: Cypress, Cucumber & Karate DSL and have experience in one or more programming languages (preferably JavaScript/NodeJs).

**CSGer Perks & Benefits**

* Work from anywhere: CSG has a global policy called "Flexibility First" that allows employees to work from wherever they feel most productive. The Quote & Order team does not maintain a dedicated office space, so your position will be 100% remote with the exception of several in-person workshops during the year (in Bali – see below – and Melbourne).
* Twice-yearly workshops in Bali: Twice a year the whole Quote & Order team gets together in Bali, Indonesia for dedicated in-person time including team presentations, hackathon sessions, training and team-building activities.
* Paid volunteer days: Everyone at CSG gets two paid days per year to volunteer at a community organisation of your choice.

**Location(s):**
Indonesia Remote

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Us**
BPS, established in Indonesia in 2018, is a company that provides alternative credit scoring services, which is a reliable indicator to assess an individual's level of creditworthiness in meeting their financial obligations. BPS utilizes artificial intelligence (AI) technology to analyze various alternative data used in alternative credit scoring products. Alternative data sources include information managed by e-commerce companies, social media, payment gateways, and telecommunications.
  
  
**Why Join BPS**

* Innovation: Be part of a company that thrives on innovation and embraces the opportunities presented by AI and alternative data.
* Impact: Contribute to reshaping the future of financial services by promoting inclusivity and offering a fair assessment of individuals' financial capabilities.
* Collaborative Culture: Join a dynamic, collaborative team where your ideas are valued, and your growth is nurtured.

If you're ready to be part of a team that is redefining the rules of the game in the financial industry, we invite you to explore opportunities at PT Bangun Percaya Sosial. Join us on this exciting journey as we pave the way for a more inclusive and informed financial ecosystem.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a skilled and proactive
**DevOps Engineer**
to design, build, and maintain a secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure environment. This role is critical in enabling seamless collaboration between engineering, data science, and security teams. You will be responsible for managing Kubernetes clusters, automating CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring our systems comply with industry regulations such as ISO 27001 and OJK guidelines. Ideal candidates are experienced in GitOps, container orchestration, and cloud-native tools, with a strong focus on reliability, security, and cost optimization. Experience in fintech or other regulated environments is a strong advantage.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable Kubernetes clusters
* Automate CI/CD pipelines for backend services, data processing jobs, and model deployment workflows.
* Build and manage monitoring, logging, and alerting systems using tools like Grafana, or similar.
* Maintain infrastructure-as-code using tools such as ArgoCD.
* Work closely with engineering and data science teams to support real-time model inference and batch data workflows.
* Ensure infrastructure compliance with data privacy regulations and internal security policies (e.g., ISO 27001 / ISO 27701, OJK regulations).
* Optimize cost and performance across staging, development, and production environments.
* Own incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement of reliability and uptime.
* Implement secrets management, RBAC, network policies, and other cloud-native security controls

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing Kubernetes clusters in production.
* Proficiency with GitOps tools (e.g., ArgoCD).
* Strong knowledge of Docker and container orchestration.
* Experience with cloud providers
* Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and alerting stacks.

**Preferred**

* Background in fintech or regulated industries.
* Knowledge of event streaming platforms like Kafka.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, ISO 27701, or similar audits.
* Familiarity with zero-downtime deployments and blue/green or canary strategies.

title: Web Developer
description:
**Company description**

Wondertabs is a digital IT start-up that focused on providing professional branding and web/e-commerce design solutions for all sizes of businesses in Singapore and Indonesia.

We are looking for an individual that is willing to learn, contribute and grow with the company. Keep in mind that as the company is a brand new start-up and the team is a small tight group, candidate must be willing to handle and help with every aspect/role of the business.

Our ideal candidate is someone with experience in web design and development, e-commerce development, and hosting management. In addition, to be an outstanding communicator, you will also demonstrate excellent interpersonal and analytical skills.

Your role will be to work along with the existing team of designers/developers in bringing creative concepts to life – leaving a mark in the minds of people, connecting brands to people and people to people. A creative opportunity to learn and develop your creativity in a supportive work environment.

At Wondertabs, we strongly value the importance of every staff. A career with us is a journey of learning and rewards as we work alongside each other to scale greater heights.

**Job Description**

**Responsibilities**

* Development of websites on a WordPress-based platform
* Development of e-commerce websites with WooCommerce
* Updating and maintaining existing WordPress websites, including content updates, visual enhancements, landing page creation, plugins & widgets
* Testing and troubleshooting pages on multiple browsers and platforms
* Troubleshooting server/hosting issues
* Troubleshooting responsive code issues
* Optimise and Implement SEO into websites
* Setting up new customer websites and hosting accounts
* Helping customers set up and configure email programs
* Assisting customers with making changes to their website
* Turning mockups into functioning sites
* Manage and execute against a variety of development tasks for new and existing clients.
* Working with a team of designers, project managers and developers to complete tasks
* Communicate clearly and effectively with clients, while understanding client goals and requirements.
* Manage the execution of all creative deliverables in line with project schedule and deadlines
* Able to multitask and react quickly to shifting priorities
* Assist in any other marketing duties and ad hoc duties as assigned

**﻿Qualifications**

* A portfolio that demonstrates good web design skills
* Must possess own Laptop
* Excellent understanding of all things WordPress/WooCommerce
* Strong knowledge of PHP , HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript
* At least 2-4 years of relevant in-house, or agency experience
* Candidate must possess at least SMK, SMU, SMA, Diploma or S1 (Bachelor’s degree)
* Must be computer savvy and has a strong knowledge of most functions in MS office programs.
* Strong written and verbal and presentation skills in English
* Open to constructive feedback and criticism
* High levels of enthusiasm, creativity, and resourcefulness
* Open-minded, teachable, inquisitive, proactive
* Ability to work within a collaborative environment independently and as part of a team
* Good time-management skills that allow you to work effectively under pressure
* You must be able to take high-stress levels to meet deadlines
* You must be willing to do all other Ad Hoc duties.
* Strong ability to pick up errors or predict errors.
* Can call or meet customers for service issues.

**Bonus**

* Knowledge in digital advertising & marketing concepts, especially FB Ads, IG Ads & YouTube Ads
* Experience with UI/UX Design
* Skilled in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustration, InDesign, After Effects)

**Please include the following information in your resume/cv:**

* Personal Particulars
* Education background
* Work experiences
* Reason(s) for leaving
