title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**About Carousell Group**
  
Carousell Group is the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India). Visit here for more information.

**Laku6**

Laku6 is the leading AI-first end-to-end Electronics Recommerce platform in Indonesia where our technology has helped over 500,000 users sell their gadgets directly for cash or via Trade-In with leading eCommerce Partners and in over 1,000 offline retail shops. We believe that making it easier for sellers to sell and safer for buyers to buy used-electronics and smartphones is a critical step to achieving that.

In July 2022, we became a part of Carousell Group, via one of the largest capital investments to-date into the region's Electronics Recommerce space.

Laku6's technology integrated with Carousell's regional platform of tens of millions of users will make buying and selling used electronics more accessible than ever before for millions of users; this will extend the life-cycle of electronics goods and slow down the growth of e-waste.

Visit www.laku6.com/ for more information.

**Job Description**

**Responsibilities{{:}}**

- Design and build high-availability architecture on Kubernetes clusters, including handling upgrades, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
- Develop, maintain and manage tools to automate operational activities and enhance engineering productivity.
- Maintain our monitoring stack (VictoriaMetrics, Jaeger, Grafana), build alerts to detect anomalies before reaching users, and handle incident response and post-mortem analysis to improve system availability.
- Ensuring the database reliability including handling replication, failover, and performance tuning on various datastore (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, and Memcache).
- Manage all infrastructure using IaC (Opentofu, Ansible, ArgoCD, Helm). Develop a modular and reusable IaC for the entire stack.
- Develop, optimize and maintain GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and CircleCI workflows to ensure fast and reliable delivery.
- Ensure a secure production environment, including managing secrets, firewalls, and access controls.
- Analyze infrastructure utilization and ensure high availability of the infrastructure while minimizing cost.
- Update, track and resolve technical issues in a timely manner.
- Explore and integrate AI-driven insights into operational processes to improve reliability, reduce noise, and empower engineering teams with intelligent decision-making.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications{{:}}**

- At least 4 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineer with relevant experience working in system engineering.
- Strong experience in building scalable systems. Experience with microservices and exposure to highly available web scale systems is a must.
- Knowledge of modern tech stacks. Comfortable with writing tools and automation in Bash, Python, or Go.
- Deep experience with storage technologies, including databases (Postgres and MySQL), document stores (MongoDB), caching systems (Redis, memcache), Queue and Pubsub (Kafka), and search engines (Elasticsearch).
- Experience of working with cloud environments (GCP and AWS, GCP certified is plus).
- Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Ansible, Terraform/Opentofu, Helm, and ArgoCD.
- User obsession and empathy.
- Focus on impact and results. You work on the right things and get them done.
- Drive and resourcefulness to persevere and overcome obstacles achieving challenging goals.
- High integrity and ability to positively collaborate with others.

**Additional Information**

We are looking for a strong DevOps / SRE Engineer to join the Laku6, part of Carousell Group. You will be the operational backbone of our marketplace, focusing on the reliability, scalability, and performance of our infrastructure. You will manage our GKE clusters and databases while leveraging the central platform tools to drive operational excellence.

100% Remote, Work from Home

By proceeding with your application
**,**
you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.

description:
**About Us**

Populix is a consumer insights platform that helps businesses connect with its database of respondents and provides them with insights to better understand the preferences of Indonesian consumers. Populix has a pool of over 1,000,000 diverse, readily accessible, and highly-qualified respondents across Indonesia. Its products range from intensive research studies to simple surveys and can be arranged on a project or subscription basis. Focusing on Indonesian consumers being super sticky to their phones, Populix facilitates a diverse range of data collection methods via its mobile app.

**Job Brief:**

- Assist in setting up, maintaining, and monitoring cloud infrastructure and servers
- Support CI/CD pipelines for automated build, test, and deployment processes
- Help manage containerized applications using Docker and orchestration tools
- Monitor system performance, availability, and security
- Assist in troubleshooting deployment and infrastructure issues
- Maintain documentation for infrastructure, processes, and configurations
- Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment and operational workflows
- Follow DevOps best practices, security standards, and operational procedures

**Technical Requirements**

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
- Basic understanding of Linux/Unix operating systems
- Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure
- Basic knowledge of CI/CD concepts and tools (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins)
- Experience or exposure to containerization tools such as Docker
- Basic understanding of networking concepts (DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP)
- Familiarity with version control systems (Git)
- Familiarity with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, etc.)

**Nice to Have**

- Exposure to Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, etc.)
- Basic scripting skills (Bash, Python, or similar)
- Knowledge of Kubernetes or container orchestration concepts
- Exposure to security best practices in cloud environments
- Exposure to security compliance standards (ISO 27001 is a good addition)

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**About Carousell Group**  
Carousell Group is the leading multi-category platform for secondhand in Greater Southeast Asia on a mission to make secondhand the first choice. Founded in August 2012 in Singapore, the Group has a leading presence in seven markets under the brands Carousell, Carousell Media Group, Cho Tot, Laku6, LuxLexicon, Mudah.my, OneShift, REFASH and Revo Financial, serving tens of millions of monthly active users. Carousell is backed by leading investors including Telenor Group, Rakuten Ventures, Naver, STIC Investments, 500 Global and Peak XV Partners (formerly known as Sequoia Capital India). Visit here for more information.

**Laku6**

Laku6 is the leading AI-first end-to-end Electronics Recommerce platform in Indonesia where our technology has helped over 500,000 users sell their gadgets directly for cash or via Trade-In with leading eCommerce Partners and in over 1,000 offline retail shops. We believe that making it easier for sellers to sell and safer for buyers to buy used-electronics and smartphones is a critical step to achieving that.

In July 2022, we became a part of Carousell Group, via one of the largest capital investments to-date into the region's Electronics Recommerce space.

Laku6's technology integrated with Carousell's regional platform of tens of millions of users will make buying and selling used electronics more accessible than ever before for millions of users; this will extend the life-cycle of electronics goods and slow down the growth of e-waste.

Visit www.laku6.com/ for more information.

 **Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

- Design and build high-availability architecture on Kubernetes clusters, including handling upgrades, capacity planning, and cost optimization.
- Develop, maintain and manage tools to automate operational activities and enhance engineering productivity.
- Maintain our monitoring stack (VictoriaMetrics, Jaeger, Grafana), build alerts to detect anomalies before reaching users, and handle incident response and post-mortem analysis to improve system availability.
- Ensuring the database reliability including handling replication, failover, and performance tuning on various datastore (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Kafka, Redis, and Memcache).
- Manage all infrastructure using IaC (Opentofu, Ansible, ArgoCD, Helm). Develop a modular and reusable IaC for the entire stack.
- Develop, optimize and maintain GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, and CircleCI workflows to ensure fast and reliable delivery.
- Ensure a secure production environment, including managing secrets, firewalls, and access controls.
- Analyze infrastructure utilization and ensure high availability of the infrastructure while minimizing cost.
- Update, track and resolve technical issues in a timely manner.
- Explore and integrate AI-driven insights into operational processes to improve reliability, reduce noise, and empower engineering teams with intelligent decision-making.

 **Qualifications**

**Qualifications:**

- At least 4 years of experience in SRE, DevOps, Systems Engineering, or Software Engineer with relevant experience working in system engineering.
- Strong experience in building scalable systems. Experience with microservices and exposure to highly available web scale systems is a must.
- Knowledge of modern tech stacks. Comfortable with writing tools and automation in Bash, Python, or Go.
- Deep experience with storage technologies, including databases (Postgres and MySQL), document stores (MongoDB), caching systems (Redis, memcache), Queue and Pubsub (Kafka), and search engines (Elasticsearch).
- Experience of working with cloud environments (GCP and AWS, GCP certified is plus).
- Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
- Strong experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Ansible, Terraform/Opentofu, Helm, and ArgoCD.
- User obsession and empathy.
- Focus on impact and results. You work on the right things and get them done.
- Drive and resourcefulness to persevere and overcome obstacles achieving challenging goals.
- High integrity and ability to positively collaborate with others.

 **Additional Information**

We are looking for a strong DevOps / SRE Engineer to join the Laku6, part of Carousell Group. You will be the operational backbone of our marketplace, focusing on the reliability, scalability, and performance of our infrastructure. You will manage our GKE clusters and databases while leveraging the central platform tools to drive operational excellence.

100% Remote, Work from Home

By proceeding with your application**,** you are adhering to our PDPA policies. In case you are interested to know more, read about our Candidates Personal Data Privacy Statement.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team architects, builds, and maintains the rock-solid infrastructure that applications rely on. We work closely with development teams to ensure scalability, reliability, and efficiency. This collaboration empowers us to deliver exceptional customer experiences while enabling developers to focus on building great features.

#### **What You Will Do**

- Deploy, automate, maintain, and manage various cloud-based and on-premises production systems.
- Understanding the high-level overview of our architecture, and possessing the ability to systematically document new and existing requirements to ensure a smooth project delivery without miscommunication.
- Work closely with the Information security and infrastructure team in ensuring that we are adopting security best practices.
- Ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, and security of productions systems.
- Troubleshoot and resolve system issues across platform and application domains.
- Suggest architectural improvements and recommend process optimizations.
- Evaluate new technologies to enhance the infrastructure stack.
- Ensuring system security policies are properly remediated.
- Drive and implement automated provisioning and scaling of servers, along with testing and compliance checks using automation tools.
- Handle operational tasks, including on-call duties, alerts, and incident management.

#### **What We Are Looking For**

- At least 2 years of engineering experience.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., IT, Computer Science) or a proven track record in DevOps.
- A strong willingness to continuously upgrade skills and stay up-to-date with the latest DevOps trends.
- Experience with cloud-native tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, Nginx, OpenTelemetry) is a plus.
- Experience managing cloud servers (AWS, GCP).
- A desire to transition into engineering management is a valued addition.
- Experience with on-premises physical servers, databases, and storage solutions (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis) is a plus, as well as familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, Pulumi).

title: Solutions Architect
description:
**About Iron Mountain**

Iron Mountain is the world's leading data storage and information management solution provider. For over 70 years, Iron Mountain Incorporated (NYSE: IRM) has been a strategic partner to care for your information and assets. A global leader in storage and information management services and trusted by more than 225,000 organizations around the world, including 95% of the Fortune 1000, we protect, unlock, and extend the value of your work – whatever it is, wherever it is, however it’s stored.

Here, you’ll bring your expertise and creativity to a workplace that thrives on continuous improvement. Here, you’ll be part of a global workforce that embraces the differences among us. And here, we’ll encourage you to Climb Higher for the benefit of our customers and each other. There is so much more, but enough about us. We can’t wait to hear about YOU.

**About the Job**

If you seek a high-growth career opportunity with national (and potentially expanding to regional) responsibilities in a market leading data management and information governance services company, this could be an ideal opportunity for you. To support the growth of our digital business in the Asia Pacific region, Iron Mountain seeks a Digital Solutions Architect for Indonesia in our Digital Business Unit. The ideal candidate should have 5 to 10 years' experience in digital solution design, technical architecture development, pre-sales and/or sales of software solutions, digital storage (cloud or on-premise), and IT infrastructure. We develop digital platforms and integrate best-of-breed digital solutions for you to engage enterprise and government customers and partners as their digital solutions consultant and to deliver Information, Content and Data Management solutions that our customers need.

**About the Team**

You shall be part of the growing Commercial Team of the Asia Pacific Digital Business Unit. The team comprises technology industry professionals who have extensive experience in the sales and pre-sales of digital solutions to add value to our customers' work. You shall report to the regional leader of solution architecture and shall have peers across Asia Pacific and the world. This team is open, dynamic, collaborative, positive and highly energetic. If this is the type of environment that you envisage working in, then please read further.

**Responsibilities**

- Understand customers physical and digital information environment and identify challenges; provide problem solving solutions as it relates to Iron Mountain services
- Scoping Iron Mountain solutions across the Digital portfolio
- Experience in SaaS CSP Platform solutioning and value propositioning
- Present solutions overviews and demonstrations
- Answer advanced solutions and services questions
- Pilot / Proof Of Concept (POC) development, tracking and support
- Answer sales teams questions and provide training as needed
- Support technical portion of RFPs and RFQs/RFIs
- Gather and share intelligence on market trends, industry trends and competitors
- Attend relevant trade shows and marketing events to create and advance opportunities
- Provide solution configuration recommendations, architectural diagrams, quote / schedule / contract / SOW creation, modification and support
- Proficient in Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and Return On Investment (ROI) modelling
- Exceed assigned pipeline and quota achievement.

**Qualifications**

A degree or diploma from a recognized institution of higher learning in Indonesia or overseas. Ideally 5 to 10 Years of working experience with the following:

- Working knowledge of Electronic Content Management solutions, Document Management Systems, Workflow, Business Process Management and Information Governance
- Understanding of the use of Enterprise Software for structured and unstructured data and content management
- Familiar with Cloud SaaS or on-premise content services, digital storage and information management
- Possess industry-specific expertise around modern digital technologies and their impact in business transformation
- Experienced in consultative solution sales and pre-sales
- Able to collaborate at all levels within Iron Mountain and serve our customers from operational to C-level
- Knowledge of Electronic Resource Management, Customer Relationship Management, Document-Content Management, Information Governance and Business Intelligence
- Familiar with enterprise data storage/archiving techniques and applications
- Awareness of cloud storage such as Amazon S3, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform digital storage solutions

**About You:**

- Strong command of the English and Bahasa Indonesia with excellent written, oral and presentation skills.
- Strong interpersonal skills as required of a consultant, including the ability to engage and ask the right questions, listen and understand, analyse and process information, correlate customer needs to solutions, plan and respond to address current customer issues and foreseeable issues in the future.
- Able to communicate openly, have discretion as needed, willing to learn and share information/career experiences.
- Possess high degree of self-motivation and an inquisitive curiosity and willing to seek answers.
- Ideally extroverted with the ability to influence and negotiate with others.
- Ability to make decisions and think in broad terms, considering the impact on Iron Mountain and our customers.
- Willing to learn and have fun in a dynamic hybrid work environment.

title: Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Job Description
  
  
We are seeking an IT Infrastructure, Cloud & Microsoft 365 Engineer to design, implement, and manage a hybrid IT environment combining on-premise servers, cloud infrastructure, and Microsoft 365 services. The role supports business operations across head office, project sites, and offshore/onshore environments.
  
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Design and maintain hybrid infrastructure (On-Premise + Cloud).
  
  
Administer and support Microsoft 365 tenant and services.
  
  
Manage on-premise servers (Windows/Linux) and virtualization platforms.
  
  
Configure and maintain network infrastructure (VLAN, VPN, NAT, firewall).
  
  
Integrate on-prem Active Directory with Azure AD / Entra ID.
  
  
Implement backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
  
  
Ensure security, access control, and policy enforcement across systems.
  
  
Support business systems (ERP, project systems, document management).
  
  
Provide infrastructure support for remote and project-based EPCIC sites.
  
  
Prepare technical documentation, SOPs, and architecture diagrams.
  
  
  
  
Technical Requirements
  
  
Mandatory
  
  
Strong experience with on-premise infrastructure:
  
  
Windows Server, Linux Server
  
  
Active Directory, DNS, DHCP
  
  
Virtualization (VMware / Hyper-V / Proxmox)
  
  
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP).
  
  
Solid understanding of networking fundamentals.
  
  
Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, including:
  
  
Exchange Online (mailboxes, mail flow, security)
  
  
SharePoint Online & OneDrive (document management)
  
  
Microsoft Teams (collaboration, policies)
  
  
Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) user & group management
  
  
Experience managing hybrid identity (AD Sync / Entra Connect).
  
  
Understanding of M365 security basics:
  
  
Conditional Access
  
  
MFA
  
  
Role-based access control
  
  
Backup and recovery knowledge (on-prem & cloud).

title: Jr. Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
**Company description**

Worlder TEAM is a startup founded by four doctorates and a project manager from Carnegie Mellon University, one of the top universities in engineering and technology in the United States. Our company is on a mission to create a groundbreaking platform that empowers small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to effortlessly expand their businesses globally, as outlined in our mission statement, "Create a platform that takes SMEs global effortlessly."

**Experience:**

Cybersecurity Background with 1-2 years of experience

Job Overview: We are seeking a motivated
**Jr. Cybersecurity Engineer**

with an interest in cloud (especially within AWS cloud environment) and operational security to support our security team. As an intern, you will assist in maintaining and improving our security posture while gaining hands-on experience with real-world tools, environments, and best practices. This role is designed for learning and growth, with the potential to transition into a Junior Cybersecurity Engineer upon successful performance.

**Responsibilities:**

**As an Jr, you will work under guidance from senior engineers on tasks such as:**

- Assist in reviewing system configurations and learning how to design secure and scalable Cloud-based solutions.
- Support basic cloud security tasks such as checking IAM permissions, reviewing S3 bucket policies, and monitoring security alerts.
- Help with conducting preliminary security assessments and documenting findings.
- Assist in routine system audits to identify common misconfigurations or vulnerabilities.
- Participate in monitoring security tools and helping respond to low-priority alerts or incidents under supervision.
- Work with development and operations teams to gain exposure to integrating security controls into CI/CD pipelines.
- Stay updated on AWS fundamentals, cloud security basics, and emerging cybersecurity trends.
- Contribute to maintaining security documentation, policies, and procedures.
- Support team activities such as preparing training material or awareness content.

**Qualifications:**

 

**Required:**

- Completed a degree/diploma in Computer Science, Information Security, Cybersecurity, or related field.
- Basic understanding of cloud computing concepts (AWS knowledge is a plus but not required).
- Familiarity with fundamental security concepts (authentication, authorization, encryption, vulnerabilities, etc.).
- Interest in learning AWS security services such as IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC, and KMS.
- Basic understanding of common application vulnerabilities (e.g., XSS, SQL Injection) based on OWASP Top 10.
- Willingness to learn vulnerability assessment and basic penetration testing tools.
- Willingness to learn security tools and understanding basic concepts of security events.
- Good problem-solving skills and eagerness to work in a collaborative environment.
- Strong communication skills and willingness to ask questions.

**Nice to Have (Not Required):**

- Hands-on exposure through school projects or self-learning with tools like Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nessus, Wireshark, etc.
- Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Bash) or basic automation.
- Introductory knowledge of compliance or security frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR).
- Certifications such as
  **CompTIA Security+**

  ,
  **AWS Cloud Practitioner**

  , or other entry-level certs (not mandatory).

**Benefits:**

 

- Fully remote working with laptop provided.
- Entry into early stage tech startup.
- Work experience in innovative and fast paced startup environment.
- Space for growth and leadership opportunities.

description:
**Company Description**

SawitPRO is a cutting-edge green digital agritech startup located in the heart of Jakarta. Our mission is to be the best innovator that improves the lives of everyone in the palm oil industry. Through our integrated end-to-end agri-platform, we create a win-win-win scenario for people, planet, and prosperity.

We provide integrated apps that connect the supply chain stakeholders in the palm oil industry (Mills, DO Agents, Smallholders, Harvesters, Drivers, etc.). Creating a digital ecosystem that essentially boosts their productivity with effortless work documentation, affordable yet original agri-inputs, and agronomist services.

Our commitment extends beyond providing innovative solutions; we aim to nurture every aspect of Indonesia's palm oil industry. By fostering growth and sustainability, we strive to bring positive change to the lives of individuals in the palm oil sector, one at a time.

**Role Description**

1. Architect, provision, and maintain resilient cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles, with a strong preference for Terraform.
2. Manage and scale modern cloud-native workloads using Kubernetes (GKE), including standardizing application deployments and configurations using Helm to ensure consistency across environments.
3. Drive cost optimization and efficiency by monitoring resource utilization, analyzing cloud spend, and rightsizing infrastructure to maximize business value.
4. Develop custom automation scripts and internal tools using Python or Bash to eliminate toil and streamline operational tasks.
5. Develop and refine comprehensive monitoring dashboards and observability frameworks, with a strong preference for the Grafana Stack and Sentry for proactive error tracking.
6. Lead troubleshooting efforts across distributed systems, performing root cause analysis (RCA) to prevent recurrence and improve system stability.
7. Design and implement automated CI/CD pipelines and frameworks to ensure seamless, low-risk software delivery cycles.
8. Collaborate with software engineers to make services highly available, reliable, and scalable by defining and tracking key reliability metrics.
9. Conduct regular architectural reviews and performance tuning to identify bottlenecks and suggest system improvements.
10. Evaluate new technology options and products, making pragmatic choices that deliver maximum business value and sustainability.

**Qualifications**

1. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field (or equivalent work experience).
2. Significant experience as an SRE or similar role in a production cloud environment, specifically within Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
3. Professional cloud certifications (e.g., Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer or Professional Cloud Architect) are considered a strong plus.
4. Strong expertise in cloud-native technologies, including hands-on experience with Kubernetes (GKE) and package management using Helm.
5. Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), with a strong preference for Terraform.
6. Strong programming and scripting skills, with the ability to write automation scripts in Python or Bash.
7. Demonstrated experience with observability tools, with a strong preference for the Grafana Stack and Sentry.
8. Strong understanding of the principles and best practices of Software Engineering.
9. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment practices.
10. Strong problem-solving abilities with an analytic and qualitative eye for reasoning under pressure.
11. Self-starter with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced work environment.
12. Strong team player with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
13. Willingness to relocate to Pekanbaru for two months during the probation period.

title: Android Developer (Mobile Training System)
description:
The Android developer will be responsible for MTS (Mobile Training System) development. (Screen and Native)

Job Overview

1) Design, develop, and debug Android applications independently.

2) Review product requirements, provide technical feedback, and contribute to project planning and estimation.

3) Create and maintain high-quality engineering documentation (architecture, APIs, release notes).

4) Implement modern Android architecture (MVVM/MVI/Clean) with Jetpack (ViewModel, Room, Navigation).

5) Build responsive, accessible UIs using Material Design (XML or Jetpack Compose); ensure adaptive layouts for various screen sizes and safe-area insets.

6) Troubleshoot and debug efficiently using Logcat and ADB, and de-obfuscate crashes (ProGuard/R8 mappings).

7) Work closely with the product team to turn customer input into practical short- and long-term solutions.

8) Enforce security best practices (secure storage, TLS/certificate pinning, obfuscation) and comply with privacy/policy requirements.

9) Manage Play Console workflows (app signing, tracks, staged rollouts); publishing experience on Google Play is a strong plus.

10) Support localization, accessibility, and backward compatibility across Android versions and devices.

11) Integrate real-time features from backend services into the Android app using socket programming

Skills / Experience Requirements

1) Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

2) 3–5 years of hands-on Android development experience.

3) Familiar with Java and Kotlin.

4) Proficient with the Android SDK and OOP; able to deliver features end-to-end independently.

5) Understanding of socket programming for real-time features (WebSocket/TCP: connecting to services, maintaining the connection, retries, and ensuring messages are received correctly).

6) Self-starter with strong ownership and minimal supervision required.

7) Committed to producing high-quality, high-performance, and well-designed software.

8) Committed to continuously improving software engineering skills.

9) Experience with Git (version control) and Jira (issue tracking).

10) Basic communication skills in English (verbal and written).

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
EngageRocket is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to take ownership of our cloud infrastructure, reliability, and security foundations as we scale. This is a high-impact, hands-on role where you will be responsible for designing, building, and operating a secure, resilient, and scalable platform.
  
  
You will work closely with engineering, product, and leadership to ensure our platform is stable, compliant, and built for growth, while remaining deeply involved in day-to-day technical execution.
  
  
What You’ll Own
  
  
Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture
  
  
Design, build, and operate EngageRocket’s AWS-based infrastructure with a focus on scalability, security, and reliability.
  
Make and document architecture decisions with a long-term view on performance, cost efficiency, and risk.
  
Drive infrastructure standardization and automation to reduce operational risk and manual work.
  
  
CI/CD, Automation & Platform Reliability
  
Design and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines that support frequent, low-risk production deployments.
  
Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and/or AWS CloudFormation across all environments.
  
Define and implement deployment strategies (blue/green, canary, automated rollbacks).
  
Introduce and improve reliability practices such as SLOs, SLIs, and operational metrics.
  
  
Observability, Incidents & Operations
  
Build and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  
Respond to production incidents, perform root-cause analysis, and implement long-term fixes.
  
Improve operational readiness through runbooks, automation, and environment consistency.
  
  
Security & Compliance
  
Own platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, encryption, certificate management, and network security.
  
Work with stakeholders on security reviews, threat modeling, and risk mitigation.
  
Support SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance efforts through implementation of technical controls and documentation.
  
  
Collaboration & Documentation
  
Collaborate closely with software engineers to ensure systems are deployable, observable, and operable.
  
Produce and maintain clear documentation for infrastructure architecture, processes, and operational procedures.
  
Evaluate and adopt tools and practices that improve platform reliability, security, and efficiency.
  
  
What We’re Looking For
  
  
Must-Have Experience
  
Extensive experience in DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering roles within cloud-native environments.
  
Strong, hands-on experience with AWS services and cloud architecture.
  
Proven experience designing and operating CI/CD pipelines for production systems.
  
Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform and/or CloudFormation).
  
Solid scripting and automation skills (Python, Bash, or similar).
  
Experience with Docker and Kubernetes (or equivalent container orchestration platforms).
  
Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, load balancing, SSL/TLS, and high-availability architectures.
  
Hands-on experience with monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions.
  
Strong troubleshooting and incident resolution skills.
  
Excellent written and spoken English.
  
Ability to work effectively in a remote-first, cross-functional environment.
  
Strong understanding of security fundamentals, including access control, encryption, certificates, and security monitoring.
  
  
Nice to Have
  
Designed and operated cloud infrastructure from the ground up.
  
Experience supporting SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar compliance frameworks.
  
Background or strong interest in cybersecurity.
  
Experience working in a scaling SaaS or startup environment.
  
  
Why Join EngageRocket
  
  
**You’ll have the opportunity to:**  
Own and improve platform reliability and security
  
Work on real production systems with meaningful scale and complexity
  
Build long-term infrastructure foundations for a growing SaaS product
  
Operate in a focused, remote-first engineering environment
  
  
**If you want, I can next:**  
Tighten this further to filter out mid-level candidates
  
Adjust tone to be more technical or more outcome-driven
  
Create screening questions aligned to this role

title: IT Security Sr. Analyst
description:
**Job Summary**
The Senior IT Security Analyst/Engineer is responsible for formulating strategies, planning, and implementing the development of the company's cybersecurity systems. This role will lead the procurement process for cybersecurity projects, manage related projects, and collaborate with various teams to ensure a strong and compliant cybersecurity posture. The ideal candidate possesses a deep understanding of cybersecurity, experience in project management, and specific knowledge of cloud security (Azure and AWS), this is optional but would be a plus for the candidate. Additionally, the candidate is expected to provide support to the operational teams in their daily tasks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

- Cybersecurity Strategy and Planning:
- Analyze the company's current cybersecurity landscape and identify areas for improvement.
- Formulate short-term and long-term cybersecurity system development strategies and plans that align with the company's business objectives.
- Conduct research and evaluation of the latest cybersecurity technologies and trends for potential implementation.
- Cybersecurity Project Procurement:
- Lead the process of developing the scope of work (SOW) and technical specifications for cybersecurity system development projects.
- Manage the vendor evaluation and selection process for cybersecurity solutions that meet the company's needs.

Be responsible for contract negotiation and managing relationships with cybersecurity vendors.
  
  

- Cybersecurity Project Management:
- Act as a coordinator or project manager for various cybersecurity initiatives, both in IT and OT (Operational Technology) environments.
- Plan, execute, monitor, and evaluate the progress of cybersecurity projects according to established schedules and budgets.
- Manage risks and issues that arise during project implementation and ensure effective resolution.
- Cybersecurity Policy and Procedure Development:
- Collaborate with the IT Governance team and strategic management to develop, review, and update the company's cybersecurity policies, standards, and procedures.
- Ensure that security policies and procedures align with applicable laws and regulations.
- Support the socialization and implementation of security policies and procedures across the organization.
- Cloud Security Development (optional but would be a plus for the candidate):
- Possess a strong understanding of security architecture in Azure and AWS cloud platforms.
- Be capable of designing and implementing security solutions for cloud environments, including security configurations, identity and access management, encryption, and security monitoring.
- Ensure compliance with cloud security standards and best practices.
- Operational Support:
- Provide technical support to the IT operations team in handling security incidents.
- Assist the Managed Service Provider (MSP) and Security Operations Center (SOC) teams in investigating and responding to security threats.
- Participate in daily operational tasks related to cybersecurity as needed.

**Qualifications**

- Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
- Possess Network Infrastructure and/or Cybersecurity certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CEH, CompTIA Security+, or specific product certification.
- Cloud security certifications (e.g., Azure Security Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Security – Specialty) will be a plus.
- Proven experience in leading cybersecurity projects from initiation to completion.
- In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity concepts and best practices, including risk assessment, vulnerability management, incident response, and security awareness.
- Understanding of security standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001 or NIST CSF or OT Cybersecurity IEC 62443
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.

description:
About YesDok

YesDok is a healthcare company formerly providing telemedicine with a proven track record in healthcare knowledge, health marketing, and regulatory compliance since 2017. Yesdok has established strong partnerships with professionals and healthcare brands to improve health knowledge in Indonesia. With a team of highly qualified medical professionals and a strong social media presence, we prioritize safety and efficacy, conducting rigorous internal and external reviews of all partners we work with. YesDok is committed to delivering innovative and effective healthcare solutions.

**Senior / Lead iOS Engineer**

What You'll Do

•⁠ ⁠Maintain and evolve YesDok’s iOS Telemedicine application using Swift and core iOS frameworks.

•⁠ ⁠Design and implement critical features (Video/Audio Consultations, Chat, E-Prescription) based on a dynamic product roadmap.

•⁠ ⁠Lead the architectural decision-making and development of reusable components to ensure modularity and scalability for team expansion.

•⁠ ⁠Integrate the app with secure backend services, Insurance APIs, and WebRTC SDKs (e.g., Agora/Twilio) for stable real-time communication.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor crash rates and video session stability; take extreme ownership to target a 99.9% crash-free session rate.

•⁠ ⁠Collaborate closely with Product Managers, QA, and fellow engineers in an agile environment to adapt quickly to changing business requirements.

•⁠ ⁠Mentor junior iOS engineers and foster a culture of "Active Teamwork" through rigorous code reviews and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications

•⁠ ⁠5+ years of software development experience with a strong focus on iOS.

•⁠ ⁠5+ years of hands-on experience with Swift and proven contributions to commercial applications with high user traffic.

•⁠ ⁠Advanced proficiency in Swift and strong understanding of AVFoundation and iOS memory management.

•⁠ ⁠Experience working with modern concurrency (Async/Await), design patterns, and scalable architecture (e.g., MVVM).

•⁠ ⁠Familiarity with data security standards (Encryption, Keychain, SSL Pinning) to meet HIPAA compliance is a major plus.

•⁠ ⁠Comfortable with tools like Fastlane, Bitrise/Jenkins, XCTest, and Instruments for performance profiling is a major plus.

•⁠ ⁠⁠Proven ability to guide junior team members and work effectively within a dynamic, fast-paced collaborative environment.

•⁠ ⁠Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

If you have relevant experience or expertise and are interested in this opportunity, please send your latest application through this job post or to: jobs@yesdok.com with the subject line:

Senior iOS - (Your Name) - (Your Current Domicile)

Thank you!

description:
**About Us**

We build AI that helps people work better — not replaces them.

At Maknadata, technology starts with purpose. We take complexity, find its root causes, and turn it into flow through practical, human-centered AI.

As we grow, we’re looking for a
**Front End Developer**

who wants more than a coding role — someone who wants to create real impact, learn fast, and help shape how AI is adopted across Indonesia.

**What You Will Do**

You will turn complex AI-driven workflows into clear, intuitive, and reliable user experiences. Your work will sit at the intersection of
**design, engineering, and real operational flow needs**

.

- Build responsive, scalable, and maintainable front-end applications for AI-powered products
- Translate business problems, user journeys, and AI outputs into intuitive UI/UX
- Work closely with backend engineers, AI engineers, analysts, and product leads
- Integrate APIs, dashboards, and data visualizations into real production systems
- Ensure performance, accessibility, and usability across devices
- Iterate quickly based on user feedback, experiments, and real usage data
- Take ownership of quality — not just how it looks, but how it works in practice

**What We’re Looking For**

- Someone who wants to grow with us — technically, professionally, and personally.
- Strong foundation in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Next.js
- Experience building real, production-ready front-end applications
- Comfortable consuming APIs and working with data-driven interfaces
- Clear reasoning, structured problem-solving, and ability to communicate trade-offs
- Sensitivity to UX — you care about clarity, flow, and user trust
- Curious to learn how AI systems work, even if you’re not building the models
- Comfortable in a small, fast-moving team and willing to wear multiple hats
- Driven by purpose, not trends — you want to build products that last

- We work with the principles of M.A.K.N.A and the 5Cs — not as slogans, but as daily practice.
- Meaningful Impact — every model must solve something real.
- Accountability with Integrity — we own the work and the outcome.
- Kolaboratif Growth — we learn fast and grow together.
- Nurturing Sustainability — we build solutions with long-term value.
- Adaptive Curiosity — we stay curious, challenge norms, and evolve continuously.
- Supported by the 5Cs — Committed, Curious, Collaborative, Credible, and Continuous Improvement — we focus on doing work that matters, bit by bit.

**Why Join Us**

- Your work matters. You’ll build AI that real users rely on, not POCs that never launch.
- Fast learning curve. You’ll see end-to-end AI delivery, not just one piece of it.
- Ownership. In a small team, your contribution shapes the outcome.
- Room to experiment. We value curiosity, initiative, and thoughtful exploration.
- Mission-driven culture. We build with intention, clarity, and care.
- Hybrid/flexible work. A mix of remote and on-site for balance and focus.

If you want meaningful work — and want to grow by doing, building, and collaborating — you will enjoy working here.

We’d love to meet you. Help us build AI in bits now, scale tomorrow.

If this speaks to you, let’s talk — and build something useful, practical, and inspiring together.

title: IT Assistant (Network and Infrastructure Engineer) for SILNAS
description:
**Background**

***UNDP is committed to achieving workforce diversity in terms of gender, nationality and culture. Individuals from minority groups, indigenous groups and persons with disabilities are equally encouraged to apply. All applications will be treated with the strictest confidence.***

***UNDP does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of harassment, including sexual harassment, and discrimination. All selected candidates will, therefore, undergo rigorous reference and background checks.***

***UNDP is the leading United Nations organization fighting to end the injustice of poverty, inequality, and climate change. Working with our broad network of experts and partners in 170 countries, we help nations to build integrated, lasting solutions for people and planet. Learn more at undp.org or follow at @UNDP***

The United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) is the UN’s global development network, advocating for change and connecting countries to knowledge, experience and resources to help people build a better life, as envisaged by 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. We are on the ground in more than 170 countries and territories, working with governments and people on their own solutions to global and national development challenges to help empower lives and build resilient nations. The United Nations Development Programme UNDP Indonesia Country Programme 2016-2020 developed in partnership with the Indonesian Government addresses the unfinished business of the Millennium Development Goals and support national efforts to advance the 2030 Sustainable Development Agenda.

The programme contributes directly to MoH National Action Plan 2015-2019, objective 1) increasing the health status of society and; 2)increasing the responsiveness and protection to society towards social and financial risks related to health and Outcome 2 of the UNDP country Programme for Indonesia (2016-2020), which are aligned with the Indonesian Government Health Sector’s Objectives, commitment to Universal Health Coverage, SDG3 Ensure healthy lives and promote wellbeing for all at all ages (target 3.8 in particular) and other Sustainable Development Goals. Among the critical components of the partnership between UNDP and the Ministry of Health is towards supporting and strengthening the access for affordable health technology, leveraging UNDP international procurement capacity as well as streamlining the standardized processes through an integrated information management system.

Indonesia's national laboratory network is a critical pillar of its public health system. However, the current landscape is fragmented, with siloed data systems hindering efficient information flow and real-time analysis. This project is essential because:
  

- Fragmented Systems: Siloed, non-interoperable systems lead to inefficiencies, data delays, and incomplete information for public health decision-making.
- Impaired Surveillance: The lack of real-time, integrated data hampers effective disease surveillance and outbreak response.
- Alignment with National Strategy: This project operationalizes the MOH's Integrated National Laboratory Information System / SILNAS’ Grand Design, ensuring laboratory data becomes a reliable, real-time component of the SATUSEHAT (Integrated Health Data) ecosystem.
- Tier-Specific Needs: A one-size-fits-all system imposed without a thorough assessment will fail. This project is designed to understand and meet the vastly different needs of laboratories from Tier 1 (simple, offline-capable) to Tier 5 (complex, integrated).

UNDP is providing technical assistance to the MoH for this strategic initiative. Based on the Grand Design of SILNAS (2023) and the mandate of the Director General of Public Health (HK.02.02/B/865/2022), as approved by the Global Fund, UNDP will facilitate the Ministry of Health to develop an Integrated National Health Laboratory Information System (SILNAS), under the C19RM grant funds. This system is a critical pillar in the digital transformation of Indonesia's health system, aiming to integrate and interconnect all health laboratories across the country with the National Health Information System (SIKN/Satu Sehat). The success of this critical national project hinges on robust technical architecture, advanced security protocols, and seamless integration of existing systems.
  
To achieve these objectives, it requires an IT Assistant to support the MOH related to network and infrastructure engineer of SILNAS implementation.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

**Scope of Work**  
IT Assistant will be under the coordination of the IT Expert. S/he will be working in close collaboration with the IT Associate, APHL (as the TA support for development of SILNAS), and the (selected) local vendor who will be developing the SILNAS apps. Refer to this, the primary objectives for the IT Assistant for SILNAS are as follows.
  
a) Sequencing technology operation, IT systems integration, hybrid network infrastructure management
  

- To support configuration, and maintenance of cloud servers, ensuring optimal performance, security, and uptime for critical data generation processes.
- To support cloud Server Administration and Cloud Infrastructure Management with a focus on AWS and GCP (refer to the infrastructure of cloud server provided by UNDP).
- To support management of containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes for SILNAS implementation.
- To support management of the networking components and peripherals of the sequencing facility, including routers, switches, firewalls, and network cabling, to guarantee a stable and secure environment.

  

- Support the team providing initial diagnose and resolve hardware, software, and network- related issues to minimize downtime and disruptions to data generation operations.
- Support in monitoring server and network performance, identifying areas for improvement and implementing proactive measures to enhance efficiency and reliability.
- Regularly update server software, firmware, and networking equipment to keep systems up-to-date with the latest security patches and enhancements.
- Organize and maintain a digital repository of all project documentation, ensuring accessibility and accuracy of SILNAS implementation.
- Assist the IT Expert in compiling, documenting, and managing all workshop outputs and project artifacts, in order to ensure distribution to all stakeholders
- Maintain detailed documentation of IT systems, configurations, and procedures to ensure effective knowledge sharing and future troubleshooting.

b) The incumbent of the position should avoid any kind of discriminatory behavior including gender discrimination and ensure that:
  

- Human rights and gender equality is prioritized as an ethical principle within all actions.
- Activities are designed and implemented in accordance with “Social and Environmental

Standards of UNDP”.
  

- Any kind of diversities based on ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, disability, religion, class, gender is respected within all implementations including data production.
- Differentiated needs of women and men are considered.
- Inclusive approach is reflected within all actions and implementations, in that sense an enabling and accessible setup in various senses such as disability gender language barrier is created.
- Necessary arrangements to provide gender parity within all committees, meetings, trainings etc. introduced.

**Institutional Arrangement**  
The direct supervisor of this activities is MOH Takel – PKP (under the Labkesmas unit), and the MOH Data and Information Center (Pusdatin). S/he will work closely with project team for SILNAS and FMTA project team – based in the MOH, and other projects in HEART cluster related to Global Fund (both for core and C19RM budget), operations units, and programme staff in the UNDP office, and should be able to provide technical assistance and advice regarding SILNAS related issues and to ensure adequate exchange of information, both with UNDP Country office and MOH program team.

**Competencies**

ARENA sedang mengembangkan website utama baru sebagai wajah brand dan platform promosi layanan travel & event (B2C & B2B).

Sistem Kerja : Onsite - di Banguntapan Yogyakarta

- Integrasi API dari backend CMS yang sudah tersedia.
- Menjaga performa, SEO basic, dan responsivitas (mobile-first).

2. UI Implementation & Componentization

- Menerjemahkan desain UI/UX menjadi komponen reusable.
- Menjaga konsistensi design system & style guide ARENA.
- Optimalisasi tampilan lintas device & browser.

3. Testing & QA Collaboration

- Bersedia dan mampu ikut proses Testing & QA, meliputi:
- Functional testing (form, API response, flow halaman)
- UI & responsive testing
- Cross-browser testing
- Bekerja sama dengan tim internal untuk fixing bug & improvement sebelum go-live.

4. Collaboration & Delivery

Koordinasi aktif dengan:

- Backend developer (API & CMS)
- UI/UX designer
- Project owner (ARENA)
- Menyelesaikan task sesuai timeline dan milestone project 2 bulan.

Job Requirements

- Pengalaman kuat sebagai Frontend Developer dengan Next.js.
- Menguasai JavaScript & TypeScript.
- Penguasaan HTML, CSS, dan web interactivity.
- Terbiasa consume API (REST / JSON).
- Paham konsep SSR, routing, dan performance basic di Next.js.
- Mau dan siap terlibat di proses QA & testing, bukan hanya coding.
- Komunikatif dan nyaman kerja kolaboratif.

Forest Technologies is a leading AI-powered product studio and consulting firm at the intersection of innovation and digital transformation. We specialize in delivering high-quality solutions that help businesses harness the full potential of emerging technologies like AI, machine learning, and automation. From AI strategy consulting to full-stack product development, our team is dedicated to pushing the boundaries of what's possible while maintaining an unwavering commitment to excellence. Our culture is built on creativity, collaboration, and a relentless pursuit of excellence. As a rapidly growing company, we offer exciting opportunities to work with cutting-edge technologies in an environment that values continuous learning, personal growth, and impactful contributions. If you're looking for a place to grow your skills while working on challenging and rewarding projects, Forest Technologies is the place to be.

**Job Description**

Forest Technologies is seeking a skilled and motivated
**QA Engineer (Automation)**
to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and executing automated test cases to ensure the highest quality of our products. You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to ensure that our software meets the highest standards for performance, reliability, and user experience.

As a QA Engineer at Forest Technologies, you will play a key role in enhancing the overall quality of our AI-driven applications. Your expertise in automation testing will help ensure that our products are scalable, secure, and free from defects.

- **Design and Develop Automated Tests:**
  Create and maintain automated test scripts using
  **Selenium**
  ,
  **Java**
  ,
  **Cucumber**
  , and other tools to validate functionality, performance, and security across different platforms.

  Integrate and maintain automated tests within
  **Jenkins**
  pipelines to ensure continuous testing and smooth integration with our CI/CD workflows.
- **Collaboration:**
  Collaborate with cross-functional teams (development, product, and operations) to understand product requirements and provide feedback on testability, risk, and quality.
- **Test Documentation and Reporting:**
  Document test plans, cases, and results. Provide detailed defect reports and analysis for test failures to ensure timely resolution.
- **Quality Assurance:**
  Perform thorough testing of both front-end and back-end systems. Ensure product releases meet our high standards for performance, reliability, and security.
- **Troubleshooting and Debugging:**
  Identify and troubleshoot issues, including software defects, UI inconsistencies, and system performance problems.
- **Automation Framework Improvements:**
  Continuously improve and optimize the automation framework for scalability, reusability, and efficiency.
- **Maintain Best Practices:**
  Contribute to the development and maintenance of test strategies, standards, and best practices to drive continuous improvement.

**Required Skills and Experience:**

- **Automation Testing Experience:**
  Strong experience with
  **Selenium**
  for automation testing,
  **Java**
  for test development, and
  **Cucumber**
  for behavior-driven development (BDD).
- **CI/CD Integration:**
  Experience with integrating automated tests into
  **Jenkins**
  for continuous integration and delivery.
- **Test Planning and Execution:**
  Proven track record in writing detailed test plans, designing test cases, executing tests, and reporting issues effectively.
- **Detail-Oriented:**
  A keen eye for detail with a focus on delivering high-quality work while meeting deadlines.
- **Proficiency in English:**
  Excellent verbal and written communication skills in
  **English**
  are required for effective collaboration within our international team.
- **Chinese Language Skills:**
  Proficiency in
  **Chinese**
  is a plus, enabling you to support our expanding global operations and team.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- **Other Automation Tools:**
  Familiarity with additional tools such as
  **TestNG**
  ,
  **Appium**
  ,
  **JUnit**
  , or other automation frameworks is a plus.
- **Agile Methodologies:**
  Experience working in an Agile development environment, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing requirements and priorities.
- **Performance Testing:**
  Familiarity with performance testing tools like
  **JMeter**
  ,
  **LoadRunner**
  , or similar.
- **Cloud Platforms:**
  Exposure to cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure) and testing applications in cloud environments.

**Why Join Forest Technologies?**

- **Remote-Friendly Culture:**
  Enjoy the flexibility and comfort of working remotely. Whether you prefer working from home or a co-working space, you have the freedom to create your ideal work environment.
- **Innovative Projects:**
  Work on cutting-edge AI, machine learning, and automation-driven solutions that are shaping the future of technology.
- **Career Growth:**
  We foster a culture of continuous learning, offering numerous opportunities to enhance your skills and advance your career.
- **Impactful Work:**
  As part of our tight-knit team, your contributions will directly influence the success of our projects and the satisfaction of our clients.
- **Collaborative Environment:**
  Join a passionate, smart, and inclusive team where creativity and innovation are encouraged and supported.
- **Competitive Salary and Benefits:**
  Enjoy a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and a work-life balance that supports both your professional and personal growth.

title: Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for a Data Analyst at Flip. You will be responsible for managing data discovery and insights generation for key initiatives. In this role, you will also be expected to collaborate with Data Engineers to improve and enrich existing state of data to meet current as well as possible future use cases.

**About Flip**

Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app.

After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.

At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits.

**What You'll Do**

- Partner with product managers, marketers, and other cross-functional stakeholders to analyze user behavior and marketing performance
- Design and evaluate A/B tests and other experiments to drive product and growth improvements
- Build dashboards and reports to track key performance indicators (KPIs) and uncover trends.
- Use forecasting models to help predict user growth, revenue, or campaign performance.
- Communicate findings clearly and effectively to technical and non-technical audiences.
- Collaborate closely with data engineering and other analysts to improve data infrastructure and tooling.

**What We’re Looking For**

- **2+ years of experience**
  in an analytics role, ideally in a
  **product or marketing analytics**
  environment.
- Strong SQL skills and experience working with large datasets and cloud-based data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake) [GCP preferred]
- Has working experience working with python/R for data analysis and modeling
- Experience with experimentation frameworks (e.g., A/B testing, holdout tests).
- Familiarity with forecasting techniques (e.g., time series models, regression).
- Comfortable with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Power BI) and storytelling with data
- Experience with tools like dbt or Amplitude/MoEngage is a big plus

**You’ll Thrive Here If You**

- Are intellectually curious and love getting to the "why" behind the numbers
- Enjoy leveraging technology and collaborating across teams
- Can balance speed and rigor when delivering insights
- Have a proactive and ownership-driven mindset

### About Pearl Talent

Pearl works with the top 1% of candidates from around the world and connects them with the best startups in the US and EU. Our clients have raised over $5B in aggregate and are backed by companies like OpenAI, a16z, and Founders Fund. ***Hear why we exist, what we believe in, and who we're building for:*** [WATCH HERE](https://www.loom.com/share/863b8e426e6d48309aa8f4ea4c1c94cd)

### Why Work with Us?

At Pearl, we're not just another recruiting firm—we connect you with exceptional opportunities to work alongside visionary US and EU founders. Our focus is on placing you in roles where you can grow, be challenged, and build long-term, meaningful careers.

### Role Overview

The QA Automation Engineer ensures that every product release is reliable, scalable, and user-friendly by designing, implementing, and maintaining comprehensive test automation frameworks. This role goes beyond writing test scripts—you'll architect quality assurance systems that integrate seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines, leverage AI tools to optimize testing processes, and collaborate cross-functionally to maintain product excellence. Working across diverse technology stacks including web, mobile, API, and database layers, you'll apply both analytical problem-solving and creative thinking to identify real-world edge cases from a user's perspective. You'll build automated testing solutions that catch bugs early, reduce manual testing burden, and enable faster, more confident product releases.

### Your Impact

Your automation expertise will directly improve product quality, development velocity, and customer satisfaction by catching defects before they reach production. By building robust test frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines, you'll enable development teams to ship features faster with confidence. Your work will reduce manual testing time by significant percentages, freeing QA teams to focus on exploratory testing and complex scenarios. Through AI-driven testing optimization, you'll accelerate testing cycles and improve coverage. Your collaboration with developers will improve code quality by identifying architectural issues early and suggesting improvements. By thinking from both technical and user perspectives, you'll ensure products not only function correctly but deliver excellent user experiences.

### Core Responsibilities

**Test Automation Development & Framework Design (50%)**

- Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts for web, mobile, and API applications
- Build and maintain automated test frameworks using Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, Tosca, Katalon, or similar tools
- Conduct comprehensive end-to-end testing across web, database, and API layers
- Create automated regression, integration, and functional test suites
- Optimize test automation frameworks for speed, reliability, and maintainability
- Implement test data management strategies and mock services where appropriate
- Apply version control, logging, and structured documentation for all test code
- Execute automated test suites and analyze results for defects and failures

**CI/CD Integration & DevOps Collaboration (20%)**

- Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar
- Configure automated test execution for multiple environments and deployment stages
- Build reporting and dashboard automations for test visibility and accountability
- Collaborate with DevOps teams to ensure smooth integration of QA processes
- Monitor test execution in continuous deployment workflows
- Implement parallel test execution strategies to reduce build times
- Maintain test environment configurations and dependencies

**AI-Driven Testing & Quality Optimization (15%)**

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Testim, or similar) to optimize QA processes and speed up testing cycles
- Apply user-centric testing approaches to identify real-world edge cases and usability gaps
- Leverage AI-powered test generation and maintenance tools where applicable
- Implement intelligent test selection and prioritization strategies
- Use AI for visual regression testing and anomaly detection
- Explore and integrate emerging AI/ML tools for quality assurance

**Bug Tracking, Collaboration & Quality Improvement (10%)**

- Identify, document, and track bugs through resolution with detailed reproduction steps
- Collaborate with developers to debug issues, verify fixes, and improve release quality
- Work with product managers to clarify requirements and define test strategies
- Participate in sprint planning, refinement, and retrospective meetings
- Suggest process improvements and contribute to culture of product reliability and excellence
- Conduct code reviews of test automation code with team members
- Mentor junior QA engineers on automation best practices

**Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement (5%)**

- Analyze testing results and maintain comprehensive technical documentation
- Monitor and report on test coverage, quality metrics, and automation ROI
- Define metrics for automation success (time saved, error reduction, efficiency gains)
- Continuously improve automation coverage based on defect analysis and risk assessment
- Maintain clear documentation and training guides for stakeholders and team members
- Track testing KPIs including defect detection rate, test execution time, and coverage percentages
- Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes and tooling

### Requirements

### Must-Haves (Required)

- **Experienc**e: 1-3+ years in QA automation, software testing, or test engineering roles
- **Programming Skills:** Strong programming proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages
- **Automation Tools:** Hands-on experience with automation frameworks (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, Tosca, Katalon, or similar)
- **Testing Methodologies:** Solid understanding of software QA methodologies, tools, and best practices
- **API Testing:** Experience with API automation, validation, and testing tools
- **Database Testing:** Proficiency in database testing including SQL queries and data validation
- **Version Control:** Solid understanding of Git or other version control systems
- **CI/CD Knowledge:** Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integration patterns
- **Problem-Solving:** Excellent logical reasoning, analytical skills, and attention to detail
- **User Perspective:** Ability to think critically and creatively, seeing from both technical and user perspectives
- **Communication:** Excellent written and verbal English; able to explain technical concepts clearly
- **Adaptability:** Fast learner with adaptability to evolving tools and testing environments
- **Collaboration:** Strong collaboration skills working cross-functionally with development and product teams

### Nice-to-Haves (Preferred)

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

- Exposure to DevOps pipelines and advanced CI/CD integrations
- Understanding of UX testing principles or accessibility standards (WCAG)

title: IT Security Analyst
description:
**IT Security Analyst**

Sebagai
**IT Security Analyst**
, peran ini bertanggung jawab dalam menjaga dan meningkatkan posture keamanan sistem informasi organisasi. Kesuksesan dalam posisi ini ditandai dengan kemampuan mendeteksi, menganalisis, dan merespons ancaman keamanan secara efektif, serta berkontribusi aktif dalam pencegahan insiden siber. Peran ini berkolaborasi erat dengan tim IT, infrastruktur, dan manajemen untuk memastikan keberlangsungan operasional bisnis yang aman dan patuh terhadap standar keamanan yang berlaku.

Tanggung Jawab

- Melakukan monitoring dan analisis aktivitas keamanan pada sistem, jaringan, aplikasi, dan endpoint untuk mengidentifikasi potensi ancaman atau anomali.
- Mengelola dan menganalisis log keamanan menggunakan teknologi SIEM guna mendeteksi insiden keamanan secara dini.
- Melakukan investigasi insiden keamanan siber, termasuk analisis root cause dan penyusunan rekomendasi mitigasi.
- Melakukan verifikasi alert keamanan (true positive / false positive) serta eskalasi insiden sesuai tingkat keparahan.
- Mendukung implementasi dan pemeliharaan kontrol keamanan seperti firewall, IDS/IPS, EDR, dan vulnerability management.
- Menyusun laporan keamanan berkala dan ad-hoc untuk kebutuhan internal maupun kepatuhan regulasi.
- Berkolaborasi dengan tim terkait dalam penerapan kebijakan, prosedur, dan standar keamanan informasi.
- Mendukung aktivitas audit keamanan dan kepatuhan terhadap standar atau regulasi yang berlaku.

Kualifikasi

- Memiliki pemahaman yang baik mengenai konsep keamanan informasi, jaringan, sistem operasi, dan aplikasi.
- Pengalaman menggunakan tools keamanan seperti SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, firewall, dan vulnerability scanner.
- Memahami konsep incident response, threat detection, dan basic digital forensics.
- Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Teknologi Informasi, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait.
- Pengalaman kerja sebagai IT Security Analyst, SOC Analyst, atau peran serupa menjadi nilai tambah.
- Memiliki sertifikasi keamanan informasi (seperti CEH, CND, Security+, atau setara) menjadi nilai tambah.
- Kemampuan analisis yang baik, teliti, dan mampu bekerja secara kolaboratif dalam tim.
- Kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang baik untuk menyampaikan temuan teknis secara jelas.
- Kemampuan berbahasa dan menulis bahasa inggris

description:
**About the role**

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for driving continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), managing cloud-based infrastructure, and ensuring high availability, scalability, and security of our applications. You will work with automation tools, observability solutions, and AI-driven enhancements to optimize DevOps workflows and improve operational efficiency. This role requires deep expertise in cloud cost optimization, infrastructure as code (IaC), monitoring, and zero-downtime deployments.

title: Cloud Migration Engineer
description:
**Job Description**

As a
**Cloud Migration Engineer**

, you will be responsible for planning, designing, and executing cloud migration projects for medium to large-scale enterprises. This role involves close collaboration with technical and business stakeholders to ensure secure, efficient, and scalable cloud adoption.

You will work with various cloud platforms and migration tools, contributing to assessment reports, solution designs, and implementation strategies across public, private, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Plan, design, and execute end-to-end cloud migration projects independently or as part of a project team.
- Assess existing IT infrastructure, applications, and workloads to define appropriate migration strategies.
- Design migration architectures for public, private, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments.
- Implement migration solutions using cloud migration and data replication tools.
- Collaborate with internal teams and clients to ensure smooth project delivery and post-migration optimization.
- Prepare technical documentation, assessment reports, workload evaluations, and migration proposals.
- Support pre-sales activities by contributing to technical proposals and solution designs for bids.
- Participate in project-based travel when required.

**Job Qualifications**

- Associate degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 3–5 years of hands-on experience in cloud migration or cloud infrastructure projects.
- Proven experience delivering cloud migration projects, preferably with the ability to complete projects independently.
- Familiarity with major cloud platforms such as
  **AWS, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, Huawei Cloud**

  , or similar.
- Strong understanding of cloud service models (
  **IaaS, PaaS, SaaS**

  ) and deployment models (public, private, hybrid, multi-cloud).
- Solid knowledge of virtualization technologies, containerization, networking, and storage systems.
- Hands-on experience with cloud migration tools or data replication tools.
- Strong analytical, communication, and solution design skills.
- Willingness to travel periodically for project-based assignments.

**Preferred / Nice to Have**

- Industry-recognized cloud certifications (e.g., AWS, Azure, Alibaba Cloud, Huawei Cloud).
- Experience with big data technologies such as
  **Hadoop, Hive, Spark, EMR**

  , or similar platforms.
- Experience working with medium to large enterprise environments.

3. ⁠Pengalaman cost-optimization di cloud.
