title: Digital Lending - Data Analyst Intern
description:
**About Amartha**

At Amartha, we empower micro-businesses across Indonesia, enabling growth and equal prosperity. We’ve supported over 2.7 million entrepreneurs—mostly women—by disbursing IDR 22.8 trillion in funding. As we step into 2026, Amartha is evolving into a technology-driven financial ecosystem, expanding our reach in lending, funding, and payments. Through innovation and digital solutions, we aim to enhance accessibility, streamline processes, and create a seamless user experience.

**About the Role**

As a Digital Lending - Data Analyst Intern, you will support the team in analyzing user and transaction data, building dashboards, and generating reports to monitor digital lending performance.

You will work closely with Product, Marketing, and Growth teams to identify insights, improve user journey, and support data-driven decision making. You will also assist in data cleaning and reporting automation to ensure data accuracy and efficiency.

**Job Descriptions**

- Collect, clean, and process data from various internal systems and sources.
- Develop dashboards and performance reports (weekly/monthly) related to users, transactions, and digital funnel performance.
- Conduct analyses to identify trends, pain points, and opportunities for improving the digital user journey.
- Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Growth teams to provide insights and data-based recommendations.
- Support documentation of data definitions, metric calculations, and dataset structures.
- Assist in automated reporting (scheduling queries, report generation, and alerting)

  
**Requirements**  

- Final-year student or fresh graduate in Statistics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Information Technology, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- Proficiency in SQL (required) — able to write queries from scratch.
- Familiar with Excel / Google Sheets (lookup, pivot, formulas).
- Comfortable working with large datasets and performing data cleaning.
- Strong attention to detail, analytical mindset, and comfortable working with numbers

*At Amartha, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, ensures equity, and fosters inclusion. We believe that diverse perspectives—shaped by factors such as gender, age, race, ethnicity, education, culture, and life experiences—drive innovation and growth.*

*We actively welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us in building an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities and foster a sense of belonging that enables our employees to thrive and make meaningful contributions.*

- Build strong relationships with customers as a **trusted technical consultant**

- Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field

---

- Strong interpersonal and stakeholder management skills

- Experience in **post-sales / implementation**

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees. We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to outserving Grabbers with positive, personalized IT experiences. We are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric and innovative values to join our growing team.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
The Senior Network Engineer is expected to be a Subject Matter Expert (SME) covering network technology deployment and support. The role is required to participate in developing network strategy, standards, technology roadmaps, and network deployments. On top of this, this role is also expected to have strong exposure into public cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) operational knowledges as well as tooling development skills. This is an onsite role based in Jakarta. You will be reporting to the IT Network Manager.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

- Global Infrastructure Lifecycle Management: Direct the design, deployment, and maintenance of resilient enterprise network architectures across multiple regions, leveraging top-tier hardware (Cisco, Juniper, Fortinet) and modern SD-WAN, WLAN, and VPN technologies.
- Strategic Project & Cloud Integration: Lead large-scale infrastructure initiatives, including office builds, expansions, and seamless integrations with AWS, GCP, and Azure to ensure scalable and high-performing hybrid-cloud connectivity.
- Architecture Standardization & Governance: Develop comprehensive reference architectures and design principles that align with enterprise standards, ensuring all networking solutions are secure, documented, and integrated through rigorous Change Management processes.
- Operational Excellence & Incident Leadership: Spearhead complex problem-solving and service restoration efforts to minimize downtime while managing ISP and vendor partnerships to ensure successful site launches and service delivery.
- Automation & Continuous Improvement: Drive organizational efficiency by developing custom operational tools and automating manual processes, while fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and technical optimization across the GTS teams.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

- Expert Network Engineering & Architecture: Over 5 years of experience managing large-scale enterprise environments, specializing in the end-to-end design, implementation, and troubleshooting of routing, switching, and SD-WAN solutions across global sites.
- Advanced Security & Wireless Integration: Proven expertise in deploying industrial-leading security frameworks (NGFW, VPN, WAF) and large-scale Wi-Fi architectures, utilizing access layer security protocols like Cisco ISE and ClearPass to ensure robust network integrity.
- Multi-Vendor & Cloud Proficiency: Highly skilled in integrating on-premises infrastructure with AWS/GCP cloud environments, with extensive hands-on experience across top-tier vendors including Fortinet, Juniper, Cisco, Zscaler, and F5 Load Balancers.
- Automation & Modern Tooling: Proficient in network automation and observability, leveraging Python, Ansible, and REST APIs alongside AI-driven development tools (Cursor, Claude Code) and monitoring suites like SolarWinds, Grafana, and Zabbix.
- Strategic Leadership & Communication: Certified professional (CCNP/JNCIP level) with a track record of managing senior stakeholders and articulating complex technical concepts into actionable business solutions within fast-paced, high-compliance sectors like Financial Services.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

- We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
- With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
- Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
- We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
- Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Data Center Engineer
description:
**About the Company**

Sycomp is a global IT services and logistics provider with extensive expertise in cloud, data center, endpoint management and security solutions. Sycomp’s diverse team of consultants and engineers deliver on the company’s mission to tackle challenging global IT projects through its state-of-the-art integration and warehouse centers and global technology partnerships. Headquartered in the heart of Silicon Valley, California, Sycomp has successfully shipped, deployed and managed complex IT projects and supporting assets in more than 150 countries helping its Fortune 500 customers and global partners realize a world without boundaries.

**We are looking for a Datacenter Engineer**
to support, monitor, and troubleshoot network and security infrastructure while ensuring high availability and SLA compliance. The role involves managing network devices, maintaining documentation, coordinating with vendors, and handling multiple projects independently while communicating effectively with cross‑functional teams.

This is a contract position, based in Surabaya.

**Role Responsibilities**

- Support, monitor, and troubleshoot network and security infrastructure to ensure high availability and optimal performance.
- Install, configure, and manage network devices including routers, switches, firewalls, and VPN solutions.
- Perform L1/L2 operational support with strong adherence to incident management workflows and SLA requirements.
- Use network monitoring and management tools for performance optimization, troubleshooting, and capacity planning.
- Develop, maintain, and update technical documentation such as SOPs, engineering diagrams, and project documentation.
- Ensure all documentation is accurate, current, and accessible to relevant stakeholders.
- Communicate technical updates, project status, and risks clearly to management and cross-functional teams.
- Contribute to the development and enforcement of networking standards aligned with business requirements.
- Manage OEM/vendor relationships, including coordination, escalation, and negotiations.
- Handle multiple projects simultaneously while working independently with minimal supervision.

**Key Qualifications**

- Hands-on experience in installing, configuring, and troubleshooting Cisco routers, switches, and PAN firewall/VPN devices.
- Strong knowledge of networking technologies including Ethernet, TCP/IP, VLANs, IPsec, PPP, QoS, ACLs, VPNs, VoIP, and structured cabling.
- Solid understanding of incident management processes, SLA compliance, and L1/L2 operational support.
- Experience using network management tools for monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and capacity planning.
- Working knowledge of UNIX systems, including setup and administration of DNS, DHCP, Web, FTP, Mail, VPN, and other internet services.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Studies or a related field from a recognized university.
- CCNA and/or CCNP certification preferred.
- Minimum of
  **3–5 years**
  of relevant industry experience in network and security operations.
- Strong problem-solving, process management, and presentation skills.
- Ability to work independently, manage ambiguity, and operate with minimal supervision.
- Excellent time management and organizational skills; able to manage multiple projects concurrently.
- Good English communication and influencing skills are a plus.
- Data Center experience, a plus.

Sycomp is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, age, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Sycomp will provide reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities as needed. If you need assistance or an accommodation in applying, please contact our Human Resources Department at hr@sycomp.com.

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
**About The Role:**

- Own the analytical function of the Marketing team by designing tracking strategies, building measurement frameworks, and providing clear insights into campaign performance and ROI.
- Conduct research and in-depth analysis of customers, marketing metrics, competitor landscape, and latest marketing trends to identify opportunities and fill product or funnel gaps.
- Develop actionable insights to improve
  **user acquisition, conversion rates, retention, and overall marketing funnel efficiency.**
- Partner with Marketing Managers to
  **evaluate campaign effectiveness**
  (e.g., channel attribution, CAC vs LTV, ROI) and recommend optimizations.
- Support
  **A/B testing and experimentation design**
  , ensuring campaigns are measurable and results statistically sound.
- Scope and prioritize analytics initiatives based on business and customer impact.
- Work closely with
  **Marketing, Product, and Business teams**
  to ensure proper event tracking, data accuracy, and smooth implementation of new campaigns or features.
- Act as the
  **voice of data**
  within the Marketing team, proactively surfacing insights that guide strategy, budget allocation, and growth opportunities.

**About You:**

- 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, preferably supporting Marketing or Growth teams.
- Strong SQL skills (must-have), with ability to query large datasets efficiently.
- Hands-on experience with marketing analytics & attribution tools.
- Solid understanding of marketing funnels, attribution models, and campaign performance metrics (CPI, CAC, LTV, ROAS, retention, etc.).
- Knowledge of UTM structures, campaign tagging, and tracking best practices.
- Experience building dashboards with data visualization tools (Metabase, Tableau, Looker, or similar).
- Familiarity with digital marketing channels (paid ads, SEO, referral, organic growth, CRM campaigns).
- Comfortable working with data from multiple sources (product events, marketing platforms, CRM) and reconciling them for accurate reporting.

title: Funding Product & Data Analyst
description:
**About Amartha**

At Amartha, we empower micro-businesses across Indonesia, enabling growth and equal prosperity. We’ve supported over 2.7 million entrepreneurs—mostly women—by disbursing IDR 22.8 trillion in funding. As we step into 2026, Amartha is evolving into a technology-driven financial ecosystem, expanding our reach in lending, funding, and payments. Through innovation and digital solutions, we aim to enhance accessibility, streamline processes, and create a seamless user experience.

**About the role**

The Product & Data Analyst – Operational is responsible for delivering actionable insights and operational analytics to support product execution, portfolio monitoring, and process efficiency across investment products. This role bridges data, product, and operations, enabling informed decision-making for operational performance reviews, issue resolution, product development support, and process improvement initiatives.

**About the team**

Partnership & Individual Lender (PI) objective is to enable access to impact investment instruments for everyone and become a source of funds with the most effective cost of fund PI consists of 10+ people from sales/business, operations, product, and tech team -- dedicated stream team to create products that fit with our partner's needs.

**Job Description**

- Serve as a data and product analytics specialist supporting operational processes across investment products.
- Monitor and analyze operational performance metrics including transaction hygiene, repayment flow, and portfolio health.
- Generate insights from operational data to identify issues, improve processes, and support data-driven decision making.
- Support product development and feature implementation by providing data analysis, tracking performance, and validating operational impact.
- Develop and maintain operational dashboards, reports, and monitoring tools to ensure data visibility and transparency for stakeholders.
- Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Finance teams to support operational initiatives, troubleshooting, and process scalability.
- Assist in manual data handling, reporting, and reconciliation where system automation is not yet available.

### Requirements

- Min experience to handling data analytic 3-4 years
- Strong SQL and advanced Excel/Google Sheets
- Experience with (Looker, superset)
- Solid understanding of growth, funnel, and cohort analysis
- Strong business acumen and communication skills
- Experience in fintech, microfinance, or mass-market analytics is a plus
- Experienced in creating and presenting analytical reports to internal stakeholders, including mid- to senior-level management.
- Able to lead strategic discussions and contribute data-driven inputs to product development and community initiatives.
- Experience join Data Analytic bootcamp is a plus.

*At Amartha, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, ensures equity, and fosters inclusion. We believe that diverse perspectives—shaped by factors such as gender, age, race, ethnicity, education, culture, and life experiences—drive innovation and growth.*

*We actively welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us in building an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities and foster a sense of belonging that enables our employees to thrive and make meaningful contributions.*

title: Android Developer (Mid or Senior) (Smart Machines & POS Systems)
description:
We are looking for a Mid/Senior Android developer who loves working with hardware to join us in building more solutions running on Android tablets and industrial boards.

We are posting for Jakarta due to the proximity to our Johor office- we would like to work with someone who can fly over periodically to our Johor office for training and hands-on integration of devices.

Konbini Technologies builds smart machines & applications for Smart Asset Management, Inventory Management and Food Service Automation.

We serve a range of multinational & government clients in Industrial, Manufacturing, Government & Institutional sectors, with a strong focus on companies in Singapore and Malaysia- our clients include Apple, Applied Materials, Shimano, Singapore Prisons, amongst others

**Example of projects:**

- Singapore Prisons: Smart Locker Systems
- Applied Materials: RFID Self-Checkout stations- we have been their vendor for the past 3 years and serve all the staff in their 3 factories in Singapore with our solutions
- Lavender Bakery: AI Machine Vision Checkout systems across Singapore & Malaysia

**Role Description**

We build a mix of customer-facing unmanned apps (like self-service kiosks, unmanned machines) and B2B apps used internally by our clients.

We write Kotlin apps which interface with all kinds of Controller boards - we either write serial libraries for interfacing with the communication protocols, or we integrate SDKs from manufacturers- think Smart Vending Machines, Weight controlled shelves, smart lockers.

We also write many transaction-related systems like self-checkout kiosks and POS systems, integrating payment terminals and gateways.

**Your role:**

- Review existing systems and apps and further enhance and improve them
- Work closely with the business team to explore development of apps for new concepts and solutions.
- Maintain a strong culture of clean, explainable code, and maintaining best practices in programming.

**Qualifications:**

- The candidate must have prior experience integrating hardware devices into Android apps, and should have strong experience interfacing with Android's various APIs, including the hardware level APIs.
- Experience in low-level serial communication to build libraries
- The candidate must have strong foundations in computer science to ensure best practises in app development
- Strong existing experience with AI development tools like Cursor, Claude Code, amongst others.
- Most importantly, a strong hunger and excitement and love for software engineering and problem solving, and an interest in building up a new team to innovate and explore new solutions.
- Strong experience in interfacing with external APIs.
- Qualifications Experience: At least 5 years Software Development background with a strong focus on Android development, Hardware interfacing and IoT.
- Education: Computer Science/Engineer degree.
- Soft Skills: Leadership, Presentation skills, fluent English.

**Why Join Us:**

- Established, large clients
- Small team, less politics, focus on building
- Forward thinking focus on innovation
- Direct collaboration with founder to define the technical direction of the company

title: AI Engineer
description:
**AI Engineer (AI Agents & Systems Security)**
**Location:**
Jakarta, Indonesia
**Workplace Type:**
Onsite
  
  
**About The Role**
ACV Capital is seeking a highly motivated and skilled AI Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be instrumental in building and securing our AI Agent orchestration system. This is a unique opportunity to go beyond basic prompt engineering and delve into the complexities of creating robust, secure, and reliable agentic workflows. You will be responsible for ensuring our AI agents operate in secure environments and do not pose any security liabilities. We are looking for someone with a proactive, "hacker" mentality who enjoys identifying vulnerabilities and implementing preventative measures. If you are passionate about AI security and have a strong understanding of containerization and backend development, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

- Agent Development: Build and optimize agentic workflows using Python or Node.js
- Security Hardening: Implement defenses against Prompt Injection and ensure strict data privacy within LLM interactions
- Containerization: Manage the application environment using Docker to ensure isolated, reproducible, and secure deployments
- API & Secret Management: Securely integrate third-party tools and databases (OAuth, API Key management, Secret scrubbing)
- Debugging & Reliability: Monitor agent performance, identify logic failures (hallucinations), and perform root-cause analysis
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI agents into existing systems and workflows
- Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI security and agentic workflows
- Contribute to the development of best practices and security standards for AI agent development

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

- Junior level (1-2 years) of relevant work experience or a high-potential Computer Science graduate with a solid GitHub portfolio in AI or backend development
- Proficiency in Python or Node.js and a strong understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs
- Hands-on experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), tool calling, and LLM orchestration frameworks
- Comfortable with Docker (writing Dockerfiles and using Docker Compose)
- Understanding of application security basics and AI-specific risks
- Proficiency in Linux/Unix terminal and Git (branching, PRs, and merge conflict resolution)
- Fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia
- High integrity, strong work ethic, and excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills
- Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus
- Knowledge of security frameworks and compliance standards (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR) is a plus

**Additional Information**
This is a full-time position based in our Jakarta office in the SCBD area. ACV Capital is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. To apply, please send your resume and cover letter to justine@acv.vc. We look forward to hearing from you!
**About ACV Capital:**
ACV Capital is a growth equity investment firm backing high-growth and tech-enabled businesses across Southeast Asia. With deep roots in Indonesia and a global network of partners, we help scale high-potential companies into market leaders. Our firm manages over US$500M across 5 funds and over the past 8 years have invested in over 100 companies in Southeast Asia.Our vision is to support the growth of Indonesia and ASEAN's most promising businesses. We partner with high-potential companies, providing smart, connected capital to help them scale, innovate, and lead in their industries across Southeast Asia and beyond.Our experienced team brings a strong track record in sectors such as consumer, financial technology, climate and sustainability, mobility and logistics, healthcare, education, enterprise solutions, retail, and commerce infrastructure. We partner with visionary leadership teams to build transformative businesses and drive long-term, measurable impact. Read more about us at www.acv.vc.

description:
**AIPDRM II - Full Stack Developer IT Specialist**

**Disaster Knowledge Management System (DKMS) BNPB**

**Program Overview:**

The Australia-Indonesia Partnership in Disaster Risk Management (SIAP SIAGA) is a seven-year program that commenced in late 2019, funded by the Australian Government’s Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) and implemented in cooperation with the Government of Indonesia (GoI). SIAP SIAGA aims at improving Indonesia’s ability to prevent, prepare for, respond to and recover from disasters and strengthen cooperation between Australia and Indonesia in humanitarian issues in the region. SIAP SIAGA is implemented at the national and sub-national levels though collaboration with the National Disaster Management Authority (BNPB), the Ministry of Home Affairs, the National Development Planning Agency (BAPPENAS), the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Local Disaster Management Agencies (BPBD) and other national and local government institutions, civil society organizations and academia.

SIAP SIAGA is focused on achieving four ends of program outcomes (EOPOs):

- **EOPO 1** : GoI’s disaster risk reduction systems are strengthened, resulting in better domestic leadership of disaster management.
- **EOPO 2** : Target provinces, districts and villages are better able to prepare for, adapt, prevent, respond to and recover from disasters.
- **EOPO 3** : Strengthened cooperation between Australia and Indonesia on disaster risk management and preparedness regionally.
- **EOPO 4** : Strengthened learning, innovation, cooperation and inclusion for disaster management.

It is progressing towards these outcomes by focusing on eight priority programs of the GoI: (1) enhancement of disaster management systems; (2) enhancement of disaster management strategy; (3) mapping and evaluation of disaster risks; (4) enhancement of data service, information management, and communication in disaster management; (5) enhancement and development of policies and regulations for disaster preparedness; (6) increasing the quality of disaster emergency management; (7) enhancement of the quality of post disaster policy; and (8) increasing local capacity of disaster management logistics and equipment.

To strengthen the disaster management system, SIAP SIAGA provides strategic technical advice to align national and local policies with international commitments. This effort focuses on embedding gender mainstreaming, institutionalizing disability inclusion, and supporting climate change adaptation across disaster risk reduction, preparedness, response, and recovery processes, through collaboration with national and local partners.

At the sub-national level, SIAP SIAGA works with four provinces in Indonesia: East Java, Bali, West Nusa Tenggara, and East Nusa Tenggara. It also promotes disaster management initiatives and innovations through its outreach program to up to six other provinces.

**Purpose of the Position:**

Under the direction of national program lead, The IT Fullstack Developer Specialist for Disaster Knowledge Management System (DKMS) BNPB will provide technical support for maintenance, refinement and addition of knowledge documents through the DKMS platform and updating the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030 at BNPB. The Developer specialist will perform the following tasks:

1. Improving features/functions of DKMS - BNPB to enhance BNPB’s role in assisting the regions in disaster management in Indonesia and abroad through disaster literacy.

2. Supporting the development of DKMS from the front-end and back-end in line with the development of the Artificial Intelligence ecosystem so that DKMS will remain relevant to meet user’s needs.

3. Supporting the integration of knowledge and the results from SIAP SIAGA program that can be used widely by various stakeholders to improve coordination, monitoring, and decision-making from ministries/agencies through better data management.

4. Updating the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030with the latest developments and projected needs of utilization of Artificial Intelligence until 2030 to make it remain relevant.

5. The consultant will coordinate the resulting product with relevant ministries/agencies and support the institutionalization and sustainable integration of the platform into disaster data and information systems.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

The Developer specialist - DKMS BNPB below Program National Lead - will do the following things:

1. Conducting an analysis of the DKMS system architecture to determine the strengths and weaknesses of the platform, including website structure, server and network stability, and AI performance.

2. Maintaining the DKMS website back-end on the website Content Management System (CMS) as the main portal in managing knowledge assets and data collected in the DKMS repository so that it will operate optimally.

3. Maintaining the DKMS website’s front-end to make it easier for users, especially local governments and the public, to access and contribute to the repository.

4. Configure the use and updates of Google Gemini as the main AI engine of used in DKMS to operate optimally.

5. Updating the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030 in accordance with the latest AI technology developments and projected AI development and specific hardware and software needed for DKMS optimization.

**Expected Key Results:**

Working under the direction of the National Program Lead, the Developer - DKMS BNPB will produce the following Results:

1. The DKMS platform runs smoothly in terms of website performance, ease of access, server stability, and AI performance for document search and summary features.

2. The optimal performance of the DKMS CMS makes it easier for enumerators and users to add assets and knowledge data to enrich the repository.

3. Google Gemini service is running for the DKMS website so that the search and document summary features continue to run optimally.

4. The preparation of the DKMS Roadmap document until 2030 is in accordance with AI developments and projections of AI progress for the next 4 years.

**Duration and location:**

It is estimated that the total input will take up to 90 days, from 1 May to 31 October 2026 and the work will be at BNPB Office.

**Key Relationships:**

This position will work closely with the following individual and/or organisation:

- Working under the supervision of PIC Program Activity 1.1.1 and National Program Lead.
- Weekly report/monthly to Senior Disaster Analyst from the Directorate of Disaster Management System, BNPB and National Program Lead.
- Consult with PIC DKMS and Associate Disaster Analyst from the Directorate of Disaster Management Systems of BNPB, and other related ministries/institutions; and
- Coordinate with other SIAP SIAGA team members as needed, particularly with KPL, Communications, and Operations for product integration purposes/knowledge.
- Coordinate with enumerator as well as the DKMS CMS team in operationalizing the DKMS CMS.

**Qualifications, Experience and Personal Attributes:**

- Bachelor’s degree in information systems or other related discipline.
- Minimum of 10 years’ experience in the field of Information Technology.
- Experience in managerial positions.
- Ability to work with a team and manage projects.
- Understand the concept of Information Technology (IT) technically and theoretically.
- Management skills in the field of AI (Artificial Intelligence)/LLM (Large Language Model).
- Has relevant certification.
- Has the experience involved in disaster knowledge management system development activities.
- Preference will be given to those with experience working at the National Disaster Management Agency (BNPB) for projects related to disaster knowledge management.
- Strong interpersonal skills, be inclusive, appreciate diversity, including in a cross-cultural environment.

**Application closed: Thursday, 07 April 2026**

**Type of Contract : Consultant Agreement**

title: Junior AI Engineer
description:
**About Us:**  
At PT Pro Teknologi Siber, we're at the cutting edge of AI innovation. Our mission is to drive transformative solutions using the power of artificial intelligence to shape the future of computer vision. We believe in fostering a culture of collaboration, learning, and personal growth. Our team thrives on challenging projects that make a real-world impact, and we're excited to expand our AI capabilities with driven, passionate individuals like you.

**Role Overview:**  
We are looking for a **Junior AI Engineer** to join our dynamic team and contribute to the development of AI models, including **computer vision** applications. In this role, you’ll assist in designing, implementing, and optimizing AI systems using machine learning and deep learning techniques such as convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and object detection frameworks. You'll play a key role in data preprocessing, ensuring data quality and integrity, while also supporting the testing and validation of computer vision models. You will collaborate closely with senior engineers to learn and grow in this rapidly evolving field.

**What You'll Do:**

- **Develop AI & Computer Vision Models**: Assist in the creation and refinement of machine learning and deep learning models, including computer vision applications like image classification, object detection, and image segmentation using frameworks such as TensorFlow, Keras, and PyTorch.
- **Code Implementation**: Write clean, efficient, and scalable code in Python, Java, or Scala to implement AI algorithms, particularly for computer vision tasks.
- **Data Management**: Support the team in managing, cleaning, and preprocessing image and video data, ensuring high-quality inputs for training and evaluation of computer vision models.
- **Testing & Validation**: Help test and validate AI and computer vision systems, ensuring their performance and reliability across a variety of use cases.
- **Continuous Learning**: Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in AI and computer vision, integrating new techniques into your work to improve model performance and innovation.
- **Team Collaboration**: Work closely with senior engineers and cross-functional teams, contributing ideas and solutions while also enhancing your own technical skills.

**What We're Looking For:**

- **Educational Background**: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
- **Technical Skills**: Experience or coursework in machine learning, deep learning, and computer vision, with proficiency in Python, Java, or Scala. Familiarity with frameworks like TensorFlow, Keras, PyTorch, OpenCV, or similar is a plus.
- **Data Handling**: Solid understanding of data preprocessing techniques, especially for image and video data, and familiarity with data augmentation and annotation methods for computer vision tasks.
- **Problem-Solving Mindset**: A curious and analytical mindset, eager to tackle complex computer vision problems and innovate.
- **Team Player**: Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively within a team and learn from others.
- **Growth-Oriented**: Passionate about AI and computer vision, with a desire to continuously develop your technical skills and knowledge.

**Why Join Us?**

- **Learning & Development**: Be part of a culture that encourages continuous learning and professional growth, with access to resources, mentorship, and real-world experience.
- **Impactful Work**: Contribute to projects that make a meaningful impact in [industry or field], using AI and computer vision to solve real-world challenges.
- **Collaborative Environment**: Work with a passionate team of engineers and AI experts who support each other’s growth and innovation.
- **Innovation at Scale**: Engage with some of the most cutting-edge AI technologies and tools to create solutions that will shape the future.

*We are seeking candidates who are not only qualified but also possess genuine interest in joining and growing with our team. If you are considering multiple offers or are still uncertain, we appreciate your honesty at the outset of the process.*

If you're excited about the potential of AI and computer vision and are looking for an opportunity to grow in a supportive, forward-thinking company, we'd love to hear from you!

**Hiring Company:** Confidential (Quick Commerce / Consumer Tech)

**Industry:** Quick Commerce / eCommerce Technology

Our client is building a high-performance Quick Commerce (Q-Commerce) platform focused on delivering products within 30–60 minutes.

Norvex Solutions is the exclusive recruitment partner managing this mandate.

**Role Overview**

Our client is seeking a **Mobile Fullstack Developer** to design, develop, and maintain a scalable, real-time Quick Commerce mobile application.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in both **mobile frontend development (React Native mandatory)** and **backend architecture (Node.js / NestJS preferred)**, with experience building transactional consumer applications involving payments, logistics, and real-time systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Mobile Development**

- Develop and maintain cross-platform mobile applications using **React Native (Mandatory)**

- Build high-performance, responsive UI/UX for customer and delivery partner apps
- Integrate RESTful and GraphQL APIs
- Implement real-time features such as live order tracking and push notifications
- Optimize app performance and offline capabilities

**Backend Development**

Design and develop scalable backend services using **Node.js (NestJS preferred)**

Build microservices for:

• Inventory management  
• Order management  
• Payment processing  
• User authentication & profile management

Develop real-time systems using WebSockets or Firebase

Integrate payment gateways and third-party APIs

Design and manage databases (MongoDB mandatory, PostgreSQL optional)

Ensure scalability, security, and high availability

**DevOps & Cloud**

- Deploy applications on **AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda)**
- Implement CI/CD pipelines
- Monitor system performance and troubleshoot production issues
- Apply security best practices (authentication, authorization, encryption)

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

5+ years experience in fullstack or mobile app development

Strong expertise in:

• React Native (Mandatory)  
• Node.js / NestJS  
• REST APIs & WebSockets  
• MongoDB (Mandatory)

Experience with payment gateway integration

Knowledge of scalable system design principles

Cloud infrastructure familiarity (AWS preferred)

Understanding of caching (Redis) and message queues (Kafka / RabbitMQ)

Startup execution-focused mindset

**Preferred Qualifications**

- Experience in Quick Commerce, food delivery, or eCommerce platforms
- Exposure to logistics or real-time tracking systems
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and Docker/Kubernetes
- Knowledge of analytics tools and A/B testing
- Experience in fast-paced startup environments

**Tech Stack**

Frontend: React Native (Mandatory), React JS, Flutter (Optional)  
Backend: Node.js (NestJS)  
Database: MongoDB (Mandatory), PostgreSQL, Redis  
Cloud: AWS  
Realtime: Firebase / WebSockets  
Payment Integration: Xendit, Wallet integrations  
API Integrations: Meta, SMS, Google Maps, Google Translate

**KPIs**

- App performance & crash rate
- Backend API uptime
- Order processing latency
- Deployment reliability
- System scalability during peak demand

**Why Join?**

Build a category-defining Quick Commerce platform, High ownership and architectural impact,

Fast-scaling, execution-driven environment, Strong long-term growth opportunity

title: Enterprise AI Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

Yourpay is a neobank focused on empowering and transforming the lives of underbanked mothers and families in rural areas of Indonesia. Our goal is to provide secure, affordable, and user-friendly financial services to Indonesian migrant workers around the world. We offer a comprehensive platform for payments, transfers, lending, and savings, allowing users to access five pillars of financial transactions: payment, lending, insurance, investment, and saving. To date, we have served over 2 million transactions for more than 60,000 active users in Indonesia, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Singapore, and soon Malaysia and Saudi Arabia. Join us in revolutionizing financial inclusion and making a positive impact on communities.

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a highly autonomous and deeply technical Enterprise AI Engineer to architect and build our internal AI infrastructure. In this role, you will operate as a senior individual contributor with an 80/20 split: spending 80% of your time hands-on in the codebase building production-grade AI systems, and 20% of your time acting as a project manager and internal evangelist. You will leverage your strong software engineering background to integrate advanced AI capabilities—like local models, intelligent agents, and robust memory architectures—into our internal workflows. Your goal is to eliminate operational bottlenecks and supercharge our productivity, ultimately allowing us to better serve our migrant worker community and scale our financial inclusion mission.

**Responsibilities**

**Technical Implementation (80%)**

- System Architecture & Coding: Design, write, and deploy scalable, secure AI-driven tools and backend infrastructure for internal teams (engineering, customer support, product, and operations).
- Advanced AI Integration: Build and maintain sophisticated AI pipelines, moving beyond basic API calls to implement complex RAG architectures, multi-agent workflows, and persistent memory systems.
- Infrastructure Management: Deploy and manage AI Gateways for routing, load balancing, and cost tracking, while evaluating and hosting local/open-weight models to ensure strict data privacy.
- Performance & Security: Ensure all internal AI deployments are highly performant, cost-effective, and strictly adhere to fintech data privacy, compliance, and security standards.

**Project Coordination & Internal Evangelism (20%)**

- Project Scoping & Management: Act as your own PM to gather requirements from internal stakeholders, define technical scope, set timelines, and drive AI projects from ideation to deployment.
- Internal Evangelism: Champion the adoption of AI across Yourpay. Conduct workshops, showcase proof-of-concepts, and mentor team members on how to leverage the AI tools you build.
- Strategic Evaluation: Continuously monitor the rapidly evolving AI landscape to prototype new technologies and assess their practical value for Yourpay's enterprise architecture.

**Requirements**

**Core Experience**

- Proven background as a Senior Software Engineer or Backend Developer, with a deep understanding of modern software development lifecycles, version control, and system design.
- Demonstrable experience architecting and deploying enterprise AI systems in a production environment (not just academic or local prototyping).

**Technical Skills & Knowledge**

- **Programming Languages:**
  Proficiency in Python and at least one other enterprise backend language (e.g., Go, Node.js, or Java).
- **AI Infrastructure & Serving:**
  Hands-on experience with hardware-accelerated inference and scaling AI workloads. This includes managing GPU/TPU compute, deploying high-throughput inference servers (e.g., NVIDIA Triton, vLLM, TGI), and applying model optimization techniques like quantization (e.g., AWQ, GPTQ) to minimize latency and infrastructure costs. Familiarity with orchestration for distributed AI workloads (e.g., Kubernetes, Ray).
- **Applied AI & LLMs:**
  Deep understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and model evaluation metrics.
- **Advanced AI Orchestration & Agents:**
  Extensive experience moving beyond simple prompts into agentic workflows. Familiarity with complex orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI) alongside standard tooling (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel).
- **AI Gateways & API Management:**
  Experience implementing AI Gateways (e.g., LiteLLM, Portkey, Cloudflare AI Gateway) to handle model routing, fallback mechanisms, rate limiting, and enterprise cost tracking across multiple LLM providers.
- **Local & Open-Weight Models:**
  Proven ability to evaluate, host, and optimize local or open-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral, Gemma) to ensure strict data privacy and reduce inference costs.
- **AI Memory & Context Management:**
  Expertise in designing sophisticated context management and memory architectures for AI agents. This includes managing context windows, semantic caching, and implementing both short-term conversational buffers and long-term persistent memory (using Redis, graph databases, etc.).
- **RAG Architecture & Vector DBs:**
  Expertise in designing and optimizing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines to connect AI models with secure, proprietary company data using vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, or pgvector).
- **Cloud & MLOps**
  : Strong knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience with MLOps/LLMOps best practices, including continuous integration, observability, monitoring, and scaling of AI models in production.

**Soft Skills & Project Management**

- **Exceptional Communication:**
  The ability to translate complex, highly technical AI concepts into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.
- **Leadership & Mentorship:**
  A natural inclination to teach, inspire, and guide peers. You enjoy unblocking others and fostering a culture of continuous learning.

**Please submit your CV to recruitment@yourpay.co.id with email SUBJECT: AI Engineer - Name**

title: Senior UI Developer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Front-End Web Developer who is motivated to combine the art of design with the art of programming. Responsibilities will include translation of the UI/UX design wireframes to actual code that will produce visual elements of the application. You will work with the UI/UX designer and bridge the gap between graphical design and technical implementation, taking an active role on both sides and defining how the application looks as well as how it works.
  
  
**Senior UI Developer Responsibilities**

* Develop new user-facing features.
* Build reusable code and libraries for future use
* Ensure the technical feasibility of UI/UX designs
* Optimize application for maximum speed and scalability
* Assure that all user inputs is validated before submitting to backend
* Collaborate with other team members and stakeholders

**Senior UI Developer Requirements**

* A minimum of 2 – 4 years of experience in front end development.
* Proficient understanding of web markup, including HTML5, CSS3
* Basic understanding of server-side CSS pre-processing platforms, such as LESS and SASS
* Proficient understanding of client-side scripting and JavaScript frameworks, including jQuery
* Good understanding of JavaScript libraries and frameworks
* Good understanding of asynchronous request handling, partial page updates, and AJAX
* Basic knowledge of image authoring tools, to be able to crop, resize, or perform small adjustments on an image. Familiarity with tools such as as Gimp or Photoshop is a plus.
* Proficient understanding of cross-browser compatibility issues and ways to work around them.
* Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as {{Git / Mercurial / SVN}}
* Good understanding of SEO principles and ensuring that application will adhere to them.

**UI Developer Skills & Qualifications**
React, JavaScript, JQuery, HTML5, CSS3, Web Programming Skills, Teamwork, Verbal Communication, cross-browser compatibility.
  
  
**Perks**

* Flexible schedule.
* Saturdays and Sundays are off.
* We provide laptops to all our employees.
* A chance to work with highly driven, self-motivated individuals in an excellent environment for career growth.
* Stress free workspace.
* Employee development opportunities.

**Work Culture**
We at Agaetis Tech aim to set new standards with our flexible work culture. Our intention is to build an employer-employee relationship solely on trust and steered by performance. We’re looking for highly driven and pro-active individuals who want to make a change. If you think that you’ve got the thirst to grow in an out of the box work environment then do get in touch!

Do you want to become an ambassador for a globally recognized high quality brand?

Are you ready for the new challenges?

Join ourorganization and help us build the **best** **in class** global IT function that is technologically sound, future proof and can react quickly to ever-changing demands!

Some career choices have more impact than others. When you join ECCO, you become part of a global family where we value people who do things differently. **BE DIFFERENT AND FIT IN!**

* Collaborate closely within a cross-functional team to deliver high quality technical solutions.

title: Data Scientist Analyst
description:
As a **Data Scientist**, you will transform complex datasets into actionable insights that drive business growth. You will work across data exploration, feature engineering, statistical modelling, and campaign analytics, collaborating with stakeholders to deliver data‑driven strategies that enhance portfolio performance and customer engagement.

### **What You’ll Do and How You’ll Succeed**

  

* Develop project scopes, methodologies, and analytical solutions using appropriate tools and techniques.
* Ensure quality control and maintain up‑to‑date documentation for all data science projects.
* Monitor client portfolio growth data, analyse spending trends, and identify new opportunities using non‑traditional data sources and advanced modelling techniques.
* Provide data support for card campaign design, including customer tiering, Test & Control setup, campaign targeting, and performance tracking.
* Track and benchmark portfolio dashboards, analyse market segments and channel opportunities, and provide insights to optimise ongoing and tactical campaigns.
* Manage communication effectively with clients and stakeholders to ensure clarity, alignment, and impact.

### **We’d Love to Hear From You If…**

**Experience**

* You hold a degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Operational Research, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or another quantitative field.
* You have at least 5 years of experience in data exploration and feature engineering.
* You understand local market conditions and industry regulations.
* A master’s degree is an advantage.

At Avanade, cybersecurity consultants are innovators, risk-takers, and challengers of the status quo. If you’re an experienced Microsoft Security Consultant, who can help our clients solve complex Cybersecurity business challenges, this might be the perfect opportunity for you.

Engage in exciting, complex projects and play a vital role in transforming clients' Cyber Defense strategies. Collaborate with a team of experts, share knowledge, and develop thought leadership. **Key Responsibilities**

* Build / Implement security capabilities such as Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, Microsoft Defender for Identity, Microsoft Entra ID P1/P2 etc.
* Design, secure and manage hybrid identity environments across on-premises Active Directory and Entra ID (Azure AD) to ensure resilience, integrity and threat resistance.
* Design and implement Entra ID solutions including Conditional Access Policy frameworks and Identity Governance (access reviews, entitlement management, lifecycle workflows).
* Conduct comprehensive security assessments across customer environments evaluating their deployment of Defender, Sentinel, Purview, Entra and Conditional Access, and deliver prioritized improvement roadmaps.
* Build strong relationships with clients, acting as a trusted advisor on best practices and Microsoft security technologies.
* Stay updated on industry trends, competitive landscape and emerging data protection threats to inform solution development and strategy.
* Conduct workshops, training and knowledge transfers to internal teams and external clients.

  

Qualification

  

**Skills & experiences**

* 6+ years of progressive experience in IT and cybersecurity, with a significant portion dedicated to Data Security & Information labeling & classification
* Experience integrating AD and Entra ID with enterprise IAM processes including provisioning, deprovisioning and access governance workflows.
* Hand-on experience in hybrid identity design including synchronization, federation and secure integration with SaaS applications.
* Hands-on experience with Conditional Access Policies aligned to Zero Trust principles incorporating device compliance, risk-based authentication, session controls and integration with Defender for Cloud Apps for real-time enforcement.

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a proven ability to articulate complex technical and business concepts clearly and persuasively to all levels of an organization.

description:
**Location: Surabaya, Indonesia**

Do you want to become an ambassador for a globally recognized high quality brand?

Are you ready for the new challenges?

Join ourorganization and help us build the **best** **in class** global IT function that is technologically sound, future proof and can react quickly to ever-changing demands!

Some career choices have more impact than others. When you join ECCO, you become part of a global family where we value people who do things differently. **BE DIFFERENT AND FIT IN!**

  

**Job Purpose**

As a Senior Frontend Engineer within our eCommerce team, you will help shape the future of our digital shopping experience. In this high-impact role, you will build performant, scalable, and user-friendly interfaces using Next.js, React, and modern web technologies. Your work will directly influence customer engagement and conversion across our global online platforms.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Optimize performance, accessibility, and SEO across all pages and components.
* Collaborate closely with product owners, designers, and backend engineers to deliver seamless user experiences.
* Stay up to date with the latest frontend technologies and advocate for best practices.
* Architect reusable components and scalable frontend systems
* Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and frontend testing strategies.
* Lead the development of new features and enhancements using Next.js, React, and TypeScript.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to code reviews and technical discussions.
  

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of front-end development experience with a strong focus on React and Next.js.
* Deep understanding of TypeScript, modern JavaScript and browser fundamentals.
* Experience building and maintaining large-scale web applications, in high-traffic e-commerce environments.
* Solid understanding of SSR, SSG, ISR, and edge rendering strategies, including trade-offs between performance, cost, and complexity.
* Experience working with headless CMS, search platforms and API-driven architectures (GraphQL/REST).
* Strong focus on web performance (Core Web Vitals), accessibility (WCAG), and SEO best practices.
* Experience with Git, modern CI/CD workflows, and frontend testing frameworks (e.g., Jest, Playwright).
* Proactive mindset - able to identify improvement opportunities and drive them independently, not just execute assigned tasks.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to identify root causes and propose pragmatic solutions in production systems.
* Collaborative team player committed to delivering high-quality outcomes.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
  

**CREATE THE FOOTPRINTS OF TOMORROW**

At ECCO, you become part of a meaningful, developing and multicultural workplace. You join a global family of more than 25,000 people who are proud to create the footprints of tomorrow.

Headquartered in Denmark, we are a family-owned company that offers international opportunities. Our offices and facilities have an informal culture and relaxed dress code – our shoe code is slightly stricter.

Join us and we guarantee lifelong learning – the speed of progress is up to you. So, if you’re curious, passionate and ready to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

Sentrabyte Digital Solusi | Jakarta, Indonesia | Full-time

Basic scripting skills (Python, Bash, or JavaScript) are a plus  
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills  
Good communication and teamwork abilities  
Willingness to learn and grow in offensive security

Experience in bug bounty or real-world testing projects

Competitive salary based on experience  
Opportunity to work on real-world security projects  
Supportive and growth-oriented environment  
Continuous learning and development opportunities

Full-time  
On-site (Jakarta)

* Ensure the performance, security, and responsiveness of applications built
* Continuously improve code quality, product execution, automatization, and customer delight
* **Drive innovation through experimentation** by understanding the purpose of the experimentation and when to fail the experiment.
* You will be able to drive innovation from experimentation results.
* **Be able to influence teams within his/her area and lead more senior team members.**

* Good written and spoken English
* Mastery of some abstract programming concepts and/or design patterns, and in some libraries or frameworks (OOP or FP)

* Experience working in Agile Software development
* Communicate, collaborate, and work effectively across distributed teams in a multicultural environment.

* You're excited to mentor and groom the team collectively to become their better version of themselves, in realms of technicality and personal development. about delivering end-to-end experiences and care about your software architecture across the front-end, back-end, and the APIs that glue them together

* Memastikan situs web berbasis WordPress mematuhi standar aksesibilitas web.

* Diutamakan berdomisili di Kota Semarang atau sekitarnya.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Artefact is a new generation of data service providers, specialising in data consulting and data-driven digital marketing. It is dedicated to transforming data into business impact across the entire value chain of organisations. We are proud to say we're enjoying skyrocketing growth.

The backbone of our consulting missions, today our Data consulting team has more than 400 consultants covering all Artefact's offers (and more): data marketing, data governance, strategy consulting, product owner…

**What will you be doing?**

**Securing delivery on your projects****Communicating your work and achievements among the team****Working closely with your Consulting counterpart to build and maintain strong relationships with your clients and best understand their needs****Ensuring that your solutions are bringing values to the client problematic****Being a good team player, knowing your role and responsibility in the global ambition**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Data Quality Analysis & Remediation: Collect, extract, and clean data from various sources to prepare comprehensive datasets for analysis This includes handling missing data, removing inconsistencies, and ensuring the data is structured correctly for further analysis.
* Analyze data using appropriate statistical techniques and tools to uncover trends, patterns, and anomalies in the information. This could involve anything from simple descriptive analysis to more complex exploratory data analysis
* Validate and cross-check analysis results to ensure accuracy. This involves verifying calculations, comparing findings against external or historical data for consistency, and investigating any irregularities in the results. Data Analysts are expected to be vigilant about data quality during analysis, catching any issues that might have passed initial data processing.
* Create clear, concise reports and visualizations to communicate findings. While the focus is on analysis rather than just creating dashboards, analysts will use tools like **Power BI** to illustrate key insights. They should present data in an understandable way for internal stakeholders, writing summaries that interpret the numbers and highlight important conclusions.
* Work closely with statisticians and other team members to interpret results and refine analysis approaches. This collaborative approach ensures that the analysis aligns with methodological standards and project goals. Analysts may adjust their methods based on feedback, contribute to discussions on what the data means, and help integrate their findings into broader census reports.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Data Science, Economics, Mathematics, or similar. This educational background provides a solid foundation in data analysis techniques and statistical reasoning.
* Strong proficiency in data analysis tools and languages, particularly **SQL** for database querying, Excel for data manipulation, and programming in Python or R for more advanced analysis and automation. Experience with statistical libraries or packages (e.g., pandas, R's tidyverse) is highly valuable.
* Demonstrated ability to perform in-depth data analysis and not just generate visuals. We need analysts who can write complex queries, perform calculations, and apply statistical tests if necessary – beyond assembling dashboard components. An analytical mindset and attention to detail are crucial for interpreting data correctly and spotting outliers or errors.
* Familiarity with business intelligence and visualization tools, especially **Power BI**, to aid in presenting analysis outcomes. While creating polished dashboards is not the primary focus, the analyst should be capable of using Power BI (and similar tools like Tableau if needed) to turn data into interpretable charts and graphs for reporting purposes. They should also understand data visualization best practices to communicate information effectively.
* Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to explain data findings in layman's terms. A collaborative attitude is important, as Data Analysts will frequently interact with other teams (IT, field operations, subject-matter experts) to gather context and ensure that analyses meet the needs of the census project. They should be proactive in sharing insights and contributing to data-driven decisions within the organization.
extracted_skills: Python, Data Science, Pandas, SQL, Power BI

title: Head of Data Science
description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic Head of Data Science to lead our data science function for the Indonesia market, our largest and most mature market. This is a senior leadership role with broad scope, overseeing a team of 20+ data scientists working across multiple domains including credit risk, collections, and growth modeling.

You will work directly with the Chief Data Officer (CDO) to define and execute the strategic vision of the data science team, drive innovation across a diverse set of use cases, and ensure the team delivers meaningful business impact at scale. This role demands both strong leadership and the ability to stay hands-on when needed.

**About the Job:**

*Team Leadership & Strategy*

* Lead, mentor, and grow a team of 20+ data scientists across multiple domains and workstreams.
* Work directly with the CDO to define the strategic vision, priorities, and long-term roadmap of the data science function.
* Build a high-performance team culture with strong best practices in model development, validation, and deployment.
* Manage hiring, onboarding, and career development of data science talent, and play a key role in shaping the team structure as it continues to grow.

*Model Development Across Domains*

* Oversee the development and deployment of models across a diverse range of domains including credit risk, collections, fraud detection, customer growth, segmentation, and propensity modeling.
* Remain hands-on and lead by example, actively contributing to data analysis, model building, and technical problem solving alongside the team.
* Collaborate with ML engineering teams to integrate models into operational systems and data pipelines.
* Champion data-driven decision making across all business functions in the Indonesia market.

*Stakeholder Communication & Collaboration*

* Serve as the primary data science leader and point of contact for a wide range of stakeholders across risk, collections, product, operations, and growth functions.
* Translate complex model outputs and data science insights into clear, actionable recommendations for non-technical audiences.
* Regularly present strategic updates, model performance, and key insights to senior leadership and the CDO.
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure models are aligned with real business needs and priorities.

**About You:**

* Minimum 10 years of experience in data science or machine learning, with at least 3–5 years in a team leadership or management role, preferably leading large teams.
* Diverse domain experience across multiple areas such as credit risk, collections, growth, fraud, or customer analytics, breadth of experience is valued as much as depth.
* Strong technical skills across the full data science lifecycle, from data analysis and feature engineering to model development and production deployment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior business leaders.
* Experience in the Indonesian market or Southeast Asian financial services industry is a plus.

**Why Join Us**

* Lead one of the largest and most impactful data science teams in the region, with 20+ data scientists across diverse domains.
* Work directly with the CDO to shape the strategic direction of the data science function.
* Have real ownership over how the team is built, how models are developed, and how data science influences business decisions at scale.
* Work with a passionate, cross-functional team that values data-driven thinking and experimentation.

title: Supply Chain Management Manager
description:
**Not just a job, but a career**

Yokogawa, award winner for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards, is a leading provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems and industrial services in several industries.

Our aim is to shape a better future for our planet through supporting the energy transition, (bio)technology, artificial intelligence, industrial cybersecurity, etc. We are committed to the United Nations sustainable development goals by utilizing our ability to measure and connect.

**About the Team**  
Our 18,000 employees work in over 60 countries with one corporate mission, to "co-innovate tomorrow". We are looking for dynamic colleagues who share our passion for technology and care for our planet. In return, we offer you great career opportunities to grow yourself in a truly global culture where respect, value creation, collaboration, integrity, and gratitude are highly valued and exhibited in everything we do.

**Supply Chain Management Manager**

**Job Summary**

The Supply Chain Management (SCM) Manager is responsible for leading and managing end-to-end supply chain operations, including **order processing, procurement, strategic sourcing, logistics, and export control**, while ensuring compliance with corporate policies, ISO standards, and regulatory requirements. This role leads an SCM team and works closely with cross-functional stakeholders to drive cost efficiency, service excellence, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement in alignment with business and regional SCM strategies.

**Reporting Line**

* Reports to: **Finance Head / Regional SCM Process Owner (RPO)**
* Manages: **SCM team** **(Procurement, Order Handling,** **Logistics/Warehousing** **as applicable)**

**Key Responsibilities**

**1.** **Supply Chain Leadership** **& Governance**

* Lead, manage, and develop the SCM team to achieve departmental objectives and service levels.
* Communicate SCM action plans and ensure alignment with functional, regional, and organizational strategies.
* Drive SCM governance, compliance discipline, and audit readiness across all SCM activities.
* Monitor team performance, allocate resources, coach staff, and contribute to performance appraisal and capability building.

**2. Order Processing Management**

* Oversee the full order processing lifecycle from order entry to delivery, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and customer satisfaction.
* Collaborate with Sales, Project, Engineering, Service, and Customers to optimize workflows and resolve issues.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, ISO standards, GMS, RMS, and customer requirements.
* Continuously improve order handling processes to enhance efficiency and service quality.

**3. Procurement & Strategic Sourcing**

* Develop and implement procurement and strategic sourcing strategies aligned with business objectives.
* Manage sourcing activities, supplier selection, negotiations, contract creation, and contract management.
* Analyze spend, cost drivers, and market dynamics to identify cost reduction and value creation opportunities.
* Deliver category plans, manage supplier performance, and ensure ethical and compliant procurement practices.

**4. Supplier & Contract Management**

* Build and maintain effective supplier partnerships to ensure continuity, quality, cost competitiveness, and risk mitigation.
* Manage supplier contracts and service providers in line with established contract management plans.
* Drive supplier evaluation, performance review, and corrective actions as required.

**5. Logistics & Warehousing**

* Oversee logistics, shipping, and warehousing operations (domestic and international) to ensure timely and cost-effective deliveries.
* Optimize logistics strategies and workflows to reduce costs and improve service performance.
* Ensure full compliance with customs regulations and timely renewal of import/export registrations and permits.
* Prevent penalties, delays, or non-compliance in all logistics and customs clearance activities.

**6. Export Control & Compliance**

* Manage export control and trade compliance activities in accordance with domestic and international regulations.
* Ensure compliance with export control policies, conduct annual awareness training, and maintain documentation.
* Ensure zero major findings in internal and external audits related to SCM, procurement, logistics, and trade compliance.

**7. Financial & Performance Management**

* Manage SCM budgets and conduct cost, margin, and financial impact analysis related to supply chain decisions.
* Drive cost control initiatives and contribute to improving gross profit and working capital performance.
* Monitor SCM KPIs, analyze trends, and prepare management reports for decision-making.

**8. Systems, Data & Continuous Improvement**

* Utilize ERP and procurement systems (e.g., SAP, ARIBA) to manage procurement, reporting, and analytics.
* Apply data-driven insights to guide sourcing decisions, risk mitigation, and process improvements.
* **Lead or support SCM-related projects and continuous improvement initiatives.**

**Education & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business, or related discipline.
* **SCM or Procurement professional certifications (e.g. CPSM, CSCP) are an advantage**.

================

Competitive salary and bonus scheme

Free day to volunteer

**About the position**
----------------------

The HR Coordinator is responsible for providing comprehensive HR operational support across Southeast Asia. This role serves as the first point of contact for employees through the HR ticketing system, ensuring timely and accurate support across the employee lifecycle. The position supports Talent Acquisition (TA), onboarding and offboarding processes, payroll coordination, and day to day HR administration while ensuring compliance with company policies and local labor regulations.

### **Your responsibilities and tasks**

HR Operations & Employee Support

* Act as the primary point of contact for employee HR inquiries via the HR ticketing system, ensuring timely resolution and proper escalation.
* Deliver end to end HR operational support across the employee lifecycle for SEA countries.
* Maintain accurate and up to date employee records in HR systems in compliance with data privacy requirements.
* Support HR audits and internal reporting as required.

Onboarding & Offboarding

* Coordinate onboarding activities including system access, documentation, and probation tracking.
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new hires in alignment with company standards.
* Manage offboarding processes including resignation notification to all related parties, system deactivation, and upload exit documentation in the system.
* Ensure compliance with local requirements related to onboarding and termination.

Payroll & Leave system Coordination

* Act as the HR point of contact for payroll coordination.
* Ensure payroll & Leaves inputs (new hires, resignations, salary changes, allowances, leave data) are accurate and submitted on time.
* Assist in compensation and benefits administration, including enrollments and changes in Leaves system and Insurance portal.

Cross Functional & Compliance Support

* Work closely with HR Business Partners, TA teams, and external vendors across SEA.
* Ensure HR processes comply with company policies and local labor laws.
* Support HR projects, process improvements, and system enhancements as assigned.

### **Your profile and qualifications**

Education & Experience

* Diploma degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* At least 2 years of experience in HR Operations, HR Administration, or HR Shared Services.
* Hands on experience supporting multiple countries or regional HR operations is preferred.
* Experience with HR ticketing systems, HRIS, and payroll coordination is an advantage.

Skills & Competencies

* Strong organizational and coordination skills with high attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast paced environment.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills across different cultures.
* Problem solving mindset with a service oriented approach.
* Proficient in MS Office; HRIS experience is an added advantage.
* Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.

Communication & Collaboration

* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and local language
* Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across different countries and cultures
* Proactive, service-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple priorities

**About GEA**
-------------

GEA is one of the largest suppliers for the food and beverage processing industry and a wide range of other process industries. Approximately 18,000 employees in more than 60 countries contribute significantly to GEA’s success – come and join them! We offer interesting and challenging tasks, a positive working environment in international teams and opportunities for personal development and growth in a global company.

Why join GEA

Applicants with disabilities are welcome and will be given special consideration if they are equally qualified.

-------------------

Contact us
