title: Growth Analyst
description:
**About Luxehouze**
Luxehouze is a fast-growing omnichannel luxury marketplace with an established presence in Singapore and Indonesia, two key markets in Southeast Asia's luxury retail landscape.
  
  
Through our operations in both markets, we bring together a curated selection of luxury watches, fashion, and beauty, serving discerning customers through integrated online and offline retail experiences.
  
  
As we continue to strengthen our regional footprint, we are building a business driven by product expertise, customer trust, commercial excellence, and a passion for luxury.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Growth Analyst who combines a strong understanding of luxury fashion with commercial acumen and an entrepreneurial mindset.
  
  
Join us in shaping our company and contributing to the growth of a luxury retail business across two dynamic Southeast Asian markets.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Analyze customer, product, and commercial data to identify growth opportunities, customer behavior patterns, and operational improvements.
* Support the Growth team by translating business questions into structured analyses and actionable insights.
* Monitor and report key growth metrics across the customer funnel, including traffic, conversion, retention, repeat purchase, and revenue performance.
* Build and maintain dashboards and automated reports to provide timely visibility into business performance.
* Conduct deep-dive analyses on customer cohorts, campaign performance, product performance, pricing, and other growth initiatives.
* Assist in formulating hypotheses, measuring experiment results, and evaluating the impact of new initiatives and A/B tests.
* Work closely with Product, Marketing, Commercial, Operations, CRM, and Finance teams to provide data-driven recommendations for business decisions.
* Ensure data accuracy by validating datasets, identifying anomalies, and collaborating with data engineering when necessary.
* Translate analytical findings into clear presentations and recommendations for stakeholders with varying levels of technical expertise.
* Continuously improve reporting processes, documentation, and analytical methodologies to increase efficiency and data reliability.
* Support the design, measurement, and post-analysis of growth experiments, including customer segmentation, CRM initiatives, referral programs, membership features, pricing tests, and pre-order initiatives.
* Measure and evaluate the impact of growth initiatives by defining success metrics, conducting post-launch analyses, and providing recommendations for optimization.

**Requirement & Qualifications:**

* Minimum 2-4 years of experience in Business Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Growth Analytics, Business Intelligence, Strategy, Management Consulting, or similar analytical roles.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect data insights to customer behavior, growth opportunities, and business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly evolving business environments.
* Experience in e-commerce, marketplace, retail, consumer, luxury, or other high-growth businesses is highly preferred.
* Strong curiosity about customer behavior.
* Ability to explain insights in plain language.
* Structured problem-solving.
* Attention to detail

**About The Role**
We’re seeking an experienced Full Stack Developer to join our development team, responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust web applications. You’ll work primarily with .NET 8+ on the backend and Angular on the frontend, building scalable and maintainable applications that power critical business functions and customer experience. **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain web applications using .NET 8 and Angular.
* Write clean, maintainable following best practices
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and integrate third-party services.
* Participate in architectural discussions and decisions; contribute to evolving system design and patterns.
* Identify and implement optimizations for application performance, scalability, and security.
* Work closely with product owners, QA engineers, and other developers to plan and deliver features.
* Diagnose, debug, and resolve issues in production and staging environments.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 3–5+ years of professional experience in full-stack web application development.
* Proven experience delivering production-ready .NET applications.
* Strong understanding of front-end development practices with Angular or similar frameworks.

**Technical Skills**

* Backend: .NET 8, C#, Entity Framework Core
* Frontend: Angular (modern versions v14+ preferred), TypeScript, HTML5, SCSS/CSS
* RESTful API design and integration
* DevOps: Git, CI/CD pipelines, build and release management
* Layered architecture, dependency injection, clean architecture principles

**Nice To Have**

* Experience with SignalR or real-time web applications
* Experience in maintaining and modernising legacy .NET applications, including refactoring and improving existing codebases.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality
* Ability to work in an agile, iterative development environment

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary

title: Web Programmer / Application Developer
description:
Bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan seluruh infrastruktur dan layanan Teknologi Informasi (TI) di ITSB berjalan secara optimal, aman, dan andal. Posisi ini mengelola pemeliharaan hardware, software, jaringan, serta berbagai sistem informasi kampus untuk mendukung operasional akademik dan administrasi. IT Specialist juga berperan dalam memberikan dukungan teknis kepada pengguna, menjaga keamanan sistem, serta mendukung implementasi pengembangan teknologi di lingkungan ITSB.

* Melakukan instalasi, konfigurasi, pemeliharaan, dan troubleshooting perangkat **IT hardware** (PC, laptop, printer, server, dan perangkat pendukung lainnya).
* Melakukan maintenance dan memastikan operasional seluruh **sistem informasi ITSB**, termasuk **Cybercampus, SAP Fiori**, Learning Management System (LMS), serta aplikasi pendukung lainnya.
* Melakukan instalasi, update, monitoring, dan pemeliharaan software untuk memastikan kinerja sistem tetap optimal.
* Mengelola dan memelihara infrastruktur jaringan (LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, internet) agar tetap stabil dan aman.
* Memberikan technical support kepada dosen, tenaga kependidikan, dan mahasiswa terkait permasalahan perangkat keras, perangkat lunak, maupun jaringan.
Melakukan monitoring terhadap performa server, storage, database, dan infrastruktur TI.  

  
  
**Requirements**  

* Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Teknik Komputer, atau bidang terkait.
* Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3–5 tahun sebagai IT Support, IT Infrastructure, System Administrator, Network Engineer, IT Specialist, atau posisi relevan lainnya.
* Memiliki kemampuan web programming dan application development, termasuk:

1. PHP Native & Laravel – terutama untuk pengembangan dan maintenance aplikasi berbasis web/ERP.

2. Python & Odoo Development – terutama untuk development, customization, dan integration ERP/Odoo.

3. Express.js / Node.js – terutama untuk API development dan payment system integration.

* Lebih disukai apabila memiliki kemampuan network management
* Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, analytical thinking, dan komunikasi yang baik serta mampu berkoordinasi dengan user maupun vendor.

title: Solutions Sales - Cloud
description:
Job Description

**Cloud Solution Architect** provides a unique opportunity to enable transformational change in customer journey to the cloud. CSA works with account managers for high-value enterprises in the market, and lead migration assessment, readiness and deal technical strategy.

**What you’ll do:**

* Design cloud-based solutions Design cloud architecture and complete plans and specifications to develop solutions
* Collaborate with product managers and engineers to develop specifications for new cloud-based products/services, applications and solutions
* Drive the roll-out of cloud management platforms, evaluate its performance and implements enhancements
* Designs and develops IT architecture (integrated process, applications, data and technology) solutions to business problems in alignment with the enterprise architecture direction and standards
* Develops specifications for new products/services, applications and service offerings
* Assesses the compatibility and integration of products/services proposed as standards to ensure an integrated architecture across interdependent technologies
* Migrate and modernize applications to Azure

**Profile requirements:**

* Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, Terraforms, etc..
* Experience with relational, graph and/or unstructured data technologies such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data
* Lake, HD Insights, Hadoop, Cloudera, MongoDB, MySQL, Neo4j, Cassandra, Couchbase
* Software development full life-cycle methodologies, patterns, frameworks, libraries and tools
* Knowledge of programming and scripting languages such as JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, .NET, Java, Python, PHP, Ruby, PERL, C++, etc.
* Experience with machine learning tools such as Azure ML, AWS, Google, etc.
* Experience in distilling complex technical challenges to actionable decisions for stakeholders and guiding project teams by building consensus and mediating compromises when necessary.
* Experience coordinating the intersection of complex system dependencies and interactions
* Experience in solution delivery using Agile methodologies.
* Demonstrated knowledge of relevant industry trends and standards

**Preferable skills:**

* 5+ years design/implementation/consulting experience of distributed applications.
* Experience in leading data center or cloud migration projects.
* Breadth of experience across the Enterprise IT in multiple of the following areas: Infrastructure architecture; Database architecture; IP Networking; IT Security; Data Center Operations; Software design or development.
* Breadth of expertise in private and public Cloud Computing, technologies and architectural best practices.
* Expert level technical acumen, including the ability to understand the customer IT landscape, identify opportunities and overcome any technical obstacles, ultimately influencing the adoption of cloud platform in conjunction with business requirements.
* Strong presentation and written communication skills; high degree of comfort with technical and Executive audiences.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Home
  
  
> Careers
  
  
> Data Engineer
  
  
Data Engineer
  
  
09 Dec 2025
  
  
**Location:**
Jakarta
  
  
**Position Type:**
Full-time (in office)
  
  
**Reports to:**
CTO
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Data Engineer to design, implement, and maintain reliable data pipelines that collect and process data from various public APIs into a centralised blob storage and database environment. You’ll play a key role in ensuring data is ingested efficiently, transformed cleanly, and made accessible for downstream analysis and reporting.
  
  
This role involves working with Python-based ETL pipelines, workflow orchestration (Apache Airflow or equivalent), and cloud storage solutions (e.g., Azure Blob Storage).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and implement robust ETL/ELT pipelines to extract data from multiple public APIs and load into blob storage and relational databases.
* Build and manage scheduled workflows using tools such as Apache Airflow (or similar).
* Handle complex API integrations, authentication flows (OAuth2, API keys), pagination, and rate limiting.
* Structure data in blob storage (e.g., Azure Blob) for efficient downstream access.
* Transform and load data into structured SQL-based databases for analytics and access by Web applications
* Implement monitoring, logging, and validation to ensure data integrity and pipeline reliability.
* Work closely with data scientists, and software developers to ensure data availability and usability.
* Maintain clear documentation for data sources, transformations, and orchestration logic.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 3+ years of experience building data pipelines in a production environment.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT architecture, API data ingestion, and data modelling principles.
* Experience with Azure

**Technical Skills**

* Languages: Python (preferred), SQL (Microsoft T-SQL)
* Orchestration: Apache Airflow or similar
* RESTful API integration (authentication, pagination, error handling)
* Azure Blob Storage
* Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD pipelines

**Nice To Have**

* Experience integrating data from open economic and financial APIs (e.g., World Bank, IMF, OECD, UN Data, FRED)
* Familiarity with large structured and semi-structured datasets (JSON, CSV, Parquet) and associated performance considerations
* Experience building incremental ingestion or change data capture (CDC) pipelines

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset
* Clear communication of technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
* Attention to detail and data accuracy
* Proactive approach to monitoring

**What We Offer**

* Modern, central office near to public transport and key amenities
* Competitive salary

**How To Apply**
If you're interested in this role, please send your CV and Cover Letter to

**About the job**
-----------------

Noraa & Co. is partnering with one of the top public companies in Indonesia to strengthen a high-impact technology organization that supports large-scale business operations across Indonesia.

Our client is entering a major technology transformation phase, where reliable backend systems, scalable software architecture, infrastructure, cybersecurity, database reliability, DevOps, and IT operations will play a critical role in future growth.

We are currently looking for a **Senior Backend Engineer** to join the engineering team.

**Position Overview**
---------------------

As a Senior Backend Engineer, you will design, build, and maintain reliable backend services and APIs that support critical business applications. You will work closely with engineering leaders, product, infrastructure, security, database, DevOps, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable systems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Backend Development**
  + Design, develop, test, and maintain backend services, APIs, integrations, and business logic.
  + Write clean, scalable, maintainable, and well-documented code.
  + Improve system reliability, performance, and maintainability.
* **System Design & Architecture**
  + Contribute to backend architecture, service design, data flow, and integration patterns.
  + Support the design of scalable systems for high-volume business operations.
  + Identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement.
* **Collaboration & Delivery**
  + Work closely with product, QA, DevOps, infrastructure, security, and database teams.
  + Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, troubleshooting, and production issue resolution.
  + Support delivery planning, estimation, and engineering best practices.
* **Quality, Security & Reliability**
  + Ensure backend services follow secure coding practices and reliability standards.
  + Support monitoring, logging, debugging, and incident resolution.
  + Help improve testing, CI/CD readiness, and operational stability.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Solid professional experience as a Backend Engineer, Software Engineer, or similar backend-focused role.
* Strong backend engineering fundamentals, including API design, databases, system design, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Experience with modern backend technologies such as Java, Go, Node.js, Python, PHP, or similar languages.
* Experience working with relational or non-relational databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, Redis, or similar technologies.
* Familiarity with microservices, REST APIs, message queues, cloud infrastructure, containers, or CI/CD is a plus.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams in a structured engineering environment.
* Good communication skills, ownership mindset, and willingness to work in a large-scale technology transformation environment.
* Experience in fintech, banking, enterprise systems, high-transaction platforms, marketplace, SaaS, or large-scale internal systems is a plus.

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

* Location: Jakarta, Indonesia.
* Employment type: Full-time.
* Client identity will be shared during the appropriate stage of the recruitment process.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Senior Associate Business Analyst is a developing subject matter expert, responsible for working with internal and external clients to determine requirements and to define solutions to address business, process and systems problems, and improvements in the organization.  
  
Working under supervision when needed, this role acts as a liaison among stakeholders in order to understand the structure, policies, and operations of an organization, and to recommend solutions that enable the organization to achieve its goals.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Acts as a bridge between the business problems and the technology solutions.
* Supports the analysis, transformation and ultimately works towards resolving business problems with the help of technology.
* Works with internal clients and applies best practice methodologies to determine business requirements and to define solutions to address business, process, information and system problems, improvements or change.
* Delivers business projects in line with sponsor requirements and enterprise architecture.
* Proactively develops and deploys enhanced services and platforms, covering all the functional aspects from service/product definition through to build and deployment.
* Ensures the identification and documentation of operational gaps including user guides, templates, test cases and related user training.
* Assists with the resolution of issues pertaining to the service.
* Adheres to and follow the relevant development and support processes.
* Communicates and escalates if any issues arise or deliverables cannot be met and request assistance to ensure closure of issues.
* Takes responsibility for delivery of project elements under relevant guidance and supervision.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Developing understanding of business practices and processes.
* Team player who displays good client service orientation with well-developed administrative and organization skills.
* Developing expertise in specific systems, processes and technologies that they will be required to analyze.
* Meticulous attention to detail whilst working under pressure.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to listen empathetically.
* Ability to build rapport and engage effectively with a variety of stakeholders.
* Knowledge of project management methodology.
* Good analytical skills with the ability to convert business requirements into operational deliverables (functional requirements) to meet business objectives.
* Good documentation skills, in particular, functional requirements, test cases, system user documentation, processes and procedures and presentations.
* Wworking knowledge of Microsoft Exchange, Word, Excel Project, PowerPoint and Visio
* Understanding of systems generally used in a services organization e.g. ServiceNow, Siebel, Remedy, SAP, EMS would be advantageous.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business or Information Technology or a related field.
* Project management certification would be advantageous.
* Professional in Business Analysis certification is preferred.
* IIBA Membership required.
* Relevant technology certification(s) required, such as ITIL.

**Required experience:**

* Moderate level experience as a Business Analyst gained within a technology services environment.
* Moderate level experience as a system administrator or developer would be advantageous.
* Developing experience in and with all operational aspects of a Services business, preferably with a Systems Integrator.
* Developing experience in the business requirement gathering, use case definition, process mapping and implementing new services and systems.

**Workplace type****:**

On-site Working

title: iOS Developer
description:
**About BJAK**
The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
  
  
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
  
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
  
  
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
  
  
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
  
****The Role****
We are looking for iOS engineers to build the native iOS experience for BJAK's AI Neobank app.
  
  
This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.
  
  
****What Will You Build****

* Build and ship native iOS features for onboarding, accounts, cards, payments, transfers, rewards and AI-assisted user journeys.
* Make complex financial flows feel clean, fast and simple on mobile.
* Work with product, design, backend and AI engineers to take ideas from rough concept to production release.
* Own app quality across performance, crash rate, loading states, edge cases, responsiveness and release stability.
* Use production feedback, analytics and customer behaviour to improve features after launch.
* Integrate APIs, authentication, secure data handling and financial workflows with strong attention to reliability.

****What We're Looking For****

* Strong native iOS experience using Swift.
* Experience shipping iOS apps used by real users.
* Good understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, async/await and iOS architecture patterns.
* Strong product sense and care for UX, not just building screens.
* Able to debug production issues and improve performance, reliability and app quality.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and moving fast without lowering the bar.

****The Bar****
We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.
  
  
****This Role Is Not For****

* Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.
* Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.
* People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.
* Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.
* People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

****Location****
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in
**Indonesia**
. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
**Indonesia**
.
  
  
****Language****
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
  
****Interview Process****
Our process is designed to move fast:
  
  

* Online assessment or practical task
* Role-specific interview
* CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.
  
  
Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.
  
  
Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.
  
  
We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
  
  
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
  
****The Role****
We are looking for full stack engineers to build fast across BJAK's AI Neobank app.
  
  
This role is for product-minded engineers who can move across frontend, backend, internal tools and customer journeys to turn ideas into working products quickly.
  
  
****What You'll Own****

* Build and ship full product features across frontend, backend, APIs and databases.
* Create customer and internal workflows for onboarding, accounts, payments, rewards, travel, FX, support automation, KYC and risk.
* Turn ambiguous product problems into working systems with clean UX and reliable backend logic.
* Work closely with product, design, mobile, backend and AI engineers to launch fast and improve after release.
* Build internal tools and automation that reduce manual work and help teams operate at scale.
* Own your work beyond release: monitor, debug, learn and improve.

****What We're Looking For****

* Strong full stack engineering experience with real shipped products.
* Comfortable across frontend, backend, APIs, databases and production debugging.
* Good frontend execution using React, Next.js, Vue or similar modern stack.
* Good backend fundamentals around APIs, data models, authentication, integrations and reliability.
* Strong product sense and ability to simplify messy workflows.
* Able to work fast with ambiguity and own outcomes end-to-end.

****This Role Is Not For****

* Engineers who only want to work on one narrow layer.
* People who need complete specs before starting.
* Developers who ship UI without understanding backend or operations impact.
* Candidates who avoid production support.
* People who make vague claims without showing real shipped work.

****The Bar****
We are looking for engineers with real technology career highlights. A strong highlight is not just working at a famous company. A strong highlight means you personally helped build, ship or scale a serious product, platform or system.
  
  
****Location****
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in
**Indonesia**
. We are hiring for this market specifically, so applicants should already be based in
**Indonesia**
.
  
  
****Language****
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
  
****Interview Process****
Our process is designed to move fast:
  
  

* Online assessment or practical task
* Technical interview
* CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: System Administrator
description:
We're looking for a proactive and hands-on **System Administrator** to keep our IT infrastructure running securely, efficiently, and reliably. In this role, you'll manage both on-premises and cloud environments, maintain critical systems and networks, troubleshoot infrastructure issues, and help drive technology improvements that support our growing business.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage and maintain Windows/Linux servers, virtualization platforms, cloud infrastructure, storage, and enterprise systems.
* Administer core IT services, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, email, VPN, firewalls, and network infrastructure.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and provide advanced technical support to ensure high availability.
* Perform system upgrades, patching, backups, disaster recovery testing, and infrastructure maintenance.
* Maintain technical documentation, IT assets, and coordinate with technology vendors.
* Participate in infrastructure projects, including deployments, migrations, and technology enhancements.
* Support ISO 27001 and Information Security Management System (ISMS) initiatives by implementing secure infrastructure and maintaining compliance.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve performance, security, automation, and operational efficiency.

**What We're Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience as a System Administrator, Infrastructure Engineer, or a similar IT Infrastructure role.
* Strong experience managing Windows and/or Linux servers, virtualization platforms (VMware, Proxmox, or similar), and cloud infrastructure.
* Hands-on experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, backup solutions, and enterprise networking.
* Solid understanding of infrastructure security, system hardening, backup & disaster recovery, and infrastructure monitoring.
* Experience with scripting or automation (PowerShell, Bash, or Python) is a plus.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, IT security best practices, or compliance frameworks is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Professional certifications such as Microsoft Azure Administrator, RHCSA/RHCE, VMware VCP, CompTIA Server+/Network+, or CCNA are a plus.
* Willing to participate in scheduled maintenance and provide after-hours support when required.
* Comfortable working under an initial **6-month employment contract**, with the possibility of conversion to a permanent position.

If you meet these requirements and you are looking for a new, exciting opportunity within a successful, growing company, then this role is for you!

\* \* \*

**Integrity Indonesia** is a foreign investment company that has operated since 2001 in Indonesia and in other countries in Asia. Our business is to provide services related to the prevention, detection, and investigation of fraud.

Our services include employment background screening, whistleblowing systems, mystery shopping services, due diligence, process serving, research & market intelligence, asset tracing, skip tracing, claims investigations, brand protection, anti-counterfeiting, trademark investigation, and market surveys.

title: Customer Service Head
description:
**Job Description :**

**Customer Service Head**

**About us**

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we’re the world’s leading premium drinks company. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate, and innovate to build brands consumers love. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you’ll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future.

Join us to create a career worth celebrating.

**Join our** **Supply Chain and Manufacturing** **Team**

Our Supply Chain and Manufacturing team are problem-solvers, sourcing, producing, and delivering our much-loved brands to delight customers around the globe. Over half of Diageo’s 30,000+ people work in Supply Chain and Manufacturing. It’s an intricate and sophisticated operation that’s the product of logistical, manufacturing, and technical collaborations.

Our teams in 100 sites in over 30 countries cover production facilities, supplier relationships, customer collaborations and third-party agreements. We’re committed to realizing our ‘Society 2030: Spirit of Progress’ goals, to protect the environment and support our farmers and suppliers. Whatever your skills and experience, we’ll help you to thrive in our inclusive culture.

**About this role**

The Customer Service Head is the face of Supply Chain and Procurement to our customers, General Manager and the Executive Team, our 3PLs, and other internal/external stakeholders. The CSM is part of the Market Executive Team, playing a key leadership role in bringing topline, bottom line, cash and organizational ambition of Diageo to life.

The most important role of the CSH is to make market the #1 supplier in the Advantage Survey within the TBA peer group, and within the top 3 within FMCG. This will come through taking customer collaboration to the next level, delighting our customers through operational excellence (every case, every day, everywhere) and driving value through effective partnership with customers resulting in strong joint business plans and joint value creation. The key metrics are OTIF/OSA, and value (cost/cash) by working end to end together with our customers.

This role will be accountable to partner with the internal interfaces as needed to be able to deliver and lead all the dimensions such as run, improve, and transform,

The successful candidate will lead and manage the market specific supply organization as well as be the custodian for process, people, and digital capabilities, and operationalizing all the learnings and insights. This role will dotted line report to the General Manager, with a key seat on their leadership team and will also work in close partnership with Supply Chain and Procurement as well as the Customers.

**You will be responsible for:**

* Lead, champion, and drive progress to win with our customers through customer engagement and customer collaboration, such as, and not limited to the following: Driving reliability: daily/weekly/monthly tracking and improvement of OTIF. Own and champion progress. Anticipate issues, own day-week-30-90-day plans and be intentional to win.
* Run the Market Logistics operation, at the right service (on time, in full, no error), cost (logistics cost per case), compliance. Partner with Commercial, Procurement and Supplier(s) to ensure the physical distribution network is customer centric and competitively fit for purpose in order to win in the market we operate.
* Serve as the key gatekeeper for Innovation and Brand Change projects, ensuring alignment with strategic objectives and quality standards.
* Leading the Supply Business Continuity Plan and represent Supply function in Risk Management Committee,
* Leading and coaching the in-market supply organization and the key sponsor for ensuring the IBP process within the market works to the right standards,
* Partner with rest of SC&P to deliver the market KPIs, customer needs, and win. The key interfaces are: Planning (Integrated Business Planning, Demand and Supply), Brand Change and Innovation and Third Party Manufacturing.

**The required qualifications for this role are:**

* Experience with direct operational accountability of delivery on outcomes in a market of a group of markets. Prior experience working in a multinational CPG / FMCG will be highly preferred.
* Proven track record working in a matrix organization partnering with senior business leadership teams and across multi level functions across the organization.
* Hands on engagement, especially in Modern Retail, with demonstrated success in improving customer service to industry leading levels, both as measured by the customer, as well as Advantage Survey,
* Hands-on logistics experience and multiple route to market experience
* Minimum 12 years’ experience working within progressive positions within the end-to-end Supply Chain function, within multiple disciplines. First hand planning experience in Customer Engagement, IBP, S&OP, S&OE, Demand Planning is crucial.
* BSc in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, Data Science/Statistics/Applied Mathematics, Economics. Additional MBA or MSc in Supply Chain Management or similar would be desirable.
* Leading change and innovation across the supply chain, through value driven collaborative partnership. Proven track record in designing, shaping, and implementing complex change agenda and transferring work from one location to another.
* Has developed and successfully implemented strategies and led cost saving initiatives
* Passion for data and performance culture. Very strong analytical skills.
* Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to foster and maintain strong working relationships and influence at all levels of the organization. At ease working effectively with a diverse group of stakeholders and business cultures.
* Team Leadership: Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, motivate and grow teams.
* Digital dexterity. Previous experience (and hunger to learn) on advanced planning tools, digital control towers, Power BI, etc.

**Working with Us**

Flexibility is key to success. From part-time and compressed hours to different locations our people work flexibly in ways to suit them. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you and we’ll work together so that you’re supported from day one.

We recognize and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this.

We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you’ll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you. You’ll be part of and help build and champion an inclusive culture that celebrates people of different gender, ethnicity, ability, age, sexual orientation, social class, educational backgrounds, experiences, mindsets, and more.

Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to the next level and build new ones as part of shaping the next generation of celebrations for consumers around the world.

Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you.

*If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.*

***Recruitment Scam Warning***

*Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we'll never ask for money.*

**Worker Type :**

Regular

Our Supply Chain and Manufacturing team are problem-solvers, sourcing, producing, and delivering our much-loved brands to delight customers around the globe. Over half of Diageo’s 30,000+ people work in Supply Chain and Manufacturing. It’s an intricate and sophisticated operation that’s the product of logistical, manufacturing, and technical collaborations.

Our teams in 100 sites in over 30 countries cover production facilities, supplier relationships, customer collaborations and third-party agreements. We’re committed to realizing our ‘Society 2030: Spirit of Progress’ goals, to protect the environment and support our farmers and suppliers. Whatever your skills and experience, we’ll help you to thrive in our inclusive culture.

**About this role**

The Customer Service Head is the face of Supply Chain and Procurement to our customers, General Manager and the Executive Team, our 3PLs, and other internal/external stakeholders. The CSM is part of the Market Executive Team, playing a key leadership role in bringing topline, bottom line, cash and organizational ambition of Diageo to life.

This role will be accountable to partner with the internal interfaces as needed to be able to deliver and lead all the dimensions such as run, improve, and transform,

* Experience with direct operational accountability of delivery on outcomes in a market of a group of markets. Prior experience working in a multinational CPG / FMCG will be highly preferred.

* Hands on engagement, especially in Modern Retail, with demonstrated success in improving customer service to industry leading levels, both as measured by the customer, as well as Advantage Survey,
* Hands-on logistics experience and multiple route to market experience
* Minimum 12 years’ experience working within progressive positions within the end-to-end Supply Chain function, within multiple disciplines. First hand planning experience in Customer Engagement, IBP, S&OP, S&OE, Demand Planning is crucial.

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this.

description:
**About The Team**
SPX Express Indonesia is building the next generation of operational systems for pickup, sortation, linehaul, last-mile delivery, and exception handling. You’ll build internal tools and automation that directly move real-world KPIs (SLA, throughput, cost per parcel, productivity) with heavy emphasis on AI implementation.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Build and ship internal web tools used daily by operations
* Own features end-to-end: discovery → design → implementation → rollout → measurement → iteration
* Integrate frontend, backend services, and data pipelines (APIs, events/queues, databases)
* Work closely with Product, Data Science, BI, and Ops to turn messy real-world problems into simple, reliable workflows
* Use automation and (when appropriate) AI/LLM capabilities to reduce manual work and improve decision-making — without sacrificing reliability

**Requirements**

* Solid programming fundamentals in any modern language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, Go, Python, etc.)
* Comfortable building web apps and APIs
* Practical engineering mindset: you can cut scope, ship v1, iterate, and avoid over-engineering
* Ownership and accountability: you debug, you measure, you improve
* Collaborative and user-focused: you care about what ops teams actually need, not just “building features.”
* React/Next.js (or similar frontend frameworks) and TypeScript experience
* Backend experience designing cloud-ready services using databases, queues, caching, etc
* Familiarity with CI/CD, cloud services, logging/metrics/tracing, feature flags
* General understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native principles (e.g. the twelve-factor app), including how services are deployed, scaled, and load-balanced in a containerized environment
* Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or strong interest in learning them

description:
Lowongan Kerja – Software Engineer

PT Altaver Teknologi membuka kesempatan bagi talenta terbaik untuk bergabung sebagai Software Engineer yang bersemangat dalam membangun solusi teknologi yang inovatif, berkualitas, dan berdampak bagi pelanggan.

Tanggung Jawab

Merancang mengembangkan, menguji, dan memelihara aplikasi berbasis web maupun mobile. - Menulis kode yang bersih, efisien, dan mudah dipelihara sesuai dengan standar pengembangan perangkat lunak. - Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product, UI/UX Designer, QA Engineer, dan stakeholder untuk menghasilkan solusi yang optimal. - Melakukan debugging, troubleshooting, dan optimasi performa aplikasi. - Berpartisipasi dalam code review serta menerapkan praktik pengembangan perangkat lunak yang baik. - Menyusun dokumentasi teknis terkait pengembangan aplikasi. - Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi dan memberikan rekomendasi implementasi teknologi terbaru yang relevan.

Kualifikasi

Minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.

Memilikipengalaman minimal 1–3 tahun sebagai Software Engineer (Fresh Graduate dengan portofolio yang kuat dipersilakan melamar).

Menguasai salah satu atau lebih bahasa pemrograman seperti Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, PHP, C#, atau Go. - Memahami framework modern seperti React, Angular, Vue.js, Laravel, Spring Boot, .NET, atau Node.js. - Memahami konsep RESTful API, Git, Database SQL/NoSQL, serta software development lifecycle (SDLC). - Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, komunikasi, dan kerja sama tim yang baik. - Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim dengan orientasi pada hasil.

Nilai Tambah

Memiliki pengalaman menggunakan Docker, Kubernetes, atau layanan cloud seperti AWS, Azure, atau Google Cloud. - Memahami praktik CI/CD dan Agile/Scrum. - Memiliki portofolio proyek atau kontribusi pada open-source menjadi nilai tambah.

Benefit

Gaji kompetitif sesuai pengalaman dan kompetensi. - Kesempatan pengembangan karier dan pelatihan profesional. - Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif dan inovatif. - BPJS Kesehatan & Ketenagakerjaan. - Cuti tahunan dan fasilitas kerja yang mendukung produktivitas.

LokasiKerja: Medan

Jenis Pekerjaan: Full Time

Bergabunglah bersama PT Altaver Teknologi dan jadilah bagian dari tim yang menciptakan solusi digital inovatif untuk masa depan.

Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu

Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

title: Senior Back End Engineer (Enterprise Efficiency) - Sea Labs
description:
**About The Team**
**About Sea Labs Indonesia**
Sea Labs is at the core of the Sea platforms development, supporting diverse business lines from e-commerce, supply chain, games, payment, and finance, among many others. The strong growth and unique positioning of Sea's e-commerce business, Shopee, spurred the launch of Sea Labs Indonesia. Since its inception, the group of passionate engineers has charted the course to drive the best experience for our users in Indonesia, many of which solutions are even adapted to other markets in the region.
  
  
Sea's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience world-class projects first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do. Together with our passionate and driven teams, you'll get to develop your skills, build on industry knowledge, and collaborate with global teams in a dynamic space. Browse our Sea Labs Indonesia team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.
  
  
**About Team**
The Enterprise Efficiency team is dedicated to transforming workplace productivity through seamless integration of enterprise communication, open platform capabilities, and management systems covering HR, finance, and operational tools. Our products power the daily workflows of thousands of employees across Sea group companies.
  
  
Our product lines include SeaTalk (enterprise communication and collaboration platform) and PFMS (people and financial management system). We are currently driving enterprise initiatives where we actively leverage AI-powered tools and LLM integrations to enhance product capabilities and accelerate engineering workflows.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Design and implement reliable, performant, and scalable backend systems.
* Write high-quality, clean, and maintainable code using engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, and QA teams across the full development lifecycle.
* Lead technical design discussions and produce thorough technical design documents.
* Conduct constructive code reviews that improve team-wide code quality.
* Integrate AI/LLM capabilities into backend services where applicable, including prompt engineering, API integration, and output handling.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
* Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability issues – then drive solutions.
* Communicate technical constraints and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of backend development experience (Java, Go, or Python preferred)
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design
* Proven ability to produce well-structured, maintainable, and testable code with minimal defects
* Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and caching layers (Redis)
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment best practices
* Able to perform thorough, constructive code reviews that improve team code quality
* Proficient in using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and documentation workflows
* General AI literacy – understands core AI/LLM concepts and can evaluate where AI capabilities can be practically applied to improve product features or engineering processes
* Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven architecture
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
* Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into backend services (e.g., prompt engineering, API integration, output parsing)

**Nice-to-Have Technical Skills**

* Experience building enterprise B2B or internal tooling products (e.g., ERP, communication platforms)
* Performance tuning and optimization experience at scale

title: Marketing & Social Commerce Strategist
description:
Are you passionate about turning data into real business growth? Do you want to combine statistical models, generative AI, and digital marketing strategy to scale brands? AnyMind is looking for a
**Marketing & Social Commerce Strategist (Research & Analytics Manager)**
who thrives in a fast-growing, tech-driven environment.
  
  
This role blends hands-on quantitative skills (regression, scripting, and LLMs) with commercial strategy (social commerce, performance marketing, and consumer insights)—perfect for a builder who loves solving complex problems.
  
  
What You Will Do as You Start the Role
  
  

* Develop a deep understanding of marketing models, including commerce and full-funnel activation.
* Translate business and marketing questions into structured, hypothesis-driven statistical analyses.
* Analyze multi-channel social commerce data across platforms to uncover performance trends.
* Run regression models (linear, multivariate, and log-linear) to calculate price elasticity of demand, media attribution, and marketing mix models (MMM) to understand growth drivers, ROI, and ROAS.
* Use LLMs, prompt engineering, and basic scripting (Python, SQL, or R) to automate data cleaning and run diagnostics.
* Stay up to date with emerging AI tools, advanced analytics frameworks, and digital marketing trends.

How Your Role Will Grow (Impact Over Time)
  
  

* Become a key insights partner to the Indonesia Marketing and Social Commerce teams, driving sales, retention, and business growth.
* Develop advanced analytical frameworks to measure adstock decay, media half-lives, and causal lift, helping guide business decisions.
* Build scalable analytics processes, AI-driven workflows, and automated marketing mix models (MMM) to elevate decision-making across Asia.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 2–3 years of experience in quantitative analytics, insights, marketing intelligence, database management, or related roles.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a solid foundation in statistics, including hypothesis testing, variance, correlation, and regression.
* Solid understanding of digital marketing and Southeast Asian e-commerce platforms (TikTok Shop, Shopee, and Lazada) and key metrics (ROAS, CAC, and CVR).
* Comfortable processing large, messy datasets from multiple social, media, and programmatic advertising sources.
* General familiarity with data science concepts, predictive modeling, and automated workflows.
* Hands-on familiarity with LLMs, prompt engineering, and using generative AI to streamline daily workflows.
* Basic scripting capability in Python, SQL, or R to clean, merge, and query databases.
* Curious, collaborative, and proactive—someone who thrives on making things happen.

Why Join AnyMind?
  
  

* Work with a fast-growing tech company across Asia.
* Gain exposure to cutting-edge AI, analytics, and marketing tools.
* Join a collaborative, global, and energetic team culture.
* Enjoy rapid career growth and cross-market opportunities.

Posted at 05:34h in Open Career by lucca
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**

* Research, develop, and deploy machine learning systems onto the Giuseppe platform for food science & technology applications.
* Brainstorm with Experimental Chefs & Food Scientists to find data and ML-driven solutions for problems arising with new product development. We develop products ranging from plant-based milks to plant-based meats, so there are always engaging challenges to solve.

* Read & implement recent ML papers that are relevant to our scope of work (e.g. implement a self-supervised algorithm proposed in a 2020 ICML paper).
* Dive into the domain of food science: be interested in learning about proteins, volatile molecules & the food industry in general.
* Contribute in general to department and organization projects.

**Requirements**

* BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field with a focus on machine learning
* 3+ years of working experience in an Applied Machine Learning group
* Strong background in software engineering, unit & functional testing (Python, unittest, nose)
* Strong data science analytical skills with a traditional data science and Deep Learning stack (Python, PyTorch, Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, Scikit-learn, Jupyter, Matplotlib, Hugging Face, LangChain, Polars, etc.)
* Prior experience with implementing & training Deep Learning models; prior experience with training models on cloud infrastructure on GPU/TPU
* Familiarity with model packaging & deployment (Docker, Kubernetes, Google Cloud Platform)
* In-depth knowledge in one or several of the following areas preferred: Representational Learning, Generative Models, Transformers, bandit algorithms & convex optimizers
* Authorization to work in the U.S. is required

description:
Job Description

**Account Manager**

**About Us:** Noventiq (Noventiq Holdings PLC) is a premier global provider of cutting-edge digital transformation and cybersecurity solutions, headquartered in London. We empower businesses to thrive in the digital age, connecting them with top-tier IT vendors and delivering our own innovative services and proprietary solutions.

**Why** **Noventiq****?** Our success is driven by a robust three-dimensional strategy focused on expanding our market presence, diversifying our product portfolio, and enhancing our sales channels. Through strategic M&A activities, we are poised to capitalize on industry consolidation and achieve unprecedented growth. With a dynamic team of approximately 6,400 employees operating in around 60 countries, we have a significant footprint in regions with immense growth potential, including Latin America, EMEA, APAC, and a notable presence in India.

**Your Opportunity:** Join a globally recognized organization, celebrated with multiple "Great Place to Work" awards. At Noventiq, your ideas matter. We foster an environment where innovation thrives and collaboration is a cornerstone. Be a part of our journey to drive digital transformation worldwide.

**Ready to Make an Impact?** If you're passionate about shaping the future of digital transformation and cybersecurity, we want you on our team. Join us and be a part of a global organization where your contributions are valued and your potential is limitless. Join us today!

**Job Title: Enterprise Account Manager**

**Location: Bangkok, Thailand**

**Department: Sales**

**Reporting to: Managing Director, Thailand & APAC Growth**

**About Noventiq**

Noventiq is a global digital transformation and cybersecurity solutions and services provider. We support organizations across industries in accelerating public cloud adoption, modernizing IT infrastructure, strengthening cybersecurity posture, and driving business transformation through cloud-native technologies.

We are looking for an **Enterprise Account Manager** to join our Sales team in Thailand. This role is responsible for developing and growing strategic enterprise accounts, building trusted relationships with business and technology leaders, and driving revenue and gross profit growth across Noventiq’s cloud, cybersecurity, managed services, and digital transformation portfolio.

**Job Overview**

The Enterprise Account Manager will be responsible for managing and expanding assigned enterprise accounts, identifying new cloud and transformation opportunities, leading complex sales engagements, and working closely with internal solution, technical, vendor, and partner teams to deliver business outcomes for customers.

The successful candidate should have strong enterprise sales experience in the IT industry, with a particular focus on **public cloud, cloud migration, cloud transformation, infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity, and managed services**. The candidate should also have experiences in engaging with large enterprises in Thailand.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute strategic account plans for assigned enterprise customers to achieve revenue, gross profit, and growth targets.

* Identify, qualify, and progress new opportunities across existing and new enterprise accounts, with focus on public cloud, cloud migration, infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity, managed services, professional services, and digital transformation solutions.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with C-level executives, IT leaders, procurement stakeholders, and key business decision-makers.

* Understand customers’ business priorities, current IT environments, cloud maturity, infrastructure challenges, security requirements, and transformation roadmap in order to position relevant Noventiq solutions and services.

* Lead end-to-end sales cycles, including opportunity qualification, cloud solution positioning, proposal development, commercial negotiation, closing, and post-sales follow-up.

* Work closely with solution architects, pre-sales consultants, cloud specialists, delivery teams, hyperscaler partners, and technology vendors to develop competitive and outcome-driven proposals.

* Manage bidding, RFP, RFQ, and tender processes where applicable, ensuring compliance with customer requirements, internal approval processes, pricing guidelines, and submission timelines.

* Collaborate with cloud hyperscalers and strategic partners to secure deal support, solution alignment, competitive pricing, funding programs, migration incentives, and joint go-to-market opportunities.

* Drive customer conversations around cloud migration, cloud modernization, cloud cost optimization, hybrid infrastructure, security, governance, and cloud transformation roadmap.

* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, account plans, and activity records in the company’s CRM system.

* Monitor market trends, customer demand, competitor activity, and cloud adoption patterns to identify new growth opportunities.

* Ensure timely coordination with internal teams for quotation, order processing, billing, delivery, collection, and customer satisfaction.

* Develop long-term customer relationships through regular account reviews, after-sales engagement, issue resolution, and continuous identification of upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

* Represent Noventiq professionally in customer meetings, partner engagements, cloud workshops, marketing events, and industry activities.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of enterprise sales experience in the IT industry, preferably in public cloud, cloud migration, cloud transformation, infrastructure modernization, cybersecurity, managed services, or systems integration.

* Proven track record of achieving sales targets, revenue growth, and gross profit objectives.

* Experience working with cloud hyperscalers such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, or other major cloud platforms is highly preferred.

* Experience selling or positioning cloud migration, cloud modernization, cloud managed services, cloud security, hybrid cloud, infrastructure transformation, or data platform solutions.

* Good understanding of enterprise IT environments, including on-premise infrastructure, public cloud, hybrid cloud, cybersecurity, data platforms, workplace productivity, and cloud governance.

* Experience managing complex enterprise accounts and engaging with CIO, CTO, CISO, procurement, and senior business stakeholders.

* Experience in managing the complete sales cycle, from lead qualification and opportunity creation to proposal, negotiation, closing, delivery coordination, and account expansion.

* Experience working with major technology vendors, cloud providers, distributors, and channel partners to drive joint opportunities.

* Experience in bidding, tender, or enterprise procurement processes is preferred.

* Strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and ability to manage pricing, margin, and deal structure.

* Good communication and presentation skills in both Thai and English.

* Self-driven, accountable, customer-focused, and able to work effectively with cross-functional and regional teams.

  

**What we offer**

* Working time: Monday-Friday, 9AM – 6PM

* Attractive Bonus, & Allowances for mobile, transportation, parking

* Opportunities to work with global colleagues from different cultures

* External and Internal Training Opportunities are sponsored by company

* Birthday paid day-off & Birthday gift

* Recognition program, Referral program

* Working device provided

* Other activities: annual company trip, year-end dinner, exciting engagement events, Coaching opportunities, etc.

* Annual Salary Review & Promotion

  

**Don’t forget to include your CV and cover letter. We receive a lot of applications, but we try to notice each of our potential candidates.**

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.
  
  
If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.
  
  
****The Role****
We are looking for mobile developers to build BJAK's AI Neobank App across Android and iOS.
  
  
This role is for strong mobile builders who can ship clean, reliable and intuitive mobile experiences, whether their main strength is Android, iOS or both.
  
  
****What You'll Own****

* Build and ship mobile features for Android and/or iOS.
* Create simple mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.
* Work with product, design and backend teams to turn complex journeys into usable mobile products.
* Integrate APIs and handle edge cases, loading states, errors and production issues.
* Improve app performance, reliability, crash rate and user experience.
* Support fast product launches, experiments and iterations across mobile journeys.
* Help set high standards for mobile product quality across the app.

****What We're Looking For****

* 3+ years of mobile development experience in Android, iOS or both.
* Strong experience with Kotlin and/or Swift.
* Experience shipping production apps used by real users.
* Strong product sense and attention to mobile UX.
* Able to work with APIs, analytics, crash logs and production feedback.
* Fast, practical and comfortable owning work with limited handholding.
* App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

****The Kind of Builder We Want****

* Thinks like a product builder, not just a mobile coder.
* Cares about smooth flows, small details and real user behaviour.
* Can work across ambiguity and ship without waiting for perfect specs.
* Takes production quality personally.
* Honest about what they built directly versus what the wider team delivered.

****This Role Is Not For****

* Developers who only want to build isolated screens.
* People who do not care about UX, performance or reliability.
* Candidates who cannot explain their own contribution clearly.
* People who need heavy guidance for every task.
* Engineers who move slowly in a high-growth environment.

****Location****
This role is remote, but candidates must be based in
**Indonesia**
. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in
**Indonesia.**
****Language****
English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.
  
  
****Interview Process****
Our process is designed to move fast:
  
  

* Online assessment or practical task
* Role-specific interview
* CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**24Slides**
is a leading presentation design company specializing in high-impact PowerPoint presentations. We are committed to creating a workplace that is diverse, equitable, and inclusive. We believe diversity drives innovation and success, and we strive to build an environment where every identity is valued. At 24Slides, we don't just celebrate differences—we make them central to our culture, ensuring everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive.
  
  
We’re looking for a Data Engineer to help design, build, and maintain reliable data pipelines with strong data quality. You will collaborate with the Software Engineering team on data architecture and work with Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, and dbt. This role requires 3+ years of Data Engineering experience, fluent English communication, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset.
**You can see the details below:**
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines
* Collaborate with the Software Engineer in Data Architecture Planning,
* Develop, construct, and maintain large-scale data processing systems that can scale as data volume grows,
* Implement Data Quality & Observability.

**Requirements:**

* Experience: 3+ years in Data Engineering.
* Tech Stack: Strong Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, and Data transformation (dbt).
* Data Contracts: Proven ability to negotiate and manage data contracts between Dev and Analytics teams.
* Soft Skills: Problem-solver with a proactive mindset, strong data empathy, and fluent English communication.

**Application & Recruitment Process:**
Please submit your application as soon as possible. Our recruitment process is designed to be thorough and transparent, consisting of five key stages: an initial screening, a technical test to evaluate your automation skills, a psychological test, an English test, an HR interview, a user interview, and a final interview with the user team. We look forward to reviewing your application and potentially welcoming you to the team!
  
  
**Benefits:**

* Salary & Insurances: Enjoy a competitive salary with additional incentives, plus comprehensive health coverage, including BPJS and private insurance.
* Global & Flexible Work Culture: Gain international experience in a multinational environment with a global team, a fun office vibe, casual attire, and a flexible hybrid working model.
* Continuous Growth & Development: We invest in your future through professional training, clear career progression paths, and dedicated personal growth programs.
* Holistic Well-being: We prioritize your happiness and mental health with access to psychological counseling, annual leave that increases with tenure, plus situational leave, and engaging "experience programs" (non-work activities).
* Operational Support: Get the tools you need to succeed with the provided working devices.

description:
**Locations**: Bangkok | Jakarta | Kuala Lumpur

Who We Are

At Inverto, we specialize in strategic procurement and supply chain management. We work globally with market-leading companies, developing transformational strategies and implementing them to make their businesses stronger. And you can too – with our continued success, this is your chance to grow as we grow. Our teams want to succeed – and you’ll be in great company, working with people and in a business that supports you to thrive. There’s never been a better time to join us as we develop and build our future together. Are you in?

Boston Consulting Group (BCG) is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. Our success depends on a spirit of deep collaboration and a global community of diverse individuals determined to make the world and each other better every day.

BCG’s INVERTO practice focuses on strategic procurement and supply chain management. We are one of the top names for strategic procurement and supply chain management. As a part of BCG, we offer the best of both worlds: in-depth expertise and high strategic competence with a draw on a strong, international infrastructure, which makes us even more dynamic in the market. Our values form the basis for our actions. They sum up what it means to be INVERTO, our own beliefs and standards, to which we are fully committed: We create value, grow as one, pioneer with expertise, take care of people and planet, do what’s right, and we are fueled by fun. That is why we want to strengthen our team with someone that matches our ambitions as well as our spirit. We are INVERTO.

At BCG, we bring together the right people to conquer complexity, drive material change, and initiate positive, long-term impact. Explore our [2] BCG Culture and Values for more information.

References

Visible links

1. https://www.bcg.com/

2. https://careers.bcg.com/bcg-culture

What You'll Do

Inverto is seeking a Data & Insights expert to join our Southeast Asia (SEA) team as Consultant, Senior Consultant or Project Manager. In this role, you will:

* Apply data, digital tools, and AI methods to support consulting projects across Southeast Asia - transforming raw data into meaningful insights, building intuitive dashboards and self-service reports, and developing prototypes that help teams and clients make smarter decisions.
* Use modern technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Azure, Python, and GenAI to automate processes, and improve operational efficiency.
* Contribute to a diverse and fast-growing regional team by exploring emerging technologies, sharing knowledge, and strengthening Inverto’s digital and AI capabilities across Southeast Asia.

What You'll Bring

* 5-10 years of relevant experience in procurement, supply chain, operations, consulting, or digital/analytics roles. Experience in the consulting industry is a strong advantage.
* Degree in economics, business informatics, engineering, or a related field, ideally with a focus on data, analytics, or digital technologies.
* Strong technical skills with a hands-on mindset, including high proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform—especially Power BI, DAX, and Power Query—and practical experience with Python and Azure-based data solutions.
* Confidence in building smart, scalable analytics tools, combined with the ability to translate business needs into impactful solutions.
* Curiosity for GenAI and intelligent automation, with a results-oriented mindset focused on delivering high-quality outcomes and measurable value.
* A grounded, collaborative team player, bringing authenticity, fairness, and positivity to the team culture.
* Flexibility and mobility to support projects across industries and locations within Southeast Asia.
* Fluency in English; proficiency in one or more Southeast Asian languages is a benefit.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Frontend Developer (React)
description:
**About Us**
launch.ist is a development agency that builds production software. Specialist agents handle the volume and the verification; named engineers review, sign, and own what ships. We build production-grade from the start — correct architecture, tests, CI/CD, and isolated infrastructure from day one — across web and AI products.
  
  
Who We’re Looking For
  
  
We’re seeking a Junior+/Middle level Frontend Developer with React experience who can help build and maintain high-quality web applications. We value attention to detail, clean code, and the ability to work in a collaborative environment.
  
  
Tech Stack
  
  

* Frontend: React (TS), Zustand, FSD, Next.js
* Backend: Go, Python (existing Node.js projects too)
* API: REST, GraphQL, gRPC
* Platform: containers, isolated Kubernetes, GitOps
* Workflow: agent-assisted development with human review and sign-off

Your Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop new and maintain existing web applications
* Write clean, maintainable code following FSD principles
* Work on projects with video integration and AI components
* Participate in code reviews and collaborative problem-solving
* Refactor and optimize existing code
* Work alongside the agent-assisted workflow, with your work reviewed and signed before it ships

**Requirements**

* 1+ years of commercial experience with React
* Strong knowledge of TypeScript
* Experience with Zustand (or other state managers)
* Understanding of Feature-Sliced Design (FSD) principles
* Proficiency in HTML/CSS and responsive design
* English language proficiency (B2+ level)
* Docker experience is a plus

We Offer
  
  

* Remote work, Monday to Friday
* Competitive salary (discussed individually)
* Long-term collaboration
* Professional growth opportunities
* Work with a small, senior team
* Interesting international projects

Our Team
  
  
We’re a small, senior team working remotely. Everyone reviews each other’s work and solves hard problems together, with the technical director providing direction and support.
  
  
How to Apply
  
  
Please send your resume, GitHub profile, or portfolio examples to careers@launch.ist with the subject “Frontend Developer - [Your Name]”.
  
  
We read every application and will get back to you.
