title: Cybersecurity Consultant
description:
At ABeam Consulting, you will be a part of the next digital revolution.  
ABeam's success is created from the contributions of each of our valued employees. At ABeam, you are not just a number! Our employees work together with all tiers of the organization. Through our collective efforts, we provide optimal opportunities for growth and development with a balanced work/life objective. Each day you will be presented with a series of challenges that will position you for your personal growth and professional advancement.  
If this exciting vision feels right for you, we invite you to apply.  
  
**Job Summary**  
Cybersecurity Consultant serves as a trusted advisor to clients seeking cybersecurity, information security, AI governance, data governance, privacy, risk management, cloud security, and digital transformation services.  
The consultant is expected to possess broad foundational knowledge across multiple domains and be capable of understanding client needs, identifying opportunities, recommending suitable solutions, supporting project delivery, and coordinating with subject matter experts to implement successful engagements.  
This role combines consulting, presales, assessment, project delivery, and business development responsibilities.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
**Client Advisory & Presales**

* Meet clients to understand business objectives, challenges, risks, and compliance requirements.
* Conduct interviews, workshops, discovery sessions, and requirement gathering activities.
* Identify client pain points and recommend suitable consulting and technology solutions.
* Prepare proposals, solution blueprints, statements of work (SOW), and presentation materials.
* Support RFP, RFQ, tender, and proposal activities.
* Present cybersecurity and digital transformation solutions to business and technical stakeholders.

**Consulting & Project Delivery**

* Participate in cybersecurity, governance, privacy, data governance, AI governance, cloud security, and digital transformation projects.
* Support project delivery as Consultant, PMO, Business Analyst, Project Coordinator, or Junior Consultant.
* Develop project deliverables including assessment reports, policies, procedures, governance documents, and management presentations.
* Coordinate project activities between clients, consultants, auditors, and technology partners.
* Support implementation, testing, and operationalization of security solutions and governance frameworks.

  
**Security Assessments & Audit Support**

* Conduct cybersecurity assessments, maturity assessments, gap analyses, self-assessments, readiness assessments, and pre-audits.
* Participate in VAPT, cloud security reviews, OT security assessments, risk assessments, and compliance reviews.
* Assist clients in preparing for certification audits and regulatory assessments.
* Support lead consultants and auditors by coordinating interviews, collecting evidence, documenting findings, and tracking corrective actions.

  
**Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* Support implementation of governance and compliance frameworks including:  
  ISO 27001 (ISMS)  
  ISO 27701 (PIMS)  
  ISO 42001 (AIMS)  
  ISO 22301 (BCMS)  
  ISO 20000 (ITSMS)  
  NIST CSF  
  COBIT  
  GDPR / PDPA
* Assist clients in risk assessments, governance initiatives, policy development, and continuous improvement activities.

  
**Knowledge Development**

* Continuously develop knowledge in cybersecurity, AI governance, data governance, privacy, cloud computing, and digital transformation.
* Maintain relevant industry certifications and stay updated with emerging technologies, threats, and best practices.

  
**Requirements**

* + Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or related disciplines.
* 2–7 years of experience in cybersecurity, information security, governance, risk management, audit, consulting, cloud computing, digital transformation, or related fields.
* Broad understanding of cybersecurity, privacy, risk management, cloud computing, AI governance, and data governance concepts.
* Strong communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and report writing capabilities.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

  
**Additional**  
**Preferred Certifications**

* ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
* CompTIA Security+
* EC-Council Ethical Hacking Essentials (EHE)
* ISO 27001 Foundation / Requirements
* GDPR Foundation
* COBIT Foundation
* TOGAF Foundation
* CDMP Foundation
* AWS Cloud Practitioner
* Microsoft AZ-900
* Microsoft AI-900

**Preferred Knowledge Areas**

* VAPT
* ISMS / PIMS / AIMS / BCMS / ITSMS
* AI Governance & Data Governance
* Cloud Security
* Risk Management
* SIEM / SOC / CSIRT
* ASM & Vulnerability Management
* IAM, MFA & SSO
* CSPM, CASB, SASE & ZTNA
* DevSecOps & AISecOps
* Digital Forensics & Incident Response
* Anti-Malware, Anti-Ransomware, Anti-Phishing & BEC Protection
* Operational Technology (OT) Security
* IT Due Diligence (ITDD)

title: Trade Compliance Analyst
description:
Overview:

For over 35 years, OSI Electronics has provided Manufacturing Solutions of the highest quality, reliability, and customer support. We specialize in customized Manufacturing Solutions with the portfolio of services, capabilities, and factory locations needed to provide our customers with a competitive advantage in the global marketplace.

OSI Electronics offers turnkey solutions for the full range of assembly complexity. We partner with Customers on Product Development, New Product Introduction, Mass Production, Sustaining Engineering and Product Lifecycle Management. Our cutting edge technology, manufacturing proficiency and responsive technical services deliver the Tier One capabilities Customers require.

Responsibilities:

Responsible for providing analytical and administrative support for the Trade Compliance Program and ensuring the business stays compliant with international trade regulations, including export and import controls, customs laws, and sanctions

* Support the Senior Trade Compliance and Automation Manager and the Trade Compliance team in various activities and projects.
* Administer and maintain the Trade Compliance policies, procedures, and forms to ensure the company’s compliance with import / export laws and regulations and best practices.
* Prepare, submit, and maintain applicable U.S., APAC region, and other country Government authorizations as needed.
* Screen, review, and resolve restricted and denied party screening transactions using a third-party screening tool
* Administer and maintain records of Trade Compliance transactions including: data entry, organizing and saving documents, and closeout of documents in the system to adhere to regulatory and company Record Keeping requirements.
* Review, action, and evaluate accuracy for the following transactions: visitor requests, sales orders, end user statements, export shipments and documentation, international transactions, open jobs reports, export-controlled positions, and other Trade Compliance transactions as needed.
* Coordinate with HR and applicable management to maintain Technology Control Plans for sites and employees
* Evaluate product information to determine the jurisdiction and classification and tariff classification of items, data, and software based on U.S., APAC region, and other country regulations
* Coordinate with global sites to ensure that transfers of items, data, and software comply with U.S., APAC region, and applicable country export laws and regulations and company policies and procedures
* Support various automation projects and initiatives, such as: visitor management system, automated denied party screening, ERP system, CRM system, export shipments system, and others as needed
* Provide training to applicable employees, update and maintain training materials and records, and coordinate with Document Control and designees at applicable sites to save the training records
* Coordinate with internal customers and respond to inquiries related to Trade Compliance matters at U.S., APAC region, and global sites
* Conduct assessments of Trade Compliance activity and assist in applicable audits, assessments, and investigations
* Uphold the company’s core values of Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork
* Demonstrate behavior consistent with the company’s Code of Ethics and Conduct.
* It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem

Qualifications:

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field highly desired.
* Experience in a manufacturing environment with a focus on Trade Compliance desired.
* Knowledge of U.S. Trade Regulations (e.g., ITAR, EAR, OFAC, Customs) and APAC region trade regulations strongly desired.
* Experience interfacing with Government agencies (e.g., DOS, DOC, Customs, MITI, MTI, Ministry of Trade, etc.) desired.
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office Suite required. Microsoft Dynamics 365 and CoPilot preferred.
* Familiarity with OCR EASE or similar denied party screening tool a plus.
* Must possess strong analytical and organizational skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential.
* Must be detail-oriented, self-motivated, and adaptable to a dynamic work environment.
* Ability to work with minimal supervision required.
* Excellent time management skills and ability to multi-task and prioritize work required.
* Must be able to read, write, and communicate effectively in the business language (English).

title: Hybrid BI & Azure Data Engineer
description:
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.

Key Responsibilities:

Hybrid BI Engineer / Data Engineer / Azure Reporting Developer profile with skills as Software Developer

Development & Maintenance

* Application Maintenance
  + Design, develop, and maintain SQL-based applications & data pipelines (SSIS, Azure, SQL data Engine, SSAS)
  + Optimize Power BI reports and dashboards for performance and scalability.
  + Implement C#/Visual Basic solutions for automation and integration.
* Infrastructure Maintenance
  + Monitoring the services availability and performances
  + Resolving services interruptions or failures
  + Management of the configuration of the application, of the security and user’s habilitation

Collaboration & Agile Practices

* Work in a Scrum team (Jira, Agile methodology) with Product Owners and Scrum Masters.
* Participate in code reviews (GitLab) and sprint planning.

Technical Support & Troubleshooting

* Monitor unattended executions (daily pipelines) and resolve issues.
* Ensure data accuracy across Azure Infrastructure and ITSM tools.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing

* Update technical documentation for TIGRE architecture and workflows.
* Train team members on new features or tools (e.g., DAX, Azure).

Requirements

Technical Skills:

* Strong proficiency in SQL and relational database development.
* Hands-on experience with SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
* Strong experience with SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services).
* Experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of data modeling and database optimization.
* Experience with Visual Studio development environment.
* Experience with DAX development and advanced Power BI analytics.
* Experience with C# or Visual Basic development.
* Experience using GitLab for source control and CI/CD activities.
* Knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems.

Nice to Have

* Familiarity with ITSM platforms and service management processes.

Soft Skills

* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to work in a collaborative, Agile environment.
* Excellent communication (English required; French a plus) and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Continuous learning mindset and willingness to work across multiple technologies.

Education/Experience

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field.
* 3+ years in software development (SQL, Power BI, Azure), data engineering, business intelligence, or a related role.
* Experience with ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira) is a plus.
* Experience working with enterprise-scale reporting and analytics solutions.
* Experience supporting production applications and operational platforms.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.
* Experience working in multinational organizations, collaborating effectively with colleagues from diverse cultural backgrounds, due to the nature of the work English is mandatory for daily business communication.

Why Join Thales?

* Work on a critical monitoring system for Thales Global Services.
* Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team (Devs, Product Owners, Scrum Masters).
* Access to cutting-edge tools (Azure, Power BI, GitLab).

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Site Reliability Engineer - Service Assurance Systems
description:
About us:

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What you'll do:

The Service Assurance Systems (SAS) Group, part of Global Operations, develop and maintain many software systems and applications which support the operation of Viasat services.

The team collects assurance and operational data from a wide range of systems across the Viasat estate. This data is shared between internal platforms and distributed through Google Cloud Platform (GCP), where it underpins observability and monitoring capabilities that give operations teams real-time insight into service health and performance. To ensure the data is accurate and fit for purpose, the team builds and maintains data pipelines that cleanse, transform and enrich raw data, making it readily consumable by our stakeholders across operations, engineering and management.

As a Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you will play a key role in bridging the gap between software development and operational reliability. You will be responsible for supporting the applications built and maintained by the SAS group, managing deployments, investigating operational issues, and driving the team’s transition toward a modern DevOps culture. You will act as a first point of contact for service issues raised through the ServiceNow ticketing system, working to diagnose, triage and resolve incidents efficiently while collaborating closely with developers and operations teams.

The day-to-day:

You will be working as part of a small team of developers and operations engineers, supporting the evolution of Viasat’s network and service monitoring capabilities, ensuring it remains world class in support of existing and future services.

Day-to-day the role will involve:

  

* Investigate and resolve incidents, service requests and problems raised through the ServiceNow ticketing system, ensuring timely and thorough resolution within agreed SLAs.
* Manage and oversee application deployments across development, staging and production environments, ensuring smooth and reliable release processes.
* Monitor application and infrastructure health using observability tools such as Prometheus and AWS CloudWatch; proactively identify and respond to anomalies and performance degradation.
* Own and maintain CI/CD pipelines, working to improve build, test and deployment automation to reduce manual effort and increase release confidence.
* Champion and drive the adoption of DevOps practices and culture within the SAS group, working towards greater automation, infrastructure-as-code, and operational maturity.
* Manage and maintain containerised workloads using Docker, and support the operation of services hosted on AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Write and maintain operational scripts (primarily Python) to automate routine tasks, support incident investigations and improve team efficiency.
* Collaborate with software developers to identify recurring operational issues and feed findings back into the development process to improve application resilience.
* Maintain clear and up-to-date operational documentation including runbooks, deployment guides and incident post-mortems.
* Provide written and verbal progress updates on open incidents, deployments and operational improvements to the SAS group and wider stakeholders.
* Support on-call and out-of-hours incident response as required.
* Liaise with engineering and infrastructure teams to ensure system changes are communicated and operationally risk-assessed before deployment.

What you'll need:

* Familiarity with both Windows and Linux operating systems, including command-line administration and troubleshooting.
* Demonstrable experience with SQL or data pipeline technologies.
* Experience with data processing frameworks such as Apache Airflow, Apache Flink or Google Dataflow, with a practical understanding of ETL pipeline design and the ability to diagnose issues across data transformation and scheduling workflows.
* Demonstrable CI/CD experience — building, maintaining and improving pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions or equivalent.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g. EC2, S3, ECS, Lambda, CloudWatch) and containerisation using Docker.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, including Prometheus and AWS CloudWatch, for metrics collection, alerting and dashboarding.
* Proficiency in scripting with Python for automation, tooling and operational support tasks.
* Strong communication skills — able to clearly articulate technical issues and their impact to both technical and non-technical audiences, and to provide timely updates on incident progress.
* Experience using an ITSM/ticketing system (e.g. ServiceNow) for incident management, request fulfilment and problem tracking.
* A proactive, solution-oriented approach with strong attention to detail and a commitment to operational excellence.
* A reasonable understanding and appreciation of IT and security standard methodologies in an operational environment.

What will help you on the job:

* Understanding of TCP/IP networking principles, including the ability to diagnose connectivity issues and interpret network traffic.
* Familiarity with event streaming platforms such as Apache Kafka, including an understanding of producer/consumer patterns and how message queues are used to move data reliably between systems at scale.
* Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Ansible.
* Experience with log aggregation and analysis platforms such as the OTEL Stack or AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights.
* Exposure to Kubernetes or other container orchestration platforms.
* Experience working in an Agile or DevOps team environment.

EEO statement:

Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. * Define the migration strategy and scope, including data objects, mapping and cleansing rules, reconciliation controls, mock migrations, cutover sequence, rollback criteria, acceptance and post-migration validation.
* Gather requirements and prepare functional specifications, process flows, configuration documents, user stories, test artefacts, issue logs, operating procedures and training materials.
* Coordinate business, operations, technology, vendors and payment networks; manage status, risks, issues, decisions and knowledge transfer. Manager candidates will lead workstreams and coach team members.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**
==========================================

* Bachelor's Degree or higher in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance or a related discipline.
* 5–12 years of relevant experience in banking, cards, payments, transaction banking, fintech, payment processing or financial-services technology.
* Hands-on experience with CMS/CMP, debit/credit card issuing, card migration and payment-system integration.
* Strong knowledge of the card issuing and transaction lifecycles, including authorisation, clearing, settlement, reconciliation, reversals, adjustments, disputes and chargebacks.
* Experience with Visa/Mastercard and Rintis/Alto/Jalin/Artajasa, with familiarity in SNAP and BI-FAST.
* Hands-on experience in a PCI-DSS-compliant system or cardholder-data environment.
* Experience with Fraud Detection / Fraud Management systems, including transaction monitoring, rules, alerts, cases and investigation workflows.
* Working knowledge of ISO 8583 and ISO 20022; familiarity with SWIFT and RTGS.
* Strong business analysis, structured problem-solving, stakeholder management, communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred experience**
========================

* Prior experience in one or more delivery roles: Project Manager, Solution Architect, Business Analyst, or Quality Assurance / Test Lead.
* Card scheme or payment-network certification; issuer, acquirer, switch, payment hub, settlement or reconciliation-engine implementation.
* Experience with recognised card platforms such as HPS PowerCARD, OpenWay Way4, VisionPLUS, PRIME, TSYS, FIS, Fiserv, Compass Plus or comparable solutions.
* Experience leading workshops and workstreams in complex, multi-vendor delivery environments.

**Success profile**
===================

A credible functional consultant who combines deep cards and payments knowledge with disciplined solution design and delivery. The candidate should connect business, operations, technology, vendors and payment networks, while maintaining clear requirements, controls, traceability and acceptance evidence.

  

EY values diversity, collaboration, integrity and a commitment to building a better working world.
  
Candidates who meet **more than 1 criterias above** are encouraged to apply.

description:
**Overview**

As a Digital Enterprise Security Sales Specialist, you will play a pivotal role in empowering customers through the unique value of the Microsoft Cloud. You’ll drive day‑to‑day execution of strategic business priorities, sell best‑in‑class cloud security solutions, and accelerate digital transformation for customers, partners, and Microsoft.

In Digital Sales, we operate as a globally led, digital‑first organization. Your strong sales skills, understanding of enterprise needs, and ability to build trusted customer relationships will help achieve sales targets. You’ll collaborate across teams while contributing to our Digital Enterprise Sales Culture priorities: **Diversity & Inclusivity, Wellbeing, Sustainability, and Customer Obsession.**

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We work with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and build a culture of inclusion grounded in respect, integrity, and accountability.

Has a deep understanding of customers' business and its priorities to drive conversations with customers on digital transformation across multiple solution areas, in collaboration with partners and services. Collaborates with account teams, partners, or services to track, qualify, and expand new opportunities. Identifies, develops, proposes, and articulates solutions that align with customer needs. Contributes input and coaches team members on strategies to drive and close prioritized opportunities. Collaborates with partners to cross-sell, up-sell, and co-sell. Applies the orchestration model to proactively drive deal closure by identifying and aligning internal stakeholders and leveraging and expanding relationships with partners. Proactively provides analysis of the competitive landscape in supported solution area and decides to pursue or withdrawal. Contributes to exploring business and emerging opportunities to optimize the portfolio and support customer innovation. Manages and/or orchestrates sales and delivery success through the account team and pursuit team. Engages with internal and external stakeholders on business planning, rhythm-of-business (ROB) meetings to review and plan for assigned accounts. Collaborates with internal teams and partners to conduct business analysis to pursue high-potential customers and develop a target list of potential business. Manages the end-to-end business of the assigned territory.

 **Responsibilities**

**Role Summary**

* Develop a fundamental understanding of customer business needs to initiate security‑focused digital transformation conversations.
* Work with account teams, partners, and services to track, qualify, and expand new opportunities.
* Identify, propose, and articulate security solutions aligned with customer goals.
* Support deal strategy and closure through structured orchestration across teams.
* Research competitors and collaborate with Global Black Belts (GBBs) on competitive positioning.
* Participate in rhythm‑of‑business (ROB) processes to plan and execute for assigned accounts and territory.
* Conduct business analysis to identify high‑potential customers and build targeted account lists.

**What You’ll Champion**

* **Passion for Security:** Enhance enterprise security capabilities across identity, compliance, and AI‑driven automation.
* **Safeguard Digital Ecosystems:** Advocate for a Zero Trust mindset and help organizations secure their environments.
* **AI‑Driven Security:** Help customers understand how AI and automation can elevate their security posture.

  
**Qualifications**

**Sales Excellence**

* Manage the end-to-end security business for assigned Majors Growth territory, including forecasting and territory planning.
* Use customer insights and industry knowledge to explore emerging opportunities and support innovation.
* Participate in ROB meetings for account planning.
* Review feedback reports and coach others to improve customer/partner satisfaction.
* Drive sales and delivery excellence through collaboration with account and pursuit teams.

**Additional Expectations:**

* Initiate security conversations with business decision makers; act as a subject matter expert on competitive insights.
* Collaborate with partners and internal resources on compete plans, forecasting, and targeting high‑potential customers.
* Model Microsoft culture priorities: Diversity & Inclusivity, Wellbeing, Sustainability, Giving, and Learning.
* Demonstrate continuous learning in cybersecurity.

**Sales Execution**

* Identify customer business needs and technical readiness; collaborate across teams to propose prioritized solutions.
* Engage external stakeholders and implement strategies to accelerate and close security opportunities.
* Hunt new opportunities by understanding customer business priorities, governance, and budget processes.
* Build and execute close plans to ensure predictable deal closure.
* Lead Level‑200 customer conversations on digital transformation in the security solution area.
* Map customer decision makers and influencers; participate in strategic communications with account teams.
* Drive security solution consumption through demos, quotes, partner collaboration, and blocker removal.
* Scale opportunities by collaborating with account teams, partners, and EPS (Enterprise Partner Solutions).
* Apply Microsoft’s sales process (MSP) to assess and qualify opportunities.

**Required / Minimum**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, or related field **AND** 5+ years of cloud technology‑related specialist sales/presales or deep account management experience  
  **OR** 6+ years of technology‑related sales or account management experience.
* Demonstrated individual quota‑carrying experience.

**Preferred**

* Security solution sales experience.
* Microsoft Cloud or Security certifications.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

description:
Commerce ops
  
  
Strategic Programs & AI Transformation Manager - Indonesia - GBS
  
  
**Location :**  
Jakarta Selatan
  
  
**Employment Type :**  
Regular
  
  
**Job Code :**  
A255938
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
TikTok's Global Business Solutions (GBS) regional sales and advertising teams drive revenue growth by promoting our advertising solutions, onboarding clients, and running campaigns that deliver measurable results. Client needs, market trends, and performance expectations shift constantly, and differently in every market. We build strategy accordingly, turning those moving pieces into advertising solutions that work and client partnerships that last. You will help businesses grow on a global platform, working on the campaigns and relationships that turn advertisers into long-term partners. Responsibilities: We are looking for a Strategic Programs & AI Transformation Manager to support GBS Indonesia. This role will partner with business leaders to set priorities, solve complex commercial problems, and lead cross-functional initiatives. The role will also identify and implement AI and automation opportunities across GBS workflows. - Lead business performance reviews and planning, OKR setting, forecasting, and for GBS Indonesia. - Manage the rhythm of the business, including weekly, monthly, and quarterly reviews. Develop clear narratives and recommendations for local, regional, and global leadership. - Analyze revenue, advertiser behavior, campaign performance, product adoption, sales pipelines, TikTok Shop, and productivity data to identify growth opportunities and performance gaps. - Break down ambiguous business problems, identify root causes, and translate findings into specific recommendations and execution plans. - Lead high-priority initiatives across Sales, Client Solutions, Agency Partnerships, Product, Marketing Science, Data, and Operations. - Build business cases and evaluate the expected revenue, productivity, cost, and client impact of proposed initiatives. - Map business workflows and identify opportunities for AI, automation, data products, or process improvement. - Develop and manage the AI transformation roadmap for GBS Indonesia, prioritizing use cases based on business value, user needs, data readiness, technical feasibility, cost, and risk. - Translate business requirements into workflows, data requirements, test cases, and acceptance criteria for Product, Engineering, Data Science, and BI teams. - Lead AI and automation projects from initial problem definition through pilot, testing, rollout, adoption, and post-launch improvement. - Define evaluation frameworks covering output accuracy, completeness, user acceptance, human review, adoption, and business impact. - Use pilots, baselines, control groups, or A/B testing to assess whether proposed solutions improve business performance. - Build reporting frameworks to track project status, dependencies, risks, investment, adoption, and results. - Investigate projects with weak results or adoption and determine whether to improve, redesign, or stop them. - Document successful approaches and develop repeatable playbooks, training materials, and operating processes.
  
  
Qualifications
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications:** - Five or more years of experience in business strategy, management consulting, strategy and operations, business analytics, AI implementation, digital transformation, technical program management, or a related field. - Experience leading cross-functional projects from problem definition through implementation and outcome measurement. - Strong business analysis skills with a hands-on approach to data; proficiency in SQL and spreadsheets. Familiarity with Python, APIs, prompt design, AI evaluation tools, data-visualization tools, or low-code automation platforms. - Experience building forecasts, opportunity assessments, financial models, or business cases. - Experience translating business problems into structured workstreams and clear requirements for business and technical teams. - Working knowledge of generative AI, large language models, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or workflow automation. - Professional proficiency in English. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex analysis and recommendations to senior leaders. Preferred Qualifications: - Experience in digital advertising, e-commerce, marketplaces, consumer technology, or another platform business. - Experience implementing AI, machine-learning, automation, or data solutions in a production business environment. - Understanding of advertising products, client segmentation, product adoption, sales pipelines, campaign measurement, or TikTok Shop operations. - Experience working with responsible-AI teams on the review of AI solutions. - Experience working with regional or global stakeholders.
  
  
Job Information
  
  
About TikTok
  
  
TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​
  
  
Why Join Us
  
  
Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day. ​
  
  
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​
  
  
​
  
  
Diversity & Inclusion ​
  
  
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

title: 【GLUE事業部】 開発リーダー候補（モバイルアプリ開発）
description:
当社は1994年創業のソフトウェアメーカーです。
  
  
法人に必要な3領域「セキュリティ・営業支援・業務効率化」で、
  
  
自社開発のパッケージソフトウェアとソリューションを提供しています。
  
  

* ネットワークソリューション事業 IT資産管理、クライアントPCの運用管理とセキュリティ対策
* セールスDXソリューション事業 名刺管理・SFA・MA・見込み客発掘まで一体で提供する営業支援DX
* AIデータエントリーソリューション事業 帳票エントリー業務の効率化

*概要*
ホットプロファイルは「営業を強くし売上を上げる。」をミッションに、名刺管理、営業支援（SFA）、マーケティング、新規開拓（企業DB）といった4領域の機能を開発・提供する営業支援SaaSです。2024年4月に新規上場し、2026年以降はSFA機能の大幅強化を順次リリースする計画を発表するなど、プロダクトへの投資を加速しています。
  
  
募集背景
  
  
ホットプロファイルのモバイル利用ユーザーは年々増加しており、モバイルアプリの開発は事業成長に重要な役割を担っています。
  
  
ユーザー数の増加と機能強化の加速にあわせて、製品企画と開発現場をつなぎ、モバイルアプリチームの開発サイクルを牽引していただく開発リーダーを募集することとなりました。
  
  
規模を拡大してもスピードと品質を失わない開発体制を、リーダーとして一緒につくっていただける方をお迎えしたいと考えています。
  
  
*サービスについて*
*担当製品「ホットプロファイル」*
ホットプロファイルは、名刺管理、営業支援（SFA）、マーケティングオートメーション（MA）を一つのプラットフォームで提供し、営業活動を強化するサービスです。最新のAI技術を搭載し、営業データの分析と提案を自動化することで、営業の生産性を向上させます。
  
  

* 営業支援SaaS『 ホットプロファイル 』 https://www.hammock.jp/hpr/
* AI機能について https://www.hammock.jp/hpr/landing/202506cm.html

*競合他社に対する優位性*
ホットプロファイルは名刺管理、SFA、MA、新規開拓という4つの分野を一つのプラットフォームで提供できることが他社にはない強みになります。4つの分野を統合的に活用できることで複数のシステムを併用する必要がなくなり、コストを抑えたシームレスな運用を実現できます。比較サイト「ITreview」では名刺管理ソフト部門にて「ITreview Grid Award」を6期連続で受賞しており、業界内で高い評価を得ています 。現在では、ビックカメラ、IHI、三菱重工、商工中金などの多くの企業が導入しています。
  
  
*技術的な面白さと醍醐味*
*非構造化データの構造化と、複雑なドメイン統合*
名刺（画像）・商談音声（非構造化データ）・Web行動履歴（ログ）という異質なデータを、SFAの商談プロセス（構造化データ）とリアルタイムに紐づける難易度の高いDB設計が求められます。
  
  
単なるCRUDではなく、「多角的なデータをビジネスインサイトに変換するパイプライン」を構築するデータエンジニアリング的要素にも関わることができます。
  
  
*RAG/LLMの「社会実装」への挑戦*
ユーザーが日常的に使う業務フローの中に、LLMやRAG（検索拡張生成）を用いた「AI議事録」「提案書解析」などの機能を本番実装しています。自分のコードが日本の営業現場の生産性を直接変える手応えがあります。
  
  
*開発組織について*
現在 ホットプロファイルの開発部には、エンジニア、QAエンジニア、SREが50名ほど在籍しています。上記以外に事業部にはプロダクトマネージャー、デザイナーが在籍しており、Eng/PdM/デザイナー/QAが1チームとなって開発を進めるスクラム型開発スタイルを取り入れています。
  
  
*チームの特徴*
開発エンジニアは20代後半～30代がボリュームゾーンです。
  
  
開発フローはスクラムを採用しており、それに準じたタイムスパンで業務をおこなっています。
  
  
また、開発外では社内勉強会、ワークショップ、情報共有用チャット等でノウハウ共有やコミュニケーションの活性化を図っています。
  
  
本ポジションでは、モバイルアプリ開発チームリーダーとして、メンバー・パートナー企業メンバーで構成される～10名程度のチームをお任せします。
  
  
*働き方*
エンジニアチームは、基本はリモートメインで「深い集中（Deep Work）」を確保し、必要に合わせ出社し直接顔を合わせて意見交換やコラボレーションを行う機会を大切にしています。この取り組みにより、リモートワークとオフィス出社の良さを組み合わせた柔軟な働き方を実現しています。
  
  
※入社直後は、キャッチアップ・開発環境の把握の為、1～2カ月程度出社を想定しています。
  
  
※状況に応じてチームの出社頻度を変更する場合があります。
  
  
*担当業務*
本ポジションではモバイルアプリ開発チームのリーダーとして、正社員・パートナー企業メンバーで構成される～10名程度のチームをお任せします。
  
  
*業務詳細*
・製品企画と連携した新機能の要件定義、プロジェクト計画の立案
  
  
・基本設計、詳細設計、実装、単体テスト
  
  
・10名程度のチームの開発サイクルのマネジメント
  
  
（進捗・品質・課題管理、設計レビュー・コードレビュー、メンバー育成、パートナー企業メンバーのディレクションを含む）
  
  
*【重点テーマ例】*
・モバイルアプリの機能強化や品質向上、および新規機能開発
  
  
・生成AIを活用した機能の開発や改善
  
  
・生成AIツールを活用した開発プロセスの推進・改善
  
  
*開発環境*
開発言語：C＃、Flutter
  
  
環境：Linux、Windows、Amazon Web Service
  
  
フレームワーク：jQuery、AWS Lambda
  
  
データベース：MySQL、DynamoDB
  
  
プロジェクト管理：Backlog、Git
  
  
生成AIツール：Cursor、Claude、Devin
  
  
情報共有ツール：Teams、SharePoint
  
  
*応募条件*
*【必須条件（MUST）】*
・モバイルアプリ開発経験、またはWEBサービスのバックエンド開発の経験（どちらか3年以上）
  
  
・数名規模のチームマネジメント経験（2年以上）
  
  
*【歓迎条件 （WANT）】*
・Flutter 開発実務経験
  
  
・C#開発実務経験
  
  
・DB（My SQL）の設計、実装の実務経験
  
  
・SaaS製品の開発のご経験
  
  
・生成AIを利用した開発経験
  
  
・AWSの知見
  
  
*求める人物像*
・新しい機能の開発を積極的に推進できる方
  
  
・要件定義を丁寧にやり切り、製品企画と開発の橋渡しができる方
  
  
・開発チームをまとめ、目標達成に導く高いコミュニケーション能力とリーダーシップを発揮できる方
  
  
*この仕事で得られる経験、魅力*
・複数ドメイン（名刺管理・SFA・MAなど）にまたがる複雑な設計課題に、1プロダクトで触れられる
  
  
・LLM/RAGを本番実装するプロダクトで、生成AI活用を前提とした開発マネジメントの経験を積める
  
  
・エンジニアリングマネージャー、プロダクトマネージャー等へつながるマネジメントキャリアの起点になる
  
  
0→1フェーズやグロース後の安定運用フェーズにはない、設計者としての深みが積める環境です。
  
  
*働く環境*
*技術スキルアップ*
勉強会、外部研修、書籍購入制度、資格取得合格報奨金制度やオフィス図書館などの積極的な活用
  
  
*キャリアパス*
テックリード、エンジニアリングマネージャー、プレイングマネージャー、プロダクトマネージャー、CTOなど、多様なキャリアパスを用意
  
  
*フラットな組織*
役職に関係なく、意見交換や議論が活発に行われる心理的安全性の高い環境
  
  
*ワークライフバランス*
フレックスタイム制、リモートワーク制度など、柔軟な働き方を支援

title: Cybersecurity Engineer (Infrastructure Security)
description:
**Blibli is on a journey to become Indonesia’s #1 e-commerce platform**
— built on trust, innovation, and care. We’re creating better experiences for customers, merchants, brands, and sellers through technology, collaboration, and a deep commitment to quality. Here, every idea matters and every action helps us grow stronger together.
  
  
As a
**Cybersecurity Engineer (Infrastructure Security)**
, you will play a critical role in securing and enabling our e-commerce platform by designing, implementing, and continuously improving cloud and infrastructure security controls. This role focuses on protecting customer trust, ensuring business continuity, supporting compliance requirements such as PCI DSS and ISO 27001, and embedding security into engineering processes so that teams can ship products quickly and securely without compromising risk management.
  
  
**What You'll Work On Together**

* Design, implement, and maintain cloud security architectures across AWS, GCP, or Azure environments.
* Develop and enforce secure infrastructure patterns, including IAM least-privilege models, network segmentation, encryption, and audit logging.
* Perform cloud security posture assessments and remediate infrastructure misconfigurations identified through CSPM tools.
* Conduct threat modeling exercises (e.g., STRIDE) for new products, services, and major platform changes.
* Implement and maintain CIS Benchmark-based hardening standards across Linux servers, Kubernetes clusters, databases, containers, and cloud environments.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Platform, SRE, and Product teams to integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure workflows.
* Build and maintain security automation solutions using Python, Go, Bash, or similar technologies.
* Develop Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) security controls and policy-as-code implementations for Terraform and CloudFormation environments.
* Design and improve Kubernetes security controls, including RBAC, admission controls, network policies, image security, and workload protection.
* Support identity and access management initiatives, including SSO, SAML, OIDC, privileged access management, service accounts, secrets management, and key rotation.
* Produce technical compliance evidence and support PCI DSS, ISO/IEC 27001:2022, internal audit, and external audit activities.
* Perform third-party and vendor security assessments to identify and mitigate infrastructure-related risks.
* Implement and maintain infrastructure monitoring, logging, audit trails, and security observability capabilities.
* Respond to infrastructure security incidents, vulnerabilities, and escalations as part of the on-call rotation.
* Partner with development teams to improve security by design and shift security controls earlier into the software development lifecycle.
* Continuously evaluate emerging threats, technologies, and industry best practices to strengthen the organization's security posture.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree (S1) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Informatics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, or related technical disciplines.
* 3–5 years of experience in Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security, Security Engineering, Security Architecture, Platform Security, DevSecOps, or related fields.
* Proven hands-on experience managing and securing production infrastructure environments.
* Experience supporting engineering teams through shared platform and security services.
* Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia with working proficiency in English for technical documentation, cloud advisories, audit frameworks, and vendor communications.
* Required Technical Skills: AWS, GCP, Microsoft Azure, Linux OS, Python & Golang.
* Preferred Technical Skills: Kubernetes, IaC, Identity & Access Management.

**Why You’ll Love Working Here**
At our company, cybersecurity is not a gatekeeper function, it's a business enabler. You'll work directly with engineering teams to protect revenue, customer trust, payment operations, and platform availability while helping the business scale securely. If you're passionate about cloud security, automation, infrastructure engineering, and solving complex challenges in a fast-moving e-commerce environment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Manager - Deals Strategy & Operations
description:
**Line of Service**

Advisory

**Industry/Sector**

Not Applicable

**Specialism**

Deal Strategy

**Management Level**

Manager

**Job Description & Summary**

A career in our Deals Strategy and Operation practice, within Deals Transaction Services, will provide you with the opportunity to help the team build, develop, manage and run strategic capacity which will undoubtedly benefit both PwC and our clients. As an indispensable part of the team, you will cooperate with other business units to boost strategic capacity in the team and stay close connection with clients to better meet their demands. In short, you are expected to strengthen the bond and establish mutual understanding between PwC and our clients through releasing every team members’ potential abilities and generating remarkable business value for the clients.

**Job Description & Summary**

  

*PwC Indonesia is an inclusive and equal-opportunity employer that does not discriminate based on physical disabilities, gender, race, religion, or age. Your application will be treated fairly and assessed solely based on job requirements and competencies.*

  

Deals Strategy and Operations (DS&O), part of Deals Transaction Services at PwC Indonesia, helps clients make and execute their most important strategic and transactional decisions, from market entry, investments and partnerships to acquisitions and value creation after the deal. We combine hypothesis-driven strategy work with commercial and financial rigour. As an indispensable part of the team, you will cooperate with other PwC business units to build strategic capacity, stay close to clients to meet their needs, and release the potential of every team member, strengthening the bond and mutual understanding between PwC and our clients and generating remarkable business value for them. Our team can deliver work under either the PwC Deals Strategy & Operations or the Strategy& Deals brand, depending on the client's needs and the delivery team's specifications.

To really stand out and make us fit for the future in a constantly changing world, each and every one of us at PwC needs to be a purpose-led and values-driven leader at every level. To help us achieve this we have the PwC Professional; our global leadership development framework. It gives us a single set of expectations across our lines, geographies and career paths, and provides transparency on the skills we need as individuals to be successful and progress in our careers, now and in the future.

As a Manager, you'll work as part of a team of problem solvers, helping to solve complex business issues from strategy to execution. PwC Professional skills and responsibilities for this management level include but are not limited to:

* Encourage everyone to have a voice and invite opinion from all, including quieter members of the team.

* Deal effectively with ambiguous and unstructured problems and situations.

* Initiate open and candid coaching conversations at all levels.

* Move easily between big picture thinking and managing relevant detail.

* Anticipate stakeholder needs, and develop and discuss potential solutions, even before the stakeholder realises they are required.

* Contribute technical knowledge in area of specialism.

* Contribute to an environment where people and technology thrive together to accomplish more than they could apart.

* Navigate the complexities of cross-border and/or diverse teams and engagements.

* Initiate and lead open conversations with teams, clients and stakeholders to build trust.

Uphold the firm's code of ethics and business conduct.  

  

**What You'll Do**

* **Deal strategy delivery:** deliver deal strategy engagements such as commercial and strategic due diligence, market entry strategy, option analysis, investment evaluation and business planning.

* **Project management:** manage one or multiple projects at the same time, owning each project's scope, workplan, timeline, budget and deliverable quality.

* **Problem solving:** frame the client's key questions, formulate hypotheses, direct the research and synthesise the findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

* **Analytical rigour:** oversee the quantitative and financial analysis of client, competitor and market data, and challenge the underlying assumptions and models.

* **Team leadership:** assign and balance workstreams across Associates and Senior Associates, set direction, review their work and coach them to grow.

* **Bridge to leadership:** act as the link between the engagement team (Associates and Senior Associates, who run the individual workstreams) and leadership (Senior Managers, Directors and Partners). Translate leadership's direction into clear workplans, and escalate workstream findings, risks and issues early, with a recommended way forward.

* **Client relationships:** act as the day-to-day point of contact and a trusted advisor to client executives, managing their expectations, ensuring their satisfaction and building long-term relationships.

* **Network collaboration:** work with other PwC business units and the global PwC network to bring the right expertise to each engagement.

* **Business development:** act as a content lead on proposals by shaping scope, approach and fees, and support Senior Managers, Directors and Partners in winning new work.

* **Practice development:** contribute to the growth of the DS&O practice through knowledge sharing, thought leadership and recruitment.

Requirements

* **Education:** a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Management, Finance, Economics, Engineering (Electrical, Chemical or Industrial) or a related field from a top-10 university in Indonesia or a top-100 university globally, with minimum recent GPA of 3.20 out of 4.00 or comparable;

* A Master's degree is an advantage

* Graduating cum laude or with distinction is an advantage

* **Experience:** a minimum of 6 years of professional experience in consulting / investment bank / corporate strategic planning (or a minimum of 4 years for candidates from a Top 3 management consulting firm), of which:

* At least 2 years must be in consulting

* The consulting experience must be recent, i.e. the most recent consulting role ended no more than 2 years ago or is ongoing

description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves.

Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: *We Before Me*, *Do the Right Thing*, and *Get Things Done*. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

We are looking for an experienced, commercially aware, and regulatory-savvy compliance professional to join us as Head of Compliance and Money Laundering Reporting Officer (MLRO).

The role will be instrumental in building the compliance programme from the ground up, and embedding a culture of compliance across the organisation.

Broader team management responsibilities will be added in due course for regulatory strategy, operational execution, and governance.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

### **Regulatory Engagement**

* Serve as the primary point of contact with relevant regulatory bodies.
* Ensure the organisation meets all applicable governance requirements, including fit and proper obligations for Approved and Designated Persons.
* Monitor and interpret regulatory developments relevant to virtual assets, and advise senior management and the Board accordingly.

### **Compliance Programme Development & Management**

* Design, implement, and maintain a comprehensive compliance framework aligned with local requirements, FATF recommendations, and international best practice for virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
* Develop, review, and update all internal policies and procedures covering AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD), transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, data protection, cybersecurity compliance, and safeguarding of client assets.
* Establish and oversee the compliance monitoring programme, including periodic testing, gap analysis, and reporting to senior management and the Board.
* Prepare and present regular compliance reports to the Board and relevant committees, including on regulatory changes, compliance breaches, and remediation progress.
* Ensure compliance considerations are integrated into new product design and operations from the inception phase by driving solutions that balance commercial outcomes and innovation, while maintaining a robust compliance posture using a clear risk-based approach.
* Review technical documentation, user journeys, and product flows to ensure compliance risks are addressed; provide clear, actionable and solution-focused advice during the product lifecycle.
* Build and scale compliance policies governing advertising, social media campaigns, influencer partnerships, and product launches.
* Partner with Legal, Product, and Marketing teams to operationalize a timely review process for client-facing assets and go-to-market materials.

### **AML/CFT & MLRO Duties**

* Act as the designated MLRO, with full statutory responsibility for overseeing the organisation's AML/CFT framework.
* Receive, review, and assess all internal Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) from staff, and make informed decisions on whether to file external disclosures with competent local authorities.
* Oversee and continuously improve the transaction monitoring programme, with support from global compliance and product functions.
* Ensure robust sanctions screening against all applicable lists, including OFAC, UK OFSI, UN, EU, and applicable local sanctions designations.
* Oversee customer risk scoring, risk-based KYC/CDD processes, and enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and customers from high-risk jurisdictions.

### **Governance & Culture**

* Act as a key member of the senior leadership team, providing compliance input on new products, services, partnerships, and business initiatives.
* Champion a strong compliance culture across the organisation through training, communications, and leadership by example.
* Design and deliver AML/CFT and compliance training programmes for all staff, ensuring completion records are maintained.
* Ensure that the organisation's compliance obligations are adequately resourced, and advise the Board on staffing, systems, and budget requirements.
* Establish and maintain a compliance manual, risk register and oversee the escalation and resolution of compliance incidents and breaches.

### **Reporting & Recordkeeping**

* Prepare and submit all required regulatory reports and notifications to relevant authorities within stipulated deadlines.
* Ensure that all compliance records, SAR documentation, KYC files, and transaction monitoring records are maintained in accordance with applicable retention requirements.
* Support and facilitate any inspections, supervisory visits, or regulatory examinations.

**What We Look For In You**
---------------------------

* ### **Qualifications**

  + Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business, or a related field. A postgraduate qualification is advantageous.
  + Professional certification in compliance or AML is strongly preferred (e.g. CAMS, ICA Certificate/Diploma in AML or Compliance, CFE, or equivalent).

  ### **Experience**

  + Minimum of 8 years of experience in compliance, AML, or financial crime prevention, with at least 3 years in a senior or leadership compliance role.
  + Demonstrated in-house experience working within virtual asset service providers (VASPs), cryptocurrency exchanges, fintech firms, or regulated financial institutions.
  + Prior experience as an MLRO or Deputy MLRO is highly desirable.
  + Experience engaging directly with financial regulators and the financial intelligence unit
  + Hands-on experience building compliance programmes from the ground up in a start-up or scaling environment is a significant advantage.
  + Familiarity with the regional regulatory framework and requirements is strongly preferred.

  ### **Knowledge & Skills**

  + Deep understanding of FATF Recommendations and their application to virtual asset service providers, including the Travel Rule (FATF Recommendation 16)
  + Strong knowledge of crypto-specific AML typologies.
  + Proficiency with blockchain analytics and transaction monitoring tools (e.g. Chainalysis, Elliptic, TRM Labs, or equivalent).
  + Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
  + Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify and articulate complex risk scenarios clearly.
  + Demonstrated ability to engage constructively with regulators, external auditors, and law enforcement.
  + High degree of personal integrity and sound professional judgment.

**Nice to Haves**
-----------------

* + Experience in cryptocurrency or blockchain compliance programs.
  + Experience working in a multi-national financial institution setting.
  + Familiarity with compliance technology and analytics tools.
  + Prior exposure to multi-jurisdictional compliance oversight.
  + In-depth knowledge of crypto products, including spot trading, derivatives, staking, lending/borrowing, DeFi, and stablecoins.

**Additional Notes**
--------------------

This role will be subject to fit and proper assessment as part of the licensing process. Candidates must be prepared to undergo background checks, provide regulatory questionnaires, CVs, references, and proof of relevant qualifications. Prior enforcement history, regulatory sanctions, or unexplained gaps in professional record may affect eligibility.

**Perks &** **Benefits**
------------------------

* Competitive total compensation package
* L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
* Various team building programs and company event
* More that we love to tell you along the process!

Notice:  

All official OKX vacancies are published on this website. While roles may appear on selected third-party platforms from time to time, information on other sites may be inaccurate or outdated. **If in doubt, please apply directly through our official careers website.**

Information collected and processed as part of the recruitment process of any job application you choose to submit is subject to OKX's Candidate Privacy Notice.

**Job Description :**  
The Software Development Team Lead will guide a team of developers in designing, building, and delivering high-quality, scalable software solutions. This role blends hands-on technical contribution with leadership responsibilities, ensuring projects meet quality standards and are completed on time. You’ll work closely with product owners, architects, and DevOps engineers to deliver modern web and mobile applications using JavaScript-based frameworks and cloud technologies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead and mentor a team of developers through the full software development lifecycle - from planning and implementation to deployment and maintenance.
* Plan, prioritize, and assign tasks to ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
* Participate in technical design discussions and contribute to hands-on development when needed.
* Conduct code reviews, ensure adherence to best practices, and maintain coding standards across the team.
* Collaborate closely with UI/UX, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure smooth integration and release processes.
* Foster a culture of ownership, teamwork, and continuous improvement within the development team.
* Encourage the use of modern frameworks, reusable components, and clean coding principles to enhance system scalability and maintainability.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies and frameworks relevant to JavaScript and cloud-native development.
* Support the implementation of CI/CD pipelines and agile methodologies to improve efficiency and delivery quality.
* Coach and guide developers to help them grow technically and professionally

**Job Requirements:**

* Experience: 4–6 years in software development, with at least 1–2 years in a team or technical lead capacity.
* Strong proficiency in .Net Core and/or JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as Node.js, React.js, Vue.js, or Next.js.
* Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, and integration architecture.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as Alicloud, AWS, or Azure is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience with Git, CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and modern development workflows.
* Familiarity with agile methodologies (Scrum or Kanban).
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills with strong attention to detail.
* Strong communication and leadership skills with the ability to guide and motivate a team.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time, including internationally, when required.

**Why join us?**

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment.
* Access to the latest tools and technologies.
* Flexible work arrangements and remote work options.

Application Question(s):

* When will you be available to start work?
* What is your last drawn salary in IDR?
* What is your expected salary in IDR and other job expectations for your new job?

Experience:

* Software development: 5 years (Preferred)
* Team lead: 3 years (Preferred)

Willingness to travel:

* 25% (Preferred)

Work Location: Remote

description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

Support operational excellence and digital transformation initiatives through process improvement, data analysis, project coordination, and digital tool deployment. Interns may be assigned to either the **Kaizen Support** or **Digitization Support** track based on business needs and individual profiles.

**What will you do:**

* Assist in process mapping, data collection, analysis, and improvement initiatives.
* Support Kaizen activities, including workshop preparation, documentation, and action tracking.
* Assist in the deployment and adoption of digital tools across business functions.
* Monitor project milestones, user adoption, and KPI performance.
* Prepare reports, dashboards, presentations, SOPs, and project documentation.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to support implementation and follow-up activities.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Interested? Send your CV to:  
**hrd@quadteknologi.com**  
Subject: Data Scientist – [Your Name]

**Job Summary**

Data Scientist bertanggung jawab mengolah dan menganalisis data serta mengembangkan solusi **Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, dan Predictive Analytics** untuk kebutuhan internal maupun customer.

Bekerja sama dengan Data Engineer, AI/ML Engineer, Software Engineer, Presales, dan Project Manager dalam menerjemahkan business problem menjadi solusi berbasis data dan AI.

**Responsibilities**

* Melakukan data collection, cleaning, preprocessing, EDA, feature engineering, dan statistical analysis.
* Mengembangkan dan mengevaluasi model **Machine Learning** untuk classification, regression, clustering, forecasting, recommendation, dan anomaly detection.
* Melakukan model selection, validation, hyperparameter tuning, dan performance evaluation.
* Mengembangkan solusi **AI/Generative AI/LLM**, termasuk chatbot, RAG, document intelligence, intelligent search, text classification, dan summarization.
* Melakukan data visualization dan menyampaikan insight serta rekomendasi kepada stakeholder.
* Berkolaborasi dalam proses **model deployment, API integration, Docker/containerization, dan ML lifecycle**.
* Terlibat dalam requirement gathering, customer workshop, POC, dan prototype development.
* Membuat dokumentasi dataset, preprocessing, model, eksperimen, evaluasi, dan technical methodology.
* Menggunakan version control dan menerapkan best practice dalam pengembangan model dan code.

**Requirements**

* Minimal **S1** Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Informatics, Computer Engineering, Physics, Industrial Engineering, atau bidang terkait.
* **8–10 tahun pengalaman** sebagai Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, Data Analyst, atau posisi terkait.
* Berpengalaman mengerjakan project **AI/Data untuk enterprise atau customer** menjadi nilai tambah.
* Menguasai **Python dan SQL** serta library seperti Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, Matplotlib, dan Seaborn.
* Memahami Machine Learning, Statistics, Feature Engineering, Model Evaluation, Cross Validation, dan Hyperparameter Tuning.
* Memahami database seperti PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, atau MongoDB.
* Memiliki analytical thinking, problem solving, communication, dan presentation skills yang baik.
* Mampu menerjemahkan **business problem menjadi data/AI solution** dan menjelaskan hasil teknis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

**Preferred Skills**

Pengalaman dengan salah satu atau beberapa teknologi berikut menjadi nilai tambah:

* **Deep Learning:** PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras
* **Generative AI/LLM:** OpenAI, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Mistral
* **RAG & Vector Database:** Milvus, Qdrant, Weaviate, Elasticsearch, FAISS, pgvector
* **Big Data:** Spark, Hadoop, Databricks
* **Visualization:** Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Streamlit, Plotly
* **Cloud:** AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Alibaba Cloud
* **MLOps:** MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Git, CI/CD, Model Monitoring

**Ideal Candidate**

Kami mencari Data Scientist yang tidak hanya mampu membangun model, tetapi juga memahami proses:

**Business Problem → Data → Analysis → Model → Evaluation → Deployment → Business Impact**

Memiliki ketertarikan terhadap **Machine Learning, Generative AI, LLM, RAG, AI Agent, Document Intelligence, dan Enterprise AI**.

Work Location: In person

description:
**Overview**

Synthesizes business insights and orchestrates global teams across the organization to deliver alternative solutions while applying deep expertise and thought leadership. Acts as a "virtual Chief Technical Officer" to provide Account Thought leadership, leverage deep knowledge of Microsoft's solutions, industry, and customer needs, and acts as the voice of the customer, industry, and team. Leads technology strategy formulation by leading alignment of customer needs and technology solutions, execution of technology strategy/digital transformation, creation of mid- to long-term technical roadmaps, and translation of customer business objectives. Develops and drives opportunities, presents opportunities to the customer, and creates demand. Coaches peers on how to create and maintain an opportunity initiation and how to map Microsoft priorities to opportunities. Leads digital transformation using corporate and cross-industry resources, and partners with line-of-business leader or senior executive to articulate the benefits of Microsoft technology over competitor solutions. Helps customer technical specialists sell Microsoft offerings. Maps technical customer requirements and business scenarios to Microsoft technology platforms. Orchestrates necessary teams and partners to ensure demand generation and establishes best practices for account planning. Delivers regular industry/technology briefings to customer technology senior decision-makers technical teams. Uses readiness resources and demonstrates expertise in creating enablement plans.

 **Responsibilities**

description:
We're looking for an HR Systems & Reporting specialist to join our team. This role is crucial in optimizing our HR systems and leveraging HR data to provide actionable insights that support strategic decision-making. The specialist will be responsible for HR process optimisation, HRIS management, HR data governance and identifying trends to drive HR initiatives and improve organizational effectiveness.

**About The Job :**

**HRIS Management & Optimization:**

* Serve as the HRIS system administrator focusing on system configuration, maintenance, and overall system health
* Lead efforts to optimize HRIS modules and functionalities to enhance user experience, automate processes, and ensure data integrity
* Collaborate with HR and IT stakeholders to identify business requirements and translate them into technical specifications for system improvements
* Manage HRIS projects, including system upgrades, new module implementations, and integrations with other enterprise tools

**Data & Reporting:**

* Conduct regular data audits as required and ensure data is maintained as per data regulatory requirements
* Establish and enforce data governance standards to ensure the accuracy and consistency of HR data across all systems
* Design, develop, and maintain HR reports and dashboards using various HRIS tools and business intelligence platforms
* Perform in-depth data analysis to identify HR trends and translate complex data findings into clear and actionable recommendations for HR and business stakeholders

**About You :**

* 2 - 4 years of experience working in an HRIS role
* Demonstrated expertise in administering and optimizing enterprise-level HRIS platforms
* Prior experience with Darwinbox system migration and configuration
* Prior experience with RDBMS and API integrations will be considered an advantage
* Experience with Project Management tools and documentation (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Asana, etc.)
* Experience with creating reports and dashboards using HRIS Tools or other business intelligence software (e.g. Tableau, PowerBI, Python, etc)
* Strong business process orientation and problem solving skills
* Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work well in teams and independently
* Strong ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, prioritize tasks, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment
* Good communication skills in both English and Indonesian (Written & Verbal)
* Capacity to apply discretion and maintain a high level of confidentiality when handling sensitive information

**Cloud Solution Architect** provides a unique opportunity to enable transformational change in customer journey to the cloud. CSA works with account managers for high-value enterprises in the market, and lead migration assessment, readiness and deal technical strategy.

**What you’ll do:**

* Design cloud-based solutions Design cloud architecture and complete plans and specifications to develop solutions
* Collaborate with product managers and engineers to develop specifications for new cloud-based products/services, applications and solutions
* Drive the roll-out of cloud management platforms, evaluate its performance and implements enhancements
* Designs and develops IT architecture (integrated process, applications, data and technology) solutions to business problems in alignment with the enterprise architecture direction and standards
* Develops specifications for new products/services, applications and service offerings
* Assesses the compatibility and integration of products/services proposed as standards to ensure an integrated architecture across interdependent technologies
* Migrate and modernize applications to Azure
  

  

**Profile requirements:**

* Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet, Terraforms, etc..
* Experience with relational, graph and/or unstructured data technologies such as SQL Server, Azure SQL, Azure Data
* Lake, HD Insights, Hadoop, Cloudera, MongoDB, MySQL, Neo4j, Cassandra, Couchbase
* Software development full life-cycle methodologies, patterns, frameworks, libraries and tools
* Knowledge of programming and scripting languages such as JavaScript, PowerShell, Bash, SQL, .NET, Java, Python, PHP, Ruby, PERL, C++, etc.
* Experience with machine learning tools such as Azure ML, AWS, Google, etc.
* Experience in distilling complex technical challenges to actionable decisions for stakeholders and guiding project teams by building consensus and mediating compromises when necessary.
* Experience coordinating the intersection of complex system dependencies and interactions
* Experience in solution delivery using Agile methodologies.
* Demonstrated knowledge of relevant industry trends and standards
  

  

**Preferable skills:**

* 3+ years design/implementation/consulting experience of distributed applications.
* Experience in leading data center or cloud migration projects.
* Breadth of experience across the Enterprise IT in multiple of the following areas: Infrastructure architecture; Database architecture; IP Networking; IT Security; Data Center Operations; Software design or development.
* Breadth of expertise in private and public Cloud Computing, technologies and architectural best practices.
* Expert level technical acumen, including the ability to understand the customer IT landscape, identify opportunities and overcome any technical obstacles, ultimately influencing the adoption of cloud platform in conjunction with business requirements.
* Strong presentation and written communication skills; high degree of comfort with technical and Executive audiences.

Blibli is accelerating its transformation into a data-driven digital ecosystem where analytics, machine learning, and technology play a critical role in driving business growth. **Data Scientist**
is responsible for identifying business opportunities, translating complex problems into analytical solutions, and developing machine learning models that create measurable business impact. This role works closely with Product, Commercial, Supply Chain, and Technology teams to deliver data-driven insights and scalable solutions across areas such as revenue optimization, personalization, pricing, and operational efficiency. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with business acumen, enabling them to not only build models but also understand the reasoning behind business decisions and drive tangible outcomes.

* Develop and maintain machine learning models to solve business problems across Revenue Intelligence, Supply Chain, and Personalization.
* Analyze large datasets and generate actionable insights to support business growth.

* Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into data-driven solutions.
* Work closely with Data Engineers and ML Engineers to support model deployment and automation.

* Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science ( preferred ), Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or related quantitative fields.
* Minimum 2-3 years of experience in Data Science or Machine Learning.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL .
* Experience building machine learning models end-to-end.
* Familiar with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
