title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Job Highlights :**

* Build and maintain automated testing solutions for web, mobile and API platforms
* Work on challenging projects across fintech, travel, hospitality and consumer applications
* Gain hands-on experience with automation frameworks, CI/CD pipelines and modern QA practices
* Grow your technical skills and advance your career in quality engineering

**Job Description :**

We are looking for a hands-on **QA Automation Engineer** to improve the quality, reliability and release confidence of our web, mobile and backend applications.

This role is primarily focused on **automated testing**. You will design, develop and maintain reusable automation frameworks and test scripts covering UI, API, integration and regression testing. You will also perform manual and exploratory testing where automation is not practical.

The ideal candidate has practical experience writing automation scripts, integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, analysing failures and working closely with development teams to prevent defects throughout the software development lifecycle.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Test Automation Development

* Design, develop and maintain automated test frameworks for web, mobile and API applications.
* Create reusable, maintainable and reliable automated test scripts.
* Automate functional, regression, smoke, integration and end-to-end test scenarios.
* Review existing manual test cases and identify suitable candidates for automation.
* Maintain test data, test environments and reusable automation components.
* Investigate failed automated tests and distinguish application defects from script or environment issues.

2. Web and Mobile Application Testing

* Automate web application testing using tools such as **Selenium, Cypress or Playwright**.
* Automate mobile application testing using **Maestro, Appium, Espresso, XCUITest or equivalent frameworks**.
* Develop and maintain **Maestro test flows** for critical user journeys, smoke testing, regression testing and end-to-end testing across iOS and Android applications.
* Validate application behaviour across supported browsers, devices, screen sizes and operating systems.
* Perform manual and exploratory testing for complex scenarios that cannot be effectively automated.

3. API and Backend Testing

* Develop automated API tests using tools or frameworks such as **Postman/Newman, REST Assured or equivalent**.
* Validate API requests, responses, authentication, business rules and error handling.
* Perform database queries to verify data integrity and backend processing.
* Test integrations between mobile applications, web applications, APIs and external systems.

4. CI/CD and Continuous Testing

* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines.
* Work with developers and DevOps engineers to execute automated tests during builds, deployments and scheduled regression runs.
* Monitor automation results and provide clear reporting on test coverage, failures and release risks.
* Improve execution speed, stability and reliability of automated test suites.

5. Test Planning and Quality Assurance

* Review business requirements, user stories and technical specifications to identify test scenarios.
* Prepare and maintain test plans, test cases, test scripts and traceability records.
* Conduct functional, regression, integration, usability and compatibility testing.
* Support SIT, UAT, release validation and post-deployment verification.
* Contribute to performance testing using tools such as **JMeter, k6, Gatling or LoadRunner**, where required.

6. Defect Management and Collaboration

* Identify, document and track defects with clear reproduction steps, evidence, severity and business impact.
* Work closely with developers, business analysts, project managers and DevOps engineers to resolve issues.
* Participate in Agile activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups and retrospectives.
* Promote early testing and quality ownership throughout the development lifecycle.
* Recommend improvements to test processes, automation coverage and release quality.

**Requirements:**

* Hands-on experience with mobile application test automation using **Maestro, Appium or an equivalent framework**.
* Practical experience building and maintaining automated test scripts—not only executing scripts created by others.
* Hands-on experience with at least one web automation framework, such as **Selenium, Cypress or Playwright**.
* Experience with API testing and automation using **Postman/Newman, REST Assured or equivalent tools**.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming or scripting language, such as **Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Python or C#**.
* Experience with source control tools such as **Git**.
* Understanding of automation design practices, including reusable test flows, data-driven testing, test reporting and failure handling.

**Preferred Qualifications :**

* Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining **Maestro test flows for Flutter, iOS or Android applications**.
* Experience integrating Maestro or other automated test suites with **Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or another CI/CD platform**.
* Experience running mobile automated tests on physical devices, emulators, simulators or cloud-based device farms.
* Experience creating a mobile automation framework or test suite from the ground up.

**What We Are Looking For :**

* A technically hands-on QA professional who is comfortable writing and debugging automation code.
* Someone who can take ownership of an automated test suite and continuously improve it.
* A quality-focused problem solver who investigates the root cause of failures instead of only reporting symptoms.
* A collaborative team member who can work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* A proactive learner who keeps up with modern testing tools and engineering practices.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on challenging and innovative web, mobile and enterprise projects.
* Build meaningful automation that directly improves product quality and release efficiency.
* Gain exposure to fintech, travel, hospitality and high-volume consumer platforms.
* Collaborate with an experienced and diverse regional team.
* Grow your skills in automation engineering, API testing, performance testing and CI/CD.
* Enjoy a supportive and dynamic working environment.

If you are passionate about test automation and enjoy building reliable testing solutions, we invite you to apply and grow with our team.

Job Type: Full-time

Application Question(s):

* How many years of hands-on experience do you have writing and maintaining automated test scripts?
* Which automation tools have you personally used? Please state the tools, application types and duration of use. Examples: Maestro, Appium, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Postman/Newman or REST Assured.
* Have you personally created automated test flows for an iOS, Android or Flutter application using Maestro, Appium or another mobile automation framework? If yes, briefly describe what you automated.
* Briefly describe one recent automation project. What did you personally develop, which tools did you use, and was the test suite integrated into a CI/CD pipeline?
* Are you willing to complete a short practical assessment involving the creation or troubleshooting of automated test scripts?
* When will you be available to start work, and what is your current notice period?
* What is your expected monthly salary in IDR, and do you have any other expectations for your next job?

Work Location: Remote

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**First Circle**
is one of the
**fastest-growing FinTech companies in South-east Asia**
, providing financial services to under-served SMEs. We've already transformed access to credit for thousands of businesses, and
**now we're building a full-stack neobank**
offering multi-currency bank accounts, payments, FX, corporate credit cards, and payroll. As we enter this next phase of growth, we're hiring exceptional talent with a track record of excellence to join us in shaping the next chapter.
  
  
We are hiring a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to join our growing fintech company as we continue to expand our operations. In this role you will help us shape our
**cloud strategy, security, and scalability**
, ensuring our systems remain robust and reliable.
  
  
With your expertise in cloud infrastructure, automation, and DevOps practices, you will be responsible for the development and maintenance of our cloud environment across multiple providers. Your focus on security and compliance will be essential as we navigate the complex regulatory landscape of financial services.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing fintech company and make a significant impact on our technology strategy. If you are passionate about cloud infrastructure, security, and innovation, and have a strong desire to work in a dynamic and challenging environment, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Adopt a Security First approach in everything you do; take ownership of Cloud Security
* Build, maintain and assist with the Cloud deployments for the company (Azure; Digital Ocean)
* Architect our Cloud and Network infrastructure, maintaining a good balance between current needs and future scaling requirements
* Maintain and build developer tooling and CI/CD pipelines
* Optimise our Cloud and Tooling spend, to ensure our funds are efficiently allocated and to maximise developer productivity
* Support the engineering team with deploying and maintaining our live workloads
* Collaborate with the IT and security team to manage requirements for the engineering team
* Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders on all matters related to Cloud create a smooth experience for all stakeholders
* Build and maintain monitoring solution for our deployed services across the stack
* Be an expert for everything Cloud, automation and DevOps best practices

**Requirements**

* Extensive knowledge of Cloud provider (Azure Cloud Services)
* Experience with Kubernetes
* Expertise in Infrastructure as Code tooling (Terraform)
* Expertise in Github Workflows
* Good knowledge of monitoring and alerting solutions (Sentry, Datadog)
* Good understanding of containerisation technologies and serverless platforms (Docker, Azure Container Apps)
* Good understanding of Linux
* Excellent knowledge of security best practices, with a focus on Cloud and Networking
* Proactive and flexible mindset- achieve objectives independently whilst adjusting priorities according to need
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to work across departments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Data Engineering (Airflow, Snowflake..) and database management
* Experience working in regulated environments, particularly financial institutions
* Experience in incident management and setting
* Passion for DevEx and building efficient tooling for Developers. Experience with measuring and reporting DORA metrics is a plus

**Benefits**

* We don't have a fixed budget for the role. When we find the right person, we will pay them competitively vs their market rate
* Flexibility around working hours and location. The role can be worked remotely within South-east Asia or Serbia, with the option to work from one of our offices. We have offices in Hong Kong, Singapore & Belgrade where other senior engineers are based
* Macbooks, private health insurance, training budgets and more!
* Opportunity for travel

title: AI Solutions Engineer (Engineering LLM) - Sea Labs
description:
Engineering and Technology

Jakarta

Entry Level

Sea Labs Indonesia

  

### **About Team**

The Engineering and Technology team is at the core of the Shopee platform development. The team is made up of a group of passionate engineers from all over the world, striving to build the best systems with the most suitable technologies. Our engineers do not merely solve problems at hand; We build foundations for a long-lasting future. We don't limit ourselves on what we can or can't do; we take matters into our own hands even if it means drilling down to the bottom layer of the computing platform. Shopee's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience it first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do.

  

**About Team**

The AI Solutions team builds and pioneers the future of AI-driven automation at Sea. We are the developers of Smart (Sea Multi-Agent Realization Platform) - the company's flagship AI agents platform that enables teams across the company to automate their workflows using large language model (LLM) agents. But Smart is just the beginning.

Our team is also spearheading a wide range of AI initiatives, especially within the engineering infrastructure domain, from internal developer tooling to intelligent operations. We believe that the future of infrastructure lies in intelligent automation, and we’re committed to building it from the ground up.

We thrive in a fast-paced, sharing-first culture, with a strong emphasis on learning, creativity, and experimentation. We work hard and play hard, explore ideas on the cutting edge, and aim to pioneer bold, practical solutions to complex real-world problems. If you want to shape how AI changes engineering at scale - this is the place.

### **Job Description**

* Design and develop the Smart platform and other AI systems, covering all essential agent platform components - agent runtimes, toolchains, memory, orchestration, logging, planning, and sandboxing.
* Collaborate with teams across departments - both tech and non-tech - to land and scale real-world AI use cases.
* Drive internal agent adoption in engineering infra by replacing traditional operations with intelligent agent workflows.
* Work on platform reliability and observability to ensure our systems are performant, debuggable, and production-ready.
* Support operations and development work in a healthy balance - you’ll gain experience in shipping features and running real services.
* Manage and operate supporting infrastructure, including vector stores, retrieval systems (RAG), and middleware components.
* Continuously experiment, learn, and bring in the latest advancements from the AI/agent ecosystem into production.
* Continuously optimize system performance through tuning, profiling, and root-cause analysis.
* Design and develop an automated technical operations platform to reduce manual work and improve reliability.
* Drive capacity and resource management, ensuring systems scale efficiently under varying workloads.
* Plan and execute stress tests and load tests to identify bottlenecks, improve throughput, and eliminate redundancy.
* Improve system reliability, availability, and observability through better monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across application, middleware, and infrastructure layers.

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2+ years of relevant experience in software development - or fresh graduates with strong fundamentals and hunger to learn.
* Strong programming skills in Python (primary) - familiarity with Golang is a plus.
* Solid CS fundamentals - algorithms, data structures, networking, systems, and architecture.
* Backend experience designing cloud-ready services using databases, queues, caching, etc.
* Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or strong interest in learning them.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to navigate ambiguity with curiosity and creativity.
* Willingness to work full stack - we prioritize backend but value well-rounded engineers.
* General understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native principles (e.g. the twelve-factor app), including how services are deployed, scaled, and load-balanced in a containerized environment.
* Passion for building AI systems that people actually use.

Skills below are optional but preferred:

* Experience building AI-powered platforms, assistants, or automation tools.
* Familiarity with agent patterns like ReAct (Reasoning and Action), tool chaining, or multi-agent orchestration.
* Knowledge of RAG systems, vector databases, or prompt tuning.
* Prior experience in developer tools, internal platforms, or large-scale systems.
* Exposure to observability, debugging, incident workflows, or service reliability.

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. We are seeking 2 Senior Software QA to support quality assurance activities across Enterprise Business applications, with primary focus on Oracle, SAP, Billing, and related enterprise platforms.

You will partner with Business Analysts, Developers, Project Managers, and Business stakeholders to ensure high-quality delivery of Global IT solutions. The role will also leverage modern AI-powered tools to improve testing efficiency, test coverage, defect detection, and overall quality outcomes.

* Analyze business and functional requirements and develop test plan and test cases.

* Collaborate with project teams to validate system changes and assess cross-system impacts.
* Support release validation and production readiness activities.
* Develop and maintain test documentation, test evidence, and execution reports.
* Identify opportunities for automation and contribute to automation development and maintenance.
* Leverage AI-assisted tools and technologies to improve test design, test execution, defect analysis, and QA productivity.
* Participate in requirement reviews and provide quality-focused feedback early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Support root cause analysis and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Share knowledge and contribute to expanding QA capabilities across the broader team.

* 5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related discipline.
* Experience testing enterprise applications such as ERP, CRM, Finance, Billing, Procurement, or Supply Chain systems.
* Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies.
* Experience with defect tracking and test management tools such as Jira, qTest, or similar.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Willingness to adopt and utilize AI-powered tools to improve testing efficiency and productivity.

The Engineering and Technology team is at the core of the Shopee platform development. **About Team**

The AI Solutions team builds and pioneers the future of AI-driven automation at Sea. We are the developers of Smart (Sea Multi-Agent Realization Platform) - the company's flagship AI agents platform that enables teams across the company to automate their workflows using large language model (LLM) agents. But Smart is just the beginning.

Our team is also spearheading a wide range of AI initiatives, especially within the engineering infrastructure domain, from internal developer tooling to intelligent operations. We believe that the future of infrastructure lies in intelligent automation, and we’re committed to building it from the ground up.

We thrive in a fast-paced, sharing-first culture, with a strong emphasis on learning, creativity, and experimentation. We work hard and play hard, explore ideas on the cutting edge, and aim to pioneer bold, practical solutions to complex real-world problems. If you want to shape how AI changes engineering at scale - this is the place.

Job Description:

* Design and develop the Smart platform and other AI systems, covering all essential agent platform components - agent runtimes, toolchains, memory, orchestration, logging, planning, and sandboxing.
* Collaborate with teams across departments - both tech and non-tech - to land and scale real-world AI use cases.
* Drive internal agent adoption in engineering infra by replacing traditional operations with intelligent agent workflows.
* Work on platform reliability and observability to ensure our systems are performant, debuggable, and production-ready.
* Support operations and development work in a healthy balance - you’ll gain experience in shipping features and running real services.
* Manage and operate supporting infrastructure, including vector stores, retrieval systems (RAG), and middleware components.
* Continuously experiment, learn, and bring in the latest advancements from the AI/agent ecosystem into production.
* Continuously optimize system performance through tuning, profiling, and root-cause analysis.
* Design and develop an automated technical operations platform to reduce manual work and improve reliability.
* Drive capacity and resource management, ensuring systems scale efficiently under varying workloads.
* Plan and execute stress tests and load tests to identify bottlenecks, improve throughput, and eliminate redundancy.
* Improve system reliability, availability, and observability through better monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across application, middleware, and infrastructure layers.

Requirements:

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2+ years of relevant experience in software development - or fresh graduates with strong fundamentals and hunger to learn.
* Strong programming skills in Python (primary) - familiarity with Golang is a plus.
* Solid CS fundamentals - algorithms, data structures, networking, systems, and architecture.
* Backend experience designing cloud-ready services using databases, queues, caching, etc.
* Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or strong interest in learning them.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to navigate ambiguity with curiosity and creativity.
* Willingness to work full stack - we prioritize backend but value well-rounded engineers.
* General understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native principles (e.g. the twelve-factor app), including how services are deployed, scaled, and load-balanced in a containerized environment.
* Passion for building AI systems that people actually use.

**Skills below are optional but preferred:**

* Experience building AI-powered platforms, assistants, or automation tools.
* Familiarity with agent patterns like ReAct (Reasoning and Action), tool chaining, or multi-agent orchestration.
* Knowledge of RAG systems, vector databases, or prompt tuning.
* Prior experience in developer tools, internal platforms, or large-scale systems.
* Exposure to observability, debugging, incident workflows, or service reliability.

description:
**SoftwareSeni** is a Software Development Company based in Yogyakarta & Sydney, Australia. We have been designing and developing phone apps, websites, and mobile experiences. We love solving tough problems – from user experience to design and code. We build enterprise web-based solutions for clients all over the world, from Australia, Indonesia, Europe, Africa, and America. Our clients from Indonesia: Astra International, Traveloka, Angkasa Pura, and Peduli Anak Foundation. Our clients from Australia: Bike Exchange, Downsizing, Red Balloon, Sectara, and many more.

**What will you get?**

* **Competitive Salary**. We believe that salary is one of the main factors that keep employees in the company, therefore, we can guarantee a competitive salary for our Staff.
* **Career Development & Training**. We have a wonderful onboarding process where we help new team members get familiar with how we work.
* **Reasonable & Flexible Schedules**. We are encouraging a culture where people can have a good work-life balance. Our schedules are pretty flexible. Need to run an errand in the middle of the day? Totally cool.
* **English Class**. Working in SoftwareSeni means that you will get massive improvement in your English, both spoken and written, guaranteed!
* **Annual Leave Entitlement**. 12 working days, which can be taken after 3 months of joining.
* **Performance Review**. We will review your performance twice annually in December and June. So, you can focus on your work and improve your performance every day.
* **Relocation Allowance**. We provide a relocation allowance if you do not live in Yogyakarta. The allowance will cover moving costs for you and your family.
* **Staff Engagement Activities**. We provide fun icebreaker activities in the middle of our working hours to chill and build relationships with all the staff. Sounds fun, right?
* **Birthday Leave**. We also want to celebrate our staff's happiest day by giving them a half-day leave on their birthday.

**Requirements:**

* **3+ years of experience in Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.**
* Proven experience in statistical estimation methodologies, including **small-area estimation, Bayesian/hierarchical modeling, or survey statistics.**
* Proficiency in Python and R for advanced statistical modeling; strong SQL skills for data extraction and manipulation.
* Advanced understanding of statistical analysis. While machine learning knowledge is valued, the focus is on rigorous statistical research rather than pure engineering or general ML implementation.
* Ability to distill complex statistical findings into clear, actionable insights for non-technical business stakeholders
* **Possess strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.**
* **Willing to work onsite at our Yogyakarta Office.**

**Responsibilities:**

* Design and implement advanced statistical estimation models (e.g., Bayesian or hierarchical models) to address specific business research questions.
* Develop and refine statistical frameworks that go beyond standard machine learning workflows to provide more accurate population estimations and trend analyses.
* Present complex statistical outputs through clear, intuitive reports and dashboards that facilitate data-driven decision-making for leadership.
* Partner with existing in-house engineering teams to integrate statistical models into business operations and strategy.
* Ensure high standards of data quality and methodological rigor while maintaining compliance with data privacy regulations and internal best practices.

* **Note: This position requires fluency in English, as most communication will be conducted in English**. If you're confident (or eager to grow) in using English at work, this position could be a great fit.

**Disclaimer**: By submitting your application, you consent to PT Software Services Indonesia collecting and processing the information you provide for recruitment purposes only. The information will be treated confidentially and used solely to evaluate your application for current or future employment opportunities with us.

description:
For Singapore Applicants:

Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Jakarta, Indonesia**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.
* Ability to communicate in Bahasa Indonesia fluently to support clients in Indonesia.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including Software as a Service (SaaS) applications, Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), business automation solutions, cloud infrastructure, agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About the job**
-----------------

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Customer Engineer (CE) with a specialty in Artificial Intelligence (AI), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of specialized workloads. You will leverage your expertise in our most strategic product areas in partnership with platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development. You will have excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills, engaging with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will blend sales skills, market knowledge, and technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the sales cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine sales strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.

* Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.

title_clean: Customer Engineer, AI, Google Cloud (Bahasa Indonesia)
description_clean:
For Singapore Applicants:

Google will be prioritizing applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require Google's sponsorship of a visa.

  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Singapore; Jakarta, Indonesia**.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience in architecting solutions that integrate AI models using agents with enterprise data sources using patterns like Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Text-to-SQL, and semantic search.
* Experience with coding in Python, JavaScript or TypeScript, Go, or Java, to demo, prototype, or workshop integration patterns with customers.
* Ability to communicate in Bahasa Indonesia fluently to support clients in Indonesia.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including Software as a Service (SaaS) applications, Integration Platform as a Service (iPaaS), business automation solutions, cloud infrastructure, agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About the job**
-----------------

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Customer Engineer (CE) with a specialty in Artificial Intelligence (AI), you will partner with technical sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as a technical expert responsible for accelerating technical wins and adoption of specialized workloads. You will leverage your expertise in our most strategic product areas in partnership with platform CEs, writing code, developing prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and demos to promote new specialized solutions to customers. You will solve AI-centered customer issues and provide a critical feedback loop to influence product development. You will have excellent organizational, communication, and presentation skills, engaging with customers to understand their business and technical requirements, and persuasively present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will blend sales skills, market knowledge, and technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the sales cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine sales strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide deep technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building lasting customer relationships. Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go-To-Market team.
* Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.
* Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.

title: Full-Stack Developer
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a skilled **Full-Stack Developer** with a minimum of 5 years of professional software engineering experience to join our engineering team.

You will be responsible for building, maintaining, and scaling core web applications from the database to the user interface. This role focuses purely on hands-on technical execution within the Laravel and modern web ecosystem, operating in a collaborative environment based in Jakarta.

**The responsibilities of this role include:**

· Develop and maintain scalable web applications and features using Laravel and modern

front-end frameworks (e.g., Vue.js or React).

· Build, test, and document robust RESTful APIs for seamless front-end and third-party

integrations.

· Write clean, efficient, and maintainable server-side PHP code utilizing Laravel’s Eloquent

ORM, service containers, and migration tools.

· Implement responsive, accessible user interfaces using modern CSS frameworks (such as

Tailwind CSS) and JavaScript/TypeScript.

· Design, build, and maintain end-to-end **CI/CD pipelines** using tools like GitHub Actions,

GitLab CI, or Jenkins to automate testing, builds, and deployments.

· Optimize database queries, indexing, and data structures in relational databases

(MySQL/PostgreSQL) to ensure high performance.

· Write comprehensive automated tests (unit and feature tests) and participate in peer

code reviews to maintain high code quality standards.

· Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues, performance bottlenecks, and

security vulnerabilities across the application stack.

**Relevant desirable skills and experience:**

· Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on software development experience, with a

strong, demonstrable focus on Laravel and modern web technologies.

· Technical Stack:

o **Backend** : Proficiency in PHP 8+ and the Laravel framework, including queue

management and task scheduling.

o **Frontend**: Solid command of JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and frontend

libraries/frameworks (Vue.js or React).

o D**atabase & Tools**: Proficient with MySQL/PostgreSQL, Redis, Git version control, Docker.

Familiar with Linux environment is a plus.

· Competencies: Strong problem-solving mindset, meticulous attention to detail, and the

ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative development

team.

· Experience in WordPress customisation & enviromenment development is preferrable

· **DevOps & CI/CD:** Proven hands-on experience building CI/CD pipelines, containerization

with Docker

· Language: Professional working proficiency in both English and Indonesian.

Work Location: In person

title: Data Science Manager
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Our confidential client is a technology-driven organisation operating in a high-urgency, customer-facing environment where reliability, scale, security, and data-informed decision-making are critical.
  
  
We are seeking a hands-on
**Data Science Manager**
to lead the development of analytical and machine-learning capabilities that support business growth, operational performance, customer experience, and strategic decision-making.
  
  
This role requires a leader who can translate complex business problems into practical, measurable data solutions; develop a capable team; and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Technology, and business stakeholders.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing data science and analytics team.
* Define and execute a practical data science roadmap aligned with business priorities and measurable outcomes.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, Technology, and commercial stakeholders to identify high-impact data opportunities.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytics, experimentation, forecasting, optimisation, segmentation, predictive-modelling, or machine-learning initiatives.
* Oversee the end-to-end data science lifecycle: problem framing, data exploration, feature development, model design, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Establish standards for data quality, experimentation, statistical rigour, model validation, documentation, reproducibility, and responsible use of data.
* Ensure models and analytical products are reliable, scalable, explainable where appropriate, and fit for production environments.
* Work with Data Engineering and Software Engineering teams to improve data accessibility, data pipelines, model deployment, and model monitoring.
* Communicate insights, recommendations, risks, and model performance clearly to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
* Drive adoption of data-informed decision-making across relevant business and operational functions.
* Define success metrics for data science initiatives, including business impact, model performance, operational adoption, and return on investment.
* Contribute to data governance, privacy, security, and model-risk practices.
* Support team planning, recruitment, capability development, and the continuing maturity of the data science function.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, Physics, or another relevant quantitative discipline.
* Proven experience leading data science, advanced analytics, machine learning, or decision-science initiatives.
* Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including coaching, developing, and managing data science or analytics professionals.
* Strong practical understanding of statistical analysis, experimental design, predictive modelling, machine learning, and data storytelling.
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
* Experience working with large, complex, and production-relevant data sets.
* Experience translating business needs into analytical and machine-learning solutions with measurable impact.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in a fast-paced technology or operational environment.
* Strong commercial judgement to prioritise data initiatives based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, risk, and expected impact.
* Clear communication skills, including explaining technical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Professional English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with cloud data and machine-learning platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent environments.
* Experience with MLOps practices, including model versioning, experiment tracking, CI/CD, monitoring, and model governance.
* Experience in a large-scale digital, platform, fintech, e-commerce, marketplace, logistics, mobility, or other technology-driven environment.
* Experience with customer analytics, risk, fraud, personalisation, recommendation, optimisation, operational intelligence, or other data-intensive use cases.

Application Note
  
  
Noraa & Co. is supporting this recruitment process on behalf of our confidential client. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for further discussion.

About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. **Job Description**
===================

*Job ID: MJ000346*

  
  

The Engineering Team at Traveloka is the backbone of our innovation, building scalable and high-performance systems that power millions of users worldwide. With a relentless focus on scalability and performance, we ensure a seamless travel experience. Our dedication to excellence and problem-solving makes us instrumental in shaping Traveloka's future as a leader in the digital travel space. You’ll be joining a team that has built industry-leading, high-performance backend systems. Our engineers work on cutting-edge technologies, solving complex challenges in distributed computing, API design, and high-traffic systems. Backend engineering is evolving rapidly, and we’re looking for developers who are eager to build the next big thing in scalable backend architecture.

  
  

**What You'll be Doing:**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable backend applications, APIs, and data integrations.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code while adhering to best practices.
* Improve and optimize existing systems for better performance and reliability.
* Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and respond to alerts proactively.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-impact solutions.
* Conduct code reviews, unit testing, and integration testing to ensure software quality.
* Participate in architectural discussions and propose innovative solutions for high-traffic environments.
* Contribute to post-mortem analyses and continuously improve system resilience.
  

  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science from a reputable university
* Minimum 3 years of experience in software engineering, particularly in efficient backend development
* Proficiency in Go, Java, or Python
* Ability to dive deep and work across backend services, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and maintainability
* Experience designing scalable and maintainable architectures
* Eagerness to continuously learn - whether it’s technology-related, product-related, or beyond
* A strong sense of ownership and accountability for both the product(s) and assigned tasks
* Fluency in English, both spoken and written

The team analyses and monitors operational KPIs across the region and conducts root cause analysis when operation performance fluctuates. The Operations team comprises Customer Service, Payment, Listings, Warehouse, Logistics, Seller Operations and Fraud.

* Solve Real-world Problem: Take ownership of complex seller-related issues and work with cross-functional teams to resolve them in a timely and efficient manner
* Ops excellence with AI & Automation: Optimize seller operations by identifying process inefficiencies, implementing automation, and introducing best practices. Act as a subject matter expert on operational processes and policies
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with internal teams such as product, engineers, and local markets to address seller-related issues and deliver solutions that enhance the seller experience
* Data-Driven Insights: Use data analytics to monitor trends, identify performance gaps, and develop actionable insights to optimize seller operations

Requirements:

* Relevant Degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field
* 1-3 years’ working experience in management consulting, experience in a technology company is a plus
* Proficiency in analytical thinking, critical reasoning, and problem-solving
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with teams from diverse markets and backgrounds
* Proven ability to work collaboratively with various stakeholders in a dynamic and multicultural environment
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to apply analytical thinking with strong interest in working with large data sets
* Experience/proficiency in SQL and/or excel is required
* Ability to thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment

title: Data & Infrastructure Support Engineer
description:
Are you someone who enjoys troubleshooting technical issues, investigating what's happening behind the scenes, and finding solutions to unfamiliar problems? Do you have an interest in AI technologies and enjoy working with logs, monitoring tools, and different technical platforms to understand how systems operate?

We're looking for a **Data & Infrastructure Support Engineer** to join ATI Business Group. In this role, you'll support the reliability and performance of our data and infrastructure environments while helping investigate technical incidents across different platforms. You'll review logs, dashboards, and alerts, identify potential root causes, and either resolve issues or escalate them with clear supporting information.

We're particularly interested in candidates with a background in **DevOps, infrastructure, or technical support who have hands-on exposure to AI/LLM technologies**. Candidates with experience developing or supporting AI-powered applications are also encouraged to apply. You'll have the opportunity to work across data platforms, infrastructure, RPA, and AI-enabled solutions as part of our evolving technology environment.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide first-line support for data, infrastructure, and AI-related incidents, investigating issues and determining appropriate resolutions or escalations.
* Monitor system health and performance through logs, dashboards, alerts, and monitoring tools to identify potential issues and their root causes.
* Support and troubleshoot infrastructure and data environments, including servers, cloud services, networking, data pipelines, ETL processes, and scheduled jobs.
* Assist in monitoring and troubleshooting AI/LLM-powered applications and integrations, identifying application errors, API issues, and service availability concerns.
* Manage support tickets, incident documentation, and stakeholder communication to ensure timely resolution and compliance with agreed SLAs.
* Support RPA environments and contribute to improving monitoring, troubleshooting procedures, and technical documentation across infrastructure, data, and automation platforms.

### **Is this you?**

* Bachelor’s degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a related technical field**.
* Experience in **DevOps, infrastructure support, technical support, application support, data operations, or AI application** development.
* A strong troubleshooting mindset with the ability to investigate unfamiliar issues methodically and reach an initial diagnosis.
* Comfortable working with **logs, dashboards, alerts, and observability/monitoring tools** such as Grafana, Datadog, Azure Monitor, Splunk, or similar.
* Familiarity with **SQL, basic data querying, and data pipeline/ETL concepts**.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across **Azure, AWS, or GCP**, including VMs, storage, and basic networking.
* Basic scripting skills in **Python, PowerShell, or similar languages** for troubleshooting and routine operational checks.
* Familiarity with ITSM tools such as **Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent**, including incident management, escalation, and SLA processes.
* Able to follow and contribute to **technical runbooks and documentation**, with clear communication skills for handovers and escalations.
* Exposure to **UiPath or other RPA platforms**, including UiPath Orchestrator, robots, queues, or transactions, is a plus.
* Exposure to **Microsoft Power Automate, AI/LLM-powered applications, or related automation technologies** is also a plus.

**Be Part of ATI's Journey**

*コネクティブAI*

*AIソリューション事業*
、「PKSHA AIヘルプデスク」「PKSHA ChatAgent」等を展開する
*AI SaaS事業*
、そしてAIで人の能力を拡張する

の3事業を推進しています。
  
  
*――開発の基盤と品質を支え、安定したリリースとインシデント削減を実現する仕事です。*
PKSHA Infinity
  
  
PKSHA Infinityは、「無駄な仕事をなくす」をビジョンに掲げ、
  
  
AI技術を活用したSaaSを自社で開発・提供しています。
  
  
主力プロダクト『YOMEL』は、
  
  
独自の音声認識エンジン『Olaris』とLLMを融合させたAI議事録サービス。
  
  
累計導入社数は2,000社を突破、月間20万件以上の会議で活用され、
  
  
多くの企業の業務効率化やナレッジマネジメントを支援しています。
  
  
売上は2期連続で前年比300%成長——しかし、私たちの挑戦はまだ始まったばかりです。
  
  
募集背景
  
  
「AIがコードを書く時代」の開発基盤を再定義し、
  
  
リードタイムを極限まで縮める次世代の自動化を推進するポジションです。
  
  
これまではフロントエンドエンジニアが兼任する形で基盤を支えてきましたが、
  
  
AI駆動開発の加速に伴い担う領域が大きく拡大しました。
  
  
開発の「当たり前」を更新し、組織全体の生産性を飛躍させる基盤・
  
  
品質領域に専修していただける方を新たに募集します。
  
  
仕事内容
  
  
変化の激しいAI業界において、圧倒的な開発スピードと積極的なリファクタリングを武器に、
  
  
組織全体の生産性をアップデートするポジションです。
  
  
ニーズの起票からリリース、
  
  
不具合報告から修正に至るまでの開発リードタイムを極限まで短縮し、
  
  
次の動き出しを最速化することがミッションです。
  
  
単なる実装の高速化にとどまらず、
  
  
CI/CDの最適化やコミュニケーションの無駄・定型業務の自動化を推進し、
  
  
組織全体の改善サイクルを爆速で回すダイナミズムを実感していただけます。
  
  
■主な業務内容
  
  
・E2Eテストの保守
  
  
・暗号化機能の開発サポート・保守
  
  
・AIによる実装がスムーズに進む開発基盤・手法（ハーネス基盤）の構築
  
  
・OneFlow運用の安定化によるリリース頻度の向上
  
  
・インシデント数・不具合数削減に向けた集計・分析基盤の構築、修正の自動化
  
  
・ISMS / SOC2対応の自動化・仕組み化（ガードレールの構築）
  
  
・PRレビュー、不具合修正、CS問い合わせ対応などの定常業務
  
  
・エンジニアチーム／デザインチームのコミュニケーションの仕組み化 など

・バックエンド：Django 5.2 / DRF / Python 3.13 / uv
  
  
・DB・キャッシュ：PostgreSQL / Redis / OpenSearch
  
  
・非同期処理：Celery
  
  
・認証：Auth0（SSO / MFA）
  
  
・Lint・型チェック：Ruff / Pyright
  
  
・インフラ：Terraform / AWS ECS
  
  
・監視・可観測性：Sentry / OpenTelemetry（X-Ray）/ Fluent Bit

Slack / Notion / ClickUp / Google Workspace / Microsoft 365 / AWS / Azure / GitHub

Claude Code等を活用し、AIエージェントによる開発を推進しています。

様々なエンジニアが在籍しており合計16名・平均年齢34.3歳の構成です。

コードレビューの7割をAIが担当し、CIにもClaude Codeを組み込んでいます。

機能を作る側では味わえない、開発の土台そのものを進化させる手応えがあります。

社内のエンジニア数十人の開発体験に直接影響するポジションです。

自分がやったことの効果を自分で計測・確認でき、「仮説→計測→改善」のループを何度も回せる環境です。

稟議待ちで埋もれず、自分の判断の結果が早く返ってくる。
  
  
この裁量とフィードバックの速さが、エンジニアとして素早く成長できる環境をつくっています。

フルリモート・フレックス制度により、好きな時間で開発が可能。
  
  
平均残業時間も月10〜30時間と少なめで、無理なく働けます。

〜フルリモート可。出社したくなる日のために、こんな空間を用意しています〜

まぶしすぎないスポットライト照明と、心地よいBGM。
  
  
会話はチャット中心で「静寂」が保たれています。
  
  
*■100%自分らしく*
Tシャツ、ビーサン、金髪、ネイルOK。
  
  
役員とも「さん付け」で話すフラットな関係で、余計な気遣いは不要です。
  
  
*■「個」を尊重する設備*
1人用ソファ、テレキューブ、フリードリンク＆スナック完備。
  
  
ランチも休憩も、誰かに合わせず自分のペースで過ごせます。
  
  
求める人材
  
  
*【必須】*
・Webアプリケーション開発の実務経験3年以上（サーバーサイド中心）
  
  
・CI/CDパイプラインの構築・改善経験

・自チーム以外のエンジニアを巻き込んで改善を進めた経験
  
  
*[歓迎]*
・Terraform等IaCの活用経験
  
  
・Sentry / OpenTelemetry等の可観測性導入・運用経験
  
  
・テスト戦略や品質改善のリード経験
  
  
・AIコーディングエージェントの実務活用経験
  
  
・マルチテナントSaaSの開発経験
  
  
・ISMSやSOC2の対応経験
  
  
*〈求める人物像〉*
・8割できているものを最後まで持っていくことに価値を感じる方
  
  
— ゼロから作るより、優先度が高いのに着手できていない領域を完了まで運べる方
  
  
・他チームが何に困っているかを自分から確かめに行き、巻き込める方
  
  
— 依頼を待つのではなく、押し付けずに距離を詰められる方

— 計測の仕組みは整っているので、分析で終わらせず実行まで持っていける方
  
  
・AIに任せる範囲を自分で線引きできる方
  
  
— AIが書いたコードのレビュー、どこまで任せてどこから人が見るかを設計できる方

title: Senior Manager, Electrical (GERA)
company: DAYONE DATA CENTERS SINGAPORE PTE. LTD.
description:
**About DayOne Data Centers**

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

  
  

DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across eight markets: Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Hong Kong, Japan, Finland and Spain. We raised US$4.5 billion in Series C funding to keep building.

  

As the platform grows, sites cannot each run to a standard of their own. Global Engineering Reliability Authority (GERA) is the technical governance layer that sits above our site operations teams and above our Mission Critical Response (MCR) teams, the specialists who respond when a site hits a critical event. It runs as three parallel disciplines: Electrical, Mechanical, and Reliability.

  

GERA does not run sites day to day. It sets the standards sites run to, at regional and global level, and it is who a site calls when a problem outruns standard procedure. We are building it out across Southeast Asia now, and you would be one of the first into this discipline.

  

**About the role**
------------------

This is a technical authority role rather than a line management one. You will not have direct reports when you start, and that is deliberate. Your influence comes from the standards you write and the judgement you bring when a site escalates.

  

**What you will do**
--------------------

**Regional electrical authority**

• Set the engineering standards every Southeast Asia site runs to, including switching standards, arc flash standards and maintenance playbooks at regional and global level.

• Take the escalation on complex electrical events: protection trips, faults, uninterruptible power supply (UPS) and generator abnormalities, switching events, power quality and degraded operating modes.

• Lead root cause analysis on significant incidents, and drive the corrective actions across every site, not only the one that had the incident.

  

**Infrastructure and reliability**

• Own the operation, maintenance and lifecycle of utility intake, high voltage, medium voltage and low voltage (HV/MV/LV) distribution, transformers, switchgear and protection systems.

• Cover the standby and critical power chain: generators, UPS, batteries, static transfer switches (STS), power distribution units and remote power panels (PDU/RPP), busway, earthing and electrical monitoring.

• Raise availability and cut lifecycle cost through preventive, predictive and condition based maintenance, and improve power quality, load utilization, redundancy and power usage effectiveness (PUE).

  

**Projects, vendors and capability**

• Take new capacity from commissioning, energization and integrated systems testing through operational readiness into live operation.

• Hold original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), service providers, consultants and contractors to maintenance quality and safe execution. Our OEMs include Siemens, Schneider, ABB, Eaton and Cummins.

• Build regional depth in switching discipline, UPS and generator systems, protection coordination and incident response.

  

**Safety and compliance**

• Hold the line on permit to work, lockout tagout, arc flash controls and electrical safety procedures.

• Keep electrical work compliant with local regulation in every market and with DayOne operational risk requirements.

• Make switching discipline the default in how site teams work.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

*Technical skills*

• A bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, power engineering or a related discipline.

• 6+ years in electrical engineering, facilities operations or critical infrastructure, with substantial time in data centers or other mission critical environments.

• Track record as the technical subject matter expert (SME) for the full electrical chain: utility and grid interface, substations, MV distribution, transformers, protection, standby generation, LV distribution and critical loads.

• Depth in protection: numerical relays and intelligent electronic devices (IEDs), coordination and selectivity, relay settings, fault analysis, interlocking and control schemes.

• Working experience of International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) 61850, supervisory control and data acquisition (SCADA) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) integration, and arc flash assessment.

• Hands on switching operations, commissioning, energization and operational readiness in live critical facilities.

• IEC, Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) and National Fire Protection Association (NFPA) 70 and 70E standards, plus local electrical regulation across Southeast Asia.

  

*Soft skills*

• Internal & External Stakeholder Management; Communicates effectively with stakeholders at all levels, translating technical or operational issues into language relevant to each audience. Builds credibility by constructively challenging internal teams and external vendors when recommendations are not supported by data, while ensuring sustainable solutions through clear written standards, knowledge transfer, and capability building rather than simply resolving immediate problems.

  

*Language*

• English and Mandarin. Much of our equipment, documentation and contractor base is Chinese, and vendor issues close fastest with an engineer who keeps technical precision in both languages.

  

**Nice to have**
----------------

• Semiconductor fabs, hyperscale facilities, oil and gas, utilities or power generation.

• Design experience alongside site operations experience.

• Multi-site or regional program experience.

• Previous team leadership or professional certification.

  

**Why DayOne**
--------------

Most regional engineering roles inherit a standards manual and enforce it. This one writes it, at regional and global level.

  

You would work across countries and campuses alongside site operations and Mission Critical Response teams, with visibility across the estate rather than responsibility for one building. It is a technical expertise role, built so you keep contributing technically instead of moving away from the work.

GERA is new, and we would rather say so. You would join during a transformation and scaling phase, as the function is built out across new markets.

  

DayOne is for people who want to build things that don't come with instructions.

  

**Make your mark from DayOne.**

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

description:
*人とソフトウエアが共進化する社会へ*
PKSHAは「人とソフトウエアの共進化」をビジョンに掲げ、人と人の「間」をAIでつなぎ直す
*コネクティブAI*
を事業の核に据えています。顧客個別のアルゴリズムを開発・提供する
*AIソリューション事業*
、「PKSHA AIヘルプデスク」「PKSHA ChatAgent」等を展開する
*AI SaaS事業*
、そしてAIで人の能力を拡張する
*AI Powered Worker事業*
の3事業を推進しています。
  
  
*業務概要*
PKSHA Technologyでは、コミュニケーション領域の社会課題を解決するため、幅広い業種の大手企業に複数のSaaSプロダクトを提供しております。
  
  
このポジションでは、AI技術本部にてソフトウエアエンジニアとして下記プロダクトの開発を担当いただきます。
  
  
・PKSHA Knowledge Stream
  
  
ドキュメントや問い合わせログをもとにFAQを自動生成するカスタマーサポート向け生成AIです。PKSHA FAQ と 連携して活用することで、AIが自動で既存FAQとの重複確認やカテゴリー選択をするため、効率的にFAQの最新性と網羅性を向上できます。また PKSHA Speech Insight で記録した音声対話ログを連携することで、「頻度が高い問い合わせ」を自動で抽出できるため、日々の運用の中で自然とFAQが蓄積されていくサイクルを構築することができます。
  
  
※他プロダクトに関しては、弊社ホームページにて詳細をご確認いただけます。
  
  
https://www.pkshatech.com/ai-saas/
  
  
*業務内容*

* プロダクトロードマップやプロダクトバックログをもとにチームで協働しながら要件定義・設計・開発・運用まで一貫して行う
* バックエンドを主軸としつつ、必要に応じてフロントエンド・インフラまで領域を横断して開発を進める

+ 主な技術スタックは Go / Python / TypeScript
+ 生成AIおよび独自アルゴリズムをプロダクトに組み込む領域が中心
+ SREメンバーと連携しながら、開発と運用の両面を担っていただきます。

* 日常的なリファクタリング
* スクラムをベースにしたチーム内や他職種とのコミュニケーション、開発プロセス推進

【所属部門について】
  
  
現在、Knowledge Stream専任の開発体制を新たに立ち上げようとしています。
  
  
少人数のチームであるため、機能開発だけでなく、アーキテクチャ設計・開発プロセスづくり・運用設計まで、プロダクトの土台そのものに関与いただけます。
  
  
*EntranceBook*
より詳細を知りたい方は、
*SoftwareEngineer Entrance Book*
をご覧ください。
  
  
*技術的なチャレンジ*
国内トップシェアを含むAI SaaSプロダクトを複数展開する私たちだからこそ向き合える、挑戦的な技術課題が数多く存在します。
  
  
*■急成長するコミュニケーション領域プロダクトならではの課題の解決*
カスタマーサポート領域では生成AIの活用が急速に進んでいますが、エンドユーザーに信頼できる回答を届けるためには、AIが参照する正確なナレッジの作成と維持管理が重要であり、その工数が大きな課題となっています。Knowledge Stream は運用しながら自然とナレッジが最新化されるサイクルの実現を目指しており、AIエージェント時代に適した知識基盤の構築に取り組んでいます。
  
  
*■生成AI・機械学習の特性を踏まえたプロダクト設計*
AIは確率的な挙動をする・1回あたりの推論コストが高いなど、従来型のソフトウエアとは違った特徴を持っています。レスポンス速度とコストのトレードオフ、モニタリングやフォールバックの仕組みの構築など、AIを安定してプロダクト上で稼働させるためには様々な知見が必要であり、社内のアルゴリズムエンジニアと協力しながら、あらゆる手法を用いてベストプラクティスを探索しています。
  
  
*■プロダクト間連携による価値創出*
PKSHA FAQ・PKSHA Speech Insight をはじめ、複数のプロダクトを連携させて、より大きな顧客価値を生み出すために、チームの垣根を越えてコミュニケーションを行い、拡張性と保守性の高い連携方式の設計から実装までを推進しています。
  
  
*■ テクノロジーによるプロダクト・組織スケーラビリティの最大化*
AIによってソフトウエア開発のプロセスが大きく変わる中で、高い開発品質とスピードを両立させるため、AIを活用した開発プロセスの標準化、文化の醸成を通じて、強い技術組織の土台づくりを推進しています。
  
  
*ポジションの魅力*

* AI時代のエンジニアとして、AI / LLMというこれまでのソフトウエア開発とパラダイムの異なる技術を搭載した、今と異なる”ソフトウエアのあるべき姿"を探求できる。加えて、複数のエンタープライズの高い要求にも耐えうる未来のアーキテクチャを作って発信していける 。
* AIエージェント時代において正確なナレッジの維持管理が必須であり、とくにカスタマーサポート領域におけるナレッジマネジメントの仕組み構築に主体的に関わることができる。
* 開発チームの初期メンバーとして、技術選定や開発プロセスづくりに関われる
* TechLead、EM、PdMといった個人のスペシャリティをいかしたキャリアパスを描くことができる。

｢人とソフトウエアの共進化｣というビジョンを実現するためには、顧客に価値を感じてもらい、ご利用し続けていただくことが必要です。ただ機能を満たす開発をするのではなく、本当に顧客の価値になるのか、という点を考え抜いてデリバリする文化があります。また最先端のAIをどうプロダクトに組み込むのか、そのアーキテクチャや実装はどうあるべきかを運用面を含めて議論して、ベストプラクティスを生み出し続けられる組織を目指しています。

company: DAYONE DATA CENTERS SINGAPORE PTE. LTD.
description:
**About DayOne Data Centers**

DayOne Data Centers is a Singapore-headquartered global digital infrastructure platform that develops and operates next-generation data centers across Asia Pacific and Europe. Trusted by leading hyperscalers and businesses, the company engineers, builds, and operates high-capacity, AI-ready campuses with speed, scale, and reliability.

  
  

DayOne builds and operates hyperscale data centers across eight markets: Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Hong Kong, Japan, Finland and Spain. We raised US$4.5 billion in Series C funding to keep building.

Global Engineering Reliability Authority (GERA) sits above our site operations teams and our Mission Critical Response (MCR) teams, the specialists who respond when a site hits a critical event. It runs three parallel disciplines: Electrical, Mechanical, and Reliability.

  

GERA does not run sites day to day. It sets the standards sites run to, at regional and global level, and it is who a site calls when a problem outruns standard procedure. We are building it out across Southeast Asia now, and you would be one of the first into this discipline.

  

**About the role**

Reliability keeps equipment performing as buildings move through the defects liability period (DLP), the window after handover when the contractor still carries defect risk, and into long term operation. Once a building is through DLP, every fault is ours.

That is where maintenance workmanship and operating parameters start showing up in the performance data. Your authority comes from the governance you build and the evidence you bring, not from headcount.

  
  

**What you will do**

**Reliability governance**

* Own the reliability governance framework and the systemic risk register, with defined risk categories and matching mitigations.

* Run operational risk assessment using Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA), and keep the register current against what it finds.

* Where a permanent fix is not viable in live operation, own the containment and hold the plan that gets to permanent resolution.

**Problem management**

* Lead problem management: root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA), and major incident review.

* Build and maintain DayOne's Known Error Database (KEDB), so a recurring issue is solved once and closed everywhere.

* Drive equipment vendors through component failure investigation to a root cause, not a parts swap.

**Performance and lifecycle**

* Catch deterioration before it becomes failure, tracking equipment performance including power usage effectiveness (PUE) and water usage effectiveness (WUE).

* Raise availability through preventive, predictive and condition based maintenance, using equipment health data, alarms and failure trends.

* Plan and run major maintenance, overhauls and cyclic replacement, and manage end of life (EOL) and end of service life (EOSL) transitions and asset refresh.

**Assets, vendors and capability**

* Maintain system specification and critical spares data using Risk Priority Number (RPN) methodology.

* Hold internal stakeholders, original equipment manufacturers (OEMs), service providers, consultants and contractors to consistent maintenance quality.

Build regional depth in mission critical operations.  

  

**Requirements**

*Technical skills*

* A bachelor's degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, building services engineering or a related discipline.

* 6+ years in critical infrastructure operations, with substantial time managing critical equipment, preferably in data centers.

* A strong grasp of local and international standards on equipment maintenance scope, frequency and operating parameters, and of local regulation in operations and maintenance management.

* Commissioning experience.

* Track record leading complex incident response, advanced fault diagnosis and forensic root cause analysis, and driving permanent corrective action across the equipment lifecycle.

* Experience taking equipment vendors through failure investigation.

*Soft skills*

* Stakeholder Management; Requires coordination with internal teams, OEMs, vendors, consultants, contractors, customers, and management to achieve operational objectives.

* Critical Thinking; Needed during FMEA assessments, root cause investigations, risk evaluations, and equipment lifecycle decisions.

Decision Making; Prioritize risks, maintenance activities, equipment replacements, and mitigation strategies based on data and business impact.  



*Language*

English and Mandarin  

  

**Nice to have**

* International Organization for Standardization (ISO) 50001 energy management.

* Semiconductor, a commissioning company, or another critical infrastructure industry.

* SCEM, GMAP, CDCS or a similar professional certification.

Previous team leadership.  

  

**Why DayOne**

Most regional engineering roles inherit a standards manual and enforce it. This one writes it, at regional and global level.

  

You would work across countries and campuses alongside site operations and Mission Critical Response teams, with visibility across the estate rather than responsibility for one building. It is a technical expertise role, built so you keep contributing technically instead of moving away from the work.

GERA is new, and we would rather say so. You would join during a transformation and scaling phase, as the function is built out across new markets.

  

DayOne is for people who want to build things that don't come with instructions.

  

**Make your mark from DayOne.**

DayOne is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
  
  
If you're ready to grow with one of the fastest-moving companies in the data center industry, apply now and be part of our global journey.

description:
Department Operations

LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor)

LocationBangkok

The Operation teams at Shopee covers the operational end-to-end process, from when the buyer searches for a product listed on the Shopee platform, to the moment the buyer receives the products. The team analyses and monitors operational KPIs across the region and conducts root cause analysis when operation performance fluctuates. The Operations team comprises Customer Service, Payment, Listings, Warehouse, Logistics, Seller Operations and Fraud.

Job Description:

* Deployment Architecture & Strategy: Scope, architect, and lead the deployment of AI-based applications and large language models (LLMs) across diverse operational workflows.
* End-to-End Integration: Manage the full lifecycle of AI model integration, wrapping machine learning models into robust, scalable APIs and integrating them seamlessly into existing full-stack production systems.
* MLOps & CI/CD Pipelines: Design and maintain automated CI/CD pipelines for machine learning models, ensuring seamless versioning, testing, and deployment without downtime.
* Infrastructure Management: Utilize Linux-based environments and containerization orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) to provision, scale, and manage AI application infrastructure.
* Monitoring & Optimization: Implement comprehensive telemetry to monitor model performance, detect data/concept drift, and track system latency. Optimize deployed systems to meet strict service-level agreements (SLAs) and safety standards.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner actively with Data Scientists to transition models into production-ready code, and with product teams to identify new opportunities for AI integration.

Requirements:

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, or a closely related field.
* Experience: 3+ years of hands-on experience deploying, managing, and scaling AI/ML applications in live production environments.
* Core Languages & Frameworks: Advanced proficiency in Python and modern web frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Node.js). Full-stack development experience to build internal tooling and integration endpoints.
* Systems & OS: Mandatory proficiency in Linux systems administration, bash scripting, and resource management (CPU/GPU allocation).
* Cloud & DevOps: Strong practical experience with major cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).
* API & Integration: Deep understanding of RESTful APIs, gRPC, and microservices architecture.
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible to provision deployment infrastructure.
* LLM Experience: Direct experience deploying and optimizing generative AI models, working with frameworks like LangChain.

Join Accenture's SAP practice and help organizations unlock the value of data through enterprise reporting, analytics, and data warehousing solutions. - Develop and maintain InfoProviders, ADSOs, CompositeProviders, DataSources, Process Chains, and transformations.
- Support report development and analytics solutions using SAP BW, SAP BusinessObjects, SAP Analytics Cloud, or related technologies.
- Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable data warehousing and reporting solutions.
- Monitor and optimize data loads, system performance, and data quality across SAP analytics environments.
