title: Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer
description:
**About Us**
**Base360.ai**
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.
  
  
Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.
  
  
We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.
  
  
We're looking for an ambitious
**Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer**
who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.
  
  
If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.
  
  
What You'll Build
  
  
As a Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.
  
  
You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.
  
  
Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.
  
  
Your Mission
  
  
Understand Customer Problems
  
  
Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.
  
  
Build Products End-to-End
  
  
Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.
  
  
Create Intuitive User Experiences
  
  
Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.
  
  
Create Powerful Automations
  
  
Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.
  
  
Develop AI-Powered Features
  
  
Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.
  
  
Connect the Ecosystem
  
  
Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.
  
  
Solve Real Operational Problems
  
  
**Build Solutions For**

* Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
* Dynamic pricing intelligence
* Smart lock access and key management
* Automated guest communication across channels
* Guest check-in and upsell journeys
* Operational forecasting
* Cleaning and maintenance automation
* Owner reporting and financial workflows
* AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve
  
  
Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.
  
  
Build for Scale
  
  
Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.
  
  
Tech Stack
  
  
We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:
  
  

* Python
* FastAPI
* React
* TypeScript
* Supabase
* PostgreSQL
* AWS
* Serverless architecture
* OpenAI APIs
* Twilio
* Stripe
* Docker
* GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have
  
  

* Strong experience building and shipping production software
* The ability to work across frontend and backend systems
* Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies
* Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture
* A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature
* Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs
* The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution
* Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders
* The ability to work independently and own outcomes
* Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
* A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

**Bonus Points For Experience With**

* Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
* Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
* Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
* AI agents and workflow automation
* Product analytics and experimentation
* Event-driven architectures
* Supabase
* AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like
  
  
**Within Your First 12 Months**

* You've shipped features that property managers actively use
* Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built
* Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks
* Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete
* Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably
* AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations
* Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions
* Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us
  
  
Build Something Meaningful
  
  
Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.
  
  
Own the Product Outcome
  
  
Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.
  
  
Small Team, Massive Opportunity
  
  
Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.
  
  
Learn Faster
  
  
Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.
  
  
Performance-Based Rewards
  
  
Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.
  
  
Remote-First
  
  
Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.
  
  
This Role Is Not For You If
  
  

* You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
* You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement
* You need detailed specifications before you can make progress
* You avoid ownership and accountability
* You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

title: Senior Data Scientist (Shopee)
description:
Department Business Intelligence and Data Analytics

LevelExperienced (Team Lead)

LocationBangkok

The Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team plays a critical role in conducting close-loop data-driven business iterations. As business intelligence specialists and data analysts, our scope of work is not limited to just performance monitoring and reporting, but also in proactively finding actionable insights to help drive high-impact business changes. Our end-to-end data solution reduces the gap between the business teams and technical teams, and achieves real ‘intelligence’ in the iteration cycle. Browse our Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.

Job Description:

* Partner directly with business stakeholders across Shopee Thailand, structuring ambiguous business problems into clear, well-defined analytical frameworks and approaches.
* Own projects end-to-end, from problem scoping and solution design to delivery and impact measurement.
* Build and apply appropriate data science and statistical methods, from classical ML, operations research, and causal inference, to AI engineering solutions, to support business use cases.
* Measure the business impact of solutions through experiments (A/B tests) and other evaluation methods, including hypothesis formulation, metric definition, and interpretation of results.
* Deliver clear, actionable insights and recommendations that influence business decisions, through effective presentations to stakeholders and senior management.
* Explore recent developments in machine learning and AI, and quickly turn promising ideas into proof-of-concepts.
* Plan and track project progress, manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment, and support the team's day-to-day delivery when the team lead is away.
* Guide and mentor team members on their projects, including reviewing approaches and technical work.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Econometrics, or a related quantitative field.
* 3-7 years of experience in data science, data analytics, or other quantitative modeling roles, with a track record of delivering measurable business impact.
* Genuine curiosity and excitement about solving problems. Enjoys digging into a problem until it is solved, and proactively pushes work forward without waiting to be asked.
* Strong analytical thinking and business acumen.
* Strong foundation in probability, statistics, machine learning, and AI.
* Proficiency in SQL and Python, with solid coding skills for data manipulation, modeling, and deployment.
* Excellent communication skills in both Thai and English, with the ability to independently present and discuss insights with stakeholders and senior management.
* Strong ownership and collaboration skills, with the ability to build good relationships with stakeholders and manage multiple priorities.
* Experience in e-commerce, logistics, marketing data science, or agentic AI is a plus.
extracted_skills: Python, Machine Learning, Data Science, SQL

Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

The HRBP Intern will support the HR Business Partner team in executing people-related strategies, programs, and initiatives that align with business objectives. This role provides hands-on exposure to various HR functions, including recruitment support, employee engagement, HR analytics, performance management, and employee relations. The intern will collaborate closely with HRBP Managers and cross-functional teams to help drive positive employee experience and operational HR excellence.

**What will you do:**

  

* HR Operations & Support
* + Support onboarding and offboarding processes, ensuring smooth employee experience.
  + Maintain and update employee data, organizational charts, Job Description and HR documentation.
  + Support on driving SPS People Commitment
* Recruitment & Talent Support
* + Coordinate with Talent Acquitition team & People Operation team to support hiring activities (screening, scheduling interviews, Follow up to hiring manager).
  + Participate in employer branding activities, internship programs, student visit and talent pipeline initiatives.
* Employee Engagement
* + Assist in Employee Engagement communication, developing Employee Engagement action plan, organizing, and executing employee engagement activities (events, surveys, communication initiatives & action plan).
  + Help collect feedback and conduct simple analysis to provide insights on employee sentiment
* Performance Management
* + Support HRBP Managers during performance review cycles, including communication, data consolidation, and tracking progress.
* HR Data & Reporting
* + Prepare regular HR reports, dashboards, and analytics to support decision making.
  + Support analysis of absenteeism, attrition, productivity indicators, and HR trends.
* Employee Relations
* + Assist in logging employee concerns and helping HRBP team prepare follow-up action items.
  + Participate in HR-related meetings and take proper minutes when needed.

* Active Bachelor degree’s student (max. 8th semester) in Industrial Engineering, Management, Business, or related fields

  + Strong communication & interpersonal skills
  + Analytical & problem solving skills
  + Able to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information

* Previous experience or exposure to human resources would be preferred.

description:
**About The Team**
**About the Team**
Monee is Sea’s main business and a key foundation. Our R&D team works across Indonesia, Singapore, and China. We provide secure and reliable financial products and payment services for millions of merchants and users across Southeast Asia, Latin America, and other markets. Our systems support e-commerce, food delivery, digital payments, and a wide range of financial services.
  
  
Together, we aim to reach the forefront of cashless payment technology by providing a more accessible, secure and reliable payment network that empowers individuals as well as micro, small and medium enterprises around the globe.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer, you will work with some of the most talented minds in the world, collaborating with fellow Developers, Product Managers, User Experience Designers and Operation Engineers to design, test and safeguard availability, performance and usability of our business-critical functionalities that delight both internal business and external end-users.
  
  
You will collaborate with experienced engineers across countries and functions, solving complex distributed-systems and payment-platform challenges at significant scale. This role offers strong opportunities to deepen your expertise in QA & AI technology.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Design and execute test plans for payment/financial products, APIs, integrations, and financial workflows.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and production validation testing.
* Test critical scenarios such as payment success and failure, retries, timeouts, duplicate requests, reversals, refunds, and reconciliation.
* Develop and maintain automated tests for APIs and backend services.
* Identify, investigate, and track defects; work with engineers to drive issues to resolution.
* Participate in release quality assessment, incident investigation, and root-cause analysis.
* Improve test coverage, QA processes, automation frameworks, and CI/CD quality gates.
* Collaborate with local/regional teams to deliver reliable payment services across multiple markets.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of experience in QA, software testing, test engineering, or quality assurance.
* Experience testing backend services, REST APIs, microservices, or distributed systems.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Basic to intermediate SQL skills for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience in UI and Mobile Automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, or WebdriverIO.
* Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Understanding of software testing principles, defect lifecycle, and Agile development practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work with international, cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn AI, use AI to facilitate and enhance quality .

title: Technical Assistance Center Engineer
description:
About us:

At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.

We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.

What you'll do:

As a Technical Assistance Center(TAC) team member, you will serve as the critical bridge between customer operations and DevOps teams supporting Viasat’s global networks. In this role, you will contribute to global incident response operations by supporting service restoration efforts and helping maintain Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Agreements (SLAs). You will also develop technical expertise in Viasat networking and satellite technologies while expanding your operational and incident management skills.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Incident Management: Coordinate communication, documentation, and escalation activities during critical outage and customer-impacting events.
* Multi-functional Collaboration: Collaborate with DevOps and hardware infrastructure teams to assist in the diagnosis and resolution of complex technical issues.
* Communication: Provide timely, detailed status updates to internal customer-facing teams and external partners, including global onsite vendors, fiber providers, and third-party support teams.
* Technical Support & Coordination: Collaborate with engineering teams using a diverse suite of networking, RF, and proprietary Viasat technologies to maintain global connectivity.

The day-to-day:

* Triage alerts to identify and isolate customer-impacting issues, escalating critical events to senior teams as required.
* Participate in incident response activities, supporting bridge calls and engaging appropriate engineering teams for rapid fault isolation.
* Communicate real-time updates regarding system status to internal customer-facing teams and external global partners.
* Coordinate field logistics, managing the dispatch of onsite vendors and fiber providers to resolve physical site issues.
* Fix and help isolate problems related to Tier 2 customer escalations, employing growing knowledge of Viasat's global network environment.
* Manage ticket queues actively, tracking documentation to ensure strict alignment to established SLAs and SLOs.

What you'll need:

* Experience in a technical operations environment, such as a Network Operations Center (NOC), Technical Assistance Center (TAC), Enterprise IT, or Technical Call Center.
* Hands-on experience managing network incidents, including outage event handling, circuit-impacting events, or service degradations.
* Proven capability to escalate and coordinate effectively with external vendors and providers to resolve complex technical issues.
* Introductory experience with AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs), specifically using AI assistants for fixing, documentation, or workflow optimization.
* Basic familiarity with query languages or data analysis tools (e.g., SQL, KQL, or similar) to parse logs and system alerts.

What will help you on the job:

* Radio Frequency (RF) and Satellite communication knowledge.
* Understanding of the OSI model and networking concepts, including common routing protocols.
* Experience using enterprise ticketing platforms such as ServiceNow, Jira, or Salesforce.

title: AI Solution Engineer
description:
Department Business Intelligence and Data Analytics

LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor)

LocationJakarta

The Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team plays a critical role in conducting close-loop data-driven business iterations. As business intelligence specialists and data analysts, our scope of work is not limited to just performance monitoring and reporting, but also in proactively finding actionable insights to help drive high-impact business changes. Our end-to-end data solution reduces the gap between the business teams and technical teams, and achieves real ‘intelligence’ in the iteration cycle. Browse our Business Intelligence and Data Analytics team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.

Job Description:

* Execute the building, testing, and maintenance of AI-enabled tools and services for internal systems within the designated project phases.
* Implement and integrate language models and advanced AI components into existing workflows and platforms to meet project delivery milestones.
* Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders, including engineering, operations, and product teams, to drive AI adoption and understand critical project use cases.
* Analyze data, support model testing, evaluate performance, and assist in seamless model integration into internal systems.
* Manage the development of internal APIs, automation scripts, dashboards, and data pipelines throughout the project lifecycle.
* Monitor the performance of deployed models and services, proactively debugging and iterating to ensure robust project deliverables.

Requirements:

* Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Possess 2+ years of professional software development experience (or strong computer science fundamentals for recent graduates).
* Demonstrate strong proficiency in Python for AI or backend system development (Golang is a major advantage).
* Show solid core CS fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, system design, and basic machine learning principles.
* Have proven experience in backend development and cloud-ready services (APIs, databases, and message queues).
* Familiar with modern AI frameworks and tools (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, Transformers, and OpenAI APIs).
* Understand key AI methodologies, including prompt engineering, embeddings, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and multi-agent systems.
* Prior exposure to deploying production-ready AI systems via APIs, containers (Docker), or cloud infrastructure.
* Exhibit a strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a proactive willingness to experiment, learn, and iterate.
* Maintain a genuine passion for engineering practical, reliable, and scalable AI solutions to address real internal business problems.

description:

Our clients from Indonesia: Astra International, Traveloka, Angkasa Pura, Peduli Anak Foundation. Our clients from Australia: Bike Exchange, Downsizing, Red Balloon, Sectara, and many more.
  
  
**What will you get?**

* Competitive Salary. We believe that salary is one of the main factors that keep the employee in the company, therefore we can guarantee a competitive salary for our Staff.
* Career Development & Training. We have a wonderful onboarding process where we help new team members get familiar with how we work.
* Reasonable & Flexible Schedules. We are encouraging a culture where people can have a good work-life balance. Our schedules are pretty flexible. Need to run an errand in the middle of the day? Totally cool.
* English Class. Working in SoftwareSeni means that you would get massive improvement in your English, both spoken and written guarantee!
* Annual Leave entitlement. 12 working days which can be taken after 3 months of joining.
* Performance Review. We will review your performance twice annually in December and June. So, you can focus on your work and improve your performance every day.
* Relocation Allowance. We provide a relocation allowance if you do not live in Yogyakarta. The allowance will cover moving costs for you and your family.
* Staff Engagement Activities. We provide fun icebreaker activities in the middle of our working hours to chill and build relationships with all the staff. Sounds fun, right?
* Birthday Leave. We also want to celebrate our staff's happiest day by giving them half-day leave on their birthday.

**Requirement**

* Previous working experience as a Node.js Developer for a minimum of 5 years.
* Have good knowledge about Node.js and JavaScript in general (knowledge of ES6 is preferred).
* Hands-on experience with HTML and CSS.
* Development experience working with object-oriented and functional programming.
* Applicable knowledge of popular modules and frameworks such as Express.js and React.js.
* Familiarity with non-relational databases like MongoDB or DynamoDB.
* Have good knowledge of JavaScript unit testing.
* Have good knowledge and experience in building REST API using Node.js.
* Strong analytical skills and problem-solving aptitude.
* Attention to details

**Responsibilities**

* Work as part of a team developing applications and services using Agile development methods.
* Contribute to team and organisational improvements in process and infrastructure.
* Code, test and operate Node.js based services.
* Effectively use tools and ingenuity to identify and fix defects before they become a problem.

title: Intern - Manufacturing Process Engineering
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**Our Facility:**

Located in Cikarang, INDONESIA (60 min from Jakarta).  
SEC is one of the most important factories in South-East Asia. It an ETO plant producing Medium and Low voltage solutions for our customers. It covers 33,000 sq meters and has more than 800 employees.

**As Intern - Manufacturing Process Engineering, you will be joining our Methods team. The main objective of the Methods team in the factory is to continuously improve our performance and service level. Our mission is simple:**

* Design, map and improve our processes
* Prepare the work instructions (JBS/OWS) for our operators
* Implement digital and automation solutions
* Apply the SPS (Schneider Production System) and use it as a guide
* Identify waste and process deviation using Lean tools (LADM, Kaizen, Red/green, VSM etc.)
* Be the point of contact for resolution of issues related to process design
* Track operations performance and analyze root cause for improvement
* Collaborate with other departments: Operation, Supply Chain, Quality, etc.

**What will you do?**

  

* Contribute to the global efficiency of the factory and warehouse
* Bring diagnoses expertise to optimize means, methods, tools and systems.
* Lead complex and transversal projects to improve processes using the right methodology focusing on:
* + Safety and ergonomics.
  + Quality & Customer satisfaction.
  + Efficiency & Service Level.
  + Cost reduction.
* Manage big projects related to logistic, manufacturing or digitalization.Analyze end to end logistic flow in order to propose improvements and keep our customers satisfied

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

* Active student (D3/D4/S1, max 8th Semester) from Industrial Engineering, Logistics, and other relevant fields.
* Available to intern onsite for up to 12 months.
* Fluency in English.
* Advanced level on Excel, PowerPoint, and AutoCAD 2D.
* Knowledgeable in manufacturing process or supply chain.
* Fast learning and ability to work under pressure.
* Problem solving and result oriented mindset.
* Experience in process improvement, lean implementation and/or warehouse process design.
* Experience in implementation of SMART technologies (Cobot, AGV, etc.)

(External) English Qualifications:

**What's in it for me?**

* An attractive mission
* A competitive salary
* A great learning experience
* An opportunity to grow

Bring your engineering talent to a team that values innovation and excellence — apply today!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

-----------------------

Motorola Solutions Services team is seeking a highly experienced Senior Field Engineer to provide technical leadership and advanced support for our customer and solutions. This role is key to ensuring the reliability, performance, and successful lifecycle management of mission-critical systems.
  
  
You will be expected to independently lead and manage the design, implementation, and maintenance of complex service and support solutions for our customer networks, and mentor junior team members.

**Job Description**

* **Provide expert-level, full-time on-site and remote support for complex deployed systems, collaborating directly with customers, internal teams, and vendors.**
* **Lead advanced incident response, drive complex root cause analysis (RCA), and implement preventative measures.**
* **Design and implement value-added services, process optimization, and automation solutions utilizing scripting, data analytics, and industry best practices.**
* **Act as the primary technical interface and trusted advisor to customers, advocating for their needs and driving high-priority issue resolution.**
* **Lead small-scale projects or technical work streams related to system upgrades, maintenance, and solution improvements.**
* **Occasional out-of-hours support and on-site customer travel may be required.**

**Basic Requirements**
----------------------

* **Domain Expertise: Public Safety and Mission Critical operations, advanced Data Analytics, deep knowledge of Tetra/other Land Mobile Radio (LMR) Systems or advanced GSM/LTE/5G technologies & Cybersecurity Products & principles.**

* **Service Management: Demonstrated expertise in Customer Support, Maintenance, and Life Cycle Management and to respond promptly to customer requests.**

* **Leadership and Communication: Proven strong interpersonal, collaborative, and team leadership skills, with the ability to coordinate across various groups and functional teams.**
* **Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, listening, negotiation, and presentation skills, with proven ability to present complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences. Customer communication and engagement is key crucial.**
* **Problem-Solving: Advanced problem-solving and critical thinking skills, with the ability to lead resolution efforts for major incidents.**

**Travel Requirements**
-----------------------

10-25%

**Relocation Provided**
-----------------------

None

**Position Type**
-----------------

Experienced

**Referral Payment Plan**
-------------------------

Yes

Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. title: .NET MAUI Mobile Developer
description:
**SoftwareSeni** is a Software Development Company based in Yogyakarta & Sydney, Australia. We have been designing and developing phone apps, websites, and mobile experiences. We love solving tough problems – from user experience to design and code. We build enterprise web-based solutions for clients all over the world, from Australia, Indonesia, Europe, Africa, and America. Our clients from Indonesia: Astra International, Traveloka, Angkasa Pura, and Peduli Anak Foundation. Our clients from Australia: Bike Exchange, Downsizing, Red Balloon, Sectara, and many more.

**What will you get?**

* **Competitive Salary**. We believe that salary is one of the main factors that keep the employee in the company, therefore, we can guarantee a competitive salary for our Staff.
* **Career Development & Training**. We have a wonderful onboarding process where we help new team members get familiar with how we work.
* **Reasonable & Flexible Schedules**. We are encouraging a culture where people can have a good work-life balance. Our schedules are pretty flexible. Need to run an errand in the middle of the day? Totally cool.
* **English Class**. Working in SoftwareSeni means that you would get massive improvement in your English, both spoken and written guarantee!
* **Annual Leave entitlement**. 12 working days, which can be taken after 3 months of joining.
* **Performance Review**. We will review your performance twice annually in December and June. So, you can focus on your work and improve your performance every day.
* **Relocation Allowance**. We provide a relocation allowance if you do not live in Yogyakarta. The allowance will cover moving costs for you and your family.
* **Staff Engagement Activities**. We provide fun icebreaker activities in the middle of our working hours to chill and build relationships with all the staff. Sounds fun, right?
* **Birthday Leave**. We also want to celebrate our staff's happiest day by giving them a half-day leave on their birthday.

  

**Requirements:**

* Minimum **3 years** of experience with **.NET / C#**, including at least **1–2 years** of experience developing mobile applications with .**NET MAUI or Xamarin.Forms.**
* Strong command of **C# and the .NET ecosystem**, with working knowledge of .NET Framework for legacy applications.
* Proven experience b**uilding and releasing mobile applications** for Android and iOS using .NET MAUI.
* Solid understanding of **MVVM**, data binding, dependency injection, and navigation patterns.
* Experience consuming **RESTful APIs** and handling offline or intermittent connectivity in mobile applications.
* Experience with **ASP.NET Core Web API, Entity Framework, and LINQ.**
* Knowledge of SQL Server and database design.
* Familiarity with Git-based workflows and branching conventions.
* Experience with React Native or Flutter will be a plus.
* Experience with React for web front-end development will be a plus.
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design and SOLID principles.
* Good understanding of async/await, threading, and mobile app responsiveness.
* Familiarity with mobile app lifecycle, permissions, push notifications, and local storage.
* Experience with App Store and Google Play Store submission, signing, and release processes.
* Knowledge of secure coding practices, including input validation and secure storage of tokens and credentials.
* Skilled in debugging and profiling mobile performance issues, such as slow startup, memory growth, and UI stuttering.
* Able to break down tasks, provide estimates, and identify risks early.
* Willing to learn new technology stacks and adapt to unfamiliar frameworks.
* **Possess strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.**
* **Having experience with front-end development will be a plus**
* **Willing to work onsite at our Yogyakarta Office**.

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop SoftwareSeni's products.
* Work as a team to investigate and resolve issues.

* **Note: This position requires fluency in English, as most communication will be conducted in English.**

**If you're confident (or eager to grow) in using English at work, this position could be a great fit.**

  

**Disclaimer:** By submitting your application, you consent to PT Software Services Indonesia collecting and processing your information for recruitment purposes. **Please submit only your CV/resume at this stage; do not attach additional personal identification or sensitive documents.** Your details will be treated with strict confidentiality and used solely to evaluate your application for current or future employment opportunities with us.

title: Lead Data Scientist - Lending
description:
**About the Role**

In this role, you will be an integral player within Data Science team based on Jakarta. You will take the wheel in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models for a variety of consumer and merchant lending products GoPay offers in Indonesia. Your responsibilities will include enhancing our credit risk models by leveraging innovative and cutting-edge algorithms on GoTo data and third-party data vendors. Most importantly, your efforts will work to bring wider financial inclusion to more people in the region and beyond.

### **What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end modeling modeling initiatives and business outcomes / metrics.
* Work with the business/product team in defining, prototyping, and implementing data science models and other supporting DS initiatives.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing data science team, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.
* Oversee the development of consumer credit risk models and statistical analyses to optimize decision-making and business outcomes.

### **What You Will Need**

* Bachelor degree or above in science and engineering related majors such as statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, etc.
* At least 6-7 years of hands-on experience in building, evaluating, and monitoring risk models.
* Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
* Comfortable using Python, SQL, and UNIX Shell.
* Understand business concerns and formulate them as technical problems that can be solved using data and math/stats/ML.
* Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a strong sense of ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Good communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
* Able to write model documentation clearly and concisely and support recommendations with research and data.

**About the Team**

Our team leverages big data from the GoTo universe, as well as external data, to build various predictive models to support the risk strategy team in real-time credit underwriting and management of the customer lifecycle Cicil (BNPL) and Pinjam (cash loans) products. As our model scores are key inputs to risk decisioning (e.g. approval/rejection of loans, credit limit adjustments), we are also able to see the direct impact of our models on the business and our customers.

We are a growing team and are constantly looking for opportunities to use data science to enhance our credit and fraud risk management capabilities. We are focused on growth and efficiency. We are all about open knowledge sharing and self-improvement. We believe that “Data Science is a team sport.”

**About GoTo Group**

GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.

The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

**About Gojek**

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

title: Junior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About WidaTech**

WidaTech is a technology and business consulting firm based in Indonesia, with nearly seven years of experience helping companies achieve digital transformation and scale with measurable, technology-driven results. Today, WidaTech serves clients across eight countries, supporting organizations in overcoming their most complex challenges. We deliver solutions through a combination of strategic management consulting and technology innovation.

To consistently deliver exceptional outcomes, we believe great solutions come from people who are curious, adaptable, and motivated to solve real-world problems. We foster a culture where learning, collaboration, and ownership are valued, enabling our team to create meaningful impact for the businesses we work with.

**What You Will Do**

As a Junior Forward Deployed Engineer at WidaTech, you will work closely with both clients and internal teams to solve real operational and business problems through technology. You will be involved from understanding the problem, discussing solutions with stakeholders, all the way to building and deploying the solution itself. This role is not only about coding, but you will also need to communicate well, think critically, and adapt quickly to different client environments and industries.

At WidaTech, we actively use AI tools as part of our development workflow. You will be expected to leverage tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, and others to improve productivity, speed up development, and help deliver better solutions for clients. You'll work closely with senior engineers on client projects, gaining hands-on experience while gradually taking ownership of smaller, well-scoped initiatives as your skills and confidence grow. If you enjoy solving problems, learning quickly, and building things that are actually used by people, this role will suit you well.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Here are some of the things you'll be involved in as a Junior Forward Deployed Engineer at WidaTech:

* Work directly with clients (remote or on-site) to understand their workflows, operational challenges, and technical requirements.
* Design, develop, and deploy software solutions based on client needs, including backend systems, APIs, frontend applications, integrations, and data processing.
* Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) as part of the daily development workflow for coding, debugging, documentation, and research.
* Build and integrate AI-powered solutions such as LLM integrations, AI agents, automation workflows, and RAG pipelines where relevant to the client’s use cases.
* Translate business and operational requirements into technical solutions together with WidaTech’s business teams.
* Conduct discovery sessions and technical discussions with stakeholders to understand current processes and identify improvement opportunities.
* Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions based on feedback and changing requirements.
* Integrate solutions with existing client systems, third-party platforms, enterprise software, and cloud services.
* Own technical delivery from development until production deployment, including testing, documentation, and handover to client teams.
* Identify technical risks or implementation challenges early and communicate them clearly to stakeholders.
* Support pre-sales and solutioning discussions through technical recommendations, estimations, and proof-of-concept development.
* Participate in code reviews and maintain good engineering practices across projects.
* Document solutions, system architecture, and implementation details properly for future maintenance and scalability.
* Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and industry knowledge to improve both individual and team capabilities.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* 0–2 years of hands-on software engineering experience.
* Proficiency in at least one modern backend language (e.g., Python, Node.js, Java, Go) and experience building and consuming REST or GraphQL APIs.
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT) as part of regular development workflows.
* Comfortable with frontend development (React, Vue, or similar) and able to build functional, user-facing interfaces when needed.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with the ability to diagnose and resolve issues quickly in live, production-facing environments.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks or projects in parallel while maintaining quality.
* Comfort with ambiguity and rapidly changing requirements; you adapt quickly and bring structure to undefined problems.
* Fluent in English (written and spoken); proficiency in Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia) or other Asian languages is a strong plus given our regional client base.
* Must be able to travel and work on-site with clients when required.
* A genuine passion for understanding business problems and using technology, especially AI, as a lever to solve them.

**Good to have:**

* Experience in startups, consulting, freelance projects, or fast-paced environments is a plus.
* Good communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Hands-on experience building or integrating AI-powered features: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.), RAG pipelines, AI agents, or ML model serving.
* Understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience deploying applications to cloud environments.
* Experience working with relational and non-relational databases, including data modeling and query optimization.
* Familiarity with agile workflows, Git, CI/CD, and collaborative development practices

**Application Process**

We're always excited to meet curious builders who enjoy solving problems and learning new things. If this role sounds interesting to you, we'd love to hear from you.

Our team reviews every application carefully. If we believe there is a good fit, we'll reach out to discuss the opportunity further.

**Job details**

Location:
**Tangerang Selatan, Banten**

Division:
**Engineering Team**

Experience Level:
**Junior Level**

Type:
**Full-Time**

Contract Type:
**Permanent**

Job Description:

Join our team as a Manufacturing Process Quality professional and help us deliver products that exceed customer expectations. You'll play a key role in driving quality culture, improving process robustness, and ensuring every manufacturing change maintains our high standards.

**What will you do?**

* Implement quality culture initiatives across manufacturing sites through process control and continuous improvement programs
* Perform process audits and root cause analysis to identify and mitigate quality risks
* Oversee quality aspects of new manufacturing line implementations and process changes through structured change management
* Partner with procurement quality to ensure suppliers address manufacturing-related quality issues effectively

* **Quality Strategy** — advanced level; developing site-level quality plans that align with customer satisfaction goals
* **Five Whys** — advanced level; leading structured root cause investigations to eliminate recurring defects
* **PFMEA** — advanced level; conducting failure mode analysis to prevent quality risks in manufacturing processes
* **Problem Solving** — intermediate level; resolving quality issues using structured methodologies
* **Process Auditing** — intermediate level; evaluating manufacturing processes against quality standards
* **Quality Management Systems** — intermediate level; implementing and maintaining QMS frameworks in production environments
* **Root Cause Analysis** — intermediate level; investigating quality incidents to drive permanent corrective actions
* **Change Management** — intermediate level; ensuring quality during manufacturing line changes and new implementations

* Meticulous attention to detail with unwavering commitment to quality excellence

description:
**POSITION SUMMARY**

To assist the Operations Manager, Power to carry out the company’s commitment and promise delivery of service level to the customers.

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Field Service Engineer with a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering to join our team. This position will primarily focus on providing on-site service, maintenance, and support for critical electrical systems in data centers, including Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) systems. The ideal candidate will have strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, along with a solid understanding of electrical systems and data center operations.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Perform installation, commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, analyzes and prepare root cause analysis report (RCA), 24X7 support of UPS systems and other critical electrical equipment within data centers.
* Conduct preventive maintenance and repair tasks on UPS systems, power distribution units (PDUs), static transfer switch (STS), electrical panels, and related equipment.
* Troubleshoot electrical issues, including power outages, UPS failures, and system alarms, ensuring minimal downtime.
* Provide technical support for clients, answering queries and delivering solutions for electrical system issues.
* Maintain accurate documentation of service activities, including work orders, reports, and service history.
* Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to ensure seamless integration and operation of electrical systems in the data center.
* Ensure compliance with safety regulations and company procedures while working on-site.
* Perform regular inspections and testing of electrical systems to ensure they are operating at peak performance.
* Assist with the training of junior engineers and technicians on electrical systems and best practices.
* Monitor and track system performance and suggest improvements to enhance efficiency and reliability.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* Proven experience (3-5+ years) in field of service engineering, specifically with UPS systems and data center electrical systems.
* Strong knowledge of electrical systems, including UPS, Battery, STS, PDUs, transformers, and power distribution.
* Ability to troubleshoot, analyze and prepare root cause analysis report (RCA) electrical issues, read and interpret electrical schematics, and perform hands-on repairs.
* Familiarity with data center operations and critical power systems.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work under pressure.
* Strong communication skills and ability to interact with clients and internal teams.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks efficiently.
* Knowledge of safety standards and procedures related to electrical systems.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Experience with advanced UPS models and other backup power solutions.
* Familiarity with data center infrastructure management (DCIM) tools.
* Certifications in UPS maintenance, electrical safety, or similar fields are a plus.

**PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS**

Please list all physical and environmental demands that may performed on a regular basis.  



**TIME TRAVEL REQUIRED**

* 90%

description:
At FLSmidth, you will collaborate with talented professionals from diverse cultures, learning and creating innovative, sustainable solutions that shape the future of mining.

As a Field Service Engineer, you will be dedicated to delivering world-class support to our customers, working onsite to ensure equipment reliability, safety, and performance. This is a hands-on role where you’ll make a direct impact on our customers’ operations.

**Your Responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Provide services and customer support during assigned onsite roster
* Perform installation, commissioning, calibration, repair, maintenance, and testing of complex equipment
* Identify and resolve advanced technical problems during start-up and operations
* Research, evaluate, and recommend new products or equipment upgrades to meet customer needs
* Deliver troubleshooting support and train customers on equipment features and functionality
* Conduct regular site evaluations to determine maintenance requirements and performance improvements
* Ensure operational uptime by addressing equipment maintenance and troubleshooting issues
* Promote a culture of safety, teamwork, and continuous improvement in all onsite activities
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships to secure future business opportunities

**What You Bring**
------------------

* Vocational/Technical education or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (or related field)
* 3–5 years’ experience in the mining or heavy industrial service industry (preferred)
* Strong hands-on skills in equipment installation, commissioning, and maintenance
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
* Ability to work onsite following customer roster, including in remote areas
* Broad knowledge of operational procedures, maintenance tools, and troubleshooting methods
* Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to work under pressure and limited supervision
* Excellent communication skills and ability to train customers effectively
* A collaborative team player who can also work independently
* Willingness to travel extensively across mine sites in Southeast Asia

**Why Join Us?**
----------------

* Work in an international, multicultural environment with global exposure
* Be part of a team delivering sustainable, future-focused solutions to the mining industry
* Develop professionally through challenging assignments and opportunities to learn from global experts
* Contribute to a safety-first culture where your skills and ideas are valued

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive remuneration package on offer.
* Work-life balance with a flexible work schedule so you can focus on professional and personal priorities.
* Job security in a volatile market. Since 1882, FLSmidth has operated successfully within a global environment.
* Development and training within a respected global OEM company.
* Access to salary packaging options to allow you to maximize your after-tax income.
* Employee Assistance Program for employees and immediate family.
* Purchased annual leave options.
* Paid Parental Leave
* Access to a recognition and benefits platform.
* Involvement with community and charity initiatives.

As an equal-opportunity employer, FLSmidth embraces diversity and equality by promoting an environment of inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply - the more diverse our employees are, the stronger our team is.

In our commitment to equal opportunity and eliminating bias, we kindly request that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, number of children, and photographs from your application materials.

Please apply by clicking "apply" on this page.

Kindly note that we will be reviewing applications and conducting interviews on an ongoing basis so please apply as soon as possible.

Successful candidates will be contacted by email.

No recruiters and unsolicited agency referrals, please.

We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

**SoftwareSeni**
is a Software Development Company based in Yogyakarta & Sydney, Australia. We have been designing and developing phone apps, websites, and mobile experiences. We love solving tough problems – from user experience to design and code. We build enterprise web-based solutions for clients all over the world, from Australia, Indonesia, Europe, Africa, and America. Our clients from Indonesia: Astra International, Traveloka, Angkasa Pura, and Peduli Anak Foundation. Our clients from Australia: Bike Exchange, Downsizing, Red Balloon, Sectara, and many more.
  
  
**What will you get?**

* Competitive Salary. We believe that salary is one of the main factors that keep employees in the company, therefore, we can guarantee a competitive salary for our Staff.
* Career Development & Training. We have a wonderful onboarding process where we help new team members get familiar with how we work.
* Reasonable & Flexible Schedules. We are encouraging a culture where people can have a good work-life balance. Our schedules are pretty flexible. Need to run an errand in the middle of the day? Totally cool.
* English Class. Working in SoftwareSeni means that you will get massive improvement in your English, both spoken and written, guaranteed!
* Annual Leave Entitlement. 12 working days, which can be taken after 3 months of joining.
* Performance Review. We will review your performance twice annually in December and June. So, you can focus on your work and improve your performance every day.
* Relocation Allowance. We provide a relocation allowance if you do not live in Yogyakarta. The allowance will cover moving costs for you and your family.
* Staff Engagement Activities. We provide fun icebreaker activities in the middle of our working hours to chill and build relationships with all the staff. Sounds fun, right?
* Birthday Leave. We also want to celebrate our staff's happiest day by giving them a half-day leave on their birthday.

**Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in .NET, with strong hands-on experience in .NET Framework 4.8.
* Solid experience building/maintaining desktop applications using WinForms.
* Strong knowledge of SQL Server and database management.
* Experience with Entity Framework and LINQ.
* Familiar with Git and team-based development practices.
* Able to develop, test, and maintain applications following best practices
* Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to fellow developers.
* Actively participate in agile processes, including planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.
* Possess strong English communication skills, both written and spoken.
* Hands-on experience with frontend stack will be a plus.
* Willingness to relocate and work onsite in Yogyakarta.

**Responsibilities**

* Development of SoftwareSeni’s products.
* Work as a team to investigate and resolve issues.

**⚠️ Note: This position requires fluency in English, as most communication will be conducted in English**
. If you’re confident (or eager to grow) in using English at work, this position could be a great fit.

**Please submit only your CV/resume at this stage; do not attach additional personal identification or sensitive documents.**
Your details will be treated with strict confidentiality and used solely to evaluate your application for current or future employment opportunities with us.

description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist (Analytics) to join our dynamic Marketing and Growth team in Jakarta, Indonesia. In this role, you will be at the forefront of driving data-informed growth strategy and user engagement across our organization. You will partner closely with Marketing and Growth teams to define and implement regional strategies aimed at expanding our user base and enhancing user engagement.s
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
We are looking for a Senior Growth Data Scientist specializing in CRM programs to join our dynamic team in Jakarta, Indonesia. In this role, you will do more than traditional analytics: you will combine advanced CRM analytics, machine learning, and experimentation with an AI-first mindset to build scalable, intelligent growth solutions. Beyond standard data workflows, you will identify opportunities to create AI-powered frameworks and self-serve tools—utilizing technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI—to scale growth strategies and optimize customer relationship management programs. Reporting to the Manager who is based in our Singapore Office.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Develop and implement data-driven strategies to enhance customer acquisition, retention, and engagement.
* Design and conduct A/B tests and experiments to improve CRM programs and marketing campaigns.
* Build predictive models to forecast customer behavior and identify growth opportunities.
* Analyze customer lifecycle data to obtain applicable insights and improve customer segmentation.
* Drive plans and initiatives involving Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI to automate workflows and enhance CRM personalization.
* Develop automated, self-serve AI solutions and analytical frameworks that enable stakeholders to make faster, scalable business decisions.
* Collaborate with Product, Marketing, and Engineering teams to translate complex analytical findings into clear, applicable recommendations.
* Create dashboards and systemic reporting solutions to communicate main performance metrics and trends.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* Minimum Bachelor's Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in data science, with a strong focus on growth analytics, customer lifecycle analysis, and CRM strategies.
* An AI-first mindset: a strong curiosity and willingness to experiment with new tools, automation, Generative AI, and LLMs to elevate analytics and decision-making.
* Proficiency in statistical analysis, machine learning algorithms, and data visualization techniques.
* Expert-level programming skills in Python, R, or SQL.
* Familiarity with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot)
* Proven track record in designing, executing, and analyzing A/B tests and growth experiments.
* Experience or demonstrated capability in developing scalable, self-serve data products or AI-powered solutions for commercial or product environments.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Insurance
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
At Financial Services, we empower the people of Southeast Asia, from consumers and drivers to every-day entrepreneurs, by ensuring financial inclusion for the underserved. The team is building solutions by enabling our partners (i.e. drivers and merchants) to get access to financial services (lending and insurance) products for their everyday needs.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
You will report to the Engineering Manager, Insurance, based in Indonesia and will develop the complex backend systems powering the many end-to-end user journeys across all Insurance products available in multiple Grab apps. We're looking for candidates that embody ownership, display a hunger for learning and improvement, excel in autonomy, and have the desire to go above and beyond expectations.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

- You will develop high-quality and scalable backend applications
- You will write clean, efficient, and maintainable code to solve challenging problems in the InsurTech domain
- You will collaborate with diverse teams to design, and ship new features
- You will participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge
- Your comprehensive understanding to troubleshoot, debug complex issues, and provide quick resolutions
- You will contribute to the architectural decisions and technical direction of the projects
- You will participate in On-Call rotations to ensure the reliability of services

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

- Years of relevant experience in software development, with proficiency in one of the major programming languages, e.g., Golang (preferred) and Java, relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle and code versioning systems like Git
- Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures, and capability to recognise when to use them
- Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, e.g., AWS
- Experience with the clean architecture principles and ability to write extensible code for complex projects following SOLID principles
- Expertise in writing clean, efficient, maintainable code and documentations

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

- We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
- With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
- Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
- We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
- Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

description:
### **What you will be doing:**

* **Ship End-to-End:** Own features from design to release—spot UX gaps early, ship core value first, log tech debt deliberately, and clean it up later.
* **Partner with Product:** Analyze technical feasibility, document requirements, estimate timelines, and build work plans alongside product managers.
* **Empower the Team:** Unblock peers through prompt PR reviews, pair programming, and hands-on coaching.
* **Work Smarter with AI:** Leverage AI tools for routine tasks (unit tests, docs, clarifications) to maximize time spent on core logic.

Medor is a leading recruitment partner in Indonesia and Asia-Pacific, bringing over a decade of experience. The customer is a technology company developing an autonomous freight management platform. Their culture values engineering quality, automation, practical problem-solving, and outcomes that create measurable value for customers.

**Job Summary:**

As the Senior Software Engineer, you will design, build, maintain, and evolve a freight management platform. You will combine hands-on software development with technical leadership, mentoring, and a strong focus on platform stability, scalability, and engineering quality. **Responsibilities:**

- Design, develop, test, and maintain production-grade software across the platform.
- Deliver scalable, secure, maintainable, and customer-focused features using modern engineering practices.
- Lead complex technical implementations involving APIs, integrations, workflow automation, AI services, and distributed systems.
- Participate in solution design, technical planning, architectural reviews, estimation, and risk identification.
- Provide technical guidance and mentoring to developers across the engineering team.
- Lead code reviews and promote strong coding, testing, deployment, and platform design standards.
- Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks, reliability issues, and recurring production problems.
- Improve system observability, resiliency, monitoring, alerting, runbooks, and operational readiness.
- Support incident investigation, root-cause analysis, and the continued development of the production-support model.
- Use AI-assisted development tools to improve development speed, quality, and automation.
- Contribute to agent-based solutions and identify opportunities to reduce manual work through automation.
- Review and validate AI-assisted outputs before production deployment.
- Reduce technical debt while improving platform maintainability, scalability, and delivery velocity.
- Work closely with Product, Customer Success, Support, Commercial, and Operations teams to translate business needs into practical technical solutions.
- Communicate progress, risks, dependencies, and technical recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
- Support customer-facing technical initiatives, onboarding, and deployment activities when required.

**Requirements:**

- Minimum 7 years of professional software development experience.
- Strong experience with modern cloud-native architecture, software design patterns, and engineering best practices.
- Strong hands-on experience with .NET, preferably .NET 8 or newer.
- Experience building APIs, integrations, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures.
- Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps practices.
- Ability to design scalable, maintainable, and reliable systems; strong system-design experience is highly preferred.
- Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
- Experience mentoring developers, conducting code reviews, and improving engineering standards.
- Comfortable taking ownership of testing and quality assurance for your own work in an environment without a dedicated QA function.
- Experience using AI development tools, such as Anthropic or Codex, and contributing to AI or agent-based solutions is highly desirable.
- Experience integrating enterprise platforms such as SAP, TMS, ERP, warehouse, or logistics systems is an advantage.
- Experience in freight, logistics, transport, or supply-chain technology is a plus.
- Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively in a remote, cross-functional environment.

**For this position, the client’s budget is between IDR 18.000.000 - 28.000.000 /month**

title: Pricing Senior Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
  
  
*Job ID: MJ000307*
**About Traveloka**
Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.
  
  
We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.
  
  
**About The Team**
Accommodation Data is the analytical engine behind how millions of travellers across Southeast Asia find and book the right place to stay — from budget guesthouses to premium international chains. We turn billions of search, pricing, and booking signals into the models and insights that shape supply quality, competitive pricing, ranking, and conversion. When a traveller sees the right property at the right price, that is our work.
  
  
Here you build at real scale on real markets, not slideware. You own problems end to end — framing the question, shipping the model or the analysis, and watching it move conversion and revenue across 11 countries. You will help build the cross-sell bridge that turns a flight booking into a full trip. We are not importing someone else's playbook for this region; we are writing our own, and you can write the next chapter of it.
  
  
**About The Job**
As a Principal Accom Data Analyst on Traveloka’s Accommodation team, you are a senior expert individual contributor with no direct reports who develops and implements the operational analytics plan for the Accommodation business area — work with direct impact on that area’s overall results and performance.
  
  

- Own and deliver the operational analytics plan for the Accommodation business area in line with the domain’s priorities, with your work directly shaping its results.
- Tackle genuinely complex problems that require in-depth understanding of impact across operational, financial, and human-capital dimensions, and turn them into clear recommendations.
- Build the advanced models, segmentations, and experiments the business uses to set direction, applying deep, well-developed expertise built from theory and experience.
- Enhance the metric definitions, pipelines, and analytical processes your area runs on as part of project teams, raising the standard others inherit.
- Persuade and convince senior business and tech stakeholders of the right course of action with evidence, even when the decision-making authority sits with them.
- Set the technical bar for rigour and experimentation across a wide analytics surface, leading through expertise rather than line authority.
- Propose strong inputs and mentor other analysts as the go-to expert, without owning a team or carrying people-management accountability.

**Job Requirements**

- You have at least 8 years of relevant experience.
- You are deeply expert in SQL, BI tooling, and advanced analytical methods — segmentation, experimentation, modelling — and still build hands-on.
- You have repeatedly solved complex, ambiguous problems whose impact spans operations, finance, and people.
- You design and interpret experiments to a high standard and improve how your area runs them.
- You build dashboards, pipelines, and data products (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, cloud platforms) that the business trusts as the source of truth.
- You influence senior business and tech leaders and have shaped real strategy with your analysis.
- You are the technical reference point others come to — you raise the bar through expertise, not headcount.
- You mentor and guide peers as a senior individual contributor, without managing a team.
- You have a degree in a quantitative field (or equivalent) and typically at least 7 years in analytics, BI, or data science.
- You communicate with executive presence in English — concise, clear, persuasive — and bring strong business acumen.
- You have built a reusable analytics framework or self-serve data product that scaled across multiple teams.
- You have led a high-stakes analytics initiative end to end and can point to the business decision it changed.
- You have driven adoption of AI-assisted analytics among your peers while keeping rigour high.

**Join Us**
If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.
  
  
We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.
  
  
We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.
