description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**What will you do:**

  

* Design and implement reliable, flexible and balanced manufacturing processes while taking into account the safety requirements, product quality and in accordance with our production system’s principles.
* Monitor productivity of the plant and solve problems when they occur.
* Prepare and present motion-time analysis and productivity reports.
* Identify, analyze and implement improvements to the technical limits and human interfaces of the manufacturing processes

**What qualifications will make you successful:**

* Active Bachelor Degree or Diploma student (max. 8th semester) in Industrial/ Mechanical/ Electrical/ Electronics/ Manufacturing Engineering or equivalent
* Proficient in AutoCAD, LADM, MTM, Microsoft Office applications, Gerber software.
* Analytical with a keen eye for detail
* Customer service and quality oriented.
* Good written and spoken English
* Willing to be placed in Cikarang

(External) English Qualifications:

**What's in it for me:**

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Ready to gain experience that matters? Apply now and start building your future!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

(External) English Company Boiler Plate:

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

*Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*

title: IT Full-Stack Developer (ERP & AI Automation)
description:
**Responsibilities**

**ERP & Internal System**

  

* Mengembangkan, memelihara, dan menyempurnakan sistem ERP dan aplikasi internal perusahaan (inventory, purchasing, sales, finance, warehouse, HR).
* Membangun dan mengelola integrasi antar sistem, termasuk dengan marketplace (TikTok Shop, Shopee, Tokopedia), platform kolaborasi, dan sistem pihak ketiga melalui API.
* Merancang dan mengelola struktur database agar data operasional akurat, konsisten, dan siap dipakai untuk reporting.
* Membangun dashboard dan reporting otomatis untuk kebutuhan manajemen dan tim operasional.

**AI Agent & Automation**

5. Merancang dan membangun AI agent serta workflow otomatisasi berbasis LLM (Claude, OpenAI, dll.) untuk mempercepat proses bisnis seperti customer service, analisis data, reporting, dan operasional harian.

6. Mengidentifikasi proses manual dan repetitif di seluruh divisi, lalu mengotomatiskannya menggunakan RPA, workflow automation, atau scripting.

7. Mengevaluasi dan mengimplementasikan tools AI baru yang relevan untuk meningkatkan produktivitas tim.

**Website & Infrastruktur**

8. Mengembangkan dan memelihara website perusahaan serta aplikasi web internal.

9. Mengelola deployment, hosting, keamanan, backup, dan akses user pada seluruh sistem perusahaan.

**Support, Dokumentasi & Enablement**

10. Mengumpulkan kebutuhan dari tiap divisi dan menerjemahkannya menjadi solusi teknis yang dapat dieksekusi.

11. Menyusun dokumentasi teknis (arsitektur sistem, alur data, SOP, akses) untuk setiap sistem yang dibangun, sehingga dapat diserahterimakan dan tidak bergantung pada satu orang.

12. Memberikan training dan support kepada user internal dalam penggunaan sistem dan tools otomatisasi.

 **Requirements**  

* Pendidikan minimal SMA/D3/S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait (atau setara dengan portofolio yang kuat).
* Pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai full-stack developer, diutamakan membangun sistem bisnis (ERP, inventory, order management, finance) di perusahaan retail, e-commerce, atau consumer goods.

* **Wajib menguasai tech stack berikut:Frontend:** React, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS, MobX (state management), Socket.IO Client, jsPDF
* **Backend:** Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript, MySQL/MariaDB, Sequelize (ORM), Socket.IO, JWT (authentication), Node-cron

* Berpengalaman membangun fitur real-time (Socket.IO/WebSocket) dan scheduled job (cron) di aplikasi production.
* Memahami desain database relasional: struktur tabel, relasi, indexing, migrasi, dan optimasi query.
* Berpengalaman melakukan integrasi API (REST, webhook), termasuk dengan API marketplace atau platform pihak ketiga.
* Memiliki pengalaman praktis membangun AI agent atau automation berbasis LLM API (Claude, OpenAI, dll.) yang sudah dipakai di lingkungan kerja nyata.
* Memahami alur proses bisnis (order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory) dan mampu menerjemahkannya menjadi sistem.
* Terbiasa menggunakan Git, menulis kode yang rapi dan terstruktur, serta mendokumentasikan pekerjaan dengan baik.
* Wajib melampirkan portofolio atau contoh sistem yang pernah dibangun (link GitHub, demo, atau studi kasus).

**Nilai Tambah:**

  

* Menguasai Python untuk scripting, data processing, atau AI automation.
* Familiar dengan tools workflow automation/RPA seperti n8n, Make, Zapier, UiPath, atau Power Automate.
* Pengalaman deployment dan server management (Linux, Docker, Nginx, PM2, cloud VPS).
* Pengalaman dengan Lark/Feishu API atau integrasi sistem kolaborasi.
* Pengalaman membangun sistem multi-agent atau AI workflow yang kompleks.

 **About ANTARESTAR**

**ANTARESTAR** is a leading local brand committed to supporting all outdoor activities and fulfilling the needs of adventurers and ‘backpackers.’ Our mission is to empower exploration and deepen the love for our homeland by providing high-quality products that make travel easier and more enjoyable.

At Antarestar, we prioritize the needs of backpackers by offering reliable, durable, and practical gear that stands up to the demands of every journey.

With Antarestar, exploring the beauty of this country becomes more convenient, inspiring you to venture further and connect with the wonders of the world around you.

* Closing Administration: Assemble final program closing packs, secure customer work-completion letters for future bids, revoke system/site access, and archive digital and physical files to audit-ready standards.
* SAG PMO Office Administration: Manage internal onboarding, access requests, and general administrative logistics for the SAG PMO team.

  
**Requirements**  

* 2-5 years in project management / project administration.
* Experienced in supporting project delivery within Kementerian/Lembaga Pemerintah (central and regional government institutions), including coordination, administration and stakeholder engagement.
* Hands-on experience preparing BAST and supporting Berita Acara, routing them for signature and closing project administration with government or SOE customers.
* Able to keep contracts, correspondence and acceptance records complete, version-controlled and retrievable, in both physical and digital form.
* Experience scheduling meetings, preparing packs, writing minutes and running an action log for several projects at once.
* Willing and able to travel frequently to customer offices in Greater Jakarta, and occasionally to other cities, for meetings and signature follow-up.
* Clear and courteous written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia, including formal official correspondence; working English for internal documents and reports.
* Persistent, detail-minded and reliable; follows an open item through to closure without being reminded.
* Handles contracts, commercial terms and customer-sensitive documents with discretion.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office / Google Workspace, in particular Word, Excel and PDF tools.
* Experience compiling tender or bid administration documents, including submission through government e-procurement portals.
* Familiarity with PSOhub, Pipedrive, Jira or comparable project and CRM tools.
* Project administration or project management training (e.g. CAPM) is a plus.

  
**About PT ITSEC Asia Tbk**

ITSEC is one of the leading cybersecurity companies in the APAC region, listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange (IDX), with over 300 employees across five countries. We deliver end-to-end cybersecurity services and solutions, including Consulting Services, Security Solutions Integration, and Managed Security Services. ITSEC provides continuous IT infrastructure protection against multiplying cybersecurity threats and ensures compliance with increasingly demanding data protection and critical infrastructure regulations. Our expertise has been built over a decade of delivering thousands of high-quality cybersecurity projects, providing cutting-edge solutions in collaboration with world-class technology partners across financial, telecommunications, energy, transportation, manufacturing, and other critical industry sectors. We also have extensive experience in helping our customers with fraud prevention, Operational Technology (OT), and Industrial IoT (IIoT) security.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
description:
**Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with**
. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.
  
  
You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.
  
  
Why This Role Exists
  
  
We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.
  
  
The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own outcomes, not tickets. Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself
* Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on. OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits
* Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade. A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten
* Work directly with customers. You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix
* Raise the bar on the codebase. Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit
* Push the team forward. Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted

Who You Are
  
  

* You ship. Ideas without execution do not count for you
* High agency. You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start
* Strong opinions, loosely held. You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts
* Curious about the domain. Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you
* Fluent with AI. You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully
* Care about humans on the other end. Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point

Your Toolbox
  
  
We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.
  
  
What We Expect at This Level
  
  

* 6+ years building production systems. Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained
* Real AI experience. You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here
* Strong fundamentals. OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher
* Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP. At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation
* Communication. You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one

Not Suitable for the Role If...
  
  

* You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build
* You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes
* You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger
* You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product
* You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform

Why CoverGo
  
  
Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.
  
  
**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* 100% Remote Work
* Paid Annual Leave
* Annual Performance Bonus
* Remote Work Allowance
* Anniversary Bonus
* Health Insurance
* Company Activities and Events
* Learning and Development Plan

**CoverGo Company**

**The Role**

**Your Role**

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage, and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. As an **AI Storage Engineer** , you will play a critical role in supporting the high-performance storage platforms that power AI, machine learning, and large-scale compute environments.

  

You will be responsible for the operation, reliability, and performance of IBM Spectrum Scale (GPFS) storage environments, ensuring seamless access to data across distributed AI and HPC workloads. Working closely with infrastructure, compute, networking, and platform engineering teams, you will help maintain large-scale storage clusters, optimize performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive continuous service improvements.

  

If you're passionate about enterprise storage, distributed file systems, and solving challenging performance problems at scale, this role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI infrastructure.

  
  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Install, configure, administer, and maintain IBM Spectrum Scale (GPFS) clusters, Network Shared Disks (NSDs), filesystems, file sets, and storage pools.
* Monitor and optimize storage capacity, IOPS, latency, throughput, and overall cluster health to ensure high availability and performance.
* Manage GPFS architecture components, including quorum nodes, storage policies, replication, tiering, and data lifecycle management.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and troubleshooting for complex storage, performance, connectivity, and filesystem issues across distributed environments.
* Support storage lifecycle activities including upgrades, patching, migrations, capacity expansion, and performance tuning initiatives.
* Develop and implement storage policies, quotas, data placement strategies, and automation processes to meet business and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with compute, network, platform, and application teams to support AI, HPC, and data-intensive workloads.
Participate in incident response, problem management, operational readiness reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen service reliability.  

  
  
  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**

  

At Kyndryl, learning and growth are part of everyday work. As an AI Storage Engineer, you'll gain hands-on experience supporting cutting-edge AI and high-performance computing environments while developing expertise in large-scale distributed storage systems.

  

You'll collaborate with experienced infrastructure specialists, architects, and platform engineers while expanding your knowledge across AI infrastructure, storage engineering, automation, SRE practices, and cloud technologies. Whether your career path leads toward storage architecture, site reliability engineering, infrastructure leadership, or AI platform engineering, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, training, and support to help you achieve your goals.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. * Familiarity with change management, incident management, problem management, and operational best practices.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
* **English language proficiency is required.**

* Experience supporting AI, machine learning, HPC, GPU, or large-scale data analytics environments.

* Relevant certifications related to IBM Spectrum Scale, enterprise storage, Linux administration, or infrastructure operations.

Working closely with infrastructure, compute, networking, and platform engineering teams, you will help maintain large-scale storage clusters, optimize performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and drive continuous service improvements.

  

If you're passionate about enterprise storage, distributed file systems, and solving challenging performance problems at scale, this role offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of AI infrastructure.

  
  

**What You'll Do**

  

* Install, configure, administer, and maintain IBM Spectrum Scale (GPFS) clusters, Network Shared Disks (NSDs), filesystems, file sets, and storage pools.

* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and troubleshooting for complex storage, performance, connectivity, and filesystem issues across distributed environments.

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **5+ years of experience** supporting enterprise storage, distributed file systems, storage infrastructure, or large-scale data center environments.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, AI Builder
description:
**Insurance is one of the world's largest industries and one of the most painful to interact with**. Paper forms. Sluggish call centres. Three-week underwriting cycles. Claims that vanish into queues. We are rebuilding all of it on top of a modern platform and AI agents that actually do the work, not pretend to.

You will not be picking up tickets. You will be deciding what to build, prototyping it on Monday, shipping a draft to a real customer by Friday, and improving it from real usage. We expect you to push the product, the codebase, and the way we work.

Why This Role Exists

We are looking for someone who treats AI as a creative material, not a feature on a roadmap. The next year of insurance is being defined right now. What gets automated, what gets reimagined, what gets thrown out. We want builders who want to be in that room and ship the answer.

The team is small. The mandate is large. If your highest-energy work has historically come from solving real problems end to end, this is the seat.

**What You Will Do**

* **Own outcomes, not tickets.** Pick the biggest lever for our customers each sprint and drive it to live. Surface the next one yourself.
* **Build with AI as a primary tool, not a chatbot bolt-on.** OCR, document understanding, generation, agent loops, evaluation harnesses. You decide where each fits.
* **Ship prototypes fast, then make them production-grade.** A working demo on day three beats a perfect plan on day ten.
* **Work directly with customers.** You will see real claims, real underwriting screens, real broker workflows. You will watch users hit dead ends and decide what to fix.
* **Raise the bar on the codebase.** Reviews, refactors, testability, observability. Not as policy, as habit.
* **Push the team forward.** Skills, agents, internal tools, engineering standards. Propose them, build them, get them adopted.

Who You Are

* **You ship.** Ideas without execution do not count for you.
* **High agency.** You do not wait for a card to be assigned. You see what is worth doing and you start.
* **Strong opinions, loosely held.** You make calls with incomplete information and change your mind when the evidence shifts.
* **Curious about the domain.** Insurance is messy and full of weird incentives. That intrigues you, not annoys you.
* **Fluent with AI.** You have shipped something real with LLMs or agents. You know where the magic ends and where you have to engineer carefully.
* **Care about humans on the other end.** Insurance done right gives people peace of mind in their worst weeks. That is the point.

Your Toolbox

We use Node.js + TypeScript + Nest.js on the back end, Vue (and some React) on the front end, GraphQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS. AI work spans OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, plus a growing set of in-house skills and agents. You do not need to have used every piece. You do need to be the kind of engineer who picks up a new tool and is shipping with it within the week.

What We Expect at This Level

* **6+ years building production systems.** Track record of complex, customer-facing software shipped, not just maintained.
* **Real AI experience.** You have built and shipped at least one substantive AI-driven feature. POCs that died in a notebook do not count here.
* **Strong fundamentals.** OO, design patterns, testing, web security, performance. You do not need a refresher.
* **Cloud comfort. AWS, Azure, or GCP.** At least one in depth, the rest enough to hold a conversation.
* **Communication.** You can explain a tradeoff to a non-technical stakeholder in two minutes and to an engineer in one.

Not Suitable for the Role If…

* You prefer tickets assigned to you over choosing what to build.
* You measure your work in lines of code, not outcomes.
* You see AI as a buzzword to put on your CV rather than a tool you have actually used in anger.
* You want a process-heavy environment with detailed specs handed down from product.
* You are looking for a maintenance role on a finished platform.

Why CoverGo

Insurance is the rare industry where AI can save people hours of their worst weeks. We are already shipping AI-powered claims, underwriting, distribution, and document automation to enterprise carriers across five continents. The platform is real. The customers are real. The next chapter is yours to help write.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* 100% Remote Work
* Paid Annual Leave
* Annual Performance Bonus
* Remote Work Allowance
* Anniversary Bonus
* Health Insurance
* Company Activities and Events
* Learning and Development Plan

**CoverGo Company** **Video**

This role acts as a **trusted advisor to customers**, ensuring they achieve measurable outcomes through the effective use of Cisco solutions while strengthening long-term strategic relationships.

  + Enterprise Networking
  + Data Center Networking
  + Security
  + Collaboration
* Identify and prioritize **high-value use cases** aligned with customer business outcomes.
* Monitor product usage, health metrics, and adoption KPIs to ensure customers achieve desired outcomes.
* Provide guidance on best practices to maximize platform capabilities.

* Guide customers through the **Cisco Customer Success Lifecycle** including Onboard, Implement, Engage, Adopt, Expand, and Renew.
* Track customer milestones, adoption progress, and risk indicators.

title: GenAI Engineer
description:
**Come grow with us at the frontier of GenAI.**

ArcFusion is expanding rapidly, with engineering teams in Bangkok and Jakarta. We’re looking for experienced engineers with a strong understanding of software, data and ML engineering, alongside frontend and product design, to join our Jakarta team at our SCBD office. You’ll help deliver some of the most exciting enterprise GenAI projects in the region. If you thrive on technical challenges and want to build practical solutions using emerging technologies, apply today.

**The Role**

You'll design, develop, and maintain software systems with integrated generative AI: building APIs, designing databases, writing comprehensive tests, deploying to production, and supporting what you ship. GenAI is your specialization, not your whole job.

**You own the product end to end, interface included.**
You'll build the UI that enterprise users actually touch, often without a designer beside you. We want someone who notices when spacing is inconsistent, who has a view on what to cut, and who can take a half-formed brief and come back with something that works and looks considered.

We also move fast with ideas. We use GenAI coding tools to prototype and validate concepts, and we're looking for engineers comfortable doing the same: turning an idea into a working proof of concept before investing in a full build.

**What You'll Do**

• Design, implement, and maintain scalable, robust generative AI systems that meet performance, cost, and latency requirements

• Build and maintain the production backend services and APIs that power AI-driven applications

• Build the user-facing side of those applications, creating interfaces that are clear, consistent, and genuinely pleasant to use

• Make product calls: decide what's worth building, what to cut, and what the user actually needs

• Implement comprehensive testing strategies (unit, integration, and end-to-end), including evaluation frameworks and monitoring for AI systems

• Rapidly prototype and build proofs of concept using AI-assisted development tools to validate ideas, demonstrate feasibility, and iterate quickly

• Participate in code and design reviews, and contribute to engineering best practices for production AI systems

• Identify potential applications of generative AI for clients and advise on their implementation

**What We're Looking For**

• Minimum 5 years building production-ready software, with exposure to ML or data engineering

• Strong Python. Other modern languages are a plus

• Hands-on LLM experience, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph

• Real frontend ability and an eye for craft. React or similar, plus genuine care about spacing, alignment, typography, colour, and consistency. You can make an interface look considered without a designer holding your hand

• Product judgment. You can look at a vague requirement and work out what should actually get built, and say so

• Clear communication. You can explain both technical and design decisions to technical and non-technical audiences, and you take critique well on both

**Nice to Have**

• Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector) or other NoSQL technologies

• Experience on a cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP

• Experience with design systems or component libraries (Tailwind, shadcn/ui), or fluency reading Figma

**Show Us Something**

Along with your application, send us something you've built that you're proud of the way it looks and feels. A live app, a side project, a repo with real UI work. One thing you can talk through in depth beats a long list. If it isn't public, screenshots plus a short note on the decisions you made are perfect. If you don't share, your application won't proceed.

**What We Value**

We believe the best solutions come from open collaboration. We're looking for engineers who don't just execute tasks, but actively contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and speak up when they see a better approach, including when the better approach is "this isn't good enough yet." If you thrive in an environment where your voice matters and continuous improvement is the norm, you'll fit right in.

If you meet the core experience requirement but haven’t worked with every tool listed, we still encourage you to apply. We value strong engineering fundamentals, the ability to learn quickly and a commitment to building reliable systems.

If you thrive on technical challenges and want to build practical solutions using emerging technologies, apply today.

**The Role**

You'll design, develop, and maintain software systems with integrated generative AI: building APIs, designing databases, writing comprehensive tests, deploying to production, and supporting what you ship. GenAI is your specialization, not your whole job.

**You own the product end to end, interface included.**
You'll build the UI that enterprise users actually touch, often without a designer beside you. We want someone who notices when spacing is inconsistent, who has a view on what to cut, and who can take a half-formed brief and come back with something that works and looks considered.

We also move fast with ideas. We use GenAI coding tools to prototype and validate concepts, and we're looking for engineers comfortable doing the same: turning an idea into a working proof of concept before investing in a full build.

**What You'll Do**

• Design, implement, and maintain scalable, robust generative AI systems that meet performance, cost, and latency requirements

• Build and maintain the production backend services and APIs that power AI-driven applications

• Build the user-facing side of those applications, creating interfaces that are clear, consistent, and genuinely pleasant to use

• Make product calls: decide what's worth building, what to cut, and what the user actually needs

• Implement comprehensive testing strategies (unit, integration, and end-to-end), including evaluation frameworks and monitoring for AI systems

• Rapidly prototype and build proofs of concept using AI-assisted development tools to validate ideas, demonstrate feasibility, and iterate quickly

• Participate in code and design reviews, and contribute to engineering best practices for production AI systems

• Identify potential applications of generative AI for clients and advise on their implementation

**What We're Looking For**

• Minimum 5 years building production-ready software, with exposure to ML or data engineering

• Strong Python. Other modern languages are a plus

• Hands-on LLM experience, including prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and agentic workflows using frameworks like LangChain or LangGraph

• Real frontend ability and an eye for craft. React or similar, plus genuine care about spacing, alignment, typography, colour, and consistency. You can make an interface look considered without a designer holding your hand

• Product judgment. You can look at a vague requirement and work out what should actually get built, and say so

• Clear communication. You can explain both technical and design decisions to technical and non-technical audiences, and you take critique well on both

**Nice to Have**

• Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Qdrant, pgvector) or other NoSQL technologies

• Experience on a cloud platform such as Azure, AWS, or GCP

• Experience with design systems or component libraries (Tailwind, shadcn/ui), or fluency reading Figma

**Show Us Something**

Along with your application, send us something you've built that you're proud of the way it looks and feels. A live app, a side project, a repo with real UI work. One thing you can talk through in depth beats a long list. If it isn't public, screenshots plus a short note on the decisions you made are perfect. If you don't share, your application won't proceed.

**What We Value**

We believe the best solutions come from open collaboration. We're looking for engineers who don't just execute tasks, but actively contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, and speak up when they see a better approach, including when the better approach is "this isn't good enough yet." If you thrive in an environment where your voice matters and continuous improvement is the norm, you'll fit right in.

If you meet the core experience requirement but haven’t worked with every tool listed, we still encourage you to apply. We value strong engineering fundamentals, the ability to learn quickly and a commitment to building reliable systems.

description:
**About us:**

We help ambitious businesses overcome complex challenges and achieve great things.

We create impactful solutions delivered by passionate people who care deeply about quality.

We make the first version the best version and conduct ourselves with integrity and honesty.

Our refreshing approach to consulting, which involves a deep understanding of our clients’ unique challenges, a collaborative problem-solving process, and a commitment to delivering practical and sustainable solutions, has rewarded us with a legacy of client confidence and trust, fueling our vision to become one of the most highly valued consulting firms.

  

We focus on delivering real impact: tangible and measurable improvement that gets our clients the results they want, achieved in a human, genuine and practical way that creates trust.

At Lancia Consult, our people have the freedom to think innovatively, work autonomously, and be empowered to make their own decisions, whilst working in a collaborative and supportive environment.

We are looking for a **Senior Technical Consultant (AI-Native Full-Stack Developer) to join our growing Technology Consulting team in Jakarta.**

You will be part of a highly talented, tight-knit team that supports one another through both everyday delivery and the toughest project moments. We believe in strong teamwork, shared ownership, and a culture where people learn, grow, and succeed together.

This is not a conventional, ticket-based software engineering position. You will work alongside functional consultants to understand complex business needs, shape practical solution architectures, and build scalable, production-ready applications. You will use AI throughout the software development lifecycle while retaining strong engineering judgement, accountability, and ownership. The role offers broad exposure across solution architecture, full-stack engineering, cloud deployment, AI-native development, consulting delivery, and client engagement.

**You can expect to be exposed to:**

  

* **Solution Architecture and Technical Design:** Work alongside functional consultants to translate business requirements into pragmatic, scalable, end-to-end solution architectures across application, data, integration, security, and deployment layers.
* **Technical Judgement and Solutioning:** Assess functional and non-functional requirements, make sensible technical trade-offs, and communicate design decisions clearly to business and technology stakeholders.
* **Full-Stack Application Development:** Design, build, test, and maintain production-grade applications using TypeScript or JavaScript, modern front-end frameworks such as React and Next.js, and backend frameworks such as Node.js and NestJS or comparable technologies.
* **Data, APIs and Integration:** Design relational data models, develop SQL-based solutions, and build secure REST APIs and integrations. You will also work with authentication, authorisation, role-based access control, background workers, queues, scheduled jobs, and asynchronous processing.
* **Engineering Quality and Delivery:** Apply disciplined engineering practices using Git-based development, branching, pull requests, collaborative code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment across the delivery lifecycle.
* **Cloud and Platform Engineering:** Deploy and operate applications in cloud environments, preferably Azure or AWS, with GCP experience also welcomed. You will gain exposure to application hosting, secrets management, environment configuration, API management, production monitoring, telemetry, alerting, and troubleshooting.
* **Security and Production Ownership:** Support the secure handling and encryption of enterprise and client data while ensuring applications remain maintainable, observable, reliable, and production-ready.
* **AI-Assisted and AI-Native Engineering:** Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or comparable platforms throughout the software engineering lifecycle. You will create structured context and reusable coding instructions, while independently reviewing generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit.
* **Intelligent Applications and Agentic Solutions:** Work with LLM APIs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, prompt and context design, agentic patterns, human approval points, and safe system actions. You will consider AI evaluation, hallucination risks, guardrails, observability, latency, and consumption costs when building AI-enabled solutions.
* **Consulting and Client Engagement:** Collaborate directly with consultants, developers, business users, and technology stakeholders. You will develop a deep understanding of client challenges and communicate technical decisions in a clear, practical, and outcome-focused manner.

  

**We are looking for people who:**

  

* Have approximately **6–8+ years of software engineering experience**, including ownership of production applications or equivalent evidence of senior-level production responsibility.Have strong TypeScript or JavaScript experience.Have end-to-end production experience with a modern front-end framework, preferably React and Next.js.
* Have production backend development experience, preferably with Node.js and NestJS or a comparable framework.Demonstrate strong SQL and relational data-modelling capabilities.
* Have experience designing REST APIs and integrating systems.
* Understand authentication, authorisation, and role-based access control.
* Have experience with background workers, queues, scheduled jobs, or asynchronous processing.
* Are comfortable with Git-based development, pull requests, collaborative code reviews, CI/CD, automated deployment, and automated testing.
* Have hands-on cloud deployment experience, preferably in Azure or AWS. GCP experience is also welcomed.
* Understand application hosting, secrets management, environment configuration, API management, logging, telemetry, alerting, and production troubleshooting.
* Can securely handle enterprise and client data and apply appropriate encryption and security practices.
* Have practical experience using AI-assisted development tools across the software engineering lifecycle.
* Can independently assess AI-generated code for correctness, security, maintainability, and architectural fit.
* Understand LLM APIs, structured outputs, tool calling, retrieval, prompt or context design, and agentic development patterns.
* Can clearly explain technical decisions and trade-offs to both business and technology stakeholders.
* Communicate confidently in English and are comfortable working with regional teams and clients.Are experienced, self-directed, and able to take ownership without waiting for highly detailed instructions.
* Are product-minded and consider user needs, business outcomes, maintainability, and long-term value when building solutions.
* Are architecturally minded and able to see beyond individual features or technical requirements.Are comfortable working with ambiguity in a fast-changing consulting environment.
* Can move quickly while maintaining discipline, security, and engineering quality.
* Are pragmatic, collaborative, client-capable, and comfortable pairing with functional consultants and other developers.
* Demonstrate an entrepreneurial mindset and are able to lead themselves and guide others when required

  

**We know that capability determines what you can do, but attitude determines how well you do it.**

If you are looking for a role where you can shape practical solution architectures, take ownership of production applications, use AI to improve how software is designed and delivered, and help solve complex client challenges, we would love to hear from you!

**How to apply**

If you are interested in a conversation with us to learn more, please **submit your CV** to apply directly.

Please note that only candidates **shortlisted for the next stage** will be contacted.

At Lancia Consult, we are truly committed to positive, inclusive and accessible recruitment and are proud to be an equal opportunities employer. We actively encourage all applications and know that an empowered team with varied perspectives and relevant experience, operating in an inclusive environment, allows us all to reach our full potential.

Our team has decades of cross-sector expertise, working with global blue chips, SMEs, ambitious scale-ups, and inspiring charities. Alongside that experience, we bring the right attitude: positivity, solution focus, empathy, and awareness.

**Privacy Statement**

Lancia is an equal opportunities employer. Information is used only for recruitment, eligibility verification, and reporting purposes. Responses are confidential and will not affect the outcome of your application.

**Declaration**

All personal data provided will be processed in accordance with the Indonesian Personal Data Protection Law (Law No. 27 of 2022). Information collected is used solely for recruitment, work eligibility verification, and statistical reporting purposes.

title: Material Productivity Manager
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Material Productivity Manager**

**What will you do?**

* Lead QVE (Quality Value Engineering) and COS (Change of Supplier) initiatives at the BU level
* Consolidate performance data and track progress against productivity targets
* Facilitate product workshops and competitor teardowns to spark innovation
* Manage the Master Project List for respective BU
* Drive cost-down projections with actionable plans and governance
* Monitor plant-level productivity actions and ensure alignment with BU goals
* Collaborate with BU and R&D teams to build strong governance frameworks
* Benchmark across plants and animate improvement plans with clear timelines

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.
* 5+ years of experience in Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, Productivity, or Cost Management roles.
* Experience working in a cross-functional, multinational environment is preferred‌
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex data and identify productivity opportunities.
* Proficiency in data analysis, KPI tracking, and financial impact assessment.
* Experience with productivity dashboards, cost modeling, and savings validation‌
* Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and deliver results within timeline commitments.
* Strong planning, prioritization, and governance capabilities.
* Experience leading productivity, cost optimization, or continuous improvement programs.‌
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to influence and engage stakeholders across different functions and organizational levels.
* Strong facilitation skills for workshops, reviews, and cross-functional meetings.
* Strong analytical and project management skills
* Experience in manufacturing, engineering, or operations
* Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement abilities

**What’s in it for me?**

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

(External) English Company Boiler Plate:

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

*Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*  
  
*Schneider Electric is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct.*

title: Data Center Operations Trainee, AWS Data Center Operation
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Trainee Period: 7 Dec 2026 - 11 June 2027  
  
We designed this unique trainee program to hire IT early careers or professionals, providing you with classroom and on the job training to introduce you to all facets of our Datacenter (DC) operations. From this program, you get to be empowered, grow and scale in your technical expertise and learn from our experienced engineers.
  
  
You will be assigned as a trainee for 6 months where you will have exposure to learn and understand how our Data center works, interact with our support teams and customers. Experience the latest technologies of our cloud that puts you among top talents of data center technical support teams. By the end of the program, you will be assessed on your learnings to see if you have what it takes to join our growing team and be a full time Amazonian.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key exposures are:  
  

* Perform installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Perform storage media (HDD, SSD etc.) sanitization and destruction tasks
* Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Movement of equipment with assisted lifting machinery.
* Maintain high system reliability by prioritizing trouble tickets
* Collaborate with internal teams (DC operations, DC Engineering, Logistics, Security, Projects etc.) sharing ideas and contribute in projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* Participate, lead and deliver small to mid-scale projects including Data Center rollout

  
About the team  
About AWS  
  
Diverse Experiences  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
#auta-sg #auta-asean

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

description:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society.

**About the role**
==================

Job Summary
  
The Internal Audit Sr. Specialist is responsible for conducting and managing internal audits to evaluate the effectiveness of internal controls and compliance with policies and regulations. This role supports risk management and contributes to operational improvements. This job profile is intended for specialist professionals that apply advanced knowledge of a job area. Required to manage projects / processes independently with limited supervision. Typically coaches and reviews the work of lower level professionals.

**Main tasks and responsibilities**

  

· **Audit Planning & Execution**

o Plan and execute risk-based internal audits across financial, operational, and compliance areas.

o Conduct audit fieldwork, including interviews, walkthroughs, data analysis, and testing of controls.

o Assess the adequacy and effectiveness of internal controls and identify areas for improvement.

o Ensure audit assignments are completed within agreed timelines and quality standards

· **Risk Assessment & Internal Control Review**

o Evaluate business processes and identify key operational, financial, and compliance risks.

o Review the design and effectiveness of internal controls and recommend practical enhancements.

o Monitor the implementation and effectiveness of corrective actions arising from audit findings.

o Support the development and maintenance of the organization's risk and control framework.

· **Business Process Improvement**

o Identify process inefficiencies, control weaknesses, and opportunities for automation.

o Provide recommendations to improve operational effectiveness and resource utilization.

o Partner with business functions to drive continuous improvement initiatives while maintaining auditor independence.

  

**Technical Competencies**

  

* Strong knowledge of internal auditing methodologies and risk-based auditing.

* Understanding of internal control frameworks and corporate governance principles.

* Strong analytical and investigative skills.

* Experience reviewing finance, procurement, inventory, operational, and service-related processes.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Positive, professional, and solution-oriented mindset.

* Strong curiosity to understand business processes and operational drivers.

* Ability to deep dive into issues and identify root causes rather than surface-level symptoms.

* High integrity, objectivity, and ethical standards.

* Strong communication and influencing skills.

* Ability to challenge constructively and work effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

* Strong attention to detail balanced with a practical business perspective.

* Continuous improvement mindset and willingness to learn.

**Requirements:**  
· Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or related discipline.

* **6-10 years of experience** in Internal Audit, External Audit, Risk Management, Compliance, or Internal Controls.

* Prior experience in the **service industry** (engineering services, project services, shared services, logistics, consulting, facility management, maintenance services, or similar sectors) is highly preferred.

* Exposure to multinational companies and cross-functional operations is an advantage.

* Professional certifications such as **CIA, CISA, CPA, ACCA, CMA, or equivalent** are preferred.

**What we offer you**
=====================

Career Opportunities

Medical Benefit

Saving Plan

Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment.

We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.

description:
* Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the company's technology and cybersecurity strategy aligned with overarching business goals. Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing technology and cybersecurity teams.
* Operations & Defense: Lead and oversee the Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, threat monitoring, and cyber defense operations.
* Service Delivery: Manage the delivery of premium cybersecurity services, including VAPT, red teaming, cloud security, and managed security services.
* Architecture & Innovation: Design and maintain a secure, scalable, and resilient technology infrastructure and security architecture. Drive innovation, automation, and continuous improvement across security operations and platforms.
* Client & Stakeholder Management: Act as a strategic advisor to enterprise and government clients on cybersecurity risks, solutions, and best practices. Support business growth through technical pre-sales, solution architecture, executive presentations, and customer engagement.
* Governance & Compliance: Establish and enforce cybersecurity governance, policies, standards, and compliance frameworks (including ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls, etc.).
* Vendor & Asset Management: Manage strategic partnerships, technology vendors, budgets, and cybersecurity investments.

  
**Requirements**  

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
* Experience: Minimum 10 years of experience in technology and cybersecurity, with at least 5 years in a dedicated leadership role.
* Core Domain Expertise: Proven experience managing a SOC, incident response, cybersecurity operations, or working within a Managed Security Services Provider (MSSP) environment.
* Technical Depth: Strong expertise in cloud security, SIEM/SOAR, network security, IAM/PAM, EDR/XDR, and security architecture with deep understanding of threat detection, vulnerability management, penetration testing, and cyber risk management.
* Frameworks & Standards: Hands-on experience with cybersecurity frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and CIS Controls.
* Consulting & Delivery: Experience leading cybersecurity consulting, enterprise security projects, or client-facing engagements.
* Soft Skills: Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and strategic decision-making skills.
* Certifications (Preferred): Professional cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CEH, OSCP, or equivalent.
* Technology Stack (Advantageous): Familiarity with tools such as Google SecOps, Mandiant, Microsoft Sentinel, Palo Alto, CrowdStrike, or Splunk.

  
**Benefits**  

* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Training & Development
* Performance Bonus

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Software Quality Assurance / Testing Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for participating in every phase of the development process to ensure that the design and software adhere to company standards.  
  
This role collaborates with various stakeholders in the development and execution of exploratory and automated tests to ensure product quality.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Works across multiple teams to ensure the planning, execution, reporting, and successful completion of QA activities for all new development cycles for various releases.
* Contributes to Agile-related user story review meetings and/or work with relevant business stakeholders and developers to understand the new or modified application functionality.
* Networks with the required user community (such as Regions or the Product Owner) to understand business requirements and uphold quality of each release by ensuring a comprehensive end-to-end testing coverage.
* Designs and implements end-to-end test scenarios, as well as debugging and defining corrective actions.
* Contributes to performing and documenting risk analysis and record test progress and results. Performing thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved.
* Works across multiple teams to review requirements, specifications, and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback.
* Creates detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.
* Designs, develops, codes, and executes automation scripts
* Works across multiple teams to identify, record, document thoroughly, and track bugs and develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products to meet client needs.
* Develops standards and procedures to determine product quality and release readiness.
* Contributes recommendations that will enable innovation and streamline overall testing processes.
* Works across multiple teams, documenting established QA processes and best practices in Agile Scrum development methodology and influence the continuous improvement of the QA activities.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Seasoned expertise in software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
* Team player with good attention to detail.
* Excellent ability to understand and analyze complex systems
* Seasoned understanding of SQL and scripting.
* Seasoned understanding of software development process.
* Seasoned expertise in agile development such as Scrum.
* Seasoned understanding of software integrated development environments.
* Seasoned ability to handle client and customer issues tactfully and professionally.
* Seasoned understanding of object-oriented programming.

* Seasoned work experience in software development.

* Proficient in working in an Agile/Scrum development process.
* Proficiency with performance and/or security testing is a plus.
* Seasoned hands-on experience with automated testing tools.
* Seasoned experience working within a geographically dispersed company is desirable.

description:
**Innovate and shape what comes next.**

  

*At AIA, your expertise, perspective and ideas can help us become a faster, simpler and more connected organisation while contributing to our Purpose of helping millions of people live Healthier, Longer, Better Lives. Across our diverse markets, you will take on real-world challenges, collaborate with talented colleagues and turn technology, data and bold ideas into simpler experiences, smarter solutions and positive outcomes for our customers and communities.*

  

*Join us to create what comes next, grow through new experiences and extend your impact across Asia.*

  

**About the Role**

  
AIA is looking for Core Architecture Specialist who will serve as the core solution architecture authority by ensuring business capabilities are supported by appropriate technology architecture in the Core Insurance domain, defining and enforcing technical standards, validating non-functional requirements, and collaborating with delivery teams to ensure solutions are implemented in alignment with architectural designs.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

**Strategy and Roadmap**

  

* Lead the formulation of the applications strategy and roadmap within the core insurance domain, assess current position, set target state, perform gap analysis and define roadmap to close the gaps.

Collaborate with relevant business stakeholders to align architecture initiatives with overall business strategy, priorities, and growth objectives.  

  

**Project Solution Design**

* Collaborate closely with business analysts and stakeholders to translate project-specific business requirements into scalable and compliant solution designs.

* Ensure alignment with development standards, regulatory requirements, and enterprise architecture principles.

Develop comprehensive solution designs in the form of architectural blueprints and supporting documentation that articulate system components, integration points, data flows, and technology stack choices. These artifacts serve as a reference for development teams, stakeholders, and governance bodies throughout the project lifecycle.  

  

**Technology Research and Selection**

* Research technology options relevant to the project (e.g., CRM solutions, digital onboarding, claims automation, data analytics) and assess their applicability.

Recommend technologies that best fit the project's objectives and effectively address business requirements while ensuring optimal cost-efficiency.  

  

**Project Solution Cost Estimation**

Collaborate with other architects, IT delivery, and business analyst, to estimate solution costs, including infrastructure, licensing, professional services, and resources for development and testing.  

  

**Technical Leadership and Guidance**

* Provide hands-on guidance to development teams during implementation, ensuring adherence to architectural standards and best practices.

Act as a technical mentor and escalation point for project-related issues.  

  

**Analytical Problem Solving**

* Conduct analysis of complex technical challenges and provide recommendations to the development team/vendors within the project scope.

Interpret technical documentation, develop actionable solutions, and make informed recommendations to project leadership.  

  

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor Degree (S1) Degree in Technical/Information System/Other related educations

* 10 years experience in IT areas with 3 years in solution architecture or system analysis

**Certifications/licenses (are an advantage):**

* Enterprise Architecture certification (e.g. TOGAF)
* Business certification (e.g. FLMI from LOMA)
* Business architecture certification (e.g. Certified Business Architect (CBA) based on Business Architecture Body of Knowlede (BIZBOK)
* Technical certification (e.g. Azure, Java, Microsoft)

TeamProduct Management

About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. **Job Description**
===================

*Job ID: MJ000272*

  
  

**Job Description**

We seek an execution-focused Technical Product Manager to join our Flight System Integration team. You will be responsible for the day-to-day development and maintenance of API connections with our suppliers, ensuring they are optimized for performance and accuracy. In this role, you will be at the heart of our technical execution, ensuring the "pipes" that power our travel platform are robust and efficient. You will directly improve the booking feature & reliability for millions of customers by optimizing our direct integrations with global airline partners.

  
  

* Collaborate closely with engineering teams to define detailed technical requirements and ensure high-quality product delivery.
* Act as the subject matter expert for API connectivity, proactively identifying and resolving issues in XML & JSON-based transactions.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) like API latency and success rates to identify areas for technical improvement.
* Partner with UX/UI designers and data scientists to ensure cohesive product strategies that enhance the end-user experience.
* Manage and prioritize the product backlog with oversight from senior leadership, ensuring technical debt is balanced with new feature development.
* Participate in the on-call rotation to maintain the high availability of our flight systems.
  

  

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field from a reputable university.
* Minimum 6+ years of experience in technical product management or a similar engineering-heavy role.
* Hands-on experience in debugging XML/JSON transactions and a solid understanding of RESTful APIs. Familiarity with the Flight API ecosystem (GDS, NDC, PSS) is a significant plus.
* Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum methodologies.
* Data-driven decision-making skills with a focus on optimizing system metrics and performance.
* Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to bridge the gap between business needs and technical implementation.

About Us:
  
  
At Qoala, we are revolutionizing the insurance and fintech industry with innovative technology solutions. As a leading Insurtech platform in Southeast Asia, we are committed to providing seamless digital experiences for our customers and partners. We pride ourselves on fostering a dynamic, inclusive, and collaborative work environment where creativity, growth, and continuous learning are highly valued and encouraged.
  
  
About the Role:
  
  
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who loves solving complex problems and building scalable systems that power real impact. You’ll collaborate with a team of passionate engineers to design, build, and improve the core systems that drive our products.
  
  
If you enjoy clean architecture, reliable APIs, and improving how teams deliver software through the full SDLC, we’d love to meet you.

* Participate in all phases of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including requirement analysis, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Develop, optimize, and maintain scalable microservices and backend systems.
* Design and implement RESTful APIs and integrations with internal and external systems.
* Contribute to system architecture and participate in technical design discussions.
* Conduct code reviews, enforce engineering standards, and ensure adherence to best practices.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, QA, DevOps, and other Engineering teams to ensure efficient software delivery.
* Take ownership of technical challenges and propose solutions that balance speed, quality, and scalability.
* Ensure high standards of security, documentation, and maintainability across all deliverables.
* Provide technical mentorship and support to team members, fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

* Minimum 5 years of experience as a Software Engineer (Backend), ideally in a product-based or SaaS environment.

* Proficient in leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, optimize workflows, and deliver high-quality results within project timelines.

At PwC, our people in sustainability focus on integrating environmental, social, economic, and governance considerations into business strategies and operations.
