title: Reliability & MRO Officer
description:
**Use Your Power for Purpose**

Whether you are managing critical spare parts, supporting maintenance planning, maintaining engineering documentation, or coordinating technical materials, your contributions are essential to keeping our facilities, utilities, and manufacturing equipment safe, reliable, and ready for operation. By collaborating with Maintenance, Engineering, Production, Quality, EHS, Procurement, Warehouse, and our external partners, you will help ensure that the medicines patients need are produced and delivered reliably.

**What You Will Achieve**

In this role, you will:

* Manage the onboarding of MRO spare parts using approved engineering information and create or update part master data in the applicable CMMS/EAMS.
* Receive spare parts and verify purchase-order documentation, quantity, technical specifications, and external condition before acceptance.
* Ensure that damaged, incorrect, rejected, obsolete, or otherwise nonconforming materials are appropriately identified, labeled, and segregated to prevent unintended use.
* Coordinate return-to-supplier activities with Procurement, suppliers, and requestors, including maintaining the required documentation and reasons for return.
* Accurately record spare-part receipts, issues, returns, and inventory adjustments in SAP/ERP and CMMS/EAMS, as applicable.
* Label and store spare parts in designated locations under the storage conditions specified by the manufacturer.
* Issue spare parts against the appropriate work order and process eligible unused parts returned to the MRO stockroom.
* Perform cycle counts, inventory reconciliation, and follow-up activities to resolve discrepancies between physical inventory and system records.
* Monitor critical-spare availability, stockout risks, lead times, minimum and maximum stock levels, reorder points, safety stocks, and equipment or bill-of-material associations.
* Review slow-moving, non-moving, damaged, obsolete, and equipment-specific spare parts, including materials affected by equipment modification or decommissioning.

* Maintain accurate part descriptions, manufacturer and model information, storage locations, inventory status, equipment associations, and bills of materials in CMMS/EAMS.
* Execute MRO business-continuity activities during planned or unplanned CMMS/EAMS outages, maintain manual transaction records, and restore transactions accurately following system recovery.
* Support maintenance planning by reviewing work-order material requirements and preparing spare parts, consumables, tools, vendor support, technical documents, and engineering drawings.
* Assist in developing maintenance work packs for preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, shutdowns, major repairs, and engineering projects.
* Support the preparation and updating of mechanical drawings, electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams, panel layouts, P&IDs, equipment layouts, exploded views, spare-part drawings, and as-built drawings.
* Ensure that only current and approved drawing revisions are used, and support field verification and controlled document updates following approved change-management processes.
* Support preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, inspections, breakdown repairs, and functional checks according to competency, authorization, and operational requirements.
* Accurately record completed work, labor hours, parts used, unused parts returned, and functional-test results in the applicable work order or supporting documentation.
* Collect equipment specifications, drawings, OEM information, material data, test reports, and other supporting evidence for exact-replacement or like-for-like assessments by qualified Engineering personnel.
* Support technical purchasing, quotation clarification, vendor coordination, material-delivery monitoring, repair services, warranty follow-up, and technical-document collection.
* Comply with GMP, Good Documentation Practices, data-integrity requirements, EHS requirements, PPE rules, safe material-handling practices, housekeeping standards, and applicable site and global procedures.

**Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)**

* Diploma 3 (D3) or higher qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Mechatronics, or another relevant technical discipline.
* At least 2 years of relevant experience in MRO, spare-parts management, an engineering stockroom, maintenance planning, a technical warehouse, or maintenance operations.
* Basic knowledge of GMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity, EHS requirements, and record traceability.
* Understanding of spare-part onboarding, receipt, storage, issue, return, segregation, cycle counting, and inventory reconciliation.
* Ability to use CMMS/EAMS for work-order material transactions, part-master data, equipment associations, and traceable inventory records.
* Ability to identify common mechanical, electrical, and automation components and interpret their technical specifications.
* Ability to read mechanical drawings, electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, single-line diagrams, equipment layouts, and P&IDs.
* Ability to prepare spare parts, consumables, tools, technical documentation, and other materials required to support maintenance activities.
* Working knowledge of PPE, safe storage, material segregation, housekeeping, hazard reporting, and applicable site safety procedures.
* Strong analytical, organizational, communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to maintain accurate inventory, transaction, and technical-document records.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Microsoft Excel, for basic analysis of inventory, consumption, lead time, and stock risks.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic operational environment.

**Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Requirements)**

* Experience working in the pharmaceutical industry or another regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience using SAP/ERP, CMMS/EAMS, or other maintenance and inventory-management systems.
* Experience supporting maintenance planning, preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, shutdown activities, major repairs, or engineering projects.
* Experience with technical purchasing, vendor coordination, quotation clarification, delivery follow-up, repair services, and warranty management.
* Knowledge of inventory optimization, critical-spare analysis, minimum and maximum stock levels, reorder points, safety stock, and obsolescence management.
* Experience supporting inventory reconciliation, slow-moving and non-moving inventory reviews, or spare-part cost-optimization initiatives.
* Ability to perform dashboard preparation, Pareto analysis, and trend analysis related to inventory, material consumption, lead times, or stock risks.
* Experience supporting maintenance troubleshooting and hands-on technical activities within the limits of assigned competency and authorization.
* Additional training or certification in inventory management, maintenance planning, CMMS/EAMS, CAD or engineering drawings, GMP, data integrity, or safety.
* Experience using common AI tools, including generative technologies such as ChatGPT or Microsoft Copilot, to support data analysis, problem solving, documentation, and productivity. Demonstrated curiosity in exploring how these technologies can improve maintenance and MRO outcomes, together with an understanding of responsible AI practices, confidentiality, risk management, and ethical use.

  
Work Location Assignment: On Premise

title: Senior Developer Application Engineer
description:
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.

Within **Thales Global Services**, the **IS-IT (Information Systems & IT)** division delivers reliable IT solutions to support the Group’s key functions, embodied by **Value Towers**. Among these, the **Sales & Marketing** and **Bid & Project** Value Towers have inspired the **ABACUS initiative**—a solution designed to **accelerate the generation of commercial offers for Spares & Repair** across the Thales Group. ABACUS enables the **accurate and efficient creation of transactional offerings** to drive recurring revenue.

To **enhance the operational efficiency of ABACUS in production**, IS-IT seeks to **internalize the required expertise** by recruiting an **experienced CINCOM CPQ Application Engineer/Senior Developer**. As part of the **ABACUS Agile Scrum Team** (alongside the Scrum Master and Product Owner), your mission will be to **take technical ownership** of the ABACUS solution, based on **CINCOM CPQ (Guru Management Studio)**.

**Key Responsibilities**

As the **ABACUS Application Engineer/Senior Developer**, you will:

* **Develop user stories** as specified by the Product Owner, ensuring alignment with business needs.
* **Conduct unit and component testing** and contribute to **non-regression testing campaigns** to guarantee solution stability.
* **Manage versions** of the editor solution (core + Thales-specific customizations).
* **Deploy the solution as a Service** on **Thales Cloud environments** (Google S3NS).
* **Document implementation and configuration** of the user stories and technical stories for knowledge sharing and compliance.
* **Collaborate with vendor** (e.g., CINCOM) to gain autonomy and take full ownership over the solution.
* **Support continuous improvement** of the ABACUS solution, including performance tuning and scalability.

**Experience & Soft Skills**

* **10+ years of experience** in **integrating COTS (Commercial Off-The-Shelf) software**, ideally with **CINCOM CPQ**.
* **Proven ability to learn quickly** and adapt to complex technical environments.
* **Strong interpersonal skills** to effectively interact with vendors, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* **Open-mindedness and cultural agility** to thrive in a **multicultural environment** (Thales operates globally).
* Due to the nature of the work, English skills are required.

**Technical Skills**

* **Expertise in CINCOM CPQ and Guru Management Studio** (configuration, customization, and troubleshooting).
* **Proficiency in C#** on **.NET environments** (development, debugging and optimization using **Visual Studio**).
* **SQL Server** (query writing, database design, and performance tuning).
* **Microsoft PowerShell** (scripting for automation, deployment, and system management).
* **Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and code quality analysis** (GitLab, SonarQube).
* **Cloud-based development and deployment** (experience with **Azure, AWS, or Thales internal cloud** is a plus).
* **Agile/Scrum methodologies** (familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, and collaborative tools like JIRA).

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Mekari is Indonesia's no. 1 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company. With our ecosystem of software solutions—including Mekari Jurnal, Mekari Talenta, Mekari Qontak, and Mekari Flex, we aim to facilitate entrepreneurs and leaders as they accelerate the digital transformation of their businesses.
  
  
In our 10+ years of journey we have reached over 3 Million platform users, and we're not planning to stop any time soon. We need more people like you: builders and owners with calculated ambition who are ready to
**#ElevateThroughImpact**
and raise Indonesia's software standard.
  
  
The Infrastructure Engineer will focus on supporting our on-premise and private cloud (single-tenant) customers. This role involves handling tasks of medium to low complexity, ensuring the smooth operation and maintenance of our infrastructure solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of both cloud and on-premise environments, with expertise in key technologies such as Kubernetes, containerization, Terraform, Ansible, Linux, and customer troubleshooting.
  
  
**On-Premise Infrastructure Maintenance**

* Perform routine maintenance on virtual servers, operating systems, storage, networks, and other infrastructure hardware that supports Mekari Officeless.
* Implement patching and updates of operating systems, applications, and firmware according to schedules and security best practices.
* Manage and maintain backup and restore systems to ensure data recovery in the event of failure.
* Conduct basic capacity planning to anticipate future infrastructure resource needs.
* Create and maintain documentation related to infrastructure configuration, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting.

**Monitoring and Troubleshooting**

* Monitor the performance and availability of on-premise infrastructure using available monitoring tools.
* Analyze system logs and performance metrics to identify potential problems or anomalies.
* Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues effectively and efficiently to minimize downtime.
* Coordinate with other teams (e.g., application teams, support teams) in resolving issues involving infrastructure.
* Create incident reports and root cause analysis (RCA) for significant infrastructure issues.

**Implementing Changes and Configuration**

* Implement infrastructure configuration changes according to approved change requests.’
* Follow change management procedures to ensure changes are made in a safe and controlled manner.
* Install and configure new infrastructure software as needed.
* Perform testing after implementing changes to ensure system stability and performance.

**On-Premise Infrastructure Security**

* Implement and comply with corporate infrastructure security policies and procedures.
* Perform basic security configuration on servers, networks, and other hardware.
* Ensure access to on-premise infrastructure is properly managed.

**Collaboration and Communication**

* Communicate effectively with other teams and stakeholders regarding infrastructure status, issues, and scheduled maintenance.
* Provide infrastructure related technical support to internal teams as needed.

description:
**About The Company**
Our client is a US-based software aggregator that leverages AI and machine learning to build scalable and intelligent solutions.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are looking for a
**hands-on AI/ML Engineer**
to build and deploy practical AI solutions for real-world applications, with a strong focus on
**Computer Vision and multimodal AI**
.
  
  
You may also work across
**LLMs/Generative AI, VLMs, and agentic AI**
, depending on project needs. The role covers the full process from
**research and experimentation to model development, evaluation, deployment, optimization, and production debugging**
.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Research, develop, train, fine-tune, and evaluate AI/ML models, particularly for Computer Vision and multimodal applications.
* Build AI solutions involving Computer Vision, VLMs, LLMs/Generative AI, or AI agents.
* Work with datasets, data quality, ML pipelines, and model evaluation.
* Design and run experiments to improve model performance, robustness, and generalization.
* Deploy, debug, and optimize AI/ML systems in production.
* Solve ambiguous technical problems and turn them into practical AI solutions.
* Build AI workflows and systems that integrate models with software, data, and real-world applications.
* Collaborate with software engineers and other teams to bring AI solutions into production.
* Stay hands-on with coding, experimentation, and technical problem-solving.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* Mid-level to Senior, with a strong hands-on approach to AI/ML engineering and technical problem-solving.
* Hands-on experience in AI/ML Engineering, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, or a related technical field.
* Strong Python and programming skills, with experience using ML/AI frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn.
* Experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions, from experimentation and model development through to production.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a practical approach to technical challenges.
* Good English communication skills.
* Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with an international team.
* Indonesian citizen.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Computer Vision / Vision Models
* VLM / Multimodal AI
* LLM / Generative AI / RAG / AI Agents
* Model fine-tuning and evaluation
* Dataset engineering / synthetic data / data quality
* ML inference optimization / MLOps
* AWS or GCP
* Docker / Kubernetes
* AI-assisted coding / agentic development

If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving challenging technical problems and experimenting with AI approaches, and are excited to turn research into impactful, production-ready AI solutions, we'd love to hear from you.

description:
### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan**

***SEVIMA Tech Talent Program*** hadir untuk menjembatani pembelajaran di satuan pendidikan dengan perkembangan dan kebutuhan dunia industri. Melalui program ini, peserta didik mendapatkan kesempatan memperoleh wawasan dan pengalaman yang relevan dengan lingkungan kerja, sekaligus mengembangkan kompetensi teknis maupun non-teknis melalui pembelajaran berbasis praktik dan proyek yang sesuai dengan standar industri. SEVIMA Tech Talent Program membuka ruang pengembangan lebih lanjut, baik melalui program pengembangan, PKL/magang, maupun kesempatan berkarier bersama SEVIMA.

**Posisi Magang yang Kami Buka:**

**Software Engineer Intern**

Anda akan membangun fitur yang benar-benar dipakai pengguna.

* Terlibat langsung dalam pengembangan fitur pada platform yang melayani ribuan institusi pendidikan.
* Menulis kode yang rapi, terstruktur, dan siap dipakai di lingkungan produksi.
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim produk, QA, dan DevOps dalam alur kerja pengembangan software yang nyata.
  

  

**Software Quality Assurance Intern**

Menjadi penjaga kualitas sebelum produk sampai ke pengguna.

* Merancang test case dan melakukan pengujian manual maupun otomatis.
* Memahami cara menemukan, mendokumentasikan, dan mengawal perbaikan bug bersama tim engineer.
* Mengasah ketelitian dan cara berpikir dari sudut pandang pengguna.
  

  

**DevOps Intern**

Memastikan aplikasi berjalan stabil, cepat, dan siap diakses kapan saja.

* Mengenal infrastruktur server, cloud, dan proses deployment aplikasi berskala besar.
* Mengotomasi pipeline (CI/CD) dan monitoring sistem secara langsung.
* Merasakan langsung bagaimana tim menjaga layanan yang dipakai ribuan kampus setiap hari.
  

  

**Security Engineer Intern**

Melindungi data dan sistem pendidikan dari ancaman siber.

* Mengenali celah keamanan dan praktik pengamanan aplikasi maupun jaringan.
* Terlibat dalam aktivitas pengecekan keamanan sistem bersama tim engineering.
* Memahami pentingnya menjaga keamanan data di industri yang mengelola informasi jutaan pengguna.

**Benefit yang Kami Tawarkan:**

* Program Magang 6 bulan.

* Berkesempatan menjadi karyawan *Full-time.*

* Kesempatan meraih Beasiswa S1.

* Paid Internship.

* Sertifikat Magang.

* Professional Development bersama tim SEVIMA University dan Mentor Berpengalaman.

* Lingkungan kerja yang mendukung inovasi.

* Makan Siang.

Internship

Surabaya, Jawa Timur

Rp 1.000.000 - Rp 1.500.000

title: Project Coordinator
description:
**MSBU is a dynamic IT staffing and recruitment company founded in 2019, specializing in on-demand talent solution for the technology industry. With a strong focus on client and candidate success, we deliver exceptional services through our SLA commitment and innovative crowdsourcing ecosystem.**

**Our expertise spans various technology domain, including software development, mobile technology, data, infrastructure, cybersecurity, product, and UX. As a leader in the industry, we are proud to have established the Freelance Tech Recruiter Community (FRC), connecting over 250 technology recruiter to collaborate, learn, and grow together.**

**To learn more about PT. MSBU Konsultan Indonesia, please visit our website at:**

**website: https://msbu.co.id/id/**

**Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/msbukonsultan/?\_\_pwa=1**

**Linkedln: https://www.linkedin.com/company/msbukonsultan/posts/?feedView=all**

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive **Project Coordinator** to support the planning, coordination and execution of IT and Telecommunication (Telco) project. The ideal candidate will work closely with project manager, technical team, business stakeholder, client and external vendor to ensure project activities are well-coordinated and delivered according to the agreed timelines, scope, quality standard and budget. This role involves coordinate project schedule, monitoring progress, tracking risk and issue, preparing project documentation and facilitating effective communication between technical and business team. The successful candidate should have a solid understand of IT project management methodologies, particularly Agile/Scrum and Waterfall, as well as familiar with telecommunication solution and infrastructure. Strong organizational, problem solving and communication skill in both English are essential, as the candidate will collaborate with international project team and stakeholder, including team based in Sri Lanka and Malaysia. Candidates who are available to join immediately and have a technical background in software engineer, system analyst, network engineer or related IT fields are highly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
- **End-to-End Delivery: Manage the full project lifecycle for IT/Telco solution, ensuring delivery on time, within scope and within budget.**  
- **Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary point of contact for internal stakeholder and external vendor/client (e.g., MNOs, Infrastructure provider)**  
- **Planning & Governance: Define project roadmap, resource allocation and budget tracking. Facilitate Scrum ceremonies or Waterfall milestones as required**  
- **Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify project risks, develop mitigation strategies, and resolve bottlenecks to prevent project delay**  
- **Technical Liaison: Bridge the gap between technical team (Developer, Architect, QA) and business unit to ensure technical solution align with business objective**  
- **Quality Assurance: Ensure all project deliverable meet the required quality standard and compliance regulation specific to the Telco industry**

**Requirement:**  
- **Middle experience: 3–5 years of IT Project Management**   
- **Industry Knowledge: Solid understand of Telecommunication domain (e.g., BSS/OSS, Digital Apps, 5G, IoT, VAS or Core Network infrastructure)**  
- **Framework: Proficiency in Agile/Scrum and Waterfall methodologies**  
- **Tools: Expert level use of project management tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project or Trello**  
- **Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunication Engineer or a related field**

**- Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skill in English**

**- Immediate joiners are preferable**

**- Certification: PMP, PRINCE2 or CSM (Certified Scrum Master) is a strong advantage**

**- Technical Background: Prior experience as a Software Engineer, Systems Analyst, or Network Engineer is highly valued**

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable communication in English, both verbally and in writing with international stakeholder and interviewer from Sri Lanka or Malaysia?
* Please briefly describe your experience communication in English
* Do you have experience managing end-to-end IT or telecommunication project, from planning to delivery
* Do you have experience work in the telecommunication (Telco) industry?
* Which Telecommunication (Telco) domain have you work with?
* Do you have hands-on experience with Agile/Scrum and Waterfall project management methodologies?
* Which project management tools have you used professionally?
* Do you have experience manage project budget, resource allocation, timeline, risk and stakeholder expectation?
* Do you have a technical background as a Software Engineer, System Analyst, Network Engineer or in a related IT role?
* Do you hold any relevant certification such as PMP, PRINCE2 or Certified Scrum Master (CSM)?

Education:

* S1 (Required)

Experience:

* do you have in IT Project Management: 3 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

* Jakarta (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: C# .NET Senior Developer
description:
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.

Within **Thales Global Services**, the **IS-IT (Information Systems & IT)** division delivers reliable IT solutions to support the Group’s key functions, embodied by **Value Towers**. Among these, the **Sales & Marketing** and **Bid & Project** Value Towers have inspired the **ABACUS initiative**—a solution designed to **accelerate the generation of commercial offers for Spares & Repair** across the Thales Group. ABACUS enables the **accurate and efficient creation of transactional offerings** to drive recurring revenue.

To **enhance the operational efficiency of ABACUS in production**, IS-IT seeks to **internalize the required expertise** by recruiting an **experienced C# .NET Developer**. As part of the **ABACUS Agile Scrum Team** (alongside the Scrum Master and Product Owner), your mission will be to **develop and qualify the key functions** of the ABACUS solution, based on **CINCOM CPQ (Guru Management Studio)**.

**Key Responsibilities**

As the **C# .NET Development Engineer of ABACUS**, you will:

* **Develop user stories** as specified by the Product Owner, ensuring alignment with business needs.
* **Conduct unit and component testing**, and contribute to **non-regression testing campaigns** to guarantee solution stability.
* **Document implementation and configuration** of the user stories and technical stories for knowledge sharing and compliance.
* **Collaborate with vendor** (e.g., CINCOM) to gain autonomy over the development of the solution,

**Experience & Soft Skills**

* **5+ years of experience** in **developing .NET Applications in C#**, ideally with **CINCOM CPQ**.
* **Proven ability to learn quickly** and adapt to complex technical environments.
* **Strong interpersonal skills** to effectively interact with vendors, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* **Open-mindedness and cultural agility** to thrive in a **multicultural environment** (Thales operates globally).
* Due to the nature of the work English Skills is required.

**Technical Skills**

* **Proficiency in C#** on **.NET environments** (development, debugging and optimization using **Visual Studio**).
* **SQL Server** (query writing, database design, and performance tuning).
* **Microsoft PowerShell** (scripting for automation, deployment, and system management).
* **Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and code quality analysis** (GitLab, SonarQube).
* **Cloud-based development and deployment** (experience with **Azure, AWS, or Thales internal cloud** is a plus).
* **Agile/Scrum methodologies** (familiarity with sprint planning, backlog refinement, and collaborative tools like JIRA).

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: System Engineer - DevOps
description:
Join our Operations team in Bangkok and become part of a global IT organization supporting enterprise-grade loyalty systems for international customers. You will work in a distributed DevOps/SRE-driven environment responsible for maintaining high availability, reliability, and performance of mission-critical platforms. Our team operates in a 24/7 model, collaborating closely with engineering, product, and security teams across Asia, Europe and Americas. We focus on operational excellence, automation, observability, and continuous improvement. Our technology stack includes Linux-based environments, cloud and hybrid infrastructures, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring and log analytics platforms (e.g., ELK/Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana), automation tools, and scripting (Python/Bash). We use Jira, Confluence, Git-based repositories, and modern DevOps toolchains to manage and improve our services. If you are passionate about reliability, automation, and working in a high-impact operational role within the loyalty platforms domain, we would be happy to meet you.

### **Candidate profile**

* Experienced (2–5+ years) in IT Operations, DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Support
* Familiar with Linux systems
* Proficient in scripting (Bash, Python or similar)
* Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, load balancers)
* Experienced with monitoring and log analysis tools
* Familiar with CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git)
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms or containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) is a strong advantage
* **Fluent in English** (spoken and written)
* Strong problem solving skills
* Experience in loyalty platforms is a plus
* Open for learning new skills
* Proactive mindset and willingness to automate repetitive tasks
* Communicative and effective in an international environment

### **Your responsibilities**

* Monitor and maintain high availability of enterprise systems
* Troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures
* Participate in incident management and on-call rotations (if applicable)
* Collaborate with Dev, QA, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure stable releases
* Support deployments and configuration changes
* Improve system observability (logs, metrics, alerts)
* Automate operational processes to reduce manual effort
* Maintain documentation, runbooks, and operational standards
* Contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes and tooling
* Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards (ex. EU regulations)

### **For you**

* Global Scale, Startup Soul – Experience the stability of a global powerhouse while we actively transform. We are shifting from traditional structures toward a fast-paced, agile tech mindset, giving you the chance to influence how we work
* AI-First Environment – We don’t just talk about AI; we live it. You’ll work in a cutting-edge ecosystem where AI-driven tools and Google Cloud/Workspace are integrated into our DNA to eliminate busywork and amplify your creative output
* Strategic Autonomy – We hire for brainpower, not just execution. You’ll have the mandate to challenge the status quo, make high-stakes technical decisions, and own your projects from ideation to global deployment
* Interdisciplinary Synergy – Break out of silos. You will collaborate with cross-functional elite teams, gaining a 360-degree view of the digital landscape and evolving technologies
* Boundaryless Growth – Our presence across 5 different sectors and a massive digital transformation creates a unique internal landscape. With dedicated development budgets and a commitment to internal mobility, you have the tools and the playground to define your own trajectory

title: Data Scientist - Risk Analytics & Modelling
description:
**Job Description**
We're looking for candidates with strong analytical skills and hands-on experience working with financial datasets. You will be responsible for monitoring portfolio health, performing deep-dive exploration and analysis to identify risk drivers and improvements in our existing framework, and translating findings into actionable credit decisions. You will partner with business, product, and engineering teams to solve some of the most challenging problems in lending while also continuously improving portfolio quality by balancing risk control with growth opportunities. You will be embedded in a fast-paced environment, working within a strong team of data scientists with access to a robust data infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Monitor portfolio risk metrics on a regular basis and proactively flag anomalies or emerging trends
* Perform root cause analysis when risk indicators deteriorate to pinpoint what's driving the change, such as identifying suspicious behavioral patterns
* Translate findings into concrete recommendations and implement adjustments as needed
* Build and maintain SQL-based features, analyses, and monitoring dashboards to support ongoing risk surveillance
* Perform occasional model evaluation to support credit scoring improvements

**Qualifications**

* Fresh Graduate/Bachelor's degree in an analytical or quantitative discipline (e.g. math, statistics, engineering, computer science), however other disciplines will be considered
* Experienced in using statistical computer languages such as Python, SQL, and MS Excel
* Have good communication skills and able to work together in a team
* Excellent problem-solving skills and have the drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
* Willingness to learn new skills independently and have a strong sense of project ownership
* Not afraid to get your hands dirty exploring data, investigating anomalies, and building SQL-based analyses
* Comfortable working with large tabular datasets to detect trends and anomalies, and communicating findings as actionable recommendations.
* Exposure to credit scoring modelling concepts is a plus.

title: Data Center Technicians
description:
**Overview**

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Performs diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
* Performs post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
* Decommissions hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
* Follows procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.

* Assists and provides guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
* Completes required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
* Contributes to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
* Has pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
* Embodies our culture and values.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications****:**

* High school diploma, GED, or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND 1+ year(s) experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
* Ability to work shifts, including shift assignments during non-standard business hours that may include evening, nighttime, weekends, and/or holidays

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following***Preferred Qualifications:***

* 2+ years' experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
* Experience supporting customer-facing IT infrastructure, including servers, storage, networking equipment, cabling, and physical troubleshooting in a datacenter or enterprise environment.
* Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

description:
**Job Description Summary**

Responsible for analyzing, developing, and improving manufacturing processes to enhance product quality, production efficiency, and operational performance while reducing costs and minimizing downtime.

**Job Description**

* Identify opportunities to improve and standardize manufacturing processes and production performance.
* Develop proposals and improvement plans to enhance process efficiency, product quality, and productivity.
* Provide technical support to production teams in implementing process improvements.
* Analyze production data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Investigate production issues, identify root causes, and recommend corrective actions.
* Ensure manufacturing processes comply with quality standards, safety procedures, and company requirements.
* Monitor the implementation of process improvements and provide technical guidance to production personnel.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience in process engineering, manufacturing, or continuous improvement is preferred.
* Good understanding of manufacturing processes, quality control, and process improvement methodologies.
* Proficient in data analysis and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams.
* Detail-oriented and able to work effectively in a manufacturing environment.
* Placement in Tarjun, South Kalimantan

title: System Engineer - DevOps
description:
Reference number: U/SED/1026414

Locations:

Bangkok, Manila

Join our Operations team in Bangkok and become part of a global IT organization supporting enterprise-grade loyalty systems for international customers. You will work in a distributed DevOps/SRE-driven environment responsible for maintaining high availability, reliability, and performance of mission-critical platforms. Our team operates in a 24/7 model, collaborating closely with engineering, product, and security teams across Asia, Europe and Americas. We focus on operational excellence, automation, observability, and continuous improvement. Our technology stack includes Linux-based environments, cloud and hybrid infrastructures, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, monitoring and log analytics platforms (e.g., ELK/Elastic, Prometheus, Grafana), automation tools, and scripting (Python/Bash). We use Jira, Confluence, Git-based repositories, and modern DevOps toolchains to manage and improve our services. If you are passionate about reliability, automation, and working in a high-impact operational role within the loyalty platforms domain, we would be happy to meet you.

### **Candidate profile**

* Experienced (2–5+ years) in IT Operations, DevOps, SRE, or Infrastructure Support
* Familiar with Linux systems
* Proficient in scripting (Bash, Python or similar)
* Understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls, load balancers)
* Experienced with monitoring and log analysis tools
* Familiar with CI/CD pipelines and version control (Git)
* Basic understanding of cloud platforms or containerization (Kubernetes/Docker) is a strong advantage
* **Fluent in English** (spoken and written)
* Strong problem solving skills
* Experience in loyalty platforms is a plus
* Open for learning new skills
* Proactive mindset and willingness to automate repetitive tasks
* Communicative and effective in an international environment

### **Your responsibilities**

* Monitor and maintain high availability of enterprise systems
* Troubleshoot incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement preventive measures
* Participate in incident management and on-call rotations (if applicable)
* Collaborate with Dev, QA, Security, and Infrastructure teams to ensure stable releases
* Support deployments and configuration changes
* Improve system observability (logs, metrics, alerts)
* Automate operational processes to reduce manual effort
* Maintain documentation, runbooks, and operational standards
* Contribute to continuous improvement of operational processes and tooling
* Ensure compliance with internal and regulatory standards (ex. EU regulations)

### **For you**

* Global Scale, Startup Soul – Experience the stability of a global powerhouse while we actively transform. We are shifting from traditional structures toward a fast-paced, agile tech mindset, giving you the chance to influence how we work
* AI-First Environment – We don’t just talk about AI; we live it. You’ll work in a cutting-edge ecosystem where AI-driven tools and Google Cloud/Workspace are integrated into our DNA to eliminate busywork and amplify your creative output
* Strategic Autonomy – We hire for brainpower, not just execution. You’ll have the mandate to challenge the status quo, make high-stakes technical decisions, and own your projects from ideation to global deployment
* Interdisciplinary Synergy – Break out of silos. You will collaborate with cross-functional elite teams, gaining a 360-degree view of the digital landscape and evolving technologies
* Boundaryless Growth – Our presence across 5 different sectors and a massive digital transformation creates a unique internal landscape. With dedicated development budgets and a commitment to internal mobility, you have the tools and the playground to define your own trajectory

title: Sr. Delivery Consultant - Migrations and Modernization, AWS Professional Services, ASEAN
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives.  
  
You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be  
proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Own technical direction and architecture. Set the target-state architecture and technical roadmap for large, multi-workstream migration and modernization programs, tied to the customer's business objectives and measurable success criteria. Design scalable, secure AWS solutions, including multi-account strategies, networking (Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPN), identity and security controls.  
  
Set the technical bar and resolve escalations. Chair architecture and design reviews, approve technical decisions, and set the standards AWS, customer and partner teams follow. Lead technical escalations and resolve complex problems across the infrastructure, application and data layers.  
  
Deliver migration and modernization end to end. Lead engagements from discovery, assessment and wave planning through execution and post-migration validation for on-premises VM and physical server workloads. Choose the right 7R path for each workload, and drive modernization where lift-and-shift isn't feasible, through re-platforming, re-architecting, containers, serverless and database modernization.  
  
Advise customer executives and grow the account. Act as the trusted technical advisor to customer CTOs, CIOs and architecture boards, and give clear trade-off recommendations at executive steering committees. Work with Engagement Managers on scope, estimates, risks and delivery plans, and with account teams to shape follow-on modernization opportunities.  
  
Build teams and reusable capability. Lead and develop technical teams across AWS, customer and partner organizations, and hold partners to defined standards through design reviews and quality gates. Mentor consultants and architects, run technical enablement, and publish reusable artifacts, reference architectures, runbooks and accelerators for the wider practice.  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  
  
Why AWS  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  
  
Work/Life Balance  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  
  
Inclusive Team Culture  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* End-to-end migration delivery — Leads the full lifecycle from discovery, assessment, and wave planning through execution, cutover, and post-migration validation for on-premises VM and physical server workloads to AWS.
* Solution design & architecture — Designs scalable, secure AWS solutions including Landing Zone architecture (multi-account, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, VPN, security controls) and drives modernization strategies (re-platform, re-architect, containerization).
* Tooling & AI-powered acceleration — Leverages AWS migration tools (Migration Hub, ADS, MGN, DMS, CMF, AWS Transform) and agentic AI tools (Amazon Q, Kiro) across the lifecycle for automated code analysis, IaC generation, testing, and documentation to improve delivery speed and quality.
* Stakeholder advisory & business alignment — Collaborates with customer stakeholders to define migration strategies (7Rs), align solutions with business outcomes, and acts as a trusted advisor on migration best practices and emerging AWS technologies.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 7+ years of cloud architecture and solution implementation experience, or AWS Associate level certification
* 6+ years of working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations experience
* 3+ years of working with Enterprise Application Modernization and Migration technologies, including, but not limited to, Mainframe, Serverless, Containers, or Cloud Operations experience
* Experience with Cloud platforms (preferably AWS), database systems (SQL and NoSQL), AI tools for development productivity, contributing to open-source projects, and/or version control systems
* AWS certification, such as, AWS Solutions Architect, or a similar cloud certification, or Associate's degree or above
* Risk management & knowledge scaling — Manages project risks, leads escalations, identifies follow-on opportunities, and scales impact through mentoring, training, and creating reusable migration artifacts, runbooks, and accelerators.

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
**About us**
============

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

**About the role**
==================

Ruby Labs is hiring an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our fast-paced, high-ownership environment. You will drive analytics across **subscription products and web funnels**, partnering with Product, Marketing (UAM), and Data teams to improve conversion, retention, and LTV- while ensuring **trusted tracking, strong data models, and decision-ready reporting**.

This role is hands-on and cross-functional: you will own analysis from problem framing to recommendation, and you’ll mentor analysts while collaborating closely with Data Engineering/BI to keep data foundations reliable.

### **Responsibilities**

* Partner with Product, Marketing, and Data Teams to define KPIs, success metrics, and decision criteria.
* Create new dashboards, maintain and improve existing reporting (e.g., Product Reports, Marketing Performance Reports), ensuring clarity and trust.
* Deliver full-funnel analysis, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements or A/B test ideas.
* Analyze payment and subscription performance across checkout, trial-to-paid conversion, renewals, failed payments, refunds, and chargebacks; identify revenue leakage and recommend improvements.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Finance to investigate payment issues and ensure payment metrics and revenue reporting are accurate and consistent.
* Lead user behavior analysis (journeys, drop-offs, activation/aha moments) using event data.
* Monitor key metrics and anomalies; escalate issues and communicate updates to stakeholders with defined SLAs
* Own and maintain event taxonomy and tracking structure (events, properties, naming conventions); validate implementation and business logic alignment.
* Design and build robust, reusable SQL data models (clean layers, consistent definitions, performance-minded queries).
* Mentor Junior/Middle Analysts in SQL, validation, funnel/cohort analysis, and experimentation quality; provide regular feedback and guidance.
* Give and receive direct, actionable feedback with peers and the Leadership Team; maintain a high bar for quality in a demanding environment.

### **Requirements**

* Degree in an analytical field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science, Economics) **or equivalent practical experience**.
* 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, with proven ownership of end-to-end analysis and stakeholder delivery.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to identify trends, patterns, and root causes in large datasets.
* Excellent verbal and written communication; ability to translate analysis into clear business actions.
* Ability to think strategically and make data-driven recommendations aligned with company goals.
* Strong experience in Product Analytics: funnels, cohorts, retention, LTV, churn, segmentation.
* Hands-on experience with event analytics tools: Mixpanel, GA4, Amplitude, or similar
* Advanced SQL
* Experience with popular BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar
* Experience in subscription business
* Hands-on experience analyzing payment and subscription data, including checkout conversion, payment approval rates, renewals, failed payments, refunds, and chargebacks.
* Ability to adapt quickly, learn new tools and methods efficiently, and work effectively in a high-pressure, fast-changing environment
* Strong spoken and written English

### **Nice To Haves**

* Experience in Marketing Analytics
* Experience with Python, R
* Experience with GCP, BigQuery
* Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads etc
* Experience with orchestration frameworks such as Airflow, dbt
* Experience with git and code review process

**Location**
============

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Technical Interview (60 minutes)
* Final Interview (30 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

title: Data Scientist - Risk Analytics & Modelling
description:
**Job Description**
We're looking for candidates with strong analytical skills and hands-on experience working with financial datasets. You will be responsible for monitoring portfolio health, performing deep-dive exploration and analysis to identify risk drivers and improvements in our existing framework, and translating findings into actionable credit decisions. You will partner with business, product, and engineering teams to solve some of the most challenging problems in lending while also continuously improving portfolio quality by balancing risk control with growth opportunities. You will be embedded in a fast-paced environment, working within a strong team of data scientists with access to a robust data infrastructure.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Monitor portfolio risk metrics on a regular basis and proactively flag anomalies or emerging trends
* Perform root cause analysis when risk indicators deteriorate to pinpoint what's driving the change, such as identifying suspicious behavioral patterns
* Translate findings into concrete recommendations and implement adjustments as needed
* Build and maintain SQL-based features, analyses, and monitoring dashboards to support ongoing risk surveillance
* Perform occasional model evaluation to support credit scoring improvements

Qualifications
  
  

* Fresh Graduate/Bachelor's degree in an analytical or quantitative discipline (e.g. math, statistics, engineering, computer science), however other disciplines will be considered
* Experienced in using statistical computer languages such as Python, SQL, and MS Excel
* Have good communication skills and able to work together in a team
* Excellent problem-solving skills and have the drive to learn and master new technologies and techniques
* Willingness to learn new skills independently and have a strong sense of project ownership
* Not afraid to get your hands dirty exploring data, investigating anomalies, and building SQL-based analyses
* Comfortable working with large tabular datasets to detect trends and anomalies, and communicating findings as actionable recommendations.
* Exposure to credit scoring modelling concepts is a plus.

description:
**Description**
**Job Purpose :**
Own the end-to-end science practice for customer retention, graduation, and revenue growth as the most senior individual
  
  
contributor in Customer Science. This role combines deep technical execution — advanced ML modelling, causal inference,
  
  
agentic AI deployment, and graph-based network intelligence — with strategic influence: translating data science output into
  
  
commercial decisions, governing algorithmic quality across all squads, and setting the analytical gold standard for XL Smart's
  
  
subscriber base and ARPU improvement initiatives.
  
  
**Main Responsibilities**

* Design and own end-to-end ML models for churn prediction, revenue graduation, and lifetime value from feature engineering through production deployment and ongoing monitoring.
* Lead causal inference and A/B experimentation frameworks; establish and enforce statistical rigour across all squad experiments and commercial interventions.
* Build and maintain advanced strategic intelligence models: market dynamics, competitive signal detection, pricing elasticity, and network quality impact on churn.
* Architect and deploy agentic AI systems autonomous real-time ML scoring, bandit-based optimisation, and self-learning decisioning pipelines.
* Own the feature store and model registry: ensure quality, reproducibility, versioning, and governance of all Customer Science outputs.
* Define and enforce model deployment standards, drift monitoring, and retraining protocols across all squads.
* Translate model outputs into commercial briefs for senior stakeholders (Strategy, Analytics, Segment); serve as the scientific authority on all outbound Customer Science findings.
* Lead monthly data discovery sprints to identify and resolve upstream data gaps; present findings at weekly Group Head reviews.
* Drive the 30% platform migration workstream (MLOps, data engineering, cloud ML infrastructure) alongside 70% commercial task-force deliverables reviewed biweekly.
* Mentor squad analysts in advanced data science methods: causal inference, graph ML, reinforcement learning, and LLM-assisted analytics.

**Requirements**

* S1 (Strata 1) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or Engineering. S2/Master's degree in a quantitative field preferred.
* Minimum 7–10 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Customer Analytics, or AI/ML roles; including at least 3 years as a principal scientist or lead practitioner owning production ML systems.
* Certified Data Scientist (CDS), Google Professional Machine Learning Engineer, AWS Certified Machine Learning — Specialty, or equivalent advanced ML certification. PMP or equivalent project governance credential is a plus.

title: Engineering Manager, Mobile Apps
description:
**Who we are**

Since 1843, The Economist Group has championed independence, excellence and openness, helping people understand and tackle the critical challenges shaping the world. Today, we are building on that legacy as a global media and information-services company powered by digital innovation, analytical rigour and evidence-based insight.

Across our three businesses -*The Economist, Economist Enterprise and Economist Education* - we deliver trusted analysis and insights to individuals and organisations in more than 170 countries. United by a shared purpose to drive progress, we empower decision-makers to make sense of change and chart a course through an increasingly complex world.

As a colleague, you will be part of a culture that values ideas, encourages ownership and holds itself to high standards. We invest in people who are curious, thoughtful and adaptable, whether they are launching new products, reporting on global events or harnessing emerging technologies such as AI to improve how we work. Here, fresh thinking is taken seriously, ambition is matched by integrity, and great work is recognised. Working across disciplines, geographies and perspectives, we are united by a commitment to innovation, excellence and creating meaningful impact.

Want to discover more about life at The Economist Group? Follow @EconomistCareers on Instagram to discover the people, stories and opportunities that make TEG unique.

Our team of 450 colleagues across Technology, Product and Data is at the heart of The Economist Group's digital-first agenda. Together, we design, build and optimise the digital products, platforms and data capabilities that power our business and reach millions of people around the world. Whether you're an engineer, product manager, designer, data scientist or analyst, you'll work on products that have real-world impact. From enhancing economist.com and developing new products for Economist Intelligence to creating personalised experiences and applying AI to solve complex challenges, you'll help shape how consumers, businesses and government leaders access trusted insights. Working in cross-functional teams, we combine engineering excellence, product thinking and data expertise to solve meaningful problems, experiment with new technologies and continuously improve the experiences we create. It's an opportunity to do challenging, purposeful work alongside curious, collaborative colleagues, while helping drive sustainable growth for one of the world's most trusted brands.

**The role**

We are looking for a Mobile Engineering Manager to lead our iOS and Android engineering team and help shape the future of our mobile platform. This is a player-coach role: you'll own the health, delivery and growth of the mobile engineering function, staying close to the code while also leading people, and partnering closely with product to shape what we build and why. As Mobile Engineering Manager, you will work closely with engineers, product managers, designers and other engineering leads to ship a fast, reliable and well-crafted mobile experience.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead and grow a team of iOS and Android engineers, providing day-to-day management, mentorship and career development.
* Stay hands-on: review code, contribute to architectural decisions, and step into implementation when it matters.
* Own delivery for the mobile team: planning, prioritisation, and removing blockers in partnership with product management.
* Set and uphold engineering standards for code quality, testing, performance, accessibility and release practices across both platforms.
* Partner with Product, Design, QA and backend/platform teams to turn roadmap priorities into a well-sequenced, technically sound mobile plan.
* Get hands-on with product and business requirements: ask questions, spot gaps, and help refine specs before and during build, rather than treating them as fixed inputs from the product.
* Use business and product metrics (engagement, retention, subscriber conversion, crash-free rate, and similar) to inform prioritisation, trade-off decisions, and what "done" looks like for a feature.
* Drive improvements to the team's engineering practices: CI/CD, release cadence, crash/performance monitoring, and app store operations.
* Recruit, interview and onboard new mobile engineers as the team grows.
* Represent mobile engineering in broader engineering leadership discussions, including technical strategy and cross-team dependencies.

**Who you are**

* Proven experience as an engineering manager or tech lead with direct people-management responsibility for mobile engineers.
* Strong hands-on background in native mobile development (iOS/Swift and/or Android/Kotlin), comfortable reviewing code and discussing architecture in both ecosystems.
* Track record of shipping and operating consumer-facing mobile apps at scale, including release management and app store submission processes.
* Experience balancing hands-on technical contribution with people leadership and delivery ownership.
* Strong understanding of mobile engineering fundamentals: performance, offline/networking, accessibility, testing (unit/UI), and CI/CD for mobile.
* Excellent communication skills, able to work closely with product, design and other engineering functions, and to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong product sense: comfortable interrogating and refining product/business requirements rather than just implementing them as given, and able to spot when a requirement doesn't hold up.

#LI-Hybrid

**Working Arrangements**

The majority of our roles operate on a hybrid working pattern, with 3+ days office attendance required.

**AI usage for your application**

We are an innovative organisation that encourages the use of technology. We recognise that candidates may utilise AI tools to support with their job application process. However, it is essential that all information you provide truthfully and accurately reflects your own experience, skills, and qualifications.

**What we offer**

Our benefits package is designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and work-life balance. It includes a highly competitive pension or 401(k) plan, private health insurance, and 24/7 access to counselling and wellbeing resources through our Employee Assistance Program.

We also offer a range of lifestyle benefits, including our *Work From Anywhere* program, which allows you to work from any location where you have the legal right to do so for up to 25 days per year. In addition, we provide generous annual and parental leave, as well as dedicated days off for volunteering and even for moving home.

You will also be given free access to all *The Economist* content, including an online subscription, our range of apps, podcasts and more.

title: Data Scientist - AI (Collection)
description:
Kredivo is hiring a **Data Scientist – AI (Collection)** in our Jakarta office to build AI-powered products that change how we collect payments from customers. This position will report to the **Lead Data Scientist – Collection & SPG** and will be accountable for designing, shipping and measuring AI solutions across the collection journey, from early reminders to late-stage recovery.

In this role you will also be responsible for driving AI transformation within Collection: building conversational AI (chatbots and voice bots/robocalls), automating desk collection audit processes, and applying LLMs to collection workflows. In addition, you will be responsible for proving business impact through rigorous experiments and working closely with Collection Ops, Product and Engineering to put models into production.

  
  
  

**About the job:**

* To design and build LLM-powered collection assistants (WhatsApp/in-app chatbots, AI voice agents/robocalls)
* To build automated audit and analysis of desk collection calls and chats, using speech-to-text and LLMs to check them against collection SOPs at scale and turn them into insights for Collection Ops
* To develop and improve predictive models (e.g. propensity-to-pay, contactability, best channel/time to contact) that decide who to contact, when and how
* To design and analyze A/B tests that measure impact on collection KPIs (roll rate, recovery rate, cost per collection)
* To work with Engineering and Ops to deploy, scale and iterate on solutions, and to make sure they follow our internal collection guidelines

**About you:**

* Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related quantitative field
* 2+ years of experience in data science or ML, ideally in fintech, lending, collections or customer operations
* Strong Python and SQL; hands-on with ML libraries (scikit-learn, XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch or similar)
* Hands-on experience building with LLMs: prompt engineering, RAG, function calling/agents, and LLM APIs or open-source models
* Exposure to conversational AI or voice tech (chatbot frameworks, STT/TTS, voice bot platforms) is a strong plus
* Solid grounding in experimentation and statistics (A/B testing, causal inference basics)
* Experience deploying models to production or working with MLOps tools (Airflow, Docker, cloud platforms) is a plus
* Fluent in Bahasa Indonesia and good English; able to explain technical work to non-technical stakeholders
* Product-minded and hands-on: you like shipping, measuring and iterating quickly

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you!

  

#LI-AL1
