description:
**Overview**

Are you passionate about software development and excited to help shape its future with AI? Join Microsoft as a **Software Solution Engineer – Developer Productivity**, where you’ll help enterprise customers modernize their software development lifecycle (SDLC), adopt **Agentic SDLC** practices, and build the next generation of intelligent applications.

Microsoft is transforming the developer experience by bringing AI into every stage of the SDLC. Bringing together GitHub, Visual Studio, VS Code, and Azure AI Foundry, you’ll help customers explore how developers and AI agents can work together across planning, coding, testing, deployment, and operations. Your focus will go beyond individual productivity: you’ll help engineering leaders rethink development workflows, integrate agentic capabilities into their toolchains, and pursue measurable improvements in delivery speed, software quality, and security.

As a trusted technical advisor, you’ll translate customer priorities into secure, scalable architectures and practical adoption roadmaps. Whether helping a global bank modernize DevSecOps, scaling GitHub Copilot across thousands of engineers, or designing workflows that combine developer expertise with AI agents, you’ll guide customers from traditional SDLC practices toward AI-native, agentic software delivery while maintaining human oversight, governance, and engineering rigor. You’ll also help teams use Microsoft’s developer and AI platforms to build, integrate, and operate intelligent applications.

Through hands-on proofs of concept, hackathons, code-with sessions, and architecture workshops, you’ll work directly with developers, engineering leaders, and platform teams to demonstrate technical value, influence platform decisions, and accelerate adoption. This role combines deep technical engagement with the opportunity to shape how enterprise engineering organizations build software in the AI era.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

 **Responsibilities**

* Drive technical sales engagements with developers, engineering leaders, and technical decision-makers, using demos and proofs of concept (PoCs) to influence solution design, demonstrate value, and enable production deployments.
* Lead hands-on engagements, including hackathons, code-with sessions, and architecture workshops, to accelerate adoption of Microsoft’s developer tools, AI capabilities, and cloud platforms.
* Guide customers in modernizing their software development lifecycle (SDLC) and adopting **Agentic SDLC** practices, integrating AI-assisted coding and AI agents into planning, development, testing, code review, deployment, and operations.
* Build trusted relationships with developers, platform leads, and AI decision-makers to co-design secure, scalable architectures for AI-powered applications and agentic development workflows, incorporating human oversight and enterprise governance.
* Resolve technical blockers and objections, collaborating with product and engineering teams to communicate customer feedback, inform product improvements, and accelerate adoption.
* Maintain deep technical expertise in GitHub, Visual Studio, Visual Studio Code, AI-assisted development tools, Azure AI Foundry and its SDKs, CI/CD, DevOps, and cloud-native development, including APIs, containers, and microservices.
* Help customers define and evaluate success criteria for technical engagements, connecting improvements in developer productivity, software quality, security, and delivery speed to business outcomes.
* Represent Microsoft through technical thought leadership, demonstrations, and knowledge sharing in developer communities and customer forums

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field AND 8+ years of technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience; OR bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology OR equivalent experience.
* Familiarity with DevOps and DevSecOps practices, including version control, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), automated testing, and security integration across the software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools, such as GitHub Copilot, Codex, or Claude Code, and their application to developer productivity and software engineering workflows.
* Understanding of **Agentic SDLC** concepts, including how developers and AI agents can collaborate across planning, coding, testing, code review, and deployment, with appropriate human oversight and governance.

title: Business System Administrator
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented, structured, independent, and reliable **Business System Administrator** to join our thriving team. Our ideal candidate is an experienced professional whose previous work revolves around accounts and access, system administration, data management, and internal team support. Previous experience working with Australian or Western agencies and proficiency in Python, Javascript, or SQL will be a great additional point.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Account and Access**

* Handle Google Workspace joiners, suspensions and offboarding end to end (mailbox, Drive transfer, groups, devices, licence) without step-by-step guidance.
* Administer groups, org units, security settings and two-factor enforcement.
* Run the organisation's password manager: vault structure, group access, joiner/leaver flows, and finding credentials untouched for a year.
* Grant and revoke access on third-party platforms, including client-owned accounts where we only have delegated access.
* Trace who holds access when there's no record, then leave one behind.

**System Administration**

* Configure the CRM properly: users, roles, object and field permissions, views, and hiding versus denying access to a record.
* Administer Asana at workspace level: teams, projects, permissions, templates, bulk changes.
* Track licences across all tools: who holds what, what's unused, what renews when, what to cancel.
* Maintain an ownership register per tool: commercial owner, administrator, payer and renewal date, keeping owner and administrator separate.

**Data and Cleanup**

* Reconcile entities that differ across systems (e.g. mapping clients across our three Search Console accounts) and keep that picture accurate.
* Import, merge and de-duplicate records at volume without losing history, and ask rather than guess when unsure.
* Do bulk spreadsheet work (lookups, joins across exports) and verify your output before it lands.

**Reporting and Measurement**

* Produce the monthly operations scorecard from agreed sources, on a published schedule, without being asked.
* Keep the data schedule current: each measure’s definition, source system, owner and refresh rate.
* Flag a measure you can’t produce, with what’s missing instead of estimating it.
* Raise any change to how a measure is calculated before applying it, not after.

**Support and Routing**

* Act as the single intake point for "something is broken" from both offices: fix, route, or escalate with what you've already tried.
* Hand off requests that belong to others instead of quietly absorbing them.
* Chase blocked requests without being reminded.

**Writing and Working Across Time Zones**

* Write procedures others can follow without asking you; your manager is in another country.
* Take a request, carry it to completion, and report that it is done or that it is stuck, without being asked.
* Keep the wiki current as systems change, not as an annual project.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in IT, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Minimum 2-4 years of experience in a IT support, systems administration or business operations
* Hands-on experience as a Google Workspace admin (users, groups, org units, security settings, Drive transfers)
* Strong spreadsheet skills: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, joins across exports, pivot tables, data validation
* Familiarity with data import, merge and de-duplication in CRMs and other systems
* Basic troubleshooting across accounts, devices and SaaS tools
* Excellent written English, especially clear, step-by-step documentation
* Ability to work independently across time zones with minimal supervision
* Proactive ownership: follows through and reports "done" or "stuck" without prompting
* Good triage judgment: knows what to fix, route or escalate
* Attention to detail and self-checking of work
* Comfortable producing a recurring report to a fixed definition, and self-checking the numbers before they go.

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Bali: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

description:
**Description**

  
**A Day in the Life of a Personalized Internet Ads Assessor:**  
In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout  
Your ultimate goal will be to contribute towards making internet search and online advertising more relevant and interesting for millions of users, including yourself.  
  
Join our team today and start putting your skills to work for one of the world's leading online advertising platforms while being a part of a supportive community that offers:  
  
Access to complimentary mental health support benefits like free EAP and Mindfulness Apps.  
Dedicated, responsive well-being team proactively offering well-being education each month, as well as quarterly initiatives.  
  
**TELUS Digital AI Community**  
Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands.  
  
**Qualification path**  
No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement.  
  
**Basic Requirements**  
Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills with full professional proficiency in English and Indonesian  
Having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in Indonesia  
Active use of Gmail, Google+, and other forms of social media and experience in the use of web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of content  
Daily access to a broadband internet connection, a smartphone (Android 4.1, iOS 8 or higher), and a personal computer with antivirus software to work on. You’ll also need a Barcode Scanner application to be installed on your smartphone to complete certain tasks.  
This is an explicit human evaluation role. Live task rating requires authentic human judgment, perspective, and evaluation  
  
**Assessment**  
In order to be hired into the program, you’ll take a language assessment and an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification.  
Random language proficiency checks may be conducted via video or phone calls throughout the duration of the program, and your participation will be mandatory. Don't worry, our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience!  
  
**Equal Opportunity**  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

 **About Company:**  
  
TELUS Digital is the customer experience transformation partner to the world's most admired brands. Our diverse team weaves data, technology, and human ingenuity to deliver differentiated customer journeys, drive operational effectiveness, and scale AI solutions with meaningful value and positive impact.  
  
We craft real-world solutions in the moments that matter, from customer acquisition to lifelong loyalty. Enabled by our global reach - spanning 78,000 experts in 33 countries - and deep industry expertise, we help over 600 organizations make the customer experience feel effortless.  
  
Our solutions span Data & AI, Digital Experience & IT, CX Management and Trust & Safety. At the core of our innovation is Fuel iX™, an enterprise-grade generative AI platform that helps clients safely access and optimize leading LLMs to scale their own AI from pilot to production.  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer Statement**  
  
At TELUS Digital, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. All aspects of employment, including the decision to hire and promote, are based on applicant's qualifications, merits, competence and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Sr. Specialist Solutions Architect (AI/ML)
description:
**FEQ128R1**

**Location: Singapore**

As the AI Product Specialist, you will be defining our technical go to market strategy and driving our AI product adoption in the Asia Pacific and Japan region.

You will be directly working with customers to guide and influence their data application architecture and decisions. You will be expected to present, demo and pitch Databricks AI/ML product suite and you will be acting as a trusted advisor for senior executives and your in-depth technical knowledge will ensure our customers are successful in leveraging Databricks to solve their business problems.

You will be the technical expert to support our field engineering teams internally and you will be expected to help enable the team to understand the key differentiators of our product against our competitors. You will partner with product managers to help to define the product direction based on local knowledge and inform our product strategy with our go-to-market field teams. You will not have any direct reports but will recruit and lead a group of specialists across the field dedicated to scale your impact.

You will also be a thought leader externally to the market via speaking at conferences, online webinars, and blog posts. You will meet with customers to communicate the vision and gather feedback.

You have expertise in designing and delivering cloud-based Data Visualisation and Analytics Solutions. You will bring your in depth knowledge and experience of building production level data applications leveraging different technologies. You will excel in creating and articulating a compelling value proposition for our customers and enabling Account Executives and Field Engineers to operate effectively using best practices and assets that you own and develop.

**The impact you will have:**

* Lead the vision and strategy for AI products adoption in Asia Pacific and Japan
* Develop materials for our GTM team to effectively communicate our value proposition
* Support our field teams in key strategic pursuit opportunities
* Work with a team of subject matter experts (SMEs) to scale your impact in local regions and enable the broader field team to have confidence in competing in the market
* Act as the thought leader to build confidence and relationships with our customers at the executive level
* Present externally at conferences, events and webinars and publish content to establish our position in the market
* Work with our FDE teams and partners to establish best practices
* Act as a cross-functional representative with Product Management, Product Marketing and Engineering on our go-to-market motion

**What we look for:**

* 6+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning and 2+ years in production Gen AI
* Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Trusted advisor to technical executives that inform strategic data decisions
* Proven ability to co-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross-functional effort across GTM and R&D teams.
* Expertise in traditional Machine Learning methodologies and have deployed large scale production systems
* Deep understanding of LLM application architectures (RAG, agentic, fine-tuning), agent frameworks (LangGraph / LlamaIndex / AutoGen / DSPy), eval methodology and foundational model markets (Claude, Llama, Mistral, OpenAI, open-source)
* Proven track record of successful pre-sales experience in competitive situations
* Ability to define and executive strategic program cross functionally
* High impact communication internally and externally

**About Databricks**

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.  
  
**Benefits**  
  
At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

  

**Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

**Compliance**

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
**About Luxehouze**
Luxehouze is a fast-growing omnichannel luxury marketplace with an established presence in Singapore and Indonesia, two key markets in Southeast Asia's luxury retail landscape.
  
  
Through our operations in both markets, we bring together a curated selection of luxury watches, fashion, and beauty, serving discerning customers through integrated online and offline retail experiences.
  
  
As we continue to strengthen our regional footprint, we are building a business driven by product expertise, customer trust, commercial excellence, and a passion for luxury.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
We are looking for a Senior QA Analyst who combines a strong understanding of luxury fashion with commercial acumen and an entrepreneurial mindset.
  
  
Join us in shaping our company and contributing to the growth of a luxury retail business across two dynamic Southeast Asian markets.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Analyze requirements and create, review, and maintain test cases and test scenarios.
* Execute functional, regression, smoke, and cross-browser/responsive testing for web applications.
* Identify, document, and track bugs using Jira or a similar defect-management tool.
* Perform API testing (e.g., Postman) and validate system integrations when required.
* Validate data using basic SQL queries.
* Support and contribute to test automation (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium).
* Collaborate with Product, Design, and Engineering to clarify requirements and reproduce issues.
* Support UAT and production deployment validation; ensure releases meet acceptance criteria.
* Contribute to improving QA processes and documentation.

**Requirement & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 2–4 years of experience in software testing / QA, preferably for web applications.
* Good understanding of SDLC and STLC, and testing types (functional, regression, smoke, UAT).
* Able to write clear, well-structured test cases and bug reports.
* Experience with bug-tracking tools (Jira, Trello, or similar).
* Experience with API testing (Postman or similar) and basic SQL.
* Exposure to automation tools (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium) with basic scripting in JavaScript/TypeScript or similar.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and good communication skills.

title: Merchant Operations Representative
description:
**About PayJoy**

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.

**This role**

### **About the role**

Merchant Operations is dedicated to providing administrative support in conjunction with internal and external stakeholders, to foster a satisfactory and positive relationship between PayJoy and our partners.

The **Merchant Operations Representative** for PayJoy Indonesia will be tasked with taking care of the admin/merchant/clerk (partners) onboarding process, identifying potential risks in current processes, and providing insights to stakeholders. The perfect candidate should be comfortable mentoring and guiding a team, comfortable with people across the organization, and focused on improving processes and issues found to ensure a great customer (admin, merchant, and clerk) experience.

In this role, they will own, monitor and improve merchant support metrics (e.g. onboarding turnaround time, requirement completeness, etc). Additionally, the hired candidate will report to the Merchant Operations Supervisor, forge strong alliances with the other Merchant Ops team members, and the Commercial team, and interact with other business operations and merchant support team members from other PayJoy-operating countries, ensuring they perform according to local expectations. This role will follow the standardization of PayJoy global merchant support metrics and initiatives (e.g. aligning a common cross-country approach for merchant support quality assurance ratings), seek for optimization of resources (e.g. creating guidance documents from the tools we are using), and manage reporting tasks. This role will be instrumental in the newly launched operations.

### **Responsibilities**

* **Partner Support & Operations:** Handle partners’ queries, support requests, and operational coordination. Ensure timely and efficient resolution of issues while maintaining a positive partner experience. Own the partner communication channel and NPS
* **Documentation & Onboarding**: Manage merchant/partner onboarding, including documentation, data entry, and record-keeping. Streamline the onboarding process to ensure accuracy and compliance.
* **Store Management**: Oversee store-related tasks, including creation, closure, and clerk management. Ensure smooth store operations and effective clerk management.
* **Operational Efficiency**: Focus on optimizing processes and ensuring smooth collaboration between teams. Identify bottlenecks, streamline workflows, and facilitate communication between different functions.
* Perform outbound calls to the customers
* Execute quality control/assurance/maintenance
* Standardize, localize, and run the partners' onboarding and support processes
* Act as a subject matter expert regarding specific issues and concerns raised by the partners
* Provide accurate, valid, and complete information by using the right methods/tools
* Provide a weekly report (during a meeting or through a template) and recommendations for better merchant experience for the related managers
* Perform data reconciliation of payments and disbursements to be coordinated with Finance departments
* Manage the store’s required clerks / promoters documentation

### **Requirements**

* Native verbal and written communication in Bahasa Indonesia
* Basic verbal and written communication in English
* Strong operations handling mentality and experience on both manual and automated works
* Willing to work on-site in the SCBD area
* Intermediate knowledge and experience in data analysis
* Aligned with PayJoy’s principles and cultures
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 1 (one) year of working in merchant support/business support (finance industry background is preferred)
* Interested in growing a career as a merchant operations professional and manager
* Must be detail and process-oriented, and have experience working with robust SLAs

* Self-orientation, drive, and ability to communicate clearly and persuasively to customers
* Comfortable working on Google Suite (Sheet, Docs, Slides, etc) / Microsoft Excel, and analytics
* Reliable/strong internet connection (if needed to work from home)
* Strong interest & experience on CRM tool, Google Script integration and automation will be a plus

### **Benefits**

* 100% Company Funded : Private Health Insurance for employee and immediate family
* 20 days vacation
* Phone finance, headphone, home office equipment and wellness perks.
* USD$2,000 annual co-working travel benefit
* USD$2,000 annual professional development benefit
* USD$500 annual wellness benefit

title: Applications Technical Specialist I
description:
**About us**

Worley is a global company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia. We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value across the life of their assets. We specialize in consulting, engineering, procurement and construction across the project lifecycle, with services extending through to operations and decommissioning. Leveraging extensive experience and AI-enabled delivery, we support customers in navigating complexity as they meet today's needs and transition to more sustainable solutions.

***As an Applications Technical Specialist I with Worley,*** you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc

**The Role**

* Collaborate with business stakeholders and other cross functional team members (Developers, Functional Analysts, and Testers) to produce scalable, efficient and supportable solutions utilizing Oracle OBIEE, EBS and secondary reporting technologies.
* Drive the design, build and implementation of solutions to solve business requirements for analysis, solutioning, testing, implementation and production support of a reporting solution for Oracle EBS and other systems.
* Implement new functionality, system capabilities, and solutions to enhance the user experience.
* Act as the liaison between business and technology teams to review reporting requirement, business processes, understand requirements, perform fit/gap analysis, evaluate options and decide direction.
* Coordinate with infrastructure resources, and managed services team to deliver a scalable, well-performing environment for users.
* Act as a project manager/coordinator for small to midsize initiatives – Define project scope and objectives by gathering requirements, develop project plans, timelines and lead the successful execution.
* Responsible to ensure appropriate testing is designed and successfully tested. Responsible for review of results conducted by others to identify completeness and possible problems. Communicating with development team on problems and errors for resolution.
* Responsible for working with internal and managed services functional service in troubleshooting and root cause analysis while fostering learning atmosphere.
* Coordinate work efforts with internal and vendor-based team(s) for application changes, production issues, and system performance issues.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:

* Degree related to Finance, Accounting, Computer Science or another relevant field
* Fluent/Proficient in written and spoken English
* 7+ years’ Oracle OBIEE, ODI, EBS 19c/23ai with focus in Projects, GL, and SLA
* 5+ years’ experience with OBIEE data modeling, ETL load, SQL query and data extract from EBS
* 5+ years’ experience with data integrations/replications and operational reporting
* 5+ years’ experience with Oracle Data Integrator and ETL processes.
* 5+ years’ experience in global environments with in-depth understanding of Multi-Org, Currency conversions, intercompany, borrowed & lent concepts.
* 3+ years’ experience with OBIA (Oracle Business Intelligence Application)/BIApps
* 3+ years’ experience with building reporting dashboards using BI Publisher
* 3+ years’ experience with managing geographically dispersed team

**Other Qualifications**

* Knowledge of OBIA pre-built content and experience with customizing / extending OBIA pre-built content, BIACM.
* Strong understanding of Data Warehouse (DW)
* Knowledgeable in other Oracle EBS modules (AP, AR, FA, Collections, OTL, HR, Procurement)
* Knowledgeable with project-based accounting concepts (e.g. DSO, Work at Risk, Backlog)
* Knowledgeable in multiple of the following reporting tools: Power BI, Noetix, Essbase, Data Warehousing, OBIEE, Oracle Analytical Server, Tableau, Cognos, Hyperion
* Ability to communicate effectively with Operational and Corporate Finance groups
* Skilled detail-oriented problem solver. Ability to identify problems and research root cause
* Hands-On experience in writing SQL queries and good understanding of R12 table structures is required
* Experience in month-end processes, ledger reconciliation and summary reporting tools to develop internal and external reports is required
* Technical savvy with the ability to quickly understand different systems and processes
* Ability to provide clear oral and written communication to a variety of business and technical audiences.
* Proven experience in designing and supporting RICEW components.
* Familiarity and experience with Hyperion suite is an advantage.
* Ability to coordinate and support activities beyond regular working hours
* Experience in project based and/or engineering industry a plus
* Strong verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills
* Strong people skills
* A self-starter, motivated, forward thinker, and takes ownership
* Ability to think strategically in connecting data flows into big picture business outcomes
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving, analytical mindset required

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation. We're building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.

And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology. Whatever your ambition, there's a path for you here.

And there's no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.

title: BCG Platinion Lead/Principal AI Tech Consultant
description:
**Locations**: Singapore | Malaysia | Indonesia | Thailand

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

**About BCG Platinion**

BCG Platinion's presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. We achieve digital excellence for clients with sustained solutions to the most complex and time-sensitive challenge. We guide clients into the future to push the status quo, overcome tech limitations, and enable our clients to go further in their digital journeys than what has ever been possible in the past. At BCG Platinion, we deliver business value through the innovative use of technology at a rapid pace. We roll up our sleeves to transform business, revolutionize approaches, satisfy customers, and change the game through Architecture, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Enterprise Application and Risk functions. We balance vision with a pragmatic path to change transforming strategies into leading-edge tech platforms, at scale.

**Practice Area**

BCG Platinion launched in Germany in 2000 to add deep technical expertise to the Boston Consulting Group’s existing capabilities. Today, our presence spans across the globe, with offices in Asia, Europe, and South and North America. Our New York-based North American team began in 2014 and in 2017 acquired MAYA Design, a Pittsburgh-based digital design and innovation lab, to grow our capabilities around technology and design.

We support our clients’ total digital transformation through technology, design, cybersecurity, and risk management & financial engineering capabilities. And together with BCG, BCG Platinion’s interdisciplinary team of technical experts enable customized technical solutions and accelerate delivery value through new business platforms, application consolidations, and major system implementations.

What You'll Do

**Role Overview**
-----------------

As a **Lead/Principal Consultant in Technology Advisory & Delivery** with **BCG Platinion**, you will shape and drive the digital and technology agendas of leading organizations across Southeast Asia. Building on deep technical and consulting experience, you will work alongside senior consultants, architects, and BCG case teams to **lead complex technology transformations, define IT strategies, and deliver large-scale digital solutions** across industries.

At this level, you will operate as a **senior technology leader and trusted advisor**, balancing strategic problem-solving with hands-on technical leadership, while contributing to **people development, chapter capability building, and firm growth**.

We welcome candidates with experience in technology advisory and large-scale digital transformation across diverse industries, with a particular focus on Industrial Goods, Manufacturing and Energy. Experience in Financial Services, Telecommunications and other sectors is also valued.

**Your Key Responsibilities**
-----------------------------

### **Client Leadership & Advisory**

* Lead the **design and implementation of technology strategies and digital solutions**, ensuring clear alignment with client business objectives
* Act as a **trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders**, influencing technology direction, investment decisions, and transformation priorities
* Translate business strategy into **scalable technology and delivery roadmaps**, balancing ambition, risk, and feasibility

### **Architecture & Solution Leadership**

* Lead the **analysis, assessment, and optimization of complex IT architectures** (enterprise, solution, data, cloud), ensuring scalability, performance, and long-term sustainability
* Define **target-state architectures** and transition roadmaps across multiple initiatives and systems
* Oversee the **design, development, and delivery of functional and technical solutions** across the full value chain
* Provide architectural guidance and governance across vendors, platforms, and delivery teams

### **Delivery & Program Ownership**

* Own and steer **major project or program workstreams**, ensuring high-quality delivery, effective risk management, and alignment with timelines and expectations
* Guide **software and vendor selection processes**, enterprise and solution architecture discussions, and implementation decisions
* Intervene proactively to resolve complex delivery, architectural, or stakeholder challenges

### **Team, Chapter & Firm Contribution**

* Lead, coach, and mentor consultants and architects, building **high-performing, diverse teams** within the TAD chapter
* Contribute to **chapter capability building**, including playbooks, accelerators, reusable assets, and best practices
* Support **business development and presales activities**, including proposal shaping, solution design, and senior client presentations
* Stay at the forefront of **digital and technology trends**, bringing innovative perspectives to clients and strengthening BCG Platinion’s thought leadership

What You'll Bring

* **8+ years of experience** in IT consulting, technology advisory, digital transformation, and/or relevant industry roles
* Proven experience leading **complex technology advisory and delivery engagements** in enterprise environments
* Deep expertise in one or more architecture domains, with the ability to operate at **enterprise scale**:

  + Enterprise, solution, application, data, cloud, or platform architecture
* Strong ability to **connect technology decisions to business outcomes**, shaping executive-level conversations
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing **high-performing, cross-functional teams**
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure and solve **ambiguous, high-stakes problems**
* Exceptional communication, storylining, and client-facing consulting skills
* Strategic mindset with senior presence and professional gravitas when engaging executives
* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline
* Advanced degree (MBA, Master’s, PhD) and/or relevant architecture or cloud certifications are advantageous
* Experience in technology consulting, enterprise architecture or large-scale digital transformation within Industrial Goods, Manufacturing, Energy or other complex enterprise environments.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel within the **Southeast Asia / Asia-Pacific region**
* **More experienced candidates may be considered for appointment at the Principal or Director level.**

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Technology Manager (App)
description:
**Responsibilities**

**About The Role**

At Tentang Anak, we move super fast because we work for the needs of 80 million Indonesian children & families that can’t wait. We seek people who are hungry to solve the problem, accountable & bring speed in everything they do. As we scale our technology to deliver even greater impact, we’re looking for a Technical Lead who will drive engineering excellence, mentor a growing team, and help shape a product that truly improves parenting in Indonesia.

**What You’ll Own**

* Technical Leadership
* Lead by example with hands-on code development while guiding system design and architecture
* Design, develop, and maintain robust systems (monolithic and microservices), including commerce transactions, content delivery, and user personalization
* Ensure code quality, system scalability, and security in all solutions
* Conduct thorough, high-standard code reviews to maintain best practices across the team
* Make sound architectural decisions that balance ideal solutions with business needs and timelines
* Team Mentorship
* Coach engineers of all levels, helping them develop both technical skills and product thinking
* Foster a product engineering mindset in the team—every engineer understands the “why” behind their work
* Model ownership, clarity, and effective collaboration
* Cross-functional Collaboration & Delivery
* Work closely with Product, Design, QA, and other departments to deliver impactful features quickly without sacrificing quality
* Help define, refine, and improve engineering processes (planning, sprints, retrospectives) to maximize team velocity and clarity
* Unblock engineers and ensure delivery aligns with business priorities

**What Success Looks Like (6 - 12 Months)**

* The team consistently ships high-quality features and bug fixes with minimal rework
* Engineering practices mature, with clear standards and shared understanding
* Technical debt is managed proactively, with critical systems stable, secure, and performant
* Junior and mid-level engineers grow under your mentorship, taking on more ownership and responsibility
* Product and business teams see engineering as a true partner in delivering value

How We Work

At Tentang Anak, we value:

* Product Engineering Mindset: Every engineer understands the user and the business
* Ownership and Clarity: We take responsibility for outcomes and communicate clearly
* Collaboration: We work as one team, across engineering, product, design, and business
* Continuous Improvement: We learn from failures, share feedback, and get better together

  
**Requirements**

**You’re a Fit If You…**

* Have 5+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, ideally in fast-paced product environments
* Have 2+ years leading or mentoring engineers in a team setting
* Are excited to stay hands-on with code, balancing leadership with active contribution
* Demonstrate strong knowledge of system design, including microservices, performance tuning, monitoring, and secure architecture
* Know when to follow best practices strictly and when to compromise to deliver pragmatically
* Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code, and demand the same from others
* Communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Care about the user experience and can translate business goals into practical engineering plans
* Are excited to help millions of families in Indonesia with your work

**Bonus Points For**

* Experience with e-commerce platforms or payment integrations
* Experience working in or integrating with retail business flows (e.g., ERP systems, distribution, retail operations)
* Background in mobile backend APIs and building user-engaging features
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing

**Seniority & Scope**

* This is a senior individual contributor role with technical leadership responsibility.
* You will lead a small-to-medium engineering team (typically 2 - 4 developers), mentoring them while staying hands-on with code development.
* You’ll be responsible for technical direction, system design, code quality, and delivery outcomes within your squad or functional area.
* You’ll work closely with the Engineering Manager (EM), Head of Engineering (HoE), Product team, and COO to align priorities with business goals, ensuring a balance of technical excellence and pragmatic delivery.

  
**About Tentang Anak**

Imagine a career where you play a pivotal role in ensuring the success and bright future of 80 million children in Indonesia. Tentang Anak is not just a company; it's a mission, a movement, and an opportunity to be part of something truly extraordinary.

Tentang Anak, at its core, is driven by a mission to advance the well-being and development of 80 million children throughout Indonesia. Founded by a team of experts, including pediatricians, child psychologists, and early childhood educators, we are steadfast in our commitment to supporting children with the most reliable education and products. From educational tools (e.g., applications, books, flashcards, puzzles) to essential skincare, Tentang Anak aims to accompany and provide the best solutions for parents and their children, from the moment they wake up until they fall asleep.

Our products are the one and only in Indonesia that are developed by experts, backed by science, and offered at affordable prices. We are humbled by the love our products receive from parents, consistently ranking our Educational Tools and Skincare highly on e-commerce platforms, making them best-sellers. We will continue to innovate and provide better solutions for parents at every step of their journey. We are dedicated to creating a brighter, healthier, and happier future for the children of Indonesia.

Our employees, whom we call TAmily, are a group of relentless and passionate individuals who share the same mission and ambitions. Are you ready to join us in this mission?

title: Operations Administrator
description:
**Who we are**
--------------

**DISPENDIX** is a dynamic deep-tech company with products that enable scientists and researchers around the world to make new discoveries in areas such as drug discovery, diagnostics and personalized medicine. Our passion drives us to develop high-tech premium liquid handling instruments for laboratory automation in the life science industry. In 2018, **DISPENDIX** became part of **BICO** Group.

  

Our vision is: To enable and automate the life science lab of the future.

We are looking for a **Operations Administrator** (m/f/d), to join our international Operations team. The position is based in **Bandung, Indonesia** .

  

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Create, maintain, and update item, supplier, product, and procurement-related master data in Microsoft Dynamics 365.
* Support the setup of new products, spare parts, service parts, and purchased materials while ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
* Support purchasing activities, including purchase order creation, supplier follow-up, delivery tracking, and supplier onboarding.
* Assist with RFQs, quotation comparisons, purchasing documentation, and indirect procurement activities.
* Prepare operational reports and KPI analyses and support inventory and transaction accuracy in ERP systems.
* Maintain operational and compliance-related documentation and support audits, data quality reviews, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Provide administrative and coordination support across Operations and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, R&D, Product Management, and other functions.  

  

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Operations, Engineering, or a related field.
* First experience in Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, Administration, or Master Data Management, ideally within a manufacturing or supply chain environment.
* Experience working with ERP systems, preferably Microsoft Dynamics 365, and strong Microsoft Excel skills.
* Experience with master data maintenance and/or purchasing activities is an advantage.
* Strong attention to detail with a structured, accurate, and process-oriented approach to work.
* Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage different tasks and priorities reliably.
* Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and international teams.
Professional proficiency in English; Bahasa Indonesia is an advantage.  

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

Joining **DISPENDIX** means being part of something big and shaping the future of medicine. We are a fast-growing life sciences company with award winning products and a fun, cool team that is friendly and supportive.

* **Agile start-up culture** : being a dynamic and international company and still benefit from a flat organizational structure. We work agile (SCRUM) in cross functional teams that is very progressive.
* **Freedom** : There is a lot of opportunity to get involved in new projects and have an impact. There is a level of freedom to take ownership and responsibility and work on projects you enjoy.
* **Development** : We regularly celebrate individual accomplishments and develop new skills through training courses. We have a talented team you can learn from and gain hands-on knowledge outside of your main responsibilities.
* **Flexible working** : We focus on results not working hours, we want our employees to be as productive and happy as possible. Depending on the position and tasks also mobile working is possible.
* **Team building:** Teamwork is a top priority for us! We are open-minded, help each other and enjoy organizing team events.
* **A chance to make a difference:** We are in the life sciences industry and our work is an excellent way to contribute to the development of new drugs and treatments that will be used to help hundreds of thousands of people worldwide.

  

Do you want to become part of our success story? Then apply online via our job portal. Please note that for Data Privacy compliance we are not able to accept any e-mail applications!

At **DISPENDIX** , we don’t just accept difference — we celebrate it, we support it, and we thrive on it for the benefit of our employees, our products, and our community. We are an equal opportunity workplace and will always pride ourselves on being a collaborative environment.

  
  

*BICO leverages a global portfolio of pioneering brands fusing automation, intelligence, and data to unlock scientific discovery at scale in pharma and biotech.* *With 53,600+ instruments installed in over 65 countries, BICO products, software, and solutions are found in more than 3,500 laboratories, including the world’s top 20 pharmaceutical companies, and have been cited in over 13,000 publications. BICO strives towards the vision to enable life-science labs to accelerate the discoveries that change lives. BICO is listed on Mid-Cap, Nasdaq Stockholm under BICO.* *www.bico.com*

  

#DISPENDIX

description:
We are looking for a Software Engineer with strong programming and robotics capabilities to develop and deploy robotic data collection and embodied AI systems. This role will work across software, robotic platforms, sensors, data pipelines, and AI model deployment.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain software for robotic data collection and embodied AI systems
* Build and improve data pipelines for multimodal sensor data, synchronization, storage, and processing
* Develop and deploy teleoperation and imitation learning systems on robotic platforms
* Integrate robotic arms, sensors, and other hardware with software systems
* Develop software interfaces and communication protocols between robotic components
* Perform data quality checks, synchronization, coordinate alignment, and anomaly detection
* Deploy and optimize AI models on robotic systems
* Troubleshoot and improve robotic systems both in the lab and on-site
* Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system reliability, data collection efficiency, and model performance
* Create technical documentation for systems and deployment processes

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Automation, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
* 2+ years of relevant experience in Software Engineering, Robotics, Automation, or a similar field
* Strong programming skills in Python and C++
* Strong experience with Linux development and debugging
* Experience working with robotic arms and their control interfaces, drivers, kinematics, or APIs
* Experience integrating sensors such as cameras, depth cameras, IMUs, or force/torque sensors
* Familiarity with hardware communication protocols such as CAN, EtherCAT, RS485, or USB
* Experience with PyTorch or other deep learning frameworks is a plus
* Experience deploying software or AI models on robotic/edge platforms is a plus
* Strong problem-solving and hands-on debugging skills

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with ROS/ROS2, DDS, or similar robotics middleware
* Experience with imitation learning, teleoperation, or embodied AI
* Familiarity with Diffusion Policy, ACT, VLA, or similar approaches
* Experience with robotic data formats such as ROS bag, HDF5, or LeRobot Dataset
* Experience with motion capture systems such as VIVE Tracker, OptiTrack, or motion capture gloves
* Experience with video processing, H.264/H.265, or NVIDIA Jetson
* Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code
* Strong English reading and writing skills, especially for technical documentation and research papers

**What We’re Looking For**
We are looking for an engineer who is not only comfortable writing code, but also understands how software interacts with real-world robotic systems.
  
  
Hands-on experience with robotic hardware, sensors, debugging, and deployment is highly valued.

title: Junior Developer/Programmer
description:
**Junior Developer/Programmer**

About The Company

BIASA is a leading luxury fashion and lifestyle brand, founded in Bali in 1994, renowned for its sophisticated design, artisanal craftsmanship, and dedication to timeless style. With an international presence, BIASA combines creative excellence with a strong heritage.

Job Summary

BIASA is seeking a Junior Developer/Programmer who is passionate about technology and problem-solving to develop, maintain, and improve internal systems that support our manufacturing and retail business processes.

Key Responsibilities

· Database Management: Develop and optimize SQL Server databases to track garment production cycles, raw material inventory, and retail stock levels.

· Logic Implementation: Design and maintain robust Stored Procedures to handle complex business processes, including stock reconciliation, production reporting, and sales audits.

· Backend Development: Build and maintain secure, scalable APIs and services using ASP.NET Core to support our internal business applications.

· System Integrity: Ensure data accuracy across all manufacturing and retail platforms through proactive monitoring and performance tuning.

Required Technical Skills

· SQL Server: Intermediate proficiency in database design, complex query writing, and data normalization.

· Stored Procedures: Strong experience in writing, debugging, and optimizing Stored Procedures for high-volume data transactions.

· ASP.NET Core: Proficiency in developing backend services and APIs with a focus on reliability and security.

· Analytical Thinking: Ability to translate complex garment production/retail operational needs into efficient database logic.

Qualifications

· Experience in the Garment, Fashion Retail, or Manufacturing industry.

· Prior experience working with ERP systems or inventory/production tracking software.

· Ability to work in an environment where precision and data accuracy are critical to operational success.

· Good command of English, both spoken and written (preferred).

· Strong organizational, time-management, and multitasking skills.

· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

· Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to work independently.

· Able to handle confidential information with professionalism.

Working Hours

08.30 AM to 17.30 PM, 5 days a week.

Location

Kerobokan Kelod, North Kuta District, Badung Regency, Bali.

If you qualify with above requirements E-mail your CV and full-size photo to:

career@biasagroup.com

Work Location: In person

title: Associate Support Engineer
description:
**Job Title:** Associate Support Engineer / Support Specialist – Video Contact Center (based on experience)

**Location:** Jakarta Indonesia

**Experience:** 2 to 5 years

**About Tetherfi:**  
At Tetherfi, we create intelligent solutions that drives business and increase productivity. We combine industry expertise, technological capabilities and human-centred approach to help businesses evolve from thinking digital to being digital.

**The Right Individual:**   
The ideal candidate will provide support to help customers with technical issues related to Tetherfi’s products and services. Support Specialist will offer technical support to organizations by managing, maintaining, and troubleshooting their IT systems. The specialist's duties will include addressing customer queries, suggesting solutions, and guiding users through product features and functionalities. To excel in this role, the candidate should be an outstanding communicator who can build trust with clients. Ultimately, the specialist will help establish the company's reputation as a provider of exceptional customer support.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Candidates will be trained in Tetherfi’s products to give end to end resolutions on usual technical issues raised.
* Candidates will be receiving, prioritizing, documenting and actively resolving issues that arises out of our products in contact center production environments.
* Will work along with the Support Lead, take up support tickets assigned, probe the issue and give possible resolution within the Turn Around Time.
* Candidate will be part of our Support team liaising with Product developers to support Tetherfi Products deployed at customer sites across the globe.
* Must perform technical troubleshooting on our products implemented at customer site by taking a remote session (or) by coordinating with onsite engineer.
* Job profile involves travel to Customer Site across the globe on need basis to perform any support related activities on Tetherfi Products.
* May have to extend regular work timings and work on various time zones while working on Support tasks assigned.
* May have to work in flexible work hours to accommodate global time zones, especially India and USA.
* Report to the Customer Support Manager in Sri Lanka for project deliverables.
* Will be given opportunity to grow to the level of Account SPOC for Tetherfi accounts globally.

**Required Technical and Functional Skills:**

* **Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Software Engineering, or a related field.**
* Good knowledge of Java and/or .net
* **Good knowledge of Windows, and Linux ecosystems**
* Good knowledge of Web & Application Servers like Tomcat and IIS
* **Good knowledge of Web Basics, HTML, CSS & JS**
* Good knowledge of SQL
* **Knowledge & experience in supporting CTI or IVR or PBX or any Agent Desktop Application will be a plus.**
* Having experience handling production issues in a Contact Center environment will be a plus.
* **Excellent Customer handling Skills, Engineers worked as in-house engineers/site engineers supporting any application-based Contact center products at customer sites like Bank, Telco are preferred.**
* Must be good in analysing application logs, SQL server logs, error logs and event viewer logs.
* **Must be good in troubleshooting and root causing issues.**

**Required Professional Skills:**

* High general intelligence
* **Strong troubleshooting, root causing and issue resolution skills**
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* **Attention to detail and quality-oriented**
* Strong sense of responsibility and accountability, with a desire to take ownership
* **Ability to prioritize and handle multiple tasks based on business needs**
* Desire to work in a fast-paced environment

Education:

* S1 (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Tech Lead
description:
Tanggung Jawab:

* Memimpin pengembangan aplikasi dan sistem internal perusahaan.
* Berkolaborasi dengan CTO dalam menyusun roadmap dan prioritas pengembangan teknologi perusahaan.
* Menganalisis kebutuhan bisnis dari berbagai departemen dan menerjemahkannya menjadi solusi sistem yang efektif.
* Mendesain arsitektur sistem, database, dan integrasi antar aplikasi.
* Terlibat langsung dalam coding, debugging, code review, testing, deployment, dan maintenance sistem.
* Mengembangkan aplikasi web dan mobile yang scalable, stabil, dan mudah dikembangkan.
* Mengembangkan serta mengoptimalkan database untuk memastikan performa dan integritas data.
* Mengintegrasikan sistem internal maupun aplikasi pihak ketiga melalui API.
* Mengembangkan dashboard dan reporting tools untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.
* Mengidentifikasi potensi risiko sistem serta memberikan solusi preventif untuk meminimalkan human error dan gangguan operasional.
* Memastikan kualitas kode, dokumentasi, keamanan, dan stabilitas sistem yang dikembangkan.
* Membimbing, mengarahkan, dan melakukan code review terhadap anggota tim developer.
* Berkoordinasi dengan user dari berbagai departemen untuk memastikan sistem yang dibangun sesuai kebutuhan operasional.
* Melakukan continuous improvement terhadap sistem yang sudah berjalan.

Kualifikasi:

* Minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Komputer, atau bidang terkait.
* Pengalaman minimal
  **5 tahun**
  dalam pengembangan aplikasi dan sistem bisnis.
* Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Senior Developer, Lead Developer, Technical Lead, atau posisi sejenis.
* Berpengalaman membangun aplikasi atau sistem dari tahap analisis kebutuhan hingga implementasi dan go-live.
* Menguasai pengembangan aplikasi berbasis web menggunakan teknologi seperti Node.js, React, Next.js, Laravel, .NET, atau teknologi sejenis.
* Memiliki pengalaman dalam pengembangan aplikasi mobile menggunakan Flutter atau framework mobile modern lainnya.
* Menguasai PostgreSQL atau database relasional lainnya.
* Memahami desain database, query optimization, indexing, dan data integrity.
* Berpengalaman dalam pengembangan dan integrasi REST API.
* Memahami Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Terbiasa menggunakan Git dan version control.
* Mampu melakukan troubleshooting, debugging, dan performance optimization secara mandiri.
* Memiliki kemampuan analitis dan problem solving yang kuat.
* Mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik kepada user teknis maupun non-teknis.

Nilai Tambah

* Berpengalaman mengembangkan ERP, Manufacturing System, Inventory Management System, atau Accounting System.
* Memahami proses bisnis manufaktur, distribusi, supply chain, atau building materials.
* Memiliki pengalaman integrasi dengan berbagai sistem pihak ketiga.
* Memahami cloud infrastructure, deployment, dan CI/CD.
* Pernah membangun sistem yang digunakan oleh banyak user atau multi-departemen.

**Penempatan:**
BRIK MIX - Alam Sutera/ WFO
extracted_skills: SQL, JavaScript, Laravel, React, Node.js, Next.js, REST API, CI/CD, Git

title: Specialist, Services and Solutions Procurement
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Specialist, Services and Solutions Procurement**

We are looking for a Specialist Services and Solutions Procurement to source and secure materials, services, and tailored solutions that support successful customer project delivery.

In this role, you will identify and evaluate suppliers, negotiate commercial agreements, and work closely with project teams to meet quality, cost, and delivery requirements. As an individual contributor, you will independently manage procurement activities, build strong supplier relationships, and contribute to procurement process improvements.

**What will you do?**

  

* Manage procurement activities for project materials, services, and solutions, ensuring alignment with project requirements, budgets, and timelines.
* Identify, assess, and select suppliers and service providers based on technical requirements, quality, commercial competitiveness, and delivery capabilities.
* Coordinate requests for quotation, evaluate proposals, and recommend suitable sourcing options.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and contractual conditions.
* Collaborate with project teams and internal stakeholders to define procurement needs and sourcing priorities.
* Monitor supplier performance and resolve issues related to delivery, quality, and contractual commitments.
* Identify supply risks and develop mitigation actions to support project continuity.
* Monitor market trends and explore innovative sourcing opportunities that improve value and project outcomes.
* Maintain accurate procurement documentation and ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and quality standards.
* Provide guidance to less experienced colleagues on complex or escalated procurement matters.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Proven experience in procurement, sourcing, or purchasing, preferably within a project-based environment.
* Experience procuring services, materials, and integrated solutions.
* Strong supplier evaluation, commercial negotiation, and contract management skills.
* Ability to assess supplier proposals against project requirements and overall business value.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across teams.
* Sound analytical thinking, problem-solving, and commercial judgment.
* Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and make decisions within established policies.
* Familiarity with procurement systems and tools; experience using ERP systems is an advantage.

**What’s in it for me?**

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

(External) English Company Boiler Plate:

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

*Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*  
  
*Schneider Electric is an Equal Opportunity Employer. It is our policy to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities in the areas of recruiting, hiring, training, transferring, and promoting all qualified individuals regardless of race, religion, color, gender, disability, national origin, ancestry, age, military status, sexual orientation, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic or conduct.*

title: IT Cybersecurity Lead
description:
**About the Role**
Star Energy Geothermal, Indonesia's leading geothermal energy producer, is seeking an
**IT Security Lead**
to strengthen cybersecurity across our IT and OT environments. The role leads cybersecurity operations, governance, risk management, and incident response to protect our information assets, technology infrastructure, applications, data, and critical operational environments.

**Job Description**

* Lead the implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of cybersecurity controls across infrastructure, endpoints, applications, cloud services, networks, identity platforms, and OT-related environments.
* Coordinate vulnerability management, including scanning, risk assessment, remediation prioritization, patch follow-up, exception handling, and security reporting.
* Oversee security monitoring and threat response across SOC services, endpoint protection, email security, network security, and other security platforms.
* Lead cybersecurity incident response, including investigation, containment, escalation, stakeholder communication, recovery, and post-incident improvement.
* Coordinate identity and access management activities covering privileged access, MFA, user access, provisioning, deactivation, and segregation of duties.
* Support cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance activities, including ITGC, ISO 27001 alignment, risk assessments, audits, control testing, and remediation tracking.
* Lead cybersecurity awareness initiatives, phishing simulations, user communications, and capability-building activities.
* Collaborate with IT, OT, business, project, vendor, SOC, and security partners to embed cybersecurity requirements into technology projects and operational activities.

**Job Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity operations, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, identity and access management, infrastructure security, or IT audit support.
* Good understanding of cybersecurity threats, IT/OT security principles, vulnerability management, incident response, ITGC, ISO 27001, NIST, data protection, and technology risk management.
* Experience in multi-site, industrial, energy, or OT-integrated environments will be an advantage.
* Relevant professional certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CEH, CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001, Microsoft Security, cloud security, or network security certifications are preferred.
* Strong analytical, communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage security priorities across technical and business teams.

**Why Join Us**
Join Star Energy Geothermal and play a key role in protecting the technology and critical environments that support reliable, clean energy production. You will work across
**IT and OT environments**
, strengthen cybersecurity and operational resilience, and help enable secure digital transformation, cloud adoption, data initiatives, and emerging technologies.

title: Industrial Engineering Staff
description:
Job Desc :

* Melakukan pengukuran standar kerja operator produksi untuk menentukan standar kapasitas produksi, menghitung nilai *Standard Minute Value* (SMV).
* Mengidentifikasi ketidakseimbangan alur kerja (*bottleneck*) di lini produksi.
* Mengimplementasikan Lean Manufacturing
* Perancangan Tata Letak (*Production Layout*) mesin serta area kerja produksi untuk memastikan aliran material (*material flow*) berjalan lancar dan meminimalkan jarak pemindahan.
* Menghitung kebutuhan jumlah tenaga kerja (*manpower planning*) dan utilitas mesin berdasarkan target permintaan pasar (*demand forecast*).
* Mengalanisa masalah produksi (menggunakan analisis Pareto atau Fishbone Diagram) bersama tim *Quality Control* untuk mengusulkan tindakan perbaikan atas defect/kecacatan produk yang tinggi.
* Melakukan evaluasi berkala terhadap target efisiensi lini (*line efficiency*), memantau performa pencapaian target harian, dan melaporkan langsung hasilnya kepada Manajemen.

Kualifikasi :

* Lulusan Teknik Industri, Teknik Mesin, Manajemen Rekayasa, atau bidang teknik lain yang relevan.
* Berpengalaman kerja di bidang Industrial Engineering pada industri manufaktur (terbuka untuk lulusan baru yang memiliki pengalaman magang relevan).
* Memahami konsep dan alat Lean Manufacturing (seperti : Value Stream Mapping (VSM), 6S, Kaizen, Six-Sigma, Poka-Yoke dan Kanban).
* Memiliki kemahiran dalam pengoperasian Ms. Office untuk data analis tingkat lanjut.
* Terampil dalam software desain seperti CAD, FlexSim, ALDEP, BLOCPLAN, CORELAP (Menjadi nilai tambah).

Benefit :

* Gaji Pokok
* Premi Hadir
* Tunjangan Makan
* Tunjangan Hari Raya
* Tunjangan Presensi
* Tunjangan BPJS
* Bonus Tahunan
* Jenjang Karir
* Pelatihan Pengembangan Karir

Jenis Pekerjaan: Penuh Waktu, Kontrak, Fresh Grad  
Panjang kontrak: 12 bulan

Education:

* D1-D4 (Preferred)

Experience:

* Industrial Engineering: 1 year (Preferred)
* Manufacture: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Preferred)

License/Certification:

* BNSP Certification, K3L, SAP/ERP, Lean Six Sigma (Preferred)

Location:

* Surakarta (Preferred)

Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka
