title: Industrial Cybersecurity Expert
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**

As an Industrial Cybersecurity Expert, you will help secure the delivery of Grid Technologies substations across Asia Pacific and China. Working with bid management, engineering, project execution, commissioning, service, and customer teams, you will embed cybersecurity requirements throughout the project lifecycle. You will assess risks, define practical mitigation measures, and implement controls aligned with customer requirements, international standards, and regulatory obligations—strengthening the security, resilience, and reliability of critical energy infrastructure.

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

* Support and advise bid, engineering, project execution, commissioning, and service teams in evaluating cybersecurity requirements and integrating cybersecurity activities throughout the project lifecycle.
* Develop security objectives, protection goals, and project-specific cybersecurity concepts based on customer requirements, contractual obligations, applicable regulations, and company standards.
* Perform cybersecurity risk assessments, threat modeling, gap analyses, and security evaluations, and develop practical mitigation measures and implementation plans.
* Support the development and implementation of project-specific cybersecurity architectures and security programs in collaboration with customers, engineering teams, portfolio managers, and other stakeholders.
* Create and maintain cybersecurity documentation, procedures, blueprints, templates, and technical guidance within the assigned area of responsibility.
* Support cybersecurity testing, validation, and acceptance activities, working closely with engineering and commissioning teams to ensure successful implementation.
* Evaluate and implement cybersecurity requirements derived from standards, regulations, customer specifications, and regional legislation, with a strong focus on IEC 62443, while driving mitigation actions for identified risks, non-conformities, and compliance gaps.
* Provide technical leadership, promote cybersecurity awareness and knowledge sharing, and contribute to the continuous improvement of cybersecurity processes, methodologies, best practices, and execution frameworks.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a comparable discipline.
* Several years of experience in industrial cybersecurity, OT/ICS security, automation systems, critical infrastructure, industrial control systems, or large-scale project execution environments.
* Solid understanding of cybersecurity standards, frameworks, and regulations applicable to industrial environments, including IEC 62443.
* Experience assessing cybersecurity requirements, identifying risks and compliance gaps, implementing mitigation strategies, and supporting cybersecurity activities across project execution, product development, manufacturing, service, or solution integration environments.
* Familiarity with industrial networks, SCADA systems, automation environments, and critical infrastructure solutions.
* Knowledge of cybersecurity governance, compliance monitoring, reporting, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex cybersecurity concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences and work effectively in international, cross-functional teams.
* Professional certifications such as IEC 62443, CISSP, GICSP, CISM, or equivalent are considered an advantage, along with willingness to travel occasionally to project locations and customer sites.

**About the Team**

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

**Who is Siemens Energy?**

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity**

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

**Rewards/Benefits**

* Opportunities to work with a team spread across different locations
* Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects
* Be part of a diverse and inclusive workplace where different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are valued and celebrated.
* Access a wide range of on-demand learning resources, development programs, and career growth opportunities to support your professional journey.
* Enjoy hybrid and flexible working arrangements that empower you to balance your career aspirations with personal commitments.
* Benefit from a people-centric culture that promotes well-being, continuous learning, and equal opportunities for growth and advancement.

**Jobs & Careers:**

title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description:
**About us**
============

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

**About the role**
==================

We are looking for a results-driven Senior Growth Product Manager for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will work on a single product and be fully responsible for increasing ARPU through higher product value: delivering winning tests in the post-purchase experience that make the product more valuable for each user.

You will own the full cycle from research to a proven result and report to the Head of Growth, with AI tooling as a core part of your workflow. The bar is high and so is the upside - strong results are significantly rewarded, with a proven path to career growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Research & Competitor Insights:** Find where users miss value and why they leave, using product and historical data, user feedback, and competitor analysis.
* **Hypothesis Pipeline:** Turn those insights into a continuous, prioritised backlog of product ideas, each backed by evidence and a clear expected impact.
* **Product Value:** Grow ARPU by giving users more value after purchase: improve onboarding, core features, and the moments where users decide whether the product is worth keeping.
* **Specs & Delivery:** Write clear, testable specs and work daily with engineering so every test ships fast and works as intended.
* **Growth Collaboration:** Coordinate with the CRO and data teams so product and funnel tests run in sequence and every result is read correctly.
* **Test Wins:** Deliver a steady stream of A/B test winners on post-purchase metrics, with ARPU as the main one, and raise the share of tests that win over time.

**Qualifications**
==================

* **Product Management:** 3+ years in product growth roles on D2C subscription or consumer products (web-to-web, web-to-app, mobile apps) or similar markets.
* **Proven Wins:** A track record of A/B tests or product changes that measurably grew revenue, with results you can attribute to your own work.
* **User Journey & Product Sense:** Strong understanding of consumer user journeys and of what turns a first purchase into lasting value for the user.

title: Sales Analyst (Modern Trade)
description:
Modern Trade Sales Analyst

📍 Jakarta Selatan | Work From Office | Full-time

At SKINTIFIC, we are continuously expanding our data and commercial analytics capabilities across nationwide Modern Trade operations.

We are looking for a Modern Trade Sales Analyst who will own recurring commercial reporting, run deep-dive analysis, build models the business can reuse, and keep numbers trusted without being chased. This role combines strong SQL, Excel, BI development, and day-to-day partnership with KAM and commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

This position is ideal for someone who is commercially sharp, technically solid, proactive, and uses AI with judgment — not as a copy-paste shortcut.

**🧩 Main Responsibilities**

Commercial Reporting & Stakeholder Support

● Own recurring weekly and monthly Modern Trade commercial reports

● Partner with KAM and commercial stakeholders: write and speak clearly; push back politely when a requested number is wrong

● Spot breaks in reports or logic, flag them, and propose a fix without waiting to be ticketed

● Break messy sales questions into steps and show the work before sending an answer

Deep Analysis & Modelling

● Run deep-dive analysis on sales and commercial questions, not only the recurring pack

● Build analytical models the business can reuse (Excel, BI, or similar) — drivers, scenarios, and “what happens if”

● Find opportunities in the numbers and turn them into a clear recommendation

BI Development & Data Quality

● Develop reports or models in Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or equivalent (semantic model and/or DAX-or-equivalent and/or publish)

● Write strong SQL (joins, grain, dedup, business-rule filters) so report numbers are explainable

● Reconcile figures before sending so trusted numbers reach the business

● Use AI to move faster on reporting and analysis, while staying accountable for the number that goes out

**🛠 Requirements**

General

● Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in analytics, commercial reporting, or similar roles

● Strong analytical thinking, structured problem-solving, and communication skills

● Proactive ownership mindset: spots issues and proposes fixes; does not wait to be ticketed

● Able to work with KAM / commercial stakeholders in a dynamic, fast-paced environment

● Recurring reporting ownership (weekly/monthly)

● Uses AI as a working tool, not a shortcut: writes a clear brief, gives enough background, and checks the result — especially numbers — before it goes to the business

Technical Skills

● Practical AI skills: prompt engineering and context engineering (clear brief, right files/background, check before send). Saved workflows or light tool use is a plus

● Strong SQL (joins, grain, dedup, business-rule filters — not only SELECT \*)

● Evidence of having developed BI reports or models in Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or equivalent — not dashboard viewing only

● Statistic-based modelling (forecasting, regression, tests, or similar) is preferred

● Putting model output into an app or interactive dashboard is a plus

● Familiarity with warehouse SQL (BigQuery or similar) is a plus

● Basic Python (pandas, cleaning, a small script) is preferred

Business & Commercial Understanding

● Experience working with sales, operational, or commercial datasets

● Ability to translate business questions into clear reporting logic

● Familiarity with FMCG sales and related commercial data (sell-in/sell-out, market share, distribution, promo/price) is a strong advantage

● Named retailers are not required

● Comfortable working with cross-functional commercial stakeholders

**🌱 Why Join Us?**

● Be part of a high-growth company expanding across nationwide commercial channels

● Own reporting the business actually uses, with real impact on Modern Trade decisions

● High exposure to commercial strategy, sales operations, and business decision-making

● Work closely with business leaders, KAMs, and cross-functional teams

● Opportunity to build and improve BI and reporting that the team relies on every week

title: Data Center Engineer Lead
description:
The Lead Engineer is responsible for supervising daily engineering operations and maintenance activities within the data center facility. This role ensures the reliability, availability, and efficiency of critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and fire protection systems. The Lead Engineer also leads engineering technicians, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and ensures compliance with safety standards, operational procedures, and service-level requirements.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Engineering Operations

* Supervise daily operations of critical data center infrastructure, including electrical distribution, UPS, generators, HVAC, cooling systems, fire protection, and other facility systems.
* Monitor equipment performance and ensure the reliability and availability of critical infrastructure.
* Conduct routine inspections and review operational parameters to identify potential risks or abnormalities.

2. Maintenance Management

* Lead and coordinate preventive, corrective, and predictive maintenance activities.
* Ensure maintenance activities are completed according to approved schedules, SOPs, and manufacturer recommendations.
* Troubleshoot equipment failures, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.

3. Team Leadership

* Supervise and guide shift engineers, technicians, and other engineering personnel.
* Assign daily tasks, monitor team performance, and ensure adequate shift handovers.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching, and knowledge sharing to improve team competency.

4. Incident and Emergency Management

* Respond to equipment alarms, system abnormalities, and infrastructure incidents.
* Coordinate troubleshooting and recovery activities to minimize downtime and operational risks.
* Participate in emergency response drills and ensure compliance with incident escalation procedures.

5. Safety and Compliance

* Ensure all engineering activities comply with HSE requirements, electrical safety standards, and site operating procedures.
* Ensure proper implementation of Permit to Work (PTW), Lockout/Tagout (LOTO), and risk assessment procedures.
* Maintain accurate maintenance records, inspection reports, incident reports, and operational logs.

6. Coordination and Reporting

* Coordinate with the Facility Manager, Shift Lead, technicians, contractors, and other relevant departments.
* Prepare daily operational reports, maintenance reports, incident reports, and equipment performance updates.
* Support audits, equipment testing, commissioning, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Qualifications and Requirements

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in engineering operations or maintenance, preferably in a data center, mission-critical facility, industrial facility, or similar environment.
* Previous experience leading an engineering or technical team.
* Strong technical knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including UPS, generators, switchgear, HVAC, and cooling systems.
* Understanding of preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and emergency response.
* Familiarity with SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, Permit to Work (PTW), and Lockout/Tagout (LOTO).
* Good communication, leadership, problem-solving, and reporting skills.
* Willingness to work on a shift basis or support 24/7 operations when required.

**Key Competencies**

* Technical leadership
* Critical infrastructure operations
* Troubleshooting and problem-solving
* Preventive and corrective maintenance
* Incident and emergency management
* Team coordination and development
* Safety and risk management
* Reporting and documentation

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Critical equipment availability and reliability
* Preventive maintenance completion rate
* Mean Time to Repair (MTTR)
* Number of recurring equipment failures
* Compliance with SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, and HSE requirements
* Incident response and resolution effectiveness
* Accuracy and timeliness of operational reports
* Engineering team performance and competency development

Work Location: In person

description:
Melaksanakan dukungan operasional dan monitoring aplikasi Al/ML sesuai dengan prosedur dan SLA yang telah ditentukan termasuk yang meliputi operasional Production dan Disaster Recovery (DR) site.
  
  
Melaksanakan dan mengelola proses release management terkait dengan pelaksanaan aktivitas deployment model Al maupun aplikasi berbasis Al.
  
  
Mengelola operasional aplikasi Al/ML dengan melakukan deep dive analysis terkait performa sistem aplikasi AI/ML dan database meliputi service configuration tuning, traffic routing, workload distribution, API management.
  
  
Mengidentifikasi dan menganalisa trend performance, capacity dan utilization sistem platform data serta merencanakan capacity planning & improvement.
  
  
Melakukan troubleshooting, fixing dan incident, dan problem management terkait isu yang terjadi di operasional aplikasi AI/ML sampai di level OS, server, dan connectivity serta melakukan pengecekan tahap lanjutan dan melakukan follow up terhadap isu yang terjadi di aplikasi Al/ML.
  
  
Melakukan penyusunan, pembaharuan, dan penerapan prosedur operasional dan prosedur pemeliharaan aplikasi AI/ML. Menyusun dan mengelola inventory management terkait server aplikasi AI/ML.
  
  
Membuat laporan aktivitas operasional aplikasi AI/ML.
  
  
Menyusun dan memberikan suggestion/ recommendation / feedback terkait dengan improvement & stability berdasarkan praktik terbaik operasional aplikasi AI/ML dan menyampaikan dalam bentuk laporan analisa operasional.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Kualifikasi pendidikan minimal D3 bidang teknik informatika, sistem informasi, ilmu komputer, teknologi informasi, statistika, matematika, teknik industri atau jurusan setara terkait bidang studi Information Technology.

Pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun di bidang data operation atau development. Pengalaman dan menguasai dalam mengelola infrastruktur configuration (server & network), OS configuration (Linux & Windows servers), containerized ecosystem (Docker, Kubernetes).
  
  
Pengalaman dan menguasai dalam mengelola API berbasis GraphQL Pengalaman dan menguasai di level advanced / professional terkait platform database dan kubernetes.
  
  
Menguasai query dan optimasi SQL & NOSQL (database cluster & non-cluster) Menguasai teknologi CI/CD seperti Jenkins dan Bamboo untuk mendukung proses deployment model dan aplikasi AI/ML
  
  
Menguasai teknologi automation seperti Ansible Menguasai configuration dan optimasi platform data berbasis containerized API (high availability dan clustering)
  
  
Melakukan analisis data growth dan traffic service untuk memberikan suggestion terkait capacity planning dan management
  
  
Mampu menyusun dan mempresentasikan analisa, rekomendasi & insight terkait aplikasi berbasis containerized API secara keseluruhan kepada tim teknis dan bisnis atau non-teknis dalam bentuk presentasi, dokumen, atau reguler report
  
  
Melakukan pengecekan di level detail object platform aplikasi berbasis containerized API untuk mengidentifikasi suatu atau potensi issue / problem.
  
  
Memiliki kemampuan menentukan solusi permanen sebagai langkah solving issue maupun langkah perbaikan berkelanjutan
  
  
Menguasai proses automasi (monitoring, alert, notification, analisis) terkait dengan platform berbasis containerized API
  
  
Menguasai performance improvement dan tuning pada platform data berbasis web server, APІ, Tableau Server, Micosoft Reporting Service maupun server untuk memenuhi kebutuhan platform
  
  
Menguasai tools yang digunakan untuk menjalankan daily operations seperti ELK Stack, Grafana, DB Monitoring, Confluence, JIRA

**OpenWeather** is a technologically innovative company that specialises in the development of intelligent environmental data products. The UK-based company has been operating on the market for a decade, adhering to its mission to provide high-quality data and analytical products that assist customers in transforming their businesses for the better. The organisation is proficient in the practical applications of artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and information technology (IT) in the context of environmental data. We are currently providing services to over 9 million consumers worldwide, with over 2 billion forecasts generated daily, and 5 PB of environmental data.

**Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, our AI-powered assistant platform, is the latest addition to the group and is experiencing rapid growth. Ulla represents the future of AI-led business support, and we are just getting started.

* Keep services up: own internal and external services from deployment through day-to-day uptime.
* Share on-call: take part in a rotating on-call schedule.
* Handle incidents: join incident response and lead root cause analysis.
* Work across teams: partner with engineering teams to deliver infrastructure and keep services available.

* A solid understanding of network services (DNS, VPN, firewalls) and the TCP/IP stack.
* Confidence with Docker / docker-compose, Ansible and GitLab CI.
* An automation-first mindset and the scripting skills to back it up.

**Nice to have experience**

* Running Kubernetes in production.
* Applying SRE practices.
* Operating high-load systems.

● Be part of a global company providing weather services to millions of customers.

● Flexible working schedule

● Annual performance bonus.

● 25 days of annual leave + 8 UK bank holidays.

title: Forward-Deployed Lead, Credit Analytics & ML Platforms
description:
### **About the role**

We are looking for a hands-on Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Lead to help develop a credit analytics platform for a regulated financial-services business operating in the UK and Ireland.

The platform brings together lending and servicing data to support portfolio analysis, credit-risk modelling and better business decisions. Current work covers probability of default, redemption and prepayment, expected credit loss, and interactive analytics. The next challenge is to turn this work into a reliable, maintainable platform that can support different portfolios and client needs.

You will work directly with the client’s business and technology teams, and with other engineers. You will own the engineering architecture, build and maintain models, contribute production code, and help the team decide what to build and how to deliver it. We need someone who can question assumptions, propose simpler alternatives and explain technical trade-offs clearly.

### **What you will do**

* Translate business problems into an architecture, practical delivery plan and clear acceptance criteria. Identify gaps in requirements, data and dependencies before they become delivery problems.
* Design the path from working models and dashboards to a production-ready ML platform. Make deliberate choices about shared components, portfolio-specific configuration, model calibration and future client onboarding.
* Build and improve reproducible workflows for data preparation, feature engineering, training, validation, scoring and deployment. Establish clear versioning for code, data, models and calibration logic.
* Build, calibrate, validate and maintain the probability of default, prepayment and lifetime risk models with the account Principal. Keep business definitions consistent across models, tables and dashboards.
* Strengthen the data foundation: trace results to source, investigate data-quality issues, document assumptions and build automated checks around important transformations.
* Improve the reliability of the Snowflake-backed analytics application, including deployment, testing, permissions and integration with model outputs.
* Put appropriate MLOps practices in place, including repeatable releases, monitoring, failure handling, rollback and operational documentation.
* Design for privacy, access control, auditability and model governance. Work with domain experts to make validation, stability and fairness checks practical and reviewable.
* Lead technical discussions, review code, unblock engineers and keep the client informed about progress, risks and architectural decisions.
* Assess where natural-language or LLM-assisted analytics would add value, without losing focus on trustworthy data, robust models and useful products.

### **What we are looking for**

* A track record of designing and delivering production data or ML systems, with ownership extending beyond prototypes and architecture diagrams.
* Hands-on experience building and deploying ML models - from features through calibration to monitoring.
* Strong hands-on Python and SQL. You should be comfortable investigating a dataset, reviewing modelling code and implementing critical parts of the solution yourself.
* Practical MLOps experience: reproducible pipelines, model and data versioning, testing, deployment, monitoring and the operational consequences of model updates.
* Experience with cloud data platforms and modern warehouses, Snowflake experience is particularly relevant.
* An understanding of model evaluation, calibration, data leakage, changing populations and the difference between model quality and system reliability.
* The ability to work through incomplete documentation and inconsistent business definitions, and turn findings into maintainable code and clear documentation.
* Strong client-facing communication in English. You can explain trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders, constructively challenge a requirement and take responsibility for the resulting decision.
* Experience leading a small technical team while remaining actively involved in implementation.

### **Useful additional experience**

* Credit-risk, lending or servicing analytics, including PD, LGD, ECL, prepayment or portfolio stress testing (strongly preferred), or other financial-services models such as fraud, pricing or churn.
* Regulated financial-services delivery and model governance.
* Streamlit, Azure ML, semantic data layers or analytics applications built on Snowflake.
* Configurable ML products serving multiple portfolios or clients.
* Evaluated natural-language analytics, text-to-SQL or LLM-assisted workflows.

### **Current technical environment**

Snowflake, SQL, Python, Streamlit and an Azure compute environment. The team also uses AI-assisted development tools. You will help evolve the architecture based on the product’s needs rather than introduce a predetermined stack.

### **What we would like to discuss**

* A production ML or analytics system you personally helped build, including the architecture decisions and code you owned.
* How you would adapt a model and its calibration for a new portfolio while preserving reproducibility, access boundaries and validation.
* A time you challenged a business or technical assumption, proposed an alternative and delivered a better outcome.

**Skills**
----------

* Production Python and SQL (Snowflake) at scale
* Hands-on model development: gradient boosting and logistic regression, calibration, out-of-time validation (scorecards a plus)
* Data engineering: pipelines, data-quality checks, lineage
* MLOps: versioning, CI/CD, monitoring, reproducible releases, rollback
* Model evaluation in production: leakage, drift / PSI, population change, model quality vs system reliability
* Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders, and the ability to challenge
* Hands-on lead of a small team

**Knowledge**
-------------

* Credit-risk concepts: PD, LGD, ECL / IFRS 9, prepayment, roll rates - strong plus
* Data protection: GDPR, anonymisation, access control. UK model governance (FCA / PRA model-risk expectations) is a plus
* Snowflake security, cost and deployment model (roles, Streamlit in Snowflake)
* Where LLM / text-to-SQL analytics is useful, and where it is not

title: Senior Android Engineer
description:
**About Astro**

ASTRO - Groceries in Minutes

Indonesia's first and fastest-growing on-demand platform for groceries and essentials.

Anything you need, fast.

Astro is Indonesia's first quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Download our app now to experience and enjoy the new definition of fast!

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

**About this Position**

This role focuses on building and optimizing high-performance Android applications that deliver smooth, responsive, and seamless user experiences. You will collaborate with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams to develop new features, improve application performance, and deliver fluid UI transitions and animations comparable to leading quick-commerce applications such as Blinkit and Zepto. You will also take ownership of performance profiling, troubleshooting, and optimization across app startup time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering. Additionally, you will explore and leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows.

**As our Astronaut, your missions are:**

* Lead the development, optimization, and maintenance of Android applications, ensuring high performance, reliability, scalability, and code quality.
* Identify, diagnose, and resolve performance bottlenecks related to app startup time, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, memory consumption, and UI rendering.
* Implement smooth UI transitions, animations, gestures, and micro-interactions to deliver a responsive and seamless user experience comparable to Blinkit and Zepto.
* Profile and optimize Android rendering performance, scrolling behavior, frame rendering time, and main-thread execution to minimize UI jank and frozen frames.
* Collaborate with Product and Design teams to translate UI/UX requirements into polished, high-performance Android experiences.
* Establish performance benchmarks, monitor production metrics, and continuously improve application responsiveness and resource efficiency.
* Lead technical design discussions, break down complex engineering problems into actionable tasks, and ensure timely, high-quality feature delivery.
* Perform code reviews, mentor engineers, and promote best practices in Android development, performance optimization, testing, and maintainable architecture.
* Take ownership of the full product lifecycle, including development, testing, release, production monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Explore and leverage AI tools or technologies to improve development efficiency and support practical implementation in daily engineering workflows, including coding, debugging, refactoring, test generation, and documentation.
* Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions to ensure correctness, security, maintainability, and performance before integrating them into production applications.

**In order to launch successfully, you need to have:**

* Minimum 3-4 years of experience in software engineering, with strong hands-on experience in native Android application development.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin, Android SDK, Android Jetpack libraries, and modern Android development practices.
* Solid experience with Jetpack Compose and/or the Android View system, including advanced UI rendering, animations, transitions, and gesture handling.
* Proven experience identifying and resolving Android performance issues related to application startup, screen load time, CPU utilization, frozen frames, frame rendering time, and memory consumption.
* Hands-on experience with performance profiling and debugging tools such as Android Studio Profiler, Perfetto, Android GPU Inspector, Firebase Performance, and LeakCanary.
* Strong understanding of Android's rendering pipeline, frame deadlines, VSync, main-thread execution, garbage collection, memory allocation, and CPU/GPU utilization.
* Proven ability to build smooth, responsive UI experiences, including complex animations, seamless navigation transitions, optimized scrolling, skeleton loading states, and interactive components.
* Experience optimizing lists, image loading, caching, asynchronous processing, and background operations using technologies such as RecyclerView, Kotlin Coroutines, and Flow.
* Solid understanding of software architecture and design patterns, including MVVM or MVI, dependency injection, modularization, and clean code principles.
* Experience with application performance monitoring, benchmarking, production troubleshooting, and regression prevention.
* Practical experience exploring and using AI-powered development tools to improve coding productivity, debugging, testing, refactoring, and other everyday engineering workflows.
* Ability to validate AI-assisted implementations and ensure that generated solutions meet production standards for performance, security, reliability, and maintainability.
* Good understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including testing, CI/CD, release management, production monitoring, and maintenance.
* Possesses a curious and proactive mindset, continuously seeking feedback, learning new technologies, and exploring better engineering practices to improve application performance and development efficiency.

title: Senior Scraper Engineer
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and maintain scalable Python-based scraping systems (e.g., using requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, Scrapy), architecting for reliability and maintainability rather than one-off scripts
* Design and implement anti-detection strategies at scale, rotating proxies, CAPTCHA-bypass solutions, user-agent/device fingerprint randomization, to sustain high scraping success rates across changing site and app defenses
* Reverse-engineer and extract data from mobile apps (Android/iOS) via API traffic interception, SSL pinning bypass, and emulator/device automation, in addition to standard web scraping
* Architect data pipelines that ingest and normalize structured and unstructured data from web APIs, mobile app APIs, HTML, JSON, and XML sources
* Own orchestration and scheduling of scraping workflows (Airflow, Prefect, n8n, or similar), including retry logic, alerting, and failure recovery
* Lead integration of pipelines into downstream systems (Snowflake, Google Sheets, S3, GCS, SharePoint), ensuring data quality and consistency
* Establish monitoring, logging, and observability practices for scraping infrastructure to catch breakages proactively rather than reactively
* Evaluate and prototype new scraping targets (web and mobile), data enrichment sources, and tooling; make build-vs-buy recommendations
* Anticipate and adapt to web/app structure, anti-bot, and API changes ahead of failures; mentor junior engineers on scraping best practices

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field
* At least 5 years of experience in web scraping, crawling, or automation scripting, including at least 1-2 years designing scraping systems at scale (not just writing individual scripts)
* Strong proficiency in Python and its scraping ecosystem (requests, BeautifulSoup, Selenium, Playwright, Scrapy)
* Hands-on experience with mobile scraping/reverse engineering, tools like Frida, mitmproxy, Charles Proxy, Objection, or Appium; experience bypassing SSL pinning and root/jailbreak detection
* Proven experience with headless browser automation (Puppeteer, Playwright) and defeating modern anti-bot measures (proxy rotation, CAPTCHA handling, rate-limiting, fingerprinting)
* Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker) and Git-based CI/CD in production environments
* Track record of scraping high-defense targets such as social media or e-commerce platforms (web and/or mobile app) at scale
* Experience owning end-to-end data pipelines into a warehouse (Snowflake preferred) or cloud storage
* Prior experience mentoring or leading other engineers is a plus

title: Data Engineer
description:
**About us:**

FIT HUB is a venture-backed technology driven health and wellness startup based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Founded in 2020, FIT HUB’s mission is to democratize access to Health and Wellness for all Indonesians. We believe that everyone should have access to improving their health and wellness, so we’ve built FIT HUB from the ground up to make exercising friendly, affordable, and fun for new gym-goers and fitness-enthusiasts alike.

**The Opportunity:**

As a Data Engineer, you will be part of our growing Data Team and play a key role in building and operating reliable data foundations that power business reporting, product analytics, and advanced analytics use cases. This role has strong ownership in areas such as curated datasets for sales, user activities (class check-in, personal trainer conduct), and membership analytics, feature pipelines to support scoring and analytics, privacy controls (masking and access management), reliability (data quality and alerting), and platform cost efficiency. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Data, Commercial, Finance, and the CEO Office to deliver trusted and scalable data products.

**What You Will Do:**

* Build and maintain production-grade data pipelines (batch and event-based) that power core business reporting and decision-making (sales funnels, membership and renewal metrics, monthly performance reporting).
* Develop curated datasets and data models (silver/gold/platinum thinking) to improve metric consistency, usability, and performance for dashboards and analytics.
* Support migration and modernization work: migrate legacy reports/queries to optimized datasets and improve maintainability of analytics assets.
* Enable machine learning delivery by building and maintaining feature pipelines and feature store patterns to support offline and online use cases (e.g., lead scoring).
* Improve reliability and observability: monitor pipeline health, implement data quality checks and alerting, and reduce recurring incidents through runbooks and operational standards.
* Implement data governance and privacy controls: apply masking/access patterns (row-level and column-level controls), support auditability, and ensure safe use of sensitive data across teams.
* Drive cost efficiency through query and pipeline optimization, reducing inefficient scans and improving refresh speed.
* Work closely with stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear data contracts and reusable pipelines, and document datasets/runbooks to reduce knowledge dependency.

**What We Need:**

* 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer (or equivalent role) building and operating data pipelines in production.
* Strong SQL skills and solid analytical data modeling fundamentals (curated datasets, performance-aware design, metric standardization).
* Proficiency in Python for pipeline development, automation, and tooling; enjoy building and delivering tools from scratch (reusable modules, validators, utilities).
* Experience working with multiple data sources and formats, including structured and semi-structured/event data.
* Strong debugging and operations mindset: comfortable troubleshooting pipeline failures, handling incidents, and improving system reliability.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to drive clarity from ambiguous requirements.
* Experience writing clear and concise documentation (data contracts, dataset definitions, runbooks).

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
**About us**
============

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

**About the role**
==================

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to own and scale the AI layer of one of our core D2C subscription products. You will be fully responsible for production LLM features and the browser automation built around them end to end — prompt systems, structured outputs, evaluation, observability, and model selection — from first experiment to live release, with quality, reliability, and cost as your accountability.

This is a high-impact role suited for someone who decides with data, not intuition. Unmeasured prompt changes, untraced failures, and model swaps without benchmarks are not acceptable. You work in a modern TypeScript stack — Next.js, Cloudflare Workers and Containers with Hono, Hatchet task queues, Drizzle on Supabase Postgres, Vercel Blob. Browser automation on Browserbase and Playwright is roughly half of the job.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Prompt Systems & Structured Outputs**

* Design dynamic prompt templates with conditional logic and context injection that maximise generation quality
* Enforce predictable outputs with JSON mode, function calling, Zod/JSON schemas, validators, and repair loops
* Own complex LLM workflows (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom) that integrate cleanly into application logic

### **Browser Automation**

* Build and maintain browser automation on Browserbase Functions and Playwright that traverses web flows reliably
* Classify screens with a model inside each traversal, and decide what the model handles versus deterministic code
* Ship automations as frozen, published workers — versioned, reproducible, and safe to roll back
* Orchestrate runs through Hatchet with retries, timeouts, and failure traces that explain every broken run

### **Evaluation & Experimentation**

* Build evaluation pipelines — test datasets, LLM-as-a-judge, RAGAS-style metrics — and score responses and screen classifications in Langfuse
* Trace complex LLM chains to find bottlenecks in cost, latency, and context-window usage
* Run A/B experiments across models and prompts through an AI gateway (OpenRouter, Cloudflare AI Gateway); release only on quantitative benchmarks
* Re-evaluate models as new architectures emerge; fine-tune when domain requirements demand it

### **Production Ownership**

* Take AI features from experiment to live production on Cloudflare Workers and Containers, and stay accountable after release
* Manage rate limits, fallbacks, and model cost so features stay reliable at scale
* Resolve production incidents in owned AI and automation systems with documented root-cause analysis

**Qualifications**
==================

### **Must-Have Experience**

* 【5+】 years of software engineering with Node.js, TypeScript, Next.js, and Postgres, including edge or serverless runtimes such as Cloudflare Workers
* Production browser automation with Playwright (Browserbase or similar): resilient selectors, retries, failure handling at scale
* Production experience with dynamic prompting — content that depends on input variables and injected context
* Structured outputs in production: JSON mode, function calling, Zod/JSON schemas
* Experience with unified LLM APIs or AI gateways (OpenRouter, Cloudflare AI Gateway): rate limits, fallbacks, cost-effective model selection
* LLM observability with Langfuse or similar: tracing, test datasets, scoring integration
* Evaluation methodology: RAGAS or custom LLM-as-a-judge systems

**Leadership Attributes**
=========================

* Decides on benchmarks and trace data, not intuition
* Analytical — converts generation logs into metrics a business can act on
* Iterative — builds feedback loops and improves continuously
* Owns the outcome from experiment to production, and after
* Verifies before trusting — treats LLM output as unproven until validated

**Location**
============

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Technical Interview (60 minutes)
* Final Interview (30 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

title: EMS Operations Manager
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: EMS Operations Manager**

**Location:** Batam and Vietnam  
**Function:** Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS)  
**Company:** Schneider Electric

We are looking for an experienced **EMS Operations Manager** to lead Schneider Electric's operational performance at our Contract Manufacturing partner while playing a critical role in **upstream supply chain management, supplier performance, material availability, and supply risk mitigation**.

The role acts as a key interface between Schneider Electric, the Contract Manufacturer, and the broader supplier ecosystem to ensure materials, capacity, and manufacturing operations are ready to meet business and customer demand. You will work closely with **Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, Suppliers, Quality, Industrialization, and Manufacturing teams** to proactively manage supply constraints, supplier capacity, material shortages, and operational risks.

**What will you do?**

**Supply Chain Upstream & Supplier Management**

* Drive **upstream supply chain performance** to ensure material availability and continuity of supply to the Contract Manufacturer.
* Work closely with **suppliers, Procurement, Supply Chain, and Planning teams** to identify and mitigate material shortages, supply constraints, and capacity risks.
* Monitor critical and watch-list suppliers, including supplier capacity and supply continuity risks.
* Lead supplier-related action plans to address shortages, capacity gaps, delivery issues, and other upstream constraints.
* Drive continuous improvement within upstream supply chain processes to improve supply reliability and operational performance.
* Build strong working relationships with suppliers and manufacturing partners to accelerate issue resolution and improve responsiveness.
* Proactively escalate critical supplier and material risks while coordinating recovery plans with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure supplier capacity and material readiness are aligned with production plans and customer requirements.

**Supplier Performance & Supply Risk Management**

* Act as a key operational interface with the **Contract Manufacturer and supplier ecosystem**, ensuring alignment on delivery, capacity, quality, and operational priorities.
* Conduct regular reviews of supplier capacity, constraints, and critical supply risks.
* Partner with Procurement and supplier-facing teams to develop sustainable recovery and improvement actions.
* Analyze supply chain bottlenecks and drive cross-functional actions to minimize production disruption.
* Strengthen supply chain resilience by identifying potential upstream risks before they impact manufacturing and customer deliveries.
* Drive clear supplier accountability and follow-through on agreed improvement and recovery plans.

**Manufacturing & Operational Excellence**

* Oversee end-to-end operational performance at the Contract Manufacturer site.
* Drive achievement of manufacturing and delivery KPIs, including **OTD, OEE, yield, productivity, capacity, and operational efficiency**.
* Monitor manufacturing and supply chain performance and lead corrective actions when deviations occur.
* Ensure production requirements are effectively synchronized with material availability and supplier capacity.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across manufacturing and supply chain operations.

**Contract Manufacturer Partnership**

* Build a strong and collaborative relationship with the Contract Manufacturer to improve operational and supply chain performance.
* Act as a key interface between Schneider Electric internal teams, the Contract Manufacturer, and external suppliers.
* Ensure alignment between production priorities, supply requirements, supplier capabilities, and customer demand.
* Establish strong operational governance with partners and drive accountability for actions and performance.
* Facilitate rapid resolution of issues involving manufacturing, material availability, supplier performance, and capacity.

**Industrialization & Process Management**

* Oversee key electronics manufacturing processes covering **SMT, PTH, ICT, FATP, PCBA manufacturing, final assembly, and testing**.
* Support new manufacturing line setup, product transfers, ramp-ups, and New Product Introduction (NPI).
* Lead engineering changes and ensure readiness of manufacturing processes, equipment, materials, and suppliers.
* Monitor production line and supplier capacity to identify potential bottlenecks.
* Ensure manufacturing documentation, SOPs, work instructions, and BOM requirements remain aligned.

**Digitalization & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve upstream supply chain visibility and operational decision-making.
* Support manufacturing and supply chain digitalization initiatives.
* Drive process improvements that enhance productivity, supply reliability, traceability, and operational efficiency.
* Promote a culture of continuous improvement across the on-site team and manufacturing partner.

**Team & Stakeholder Leadership**

* Lead and develop the on-site team to deliver operational and supply chain objectives.
* Influence suppliers and cross-functional stakeholders to achieve agreed business outcomes.
* Establish effective collaboration across **Supply Chain, Procurement, Planning, Quality, Industrialization, Manufacturing, and external partners**.
* Create a culture of ownership, proactive risk management, and rapid problem-solving.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

  

* Strong experience in **Supply Chain Upstream, Supplier Management, Manufacturing Operations, EMS, or Contract Manufacturing** environments.
* Proven experience **working directly with suppliers** on material availability, supply constraints, delivery performance, capacity, and operational issues.
* Strong understanding of **upstream supply chain processes, material management, supplier capacity, shortage management, and supply risk management**.
* Experience managing supplier escalations and developing recovery actions for critical supply constraints.
* Strong understanding of electronics manufacturing and supply chain environments.
* Ability to analyze supplier and supply chain issues and translate them into clear operational action plans.
* Strong stakeholder management, negotiation, influencing, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work effectively across Procurement, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, Manufacturing, and external supplier organizations.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience within **EMS, electronics manufacturing, or high-volume manufacturing environments**.
* Hands-on experience managing **upstream suppliers and supplier performance**.
* Experience dealing with critical material shortages, supplier capacity constraints, and supply recovery plans.
* Knowledge of demand/supply planning, material management, logistics flows, and inventory management.
* Understanding of electronics manufacturing processes such as **SMT, PCBA, PTH, ICT, and final assembly/testing**.
* Experience supporting manufacturing transfers, NPI, ramp-up, and capacity expansion.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to make decisions in a fast-changing supply environment.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is:

* **Experienced in dealing directly with suppliers and upstream supply chain challenges.**
* Able to confidently engage and influence suppliers when facing **shortages, capacity constraints, delivery gaps, or operational disruptions**.
* Strong in both **supplier management and manufacturing operations**, with the ability to connect upstream supply performance with factory execution.
* Proactive in identifying supply risks before they impact production or customer delivery.
* Comfortable managing multiple supplier and operational escalations simultaneously.
* Able to influence stakeholders without relying solely on direct authority.
* Customer-focused, results-driven, and passionate about building a more resilient supply chain.

**What’s in it for me?**

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*

*At Schneider Electric, we uphold the highest standards of ethics and compliance, and we believe that trust is a foundational value. Our Trust Charter is our Code of Conduct and demonstrates our commitment to ethics, safety, sustainability, quality and cybersecurity, underpinning every aspect of our business and our willingness to behave and respond respectfully and in good faith to all our stakeholders. You can find out more about our Trust Charter* *here*

description:

**Experience Level**
: 5 years

**Employment Type**
: Full-time

**About the Company**

We’re a growing technology company focused on building reliable and scalable solutions that help businesses improve their operations. Our products connect software, hardware, and real-world workflows to create value across industries. We believe in teamwork, accountability, and a product mindset that blends creativity with strong technical execution.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a hands-on Security Analyst Engineer to protect our network, cloud, and connected-device ecosystem. You will assess, monitor, and harden infrastructure and IoT/embedded devices (cameras, sensors, gateways, edge devices), and work closely with infrastructure, development, and product teams to build security into what we ship and operate.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Design, implement, and maintain
**security measures**
across system infrastructure, cloud environments, and embedded systems.

• Monitor, triage, and respond to security events across networks, servers, cloud, and IoT/edge environments.

• Run vulnerability assessments and penetration tests (internal, network, and devicelevel) and track remediation to closure.

• Review and harden network architecture: firewalls, segmentation/VLANs, VPNs, load balancers, WAF, and secure remote access.

• Assess IoT and embedded device security, including firmware and configuration review, default credentials, exposed services, and insecure protocols.

• Secure IoT communication layers such as MQTT brokers, device authentication, TLS/certificate management, and message-queue access.

• Write and maintain firewall rules, IPTables policies, IDS/IPS rules, and log-analysis queries to detect and block attacks (e.g., brute force, scanning, abnormal device behavior).

• Support hybrid (cloud + on-premises) security: IAM, security groups, firewalls, and log collection and analysis.

• Automate security tasks and configuration using scripts and tools such as Ansible, Bash, or Python.

• Deploy, configure, and maintain
**Security Information and Event Management (SIEM)**
solutions to continuously monitor, detect, and respond to security events.

• Establish and maintain security monitoring, incident response, and vulnerability management processes across IT infrastructure and embedded environments.

• Develop, implement, and enforce cybersecurity policies, standards, and security best practices across the organization.

• Support internal and external cybersecurity audits and ensure compliance with customer security requirements and international security standards.

• Collaborate with engineering teams to integrate
**security-by-design principles**
into product development.

• Produce clear incident reports, risk assessments, and security documentation for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Ensure compliance with relevant
**cybersecurity standards and regulations.**

• Support
**secure system architecture design**
for both software and embedded solutions.

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**About Astro**

**ASTRO - Groceries in Minutes**

Indonesia's first and fastest-growing on-demand platform for groceries and essentials.

Anything you need, fast.

Astro is Indonesia's first quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Download our app now to experience and enjoy the new definition of fast!

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

**About this Position**

As a
**Senior Forward Deployed Engineer**
, you will own AIRO engineering delivery end-to-end; designing, building, releasing, and operating customer-facing AI capabilities across product discovery, supported cart and payment journeys, platform assistance, and post-purchase support. You will work directly with business users and external stakeholders to observe workflows, discover root-cause bottlenecks, and define clear value and success metrics before writing code. Balancing technical practicality with business impact, you will architect, test, and deploy production software: integrating APIs, data flows, shared AI capabilities (retrieval, tool use, and agent workflows), and intuitive user interfaces. Beyond deployment, you will evaluate conversational reliability, monitor latency and AI quality in production, and co-design with users to drive adoption and continuous improvement.

**Job Description**

As our
**Astronaut**
, your missions are:

* Own AI project engineering delivery. Design, build, release, and operate customer-facing AI capabilities across product discovery, supported cart and payment journeys, platform assistance, and post-purchase support, in partnership with the relevant service owners.
* Discover and validate problems. Understand customer journeys through feedback, usage data, and execution traces; embed with business users to observe workflows and investigate bottlenecks, errors, repetitive tasks, and knowledge gaps.
* Define value before building. Establish baselines, identify accountable stakeholders, prioritize opportunities, and agree on success measures, acceptance criteria, and experiment stop conditions.
* Choose practical solutions. Compare process changes, existing tools, system integrations, custom software, data solutions, and AI against expected value, delivery effort, operating cost, and risk.
* Build and deliver end to end. Write, review, test, and deploy production software across APIs, integrations, data flows, automation, and user interfaces as needed. Iterate through small releases and direct user feedback.
* Apply AI to real workflows. Integrate approved models and shared AI capabilities; implement retrieval, tool use, structured outputs, and agent workflows where justified by the problem.
* Evaluate quality and reliability. Define representative customer-journey and workflow evaluations, investigate failure modes, and implement appropriate access controls, confirmation, human escalation, fallback, and recovery behavior. Validate conversation context, factual grounding, and the correctness of actions across retries and partial failures.
* Drive adoption and improve experience. Work with Product and Design on customer usability and task completion. For internal workflows, co-design with users, demonstrate progress, train users, and address adoption barriers.
* Own production operation. Coordinate releases, monitor reliability, latency, AI quality, and cost, troubleshoot incidents, and continuously improve AIRO and assigned solutions. Establish ongoing ownership explicitly and transfer support only through an accepted handover.
* Prove business impact. Compare results with the agreed baseline and recommend whether to scale, improve, transfer, or stop an initiative.
* Make learning reusable. Document decisions, runbooks, integrations, and delivery patterns; share platform needs and reusable improvements with the relevant engineering owners.

**Job Requirements**

In order to launch the missions successfully, you need to have:

* 5+ years of experience in Backend Engineering or Software Engineering, with demonstrated senior-level ownership of production-grade systems. Prior experience in an FDE role is not required.
* Strong proficiency in at least one backend programming language such as Go, Java, Kotlin, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript with Node.js, with the ability to adapt to the team’s stack.
* Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, microservices, databases, distributed systems, and system design, including experience designing and developing scalable, highly available backend services.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, clean code, testing, version control, and CI/CD practices.
* Experience working with cloud infrastructure and modern engineering tools and processes.
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills in production environments, including monitoring, incident resolution, and continuous improvement of performance and reliability.
* Demonstrated ability to independently own a product capability or solution from problem discovery and technical design through implementation, deployment, and ongoing production improvement.
* Hands-on experience building and evaluating LLM-powered applications or workflows, with an understanding of model limitations, failure handling, and quality, latency, and cost trade-offs. No fixed number of years in AI or FDE roles is required.
* Ability to translate customer needs into reliable product experiences and assess usability, task completion, correctness, and performance, supporting ownership of AIRO, Astro’s customer-facing AI.
* Ability to work directly with business users, identify root causes, clarify ambiguous requirements, and choose practical solutions across process improvement, software, data, and AI.
* Strong cross-functional communication with Product, QA, Frontend, Data, and business stakeholders, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs, constructively challenge assumptions, and align priorities and scope.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with evolving requirements and tight delivery timelines, prioritizing work and making sound trade-offs between speed, quality, and scope.
* Ability to define success criteria and use data and feedback to evaluate customer outcomes, adoption, and business impact.
* Sound judgment about security, access permissions, sensitive data, and the consequences of automated actions.

**Job Location**

JAKARTA GENERAL OFFICE

**Job Description**

As SFE Manager, you will lead the Sales Force Effectiveness agenda for PHC Indonesia under the Commercial Excellence strategy, translating it into disciplined field execution. You will build and run the processes, data, tools, performance routines, and capability interventions that improve sales productivity, customer coverage, and decision quality, and you will run day-to-day Commercial Excellence operations, while ensuring full stewardship and compliance.

* **SFE strategy and operating model:** Develop, run, and continuously improve the SFE framework, annual roadmap, and governance, aligned with the Commercial Excellence strategy and priorities set by the Commercial Excellence Sr. Manager.
* **Segmentation, targeting, and territory design:** Develop and maintain HCP and account segmentation, targeting, and call planning models; run territory alignment, workload analysis, and sales force sizing, and recommend changes for approval by the Commercial Excellence Sr. Manager and Sales Leadership to optimize coverage and resource deployment across hospital and retail channels.
* **Performance management and insights:** Establish and run clear field force KPIs, scorecards, and dashboards covering reach, frequency, call quality, coverage, sales productivity, execution, and business outcomes. Analyze trends, identify performance gaps, and recommend actions to sales leadership.
* **CRM and data governance:** Act as business owner for requirements, adoption, data quality, reporting, and continuous improvement for Veeva CRM, HCPi, sales force automation, and related commercial data systems. Ensure timely and accurate field force reporting.
* **Sales incentive planning:** Lead the design, modelling, communication, administration, and effectiveness review of PHC sales incentive plans, for approval by the Commercial Excellence Sr. Manager, Finance, and HR. Ensure measures support business strategy, are transparent, and comply with applicable policies and controls.
* **Hospital channel execution:** Translate the PHC Hospital channel strategy into coverage models, account deployment, activity planning, and effectiveness tracking to strengthen execution and customer value. Support market access data needs, such as e-catalog and hospital formulary listing tracking.
* **Field capability and adoption:** Partner with Sales Leaders, HR, Brand, and Medical & Technical Affairs to identify capability gaps and deliver training, coaching tools, onboarding, and change plans that improve use of SFE processes and systems.
* **Cross-functional business partnership:** Act as the SFE business partner to Sales, Marketing, MS&P, Finance, HR, IT, and other stakeholders to translate insights into field actions; lead SFE continuous-improvement initiatives and contribute to broader Commercial Excellence transformation.
* **Analytics and decision support:** Integrate internal and external data to generate actionable insights on field execution, sales performance, customer potential, coverage, and resource allocation; support promotional-effectiveness and customer profitability analyses led by Commercial Excellence, where data is available and approved for use.
* **Stewardship and compliance:** Ensure SFE processes, dashboards, incentives, customer data, and field practices comply with P&G policies, applicable regulations, WBCM, PVP, data privacy requirements, and healthcare industry standards.
* **Commercial Excellence operations and project leadership:** Run day-to-day Commercial Excellence operations, including data refresh, reporting, and dashboard maintenance across Commex pillars (sales, prescription, market share, and HCP engagement data). Manage SFE vendors, where applicable, and lead projects with clear milestones, risks, decisions, and sustainable handover into business-as-usual operations.

**Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Statistics, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline; postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Typically, at least 3 years of experience in Sales Force Effectiveness, Commercial Excellence, Sales Operations, Business Intelligence, or related commercial roles, preferably within pharmaceutical, consumer healthcare, medical devices, or nutrition businesses.
* Strong understanding of the Indonesian healthcare and pharmaceutical environment, field force operating models, HCP engagement, hospital channels, and relevant compliance requirements.
* Demonstrated experience in CRM and sales force automation, customer master data, segmentation and targeting, territory alignment, KPI design, dashboarding, and sales performance reporting, including working with prescription and market data.
* Experience with incentive design or calculation, governance, and effectiveness analysis is preferred.
* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to translate complex data into clear recommendations and influence business decisions.
* Strong project management, change leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and facilitation skills across senior and cross-functional audiences.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with visualization or analytics platforms such as Power BI is preferred.
* Fluent Bahasa Indonesia and strong professional English, both written and spoken.
* High integrity, strong stewardship mindset, attention to detail, learning agility, and ability to operate independently in a dynamic environment.

**About us**

We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.

Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.

Our consumers are diverse and our talents - internally - mirror this diversity to best serve it. That is why we’re committed to building a winning culture based on Inclusion and our ideal candidate is passionate about the same principle: you will join our daily effort of being “in touch” so we craft brands and products to improve the lives of the world’s consumers now and in the future. We want you to inspire us with your unrivaled ideas.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor.

Full time

R000160908

**Job Segmentation**

Experienced Professionals
