description:
**About Astro**

ASTRO - Groceries in Minutes

Indonesia's first and fastest-growing on-demand platform for groceries and essentials.

Anything you need, fast.

Astro is Indonesia's first quick commerce company that delivers groceries and essentials to your door within 15 minutes. 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

Just like real Astronauts that take off into outer space, Astro embodies the values of being fast, bold, adventurous, and technologically advanced. Download our app now to experience and enjoy the new definition of fast!

Interested in working for a company that pushes the boundaries and strives to be the best? Join us now to be a part of this ground-breaking mission!

**About this Position**

As a Data Platform Engineer — External Data Acquisition, you will build and operate ASTRO's platform for acquiring data from external sources, including websites, web/mobile applications, APIs, public datasets, and third-party data providers.

A significant part of this role focuses on production-grade web and application data acquisition for pricing and market intelligence use cases. You will own the acquisition layer—from understanding external systems and extracting data to delivering reliable landing data for downstream processing.

**Job Description:**

As our Astronaut, your missions are:

* Build and maintain reliable web/app crawlers, scrapers, and external API integrations across e-commerce, marketplace, retail, and other external sources.
* Analyze browser, mobile application, API, and network traffic to understand how data is delivered and design the appropriate acquisition approach and runtime, from direct HTTP/API extraction to browser automation.
* Build acquisition systems that remain reliable as external websites, applications, APIs, and data contracts evolve.
* Handle real-world source complexity such as sessions, tokens, pagination, dynamic content, rate limits, retries, concurrency, and partial failures.
* Build resilient and maintainable acquisition systems with appropriate testing, idempotency, deduplication, retries, safe reruns, data-quality validation, monitoring, and alerting.
* Operate acquisition workloads using appropriate workflow orchestration, compute, data storage/warehousing, and cloud infrastructure.
* Continuously improve reliability, scalability, maintainability, and total cost of ownership, including evaluating build-vs-buy approaches for external data.
* Explore new technologies and AI-assisted development or automation to improve how external-data pipelines are built, operated, and maintained.
* Collaborate with Pricing, Data Warehouse Engineering, Data Analysts, and other stakeholders to turn external-data needs into sustainable platform capabilities.

**Job Requirements:**

In order to launch successfully, you need to have:

* Strong Python/software engineering fundamentals and experience building maintainable production systems.
* Hands-on experience building or operating web scraping, crawling, external API, or similar data acquisition systems.
* Strong understanding of HTTP, APIs, JSON, headers, cookies, sessions, authentication, pagination, and request/response behavior.
* Hands-on experience with browser/network debugging and the ability to investigate how websites or applications communicate with their backend services.
* Experience with both HTTP-based extraction and browser automation, using tools such as Requests/HTTPX, Selenium, Playwright, Scrapy, or equivalent.
* Understanding of production reliability patterns such as retry, timeout, rate limiting, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.
* Solid understanding of SQL, data storage/warehousing, schema evolution, workflow orchestration, containerized workloads, and cloud infrastructure fundamentals.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, especially when working with frequently changing external systems outside your direct control.

**Good to Have**

* Experience acquiring data from mobile applications, marketplaces, e-commerce, grocery, food-delivery, or other large consumer platforms.
* Experience with asynchronous or distributed acquisition systems and high-volume crawling.
* Familiarity with proxy infrastructure, data observability, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Experience using AI-assisted development or automation to improve data acquisition workflows.
* Experience designing reusable scraping frameworks or shared acquisition platforms.
* Experience with geospatial or other non-traditional external datasets.

About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region.

**Job Description**
===================

*Job ID: MJ000418*

  
  

**About Traveloka**

Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.

We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.

  
  

**About the Team**

Information Security at Traveloka protects one of Southeast Asia's largest travel platforms — millions of travellers, their payments, and their trust across 11 markets. We are the team that lets hundreds of engineers ship fast without shipping risk: building secure-by-default infrastructure, hunting threats in real time, and setting the standards every product team is held to. As we scale and as AI becomes native to how we build, the attack surface grows and our work only gets more critical.

Here you defend at genuine scale and own outcomes, not tickets. Whether you are hardening systems through security engineering or running detection and response in security operations, you will make decisions that move the whole company. If you want your security work to matter to real people across the region, you will fit right in.

  
  

As a DevSecOps Engineer, you are the technical authority for security within the software development lifecycle, driving the most complex security-in-pipeline programs, setting the standards your function operates by, and shaping how secure development is practiced across Traveloka as an individual contributor.

  
  

**Job Scope:**

* Own and drive the most complex, highest-impact SDLC security programs end-to-end, from scoping and embedding controls into CI/CD workflows through to remediation validation and organisational learning
* Define and enforce the technical standards, scanning methodologies, and tooling frameworks your function operates by — covering vulnerability detection in code and 3rd-party libraries — ensuring consistency, quality, and continuous improvement across all security work in the build pipeline
* Identify systemic gaps in secure coding practice and pipeline security coverage across the engineering organisation, and lead cross-functional improvement programs that produce lasting structural change in how Traveloka builds software securely
* Act as the senior technical authority in security discussions with engineering, product, and business leadership, providing the depth of reasoning and credibility that helps the organisation make sound, defensible decisions on security rules and build-time controls
* Influence engineering teams toward secure coding and design practices through deep technical credibility, shaping how security is embedded into Traveloka’s development workflows as an individual contributor
* Define how AI tools are adopted within secure development workflows, establishing the standards for responsible use and modeling the judgment that separates genuine security acceleration from risk amplification
* Define and own Traveloka’s CI/CD pipeline security architecture, setting the standards for how security controls are embedded across build workflows and ensuring coverage is consistent, reliable, and trusted by the engineering organisation
* Lead the design and delivery of the most complex security automation and tooling programs, producing capabilities that scale security feedback across hundreds of engineers and measurably improve secure development practices
* Shape Traveloka’s secure development culture at an organisational level, defining the security awareness strategy and developer guidance frameworks that make security a natural part of how engineering teams build
  

  

**Requirements:**

* You have at least 6 years of relevant experience in DevSecOps, application security, or secure SDLC engineering
* Designs and builds production-grade security tooling and automation (e.g. CI/CD security scanners, SCA/SAST integrations, policy-as-code) in Python or equivalent
* You have defined security standards or built security capabilities — such as vulnerability scanning, dependency/3rd-party library checks, or security rule validation — adopted across an entire engineering organisation
* You have driven the change management required to make them stick, including getting developer teams to adopt secure coding guidance during the build process
* You can weigh security, operational, and business trade-offs in your decisions and defend them with data, communicating clearly to both technical and business leadership
* You influence senior engineers and cross-functional leaders through credibility rather than authority
* You use AI security tools with sophistication, understanding their failure modes and shaping how they are adopted responsibly within developer workflows
* You have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
* You are the security engineer that engineering directors want in the room for the most consequential CI/CD and secure development architecture decisions
* You have defined pipeline security architecture at organizational scale and built security automation that measurably improved secure coding practices across hundreds of engineers
  

  

**Join Us**

If you have read this far and felt something click — the problem, the scale, the moment — we would like to hear from you.

We review every application. If your background is a strong fit, you will hear from us within 5 business days.

We are building the kind of company where strong people choose to stay because the work keeps getting bigger and better. If that is what you are looking for, apply.

title: Senior Security Engineer (AppSec / DevSecOps)
description:
**Responsibilities**  

* Build and run Jubelio's security function as the first dedicated Security Engineer, reporting to the VP of Technology.
* Perform threat modelling across applications, infrastructure, repositories and third-party integrations, and turn the results into a prioritised list of what to patch first.
* Own security risk scoring and the risk register, so that severity reflects real business impact.
* Triage and validate findings from vulnerability scanners, SIEM alerts, code scanning and external reports, and escalate only what matters.
* Analyze monthly security reports and turn them into clear decisions and actions for engineering and management.
* Handle security incidents end to end: detection, containment, investigation and post-incident improvements.
* Review code and architecture for security risks, and work with developers to fix them.
* Define security standards and frameworks (secure development, secrets, access, vulnerability management) that engineers can follow.
* Decide which areas need penetration testing, scope the work with external vendors, challenge their reports and verify the fixes.
* Work with GRC so that security controls and evidence meet compliance requirements.
* Coordinate with DevOps and development squads, who own remediation under our agreed SLA.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in security engineering, AppSec, DevSecOps or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience in threat modelling (STRIDE, attack trees or similar) on real systems.
* Able to read code and review pull requests for security issues in at least one of: Go, NodeJS, or TypeScript.
* Experience with cloud and container security, preferably Kubernetes (RBAC, network policy, secrets management).
* Experience handling real security incidents and writing post-incident reviews.
* Experience with vulnerability management and security monitoring, including SIEM, vulnerability scanners and SAST/SCA tools.
* Strong risk judgment: able to prioritise by real exploitability and business impact, not only CVSS scores.
* Experience scoping and managing penetration tests with external vendors is an advantage.
* Knowledge of compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST Cybersecurity) is an advantage.
* Good communicator who can influence engineers without formal authority. Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia.
* Comfortable building from zero, with a strong sense of ownership. You will be the only security engineer at first.
* Certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, CKS or CISSP are a plus, but demonstrated experience matters more.

  
**About Jubelio**

An Omnichannel Platform for retailers and wholesalers. Our mission is to simplify your business by integrating back office, warehouse, marketplace, webstore and point of sales (POS) into one dashboard.

title: Data Analytics Lead
description:
**Business performance reporting**

* Own the weekly and monthly performance reviews for Fore Coffee and Fore Donut leadership, from data pull to final narrative.
* Make every report lead with the "so what": what moved, why it moved, and what the business should do next.
* Monitor core KPIs (GMV, transactions, AOV, new and returning users, store and channel performance) and flag anomalies before they reach leadership.

**Analytics and insight**

* Lead deep-dive analyses on customer acquisition, retention and cohorts, promotion and pricing effectiveness, menu performance, and new-store and city expansion.
* Design and read A/B tests and campaign measurement with sound statistical method.
* Translate ambiguous business questions into clear hypotheses, analyses and recommendations.

**Metrics, dashboards and data quality**

* Own the metric layer: one definition per KPI, documented and consistent across reports and dashboards.
* Govern the Metabase dashboard portfolio, including standards, access by role, and retirement of unused dashboards.
* Partner with Data Engineering on the ClickHouse platform, making sure tables and dashboards reconcile and stay trusted.

**Stakeholder partnership**

* Act as the main analytics counterpart for Commercial, Marketing, Operations and Finance heads.
* Run intake and prioritisation of analytics requests, and push back on low-value work.
* Present findings to senior leadership in clear, decision-ready form.

**Team leadership**

* Lead, coach and grow the Data Analyst team, including goal setting, reviews and career development.
* Review analysts' SQL, logic and storytelling before work goes out.
* Hire for the team as it grows, and build repeatable ways of working (templates, peer review, documentation).

title: Project Leader to Principal, Technology & Digital Advantage Practice
description:
**Locations**: Singapore | Kuala Lumpur | Bangkok | Jakarta

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures-and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

**Practice Area**

BCG’s Tech and Digital practice area focuses on helping clients deliver competitive advantage and business superior performance through the use of data, technology and digital. Tech and Digital is the fastest growing practice at BCG and at the heart of the strategic impact we have with our clients. Our consultants and experts globally work across all industries and provide deep experience and expertise across a number of topics including Digital Transformation, Data & Digital Platforms, AI at Scale, Agile, Cybersecurity and Digitizing the Tech Function. Our Tech and Digital offer encompasses tech experts across BCG and Platinion, providing seamless multidisciplinary solutions to our clients.

What You'll Do

As a Project Leader/Principal at BCG, you will lead end-to-end AI and digital transformation engagements, helping organizations reinvent business models, transform operating models, and unlock new sources of value. Working with senior clients and multidisciplinary teams, you will drive AI-first transformation from strategy through implementation, scaling, and measurable business impact.

Your responsibilities will include:

* **AI Transformation and Strategy:** Lead the development of end-to-end AI strategies and transformation roadmaps, shaping AI-first operating models, identifying value creation opportunities, and defining strategic priorities to drive enterprise-wide transformation and business impact.

* **Emerging Technologies:** Advise clients on opportunities across generative AI, agentic AI, cloud, and other emerging technologies to accelerate innovation and business transformation.

* **Customer Centricity:**Reinvent customer experiences through AI-powered personalization, customer insights, journey redesign, and digital solutions.

* **Data, AI, and Analytics:** Identify, develop, and scale AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics solutions to unlock business value and improve performance.

* **New Ways of Working:** Drive AI-first ways of working (WOW), operating models (OPM), and product development lifecycles (PDLC) to reinvent workflows, accelerate innovation, and improve productivity.

* **Technology Function Transformation:** Redesign technology functions and engineering capabilities to enable AI-first operations, improve efficiency, and accelerate technology delivery.

What You'll Bring

* At least 6 years of professional consulting experience, with a proven track record of leading multidisciplinary teams and successfully delivering complex, end-to-end AI and digital transformation engagements in a consulting environment.

* Deep expertise in AI strategy, operating model transformation, or AI value delivery, with demonstrated business impact.

* Strong ability to build trusted senior client relationships and align teams around strategic priorities.

* Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills to develop actionable business recommendations.

* Excellent communication skills, translating complex technology concepts for technical and nontechnical audiences.

Who You'll Work With

You will collaborate with BCG consulting teams and multidisciplinary digital specialists, including engineers, architects, and data scientists, to address complex client challenges and deliver impactful digital transformation solutions. Working alongside senior clients and BCG leadership, you will build trusted relationships and bring together diverse perspectives and expertise to drive meaningful outcomes. You will also collaborate with colleagues across regional and global BCG teams, contributing to an inclusive environment built on teamwork, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

Additional info

What Can A Career At BCG Offer You?

* An opportunity to innovate and change: We have a legacy of developing deep insights and game-changing ideas and our case teams take ideas from all levels in order to deliver breakthrough insights to our clients
* Training and mentoring: We embed mentorship and apprenticeship throughout your time at BCG. You will have a support system of career development advisors, the guidance of project leaders, and partnership with your colleagues and teammates at every turn
* A collaborative approach: You will join a growing team of talented individuals, operating and learning from people with a diverse and broad set of backgrounds

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Overview:

The Project Engineer is responsible for end-to-end coordination and control of capital projects, including project planning, scheduling, CAPEX proposals, budgeting, procurement documentation, progress monitoring, and risk management. The role coordinates internal stakeholders, vendors, and contractors to ensure projects are delivered according to approved technical specifications, financial targets, safety standards, and timelines. It also oversees commissioning, performance verification, issue resolution, user and maintenance training, preventive maintenance planning, and the preparation of technical documentation, asset records, and final project closure reports to ensure a structured and sustainable handover to operations and maintenance teams.

  
Responsibilities:

* Lead end to end project network from feasibility study, design phase, project network creation, FAT, execution and handover process
* Develop and maintain the overall project network, master schedule, milestones, and critical-path activities.
* Coordinate project planning and monitor execution progress against the approved scope, schedule, cost, quality, and safety requirements.
* Prepare and coordinate CAPEX proposals, including project justification, scope definition, cost estimates, financial information, benefits, risks, and implementation plans.
* Monitor project financial performance, including commitments, actual expenditure, forecasts, cash flow, budget utilization, and potential cost variances.
* Prepare complete procurement documentation, including: Detailed purchase requests, Technical specifications, Scope of work, Bill of quantities, Vendor deliverables, Commercial and technical evaluation requirements, Required delivery and execution schedules
* Maintain a complete and organized project documentation system, including approvals, drawings, specifications, meeting minutes, change records, reports, contracts, and vendor submissions.
* Coordinate document reviews and ensure that the latest approved versions are available to relevant stakeholders.
* Support project change management by documenting scope changes and assessing their impact on cost, schedule, resources, and project benefits.
* Coordinate commissioning plans, test protocols, and acceptance criteria.
* Compare commissioning results against design requirements, contractual guarantees, operational needs, and acceptance criteria.
* Track commissioning findings, punch-list items, and corrective actions through final closure.
* Arrange equipment and system training for users, operators, technicians, and maintenance personnel.
* Ensure that training materials, attendance records, competency requirements, and follow-up actions are properly documented.
* Coordinate the development of initial preventive and predictive maintenance schedules together with maintenance and technical teams.
* Confirm that critical spare parts, recommended consumables, special tools, maintenance instructions, and vendor support requirements are defined before handover.
* Manage the formal handover process from the project team to Operations, Engineering, and Maintenance.
* Coordinate project closeout reviews and ensure all outstanding actions have clear owners and agreed target dates.
* Provide regular status updates and management reports covering progress, financial status, key risks, decisions required, and recovery actions.
* Ensure project compliance with EHS procedures, standards, and regulatory requirements, including Electrical and Instrumentation (E&I) safety standards.
* Perform other duties as assigned by the manager.

  
Qualifications:

* A minimum bachelor’s degree in electrical, mechanical or mechatronic engineering or related major.
* Minimum 5-7 years of experience in E&I project and maintenance with multinational exposure in foods and beverages is preferred
* Flexibility and endurance in a challenging environment
* Good team player with strong knowledge‑sharing mindset
* Multi‑skilling and multi‑tasking
* Good communication skills
* Strong coordination and stakeholder-management capabilities.
* Experience in project engineering, project coordination, or capital-project execution within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Understanding of CAPEX processes, procurement workflows, project financial control, commissioning, and equipment handover.
* Ability to develop and manage project schedules, action trackers, cost reports, and document registers.
* Strong analytical skills, particularly for commissioning data, performance verification, and project financial tracking.
* High level of accuracy and discipline in project documentation.
* Ability to prioritize multiple projects and follow actions through to completion.
* Working knowledge of project management tools, SAP and standard Microsoft Office applications.

title: Customer Service Manager
description:
At **Hach** (www.hach.com), a Veralto company, we ensure water quality for people around the world, and every team member plays a vital role in that mission. Our founding vision is to make water analysis better—faster, simpler, greener, and more informative. We accomplish this through teamwork, customer partnerships, passionate experts, and reliable, easy-to-use solutions.

As part of our team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll be part of a unique work environment where purpose meets possibility: where you’ll make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale by enabling the world’s everyday water needs, and where you’ll have opportunities to foster your professional development and fuel your career growth.

Motivated by the highest possible stakes in climate change and global health, we’re working together within a rapidly digitizing industry to find innovative technologies that guarantee the safety of our water and our environment. More about us: https://www.hach.com/about-us

*<*Hach*>*

We offer:

* Professional onboarding and training options
* Powerful team looking forward to working with you
* Career coaching and development opportunities

**Role Purpose**
----------------

Lead the Customer Service function for Indonesia, ensuring accurate and timely execution of the complete quote-to-book-to-delivery-to-payment process. The role is accountable for customer experience, order-management governance, operational performance, cross-functional coordination, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. The incumbent will initially operate as a hands-on manager and, as the organization evolves, will lead, coach, and develop Customer Service team members.

**In This Role, a Typical Day Will Look Like**
----------------------------------------------

* Ensure all sales orders are accurately and promptly entered into Oracle, personally supporting order entry when business volume, complexity, or staffing requires.
* Review customer purchase orders, Letters of Credit, commercial terms, pricing, approvals, delivery requirements, and supporting documents before order entry, targeting at least 98% first-time-right performance.
* Own the end-to-end quotation-management process for commercial and service requirements, ensuring accurate pricing, margin review, approvals, commercial terms, customer requirements, data quality, disciplined use of the designated quotation tool, and timely issuance.
* Manage the Customer Service inbox through clear work allocation, timely responses, ageing review, and closure of actions within agreed service levels, with no overdue item lacking an agreed owner and completion plan.
* Apply first-in, first-out workflow discipline while prioritizing urgent customer, safety, compliance, and business-critical requirements through documented escalation.
* Maintain complete, accurate, securely stored, and audit-ready core sales and after-sales transaction records in accordance with applicable retention and access-control requirements.
* Lead daily-management and visual-management routines, review key performance indicators, identify abnormalities, assign countermeasures, and follow actions through to closure.
* Lead regular fulfilment reviews with Supply Chain covering backlog, shipment plans, product allocation, ship-set readiness, order holds, customer priorities, delivery risks, and recovery actions to achieve on-time delivery against confirmed commitments.
* Own the customer-issue and complaint-management process, including escalation, root-cause analysis, corrective action, closure, and customer-satisfaction improvement.
* Act as the primary coordination and escalation point among customers, channel partners, Sales, Service, Aftermarket, Supply Chain, Finance, and regional or global support teams.
* Establish and maintain operational dashboards and management reports covering order intake, backlog, quotation turnaround, order accuracy, on-time delivery, complaint ageing, receivables follow-up, and service-level performance.
* Govern the discount-approval process and ensure that all pricing exceptions and commercial approvals are obtained in accordance with the applicable Delegation of Authority before quotation submission or order acceptance.
* Partner with Finance on credit validation, pro-forma invoices, customer payment follow-up, cash application, overdue receivables, taxation requirements, and performance bank guarantees.
* Ensure effective management of returns, Return Material Authorizations, rejected orders, free-of-charge orders, pre-orders, warranty transactions, and other order exceptions with appropriate approvals and documentation.
* Oversee new-customer creation, customer master-data maintenance, vendor registration, customer-portal requirements, and related documentation and controls.
* Ensure timely coordination with channel partners for quotation submission, customer follow-up, purchase-order release, order-status communication, and resolution of commercial or fulfilment issues.
* Maintain appropriate controls over demo instruments, service-bench inventory, consumables, spare parts, and associated documentation.
* As the team develops, recruit, onboard, coach, and develop Customer Service associates; establish individual objectives, provide regular feedback, assess performance, and maintain cross-training and succession plans for critical activities.
* Establish and maintain standard operating procedures, work instructions, templates, controls, escalation paths, and backup arrangements for all critical Customer Service processes.
* Ensure Customer Service activities comply with company policies, applicable legal and regulatory requirements, internal controls, and audit standards.
* Undertake other responsibilities consistent with the scope, accountability, and business needs of the Customer Service Manager role.

**Key Performance Indicators**
------------------------------

* Order-entry accuracy and first-time-right performance
* Quotation turnaround time
* Customer-query response and closure time
* Backlog, order-hold, and past-due order ageing
* On-time delivery against confirmed customer commitment
* Complaint and RMA resolution time
* Customer satisfaction and escalation trends
* Effectiveness of payment follow-up, overdue-receivable reduction, and timely cash application
* Compliance with Delegation of Authority, documentation, and audit requirements
* Continuous-improvement benefits and process-adherence levels
* Team capability, cross-training, and succession readiness

**Essential Requirements**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Science, Chemistry, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Customer Service, Sales Operations, Order Management, or Commercial Operations, preferably in instrumentation, industrial products, water-quality, life-sciences, or a related B2B environment.
* Minimum 2–3 years of supervisory, team-lead, or process-leadership experience; candidates with strong demonstrated leadership in a senior individual-contributor role may also be considered where the position initially has no direct reports.
* Strong hands-on experience with ERP-based order management; Oracle experience is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of purchase-order review, commercial terms, pricing and discount controls, Letters of Credit, payment terms, logistics coordination, returns/RMAs, customer complaints, and order documentation.
* Experience working with channel partners, customers, Sales, Service, Supply Chain, Finance, and regional or global stakeholders.
* Strong analytical capability and proficiency in Microsoft Excel, CRM and quotation tools; Salesforce experience is preferred.
* Working knowledge of internal controls, audit readiness, Delegation of Authority, and process compliance.
* Strong written and spoken English and Bahasa Indonesia.

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

* Demonstrated customer-centric mindset with sound commercial judgment.
* Strong leadership, coaching, influencing, stakeholder-management, and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to balance hands-on execution with process ownership, team development, and strategic improvement.
* High attention to detail and a strong commitment to accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
* Ability to prioritize effectively, manage competing demands, and make sound decisions under pressure.
* Proactive ownership, disciplined follow-through, and effective escalation management.
* Strong problem-solving, root-cause analysis, and continuous-improvement capability.
* Ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, locations, and channel-partner networks.

**Deskripsi Pekerjaan — Manajer Layanan Pelanggan**

**Bayangkan diri Anda…**

* Mewujudkan ambisi Anda dan mendorong pertumbuhan karier Anda.
* Berkembang dalam lingkungan tim yang suportif dan menginspirasi Anda untuk mencapai keunggulan.
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim global yang dinamis dan beragam.

Di **Hach**, sebuah perusahaan Veralto, kami memastikan kualitas air bagi masyarakat di seluruh dunia, dan setiap anggota tim memainkan peran penting dalam misi tersebut. Visi awal kami adalah membuat analisis air menjadi lebih baik—lebih cepat, lebih sederhana, lebih ramah lingkungan, dan lebih informatif. Kami mewujudkannya melalui kerja sama tim, kemitraan dengan pelanggan, para ahli yang berdedikasi, serta solusi yang andal dan mudah digunakan.

Sebagai bagian dari tim kami dan jaringan Veralto yang lebih luas, Anda akan bergabung dalam lingkungan kerja yang unik, tempat tujuan bertemu dengan peluang. Anda akan memberikan dampak langsung dan terukur dalam skala global dengan membantu memenuhi kebutuhan air sehari-hari di seluruh dunia, sekaligus memperoleh kesempatan untuk mengembangkan kemampuan profesional dan mendorong pertumbuhan karier Anda.

Dengan motivasi untuk menjawab tantangan besar perubahan iklim dan kesehatan global, kami bekerja bersama dalam industri yang berkembang pesat secara digital untuk menemukan teknologi inovatif yang menjamin keamanan air dan lingkungan kita.

**Kami menawarkan:**

* Program orientasi dan pilihan pelatihan profesional.
* Tim yang kuat dan siap bekerja sama dengan Anda.
* Kesempatan pembinaan dan pengembangan karier.

**Tujuan Jabatan**
------------------

Memimpin fungsi Layanan Pelanggan Hach Indonesia untuk memastikan pelaksanaan proses lengkap dari penawaran, pemesanan, pengiriman, hingga pembayaran secara akurat dan tepat waktu. Jabatan ini bertanggung jawab atas pengalaman pelanggan, tata kelola pengelolaan pesanan, kinerja operasional, koordinasi lintas fungsi, penyelesaian masalah, dan perbaikan berkelanjutan. Pada tahap awal, pemegang jabatan akan berperan sebagai manajer yang tetap terlibat langsung dalam operasional dan, seiring perkembangan organisasi, akan memimpin, membina, dan mengembangkan anggota tim Layanan Pelanggan.

**Dalam Jabatan Ini, Aktivitas Sehari-hari Meliputi**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Memastikan seluruh pesanan penjualan dimasukkan ke Oracle secara akurat dan tepat waktu, serta mendukung langsung proses entri pesanan apabila volume bisnis, kompleksitas, atau ketersediaan tenaga kerja memerlukannya.
* Meninjau purchase order pelanggan, Letter of Credit, ketentuan komersial, harga, persetujuan, persyaratan pengiriman, dan dokumen pendukung sebelum entri pesanan, dengan target sekurang-kurangnya 98% benar pada proses pertama.
* Memiliki tanggung jawab menyeluruh atas proses pengelolaan penawaran untuk kebutuhan komersial dan layanan, termasuk keakuratan harga, peninjauan margin, persetujuan, ketentuan komersial, kebutuhan pelanggan, kualitas data, penggunaan disiplin atas perangkat penawaran yang ditetapkan, dan penerbitan tepat waktu.
* Mengelola kotak masuk Layanan Pelanggan melalui pembagian pekerjaan yang jelas, respons tepat waktu, tinjauan umur pekerjaan, dan penyelesaian tindakan sesuai tingkat layanan yang disepakati, tanpa item terlambat yang tidak memiliki penanggung jawab dan rencana penyelesaian.
* Menerapkan disiplin alur kerja berdasarkan urutan masuk sambil memprioritaskan kebutuhan pelanggan yang mendesak, keselamatan, kepatuhan, dan kebutuhan bisnis kritis melalui eskalasi terdokumentasi.
* Memelihara catatan transaksi inti penjualan dan purnajual yang lengkap, akurat, tersimpan secara aman, dan siap diaudit sesuai persyaratan retensi dan pengendalian akses yang berlaku.
* Memimpin rutinitas manajemen harian dan manajemen visual, meninjau indikator kinerja utama, mengidentifikasi penyimpangan, menetapkan tindakan perbaikan, dan memantau penyelesaiannya.
* Memimpin tinjauan pemenuhan pesanan secara berkala bersama Supply Chain yang mencakup backlog, rencana pengiriman, alokasi produk, kesiapan ship-set, pesanan tertahan, prioritas pelanggan, risiko pengiriman, dan tindakan pemulihan untuk mencapai pengiriman tepat waktu sesuai komitmen yang telah dikonfirmasi.
* Memiliki tanggung jawab atas proses penanganan masalah dan keluhan pelanggan, termasuk eskalasi, analisis akar penyebab, tindakan korektif, penyelesaian, dan peningkatan kepuasan pelanggan.
* Bertindak sebagai titik koordinasi dan eskalasi utama di antara pelanggan, mitra saluran, Sales, Service, Aftermarket, Supply Chain, Finance, serta tim pendukung regional atau global.
* Menyusun dan memelihara dasbor operasional serta laporan manajemen yang mencakup penerimaan pesanan, backlog, waktu penyelesaian penawaran, keakuratan pesanan, pengiriman tepat waktu, umur keluhan, tindak lanjut piutang, dan kinerja tingkat layanan.
* Mengelola proses persetujuan diskon serta memastikan seluruh pengecualian harga dan persetujuan komersial diperoleh sesuai Delegation of Authority yang berlaku sebelum penerbitan penawaran atau penerimaan pesanan.
* Bermitra dengan Finance dalam validasi kredit, pro-forma invoice, tindak lanjut pembayaran pelanggan, penerapan pembayaran, piutang jatuh tempo, persyaratan perpajakan, dan performance bank guarantee.
* Memastikan pengelolaan retur, Return Material Authorization, pesanan yang ditolak, pesanan tanpa biaya, pre-order, transaksi garansi, dan pengecualian pesanan lainnya dilakukan secara efektif dengan persetujuan dan dokumentasi yang sesuai.
* Mengawasi pembuatan pelanggan baru, pemeliharaan master data pelanggan, registrasi vendor, kebutuhan portal pelanggan, serta dokumentasi dan pengendalian terkait.
* Memastikan koordinasi tepat waktu dengan mitra saluran untuk pengajuan penawaran, tindak lanjut pelanggan, penerbitan purchase order, komunikasi status pesanan, dan penyelesaian masalah komersial atau pemenuhan pesanan.
* Memelihara pengendalian yang sesuai atas instrumen demo, inventaris service bench, consumables, spare parts, dan dokumentasi terkait.
* Seiring berkembangnya tim, merekrut, melakukan orientasi, membina, dan mengembangkan anggota Layanan Pelanggan; menetapkan sasaran individu, memberikan umpan balik berkala, menilai kinerja, serta memelihara rencana pelatihan silang dan suksesi untuk aktivitas kritis.
* Menetapkan dan memelihara prosedur operasi standar, instruksi kerja, templat, pengendalian, jalur eskalasi, dan pengaturan pengganti untuk seluruh proses kritis Layanan Pelanggan.
* Memastikan aktivitas Layanan Pelanggan mematuhi kebijakan perusahaan, persyaratan hukum dan regulasi yang berlaku, pengendalian internal, serta standar audit.
* Menjalankan tanggung jawab lain yang selaras dengan ruang lingkup, akuntabilitas, dan kebutuhan bisnis jabatan Manajer Layanan Pelanggan.

**Indikator Kinerja Utama**
---------------------------

* Keakuratan entri pesanan dan kinerja benar pada proses pertama.
* Waktu penyelesaian penawaran.
* Waktu respons dan penyelesaian pertanyaan pelanggan.
* Umur backlog, pesanan tertahan, dan pesanan lewat jatuh tempo.
* Pengiriman tepat waktu terhadap komitmen pelanggan yang telah dikonfirmasi.
* Waktu penyelesaian keluhan dan Return Material Authorization.
* Kepuasan pelanggan dan tren eskalasi.
* Efektivitas tindak lanjut pembayaran, pengurangan piutang jatuh tempo, dan penerapan pembayaran tepat waktu.
* Kepatuhan terhadap Delegation of Authority, dokumentasi, dan persyaratan audit.
* Manfaat perbaikan berkelanjutan dan tingkat kepatuhan proses.
* Kapabilitas tim, pelatihan silang, dan kesiapan suksesi.

**Persyaratan Utama**
---------------------

* Gelar Sarjana di bidang Teknik, Sains, Kimia, Administrasi Bisnis, Supply Chain, atau disiplin terkait.
* Pengalaman minimal 8–10 tahun di bidang Layanan Pelanggan, Operasi Penjualan, Pengelolaan Pesanan, atau Operasi Komersial, terutama dalam industri instrumentasi, produk industri, kualitas air, ilmu hayati, atau lingkungan B2B terkait.
* Pengalaman minimal 2–3 tahun sebagai supervisor, pemimpin tim, atau pemimpin proses; kandidat dengan kepemimpinan yang terbukti dalam peran kontributor individu senior juga dapat dipertimbangkan apabila posisi ini pada awalnya belum memiliki bawahan langsung.
* Pengalaman langsung yang kuat dalam pengelolaan pesanan berbasis ERP; pengalaman menggunakan Oracle sangat diutamakan.
* Memiliki pengetahuan yang terbukti tentang peninjauan purchase order, ketentuan komersial, pengendalian harga dan diskon, Letter of Credit, syarat pembayaran, koordinasi logistik, retur atau Return Material Authorization, keluhan pelanggan, dan dokumentasi pesanan.
* Berpengalaman bekerja dengan mitra saluran, pelanggan, Sales, Service, Supply Chain, Finance, serta pemangku kepentingan regional atau global.
* Memiliki kemampuan analitis yang kuat dan mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel, CRM, serta perangkat penawaran; pengalaman menggunakan Salesforce diutamakan.
* Memiliki pengetahuan kerja tentang pengendalian internal, kesiapan audit, Delegation of Authority, dan kepatuhan proses.
* Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang kuat dalam bahasa Inggris dan Bahasa Indonesia.

**Kompetensi Utama**
--------------------

* Berorientasi kuat pada pelanggan dengan pertimbangan komersial yang baik.
* Memiliki kemampuan yang kuat dalam kepemimpinan, pembinaan, memengaruhi, pengelolaan pemangku kepentingan, dan penyelesaian konflik.
* Mampu menyeimbangkan pelaksanaan langsung dengan kepemilikan proses, pengembangan tim, dan perbaikan strategis.
* Memiliki perhatian tinggi terhadap detail serta komitmen kuat terhadap keakuratan, kepatuhan, dan ketepatan waktu pelaksanaan.
* Mampu menetapkan prioritas secara efektif, mengelola tuntutan yang bersaing, dan mengambil keputusan yang tepat di bawah tekanan.
* Memiliki rasa kepemilikan yang proaktif, disiplin dalam tindak lanjut, dan pengelolaan eskalasi yang efektif.
* Memiliki kemampuan pemecahan masalah, analisis akar penyebab, dan perbaikan berkelanjutan yang kuat.
* Mampu bekerja secara efektif lintas budaya, fungsi, lokasi, dan jaringan mitra saluran.

Sebagai bagian dari tim kami dan jaringan Veralto yang lebih luas, Anda akan bergabung dalam lingkungan kerja yang unik, tempat tujuan bertemu dengan peluang. Anda akan memberikan dampak langsung dan terukur dalam skala global dengan membantu memenuhi kebutuhan air sehari-hari di seluruh dunia, sekaligus memperoleh kesempatan untuk mengembangkan kemampuan profesional dan mendorong pertumbuhan karier Anda.

Dengan motivasi untuk menjawab tantangan besar perubahan iklim dan kesehatan global, kami bekerja bersama dalam industri yang berkembang pesat secara digital untuk menemukan teknologi inovatif yang menjamin keamanan air dan lingkungan kita.

**Kami menawarkan:**

* Program orientasi dan pilihan pelatihan profesional.
* Tim yang kuat dan siap bekerja sama dengan Anda.
* Kesempatan pembinaan dan pengembangan karier.

------------------

Memimpin fungsi Layanan Pelanggan Hach Indonesia untuk memastikan pelaksanaan proses lengkap dari penawaran, pemesanan, pengiriman, hingga pembayaran secara akurat dan tepat waktu. Jabatan ini bertanggung jawab atas pengalaman pelanggan, tata kelola pengelolaan pesanan, kinerja operasional, koordinasi lintas fungsi, penyelesaian masalah, dan perbaikan berkelanjutan. Pada tahap awal, pemegang jabatan akan berperan sebagai manajer yang tetap terlibat langsung dalam operasional dan, seiring perkembangan organisasi, akan memimpin, membina, dan mengembangkan anggota tim Layanan Pelanggan.

**Dalam Jabatan Ini, Aktivitas Sehari-hari Meliputi**
-----------------------------------------------------

* Memastikan seluruh pesanan penjualan dimasukkan ke Oracle secara akurat dan tepat waktu, serta mendukung langsung proses entri pesanan apabila volume bisnis, kompleksitas, atau ketersediaan tenaga kerja memerlukannya.
* Meninjau purchase order pelanggan, Letter of Credit, ketentuan komersial, harga, persetujuan, persyaratan pengiriman, dan dokumen pendukung sebelum entri pesanan, dengan target sekurang-kurangnya 98% benar pada proses pertama.
* Memiliki tanggung jawab menyeluruh atas proses pengelolaan penawaran untuk kebutuhan komersial dan layanan, termasuk keakuratan harga, peninjauan margin, persetujuan, ketentuan komersial, kebutuhan pelanggan, kualitas data, penggunaan disiplin atas perangkat penawaran yang ditetapkan, dan penerbitan tepat waktu.
* Mengelola kotak masuk Layanan Pelanggan melalui pembagian pekerjaan yang jelas, respons tepat waktu, tinjauan umur pekerjaan, dan penyelesaian tindakan sesuai tingkat layanan yang disepakati, tanpa item terlambat yang tidak memiliki penanggung jawab dan rencana penyelesaian.
* Menerapkan disiplin alur kerja berdasarkan urutan masuk sambil memprioritaskan kebutuhan pelanggan yang mendesak, keselamatan, kepatuhan, dan kebutuhan bisnis kritis melalui eskalasi terdokumentasi.
* Memelihara catatan transaksi inti penjualan dan purnajual yang lengkap, akurat, tersimpan secara aman, dan siap diaudit sesuai persyaratan retensi dan pengendalian akses yang berlaku.
* Memimpin rutinitas manajemen harian dan manajemen visual, meninjau indikator kinerja utama, mengidentifikasi penyimpangan, menetapkan tindakan perbaikan, dan memantau penyelesaiannya.
* Memimpin tinjauan pemenuhan pesanan secara berkala bersama Supply Chain yang mencakup backlog, rencana pengiriman, alokasi produk, kesiapan ship-set, pesanan tertahan, prioritas pelanggan, risiko pengiriman, dan tindakan pemulihan untuk mencapai pengiriman tepat waktu sesuai komitmen yang telah dikonfirmasi.
* Memiliki tanggung jawab atas proses penanganan masalah dan keluhan pelanggan, termasuk eskalasi, analisis akar penyebab, tindakan korektif, penyelesaian, dan peningkatan kepuasan pelanggan.
* Bertindak sebagai titik koordinasi dan eskalasi utama di antara pelanggan, mitra saluran, Sales, Service, Aftermarket, Supply Chain, Finance, serta tim pendukung regional atau global.
* Menyusun dan memelihara dasbor operasional serta laporan manajemen yang mencakup penerimaan pesanan, backlog, waktu penyelesaian penawaran, keakuratan pesanan, pengiriman tepat waktu, umur keluhan, tindak lanjut piutang, dan kinerja tingkat layanan.
* Mengelola proses persetujuan diskon serta memastikan seluruh pengecualian harga dan persetujuan komersial diperoleh sesuai Delegation of Authority yang berlaku sebelum penerbitan penawaran atau penerimaan pesanan.
* Bermitra dengan Finance dalam validasi kredit, pro-forma invoice, tindak lanjut pembayaran pelanggan, penerapan pembayaran, piutang jatuh tempo, persyaratan perpajakan, dan performance bank guarantee.
* Memastikan pengelolaan retur, Return Material Authorization, pesanan yang ditolak, pesanan tanpa biaya, pre-order, transaksi garansi, dan pengecualian pesanan lainnya dilakukan secara efektif dengan persetujuan dan dokumentasi yang sesuai.
* Mengawasi pembuatan pelanggan baru, pemeliharaan master data pelanggan, registrasi vendor, kebutuhan portal pelanggan, serta dokumentasi dan pengendalian terkait.
* Memastikan koordinasi tepat waktu dengan mitra saluran untuk pengajuan penawaran, tindak lanjut pelanggan, penerbitan purchase order, komunikasi status pesanan, dan penyelesaian masalah komersial atau pemenuhan pesanan.
* Memelihara pengendalian yang sesuai atas instrumen demo, inventaris service bench, consumables, spare parts, dan dokumentasi terkait.

* Menetapkan dan memelihara prosedur operasi standar, instruksi kerja, templat, pengendalian, jalur eskalasi, dan pengaturan pengganti untuk seluruh proses kritis Layanan Pelanggan.

* Menjalankan tanggung jawab lain yang selaras dengan ruang lingkup, akuntabilitas, dan kebutuhan bisnis jabatan Manajer Layanan Pelanggan.

**Indikator Kinerja Utama**

* Keakuratan entri pesanan dan kinerja benar pada proses pertama.
* Waktu penyelesaian penawaran.
* Waktu respons dan penyelesaian pertanyaan pelanggan.
* Umur backlog, pesanan tertahan, dan pesanan lewat jatuh tempo.
* Pengiriman tepat waktu terhadap komitmen pelanggan yang telah dikonfirmasi.
* Waktu penyelesaian keluhan dan Return Material Authorization.
* Kepuasan pelanggan dan tren eskalasi.
* Efektivitas tindak lanjut pembayaran, pengurangan piutang jatuh tempo, dan penerapan pembayaran tepat waktu.
* Kepatuhan terhadap Delegation of Authority, dokumentasi, dan persyaratan audit.
* Manfaat perbaikan berkelanjutan dan tingkat kepatuhan proses.
* Kapabilitas tim, pelatihan silang, dan kesiapan suksesi.

**Persyaratan Utama**
---------------------

* Gelar Sarjana di bidang Teknik, Sains, Kimia, Administrasi Bisnis, Supply Chain, atau disiplin terkait.
* Pengalaman minimal 8–10 tahun di bidang Layanan Pelanggan, Operasi Penjualan, Pengelolaan Pesanan, atau Operasi Komersial, terutama dalam industri instrumentasi, produk industri, kualitas air, ilmu hayati, atau lingkungan B2B terkait.
* Pengalaman minimal 2–3 tahun sebagai supervisor, pemimpin tim, atau pemimpin proses; kandidat dengan kepemimpinan yang terbukti dalam peran kontributor individu senior juga dapat dipertimbangkan apabila posisi ini pada awalnya belum memiliki bawahan langsung.

* Berpengalaman bekerja dengan mitra saluran, pelanggan, Sales, Service, Supply Chain, Finance, serta pemangku kepentingan regional atau global.
* Memiliki kemampuan analitis yang kuat dan mahir menggunakan Microsoft Excel, CRM, serta perangkat penawaran; pengalaman menggunakan Salesforce diutamakan.
* Memiliki pengetahuan kerja tentang pengendalian internal, kesiapan audit, Delegation of Authority, dan kepatuhan proses.
* Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi lisan dan tulisan yang kuat dalam bahasa Inggris dan Bahasa Indonesia.

**Kompetensi Utama**
--------------------

* Berorientasi kuat pada pelanggan dengan pertimbangan komersial yang baik.
* Memiliki kemampuan yang kuat dalam kepemimpinan, pembinaan, memengaruhi, pengelolaan pemangku kepentingan, dan penyelesaian konflik.
* Mampu menyeimbangkan pelaksanaan langsung dengan kepemilikan proses, pengembangan tim, dan perbaikan strategis.
* Memiliki perhatian tinggi terhadap detail serta komitmen kuat terhadap keakuratan, kepatuhan, dan ketepatan waktu pelaksanaan.
* Mampu menetapkan prioritas secara efektif, mengelola tuntutan yang bersaing, dan mengambil keputusan yang tepat di bawah tekanan.
* Memiliki rasa kepemilikan yang proaktif, disiplin dalam tindak lanjut, dan pengelolaan eskalasi yang efektif.
* Memiliki kemampuan pemecahan masalah, analisis akar penyebab, dan perbaikan berkelanjutan yang kuat.
* Mampu bekerja secara efektif lintas budaya, fungsi, lokasi, dan jaringan mitra saluran.

description:
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze data flows to support project requirements and system implementation.
* Ensure data quality and data integrity, and perform data analysis to support business needs.
* Configure and manage CRM systems, particularly SAP Customer Data Platform (SAP CDP), and integrate them with ERP systems and surrounding applications such as BigQuery, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and other related platforms.

* Support testing activities and system implementation.
* Provide support during go-live and post-implementation activities.
* Perform debugging and troubleshoot system or data-related issues.
* Conduct user training to ensure effective system adoption and usage.
* Support and address user requirements by translating business needs into technical and functional solutions.

* Bachelor's degree in Informatics Engineering, Information Systems, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.

* Strong SQL skills and a solid understanding of databases and relational data models.
* Good understanding of data quality, integrity, consistency, completeness, accuracy, validation, and reconciliation.
* Understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and processes.
* Familiarity with data structures and formats such as JSON, CSV, XML, and other data exchange formats.
* Knowledge of SAP Customer Data Platform (SAP CDP), CRM, or related systems.
* Understanding of data modeling and data mapping.
* Familiarity with SAP Functional Modules, particularly SD/MM, ERP systems, and marketing automation platforms.
* Experience with Google BigQuery, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and Google Tag Manager.
* Basic to intermediate programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript.
* Strong root cause analysis and troubleshooting skills.

**Interpersonal and Communication Skills**

* Strong negotiation and communication skills when interacting with users and internal teams.
* Good presentation skills and the confidence to communicate ideas effectively.
* Ability to collaborate effectively within a team.
* Strong time management and task prioritization skills, with the ability to work under tight deadlines.

title: Sales Administrator
description:
Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and highly organized? Do you enjoy working with data, documentation, and business research? We are looking for a **Sales Administrator** to support our Sales team and ensure smooth sales operations through accurate administration, effective coordination, and timely follow-ups.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Sales Team in client onboarding requirements and other pre-sales administrative activities.
* Provide administrative support for sales team such as proposals, tender documents, and other sales-related documentation.
* Develop and maintain a prospect database to support business development activities.
* Keep sales and customer records accurate, complete, and up to date. Follow up to sales team for missing data and updates.
* Handle sales inquiries received through phone, email, and chat. Follow up with clients to obtain missing information and respond to administrative inquiries.
* Process orders and coordinate with relevant stakeholders when necessary.
* Coordinate and schedule weekly and monthly meetings. Prepare meeting minutes and monitor follow-up actions to ensure timely completion.
* Monitor media coverage and identify potential business opportunities relevant to the company's services.
* Compile and maintain research findings to support the Business Development team.

**Requirements**

* Minimum Diploma or Bachelor’s degree. Candidates with an academic background in Mathematics or Engineering are highly preferred
* Strong analytical and logical reasoning skills, with a high level of numerical aptitude.
* Previous experience in sales administration, data administration, or a related role.
* High attention to detail and accuracy in handling sales data, documentation, quotations, and reports.
* Advanced English proficiency, both written and verbal, to communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Experienced in using CRM
* Proficient in Microsoft Excel, including data processing, formulas, and report preparation.
* Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritize deadlines, and maintain accurate records.
* Able to work independently, demonstrate initiative, and follow established procedures.
* High level of integrity, reliability, and accountability in handling confidential business and sales information.

If you meet these requirements and you are looking for a new, exciting opportunity within a successful, growing company, then this role is for you!

Integrity Indonesia is an equal-opportunity employer.

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

**Integrity Indonesia** is a foreign investment company that has operated for 25 years in Indonesia. Our business is to provide services related to the prevention, detection and investigation of fraud. Our services include employment background screening, whistleblowing systems, mystery shopping services, due diligence, research & market intelligence, asset tracing, skip tracing, claims investigations, brand protection, anti-counterfeiting, trademark investigation and market surveys.

**Are you ready to unleash your potential?**
At Deloitte, our purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.
  
  
We believe we have a responsibility to be a force for good, and WorldImpact is our portfolio of initiatives focused on making a tangible impact on society’s biggest challenges and creating a better future. We strive to advise clients on how to deliver purpose-led growth and embed more equitable, inclusive as well as sustainable business practices.
  
  
Hence, we seek talented individuals driven to excel and innovate, working together to achieve our shared goals.
  
  
We are committed to creating positive work experiences that foster a culture of respect and inclusion, where diverse perspectives are celebrated, and everyone is recognized for their contributions.
  
  
Ready to unleash your potential with us? Join the winning team now!
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As a Security Operations Center (SOC) Engineering Manager at Deloitte, you will lead the SOC team in providing a secure environment through continuous management and coordination of Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems. You will play a strategic and critical leadership role in overseeing security operations, identifying and mitigating cyber risks, and ensuring robust security measures are in place to protect our clients.
  
  

* Design & Architecture
* Design and implement enterprise SecOps architecture (SIEM, SOAR, EDR/XDR, Threat Intelligence, IAM integration)
* Define log collection strategy across cloud, on-prem, SaaS, endpoints, and network
* Architect detection strategy aligned to MITRE ATT&CK
* Establish monitoring coverage and telemetry standards
* Define security tooling roadmap and integration patterns
* Implementation & Setup
* Deploy and configure SIEM/XDR platforms
* Develop detection rules and use cases
* Integrate security tools (EDR, NDR, IAM, cloud security, vulnerability management)
* Build SOAR playbooks and automation workflows
* Establish alert tuning and noise reduction process
* Process Development
* Develop incident response procedures and runbooks
* Define severity classification and escalation matrix
* Establish SLA/SLO for detection and response
* Build case management and ticketing workflows
* Implement threat hunting lifecycle
* Conduct tabletop exercises
* Governance & Compliance Alignment
* Align SecOps to: NIST CSF, ISO 27001, MITRE ATT&CK, CIS Controls
* Support audits and regulatory assessments
* Document architecture and processes

**Your role as a leader**
At Deloitte, we believe in the importance of empowering our people to be leaders at all levels. We connect our purpose and shared values to identify issues as well as to make an impact that matters to our clients, people and the communities. Additionally, Managers across our Firm are expected to:
  
  

* Establish a strong leadership brand and inspire their team through passion, integrity, and appreciation of others.
* Make effective use of resources to optimise value.
* Demonstrate the success and efficiency of Deloitte through leveraging its network and people.
* Deliver exceptional quality results and stakeholder value by leveraging each person’s strengths to build high performing teams across businesses and borders.
* Apply deep knowledge of disruptive trends and competitor activity to drive continuous improvement.
* Build deep professional relationships across a diverse network and use a flexible influencing style to gain buy-in and drive impact.
* Translate broader strategy into a compelling team vision and goals as well as align the team and sets priorities to achieve objectives.
* Contribute to building an inclusive talent pipeline by creating a talent experience that attracts, develops and retains diverse, top talent and high performing teams.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, or a related field.
* 8+ years of experience in SOC Engineering scope.
* Experience in Security Operations / SOC
* Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (e.g., Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar, Elastic)
* Strong knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK mapping
* Experience deploying EDR/XDR solutions
* Incident response and digital forensics experience
* Log parsing and query writing (KQL, SPL, etc.)
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Excellent communication and leadership abilities.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CEH) are highly preferred.

**Due to volume of applications, we regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified.**
**Please note that Deloitte will never reach out to you directly via messaging platforms to offer employment opportunities or request money, bank account details, passwords, one-time passwords (OTPs), or other sensitive personal information.**
**If you receive a suspicious communication claiming to be from Deloitte, please verify its authenticity through our official channels before taking any action.**
**Apply only for roles listed on the official Deloitte careers website, as all legitimate Deloitte career opportunities are published exclusively through this channel.**
**Shortlisted candidates will only be contacted through official Deloitte email addresses ending with@deloitte.com.**

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
****Responsibilities****
**About the Role**
We are building a next-generation HRIS platform that tightly integrates
**attendance**
,
**overtime**
,
**reimbursement**
, and
**payroll**
into a seamless, reliable experience for our clients.
  
  
We're looking for
**backend engineers**
who are obsessed with
**data consistency**
,
**system resilience**
, and
**clean architecture**
— and who thrive working on
**transaction-heavy, critical systems**
.
  
  
****Responsibilities****

* Design, build, and maintain backend services that sync attendance, overtime, reimbursement, and payroll.
* Ensure high data integrity and system consistency, even under concurrent user updates.
* Optimize and scale relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred).
* Design clear, extensible APIs to support frontend and third-party integrations.
* Implement event-driven architecture to handle system-wide updates efficiently.
* Monitor and improve system reliability, latency, and error rates.
* Collaborate with product and engineering teams to build a scalable HRIS platform.

**Why Join Us?**

* Opportunity to build a core system from early stages with massive impact.
* Lean, fast-moving, high-ownership culture.
* Solve real-world problems for growing businesses.

**Requirements**

* 3–7 years experience in backend development.
* Experience in Golang.
* Strong experience with PostgreSQL (or other RDBMS) and database optimization.
* Solid knowledge of transaction management, data modeling, and eventual consistency concepts.
* Hands-on experience building RESTful APIs or GraphQL APIs.
* Familiarity with distributed systems, message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), and caching (e.g., Redis).
* Experience in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) is a big plus.
* Bonus: Experience in financial systems, payroll, HR tech, or ERP platforms.
extracted_skills: SQL, Golang, GraphQL, REST API, AWS, GCP

title: Senior Data Scientist (AI Product)
description:
**Reponsibilities**

* Collect and clean data. This includes identifying and collecting data from a variety of sources, and cleaning and formatting the data so that it can be analyzed.
* Analyze data. This includes using statistical and machine learning techniques to identify patterns and trends in the data.
* Build models. This includes using the patterns and trends identified in the data to build models that can be used to make predictions or decisions.
* Communicate findings. This includes presenting the findings of the analysis to stakeholders in a clear and concise way.
* Work with other teams. This includes working with product managers, engineers, and marketing teams to ensure that the findings of the analysis are used to improve the company's products and services.
* Mentor junior data scientists. This includes providing guidance and support to junior data scientists, helping them to develop their skills and knowledge.
* Stay up-to-date on the latest data science trends and technologies. This includes reading research papers, attending conferences, and participating in online communities.
* Contribute to the development of the company's data science strategy. This includes identifying new opportunities for data science, developing metrics for success, and communicating the strategy to stakeholders.Present data science findings to senior management. This includes communicating the findings in a clear and concise way, and answering questions from senior management.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor/Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field with 5+ years of relevant experience
* 3+ years of experience in data science, with a focus on machine learning and NLP
* Experience with large-scale data sets.
* Experience with a variety of data science tools and technologies.
* Experience with working in a cross-functional team environment
* Strong programming skills in Python, R, or another statistical programming language.
* Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms and techniques.
* Strong understanding of statistical concepts and methods.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Strong ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong ability to learn new things quickly.
* A passion for data science and a desire to make a positive impact on the world.
* A strong work ethic and a commitment to excellence.
* A positive attitude and a willingness to help others.

title: AI / Agent Engineer
description:
Job Description

**Surya Digital Teknologi** is a digital agency based in Indonesia. We specialize in creating mobile applications, websites, software solutions, and recruitment services for businesses of all sizes. Our mission is to help organizations streamline operations through technology, enabling them to focus on growth and innovation. We pride ourselves on delivering reliable solutions and building long-term partnerships with our clients.

Currently, we are looking for an **AI/Agent Engineer** who is passionate about building intelligent systems and leveraging the latest advancements in Generative AI. This role offers an opportunity to work on an innovative AI Assistant platform that combines workflow automation, knowledge-grounded responses, and system integrations to improve customer experience and operational efficiency. If you enjoy solving complex problems, building AI-powered products, and working in a collaborative environment, we'd love to hear from you.

As an **AI/Agent Engineer**, you will be responsible for designing, building, and optimizing AI agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs). You will develop agent orchestration frameworks, implement tool and function calling capabilities, establish evaluation methodologies and guardrails, and collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to deliver reliable, scalable AI solutions. You will also contribute to system integrations, automation workflows, and continuous improvement of AI performance, accuracy, and compliance.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in software engineering, AI engineering, or machine learning development.
* Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), AI agents, RAG systems, or conversational AI solutions.
* Strong programming skills in Python and experience working with APIs, system integrations, and backend services.
* Experience with agent orchestration, tool/function calling, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and AI guardrails.
* Good written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a cross-functional environment.

We are looking for someone with a strong interest in AI innovation, excellent problem-solving skills, and a proactive mindset. If you are excited about building next-generation AI solutions and growing with a dynamic team, we look forward to receiving your application.

Work Location: Remote

**Location:** Remote | **Type:** Full-time | **Compensation:** Competitive salary + stock option

About VELZI AI

At **VELZI AI**, we’re redefining finance for the modern business. Our mission is to eliminate manual accounting through advanced AI automation. From procurement to real-time financial reporting, our intelligent SaaS platform streamlines every operational workflow, so companies can focus on growth, not spreadsheets.

We’re a fast-growing, AI-driven fintech startup backed by innovation and a clear, ambitious vision. Now, we’re searching for a **DevOps Engineer** to help us scale our infrastructure, ensure reliability, and power our next generation of AI-driven financial systems.

About the Role

As a **DevOps Engineer at VELZI AI**, you’ll build, maintain, and scale a secure, cloud-native infrastructure across **GCP, Azure, and AWS**. You’ll work closely with our engineering team to ensure seamless deployment pipelines, reliable environments, and high-performance systems that support our AI and fintech applications.

You’ll be the backbone of our infrastructure and enabling fast iteration, smooth deployments, and resilient architectures.

**Tasks**
---------

What You’ll Do

️ **Cloud Infrastructure & Systems**

* Design, deploy, and maintain cloud infrastructure across **GCP, Azure, and AWS**
* Manage and optimize compute environments including **Virtual Machines**, **Cloud Run**, and container orchestration platforms
* Architect scalable, multi-region solutions with high availability, redundancy, and strong security practices
* Manage and monitor cloud storage solutions such as **GCP Cloud Storage**, **Azure Blob Storage**, and **AWS S3**

**Containers, Orchestration & Scaling**

* Build, deploy, and manage containers using **Docker**
* Deploy and manage services on **Kubernetes (GKE / AKS / EKS)**
* Implement auto-scaling strategies, load balancing, and autoschedulers
* Optimize resource utilization and cost efficiency across environments

**CI/CD, Automation & Deployment**

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, or similar)
* Automate deployments, updates, rollbacks, and environment provisioning
* Create infrastructure-as-code using tools like **Terraform** or **Pulumi**
* Push our platform toward full automation and self-healing systems

**Networking, Security & Integrations**

* Configure VPCs, VPNs, firewalls, DNS, subnets, and secure routing
* Ensure secure API communication between our Next.js app and backend services
* Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting systems (Prometheus, Grafana, Cloud Logging, Azure Monitor, CloudWatch, etc.)
* Ensure compliance, data protection, and identity management across clouds
* Work with **Firebase Authentication**, secure API gateways, and IAM policies

️ **Backend, APIs & System Support**

* Collaborate with engineers to support API creation and deployments
* Optimize performance of server environments running in Cloud Run or VMs
* Implement failover systems, disaster recovery, and backup strategies
* Ensure reliable operation of services including **SES / SendGrid**, databases, and microservices

**Collaboration & Reliability Engineering**

* Work closely with backend, AI, and product teams to support rapid iteration
* Establish DevOps best practices, guidelines, and internal documentation
* Conduct root-cause analysis, implement fixes, and prevent future incidents
* Help shape the engineering culture by improving processes, scalability, and system observability

**Requirements**
----------------

What We’re Looking For

* Proven experience as a **DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, or Site Reliability Engineer**
* Strong experience with **GCP, Azure, and/or AWS** (multi-cloud experience is a huge plus)
* In-depth knowledge of **Kubernetes, Docker, Cloud Run,** and container-based application delivery
* Experience with CI/CD tooling and automation frameworks
* Solid understanding of networking, firewalls, DNS, and cloud security models
* Experience with **VM deployment**, Cloud Run (or similar), autoscaling, and infra optimization
* Strong understanding of cloud storage solutions (Blob, S3, Cloud Storage)
* Experience with **Authentication**, IAM, or identity systems is a bonus
* Understanding of API architecture, microservices, and distributed systems
* Experience with Terraform, Pulumi, or other infrastructure-as-code tools
* Bonus: Experience with observability stacks, FinOps cost optimization, or AI infrastructure
* You’re a problem-solver who thrives in fast-moving environments
* You’re comfortable owning systems end-to-end and improving processes proactively
* You're collaborative, communicative, and enjoy cross-functional teamwork

**Benefits**
------------

Why Join VELZI AI?

* **Remote-first & flexible** – Work from wherever you do your best work
* **Cutting-edge tech** – Work with AI, automation, and the latest dev tools
* **Rapid growth** – Be part of an early-stage rocket ship
* **Collaborative culture** – Join a team that values innovation, autonomy, and teamwork
* **Competitive salary & equity** – Get well-compensated with generous stock options
* **Career advancement** – As we scale, so do your opportunities

How to Apply

Ready to build the future of finance?  
**Click “Apply”** and let’s start building AI-powered financial automation together.

Join VELZI AI. Automate boldly. Build brilliantly.

title: iOS Developer
description:
**Responsibilities**
We are looking for an iOS Developer with at least 1 year of experience in mobile application development. * Develop, maintain, and enhance iOS applications based on business and technical requirements.
* Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code following coding standards and best practices.
* Collaborate with designers, backend developers, QA engineers, and other stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle.
* Integrate APIs and third-party services into mobile applications.

* Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

* Knowledge of version control systems such as Git.
* Understanding of mobile application architecture patterns such as MVC or MVVM.
* Familiarity with App Store submission and deployment processes is a plus.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and within a team environment.
