title: EYDS - AI Engineer (Senior)
description:
****About EY****
EY, a global leader operating in more than 150 countries delivers unparalleled service in
**Consulting**
and assists clients to transform and upskill their capabilities.
  
  
We serve our clients to build a better working world, helping them to create long-term value for people and society and build trust in the capital markets. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we work towards our ambition to be the best employer.
  
  
The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.
  
  
As an AI Engineer (Consultant), you will work with cross‑industry clients to design and deliver end‑to‑end AI solutions, including LLM‑based and agentic AI applications, from solution design through cloud deployment and client adoption.
  
  
****Job Responsibilities****

* Design and implement LLM-powered solutions for analytics, decision support, and automation.
* Develop Natural Language Query (NLQ) agents enabling users to query enterprise data using natural language.
* Build agentic AI workflows (multi-step reasoning, tool-using agents).
* Develop user-facing AI applications (chat interfaces, NLQ dashboards, AI assistants).
* Integrate AI solutions with client data platforms, APIs, and enterprise systems.
* Deploy AI solutions to cloud environments following security, scalability, and reliability best practices.
* Support end-to-end delivery: use case discovery, design, development, deployment, and client enablement.
* Communicate technical solutions clearly to business and executive stakeholders.

****Core Technical Skills****

* Have at least 3 (three) years of working experience.
* Strong Python programming skills.
* Hands-on experience with Large Language Models (LLM) (Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, or open-source models).
* Solid understanding of SQL and enterprise data model.
* Proven experience with:

+ Prompt engineering RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation).
+ Embeddings and vector search.
+ Experience building agent-based AI solutions, including NLQ agents or AI assistants.

****Front-End And Integration Skills****

* Experience developing front-end applications using React, Angular, or Vue.js.
* Ability to integrate front-end applications with AI/ML APIs (REST, streaming responses, authentication).

****Front-End And Integration Skills****

* Experience deploying applications to cloud platforms (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP acceptable).
* Hands-on experience with:

+ Containerization (Docker).
+ API deployment (FastAPI / Flask).
+ Cloud services for AI workloads (e.g., Azure OpenAI, App Service, Kubernetes, or equivalent)
+ Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, environment configuration, and basic cloud security concepts.

**What we look for:**

We’re interested in passionate individuals with a strong vision and a desire to stay on top of trends. If you have a genuine passion for helping businesses achieve their full potential, then these role(s) are for you.
  
  
**What we offer:**

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, on your way
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching, and confidence to be the leader the world needs
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

title: AI Solutions Engineer (Engineering LLM) - Sea Labs
description:
**About the Team:**
The Engineering and Technology team is at the core of the Shopee platform development. The team is made up of a group of passionate engineers from all over the world, striving to build the best systems with the most suitable technologies. Our engineers do not merely solve problems at hand; We build foundations for a long-lasting future. We don't limit ourselves on what we can or can't do; we take matters into our own hands even if it means drilling down to the bottom layer of the computing platform. Shopee's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience it first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do.
  
  
**About Team**
The AI Solutions team builds and pioneers the future of AI-driven automation at Sea. We are the developers of Smart (Sea Multi-Agent Realization Platform) - the company's flagship AI agents platform that enables teams across the company to automate their workflows using large language model (LLM) agents. But Smart is just the beginning.
  
  
Our team is also spearheading a wide range of AI initiatives, especially within the engineering infrastructure domain, from internal developer tooling to intelligent operations. We believe that the future of infrastructure lies in intelligent automation, and we’re committed to building it from the ground up.
  
  
We thrive in a fast-paced, sharing-first culture, with a strong emphasis on learning, creativity, and experimentation. We work hard and play hard, explore ideas on the cutting edge, and aim to pioneer bold, practical solutions to complex real-world problems. If you want to shape how AI changes engineering at scale - this is the place.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Design and develop the Smart platform and other AI systems, covering all essential agent platform components - agent runtimes, toolchains, memory, orchestration, logging, planning, and sandboxing.
* Collaborate with teams across departments - both tech and non-tech - to land and scale real-world AI use cases.
* Drive internal agent adoption in engineering infra by replacing traditional operations with intelligent agent workflows.
* Work on platform reliability and observability to ensure our systems are performant, debuggable, and production-ready.
* Support operations and development work in a healthy balance - you’ll gain experience in shipping features and running real services.
* Manage and operate supporting infrastructure, including vector stores, retrieval systems (RAG), and middleware components.
* Continuously experiment, learn, and bring in the latest advancements from the AI/agent ecosystem into production.
* Continuously optimize system performance through tuning, profiling, and root-cause analysis.
* Design and develop an automated technical operations platform to reduce manual work and improve reliability.
* Drive capacity and resource management, ensuring systems scale efficiently under varying workloads.
* Plan and execute stress tests and load tests to identify bottlenecks, improve throughput, and eliminate redundancy.
* Improve system reliability, availability, and observability through better monitoring, logging, alerting, and incident response practices.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues across application, middleware, and infrastructure layers.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 2+ years of relevant experience in software development - or fresh graduates with strong fundamentals and hunger to learn.
* Strong programming skills in Python (primary) - familiarity with Golang is a plus.
* Solid CS fundamentals - algorithms, data structures, networking, systems, and architecture.
* Backend experience designing cloud-ready services using databases, queues, caching, etc.
* Familiarity with modern AI agent frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or strong interest in learning them.
* Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to navigate ambiguity with curiosity and creativity.
* Willingness to work full stack - we prioritize backend but value well-rounded engineers.
* General understanding of distributed systems and cloud-native principles (e.g. the twelve-factor app), including how services are deployed, scaled, and load-balanced in a containerized environment.
* Passion for building AI systems that people actually use.

Skills below are optional but preferred:
  
  

* Experience building AI-powered platforms, assistants, or automation tools.
* Familiarity with agent patterns like ReAct (Reasoning and Action), tool chaining, or multi-agent orchestration.
* Knowledge of RAG systems, vector databases, or prompt tuning.
* Prior experience in developer tools, internal platforms, or large-scale systems.
* Exposure to observability, debugging, incident workflows, or service reliability.

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
We are looking for a skilled and passionate Senior Backend Engineer who will be responsible for our server-side application logic along with its integration with the front-end platforms. You will also be actively involved in researching new technologies/tools that can be incorporated to improve the current system.

* Build solid, secure, performant and scalable APIs to serve our front-end platforms
* Optimize existing codes to improve performance and efficiency
* Collaborate with Product, QA and UI team to deliver features and improvements

description:
**Why Join:**

Build the data and AI backbone that powers real decisions for millions of banking customers across Indonesia. You will work with a modern stack: Spark, Kafka, Kubernetes, cloud ML platforms. You will partner directly with data scientists and business stakeholders from prototype to production, with a clear path toward senior engineering or ML platform leadership.

**How You Succeed:**

You're succeeding when the data pipelines and AI/ML models you build are scalable, secure, and trusted across the business. You collaborate effectively with data science, engineering, and business teams to turn complex data needs into production-ready solutions. Your work directly supports OCBC's digital transformation and data-driven banking decisions.

**What You Do:**

* Develop and maintain scalable, low-latency data pipelines (ETL/ELT) using Spark, Kafka, Airflow, or Flink to support analytics, reporting, and model training.
* Integrate ML models into production systems via APIs, microservices, and containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Build real-time and batch inference services for credit scoring, fraud detection, and customer personalization.
* Convert data-science prototypes into stable, monitored production services with versioning and automated retraining.
* Architect and manage big data infrastructure on cloud or hybrid environments (AWS, GCP, Azure, Hadoop, Delta Lake).
* Optimize query performance, resource allocation, and storage at large data volumes.
* Embed data-quality checks, observability, and MLOps practices across all systems you ship.

**Who You Are:**

* 3–5 years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer or Data Engineer working on large-scale data systems and AI integration.
* Fluent in Python (is a must); comfortable in Scala, Java, or Go.
* You've shipped ML models to production, not just notebooks, but versioned, monitored, API-served models.
* You think in systems: microservices, RESTful design, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code.
* You've operated on at least one major cloud (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and orchestrated workloads with Docker & Kubernetes.
* You know your way around SQL and at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, Cassandra) or data warehouse (Snowflake, Redshift).

**You’ll be Part of:**

Group Operations and Technology co-creates products and solutions. We build the underlying technology applications and services. And manage the Group’s IT operations & cyber defense. 24/7. 365. End-to-end transaction fulfillment services. For the whole Group. With singular focus. Delivering exceptional customer experience. At the forefront of our digital transformation journey. Relentless innovation. Pushing boundaries. And it’s all powered by serious investment in your development.

**About OCBC:**

At PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk (OCBC), we don’t just serve customers, but we walk alongside them being a trusted partner to enrich the quality of their lives. Since 1941, we have been committed to helping individuals and businesses navigate their financial journey with solutions that grow alongside their evolving needs.

By combining deeply rooted Indonesian values with the comprehensive global capability of the OCBC Group, we offer meaningful, relevant financial services, from daily banking to long-term planning, all delivered with care, understanding, and responsibility.

We are always looking for bright, driven individuals who are curious, collaborative, and eager to grow. At OCBC, you will find a workplace that respects your journey, supports your development, and gives you space to contribute meaningfully–because your Opportunity Starts Here!

**What We Offer:**

OCBC offers a competitive compensation & benefit, including a comprehensive suite of flexible benefits that fit your lifestyle and livelihood, community engagement programs, industry-leading learning, and professional development opportunities in the banking sector. We genuinely care about your well-being, growth, and aspirations−just as much as we care about our customers' needs. By joining our team, you will not only thrive personally and professionally but also contribute to become a Trusted Partner to Improve Quality of Life.

title: QA Engineer (SaaS Platform)
description:
**Company Summary:**

Since 2002, DVI Solutions has been a leading provider of audio-visual setups to help our clients communicate and collaborate better--whether it's with colleagues across the office, or partners on the other side of the world. We have presence across Japan, Singapore, Thailand, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Philippines, Vietnam, India, Malaysia and Indonesia. Our satisfied clients include corporations, government agencies, schools, retail stores, hotels and many more.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a
**QA Engineer**
to join our team and ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our SaaS platform.

In this role, you will be responsible for both manual and automated testing, API testing, defect management, and supporting System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

You will work closely with Senior QA Engineers, Software Developers, Product Managers, and other stakeholders in an Agile environment to identify issues, improve test coverage, and ensure high-quality software releases.

***Key Responsibilities***

**Manual & Automation Testing**

* Design, develop, execute, and maintain manual and automated test cases for web-based applications.
* Develop and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Playwright, Selenium, or similar frameworks.
* Perform functional, regression, smoke, integration, and exploratory testing.
* Identify opportunities to improve test automation coverage and testing efficiency.
* Investigate test failures and collaborate with developers to resolve issues.

**API Testing**

* Perform API testing using Postman or similar tools to validate functionality, reliability, and system integrations.
* Verify API responses, authentication, error handling, and data accuracy.
* Develop and maintain API test collections and document testing results.
* Identify, report, and track API-related defects.

**SIT/UAT & Defect Management**

* Support System Integration Testing (SIT) and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to ensure applications meet business and functional requirements.
* Prepare test plans, test scenarios, test cases, and relevant testing documentation.
* Identify, document, track, and retest defects throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Collaborate with developers and stakeholders to investigate issues and verify resolutions.
* Conduct regression testing to ensure fixes do not impact existing functionality.

**Agile Collaboration & Quality Improvement**

* Participate in Agile/Scrum activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives.
* Work closely with Product Managers, Developers, and Senior QA Engineers to review requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Identify potential quality risks and edge cases early in the development lifecycle, supporting a Shift-Left testing approach.
* Provide regular updates on testing progress, defect status, and release readiness.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, testing standards, and automation practices.

***Requirements***

* **API Testing:**
  Hands-on experience in API testing using Postman or similar tools, including validating API responses, authentication, and error handling.
* **Test Automation:**
  Practical experience developing, executing, and maintaining automated test scripts using Playwright, Selenium, or similar automation frameworks.
* **SIT/UAT & Defect Management:**
  Experience supporting SIT/UAT, managing defects, and collaborating with cross-functional teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.
* **3+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance**
  , covering both manual and automated testing.
* Good understanding of software testing methodologies, the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
* Ability to develop and execute test cases independently, investigate defects, and document findings clearly.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced development environment.

**Why Join us**

* Opportunities to work on regional projects with global brands.
* Exposure to multinational clients, cross-border teams, and cutting-edge technology.
* Exposure to solutions that include immersive video walls, hybrid meeting tech, collaboration tech, digital transformation, smart workspace integration and much more.
* Team-oriented culture that encourages collaboration and continuous learning.
* Involved in custom projects for high-profile clients, DVI offers opportunities to expand your portfolio and build a specialized skill set.
* A booming industry with the rise of hybrid workspaces and smart office solutions.

We develop, publish, and operate web and mobile games that reach millions of players worldwide, and we’re actively expanding in emerging markets with localized content and cutting-edge experiences.

At FireRock, innovation isn’t a buzzword—it’s how we build games that players love and communities that thrive. Our Singapore, Indonesia, and SEA teams are at the heart of this growth, bringing creative ideas to life and shaping the future of play in the region.

We’re looking for a
**Kubernetes-focused DevOps Engineer**

  and
  **Jenkins**
  .

  **Grafana**
  and
  **Promtail**
  .

  **NATS/NSQ**

  Configure and maintain
  **Nginx**
  ,
  **WAFs**
  , and Load Balancers for secure operations.
* **Reliability:**
  Maintain detailed run books and participate in
  **on-call rotations**
  to ensure 24/7 system availability.
* Passion for games or experience in the gaming industry is a plus.
* **Proficiency in English (written and spoken) is essential**
  .

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  3+ years in DevOps, Infrastructure, or SRE with strong Linux system administration skills.
* **Orchestration:**
  Hands-on expertise in
  **Kubernetes**
  and
  **Docker**
  troubleshooting.
* **The Stack:**
  Proficiency in deploying and running
  **Go**
  backend services and
  **PHP**
  applications.
* **Observability Tools:**
  Experience with
  **Grafana**
  and
  **Promtail**
  for log collection, custom dashboards, and alert workflows.

  Proven ability to install, configure, and maintain:
* **SQL:**
  MySQL and PostgreSQL.
* **NoSQL & Caching:**
  MongoDB and Redis.
* **Analytics:**
  ClickHouse (optimization for ingestion and storage).
* **CI/CD Tools:**
  Strong proficiency in building and managing pipelines via
  **GitHub Actions**
  and
  **Jenkins**
  .
* **Multi-Cloud:**
  Familiarity with major providers including
  **AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud,**
  or
  **Azure**
  .

**What We Offer**

* A strategic role with real influence on FireRock’s growth, revenue, and community engagement across Indonesia and the broader SEA region.
* A chance to shape how FireRock engages with Indonesia’s indie game ecosystem and connects with players and partners globally.
* Close collaboration with a small, high-impact team where your network, insights, and execution matter.
* Competitive salary and comprehensive private health insurance coverage for you, your spouse, and your children.

title: Junior Software Engineer (Python / Next.js)
description:
**Introduction**

At CodeX Gate, we build secure, scalable, AI-driven web platforms. We’re looking for a
**remote Junior Software Engineer**
based in Jakarta, Indonesia, fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia, who is ready to contribute from day one, write clean code across our Python backend and Next.js dashboards, and grow alongside an experienced team. If you have hands-on Python experience, working knowledge of Next.js, a solid foundation in backend development, a drive to keep improving, and you’re comfortable communicating with managers and clients in both languages, we’d love to hear from you.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain REST APIs and backend services using FastAPI (or similar Python frameworks).
* Write clean, readable, and well-documented Python code, including async Python where appropriate.
* Work with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL): write efficient queries and manage schema migrations.
* Integrate third-party APIs and services (e.g., payment gateways, messaging platforms, voice/calling services, AI APIs).
* Implement and verify webhooks, including signature/HMAC validation where required.
* Build background workers and scheduled jobs for retries, cleanup, and batched processing.
* Write unit tests and participate in code reviews to maintain code quality.
* Debug and resolve issues across backend services in development and production.
* Use frontend development and design fundamentals to ship features independently.
* Contribute to improving existing codebases under guidance from senior developers.
* Follow team Git workflows, coding standards, and deployment practices.
* Communicate with managers and clients in English and Bahasa Indonesia, including gathering requirements, giving progress updates, and explaining technical issues clearly.
* Collaborate effectively in a remote team using online communication and project tools.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2-3 years of professional or internship experience in Python development.
* Solid understanding of Python and object-oriented programming principles.
* Hands-on experience with FastAPI.
* Comfortable writing and reasoning about async Python (asyncio, await, coroutines).
* Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL (PostgreSQL preferred).
* Familiarity with RESTful API design and HTTP fundamentals (status codes, headers, request/response lifecycle).
* Experience working with Next.js and TypeScript.
* Comfortable using Git for version control in a team environment.
* Comfortable working in Linux/Unix environments and using the command line.
* Based in Jakarta, Indonesia.
* Fluent in both English and Bahasa Indonesia (spoken and written).
* Confident communicating with managers and clients in both languages.
* Willing to work Malaysian business hours (9:00 AM – 6:00 PM GMT+8, which is 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Jakarta time).
* Able to work remotely and independently, with a reliable internet connection and a suitable home work setup.
* Good communication skills and a collaborative, proactive attitude.

**Optional / Nice-to-Have Skills**

* Experience working with LLM and AI APIs: chat completions, function-calling, embeddings, transcription, vision.

title: Android Engineer (Kotlin and Java)
description:
As an Android Engineer (Kotlin / Java), you will work remotely on an hourly paid basis to review AI-generated Android code, mobile architectures, and technical explanations, as well as produce high-quality reference implementations and step-by-step reasoning for complex engineering problems. You will assess solutions for correctness, clarity, security, performance, reliability, and adherence to the prompt; identify issues in Jetpack Compose/UI, concurrency, threading, memory/performance, app lifecycle, networking, persistence, and build/release practices; fact-check technical information; write high-quality explanations and model solutions that demonstrate best practices; and rate and compare multiple AI responses based on correctness and reasoning quality.
  
  
This fully remote, hourly paid contractor role is with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI data services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data to many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation model labs—where your frontend expertise will directly help improve the world’s premier AI models used by millions of developers worldwide.
  
  
**Important**
There is no immediate project for this role; however, if qualified, you will be among the first experts we reach out to when relevant opportunities arise. This will also provide you with access to future projects available through our expert network.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop AI Training Content: Create detailed prompts across Android topics and write high-quality reference answers to guide AI learning.
* Optimize AI Performance: Evaluate and rank AI responses to enhance correctness, security, performance, and maintainability.
* Ensure Model Integrity: Test AI outputs for inaccuracies or unsafe recommendations, validating reliability across real-world Android use cases.

**Your Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 4+ years of professional experience building production Android apps, including work in Kotlin and (ideally) Java codebases.
* Expert-level proficiency in Kotlin (Kotlin 1.6+): null-safety, coroutines/flows, sealed types, generics, and idiomatic patterns.
* Strong Android fundamentals: app lifecycle, Activities/Fragments, state restoration, background execution limits, and permissions.
* Modern UI experience with Jetpack Compose and/or Views; ability to reason about recomposition, state hoisting, and UI performance.
* Concurrency expertise: coroutines, Flow, threading best practices, cancellation, and avoiding race conditions/ANRs.
* Strong knowledge of architecture patterns: MVVM, Clean Architecture concepts, dependency injection (Hilt/Dagger/Koin), and modularization.
* Experience with networking and data: Retrofit/OkHttp, serialization, caching, offline strategies, and persistence (Room/SQLite/DataStore).
* Experience with testing and quality: JUnit, instrumentation tests, Compose UI tests/Espresso, mocking strategies, CI/CD (Gradle, Play Console workflow).
* Security awareness: secure storage (Keystore/EncryptedSharedPreferences), auth flows, certificate pinning awareness, privacy permissions, and sensitive data handling.
* Minimum C1 English proficiency (written and spoken), with the ability to write clear technical explanations and follow detailed English-language guidelines.
* Previous experience with AI data training, annotation, or evaluating AI-generated technical content is a strong plus.
* Highly detail-oriented and systematic, with a methodical approach to evaluating reasoning quality and identifying subtle issues in complex Android code.

**Industry:** FMCG (Food & Beverage / Perishable Consumer Goods)

**Employment Type:** Full-time, Permanent

**About the Opportunity**

We are partnering with a rapidly expanding **Multinational FMCG (Food & Beverage)** leader in Southeast Asia. To accelerate their digital transformation and enhance financial governance across regional entities, they are seeking an experienced and techno-functional **Assistant Manager – Finance Transformation**.

Operating at the intersection of Finance, Accounting, and IT, you will serve as a key functional architect bridging core accounting operations with digital solutions. This role is instrumental in standardizing financial SOPs, leading ERP module enhancements, managing UAT, and driving process automation across multi-entity operations.

* **Finance Process Standardization:** Conduct end-to-end finance process reviews, identify workflow bottlenecks, and establish standardized SOPs and internal financial controls across business units.
* **ERP & Systems Optimization:** Lead and support finance system and ERP enhancement projects (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Yonyou, or equivalent), translating complex accounting needs into functional system specifications.
* **Testing & Implementation:** Oversee User Acceptance Testing (UAT), workflow process mapping, data migration verification, and post-implementation reviews.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Act as the primary functional bridge between core finance/accounting teams, internal IT engineers, operational business units, and third-party software vendors.
* **Financial Reporting & Intercompany Alignment:** Support multi-entity intercompany reconciliations, financial consolidation flows, and ensure seamless data synchronization between operational and accounting systems.
* **Digitalization & Automation:** Build executive reporting dashboards and automate routine workflows using modern analytics and business intelligence tools (e.g., Power BI, RPA, Advanced Excel).

**Qualifications & Requirements**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Accounting Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* **Work Experience:**
* Around 4–7 years of solid experience in accounting, finance systems, or finance transformation.
* At least 2–3 years in a supervisory or senior-level capacity within a **multinational FMCG or Manufacturing** environment handling multi-entity setups.
* **Technical Skills:**
* Strong fundamentals in core accounting, intercompany reconciliation, and financial consolidation.
* Hands-on functional exposure to major ERP platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Yonyou) with direct involvement in system implementation, module optimization, or UAT.
* Advanced MS Excel proficiency; experience with Power BI, RPA, or reporting dashboards is highly preferred.
* **Languages:** Professional fluency in **English** (written & spoken) for cross-border documentation and reporting; Mandarin proficiency is an added advantage.
* **Availability:** 1-month notice period or immediately available (strongly preferred).

title: AI & Data Management Consultant

* Manage the end-to-end delivery of AI projects, ensuring they meet client requirements and timelines.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution.
* Monitor project progress, manage risks, and ensure quality standards are met.

Data Management and Analytics:
  
  

* Oversee data governance and ensure data integrity, accuracy, and security.
* Implement data management strategies, including data quality, metadata management, and master data management.
* Utilize advanced analytics tools to extract insights from data and support AI model development.

Collaboration and Communication:
  
  

* Work closely with customer's to align AI initiatives with organizational goals.
* Provide training and support to team members on AI technologies and best practices.
* Communicate findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders.

Technical Expertise:
  
  

* Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in AI, data management, and analytics.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations, particularly those relevant to the financial sector.
* Troubleshoot and resolve AI-related and data-related issues promptly.

Client Engagement:
  
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored AI solutions.
* Act as a trusted advisor to clients, offering insights and recommendations on AI and data management.

**Qualifications:**

* Educational Background:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field.
  
  

* Professional Experience:

+ Minimum of 5 years of experience in AI implementation and data management, preferably within the financial industry.
+ Proven track record of managing AI projects and delivering successful outcomes.
+ Experience in pre-sales support and client engagement.

* Technical Skills:

+ Proficiency in AI technologies and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, IBM WatsonX, etc).
+ Strong knowledge of data management principles, data warehousing, and analytics.

* Analytical Skills:

+ Ability to analyze complex data sets and derive actionable insights.
+ Experience with statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and AI algorithms.

* Soft Skills:

+ Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
+ Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
+ Ability to present complex AI and data findings to non-technical stakeholders.

* Certifications (Preferred):

+ Certifications in AI, data management, or related fields (e.g., CDMP, CBIP) is an additional value
+ Relevant certifications in data management or AI space.

**Workplace type:**
Hybrid Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

title: AI Engineer
description:
We are seeking an AI Engineer to design, build and maintain artificial intelligence systems that support the company's operations.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop the company's AI strategy and roadmap, including prioritizing implementations by business impact.
* Design the company's AI system architecture, including access control and data separation between business units.
* Integrate AI with the company's systems and applications, such as ERP, messaging apps, email and internal documents.
* Develop business process automation, including sales order creation, order monitoring and margin monitoring.
* Plan and set up server infrastructure, including GPUs, to run AI models internally so that confidential data does not leave the company.
* Build question-and-answer systems based on internal documents such as SOPs and meeting minutes.
* Evaluate and select AI technologies, models and vendors, including managing operating costs.
* Measure the effectiveness of each AI system in terms of time and cost savings.
* Monitor, maintain and document all systems developed.
* Provide training and support to employees in the use of AI systems.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Informatics Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in AI/Machine Learning or software engineering, including at least 3 years handling AI projects in operational use.
* Comprehensive understanding of AI fundamentals, including machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, speech recognition and generative AI.
* Experience selecting, adapting (fine-tuning) and evaluating different types of AI models, both commercial and open-source.
* Experience running AI models on internal servers and cloud services, including specifying the hardware required.
* Ability to learn and integrate new software and systems quickly through APIs.
* Proven experience designing and leading system development from design through to production.
* Proficiency in programming languages commonly used for AI (such as Python), databases and server administration.
* Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and the ability to read technical documentation in English.
* Willing to work in Surabaya.

**Preferred**

* Experience integrating ERP systems and business applications.
* Experience in MLOps, such as model deployment, monitoring and versioning.
* Publications, certifications or open-source contributions in AI.
* Background in distribution, manufacturing or F&B companies.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary based on experience
* BPJS Health and BPJS Employment insurance
* Religious holiday allowance (THR)
* Work equipment and training support

**How to Apply**

Please submit your CV together with a portfolio or examples of AI projects you have worked on. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview and a case study.

title: Partnership Representative
description:
**About PayJoy**

PayJoy, a Public Benefit Corporation, is a mission-first credit provider dedicated to helping under-served customers in emerging markets to achieve financial stability and success. Our patented technology for secured credit provides an on-ramp for new customers to enter the credit system. Through PayJoy’s point-of-sale financing and card offerings, customers gain access to a modern quality of life. PayJoy’s credit also allows our customers to seize opportunities as micro-entrepreneurs, and acts as insurance for tough times. Through our cutting-edge machine learning, data science, and anti-fraud AI, we have served over 18 million customers as of 2025 while achieving solid profitability for sustainable growth.

**This role**

We are expanding our Business Development team and looking for a results-driven BD Representative to drive new partner acquisition and onboarding, strategic partnerships, and nurturing robust relationships and enlarging the customer database through new commercial partners

You will report to the Business Development Lead and work closely with the sales team in acquiring new commercial partners and strengthening relationships beyond big traditional retailers (e.g. pawn shop collaboration, B2B, VAS bundle with local providers and driving growth in our distribution network.

You will support the Business Development Lead in all activities to expand big traditional retailers and enlarge the customer base, driving sales to our commercial partners.

### **Responsibilities**

1. Merchant Acquisition & Market Expansion

Identify, prospect, and acquire new local merchants/semi modern channels/ strategic partners in line with company targets. Conduct market mapping, competitor analysis, and identify new business opportunities. Own end-to-end pipeline from lead generation to onboarding and activation.

2. Partnership & Key Account Management

Act as the main point of contact for key merchants (including handling operational cases and escalations. Maintain strong relationships, ensure SLA compliance, and drive partner satisfaction. Conduct regular business reviews and drive joint business plans.

3. Business Growth & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Develop and execute go-to-market strategies to increase transaction volume and revenue. Collaborate closely with Marketing and Operations teams for promo programs, roadshows, and merchant activation. Support registration, contracting, and documentation for all partnerships.

4. Reporting & Performance Tracking

Monitor merchant performance, prepare weekly / monthly reports, and provide actionable insights. Achieve and exceed assigned KPIs for acquisition, revenue, and retention. Monitor competitor and market activities by obtaining information on market trends, opportunities and challenges, leveraging insight to inform strategic decisions and action plans.

### **Qualifications**

* Aligned with PayJoy’s principles and culture;
* Bachelor's degree in any major
* 5+ years of experience in business development/account management/partnerships/sales with a background in financial services /banking/retail is a plus;
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, capable of engaging and influencing stakeholders at all levels; English and Indonesian
* Comfortable working on Google Suite (Sheets, Docs, Slides, etc.). CRM (Zoho & Zendesk), communication (Slack), data analytics, and project management (Hex & Jira)
* Willing to work on-site in Jakarta and to travel to field/market locations.
* Must be detail-oriented and comfortable in a fast-paced & early-stage environment;
* Experience in Smartphone Retail or Fintech/Banking is highly preferred
* Strong merchant network, especially in Gadget Retail & Distributors
* Proven track record of achieving acquisition and revenue targets
* Excellent negotiation, communication, and presentation skills
* Field-ready, resilient, and willing to travel/work on-site when required
* Self-starter with ability to work independently and collaboratively with local Sales Team/ regional teams

### **Benefits**

* 100% Company Funded : Private Health Insurance for employee and immediate family
* 20 days vacation
* Phone finance, headphone, home office equipment and wellness perks.
* USD$2,000 annual co-working travel benefit
* USD$2,000 annual professional development benefit
* USD$500 annual wellness benefit

PayJoy is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and we welcome and encourage people of all backgrounds. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

**PayJoy Principles**

Finance for the next billion \* Ownership \* Break Through Walls \* Live Communication \* Transparency & Directness \* Focus on Scale \* Work-Life Balance \* Embrace Diversity \* Speed \* Active Listening

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: QA Engineer / QA Lead (Automation)
description:
**About The Job QA Engineer / QA Lead (Automation)**
**Meratus Group**
is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centers.
  
  
At Meratus, we are committed to
**digitalization, innovation, and transformation**
, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our
**customer-centric approach**
and
**agile operations**
empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.
  
  
We take pride in fostering a
**dynamic and inclusive workplace**
, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.
  
  
Position Overview : ﻿We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**QA Automation Engineer**
to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our applications by working closely with cross-functional teams throughout the development lifecycle.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* ﻿ Review and approve Functional Specification Documents (FSD) and UI/UX flows, providing timely, structured, and constructive feedback.
* Design and implement comprehensive QA strategies and test plans in collaboration with Business Analysts, Product Lead, and Solution Delivery Managers.
* Lead and mentor QA team members on testing best practices, automation frameworks, and quality standards.
* Support and participate in the User Acceptance Testing (UAT) process together with business users and stakeholders.
* Develop, document, and maintain clear, structured, and reusable test scenarios, scripts, and automation suites.
* Execute and oversee manual and automated test scripts to ensure application quality, stability, and performance.
* Identify, document, and track defects, ensuring proper resolution and communicating risk to management.
* Monitor QA metrics, generate reports, and recommend improvements to processes, tools, and team productivity.

**Requirements**

* ﻿ Significant experience in software quality assurance, with at least 5+ years in QA and 2+ years in QA leadership roles
* Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, QA processes, and industry best practices.
* Hands-on experience or strong familiarity with automation testing tools such as Katalon, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Experience with performance, load, or stress testing tools (e.g., JMeter) is a strong advantage.
* Proven ability to lead QA teams, define QA strategy, and ensure software quality across multiple projects.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to collaborate with developers, product teams, and business users.
* Experience in mentoring junior QA engineers and fostering a culture of quality within the team.

description:
**About Scarlett Indonesia**

Founded in 2017, Scarlett Indonesia has rapidly emerged as one of the leading local brands in beauty and personal care. As a fast-growing company, we have built a strong presence across both online and offline platforms.

Our growth is driven by our innovative product offerings, passionate team, and the support of over 5 million organic followers on Instagram and e-commerce channels.

With a bold vision to become Indonesia’s number one beauty and personal care brand, we invite you to be part of our journey and #BeOurSTARlett!

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field, with 3–4 years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
* Strong SQL skills, including complex queries, performance optimization, and data modeling (Star/Snowflake Schema).
* Hands-on experience with ETL/ELT tools such as SSIS, Talend, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, or equivalent.
* Familiar with databases/data warehouses such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, or equivalent, and REST/SOAP API integration for data consolidation.
* Familiarity with Azure, AWS, or GCP is a plus.
* Experience working with Business Analysts/users to prepare data sources for BI/reporting.
* Understanding of data governance and data quality, including validation, cleansing, and documentation.

**Responsibilities:**

* Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines from databases, applications, and APIs to the data warehouse, including API integrations to consolidate data across systems.
* Design and manage data warehouse structures and data models.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and availability.
* Monitor pipeline performance and troubleshoot data process failures.
* Publish Business Analyst datasets/reports to the internal reporting portal.
* Maintain technical documentation for data architecture, pipelines, and integrations.
* Collaborate with Business Analysts/users and IT teams to support BI/reporting and technical requirements.

**Why Scarlett Indonesia?**

At Scarlett Indonesia, time flies beautifully as we stay focused on building, growing, and achieving meaningful milestones through memorable experiences.

title: AI Infrastructure / Platform Engineer
description:
**Responsibilities**
THIS JOB OPPORTUNITY IS FOR OUR PARTNERING COMPANY,
**SERTIS INDONESIA**
**[About Sertis Teknologi Indonesia]**
Sertis Teknologi Indonesia builds AI and data solutions for enterprises in Indonesia. We apply leading-edge research and practices to push the boundaries of what AI can do, turning them into practical, innovative solutions for our clients. We also run our own on-premise AI platform, so clients, including those in regulated industries, can use advanced AI while their data stays private and under their control.
  
  
**[About the Role]**
We are looking for an AI Infrastructure / Platform Engineer to build, operate, and maintain our on-premise AI platform, powered by high-performance GPU servers in a data centre.
  
  
In this role, you will take ownership of the platform end to end, from preparing physical servers and configuring system environments to deploying AI systems and applications, maintaining infrastructure security, optimizing performance, and supporting clients in production.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is passionate about hardware, understands how software runs on physical systems, has a solid foundation in networking, and enjoys solving technical challenges while delivering reliable services to clients.
  
  
**[Key Responsibilities]**

* GPU Server Setup & Management: Prepare and configure servers after hardware installation, including operating systems, user permissions, secure access, firewalls, storage, software RAID, and disk encryption. Maintain GPU drivers, CUDA, container runtimes, and related system components.
* System & Application Deployment: Deploy, configure, and maintain systems and applications, primarily AI-related workloads, on the on-premise platform. Manage containerized deployments, application updates, versioning, and rollbacks while ensuring secure connectivity and appropriate firewall configurations.
* Monitoring & Observability: Build and maintain monitoring systems, dashboards, and alerts for GPU utilization, server health, network performance, and application services. Establish performance baselines and identify potential issues before they affect clients.
* Performance Optimization: Conduct load and performance testing, assess platform capacity, and improve system reliability, application responsiveness, and GPU utilization within data centre power and cooling constraints.
* Troubleshooting & Incident Management: Diagnose and resolve issues across hardware, operating systems, storage, networks, and applications. Identify root causes, document solutions, and maintain clear operational procedures.
* Client Onboarding & Technical Support: Support client onboarding, access provisioning, API key management, data separation, and usage limits. Act as a technical point of contact, provide technical consultations and usage reports, and help resolve incidents in line with agreed service levels.
* Security & Infrastructure Operations: Maintain access controls, logging, encryption, backups, and security documentation. Coordinate with hardware vendors and data centre providers on maintenance, repairs, warranties, and infrastructure requirements.

**Requirements**
**[Main Requirements]**

* Are enthusiastic and passionate about computer hardware, particularly GPUs, CPUs, and server infrastructure.
* Understand how to install, configure, and run software on physical hardware, from operating systems and system services to applications.
* Have experience managing Linux servers in production, with a solid understanding of SSH, storage, networking, and security hardening.
* Have hands-on experience with GPU servers, including drivers, CUDA, and troubleshooting. Experience with AI workloads or large language model deployment is a plus.
* Understand the fundamentals of networking, connectivity, firewalls, and network security.
* Are familiar with containers and scripting using Bash or Python.
* Can build or maintain monitoring and alerting systems, such as Prometheus and Grafana, and understand how to identify meaningful metrics.
* Enjoy troubleshooting issues across hardware, operating systems, networks, and applications using logs, metrics, and system tools.
* Use innovative tools, including AI tools, to work efficiently while carefully reviewing and validating their output before production use.
* Have strong client-facing and service-oriented skills, with the ability to support onboarding, prepare technical reports, explain technical issues, and provide practical consultations.
* Communicate clearly, collaborate effectively, and take ownership of technical responsibilities in a dynamic environment.

**[Nice to Have]**

* Experience with multi-GPU servers, GPU interconnects, or AI inference engines such as vLLM.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible or Terraform.
* Experience with monitoring and observability tools, high-speed networking (100 Gbps or above), or infrastructure performance testing.
* Knowledge of infrastructure security, data privacy, or compliance standards such as ISO 27001 and financial-sector regulations.

Accenture is seeking talented ServiceNow Engineers to join our growing Technology team. This role is ideal for professionals who are passionate about digital workflow automation, IT Service Management (ITSM), and enterprise platform development.

As a ServiceNow Engineer, you will work with cross-functional teams to design, develop, enhance, and support ServiceNow solutions that improve operational efficiency, employee experience, and business service delivery. You will have the opportunity to work on enterprise-scale implementations while building expertise across various ServiceNow products and modules.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support system integration activities with enterprise applications, APIs, cloud platforms, and third-party tools.

* Understanding of IT Service Management (ITSM) processes, including Incident Management, Change Management, Problem Management, Service Request Management, and CMDB concepts.
* Experience working in Agile, Scrum, or DevOps delivery environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

description:
Job Function: Sales The role:

Passionate about helping customers turn data and AI opportunities into real business outcomes?

Do you enjoy designing modern Data & AI architectures across AWS and Azure?

Excited to help customers move beyond GenAI experimentation towards scalable, production-ready agentic AI solutions?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations unlock the value of their data through cloud, analytics, and AI. We are looking for a Presales Solution Architect – Data & AI to work with customers, Sales, and Delivery teams to understand business challenges, shape technical strategies, and design scalable Data & AI solutions across AWS and Azure.

As a Presales Solution Architect – Data & AI, you will act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the customer journey. You will bring deep expertise in either AWS or Azure, with the ability to confidently design solutions across the other platform, helping customers select the right architecture based on their existing technology investments, business goals, security requirements, and commercial considerations. You will also help customers evolve from traditional data and analytics platforms through GenAI and towards emerging agentic AI solutions.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Leading customer discovery sessions and workshops to understand business objectives, existing data environments, technical challenges, and transformation priorities.
* Designing secure and scalable Data, Analytics, GenAI, and agentic AI architectures across AWS and Azure, incorporating Databricks or Snowflake where appropriate.
* Creating solution architectures, technical designs, effort estimates, Statements of Work, proposals, and commercial recommendations.
* Delivering technical workshops, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept engagements for both technical and business stakeholders.
* Advising customers on the right cloud and platform approach based on architecture, existing investments, cost, governance, security, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborating with Sales throughout the opportunity lifecycle and ensuring a smooth transition of successful solutions into Delivery.

What we need to see from you:

* Experience in presales, solution architecture, data architecture, or consulting roles focused on customer-facing Data & AI solutions.
* Deep expertise in either AWS or Microsoft Azure, with sufficient knowledge of the other platform to design and position multi-cloud Data & AI solutions.
* Strong understanding of modern data architectures including data lakes, lakehouses, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, analytics, data integration, and governance.
* Experience designing AI/ML, Generative AI, or agentic AI solutions and translating emerging technologies into practical customer use cases.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to simplify complex architecture concepts and clearly articulate business value.
* Commercial awareness with experience developing solution scopes, estimates, technical proposals, and Statements of Work.

Why SoftwareOne?:

SoftwareOne is a global software and cloud solutions provider and distributor, powered by around 12,000 people across more than 70 countries. But what really makes us SoftwareOne is our people: curious minds, different perspectives, and talented teams working together to solve real challenges and create meaningful impact. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to grow, explore new possibilities, and build a career that’s uniquely yours, while helping shape what’s next in technology.

Accommodations:

Please include the role for which you are applying and your country location. Someone from our organization that is not part of the decision-making process will be in touch to discuss your specific needs and we will make every effort to accommodate you. Any information shared will be stored securely and treated in the strictest of confidence in line with GDPR.

At SoftwareOne, we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and teammates without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. * Perform deep analysis of security alerts to identify, mitigate, and remediate threats.
* Conduct forensic investigations on compromised hosts, networks, and cloud environments.

* Analyze malware samples (basic level) to determine functionality, impact, and mitigation strategies.
* Develop and refine detection rules, improving alert fidelity and response workflows.
* Contribute to threat intelligence gathering, analyzing attack patterns, and enhancing defensive strategies.
* Participate in red teaming or penetration testing activities to identify and remediate vulnerabilities.

* Strong forensic analysis skills across Windows, Linux, and macOS systems.
* Expertise in network forensics, traffic analysis, and packet inspection (Wireshark, Zeek).
* Proficiency in SIEM platforms (Splunk, Sentinel, QRadar) and EDR solutions (CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender ATP).

**Preferred Certifications:**

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

AccelByte is building a 24x7 operations team for AAA multiplayer video games. In this position, we need a driven Site Reliability Engineer who can actively participate in the day-to-day combat by maintaining high reliability of our service and drive prioritization in fixing what may be broken today, as well as able to envision, design and implement processes and technologies to improve the ability to identify, isolate, correlate, and mitigate service impacting problems in the system. The Site Reliability Engineer must also know some coding to automate routine tasks in service metrics gathering, correlating, organizing, and presenting, in addition to detail and in-depth root cause analysis

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is accountable for the following functions and responsibilities:

* Design, implement, and maintain infrastructure for applications
* Architect, implement, and maintain a highly scalable deployment framework that improves the stability, reliability, and availability of our products.
* Build and run service deployment using K8s and other CNCF projects
* Provide a secure, high-scalable, and cost-effective cloud platform
* Construct and build effective systems to monitor the health of our system/applications, and to handle outages
* Solve problems occurring in all our environments and create solutions to prevent them from happening again
* Produce automation and innovative tools to assist the product development teams and to deliver operational excellence
* Create and maintain infrastructure related documentations and SRE runbooks
* Collaborate with other stakeholders to provide cost-effective, operational excellence, and performance efficient infrastructure solutions to improve our products.
* Identify technology, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement
* Liaise, communicate, and work directly with our client.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED**

* 3+ years Linux administration
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Prior experience helping design, manage and run large scale applications in the cloud
* Experience with monitoring systems and strategies (System Admin)
* Solid performance and troubleshooting skills
* Solid foundation on distributed system
* Robust knowledge and experience in cloud computing of at least one cloud provider (preferred AWS/GCP)
* Experience with containerization principles and frameworks such as Docker, Container, Kubernetes, etc
Proven track record of building infrastructure as code (Terraform is must), configuration management, and package manager (eg: Helm Chart)  
* Hand-on experience designing and operating observability, monitoring, and alerting systems using Grafana and/or Datadog with strong proficiency in OpenTelemetry for instrumenting metrics, logs, and traces across distributed systems
* Proven experience with automation, CICD, and GitOps tools such as Jenkins, GitLab, GitHub, and/or Flux
* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK, OpsGenie, etc
* Experience within a greenfield environment, building infrastructure from scratch
* Software development and scripting experience with Bash, Python, and/or Golang
* Ability to work with clients on tight deadlines and fluid requirements
* Good communication skill (escalation, explaining the incident)
* Fluent in English both spoken and written

  

**QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE PREFERRED**

* Experience using AI tools for software development and system operations, such as Claude Code, Codex, and Amazon Kiro
* Contribute to open source projects and participate in technical communities
* Experience working for or with AAA game studios
* Experience using AI-powered tools for development and system operations (e.g., Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or Amazon Q Developer)
* Experience in infrastructure cost optimization
* JVM tuning and troubleshooting
* Experience with web services
* Experience working with cloud-native infrastructure tools such as Emissary and Karpenter
* Experience in Networking, Security, or Storage
* Experience managing SQL and NoSQL databases
* Familiar with Perforce version control

title: App Operations (Marketplace App & Mobile) - Sea Labs
description:
**About The Team**
**About Sea Labs Indonesia**
Sea Labs is at the core of the Sea platforms development, supporting diverse business lines from e-commerce, supply chain, games, payment and finance, among many others. The strong growth and unique positioning of Sea's e-commerce business, Shopee, spurred the launch of Sea Labs Indonesia. Since its inception, the group of passionate engineers have charted the course to drive the best experience for our users in Indonesia, many of which solutions are even adapted to other markets in the region.
  
  
Sea's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience world-class projects first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do. Together with our passionate and driven teams, you'll get to develop your skills, build on industry knowledge and collaborate with global teams in a dynamic space. Browse our Sea Labs Indonesia team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are an open-minded and innovative mobile operations team. We own the release platform operations of Shopee’s mobile apps across Android, iOS and multiple tech stacks. We bridge the gap across platforms and teams, and we use automation and AI to solve challenging problems, so that our fast-growing business ships safely and our users get a better product experience.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Own multi-platform release operations across regions and apps (Shopee, Seller, Lite, etc.): release scheduling, regression and late-merge management, hotfix/ad-hoc releases, and greyscale rollout monitoring.
* Manage third-party platform submissions and compliance (Apple App Store, Google Play, Firebase, Maven, Facebook, OEM partners). Perform impact analysis on policy changes, rejections, alerts and SDK updates from external platforms and partners.
* Manage platform access and security, including access requests via the help desk, periodic access reviews, and revocation for departing employees.
* Design, develop and maintain automated operation and reporting tools (e.g. alert triage, weekly reports, access checks, release notifications, bots and scripts). Apply LLMs and AI agents to automate triage, summarization, root-cause hints and report generation, and continuously evaluate and improve their accuracy.
* Optimize the efficiency of processes across Android, iOS and multiple tech stacks. Identify repetitive manual work and replace it with AI-assisted workflows.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to handle operational and technical queries. Maintain SOPs, runbooks and the knowledge base. Build AI-assisted knowledge search and Q&A so teams can self-serve.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s or higher degree in Computer Science or IT-related fields.
* Good logical thinking and problem-solving ability.
* Good verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to coordinate across teams and regions.
* Strong analytical skills: understands complex issues, identifies root causes, and makes data-driven decisions.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools and LLM-based coding assistants in daily work, with a track record of building or shipping AI-assisted automation. Familiarity with prompt design, agent/tool-calling workflows or MCP-style integrations is a plus.
* Good judgment on AI output: able to verify results, handle hallucinations, and protect data security and access boundaries.
* Process-driven mindset, with attention to release quality and risk control.
* Software development experience in the mobile field (Android, iOS or React Native), or familiarity with the app release and submission process, is a plus.

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia
  
  
Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.
  
  
Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.
  
  
The role is to support the team responsible for managing network flows within the global Thales scope.
  
  
In addition to flow management, the team to which the profile will belong is responsible for:
  
  

* Improving user experience, reducing processing times, and making them predictable.
* Increasing configuration compliance and risk management.
* Globalizing the services delivered by the squad, which are:
* Network flow security management
* Configuration audit and compliance

The requested service content consists of:
  
  

* Automating recurring/repetitive and complex tasks.
* Enhancing the squad's development environment.
* Supporting the squad in cleaning up and automating configurations.
* Project support.

**Technical Skills**

* Development: Python, PowerShell, Ansible
* Firewalls: Juniper SRX / Stormshield / Palo Alto / Fortinet / Juniper ScreenOS
* Networking / Routing: Cisco Routers (IOS / NX-OS), BGP / OSPF, LACP, VRF, Route Leaking

**Soft Skills**

* Quick thinking
* Curiosity
* Strong team spirit
* Agile / Scrum mindset
* English skills are needed for writing documents and participating in requirement understanding meetings

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
