title: Business and Data Analyst - eCommerce SME
description:
**Who We Are**
Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state-of-the-art in-house Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.
  
  
We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a BA/DA — eCommerce Operations to become Intrepid's dedicated e-commerce operations and finance analytics subject-matter expert across the region, based in Thailand, while acting as the go-to operations and finance data resource for country teams across all six SEA markets we operate in.
  
  
This is a hybrid role by design. You will own e-commerce operations and finance analytics requirements end-to-end — discovering what country operations and finance teams actually need, translating it into a solvable data problem, and then doing the hands-on SQL, dashboard, and reconciliation work yourself, working hand-in-hand with our central Data Engineering and BI team (based in Vietnam and Indonesia) in a hub-and-spoke model. You are not a traditional, non-technical BA who hands off requirements and waits — nor a pure data analyst who builds what's asked without questioning it. You are the person who connects marketplace operations — pricing, promotions, fulfilment, and SKU/category performance — to financial outcomes, and who is experienced enough to surface discrepancies and signals nobody has thought to ask about yet.
  
  
The world is moving past the era of the static dashboard. Stakeholders no longer just want a chart to interpret — they want AI-native, proactive insight: analytics that surfaces what matters before anyone has to go looking for it, flags anomalies and drivers automatically, and arrives with a narrative and a recommendation attached, not just a number. In operations and finance, that means catching a pricing error, a margin leak, or a reconciliation discrepancy before month-end close, not after. We want this role to help lead that shift inside Intrepid's e-commerce operations domain, not simply maintain the reporting model it's replacing.
  
  
You will work directly with data flowing through Intrepid's own PowerSell e-commerce platform and Finance Data Warehouse, as well as marketplace operations data crawled or pulled via official API from Shopee, Lazada, and TikTok Shop Seller Centres, and third-party market intelligence and digital shelf data. Data accuracy has been a real, active challenge for our dashboards; this role is central to closing that gap between operational and financial reporting — and to reimagining what ops and finance reporting looks like once it isn't just a dashboard anymore.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**2. Analysis & Solutioning — Domain and Technical**
**3. Insight Delivery & Stakeholder Management**
**4. Governance, Documentation & Scale**
**5. AI-Native Analytics & Proactive Insight Generation**

* Discovery & Requirements
* Lead requirement-gathering conversations and workshops with e-commerce operations and finance stakeholders, and support country operations and finance leads across all six SEA markets
* Map how operations and finance data flows across PowerSell, the Finance Data Warehouse, and marketplace Seller Centre sources, to identify what a country team actually needs versus what they're asking for
* Translate open-ended questions (e.g. "why is reported GMV not matching finance's reconciled revenue for this market") into concrete, structured data requirements
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of operations and finance analytics requests, working the hub-and-spoke model with the central Data Engineering / BI team in Vietnam and Indonesia
* Own end-to-end e-commerce operations analytics: SKU/category performance, pricing and promotions, marketplace P&L, and fulfilment/returns — reconciled against Finance Data Warehouse actuals
* Write your own SQL and build/validate your own dashboards rather than fully depending on the central BI team — pairing with a Vietnam- or Indonesia-based analyst for heavier pipeline or engineering work
* Validate and reconcile operations and finance numbers against each other, escalating recurring data quality or reconciliation issues to the central Data Governance & Quality function
* Interpret third-party market intelligence and digital shelf vendor data for competitive and category context, understanding the strengths and known limitations of each data source
* Present operations and finance insights and recommendations directly to country operations and finance leads and regional leadership — not just a finished dashboard, but a point of view on what to do next
* Proactively surface non-obvious patterns and discrepancies across markets, rather than only answering questions as they're asked
* Act as the operations and finance domain's voice within Data & Analytics, feeding requirements into the central data engineering roadmap — including Intrepid's ongoing move from crawled Seller Centre data to official platform APIs for commercial and operational metrics
* Maintain operations and finance-specific metric definitions (e.g. GMV, net revenue, category margin), feeding into Intrepid's broader BI Business Glossary and semantic layer
* Document reconciliation methodology between operational and financial reporting to ensure consistency of definitions across all six markets
* Contribute to operations and finance data quality monitoring, flagging recurring issues as candidates for automation
* Use AI tools such as Claude to move operations and finance reporting from reactive, end-of-month reconciliation toward proactive, continuous insight — automated anomaly and discrepancy detection, and "so what" summaries generated alongside the numbers
* Prototype and pilot AI-assisted analytics workflows — automated reconciliation-variance alerts, pricing/margin anomaly detection, natural-language querying over operations and finance data — in partnership with the central Data Engineering team
* Continuously evaluate where GenAI can replace manual, repetitive reconciliation and reporting effort, and hand off validated use cases into Intrepid's broader AI transformation and automation roadmap

**Requirements**
**Technical & Data Capabilities**

* Hands-on SQL and dashboarding experience (e.g. Apache Superset, Looker, Power BI, or similar), with the ability to validate and reconcile data from multiple sources yourself
* Working knowledge of e-commerce operations data structures — SKU/category, pricing and promotions, fulfilment and returns — and basic finance/reconciliation concepts (GMV vs. net revenue, margin, accruals)
* Experience with or exposure to marketplace Seller Centre data (Shopee, Lazada, TikTok Shop) and finance data warehouse reporting is a strong plus
* Comfort working with third-party vendor datasets (market intelligence, digital shelf) and reconciling discrepancies between sources
* Genuine, hands-on experience using Claude or other GenAI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini) for real analytical work — generating and debugging SQL, summarizing large or messy datasets, drafting stakeholder-ready insight narratives — not just casual or occasional use
* Comfort experimenting with AI agents or no/low-code workflow automation tools (e.g. n8n) to prototype proactive, always-on insight generation rather than one-off, on-request dashboard pulls
* Working prompt-engineering literacy — able to get reliable, decision-useful analytical output from an AI tool, and to know when to trust it and when to verify it

**Operations & Finance Domain and Business Analyst Capabilities**

* Deep understanding of e-commerce marketplace operations: pricing and promotions mechanics, fulfilment and returns, and category/SKU management
* Working understanding of finance and reconciliation concepts sufficient to bridge operational and financial reporting
* Strong requirements-gathering and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate with minimal oversight across multiple country operations and finance teams
* Excellent communication skills, able to bridge business/operations, finance, and technical/data audiences

**Preferred Experience**

* 4-6 years of combined experience across e-commerce operations analytics, finance analytics, business analysis, or data analysis roles
* Prior experience in e-commerce marketplace operations or finance reporting in Southeast Asia
* Experience covering multiple markets or countries remotely from a regional hub
* Exposure to finance reconciliation or data warehouse reporting systems
* Prior experience building or piloting an AI-assisted or automated reporting/insight workflow, even informally, is a strong plus

**Benefits**
**Why Join Intrepid**

* Shape e-commerce operations and finance analytics for a leading e-commerce enabler operating across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam
* Be the first dedicated operations and finance SME in this role, shaping how the function operates region-wide from the ground up
* Help lead Intrepid's shift from static, end-of-month reporting to AI-native, proactive operations and finance insight — you'll be defining what that looks like, not inheriting someone else's legacy reporting model
* Work directly with real marketplace and finance data — flowing from Intrepid's own PowerSell platform and Finance Data Warehouse — not theoretical frameworks

**In return, you will be getting**

* We are building 'the operating system for digital commerce in South East Asia' covering all key platforms, working with leading international brands, with a breadth and depth of functionalities (Middleware, OMS, Inventory mgmt, Store Ops, CX, MarTech, Data & Analytics) that few in the industry can match
* You get the chance to work on exciting SaaS projects and sophisticated features and functionalities that will make a big impact in the industry, on a top-notch scalable infrastructure
* Our Tech team has been around since 2017, so you will join a well-oiled and stable "machine" (= rockstar expert team), where processes are well established and enterprise-grade. But at the same time, our organisation is non-hierarchical, entrepreneurial and collaborative, and working on cool stuff, so you get the best of both worlds
* Tech is a strategic pillar for intrepid, so you will feel the love and recognition for your work, and will partner closely with business stakeholders, who as internal users of the tech will provide the real-world feedback and inputs which help to take our tech stack to the next level

**We also offer**
**Best of Both Worlds**
We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.
  
  
**Culture that Brings Out the Best**
At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.
  
  
**Grow Without Limits**
Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.
  
  
**Rewarding You Right**
We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That's why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.
  
  
*Note: We will not be accepting any unsolicited resumes or CVs from headhunting or recruitment agencies at this point. Any CVs or profiles shared with us will not be entertained, and in the event of dispute, Intrepid will not be liable for any material compensation to third parties*

title: Field Service Engineer (Mandarin Speaker)
description:
At Endress+Hauser, progress happens by working together. As the global leader in measurement instrumentation, our over 18.000 employees shape the future in the field of process automation. Whether developing and realizing new technology as a team, collaborating to build instrumentation, or strengthening vital relationships with countless global industries, we work to create trusted relationships that help everyone thrive. As a family-owned company, we look beyond short-term moves and work to create a vision that is forward-thinking for our people, our clients, and the world at large.

We are looking for a Field Service Engineer (Mandarin Speaking) to join our team in Indonesia. In this customer-facing role, you will provide technical service and support for our process instrumentation, with a particular focus on supporting our Chinese-speaking customers across Indonesia. Depending on your preference, this position can be based in Surabaya, Jakarta, or Medan.

**What is the role about?**

Do you enjoy working hands-on with technology and solving technical challenges directly at customer sites? Are you comfortable communicating in Mandarin and interested in developing your expertise in process instrumentation?

As a Field Service Engineer, you will support our customers throughout the lifecycle of their Endress+Hauser instruments. From installation and commissioning to troubleshooting and maintenance, you will help ensure that our customers' instrumentation operates reliably and effectively.

**Which tasks will you perform?**

You will:

* Deliver post-sale services at customer sites, including on-site installation, commissioning, inspection, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of Endress+Hauser instruments

* Diagnose technical issues and provide effective solutions to ensure reliable instrument performance and minimize operational disruption

* Advise customers on preventive maintenance, instrument configuration, and service measures that can improve performance and reliability

* Provide technical guidance and practical training to customer employees on the correct operation and maintenance of our instruments

* Complete service reports and other required administrative documentation accurately and on time

* Collaborate with customers, internal technical teams, and other stakeholders to resolve service requests and maintain a high level of customer satisfaction

**What do we expect from you?**

You:

* Hold a bachelor’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or another relevant technical discipline

* Have hands-on knowledge of process instrumentation and are comfortable working with technical equipment in industrial environments

* Have knowledge of IT applications, MS Office (proficient user in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SFDC, SAP)

* Communicate fluently in Mandarin, both spoken and written, enabling you to work effectively with our Chinese-speaking customers

* Have a good command of English for communication within our international organization

* Communicate confidently with customers, approach problems systematically, and can work both independently and collaboratively

* Are proactive, service-oriented, and willing to travel regularly throughout the assigned service area

**What can you expect from us?**

* The stability and long-term perspective of a successful international family-owned company

* A collaborative and people-focused culture where your ideas and expertise can make a real impact

* Opportunities for professional and personal development through a wide range of training and learning programs

* Close collaboration with experts and colleagues across our global Endress+Hauser network

* The flexibility and support needed to maintain a healthy work-life balance

* The opportunity to contribute to meaningful solutions that help customers operate more efficiently, safely, and sustainably

**How do you apply?**

To apply, we kindly ask you to upload your documents on our career page. Applications sent to us by email can unfortunately not be considered due to data privacy considerations.

*\*Agencies, HR service providers, or similar entities are kindly requested to refrain from unsolicited submission of profiles and inquiries regarding potential collaboration. Currently, we do not engage with external service providers for this role. Any unsolicited applications will be disregarded and deleted without further consideration. We appreciate your understanding.*

Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative, but work well within a team.

**Responsibilities**

* Supports the delivery of geo-data and related products by independently executing data processing activities.
* Applying professional judgement and ensuring quality, consistency and reliability of deliverables by: 1) Independently collating, processing, validating, and presenting geo-data for projects of low to medium complexity, following established workflows and standards.
* Applying judgement to resolve non-routine processing and data quality issues, ensuring completeness and accuracy of deliverables.
* Performing quality control on own deliverables and, where required, on selected outputs from others.
* Collaborating with project teams to support timely and reliable delivery of data products.
* Applying and contributing to improvements in existing processing workflows and tools.
* Maintaining accurate project documentation and records.

**Qualifications / Skills / Experience**

* A Degree in Geotechnical / Civil engineering or a relevant scientific or numerical subject (desired)
* Relevant experience, ideally in handling datasets. Experience in geotechnical laboratory testing (desired)
* Excellent IT skills, particularly in modifying and using MS Excel spreadsheets with embedded macros.
* Relevant experience in ISO 17025 accreditation by Komite Akreditasi Nasional (KAN) will be advantageous.
* Familiar with ASTM and ISO 17892 test standards will be advantageous
* Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Effective communication skills, both written and oral.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment.
* Proficient in English

**What we offer**

* Competitive salary ;
* Generous paid-leave;
* Career & training opportunities (international opportunities possible);
* Collective health insurance and outpatient benefits;
* Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) to provide help when you need extra support.

\*\*Benefits may vary according to position/contract/grade level.

**Our view on diversity, equity and inclusion**

At Fugro, our people are our superpower. Their variety of viewpoints, experiences, knowledge and talents give us collective strength. Distinctive beliefs and diverse backgrounds are therefore welcome, but discrimination, harassment, inappropriate behaviour and unfair treatment are not. Everybody is to be well-supported and treated fairly. And everyone must be valued and have their voice heard. Crucially, we believe that getting this right brings a sense of belonging, of safety and acceptance, that makes us feel more connected to Fugro’s purpose ‘together create a safe and liveable world’ – and to each other.

**How to apply**

* Please include your latest resume in the application.
* We regret to inform that we will only process applications made via our Careers website (and other linked portals) and only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: Senior Back End Engineer (Enterprise Efficiency) - Sea Labs
description:
**About the Team:**
**About Sea Labs Indonesia**
Sea Labs is at the core of the Sea platforms development, supporting diverse business lines from e-commerce, supply chain, games, payment, and finance, among many others. The strong growth and unique positioning of Sea's e-commerce business, Shopee, spurred the launch of Sea Labs Indonesia. Since its inception, the group of passionate engineers has charted the course to drive the best experience for our users in Indonesia, many of which solutions are even adapted to other markets in the region.
  
  
Sea's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience world-class projects first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do. Together with our passionate and driven teams, you'll get to develop your skills, build on industry knowledge, and collaborate with global teams in a dynamic space. Browse our Sea Labs Indonesia team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.
  
  
**About Team**
The Enterprise Efficiency team is dedicated to transforming workplace productivity through seamless integration of enterprise communication, open platform capabilities, and management systems covering HR, finance, and operational tools. Our products power the daily workflows of thousands of employees across Sea group companies.
  
  
Our product lines include SeaTalk (enterprise communication and collaboration platform) and PFMS (people and financial management system). We are currently driving enterprise initiatives where we actively leverage AI-powered tools and LLM integrations to enhance product capabilities and accelerate engineering workflows.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Design and implement reliable, performant, and scalable backend systems.
* Write high-quality, clean, and maintainable code using engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with product managers, frontend engineers, and QA teams across the full development lifecycle.
* Lead technical design discussions and produce thorough technical design documents.
* Conduct constructive code reviews that improve team-wide code quality.
* Integrate AI/LLM capabilities into backend services where applicable, including prompt engineering, API integration, and output handling.
* Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing.
* Proactively identify technical debt, performance bottlenecks, and reliability issues – then drive solutions.
* Communicate technical constraints and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years of backend development experience (Java, Go, or Python preferred)
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and API design
* Proven ability to produce well-structured, maintainable, and testable code with minimal defects
* Experience with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL) and caching layers (Redis)
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment best practices
* Able to perform thorough, constructive code reviews that improve team code quality
* Proficient in using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to accelerate coding, debugging, testing, and documentation workflows
* General AI literacy – understands core AI/LLM concepts and can evaluate where AI capabilities can be practically applied to improve product features or engineering processes
* Experience with message queues (Kafka, RabbitMQ) and event-driven architecture
* Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and cloud platforms (AWS/GCP)
* Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into backend services (e.g., prompt engineering, API integration, output parsing)

Nice-to-Have Technical Skills
  
  

* Experience building enterprise B2B or internal tooling products (e.g., ERP, communication platforms)
* Performance tuning and optimization experience at scale

title: Business Intelligence ( Mid - Senior)
description:
**Job Description**

* Interpret data and analyze results using advanced query techniques and statistical methods to uncover actionable insights.
* Create robust, reusable data querying, transformation, and visualization processes using tools such as Excel, SQL, BigQuery, Python, R, and other big data tools.
* Develop analytical reports and represent large, complex sets of data through sophisticated visual representations and dashboards.
* Proactively identify reporting needs and updates independently or based on stakeholder requirements within business processes.
* Present information and insights in a way that drives fact-based decision-making across the organization.
* Propose and define new business process improvement opportunities based on data to drive significant business impact.
* Work closely with management to prioritize business and information needs while ensuring alignment with company goals.
* Monitor deep-dive data analysis to identify trends or specific events and proactively escalate issues or findings discovered in business processes.
* Mentor junior BI team members by providing guidance, reviewing their work, and offering constructive feedback on their projects.
* Implement and maintain thorough documentation and records for all reports and dashboards created to ensure consistency and scalability.

Qualifications
  
  

* Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in Business Intelligence, Data Analytics, or a related field.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field.
* Expert-level SQL skills with the ability to write advanced database queries; proficiency in Python, R, Java, or Javascript is highly desirable.
* Ability to quickly disseminate data to find key trends and the skill to perform deep-dive data mining to understand the "why" behind those trends.
* Comfortable working with datasets containing millions of rows and creating complex visualizations from raw data in a live dashboard environment.
* Experience working with analytical tools such as Jupyter, Python, Hive, and BigQuery ML is a significant plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead complex data analysis projects and provide strategic recommendations to management.
* Ability to work well and deliver high-quality results under pressure in a fast-paced environment

description:
**About The Role**
We are seeking a Data Science & Functional AI Consultant to help organizations transform data into actionable business insights and AI-powered solutions. This role combines data science expertise, functional consulting capabilities, and industry knowledge to solve complex business challenges, drive innovation, and accelerate digital transformation initiatives.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have a strong foundation in data science, analytics, and AI technologies, along with practical experience in at least one industry domain. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities, develop intelligent solutions, and deliver measurable business value.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
  
- Translate business challenges into data-driven and AI-enabled solutions that support strategic objectives.
- Analyze large and complex datasets to generate insights, recommendations, and predictive models.
- Design, develop, and implement machine learning, analytics, and AI use cases to improve business outcomes.
- Collaborate with business stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize opportunities, and measure value realization.
- Apply industry domain knowledge to identify relevant business use cases and advise on solution adoption.
- Support AI and analytics transformation initiatives, including process redesign and change management activities.
- Communicate findings and recommendations to technical and non-technical audiences through presentations, dashboards, and workshops.
- Stay current with emerging trends in data science, Generative AI, machine learning, and responsible AI practices.
**Required Qualifications**- Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
- Strong understanding of data science concepts, statistical analysis, machine learning, and predictive analytics.
- Experience working with data analysis and visualization tools such as Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.
- Demonstrated experience delivering analytics, AI, or data-driven business solutions.
- Knowledge of at least one industry domain, such as Energy, Utilities, Resources, Financial Services, Consumer Goods, Telecommunications, Healthcare, or Manufacturing.
- Strong stakeholder management, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work effectively in a collaborative consulting environment and manage multiple priorities.
**Preferred Qualifications**- Experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, or AI-enabled business transformation initiatives.
- Experience with cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
- Familiarity with AI governance, responsible AI, data management, and data strategy frameworks.
- Professional certifications in Data Analytics, Data Science, AI, Cloud Technologies, or related areas.
- Experience in consulting, digital transformation, or enterprise-scale analytics initiatives.
**About The Company / Team**
We work with one shared purpose: to deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity. Every day, more than 775,000 of us help our stakeholders continuously reinvent. Together, we drive positive change and deliver value to our clients, partners, shareholders, communities, and each other.

We also provide opportunities to keep skills relevant through certifications, learning, and diverse work experiences. We're proud to be consistently recognized as one of the World's Best Workplaces™.
  
  
Join Accenture to work at the heart of change. Visit us at www.accenture.com.
  
  
Equal Employment Opportunity Statement
  
  
All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law.

title: Finance Management Trainee
description:
**Finance Management Trainee**

**Kickstart your career at the intersection of Finance, Data Science and IT — right where products are made.**

  

If you’re the kind of graduate who gets equally excited about a P&L, a dataset, and experimenting with AI — this is your program.

  

We are a **manufacturing company operating in the Consumer Health and Fast‑Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) space**, and we are **proud of the products we create every day** — products that aim to reach billions of consumers worldwide and make a real difference in people’s lives.

Guided by Bayer’s mission **“Health for all, hunger for none,”** we are shaping the future of finance by combining **business impact, technology and purpose**.

In our **1.5–2 year Finance Management Trainee program**, you will be **based at one of our production facilities**, close to our products and operations. Your home assignment sits in **Product Supply Finance**, complemented by **~50% rotations** across **Commercial Finance, Digital Finance and key stakeholders**. This ensures you gain a true end‑to‑end understanding of how value is created, steered and transformed through data and technology.

  

This is **not a traditional finance traineeship**. It is **on‑the‑job learning by design**: you will apply newly acquired knowledge immediately, work on real business questions, and actively experiment with **AI, analytics and emerging technologies** in a manufacturing environment.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO (YOUR PLAYGROUND)**

  

In Product Supply Finance, you will learn how a production facility operates and how shop‑floor reality is translated into financial insights that steer decisions.

You will:

* Partner closely with experienced **Finance Business Partners on site**, learning manufacturing finance hands‑on
* Translate **production processes into numbers**, connecting operational drivers to P&L, working capital and performance
* Actively identify opportunities for **automation, analytics, self‑service reporting and AI‑enabled insights** in day‑to‑day finance work
* Work with **Bills of Materials (BOMs)** to understand product costing and value drivers
* Collaborate on **periodic reporting, planning and forecasting**, together with central reporting and analytics partners
* **Present financial results** to site and stakeholder management, learning how to tell the story behind the numbers
* Support **continuous improvement initiatives** where finance, operations and efficiency come together

  

**YOUR 1.5-2 YEAR JOURNEY**

  

**~50% Product Supply Finance (home base at the production site)**

Build strong fundamentals in manufacturing and supply finance, staying close to our products and operations.

**~50% Rotations (Commercial Finance, Digital Finance & stakeholders)**

Broaden your perspective across the business, understanding how commercial decisions, digital solutions and finance jointly drive performance.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL LEARN (AND WHY IT'S A CAREER ACCELERATOR)**

  

By the end of the program, you will:

* Understand **how manufacturing performance flows into financial results** in a Consumer Health / FMCG environment
* Combine **finance logic, data thinking and technology** to create tangible business impact
* Understand **enterprise E2E supply chain** management
* Confidently engage with finance and non‑finance stakeholders, including production and management teams
* Build a strong foundation for future roles across Product Supply Finance, Commercial Finance, Digital Finance or project‑driven teams

  

**WHO YOU ARE**

  

We’re looking for **graduates with up to 2 years of work experience** who want to become **hybrid professionals** at the crossroads of Finance, Data and IT.

You bring:

  

* A degree in **Finance, Business, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering** or similar
* Strong curiosity, learning agility and a proactive mindset
* A clear affinity with **data, systems and digital solutions**
* Enthusiasm for experimenting with **AI and new technologies**
* A genuine interest in **manufacturing, production environments and FMCG operations**
* Confidence to ask questions, challenge the status quo and roll up your sleeves
* Strong communication skills and cultural sensitivity

  

**WHAT WE OFFER**

  

* A **steep learning curve** across Finance, Data and Technology — and how they interlink
* Real responsibility from day one, with your work embedded in real processes and decisions
* Coaching and mentoring from experienced finance professionals on site and globally
* A purpose‑driven environment aligned with Bayer’s mission:  
  **“Health for all, hunger for none.”**
* A strong pipeline into future roles across finance, analytics, digital and business partnering

  

**Ready to shape the future of finance — from the factory floor to data‑driven decisions?**

  

Apply with your CV and a short note on **a manufacturing, finance or data challenge you’d love to solve using analytics or AI**.

Oct 2026 - Nov 2026

894837

Consumer Health

Indonesia : West Java : Cimanggis

  

**Functional Area:**

General Administration & Corporate Services

**Position Grade:**

R.12

  

**Employment Type:**

Temporary Work

Standard

title: Business and Data Analyst - Social Commerce SME
description:
**Who We Are**
Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state-of-the-art in-house Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.
  
  
We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a BA/DA — Social Commerce to become Intrepid's dedicated social commerce analytics subject-matter expert across the region, based in the Philippines, while acting as the go-to social commerce domain resource for country teams across all six SEA markets we operate in.
  
  
This is a hybrid role by design. You will own social commerce analytics requirements end-to-end — discovering what country livestream, affiliate, and content teams actually need, translating it into a solvable data problem, and then doing the hands-on SQL, dashboard, and reconciliation work yourself, working hand-in-hand with our central Data Engineering and BI team (based in Vietnam and Indonesia) in a hub-and-spoke model. You are not a traditional, non-technical BA who hands off requirements and waits — nor a pure data analyst who builds what's asked without questioning it. You are the person who connects livestream performance, affiliate and creator economics, and content-to-conversion outcomes into one picture, and who is experienced enough to surface signals nobody has thought to ask about yet.
  
  
The world is moving past the era of the static dashboard. Stakeholders no longer just want a chart to interpret — they want AI-native, proactive insight: analytics that surfaces what matters before anyone has to go looking for it, flags anomalies and drivers automatically, and arrives with a narrative and a recommendation attached, not just a number. In social commerce, that matters even more — a livestream session or a piece of content can succeed or fail in real time, and a report delivered the next morning is often a report delivered too late. We want this role to help lead that shift inside Intrepid's social commerce domain, not simply maintain the reporting model it's replacing.
  
  
You will work directly with data flowing through Intrepid's socom platform, our internal system of record for livestream, affiliate, and content performance, as well as social commerce data crawled or pulled via official API from TikTok Shop, Shopee Live, and Lazada Live, and third-party market intelligence and digital shelf data. Data accuracy has been a real, active challenge for our dashboards; this role is central to closing that gap for the social commerce domain specifically — and to reimagining what social commerce reporting looks like once it isn't just a dashboard anymore.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**2. Analysis & Solutioning — Domain and Technical**
**3. Insight Delivery & Stakeholder Management**
**4. Governance, Documentation & Scale**
**5. AI-Native Analytics & Proactive Insight Generation**

* Discovery & Requirements
* Lead requirement-gathering conversations and workshops with livestream, affiliate, and content stakeholders, and support country social commerce leads across all six SEA markets
* Map how social commerce data flows across the socom platform and creator/affiliate/content sources, to identify what a country team actually needs versus what they're asking for
* Translate open-ended questions (e.g. "why did last night's livestream underperform versus last week's") into concrete, structured data requirements
* Maintain a prioritized backlog of social commerce analytics requests, working the hub-and-spoke model with the central Data Engineering / BI team in Vietnam and Indonesia
* Own end-to-end social commerce analytics: livestream session performance, affiliate/creator ROI and commission economics, and content-to-conversion funnel analysis
* Write your own SQL and build/validate your own dashboards rather than fully depending on the central BI team — pairing with a Vietnam- or Indonesia-based analyst for heavier pipeline or engineering work
* Validate and reconcile socom platform numbers, escalating recurring data quality issues to the central Data Governance & Quality function
* Interpret third-party market intelligence and digital shelf vendor data for competitive livestream and creator context, understanding the strengths and known limitations of each data source
* Present livestream, affiliate, and content performance insights directly to country social commerce leads and regional leadership — not just a finished dashboard, but a point of view on what to do next
* Proactively surface non-obvious patterns across markets, creators, and content formats, rather than only answering questions as they're asked
* Act as the social commerce domain's voice within Data & Analytics, feeding requirements into the central data engineering roadmap — including Intrepid's ongoing move from crawled Seller Centre data to official platform APIs for social commerce metrics
* Maintain social commerce-specific metric definitions (e.g. livestream GMV, viewer engagement, creator commission), feeding into Intrepid's broader BI Business Glossary and semantic layer
* Document social commerce metric methodology to ensure consistency of definitions across all six markets
* Contribute to social commerce data quality monitoring, flagging recurring issues as candidates for automation
* Use AI tools such as Claude to move social commerce reporting from reactive, next-morning dashboard-pulls toward proactive, near-real-time insight — automated commentary, anomaly detection on live sessions, and "so what" summaries generated alongside the numbers
* Prototype and pilot AI-assisted analytics workflows — real-time livestream anomaly alerts, automated creator/affiliate performance summaries, natural-language querying over social commerce data — in partnership with the central Data Engineering team
* Continuously evaluate where GenAI can replace manual, repetitive reporting effort within the social commerce domain, and hand off validated use cases into Intrepid's broader AI transformation and automation roadmap

**Requirements**
**Technical & Data Capabilities**

* Hands-on SQL and dashboarding experience (e.g. Apache Superset, Looker, Power BI, or similar), with the ability to validate and reconcile data from multiple sources yourself
* Working knowledge of social/live commerce data structures — livestream session metrics, affiliate/creator commission models, and content-to-conversion funnels
* Experience with or exposure to live commerce and social platform data (TikTok Shop, Shopee Live, Lazada Live) is a strong plus
* Comfort working with third-party vendor datasets (market intelligence, digital shelf) and reconciling discrepancies between sources
* Genuine, hands-on experience using Claude or other GenAI tools (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini) for real analytical work — generating and debugging SQL, summarizing large or messy datasets, drafting stakeholder-ready insight narratives — not just casual or occasional use
* Comfort experimenting with AI agents or no/low-code workflow automation tools (e.g. n8n) to prototype proactive, always-on insight generation rather than one-off, on-request dashboard pulls
* Working prompt-engineering literacy — able to get reliable, decision-useful analytical output from an AI tool, and to know when to trust it and when to verify it

**Social Commerce Domain & Business Analyst Capabilities**

* Deep understanding of live commerce mechanics: livestream selling, affiliate/creator economics, and content-driven conversion
* Strong requirements-gathering and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to operate with minimal oversight across multiple country social commerce teams
* Ability to connect content and creator investment to commerce outcomes into a single, coherent narrative for leadership
* Excellent communication skills, able to bridge business/social commerce and technical/data audiences

**Preferred Experience**

* 4-6 years of combined experience across social/live commerce analytics, business analysis, or data analysis roles
* Prior experience in live commerce, TikTok Shop, or the creator economy in Southeast Asia
* Experience covering multiple markets or countries remotely from a regional hub
* Exposure to affiliate/creator management platforms or livestream analytics tools
* Prior experience building or piloting an AI-assisted or automated reporting/insight workflow, even informally, is a strong plus

**Why Join Intrepid**

* Shape social commerce analytics for a leading e-commerce enabler operating across Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Vietnam
* Be the first dedicated social commerce SME in this role, shaping how the function operates region-wide from the ground up
* Help lead Intrepid's shift from static, next-day dashboards to AI-native, proactive social commerce insight — you'll be defining what that looks like, not inheriting someone else's legacy reporting model
* Work directly with real livestream, affiliate, and content data flowing through Intrepid's own socom platform — not theoretical frameworks

**Benefits**
**In return, you will be getting**

* We are building 'the operating system for digital commerce in South East Asia' covering all key platforms, working with leading international brands, with a breadth and depth of functionalities (Middleware, OMS, Inventory mgmt, Store Ops, CX, MarTech, Data & Analytics) that few in the industry can match
* You get the chance to work on exciting SaaS projects and sophisticated features and functionalities that will make a big impact in the industry, on a top-notch scalable infrastructure
* Our Tech team has been around since 2017, so you will join a well-oiled and stable "machine" (= rockstar expert team), where processes are well established and enterprise-grade. But at the same time, our organisation is non-hierarchical, entrepreneurial and collaborative, and working on cool stuff, so you get the best of both worlds
* Tech is a strategic pillar for intrepid, so you will feel the love and recognition for your work, and will partner closely with business stakeholders, who as internal users of the tech will provide the real-world feedback and inputs which help to take our tech stack to the next level

**We also offer**
**Best of Both Worlds**
We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.
  
  
**Culture that Brings Out the Best**
At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.
  
  
**Grow Without Limits**
Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.
  
  
**Rewarding You Right**
We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That's why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.
  
  
*Note: We will not be accepting any unsolicited resumes or CVs from headhunting or recruitment agencies at this point. Any CVs or profiles shared with us will not be entertained, and in the event of dispute, Intrepid will not be liable for any material compensation to third parties*

title: Sr Security Engineer (Defensive/Blue Team)
description:
We think you also hate when travel app is giving you a headache, right? A slight misinformation can ruin the trip.
  
  
That is exactly what we are tackling as t-fam! Making sure that our 50+ million users have the best experience in crafting their own adventure.
  
  
**Your Main Duties In Flying With Us**

* Conduct log analysis and able to present the findings to the stakeholders
* Develop automation scripts and security tools using Python, Go, Bash, or similar programming languages.
* Build and maintain security automation workflows, including the orchestration of security tools through RESTful APIs, to improve efficiency and support security pipelines.
* Collaborate with the Infrastructure teams and Engineering teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities and strengthen overall security posture.
* Stay up to date with the latest offensive security techniques, tools, and threat landscape.
* Simulate advanced attack scenarios to identify and validate security weaknesses.

**Mandatory Belongings That You Must Prepare**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in defensive security, cybersecurity engineering, network security, or a related cybersecurity field.
* Solid understanding of vulnerability assessment methodologies, exploitation techniques, and security testing tools.
* Proficiency in Python, Go, Bash, or other scripting languages, including experience integrating and automating workflows through RESTful APIs.
* Experience building or maintaining security automation solutions and orchestrating multiple security tools to support scalable security operations.
* Strong hands-on experience with enterprise-grade perimeter security technologies, including Cloudflare and firewall management.
* Experience in adversary simulation exercises is highly preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience conducting security assessments in cloud environments.
* Familiarity with threat emulation frameworks and attack simulation methodologies.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate findings and remediation recommendations to technical and non-technical stakeholders

In the event that you haven’t received any updates after 3 weeks, your data will be kept and we may contact you for another career destination. Meanwhile, discover more about tiket.com on Instagram, LinkedIn, or YouTube.

description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Senior Project Data Specialist**

**Location:** Batam, Indonesia  
**Function:** Data Analytics & Digital Transformation  
**Company:** Schneider Electric

We are looking for a highly analytical and digitally savvy **Senior Project Data Specialist** to turn complex business data into meaningful insights, automated reporting solutions, and clear recommendations for decision-makers.

In this role, you will collect and analyze data from multiple sources, develop interactive Power BI dashboards, automate recurring reports, and support digitalization initiatives across the organization. You will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand business requirements, identify performance gaps, and translate analytical findings into executive-level presentations and actionable improvement plans.

**What will you do?**

**Data Analytics & Business Insights**

* Collect, clean, validate, and analyze large datasets from multiple business sources.
* Identify trends, risks, opportunities, and performance gaps through quantitative analysis.
* Translate data into practical insights and recommendations that support strategic and operational decision-making.
* Conduct root-cause analysis and scenario modeling to support business and process improvement initiatives.
* Monitor key performance indicators and project performance metrics.
* Maintain a high level of accuracy, integrity, and consistency across analytical outputs.

**Dashboard Development & Reporting Automation**

* Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reporting solutions using **Microsoft Power BI**.
* Create clear and user-friendly data visualizations that enable stakeholders to monitor business performance effectively.
* Automate recurring reports to reduce manual work, improve reporting accuracy, and accelerate access to information.
* Develop and maintain KPI tracking and performance-monitoring systems.
* Ensure consistency and data integrity across dashboards and reporting platforms.
* Continuously improve reporting solutions based on evolving business requirements and user feedback.

**Digitalization & Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to digitalize, simplify, and automate business processes.
* Support automation and digital transformation initiatives using **Microsoft Power BI, Power Apps, and Power Automate**.
* Gather business requirements and translate them into practical digital solutions.
* Lead or support continuous improvement projects that enhance operational efficiency and productivity.
* Evaluate new digital tools and technologies based on business needs.
* Contribute to the development of scalable reporting and automation practices across the organization.

**Business Partnering & Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with stakeholders across different functions to understand reporting, analytical, and digitalization requirements.
* Facilitate discussions to clarify business challenges and align stakeholders on proposed solutions.
* Partner with business teams to ensure dashboards and reports address operational and management priorities.
* Present analytical findings and recommendations to senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
* Build effective working relationships and influence stakeholders through data-supported recommendations.

* Prepare executive-level presentations, performance reports, and management updates.
* Transform complex analytical findings into clear, relevant, and compelling business narratives.
* Communicate insights in a way that supports informed and timely decision-making.
* Present key trends, risks, and improvement opportunities to management.
* Provide training and guidance to end users on dashboards and reporting tools.

* Strong knowledge of data cleaning, validation, visualization, and data-quality management.
* Experience working with **SharePoint and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem**.

* Master’s Degree in a relevant discipline.
* Experience in a manufacturing, supply chain, project management, operations, or multinational environment.
* Practical experience using **Power Apps and Power Automate** to improve business processes.
* Exposure to AI-assisted analytics and reporting tools.
* Experience preparing executive presentations and management-level performance reports.
* Strong project management skills and experience coordinating cross-functional digital initiatives.
* Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a cross-functional team.

* Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and committed to data accuracy.
* Able to transform complex datasets into clear business insights and practical recommendations.

* Confident communicating analytical findings to senior leaders and non-technical stakeholders.
* Proactive in identifying opportunities for reporting automation and process digitalization.
* Capable of managing multiple priorities and projects with limited supervision.
* Curious about emerging digital technologies and committed to continuous improvement.

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
The Fulfilment tech family is one of the most important pillars ensuring Grab to out-serve our customers and partners in different businesses and marketplaces across Southeast Asia. We are working on high throughput, real-time distributed systems that use machine learning techniques to solve hundreds of millions of requests per day.
  
  
Our mission is to offer the best products and experiences to our driver partners as to increase adoption and engagement of our services. Improve driver partner opportunities and efficiency to fulfil customer orders without fail, rain or shine. And to create efficient marketplaces by determining a price that is both sustainable and loved by our partners and customers.
  
  
Our team members are in Indonesia and Singapore.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
We are seeking experienced and passionate Software Engineers to join our team. You will have opportunities to lead a small team of software engineers to work on multiple backend service clusters. It is very important that our team members to initiatively identify problems and have the right mindset and skills to solve them.
  
  
You will be reporting to Software Engineering Manager II, Backend and the role will be base onsite in our South Jakarta, Jakarta, Indonesia office.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Develop and maintain backend services and APIs with a focus on reliability and scalability.
* Write efficient database queries (e.g., MySQL, Presto) and optimize system performance through profiling and troubleshooting.
* Contribute to projects on cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and support deployments via CI/CD pipelines.
* Implement and maintain automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end) to ensure code quality.
* Gain exposure to distributed computing frameworks such as Apache Flink, while building services in Golang and Scala.
* Collaborate with senior engineers and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality technical solutions.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* More than 4 years of experience in backend development.
* Familiarity with large-scale distributed web or API services, including systems internals and networking.
* Hands-on experience with databases and query languages such as MySQL or Presto.
* Strong understanding of system performance, with ability to profile and resolve bottlenecks.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), testing frameworks (unit, integration, E2E), and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands-on experience using any language and willing to work on Golang and Scala (Flink)

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: AI Engineering / Consultant / Senior Specialist (Based in Indonesia)
description:
**About Us**

ABeam Consulting is a global professional services company that specializes in delivering business transformation and technology solutions to clients across a wide range of industries. With a global presence and over 9000 employees worldwide we aim to be the transformation partner of choice for all of our clients.

**AI Engineering Senior Consultant**

**Locations: Indonesia**

* Work with Sales to discover, identify, assess, prioritize, promote and drive realization of potential customer AI and Agentic AI use cases into actual projects.
* Understand business processes, pain points, data availability, and system constraints, and translate them into appropriate AI solution designs.
* Design, develop, test, and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications and AI agents.
* Develop AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and all relevant agentic AI frameworks.
* Design and implement single-agent and multi-agent workflows, including agent communication, task delegation, decision logic, memory, and tool orchestration.
* Develop orchestration workflows using technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, and similar agent frameworks.
* Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, databases, APIs, document repositories, and external tools.
* Design and develop robust backend services and APIs using Python and frameworks such as FastAPI.
* Design and implement RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, chunking, embedding, retrieval, hybrid search, reranking, prompt construction, and response generation.
* Build reusable AI components, agent tools, APIs, connectors, and services to accelerate future AI implementations.
* Develop demos, POCs and proposals rapidly and work with Sales and customers to validate business feasibility, technical feasibility, and expected value.
* Industrialize successful POCs into scalable and maintainable production solutions.
* Implement appropriate security, access control, guardrails, governance, observability, and monitoring for enterprise AI applications.
* Define evaluation frameworks and success metrics to assess AI agent performance, including response quality, accuracy, reliability, latency, token consumption, and business outcomes.
* Establish feedback loops and continuously improve AI agent performance based on evaluation results and user feedback.
* Troubleshoot and optimize AI applications, including prompts, retrieval quality, agent workflows, model selection, and system performance.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, security, application, data, and architecture teams to support successful enterprise deployment.
* Communicate AI concepts, solution architecture, limitations, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive deal closure, positive decision, etc.
* Prepare solution documentation, architecture designs, implementation plans, technical specifications, test scenarios, and operational documentation.
* Provide knowledge transfer and technical guidance to client teams to support sustainable adoption of AI solutions.

**Key Requirements**

* 5 or more years of relevant hands-on presales, design, solutioning and implementation experience in Software Development, AI Engineering, Generative AI, or Agentic AI development.
* Practical experience designing and implementing solutions using LLMs.
* Strong understanding of RAG architecture, including retrieval strategies, embeddings, vector search, hybrid search, reranking, and prompt engineering.
* Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent agent orchestration frameworks.
* Experience designing multi-agent workflows and tool-calling/orchestration architectures.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Strong experience developing APIs, backend services, and integrations with enterprise applications.
* Experience developing AI solutions from POC through production deployment.
* Experience integrating AI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources.
* Understanding of AI application architecture, security, governance, access controls, guardrails, observability, and monitoring.
* Experience defining LLM/agent evaluation methodologies and performance metrics.
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and managed AI services, preferably Azure / Azure OpenAI.
* Experience and knowledge in Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio are mandatory; experience with Microsoft Foundry and Google Antigravity and Google Vertex AI are good to have.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and deliver solutions in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and consulting skills.
* Ability to work directly with business users to convert business requirements into practical AI solutions.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agent tool integration.
* Experience with self-hosted or open-source LLM deployment.
* Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks such as DeepEval or equivalent.
* Experience with model fine-tuning, including SFT or other post-training techniques.
* Experience working with enterprise document-processing, OCR, knowledge-management, or search solutions.
* Familiarity with Azure, AWS, containerization, and enterprise deployment architectures.
* Experience working in consulting, banking, financial services, or other highly regulated enterprise environments.

**Other Requirements**

* Ability to work well within a multi-disciplinary team structure, but also independently.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills across both rule-based and AI-driven scenarios.
* Meet agreed deadlines, with demonstrable Productivity.
* Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work in culturally diverse and inclusive environments.
* Flexibility in scheduling with willingness to work extra non-standard hours if required.
* Initiate, proactive and willingness to self-learn existing and new technology.
* Willing and able to travel 50% or more (domestic, regional and international).

**Education Requirements**

* Degree in in Computer Science or related discipline.
* Written and spoken fluency in English with business proficiency in Mandarin and/or Bahasa mandatory.

**Why Join Us**

At ABeam Consulting, we place a strong emphasis on collaboration, and helping our employees grow and develop their skills, offering a supportive and empowering work environment. With a presence in multiple countries and a diverse range of clients, ABeam Consulting offers an exciting and dynamic workplace for individuals looking to build a career in consulting. ABeam Consulting has also recently joined SAP’s regional strategic partner initiative as their first regional partner in the region and has also been recognized by UiPath as a Diamond Partner in providing RPA solutions. With such accolades, we aim to continue driving enterprise and digital transformation initiatives in order to transform the way people work and communicate in the digital age. In addition, our industry team is working tirelessly in order to bring more solutions to the banking and finance sector.

title: ML Ops Engineers
description:
Role Overview
  
  
As a Senior AI/MLOps Engineer specializing in ML Pipeline & Platform Engineering, you will play a pivotal role in scaling Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison's AI and data intelligence capabilities across our digital ecosystem. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end design, automation, and operational management of high-throughput machine learning pipelines and cloud platform environments on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). You will empower data scientists and AI engineers by building robust CI/CD deployment automation, optimizing high-scale BigQuery workflows, enforcing zero-trust platform security guardrails, and supporting emerging Agentic AI platform integrations to accelerate Indonesia's digital transformation.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Architect and Operate ML Pipelines: Design, build, compile, and maintain enterprise-grade Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) and Vertex AI Pipelines for automated training, evaluation, continuous batch inference, and automated retraining.
* Optimize High-Scale Data Workflows: Engineer and optimize large-scale BigQuery data extraction, partitioned and clustered dataset transformations, and automated data pipelines handling multi-million row operational datasets.
* Drive Platform Provisioning & Governance: Review Architectural Requirement Specifications (ARS) and execute infrastructure provisioning across GCP services (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Spanner, Cloud Storage, and GKE).
* Enforce Platform Security & Guardrails: Implement least-privileged Identity & Access Management (IAM), per-pipeline service account bindings, and VPC Service Controls (VPC-SC) perimeters to prevent unauthorized data access and egress leaks.
* Champion Blast Radius Governance: Conduct comprehensive pre-deployment verification checklists for IAM policies, dependencies, and external partner integrations to guarantee zero service disruption.
* Standardize CI/CD Automation: Build and maintain reusable GitLab CI/CD runner pipelines for pipeline compilation, automated testing, container image packaging, and progressive environment promotion.
* Secure AI Tooling & Developer Harnesses: Establish security guardrails and governance policies for internal AI tooling, CLI assistants, and IDE developer harnesses, ensuring secret isolation, token sanitization, and auditability.
* Support Emerging Agentic AI Integrations: Enable operational runtime configurations and backend service connectivity for Agentic AI frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and conversational agent deployments.
* Lead Technical Problem Resolution: Troubleshoot complex container dependency builds, private package repository configurations (Google Artifact Registry), and runtime environment discrepancies across Workbench and Cloud Build runners.
* Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Data Governance, Cloud Operations, Enterprise Security, and external technology partners to ensure platform compliance, high availability, and rapid time-to-market.

Qualification
  
  
**Professional Experience & Technical Qualifications**
  
  

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Experience: Minimum 5+ years of total experience in software, data, or ML engineering, with at least 3+ years of dedicated hands-on experience in MLOps, DataOps, or DevOps within enterprise production environments.
* Cloud & Big Data Mastery:

+ Deep operational expertise with Google Cloud Platform, specifically Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, IAM, and VPC Service Controls.
+ Strong experience in BigQuery performance tuning, partitioning, clustering, and stored procedures.

* ML Pipeline & Orchestration:

+ Proven track record of designing, building, compiling, and monitoring production Kubeflow Pipelines (KFP) or Vertex AI Pipelines.
+ Deep familiarity with model registry workflows, artifact versioning, and lifecycle management.

* Programming & Automation:

+ Expert-level proficiency in Python, including object-oriented programming, packaging, data structures, and cloud SDK integrations.
+ Strong foundation in Linux environments and shell scripting.

* DevOps & CI/CD Tooling:

+ Hands-on expertise building enterprise CI/CD workflows using GitLab CI/CD, Docker containerization, Helm, and GitOps methodologies.
+ Experience managing private package repositories using Google Artifact Registry.

* Security & Governance Acumen:

+ Practical experience securing day-to-day engineering AI harnesses, managing service account tokens, and implementing Data Loss Prevention (DLP) best practices.

* Certifications:

+ Google Cloud Certified Professional Machine Learning Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
+ Google Cloud Certified Professional Data Engineer (Preferred / Nice to have).
+ Google Cloud Certified Professional Cloud Architect (Preferred / Nice to have).

* Value-Add / Bonus Qualifications:

+ Experience with Agentic AI engineering frameworks (Google ADK, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, or MCP servers).
+ Familiarity with RAG evaluation frameworks (such as Ragas or DeepEval) and vector databases.
+ Exposure to Cloud Spanner, Redis/Memorystore, or GraphDB integrations.

Behavioral Competencies
  
  

* Problem-Solving Agility: Exceptional analytical and diagnostic skills with the ability to resolve complex infrastructure, pipeline, and security challenges under fast-paced operational conditions.
* Proactive Ownership Mindset: High sense of accountability, initiative, and drive to transform operational lessons into scalable, automated standards.
* Collaborative Communication: Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary squads, data science teams, and vendor partners.
* Continuous Learning & Adaptability: Eagerness to stay ahead of the curve in emerging MLOps practices, GenAI platform engineering, and modern cloud technologies.
