title: Supplier Quality System Engineer
description:
Overview:

For over 35 years, OSI Electronics has provided manufacturing solutions of the highest quality, reliability, and customer support. We specialize in customized manufacturing solutions with the portfolio of services, capabilities, and factory locations needed to provide our customers with a competitive advantage in the global marketplace. OSI Electronics offers turnkey solutions for the full range of assembly complexity. We partner with customers on product development, new product introduction, mass production, sustaining engineering and product lifecycle management. Our cutting edge technology, manufacturing proficiency and responsive technical services deliver the Tier One capabilities customers require.

OSI Electronics is seeking a Supplier Quality Systems Engineer to join the team. This individual will be responsible for providing supplier quality system administration, documentation control, and supplier quality process support across multiple manufacturing sites. They will ensure supplier quality records, qualification files, audit records, quality agreements, approved supplier lists, scorecards, corrective actions, and supplier performance documentation are maintained in accordance with company, customer, regulatory, and quality management system requirements. Additionally, they will serve as a centralized supplier quality resource supporting site quality teams, procurement, engineering, operations, and regulatory affairs by managing supplier quality documentation and driving consistency across all facilities. They will support supplier onboarding, performance monitoring, audit administration, and cross-site quality system standardization.

Responsibilities:

* Manage supplier qualification files and records for all company locations.
* Manage supplier quality documentation within the D365 ERP system.
* Maintain quality agreements, certifications, audit reports, and supplier qualification records.
* Ensure supplier records remain up-to-date and compliant with internal procedures and customer requirements.
* Coordinate periodic reviews of supplier documentation.
* Archive and store supplier records in accordance with company retention policies.
* Support the Approved Supplier List (ASL) for various locations.
* Coordinate supplier approval, conditional approval, suspension, and disqualification activities.
* Update supplier approval status based on audit results, performance reviews, and management decisions.
* Compile supplier approval reports for site and corporate management.
* Verify that supplier certifications and regulatory registrations remain valid (current).
* Coordinate supplier onboarding and qualification activities.
* Manage supplier surveys, risk assessments, capability assessments, and qualification packages.
* Monitor qualification progress and obtain necessary approvals.
* Support periodic supplier re-qualification and re-evaluation activities.
* Ensure qualification documentation is complete prior to granting supplier approval.
* Manage supplier quality scorecards and KPI dashboards.
* Collect quality and delivery performance data from various locations.
* Prepare monthly and quarterly supplier performance reports.
* Support supplier review meetings by providing performance metrics and data analysis.
* Monitor supplier quality trends and escalation activities.
* Support the implementation of standardized supplier quality processes across locations.
* Manage standardized templates, forms, procedures, and work instructions.
* Coordinate supplier quality documentation harmonization projects.
* Assist the site during internal, customer, and certification audits.
* Support the "One Company, One Quality System" approach to supplier management.
* Ensure supplier quality records support compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100, ISO 13485, and IATF 16949 standards.
* Support audit preparation and requests for supplier documentation.
* Uphold the company's core values: Integrity, Innovation, Accountability, and Teamwork.
* Demonstrate behavior aligned with the company's Code of Ethics and Conduct.
* It is the responsibility of every employee to report to their manager or a member of senior management any quality problems or defects in order for corrective action to be implemented and to avoid recurrence of the problem.
* Every employee is responsible for reporting any quality issues or defects to a manager or senior management member so that corrective actions can be implemented and the issues prevented from recurring.
* Duties may be modified or assigned at any time to meet the needs of the business.

Qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing Technology, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management or related field required.
* Must have at least three (3) years of experience in supplier quality, quality systems, document control, quality assurance administration, and regulatory compliance support.
* Experience working within a multi-site manufacturing environment desired.
* Experience in electronics manufacturing services (EMS) or a related electronics manufacturing environment desired.
* Ability to support supplier quality, quality systems, or compliance activities in aerospace, medical device, defense, or other regulated industries, is a plus.
* Knowledge of document control management, including maintaining controlled records, procedures, templates, and compliance documentation required.
* Experience with supplier qualification processes, including supplier onboarding, risk assessments, capability reviews, approvals, and periodic reevaluations needed.
* Must have experience administering supplier audits, including audit scheduling, documentation requests, audit records, corrective action follow-up, and status tracking.
* Experience managing supplier scorecards, supplier performance metrics, KPI reporting, and related performance review documentation is required.
* Must have ability to collect, analyze, and report quality data and key performance indicators to support supplier performance monitoring and continuous improvement.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook are essential.
* Experience using ERP and electronic quality management systems (eQMS) to maintain supplier quality records, documentation, workflows, and reporting needed.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule to support teams across the UK, US, and Mexico locations.
* Must be able to read, write, and communicate effectively in the business language (English).

title: Resident Engineer
description:
**Role Summary:**
-----------------

The Resident Incident Engineer is responsible for maintaining the availability,

performance, resilience, and operational readiness of DDN storage infrastructure

deployed within a customer / NVIDIA Cloud Partner (NCP) environment.

The role will initially support a mid-tier NCP deployment that is expected to grow into

one of the largest storage environments in the region. The engineer will act as a trusted

on-site technical resource, working closely with the customer’s infrastructure, platform,

Kubernetes, networking, security, and operations teams.

The role requires hands-on expertise across DDN storage platforms, EXAScaler/Lustre,

Linux, high-speed networking, data-centre infrastructure, Kubernetes, and the

Container Storage Interface (CSI). The engineer will provide proactive operational

support, incident response, problem management, capacity planning, performance

optimization, and technical coordination with DDN Support and Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Provide on-site operational ownership for DDN storage systems and associated

EXAScaler/Lustre environments.

* Monitor storage health, availability, capacity, performance, alerts, and system

trends.

* Respond to incidents, service requests, and operational events in accordance

with agreed severity and response targets.

* Lead technical triage, fault isolation, recovery, and root-cause analysis for

storage, file-system, Linux, networking, and integration issues.

* Coordinate with customer operations teams, DDN Support, Engineering,

hardware vendors, and other stakeholders during major incidents.

* Maintain and troubleshoot EXAScaler/Lustre file systems, metadata services,

storage targets, client connectivity, failover, and recovery procedures.

* Support Kubernetes environments that consume DDN storage, including cluster

integration, persistent volumes, storage classes, access modes, and workloadlevel storage troubleshooting.

* Configure, validate, and troubleshoot CSI drivers and related Kubernetes storage

components

Investigate issues across the Kubernetes-to-storage path, including pods, nodes,

kubelet, CSI controller and node plugins, APIs, mounts, permissions,

networking, and backend storage.

* Support NFS, parallel file-system, block, and other storage access protocols

where applicable.

* Perform planned maintenance, upgrades, expansions, migrations, hardware

replacements, and configuration changes using approved change-management

processes.

* Develop and maintain operational runbooks, standard operating procedures,

recovery procedures, escalation guides, and troubleshooting documentation.

* Conduct regular health checks, capacity reviews, performance assessments,

and operational-readiness reviews.

* Identify risks, recurring failure patterns, single points of failure, and opportunities

to improve reliability and automation.

* Validate backup, restore, replication, disaster-recovery, and business-continuity

procedures where applicable.

* Support capacity forecasting for storage, metadata, network, client, and datagrowth requirements.
* Assist with performance benchmarking, workload analysis, tuning, and servicelevel reporting.
* Maintain accurate configuration management, asset records, incident records,

problem records, and installed-base information.

* Participate in on-call, out-of-hours, or escalation coverage as required by the

customer environment.

* Provide technical briefings, knowledge transfer, and operational training to

customer teams.

* Contribute to implementation schedules, risk and mitigation plans, acceptance

testing, handover, and customer sign-off.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering,

Information Technology, or a related discipline.

* At least 5 years of experience in infrastructure engineering, storage

administration, systems administration, data-centre operations, or a related

field.

* Hands-on experience supporting enterprise storage, HPC, AI, cloud, or highperformance computing environments.
* Strong Linux systems administration and troubleshooting skills.

* Problem-solving attitude

title: Account Executive, New Business
description:
**Our company**

Teradata’s Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge, AI, and business context to deliver measurable outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can give AI agents the trusted enterprise context they need to act with confidence when it matters most. Our platform enables businesses to connect, scale, and innovate across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments — turning AI ambition into real business value.

**The role**

Teradata is building the APJ Growth Engine — a focused new business team with a clear mandate: acquire new enterprise customers and build a repeatable, outcome-driven go-to-market motion across Asia Pacific and Japan.

As a New Logo Account Executive, you will own the full sales cycle — from first engagement through close and early workload activation. This is not a farming role. It is a true hunting role for sellers who thrive in new territories, move with urgency, and win complex enterprise deals by leading with business outcomes.

You will be one of the founding members of this team. What you build here will help shape how Teradata sells, scales, and wins across APJ and beyond.

**What you will do**

* Build, own, and manage your pipeline across targeted enterprise accounts in your territory
* Lead the full sales cycle — prospecting, discovery, value framing, technical demonstration, commercial negotiation, and close
* Qualify and advance opportunities with a clear focus on business outcomes, consumption fit, and long-term customer value — not deal size alone
* Drive early workload activation after close to build momentum for retention, adoption, and expansion
* Partner with Solution Architects to deliver compelling, technically credible demonstrations that bring customer outcomes to life
* Contribute to the APJ Growth Engine playbook by capturing what works and helping turn successful motions into repeatable scale

**What success looks like**

* New logo acquisition within your targeted territory
* Fast and effective workload activation after close
* High-quality deals with outcome-aligned, consumption-ready customers
* Healthy pipeline coverage, disciplined stage progression, and accurate forecasting
* Meaningful contribution to a scalable, repeatable go-to-market playbook

**Who you will work with**

You will be part of a dedicated New Logo team with direct access to Customer Solution Architects, Sales Leadership, and Sales Operations. The team has executive sponsorship and represents a strategic investment for Teradata — giving you strong visibility, support, and the backing needed to win at the highest level.

**What we are looking for**

**Experience:**

* Proven track record in B2B software, data, cloud, or analytics sales, with a strong preference for new logo hunters
* Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles involving technical and business buyers
* Confidence in running pilots, proof-of-concepts, and technical demonstrations that translate platform capability into customer value
* Exposure to early-stage go-to-market motions or greenfield territory development is a strong advantage
* Direct experience working in the Indonesia market with Enterprise and Mid-Market customers and local system integration partners

**Capabilities:**

* Independent pipeline generation — you create demand and do not wait for inbound opportunities
* Strong discovery skills, with the ability to connect customer pain points to technical outcomes and measurable business value
* Commercial discipline — you qualify rigorously, close with precision, and protect deal quality
* Technical fluency in data and AI, with the credibility to engage technical stakeholders and confidently lead a demonstration
* Adaptability — you operate effectively in ambiguity, build as you go, and move quickly with purpose
* Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English

**Mindset:**

* Hunter mentality — hungry, persistent, proactive, and energised by creating new business
* Outcome-led seller — you lead with business value and customer impact, not product features alone
* Builder mindset — you want to be part of something being created, not simply execute an established playbook

**Why this role**

This is a rare opportunity to join a high-visibility team at a pivotal moment in Teradata’s go-to-market evolution. You will work with a focused, differentiated offering that enterprise and mid-market customers across financial services, manufacturing, retail, and the public sector are actively looking to solve for. You will have executive air cover, a collaborative team around you, and the autonomy to build, shape, and own your territory.

If you are a seller who wants to be known for what you built — not just what you inherited — this is the role.

**Why Teradata**

We foster a people-first culture built on trust, flexibility, and well-being, enabling our people to perform at their best both personally and professionally. We are deeply committed to inclusion and belonging, and we believe diverse perspectives create stronger products, stronger teams, and better outcomes for our customers.

Teradata is proud to have earned an Equality 100 score on the Human Rights Campaign Foundation’s 2025 Corporate Equality Index.

description:
We are seeking an Associate Product Manager (APM) who is eager to take on new challenges in product management, particularly in managing third-party data and working with external vendors. This role requires a combination of analytical thinking, technical knowledge, and strong collaboration and communication skills to work effectively with both internal teams and external partners.

* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with internal teams (Engineering, Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers) and external teams to communicate product requirements and ensure alignment on goals, timelines, and deliverables across all stakeholders.

* Data Analysis: Define and monitor key metrics to evaluate product performance and identify areas for improvement.

**Must-Have**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent, preferably in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in product management or project management.
* Strong analytical skills; experience with data analysis; SQL & Python is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
* Proficient in English, both written and verbal.

  

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in fintech, SaaS, startups, or the financial industry.
* Cloud/microservices understanding
* AI/ML product experiences
* Involvement in application or system development projects.

title: Regional Data & Analytics Capability Manager
description:
At JTI we celebrate differences, and everyone truly belongs. **46,000 people from all over the world** are continuously building their unique success story with us. **83% of employees feel happy** working at JTI.

  

To make a difference with us, all you need to do is bring your **human best.**

  

What will your story be? Apply now!

**Learn more:** **jti.com**

**Location:** Taguig / Philippines(Primary), Open to Taiwan, and Indonesia
  
**Reporting to:** Regional IT Director, South Asia
  
**Role:** Permanent

  

**Regional Data & Analytics Capability Manager**

  

The Regional Data & Analytics Capability Manager leads the regional Data & Analytics capability, translating market and regional business priorities into trusted, reusable data products and measurable business outcomes. The role drives the regional D&A roadmap, oversees the D&A portfolio and distributed team, strengthens data governance and analytics adoption, and builds the foundations required for advanced analytics and AI.
  
  
**As the Regional Data & Analytics Capability Manager, you will:**

* Translate enterprise D&A strategy and market priorities into a regional capability roadmap, balancing business value, funding, capacity, sequencing, and dependencies.
* Lead the delivery and lifecycle management of regional data products, datasets, semantic models, and analytics assets, promoting reusable solutions and governed self-service analytics.
* Drive data governance, quality, and AI readiness by establishing clear data definitions, quality controls, ownership, metadata, lineage, and access requirements with business and technology stakeholders.
* Oversee the regional D&A portfolio, service reliability, operational commitments, vendors, budgets, and resources while coordinating dependencies with Market IT, SSD, Global D&A, and other capability teams.
* Partner with Market/Cluster D&IT Leads, regional functions, and business data owners to shape demand, prioritize initiatives, drive adoption, and track measurable business benefits.
* Lead and develop the regional D&A team, strengthening data and analytics capabilities, knowledge transfer, sustainable resource coverage, and a strong regional data practitioner community.

  

**Requirements:**

* University degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data & Analytics, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 8+ years of relevant experience in Data & Analytics, BI, data management, or enterprise IT, including 5+ years leading teams, capabilities, or complex cross-functional delivery.
* Proven experience translating business priorities into data roadmaps and delivering data and analytics products across multiple markets or functions.
* Strong knowledge of data architecture, DWH/Data Lake, ETL/ELT, semantic modelling, BI and self-service analytics, data governance, and data quality principles.
* Experience in portfolio and project delivery, service operations, vendor governance, financial and capacity management, and enabling data readiness for advanced analytics and AI.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills within a complex matrix organization, with fluent written and spoken English.

  

Are you ready to join us? Build your success story at JTI. Apply now!

Next Steps:

  

After applying, if selected, please anticipate the following within 1-3 weeks of the job posting closure: Phone screening with Talent Advisor > Assessment tests > Interviews > Offer. Each step is eliminatory and may vary by role type.

  

At JTI, we strive to create a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal-opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If you need any specific support, alternative formats, or have other access requirements, please let us know.

title: Manufacture Engineer
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Manufacture Engineer**

**Location:** Batam, Riau Islands, Indonesia  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Company:** Schneider Electric

We are looking for a hands-on and improvement-driven **Manufacture Engineer** to optimize manufacturing processes, workstations, production capacity, and industrial performance within our Batam manufacturing operations.

In this role, you will serve as a key specialist in **time determination and ergonomics**, while leading productivity initiatives across your assigned manufacturing perimeter. You will analyze production methods, improve manual and automated processes, support new line development, and ensure manufacturing capacity is aligned with business requirements.

Working closely with Production, Industrialization, Engineering, Quality, and other cross-functional stakeholders, you will help create safer, more efficient, and more robust manufacturing processes.

**What will you do?**

**Manufacturing Methods & Process Optimization**

* Determine the standard time required to manufacture products using appropriate time-analysis methodologies.
* Analyze and improve production methods, manufacturing processes, and workstation design.
* Implement process and workstation improvements for existing products to enhance safety, quality, productivity, and operational performance.
* Optimize manual, automated, and PLC-controlled manufacturing processes.
* Develop clear and standardized work instructions to support operator training and consistent process execution.
* Act as the **Time Determination and Ergonomics Specialist** within the assigned manufacturing perimeter.

**Productivity & Continuous Improvement**

* Define, implement, and monitor productivity action plans within the assigned area.
* Lead or contribute to continuous improvement projects focused on manufacturing performance, cost, quality, and lead-time improvement.
* Deploy Schneider Production System principles and apply Lean Manufacturing and Six Sigma tools.
* Participate in operational performance meetings and drive actions to remove production barriers quickly.
* Identify process inefficiencies and translate findings into practical, measurable improvement plans.

**Capacity & Industrial Performance Management**

* Analyze and manage production capacity against workload requirements for internal and external manufacturing lines.
* Use capacity and simulation tools such as **iQ Simulation, CAMA, CORIM, and Bridge** to support production planning and industrial decisions.
* Identify capacity constraints and implement solutions to optimize line utilization.
* Reduce manufacturing lead times while ensuring sufficient production capacity.
* Support performance analysis related to process design, ergonomics, investment, cost, and operational efficiency.

**Industrialization & New Product Introduction**

* Support the development of new products by evaluating manufacturability, producibility, and process feasibility.
* Participate in the specification and quotation of new production-line architectures and industrial scenarios.
* Ensure proposed manufacturing solutions meet safety, quality, lead-time, capacity, and productivity requirements.
* Lead or support new production ramp-up activities and ensure stable transition into regular manufacturing.
* Collaborate with project teams to deliver manufacturing and industrialization projects successfully.

**Equipment, Process Qualification & Investment**

* Evaluate the feasibility and profitability of manufacturing investments.
* Support the selection, specification, and implementation of manufacturing equipment and production solutions.
* Qualify manufacturing equipment, processes, and production methods at the plant and supplier locations.
* Ensure new or modified manufacturing processes are ready for safe, reliable, and efficient production.
* Monitor implemented solutions to confirm that expected improvements and business results are achieved.

**PCBA Manufacturing Support**

* Support process improvement across front-end and back-end **PCBA manufacturing operations**.
* Analyze manufacturing challenges and recommend appropriate technical solutions.
* Improve process flow, workstation arrangement, capacity, and production performance.
* Work with production and engineering teams to resolve operational issues and maintain stable manufacturing output.
* Support the implementation of automation and PLC-based process improvements where applicable.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

  

* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in **Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Manufacturing Engineering**, or an equivalent discipline.
* Approximately **2 to 5 years of experience** in process engineering, manufacturing engineering, manufacturing planning, or a related industrial role.
* Practical understanding of manufacturing processes, time determination, ergonomics, capacity analysis, and productivity improvement.
* Experience with front-end and back-end **PCBA manufacturing processes**.
* Experience improving manual, automated, or PLC-controlled production processes.
* Ability to lead project teams, execute improvement plans, and deliver measurable results.
* Good written and spoken English.
* Willingness to work on-site in Batam.

**Preferred Skills**

* Proficiency in **AutoCAD, LADM, MTM, SAP, and Microsoft Office applications**.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and structured continuous improvement methodologies.
* Experience with manufacturing capacity analysis and simulation tools.
* Understanding of workstation design, ergonomics, standard time calculation, and industrial cost analysis.
* Experience supporting production-line setup, equipment qualification, or new product ramp-up.
* Strong analytical, project management, and structured problem-solving capabilities.
* Customer-focused and quality-oriented approach to manufacturing improvement.

**What We're Looking For**

The ideal candidate is:

* Passionate about improving manufacturing methods and industrial performance.
* Comfortable working directly on the production floor and engaging with operators, technicians, and engineering teams.
* Able to combine technical analysis with practical, sustainable manufacturing solutions.
* Strong in time studies, ergonomics, capacity management, and workstation optimization.
* Proactive in identifying productivity opportunities and resolving process constraints.
* Capable of leading cross-functional improvement projects from analysis through implementation.
* Detail-oriented, safety-conscious, and committed to quality.
* Comfortable working in a dynamic PCBA and electronics manufacturing environment.

**What’s in it for me?**

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Local Benefits (English):

**Rewards designed for you**

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

**Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
First Circle is an SME-focused, credit-centric, and multi-product NeoBank in SE Asia which is fast-growing (>100%), profitable, and internationalising soon.

We started life as an SME lender in the Philippines in 2016 to solve the SME credit gap by using technology to systemise underwriting, deliver exceptional UX, and automate away delivery costs. We’ve delivered our clients the fastest, cheapest, most flexible credit line available to businesses anywhere in Southeast Asia. We’ve been rewarded with both fast growth and exceptional unit economics, a rare combination in our space.

Over the past two years we’ve expanded our product range to include business bank accounts & payments, e-Invoices, corporate credit cards, rooftop solar, and most recently deposits catalysed by securing a full bank charter in the Philippines. In 2027, we’ll expand our geographical coverage to include at least two new markets in APAC.

Our excellent track record results from our people & culture. We combine high standards & intensity with a collegiate environment. Our barometers of success are the rate of personal growth of our people, how long high performers choose to stay, and ensuring we we raise the bar with every hire.

We are now hiring senior developers to drive meaningful impact during our most ambitious year of growth to date.

Building in developing markets like the Philippines presents unique challenges, given the state of digital infrastructure. We are building virtually everything in-house, which is not easy, but its a lot of fun. We have a track record of solving seemingly impossible problems that defeated many other start-ups, and the opportunity ahead remains enormous.

**What you'll do**

* Build and evolve backend services and APIs that are fast, reliable, and easy to change.
* Take features from first idea to production: shape the approach with product and design, ship it, measure what happens, and improve it.
* Help make architectural decisions, write clear technical proposals, and balance speed with solutions that will hold up over time.
* Keep your services running smoothly by setting up clear ways to spot issues early, respond quickly, and support users when something goes wrong.
* Review code, share what you know, and help other engineers grow.
* Work across product, design, and business to turn real needs into practical technical solutions—and explain the trade-offs clearly.

 **Requirements**  

* 5+ years of experience building and operating production backend systems in Kotlin, Java, or Ruby.

* Strong foundations in API design, relational databases, and data modeling, with a clear sense of how to keep data consistent as systems scale.
* Experience in a startup environment, fintech, payroll, payments, or banking is a strong plus (especially if you’ve shipped products in regulated environments).
* Hands-on experience running services in production: debugging effectively, investigating incidents, and making systems more resilient afterwards.
* Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve.
* Curiosity about AI and practical experience using it, whether you're building LLM-powered features or using AI tools to work more effectively day to day.

  
**Benefits**  

* No fixed budget, we hire globally and adjust offers based on experience and market rate.

* Primarily remote, with the option to work from our office. We have offices in London, Hong Kong, Singapore & Belgrade where other senior engineers are based.
* Macbooks, private health insurance, training budgets and more!
* Opportunity to travel to South East Asia.

**Disclaimer: all information provided in this advertisement is subject to our** terms and conditions.

title: Data Engineer
description:
**Location:** Remote, with onsite days in Bali once a month (and occasionally when needed)

**Job type:** Full-time

**About Us**

HeyRCG is a Bali-based, full-service marketing and performance agency. We help brands across hospitality, F&B, ecommerce and D2C grow through Meta, Google, social media, email marketing, creative production and web development. Data sits at the centre of how we work, from campaign reporting and client dashboards to the AI-powered tools we’re building for our team and clients.

**About the role**

You'll build the data foundations behind our reporting, analytics and AI-powered products, covering pipelines, data quality, governance and AI-ready data models. You'll work closely with international stakeholders and global clients, turning their business needs into reliable data solutions.

**What you'll do**

* Build and maintain ELT pipelines using modular, metadata-driven practices
* Set up and enforce data quality checks, monitoring and governance standards
* Design semantic data models and prepare data so it's ready for AI use cases
* Work with global clients and cross-functional teams to deliver AI-powered solutions and workflows

**What you'll need**

* 3–5 years' experience in data engineering or a similar role
* Strong SQL and Python skills
* Comfortable with Git and modern data workflows
* Hands-on exposure to GenAI tools, such as LLM-based apps, agentic workflows or MCP
* Clear written and spoken English

**Nice to have**

* Experience with Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or similar data platforms
* Orchestration tools such as Airflow or Dagster
* Docker, Terraform and GitHub Actions
* API integrations
* dbt and data modelling best practices

**Why join us?**

If you enjoy fast-moving environments, like solving tricky data problems and want to build AI-ready data products at scale, we'd love to hear from you!

**How to apply**

Apply here: https://forms.gle/1bWzeXbmzCGnPRSX7

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

* Bali (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Bali

title: Software Engineer
description:
**Why Join:**

You'll have the opportunity to work on diverse projects and collaborate with team members from different backgrounds, making a real impact in the industry.

**How You Succeed:**

Designing and delivering secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions that directly enhance customer experiences and drive digital innovation. This involves collaborating cross-functionally within an Agile environment to modernize banking systems while adhering to strict security and reliability standards. Ultimately, your impact is measured by your ability to translate technical excellence into tangible business value and operational efficiency.

**What You Do:**

* Bring your coding expertise to life by developing program code based on Functional Specification Design.
* Embrace the agile software development process, participating in all aspects from design to implementation, testing, and deployment.
* Showcase your architectural skills by providing guidance on building end-to-end systems optimized for speed and scalability.
* Contribute your technical input and analysis during the gathering stage, including making development time estimates that adhere to predetermined limits.
* Ensure the quality of our programs by conducting internal tests with programmers, promoting error-free programs to UAT (User Acceptance Testing).
* Communicate effectively by reporting any issues or delays in the development process to the Project Manager and/or Line of Business Manager.
* Create comprehensive system documentation to support the project's success.

**Who You Are:**

* Demonstrate a minimum of 5 years of experience in software development.
* Have minimum Bachelor’s Degree of Informatics/IT or similar field
* Have experience using Java Spring Boot, Golang (for Back End Developer)
* Have experience using React Js (for Front End Developer)
* Have experience using Kotlin or Swift (for Mobile Developer)
* Fluent in English both verbal and written
* Willing to work onsite in BSD City, Tangerang (OCBC Space)

**You’ll be Part of:**

Group Operations and Technology co-creates products and solutions. We build the underlying technology applications and services. And manage the Group’s IT operations & cyber defense. 24/7. 365. End-to-end transaction fulfillment services. For the whole Group. With singular focus. Delivering exceptional customer experience. At the forefront of our digital transformation journey. Relentless innovation. Pushing boundaries. And it’s all powered by serious investment in your development.

**About OCBC:**

At PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk (OCBC), we don’t just serve customers, but we walk alongside them being a trusted partner to enrich the quality of their lives. Since 1941, we have been committed to helping individuals and businesses navigate their financial journey with solutions that grow alongside their evolving needs.

By combining deeply rooted Indonesian values with the comprehensive global capability of the OCBC Group, we offer meaningful, relevant financial services, from daily banking to long-term planning, all delivered with care, understanding, and responsibility.

We are always looking for bright, driven individuals who are curious, collaborative, and eager to grow. At OCBC, you will find a workplace that respects your journey, supports your development, and gives you space to contribute meaningfully–because your Opportunity Starts Here!

**What We Offer:**

OCBC offers a competitive compensation & benefit, including a comprehensive suite of flexible benefits that fit your lifestyle and livelihood, community engagement programs, industry-leading learning, and professional development opportunities in the banking sector. We genuinely care about your well-being, growth, and aspirations−just as much as we care about our customers' needs. By joining our team, you will not only thrive personally and professionally but also contribute to become a Trusted Partner to Improve Quality of Life.

title: Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer
description:
UltaHost is looking for a Senior Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer to take ownership of internal security and help strengthen the protection of our workforce, identities, systems, and day-to-day operations.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role with responsibility across Identity & Access Management (IAM), internal security, security monitoring, SOC operations, and incident response. The position requires someone who can combine strong technical security expertise with a structured and operational approach to access control, monitoring, investigation, and risk reduction.

You will be responsible for securing employee and contractor identities, privileged access, credentials, internal systems, endpoints, VPN and remote access, while ensuring that appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained throughout the account and access lifecycle.

A key part of the role will also involve actively monitoring security events and investigating suspicious activity across authentication systems, endpoints, internal applications, and cloud/SaaS environments. You will take an active role in identifying potential threats, investigating security incidents, collecting evidence, containing risks, coordinating remediation, and ensuring corrective actions are followed through to closure.

You will work closely with HR, IT, system owners, and other technical teams to improve access governance, strengthen internal security controls, enhance detection and response capabilities, and reduce security risks across UltaHost’s internal environment.

We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking end-to-end ownership — from implementing preventive controls and improving security monitoring to investigating real incidents and driving security improvements across the organization.

**What You’ll Own**

**Identity, Access & Credential Security**

* Design and maintain RBAC across departments, roles, and critical systems.
* Manage MFA, SSO, PAM, password vaults, API keys, SSH keys, recovery codes, and secrets.
* Own security controls around onboarding, role changes, temporary access, contractor access, and offboarding.
* Identify and remove shared, dormant, unnecessary, and excessively privileged accounts.
* Conduct regular access reviews and maintain approval and audit evidence.

**Security Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, authentication systems, cloud/SaaS platforms, internal applications, and endpoints.
* Investigate suspicious logins, compromised accounts, credential leaks, malware, privilege abuse, insider risk, and unauthorized access.
* Collect evidence, contain threats, coordinate recovery, and drive corrective actions through closure.
* Maintain detection rules, alert quality, incident records, escalation paths, and response playbooks.
* Lead internal security incidents and support infrastructure/product incidents involving identities or credentials.

**Internal Systems & Workforce Security**

* Define security requirements for laptops, VPN and remote access, email, code repositories, support platforms, finance tools, and administrative systems.
* Work closely with HR and IT on joiner/mover/leaver processes and internal security investigations.
* Support security awareness, phishing prevention, and secure handling of sensitive information and credentials.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in internal security, IAM, SOC/security operations, incident response, IT security, or a closely related role.
* Practical experience with RBAC, MFA, SSO, PAM, identity providers, password management, account lifecycle management, and access auditing.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, centralized logging, authentication logs, alert triage, and case management.
* Proven ability to investigate compromised accounts, malware, credential leaks, suspicious authentication activity, insider risk, and unauthorized access.
* Strong understanding of Linux access, SSH, VPN, endpoints, cloud/SaaS administration, email security, and remote-workforce security.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to enforce security controls while collaborating with HR, IT, managers, and system owners.

**Preferred Background**

Experience in web hosting, cloud infrastructure, data centers, SaaS, fintech, MSSP, or another distributed technology environment is highly valuable. Preferred certifications include Security+, CySA+, GCIH, SC-200, IAM/PAM vendor certifications, CISSP, or equivalent practical expertise. Certifications are a plus — hands-on experience matters more.

**What Success Looks Like**

**You will help us improve:**

* MFA and privileged-access coverage
* Joiner/mover/leaver security and access-removal speed
* Control of shared, dormant, and excessive access
* Alert response and incident-resolution times
* Access-review coverage and security evidence
* Internal security standards, procedures, and playbooks

**Important**

We are not looking for a policy/compliance-only profile. The successful candidate must have real hands-on experience administering access controls, operating security tooling, investigating logs, and responding to security incidents.

You will work closely with our second cybersecurity specialist, the Product & Infrastructure Security Engineer, as well as DevOps, Network, Product, Engineering, Support, Abuse, HR, Finance, Legal, and executive management.

If you enjoy taking ownership, building security controls, investigating real incidents, and improving security in a large-scale technology environment, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Data Analyst
description:
As a Data Analyst in the Business Analytics team, you'll be the dedicated analyst for our B2B commercial direction. You'll work as an independent contributor, side by side with the commercial team. You'll find growth opportunities in the data, form and test hypotheses, and measure the impact of business initiatives that are not product features. Your first projects will be supporting and developing our pricing override and cost modifier processes, designing experiments around the credit limits we give B2B partners to help grow their booking volumes, and evaluating the financial and customer impact of opening local legal entities in new markets. A/B testing alone often isn't enough here, so you'll choose and apply other methods, such as difference-in-differences or causal impact. There is no ready-made playbook. You'll set your own approach, and project managers on both sides will help you run the work. The role suits a self-driven analyst who wants real ownership and visible impact on commercial decisions, and it can grow as the direction expands.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 2+ years of experience in business, data or product analytics
* Strong SQL, including writing efficient, fast-running queries
* Confident Python and its data libraries: Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Seaborn, Scikit-learn and others
* Hands-on experience with difference-in-differences
* Experience with causal inference methods: Causal Impact, Propensity Score Matching and similar
* Solid knowledge of statistics and experience designing and running A/B tests and other experiments
* Ability to dive deep into business processes, solve non-standard problems and work independently
* Fluent Russian and English B2

**Nice to have**

* Experience with time series forecasting (Prophet, ARIMA, Exponential Smoothing or similar)
* Experience in B2B, commercial or partner analytics
* Experience onboarding or mentoring junior colleagues
* Hands-on use of AI tools, such as Copilot or agents, to speed up your work

**Benefits**

* Flexible schedules and opportunity to work remotely
* Ambitious and supportive team who love what they do, appreciate each other, and grow together
* A structured onboarding, a personal development plan, and regular internal lectures and demos from the team
* Internal programs for adaptation and training, development of soft skills, and leadership abilities
* Partial compensation for participating in external training and conferences
* Corporate English school: Group and individual lessons, speaking clubs with colleagues from all over the world
* Corporate prices on hotels and travel services
* MyTime Day Off - an extra non-working day without loss of compensation

At PwC, our people in cybersecurity focus on protecting organisations from cyber threats through advanced technologies and strategies. They work to identify vulnerabilities, develop secure systems, and provide proactive solutions to safeguard sensitive data.
  
  
As a cybersecurity generalist at PwC, you will focus on providing comprehensive security solutions and experience across various domains, maintaining the protection of client systems and data. Focused on relationships, you are building meaningful client connections, and learning how to manage and inspire others. * Use a broad range of tools, methodologies and techniques to generate new ideas and solve problems.
* Use critical thinking to break down complex concepts.
* Understand the broader objectives of your project or role and how your work fits into the overall strategy.
* Develop a deeper understanding of the business context and how it is changing.
* Use reflection to develop self awareness, enhance strengths and address development areas.
* Interpret data to inform insights and recommendations.

  + Red teaming exercise; or
  + Cyber incident response, threat hunting and incident analysis; or
  + Operation Technology security (preferably in energy, mining, utilities and oil & gas industry).
* Provide recommendations/ advice to the clients.
* Train, coach and upskill team members’ capabilities.

* Minimum Bachelor degree(s).
* 3- 5 Years of working experience in the relevant area. Having experience in cybersecurity consulting firm is an advantage
* Good professional reporting skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English
* Good knowledge of relevant cybersecurity standards / frameworks.
* Good experience and knowledge in the general IT technical and controls, network, and security best practises.

title: Senior IT Cybersecurity Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a Senior Security Architect to strengthen our Security Engineering & Architecture capability

In this role, you will work closely with Technology, Infrastructure, Cloud, Application, and Cybersecurity teams to embed security into the design and delivery of technology solutions. You will define security architecture and standards, lead security design reviews, evaluate security technologies, and ensure security controls are effectively designed, implemented, and continuously improved across the technology environment

This is a hands-on technical role for someone who can translate security principles into practical architecture, engineering requirements, and scalable security controls

**Job Description**

* Own and continuously evolve security reference architectures, security standards, patterns, and capability maps across the technology environment
* Lead the security design-review gate for new projects, technology changes, integrations, and in-house applications before go-live
* Assess solution architecture, technology designs, data flows, integrations, and proposed implementations to identify security risks and define appropriate security requirements and controls
* Lead technical evaluations, Proofs of Concept (PoC), and technical tender assessments for security technologies and platforms, such as SSE, SAST, cloud security, and other security capabilities
* Coordinate with Security Engineers, Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, Application, and other Technology teams to design, implement, integrate, and operationalize security controls and solutions
* Define and continuously improve security controls across endpoint, SDLC, cloud, network, identity, and data, including security hardening and technical remediation
* Evaluate the effectiveness, reliability, scalability, and operational performance of security controls and drive continuous improvement.
* Identify opportunities to improve security engineering through automation, standardization, reusable security patterns, and security-by-design practices
* Provide technical guidance to engineering and technology teams on security architecture, implementation trade-offs, and remediation of security gaps
* Contribute to the development of the organization's overall security engineering roadmap and capability maturity
* Stay current with emerging security technologies, architectural patterns, and evolving technology risks

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or another relevant STEM field
* 3–5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, security engineering, security architecture, application security, cloud security, infrastructure security, or related technical security functions
* Strong understanding of security architecture principles, security controls, secure-by-design practices, and technical risk assessment
* Experience conducting or contributing to security design reviews for applications, systems, infrastructure, cloud environments, or technology projects
* Experience designing, implementing, integrating, or improving security controls across areas such as cloud, network, endpoint, identity, SDLC/application, and data security
* Strong understanding of several programming languages, particularly JavaScript, Go (Golang), and Python, with proven experience in system development using these languages
* Understanding of Rust is an advantage
* Experience working closely with Software Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, Network, DevOps, or Technology teams to implement and operationalize security controls
* Experience evaluating security technologies, conducting technical assessments or PoCs, and translating security requirements into practical technical solutions
* Familiarity with modern technology environments, including cloud platforms, APIs, CI/CD, microservices, containers, and enterprise applications
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate security risks into practical technical recommendations and solutions
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cybersecurity and technology teams

At Deloitte, our purpose is to make an impact that matters for our clients, our people, and the communities we serve.
  
  
We believe we have a responsibility to be a force for good, and WorldImpact is our portfolio of initiatives focused on making a tangible impact on society’s biggest challenges and creating a better future. Ready to unleash your potential with us? Join the winning team now!
  
  
**Work you’ll do:**
This role sits within the Artificial Intelligence & Data team of Deloitte Southeast Asia, which encompasses data, analytics and intelligent automation (IA). As a leader of this group, you will drive the growth of our IA business in the region and be responsible for the creation, sale and delivery of IA solutions: robotic process automation, intelligent character recognition, chatbots/virtual assistants and artificial intelligence.
  
  
The Artificial Intelligence & Data team leverages the power of data, analytics, robotics, science and cognitive technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform decision-making. We help clients transform their business by architecting organizational intelligence programs and differentiated strategies to win in their chosen markets.
  
  

* Apply emerging technologies to help our clients maximize the value of their data by generating actionable insights that provide real business outcomes.
* Designing and implementing data structures to support Big Data, Analytical models and traditional BI/DW reporting solutions using technologies such as Microsoft SQL, Oracle, SAP, Cloudera, IBM Watsons, MuleSoft, Qlik Technologies or Informatica.
* Designing and developing data integration using Data Governance, Data Quality, MDM and Metadata management.
* Applying analytical models to predict business outcomes with tools such as DataRobot and languages like Python or R.
* You will be part of a collaborative team that provides our clients with solutions that are practical as well as visionary and have an impact from the back office to the boardroom.
* Demonstrated experience across a broad range of industries such as Energy and Resources, Public Sector, Financial Services, Life Sciences and Health Care, Consumer Business, Manufacturing, Telecommunications or Consumer Business.
* Ability to link industry specific business requirements to BI, Analytics and Big Data solutions.
* Ability to recommend BI/DW/Analytics processes, governance, organisational and platform models, tool selections, and data integration options to clients.
* Project experience through all phases of the project lifecycle from strategy and advisory, scoping and planning, requirements gathering, design, development, testing, training and deployment.

* Understand the goals of our internal and external stakeholder to set personal priorities as well as align their teams’ work to achieve the objectives.
* Constantly challenge themselves, collaborate with others to deliver on tasks and take accountability for the results.
* Build productive relationships and communicate effectively in order to positively influence teams and other stakeholders.
* Offer insights based on a solid understanding of what makes Deloitte successful.
* Project integrity and confidence while motivating others through team collaboration as well as recognising individual strengths, differences, and contributions.
* Understand disruptive trends and promote potential opportunities for improvement.

**Requirements:**

* A good honors Degree, preferably at postgraduate level, in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or related disciplines.
* Experience in Big 4 or MNC Consulting firm or industry equivalent role.
* Minimum 2 years (Analyst) or 4 years (Consultant) of relevant experience.
* Strong experience in one or more of the following programming languages: Scala, Python, or R.
* Experience with one or more non-relational data stores such as Pivotal, Cloudera, Hortonworks, MapR, Oracle BDA.
* Experience with one or more relational data stores using SQL, Oracle DB, Microsoft SQL Server, IBM Netezza, Teradata or MySQL.
* Experience building data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Big Data technologies, including one or more of the following: Spark, Hive, Pig, Kafka, MapReduce, HBase, Sqoop, Flume or Storm.
* Experience in cloud Data Engineering
* Experience working with Agile software engineering tools and applying Agile methodologies in a pragmatic manner.
* Experience working with Source Control Management tools such as Git, Subversion or Mercurial.
* General knowledge of Linux/Unix based operating systems and Shell scripting.
* Experience directly interfacing with business and IT stakeholders for clients.
* Excellent problem solving skills, ability to think out-of-the-box, work under pressure and tight project timelines.
* Drive, tenacity, client focused and results oriented.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

In addition to strong client service orientation, we are also seeking talented leaders who have the capability to deliver quality solutions with superior analytical and problem solving skills. Besides excellent interpersonal and communication skills, candidates should have proven demonstration of sound business acumen, teamwork and leadership qualities. title: Compliance Analytics & Insights
description:
Company: 3111 UOB Indonesia
  
  
**About UOB**
United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in ASEAN with a global network in Southeast Asia, Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. Operating through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, we have a global network of about 430 branches and offices in 19 markets. At the heart of UOB is our culture, shaped by the UOB Way and anchored on our four values – Honourable, Enterprising, United and Committed. For more than 90 years, these values have guided how we do right by our customers, collaborate with one another and create long-term value for the communities we operate in. As One Bank, we are committed to helping our colleagues build sustainable careers grounded in purpose, supported by strong values, and enriched with meaningful opportunities to grow.
  
  
**Job Description**

* Create, build, and maintain the infrastructure required for optimal extraction, transformation, and loading of data from a wide variety of sources
* Deliver high-quality, production-ready data pipelines that bring and cleanse data from source systems to support AFC model build
* Implement processes/systems to monitor data quality, and drive optimization, testing and tooling to improve data quality
* Design and/or evaluates open source or vendor tools to be used for data lineage mapping
* Make sure info/data flow from system to system is correct
* Liaise closely with relevant stakeholders (e.g., Data Management Office) to identify and assess suitability of data for AFC models
* Liaise with Business Analyst and ensure assembled data sets used for model build meet business requirements

title: Cyber Security Engineer
description:
**About Artajasa**

PT Artajasa Pembayaran Elektronis is one of Indonesia's leading payment infrastructure providers, delivering secure, reliable, and high-availability transaction services for banks and financial institutions. As a key enabler of the national payment ecosystem, Artajasa operates mission-critical platforms that support interbank connectivity, fund transfers, switching, clearing, and settlement services across Indonesia. Through continuous innovation and technology advancement, Artajasa is committed to building scalable and resilient payment solutions that support the future of digital finance.

**About the Role**

We are seeking Cyber Security Engineer to strengthen the security posture of Artajasa's critical payment infrastructure. This role is responsible for implementing and maintaining cybersecurity controls, monitoring security threats, managing vulnerabilities, and ensuring compliance with industry security standards to protect mission-critical systems and digital payment services.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Implement and maintain cybersecurity controls across network, infrastructure, applications, and cloud environments.
* Monitor, investigate, and respond to security incidents, threats, and vulnerabilities.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments and support penetration testing and remediation activities.
* Manage and optimize security tools such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, and Web Application Firewalls (WAF).
* Collaborate with infrastructure, development, and DevOps teams to implement security best practices throughout the system lifecycle.
* Support security risk assessments, regulatory audits, and compliance with security standards such as ISO/IEC 27001 and PCI DSS.
* Develop and maintain security documentation, procedures, and technical recommendations.
* Stay up to date with emerging cybersecurity threats and recommend continuous security improvements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Cybersecurity, IT Security, Security Operations, Security Engineering, or a related role.
* Experience in banking, financial services, fintech, or other highly regulated industries is preferred.
* Strong understanding of network security, operating systems, cloud security, and modern application security concepts.
* Experience with security technologies such as SIEM, EDR/XDR, IDS/IPS, vulnerability scanners, or Web Application Firewalls (WAF).
* Familiarity with vulnerability management, incident response, and security monitoring.
* Knowledge of security standards such as ISO/IEC 27001, PCI DSS, NIST, or CIS Controls is an advantage.
* Professional certifications such as CEH, CompTIA Security+, or SSCP are preferred.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
description:
**Description**
We are building a data-intensive M&A deal-tracking platform - a web application where investment bankers manage pipelines, process documents, and surface AI-driven insights. We're looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who is equally comfortable shipping polished React UIs and designing backend systems that handle document ingestion, async job pipelines, and AI agent orchestration.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Build & maintain the full stack - from Next.js App Router pages and API routes through to the PostgreSQL schema, Drizzle migrations, and background job workers
* Own AI-powered features - integrate and extend LangGraph agents (document classification, structured extraction, company enrichment) using the Anthropic SDK and Vercel AI SDK
* Design backend systems - model new domain concepts in Drizzle ORM, write service and repository layers following clean architecture, and queue async work through the jobs table
* Drive quality - write unit tests (Vitest) and Playwright e2e tests for every feature; participate in code reviews
* Collaborate across functions - translate business requirements from the deal team into technical specs, and work with product on iterative feature releases gated behind feature flags

**Requirements**
Must-Have Skills:
  
  

* 5+ years of full-stack experience; strong in React, Next.js App Router, and TypeScript (strict mode)
* Solid backend skills: RESTful API design, relational database modeling (PostgreSQL), and ORM usage (Drizzle or Prisma/TypeORM)
* Experience wiring up AI SDK or LangGraph — prompt engineering, tool/function calling, streaming responses
* Familiarity with async job patterns — queuing work, tracking state in a jobs table, handling retries
* Proficiency with Tailwind CSS and component libraries (Radix UI / shadcn/ui)
* Experience with cloud infra on AWS (S3, SES, RDS) or equivalent

**Nice-to-Have**

* Multi-agent orchestration experience
* Graph database exposure (Neo4j)
* Terraform or infrastructure-as-code
* Vercel platform (feature flags, Edge Config, Fluid Compute)
* Python for data pipeline work

**Stack**
Next.js 16
  
  

* TypeScript
* Drizzle ORM
* PostgreSQL
* Neo4j
* LangGraph
* Anthropic Claude
* Vercel AI SDK
* AWS (S3 / SES / RDS)
* Tailwind CSS
* Recharts
* React Force Graph
* Vitest
* Playwright
* Vercel

  .

* Strong understanding of the broader
  **Data & AI ecosystem**

You identify opportunities, build client relationships, and actively contribute to business growth.

**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
Come join the Consumer Experience (CX) Engineering team! We work on a diverse set of consumer problems. These problems span across core experiences that power the UX navigation and transaction funnels, search and discovery of content and services. They also cover the user lifecycle, including user growth, engagement, and loyalty. Additionally, they involve the critical platform mission of mobile application developer experience. We are on an exciting mission to connect consumers to Grab's marketplace by allowing them to discover and engage with Grab's services and partners.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
You will build high-quality systems that power end-to-end consumer journeys across the Grab app—from login to the home and activity experiences. You will promote AI-driven delivery, using AI-enabled engineering workflows to take well-defined requirements through planning, testing, debugging, and documentation to a review-ready merge request. You will ensure these workflows produce secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions while helping raise engineering standards across the team. You will report to the Engineering Manager. This is an on-site role based in Jakarta.
  
  
You will report to the Engineering Manager. This is an on-site role based in Jakarta.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Build, operate, and optimize scalable, high-availability fullstack services and Go backend systems.
* Leverage and validate AI-assisted tools to build secure, high-quality code and lead plans that boost team efficiency.
* Design scalable architectures, manage system performance and capacity, and resolve complex distributed system issues.
* Take end-to-end ownership of product outcomes, drive cross-functional alignment, and manage production incidents during on-call rotations.
* Elevate engineering standards through design/code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, IT, or related field
* 6+ years of software engineering experience.
* Computer Science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, and system design).
* Critical ability to audit AI-generated code for security, correctness, and maintainability.
* Proven track record of leading AI-driven technical initiatives and raising engineering standards across teams.
* Proficiency in Go (or strong expertise in Java, C++, Scala, Rust, Python, Node.js, C# with a willingness to write Go).
* Modern Web Frameworks (React) using JavaScript / TypeScript.
* Distributed systems, large-scale web services, system internals, networking, performance tuning, and scalability.
* Hands-on experience with AI-assisted engineering workflows (Copilot, LLM coding tools) to plan, write, test, and debug code.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer
description:
UltaHost is looking for a Senior Internal Security & Security Operations Engineer to take ownership of internal security and help strengthen the protection of our workforce, identities, systems, and day-to-day operations.
  
  
This is a senior, hands-on technical role with responsibility across Identity & Access Management (IAM), internal security, security monitoring, SOC operations, and incident response. The position requires someone who can combine strong technical security expertise with a structured and operational approach to access control, monitoring, investigation, and risk reduction.
  
  
You will be responsible for securing employee and contractor identities, privileged access, credentials, internal systems, endpoints, VPN and remote access, while ensuring that appropriate security controls are implemented and maintained throughout the account and access lifecycle.
  
  
A key part of the role will also involve actively monitoring security events and investigating suspicious activity across authentication systems, endpoints, internal applications, and cloud/SaaS environments. You will take an active role in identifying potential threats, investigating security incidents, collecting evidence, containing risks, coordinating remediation, and ensuring corrective actions are followed through to closure.
  
  
You will work closely with HR, IT, system owners, and other technical teams to improve access governance, strengthen internal security controls, enhance detection and response capabilities, and reduce security risks across UltaHost’s internal environment.
  
  
We are looking for someone who is comfortable taking end-to-end ownership — from implementing preventive controls and improving security monitoring to investigating real incidents and driving security improvements across the organization.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**
**Identity, Access & Credential Security**

* Design and maintain RBAC across departments, roles, and critical systems.
* Manage MFA, SSO, PAM, password vaults, API keys, SSH keys, recovery codes, and secrets.
* Own security controls around onboarding, role changes, temporary access, contractor access, and offboarding.
* Identify and remove shared, dormant, unnecessary, and excessively privileged accounts.
* Conduct regular access reviews and maintain approval and audit evidence.

**Security Monitoring & Incident Response**

* Monitor and investigate alerts from SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, authentication systems, cloud/SaaS platforms, internal applications, and endpoints.
* Investigate suspicious logins, compromised accounts, credential leaks, malware, privilege abuse, insider risk, and unauthorized access.
* Collect evidence, contain threats, coordinate recovery, and drive corrective actions through closure.
* Maintain detection rules, alert quality, incident records, escalation paths, and response playbooks.
* Lead internal security incidents and support infrastructure/product incidents involving identities or credentials.

**Internal Systems & Workforce Security**

* Define security requirements for laptops, VPN and remote access, email, code repositories, support platforms, finance tools, and administrative systems.
* Work closely with HR and IT on joiner/mover/leaver processes and internal security investigations.
* Support security awareness, phishing prevention, and secure handling of sensitive information and credentials.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in internal security, IAM, SOC/security operations, incident response, IT security, or a closely related role.
* Practical experience with RBAC, MFA, SSO, PAM, identity providers, password management, account lifecycle management, and access auditing.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, centralized logging, authentication logs, alert triage, and case management.
* Proven ability to investigate compromised accounts, malware, credential leaks, suspicious authentication activity, insider risk, and unauthorized access.
* Strong understanding of Linux access, SSH, VPN, endpoints, cloud/SaaS administration, email security, and remote-workforce security.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to enforce security controls while collaborating with HR, IT, managers, and system owners.

**Preferred Background**
Experience in web hosting, cloud infrastructure, data centers, SaaS, fintech, MSSP, or another distributed technology environment is highly valuable. Preferred certifications include Security+, CySA+, GCIH, SC-200, IAM/PAM vendor certifications, CISSP, or equivalent practical expertise. Certifications are a plus — hands-on experience matters more.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**
