description:
**Fitch Group is currently seeking an Engineering & Quality – Full Stack Engineer based out of our**
**Jakarta, Indonesia office.**
As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group’s culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.
  
  
Fitch's Technology & Data Team is a dynamic department where innovation meets impact. Our team includes the Chief Data Office, Chief Software Office, Chief Technology Office, Emerging Technology, Shared Technology Services, Technology, Risk and the Executive Program Management Office (EPMO). Driven by our investment in cutting-edge technologies like AI and cloud solutions, we’re home to a diverse range of roles and backgrounds united by a shared passion for leveraging modern technology to drive projects that matter to our organization and clients. We are also proud to be recognized by Built In as a “Best Place to Work in Technology” 3 years in a row. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, we offer an exciting and supportive environment where you can grow, innovate, and make a difference.
  
  
Want to learn more about a career in technology and data at Fitch?
  
  
Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Technology-and-Data/
  
  
**About The Team**
Join the FDR Data Tech team—a highly visible group responsible for designing, building, and maintaining Fitch's core data repository and ratings platform. The team develops robust Java-based applications and data solutions that power critical business operations across Fitch Ratings. We collaborate closely with stakeholders including Ratings, Business, and Operation teams to deliver scalable data infrastructure, APIs, and services with a focus on reliability, performance, data integrity, and innovation—including the integration of AI/ML capabilities to enhance data solutions and developer productivity
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-performing full stack applications across front-end and backend layers
* Build intuitive, responsive UI components (e.g., React/TypeScript) and robust backend services (e.g., Java/Spring Boot or Python APIs)
* Develop and integrate APIs and data services, ensuring seamless interaction with enterprise data platforms and databases (SQL and NoSQL)
* Collaborate closely with product owners, designers, and data/engineering teams to deliver high-quality, business-aligned solutions
* Contribute to architectural decisions and implement best practices for performance, scalability, and maintainability
* Ensure code quality through automated testing (unit, integration, and UI) and active participation in code reviews
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, optimizing applications for performance and reliability
* Support CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices to enable efficient and secure deployments
* Contribute to continuous improvement of engineering standards, tooling, and development processes

**You May Be a Good Fit If**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
* 3–5+ years of hands-on experience in full stack software development
* Strong proficiency in:

+ Frontend: React, TypeScript, modern UI frameworks, and component-based design
+ Backend: Java (Spring Boot) and/or Python (FastAPI or similar)

* Solid experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and working with distributed systems
* Strong database skills (SQL required; experience with PL/SQL or optimization is a plus)
* Understanding of modern software engineering principles (microservices, event-driven architecture, scalability, performance)
* Experience with testing frameworks and building automated test suites
* Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS preferred) and modern development tooling
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to work in agile, collaborative environments
* Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q)

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

* Experience building end-to-end applications in cloud-native environments (AWS, Kubernetes/EKS, Docker)
* Familiarity with modern front-end ecosystems (Next.js, state management tools like Redux/Zustand)
* Experience with event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar)
* Knowledge of caching and high-performance patterns (Redis/Valkey, etc.)
* Exposure to NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB)
* Experience implementing CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
* Understanding of distributed systems design and data-intensive applications
* Experience working in data-centric platforms (data lakes, APIs, analytics ecosystems)
* Ability to navigate cross-functional environments and influence technical decisions
* Hands-on experience building AI agents (e.g., using LangChain or LlamaIndex), implementing RAG over enterprise data, and enforcing robust guardrails through rigorous testing and evaluation.
* Applying AI/ML to boost engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) and using agentic AI to automate workflows such as code reviews, test generation, data quality checks, and runbook execution.
* Experience working with AI connection protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) that ensure secure, interoperable, observable, and vendor-agnostic communication with authenticated, auditable messaging and robust error handling

**Why Choose Fitch**

* Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

title: Scrum Master (Technical & ERP Background).
description:
**Kualifikasi Utama (Requirements)**

* **Pendidikan & Pengalaman:**
* Minimal lulusan S1 di bidang Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.
* Pengalaman kerja minimal 3–5 tahun sebagai **Scrum Master** atau **Agile Coach**, sekaligus memiliki latar belakang yang kuat sebagai **Software Developer / Engineer**.
* Memiliki sertifikasi Scrum resmi (seperti CSM, PSM I/II) menjadi nilai tambah yang besar.
* **Keahlian Teknis (Technical Skills):**
* **Kemampuan coding dan review kode:** Wajib memiliki keahlian teknis yang kuat untuk melakukan *code review* dan membantu tim dalam proses *software development*.
* Menguasai bahasa pemrograman yang relevan dengan stack teknologi perusahaan (misalnya: Java, JavaScript/Node.js, Python, PHP, atau .NET).
* Memahami konsep arsitektur perangkat lunak, database, CI/CD, Git workflows, dan *best practices* dalam rekayasa perangkat lunak.
* **Kemampuan Manajemen Agile (Agile & Scrum Expertise):**
* Pemahaman mendalam tentang nilai, prinsip, dan praktik Agile/Scrum.
* Pengalaman dalam memfasilitasi semua Scrum Events (Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Review, dan Sprint Retrospective).
* Mahir menggunakan tools manajemen proyek seperti Jira, Confluence, Trello, atau sejenisnya.
* **Keterampilan Interpersonal (Soft Skills):**
* Kemampuan komunikasi dan kolaborasi yang sangat baik untuk menjembatani aspek teknis dan bisnis.
* Memiliki jiwa kepemimpinan yang melayani (*Servant Leadership*) dan mampu memotivasi tim teknis.
* Kemampuan *problem solving* yang kuat untuk membantu tim mengurai hambatan (*blockers*).

**Tanggung Jawab Utama (Responsibilities)**

* Memfasilitasi dan memastikan seluruh proses Scrum berjalan dengan efektif dan sesuai dengan Agile prinsip.
* **Terlibat aktif dalam aspek teknis**, termasuk melakukan peninjauan kode (*code review*) serta membantu memecahkan masalah teknis (development) yang dihadapi oleh tim.
* Membantu Product Owner dalam mengelola *Product Backlog* agar terstruktur dengan baik dari sisi bisnis maupun kelayakan teknis.
* Mengidentifikasi, melacak, dan menghilangkan segala hambatan (*impediments*) yang dapat mengganggu produktivitas tim technical.
* Mendorong budaya perbaikan berkelanjutan (*continuous improvement*) di dalam tim untuk meningkatkan kualitas kode dan kecepatan pengiriman produk.

Agar kualifikasi teknisnya lebih spesifik dan sesuai dengan kebutuhan Anda, boleh informasikan:

* **Bahasa pemrograman** atau **tech stack** utama apa yang digunakan oleh tim technical Anda? (Contoh: Node.js, Golang, React, dll.)

title: IT GRC
description:
**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Relevant professional certifications (at least one required), such as:
* CISSP, CISA, CISM, CEH, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or equivalent.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in IT Security, particularly in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC).
* Prior experience in Payment Gateway, or Financial Services industry is a strong plus.
* Proven experience in implementing and managing IT security architecture across hardware, operating systems, networks, databases, and applications.
* Solid experience in security audits and ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g., PCI DSS, ISO 27001, NIST) and local regulations (e.g., Bank Indonesia, OJK).
* Strong understanding of network, endpoint, and application security principles.
* Hands-on experience with Vulnerability Management tools (e.g., Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7, OpenVAS).
* Proficient in developing and implementing IT security policies and procedures.
* Experience in security incident handling and forensic investigation.
* Familiar with SIEM tools (Security Information and Event Management) and real-time threat monitoring.
* Capable of conducting risk assessments and preparing comprehensive security documentation.
* Deep knowledge of security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, COBIT, or equivalent.
* Ability to conduct security awareness training across different levels of the organization.
* Strong communication skills, especially in presenting security findings and recommendations to non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with IT, compliance, legal, and business teams.
* Proactive problem-solver with the ability to respond quickly and effectively in security incidents.

**Job Description**

* Develop and implement comprehensive IT security architecture covering the security of hardware, operating systems, networks, databases, and applications.
* Implement IT Security Policies in accordance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* Deploy Vulnerability Management Solutions and lead necessary remediation efforts proactively.
* Continuously monitor and assess IT security to detect and respond to potential threats.
* Conduct security awareness training for staff to enhance understanding and vigilance regarding information security.
* Lead security incident response efforts in collaboration with relevant stakeholders, and perform forensic analysis to identify root causes and impacts.
* Stay up to date with the latest security trends and technological developments to ensure effective protection against emerging threats.
* Responsible for maintaining the information security system by adhering to security policies, protecting company data, and reporting suspicious activities that may pose a threat to information security.

description:

* Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the company's technology and cybersecurity strategy aligned with overarching business goals. Lead, mentor, and develop high-performing technology and cybersecurity teams.
* Operations & Defense: Lead and oversee the Security Operations Center (SOC), incident response, threat monitoring, and cyber defense operations.
* Service Delivery: Manage the delivery of premium cybersecurity services, including VAPT, red teaming, cloud security, and managed security services.
* Architecture & Innovation: Design and maintain a secure, scalable, and resilient technology infrastructure and security architecture. Drive innovation, automation, and continuous improvement across security operations and platforms.

* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Training & Development
* Performance Bonus

title: Information Security Program Manager
description:
**What You Will Do**
**Security Program Leadership & Operations**

* Develops and implements client information security programs that meet business, regulatory, and industry requirements
* Advises executive leadership on information security strategy, policies, standards, and procedures
* Updates client executives on security plan progress, emerging threats, and actual or potential security incidents
* Develops and maintains security policies and procedures that govern the protection of the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of client systems and data
* Monitors client security programs and environment changes to keep controls effective and risks minimized
* Oversees implementation of security solutions to improve overall security posture
* Develops, maintains, and coordinates testing of disaster recovery and business continuity plans that reflect client system and facility needs
* Develops, delivers, and monitors security awareness training programs
* Works within cross-functional teams to develop and deliver secure solutions
* Leads or participates in client steering committees and working groups as needed
* Coordinates with client security teams on incident detection, response, and resolution within agreed service-level agreements (SLAs)

**Risk & Compliance Support**

* Leads internal, vulnerability, and third-party risk assessments and supports client security audits
* Conducts security reviews of new and existing systems and recommends improvements to systems, policies, and procedures
* Ensures appropriate administrative, technical, and physical safeguards protect client systems and information
* Advises clients on control requirements for NIST CSF, ISO/IEC 27001/27002, HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI DSS, and other applicable frameworks and regulations
* Assesses control gaps and maturity against applicable frameworks and helps clients prioritize remediation
* Supports client audits, assessments, and certifications by clarifying controls, coordinating evidence, and addressing findings
* Defines scope and maintains segmentation and protection controls for regulated data environments (e.g., ePHI, cardholder data, CUI)
* Oversees vulnerability scanning and penetration testing programs aligned with framework and regulatory requirements
* Maintains cross-framework control mappings and supports compensating-control and risk-acceptance documentation

**What Makes You Stand Out**

* Communication Proficiency
* Decision Making
* Project Management
* Teamwork Orientation
* Thoroughness
* Client Relationship Management
* Regulatory Compliance Expertise

**What Are We Looking For**
**Information Security Experience**
*Note: The required qualifications may be satisfied through a combination of the experience areas listed below.*

* At least five years of information security leadership experience, such as CISO, vCISO, or senior security leadership
* At least three years of experience in security operations, security engineering, vulnerability management, or system administration
* Consulting or managed services experience supporting multiple clients across regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, financial services, government contracting)

**Compliance & Regulatory Experience**

* At least three years of hands-on experience implementing and operating controls for frameworks such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA, SOC 2, or PCI DSS
* Experience serving as the security point of contact during external audits and assessments (e.g., ISO/IEC 27001, SOC 2, PCI DSS, HIPAA)
* Experience scoping regulated systems and data, identifying required controls, and reducing scope through data classification and network segmentation
* Knowledge of risk management frameworks and methodologies (e.g., NIST RMF, NIST SP 800-30, ISO/IEC 27005, ISO 31000, and FAIR), with experience applying them to risk assessment, treatment, and reporting
* Experience with data protection technologies (encryption, tokenization, data loss prevention, secure coding)

**Required Training And Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Network Security Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience

**Required Certifications**
**Must Have**

* CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional)

**Highly Preferred**

* CISM (Certified Information Security Manager)
* CCSP (Certified Cloud Security Professional)
* CGRC (Certified in Governance, Risk and Compliance)
* Framework-specific credentials such as PCI ISA, HCISPP (HealthCare Information Security and Privacy Practitioner), or CMMC Certified Professional (CCP)

**Additional Preferred**

* CRISC (Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control)
* CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor)
* CIPT (Certified Information Privacy Technologist)

**Compensation Details**
The potential salary range for this role is $105,000 to $120,000 per year, with eligibility for bonus or merit program. Final compensation will be based on experience, skills, market conditions, and internal equity. We offer a competitive Total Rewards program including health benefits, RRSP matching, stock option, and career development opportunities.
  
  
*This description does not include every duty or responsibility. Role requirements may change based on client needs and service agreements.*

title: Data & AI Platform Engineer
description:
We’re on a mission to help people discover the real value of travel — to inspire, to give more reasons, to make it easy — for you to go. Our company was founded back in 2005, and since then, we’ve imagined and created some of the most well-loved products for travelers all around the world.
  
  
Today, Wego is used by millions of people every month — people who travel for adventure, work, family, and for many other reasons. That’s why we work tirelessly to make your experience of planning & booking flights, hotels, and trips as seamless as possible.
  
  
**Team Description:**
You'll join Wego's Data Analytics & Data Science team, which powers analytics, data science and AI tooling across our Flights and Hotels products, from the metasearch marketplace to our OTA business, in markets worldwide.
  
  
Our roadmap has more high-impact projects than ever, and we're growing the team to deliver the data ingestion, platform and AI tooling work behind them.
  
  
**The Role:**
You will build and operate the ingestion systems and runtime infrastructure that support analytics, data science and AI tools across Wego. Your focus is reliable data movement from source systems and dependable operation of the services that consume it, and you will own pipelines and services through development, deployment and operation.
  
  
You'll work closely with analysts, data scientists and engineering teams to find bottlenecks and build practical solutions, and you'll connect AI tools to data and services with clear access boundaries, evaluations and operational ownership.
  
  
**What you will be working on:**

* Building reliable batch and streaming pipelines so data moves from source systems without being silently lost or duplicated
* Running pipelines and services on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, with repeatable environments and safe release and rollback paths
* Building the systems that let AI assistants and agents use Wego data and APIs reliably, with evaluations built alongside data scientists
* Improving reliability and cloud cost against agreed service goals
* Finding sources of data loss, operational toil and slow delivery, validating their impact with users and owning the fix end to end

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Data ingestion: Build pipelines from APIs, databases and event sources; handle schema changes, incremental loads and change data capture where needed
* Recovery & data quality: Design retries, deduplication, backfills and replay; monitor freshness and completeness from source to consumer
* Kubernetes & runtime: Deploy and operate containerized pipelines and services; manage resources, configuration, scaling and recovery with platform teams
* DevOps & delivery: Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines; test changes and manage secrets and access
* Observability & operations: Define metrics, logs and alerts; diagnose incidents and fix recurring failures
* AI tooling & model services: Build tool and API integrations, agent loops, context and memory, retrieval, prompts and guardrails; support model serving where needed
* Evaluations: Build test sets, regression checks and monitoring of AI outputs with data scientists

**Skills and experience:**

* 3–8 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering or related infrastructure work
* Experience owning ingestion systems in production, including failures, recovery and source schema changes
* Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes workloads and cloud infrastructure
* Experience with DevOps practices, automated deployments and infrastructure as code
* Fluency in Python and SQL, with practical Linux, networking and container skills
* Experience with APIs, databases and event systems, including batch or streaming ingestion
* Understanding of delivery guarantees, idempotency and schema compatibility, and how they affect downstream data
* Experience with Kubernetes and container tooling such as Docker and Helm
* Experience with a cloud platform such as Google Cloud Platform or AWS, and infrastructure tools such as Terraform
* Practical knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring, alerting and incident diagnosis
* Ability to build AI assistants and agents (tool calling, agent loops, context and memory, retrieval, guardrails) and evaluate them with test sets and regression checks
* You spot worthwhile problems without waiting to be assigned, validate why they matter and own the solution through to measurable impact
* You align priorities with stakeholders, then work independently through ambiguity and missing context
* You use AI fluently but own the output: you test generated code, investigate failure paths and own what you deploy
* You provide tests and operational evidence before calling a change complete, and fix defects after release
* You explain engineering tradeoffs in practical terms and treat analysts, data scientists and product teams as users of what you build

**Additional Info:**

* Experience building AI assistants, agents, evaluations or model services is a plus
* Travel-domain experience is a plus

title: SVP IT Audit and Data Analytics
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**

If you’re looking for a role that will help you stand out at HSBC, take a look at how you can fulfil your potential.

Global Internal Audit provides independent, objective assurance to management and the risk and audit committees as to whether the framework of risk management, control, and governance processes, as designed and represented by management, is adequate and functioning. This team with skilled business, process, data, change, and culture analysts helps HSBC to achieve its strategic purpose, safely and sustainably.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead the delivery of highly complex audits by supervising audit planning, fieldwork, reporting and debriefing in accordance with the Audit Instruction Manual (AIM). The candidate will be responsible for leading both IT and non-IT audits; therefore, hybrid audit skills and flexibility are required.
* Lead the digital enablement of the Internal Audit function, including the continuous enhancement of data analytics (DA) for both audits and continuous monitoring. Support other DA-skilled team members and the wider function with data extraction and infrastructure maintenance, and act as the custodian of established DA logic. Implement and lead others in implementing audit testing of automated controls.
* Be responsible for managing team members and supporting their development to achieve the objectives of the Internal Audit function.
* Manage key stakeholders across HBID and the GIA verticals, supervise audit stages, escalate issues to the Country Head and establish appropriate resolutions.
* Apply professional knowledge, expertise and judgement to understand the business and develop suitable audit approaches and solutions.
* Support the Country Audit Head with the annual risk assessment and the formulation of the annual audit plan, based on the risk assessment outcomes and local regulatory requirements.
* Execute and document risk-based continuous monitoring of the assigned audit universe areas, in line with the established continuous monitoring strategy. This includes attending and actively challenging relevant business or functional risk forums, as well as staying informed about emerging industry topics and developments from relevant local associations.

**To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:**

* Degree holder from a reputable university; a master’s degree is preferred.
* Minimum of 13 years’ proven and progressive experience in auditing, business and/or accounting, preferably within the banking industry or a public accounting firm. Possesses hybrid IT and business audit skills, with an in-depth understanding of and experience in IT governance, risk and controls, and IT audit technical proficiency, including cybersecurity.
* Professional certification related to IT audit is preferred (e.g. CIA, CISA, CEH, ISO auditor certification, CISM or CISSP), along with other relevant certifications (e.g. CAMS, CPA or FRM).
* Possesses intermediate to advanced data analytics expertise and the ability to apply technology to business or operational problems.
* Experience in testing automated controls.
* Fluent in written and spoken English, with strong analytical, problem-solving, organisational, lateral-thinking and interpersonal skills.
* Internal Audit competency level of ‘Applied Knowledge’ in professionalism, performance, environment, leadership and communication, in accordance with the Internal Audit Competency Framework.
* Advanced understanding of the business, risks and related controls within the areas of responsibility.

**You’ll achieve more at HSBC**

***HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and every opinion counts. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters professional development, flexible working, and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We want everyone to achieve their potential with equality regardless of gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, age, or any other trait protected by applicable law. If you need any support or have any access requirements, we encourage you to inform us through email at recruitment.hrd@hsbc.co.id at the time of your application, so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.***

description:
**Microsoft AI, Copilot, Power Platform & Azure Specialists — Remote Contract Opportunities**

**Remote | Contract / Project-Based | International Client Projects**

Vurke is expanding its global technology-delivery network and is inviting experienced Microsoft professionals to join our talent community for **current and upcoming remote implementation projects** with Microsoft partners, systems integrators, consulting firms and enterprise clients.

We are looking for professionals who have **hands-on implementation experience** across Microsoft AI, Copilot, Power Platform, Azure AI, Microsoft Fabric, integration, security, governance, adoption and enterprise automation.

This is not one single role. We are currently building delivery capacity across the following specialist areas:

1. **QA / Business Analyst — Microsoft AI & Power Platform**

2. **Microsoft Integration Developer**

3. **Microsoft AI Solution Architect**

4. **Power Platform Architect**

5. **AI / Agent Engineer — Microsoft Ecosystem**

6. **Azure OpenAI Engineer**

7. **Azure AI Engineer**

8. **Copilot Studio Developer**

9. **Power Automate Developer**

10. **Power Platform Developer**

11. **Microsoft AI & Power Platform Business Analyst**

**What kind of opportunities are available?**

Vurke specialists may work:

* As part of a **Vurke delivery team**
* As an extension of a **Microsoft partner or systems integrator**
* Directly within an enterprise client project under an agreed delivery model
* On short-term or longer-term **remote contract assignments**
* On international engagements supporting clients in **North America, the United Kingdom and Europe**

Vurke is building a technically assessed global talent network focused on real implementation and delivery work—not simply traditional recruitment.

**Who should apply?**

We want to hear from experienced professionals who can demonstrate:

* Real production implementation experience
* Strong Microsoft technical or functional expertise
* Experience working with enterprise customers or delivery teams
* Strong written and spoken English
* Ability to work independently in distributed teams
* Ability to clearly explain the projects you personally delivered
* Availability for remote contract work
* Where required, partial overlap with **US, UK or European business hours**

Microsoft certifications are valuable, but **practical implementation experience matters more than certification alone**.

**How the Vurke process works**

Rather than applying separately to multiple job advertisements, you can join Vurke once and create your professional profile.

**Step 1 — Create your Vurke profile**  
Register on the Vurke talent portal.

**Step 2 — Upload your CV**  
Provide a current CV that clearly shows your Microsoft technologies, projects, responsibilities and delivery experience.

**Step 3 — Select the role or roles that best match your skills**  
Choose the opportunities most relevant to your background.

**Step 4 — Profile review and matching**  
Vurke reviews your experience and may use technology-assisted matching to identify suitable roles and projects.

**Step 5 — Technical assessment and interview**  
Shortlisted professionals may be invited to a technical assessment and/or client interview.

**Step 6 — Project opportunities**  
Successful specialists become part of the Vurke talent network and may be considered for suitable current and future international client assignments.

Joining the Vurke talent network does not guarantee an immediate project assignment. Opportunities depend on live client requirements, technical fit, availability, time-zone compatibility and commercial agreement.

**Why join the Vurke Talent Network?**

* **Remote international contract opportunities**
* Exposure to projects across **Microsoft AI, Copilot, Azure and Power Platform**
* Opportunities with Microsoft partners, technology consultancies and enterprise customers
* Project-based work without being limited to one geography
* One professional profile that can be considered for multiple relevant opportunities
* Technical assessment designed to identify strong delivery professionals
* Future matching against new Vurke client requirements
* Opportunity to build experience across international technology projects

**Apply now**

If your background fits **any of the roles above**, create your Vurke profile, upload your CV and select the opportunity most relevant to you:

**Apply here:**

**https://app.vurke.io/jobs**

**Create your Vurke profile once. Be considered for multiple global technology projects.**

title: Senior InfraOps Engineer (SDE 3)
description:
Kredivo is hiring an Senior DevOps Engineer (SDE3) in Indonesia Office who will be a key technical leader responsible for building, automating, and maintaining infrastructure for Kredivo International, collaborating closely with engineers across products and stakeholders to architect robust CI/CD pipelines, enhance system reliability, and enforce security best practices. This position will report to the Infra Lead and will be accountable for driving initiatives end-to-end and mentoring junior engineers while staying hands-on with the code.
  
  
In this role you will also be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure systems across multiple environments, and for owning and improving CI/CD pipelines to enhance delivery speed, testing coverage, and deployment safety. In addition, you will be responsible for leading incident response and postmortem reviews, enforcing best practices in infrastructure as code and observability, and driving cost optimization across our cloud infrastructure.
  
  
**About The Job**

* Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and reliable infrastructure systems across multiple environments (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, ECS etc.)
* Own and improve CI/CD pipelines to enhance delivery speed, testing coverage, and deployment safety
* Lead incident response, root cause analysis, and postmortem reviews with a focus on preventing recurrence
* Develop and enforce best practices in infrastructure as code (IaC), configuration management, and observability
* Work closely with engineering teams to guide architectural decisions that support high availability and fault tolerance
* Drive cost optimization and resource efficiency across our cloud infrastructure
* Proactively identify and resolve system bottlenecks, architectural risks, or security vulnerabilities
* Mentor and support junior engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and knowledge sharing
* Collaborate with compliance and cross-functional teams to ensure audit readiness and compliance with regulations
* Take ownership of high-impact initiatives and lead cross-functional projects

**About You**

* 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering
* Good experience in Kubernetes highly preferred
* Good experience in automation highly preferred
* Deep experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP)
* Strong hands-on expertise with container orchestration (Kubernetes), AWS ECS, Helm, ArgoCD and service mesh technologies
* Proven experience writing Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
* Solid understanding of Linux systems, networking, DNS, and performance tuning
* Deep understanding of firewalls, NAT and packet filtering (specifically Iptables)
* Expertise in observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Scalyr, ELK, or similar)
* Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash
* Experience with CI/CD platforms like GitHub Actions, Bitbucket Pipeline, or Jenkins
* Familiarity with secrets management (AWS KMS, etc)
* Familiarity with migration of services and server to the cloud and containers
* Experienced with Atlassian products.
* Experienced with JumpCloud is plus
* Experience in data analysis and visualization
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and mentor other engineers
* Excellent problem-solving and communication skills

title: Senior Software Engineer, Mobile (Android) - Consumer Experience
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
Join the Consumer Experience (CX) Engineering team - we work on a diverse set of consumer problems spanning across core experiences that power the UX navigation and transaction funnels, search and discovery of content and services, user lifecycle covering user growth, engagement and loyalty and the critical platform mission of mobile application developer experience. We are on an exciting mission to connect consumers to Grab's marketplace by allowing them to discover and engage with Grab's services and partners.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
You are a Senior Engineer who designs, builds, operates, and monitors secure, high-quality software systems. You will partner with technical and non-technical team members from product design through rollout, drive project momentum, and uplift the team through mentorship and process improvements.
  
  
You will report to the Senior Software Engineering Manager, and you will be based on-site in Jakarta.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Design and write in RxJava and/or Kotlin.
* Collaborate with mobile and backend engineers, designers, data scientists and product managers to build features
* Participate in code and design reviews to maintain our high development standards
* Brainstorm ideas, identify problems, propose and implement solutions geared towards scale and performance
* Take full ownership of projects that are built to meet functional and non-functional requirements of our users and partners.
* Design, implement, instrument and deploy highly performant and reusable Android components for operational excellence programs
* Lead collaboration across teams and roles, to resolve ambiguous, multi dimensional business, legal, and product needs.
* Participate in interview loops to help Grab continue hiring top industry talent
* Provide technical guidance, mentorship and knowledge sharing to peers.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience (4+ years specializing in Android) and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* Understanding of CS fundamentals (algorithms, data structures), system internals, CI/CD pipelines, and app observability tools (crash analytics, remote debugging).
* Experience managing end-to-end features for large-scale applications with analytical, critical-thinking, and design skills.
* High accountability, clear English articulation, and familiarity with applying Generative AI tools to enhance productivity.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Data Scientist
description:
We’re on a mission to help people discover the real value of travel — to inspire, to give more reasons, to make it easy — for you to go. Our company was founded back in 2005, and since then, we’ve imagined and created some of the most well-loved products for travelers all around the world.

Today, Wego is used by millions of people every month — people who travel for adventure, work, family, and for many other reasons. That’s why we work tirelessly to make your experience of planning & booking flights, hotels, and trips as seamless as possible.  
**Team Description:**

You'll join Wego's Data Analytics & Data Science team, which works across our Flights and Hotels products, from the metasearch marketplace and ad units to our OTA business, in markets worldwide.

Our roadmap has more high-impact projects than ever, and we're growing the team to deliver the core Flights and Hotels work that needs strong data science and statistical skills.

**The Role:**

You will build statistical models that guide pricing, bidding and conversion decisions across Wego's metasearch marketplace and our hotel and flight products. Causal inference is central to the role: you'll separate the effect of a decision from changes in users, markets and measurement.

We value modeling experience from risk, insurance, actuarial or other fields where calibrated probabilities and uncertainty affect real decisions. You'll own the statistical reasoning, validation and interpretation, and partner with engineering to put models into production.

**What you will be working on:**

* Designing experiments and quasi-experimental analyses that show the real effect of pricing, bidding and conversion decisions
* Estimating price response and gain/loss tradeoffs, and turning them into pricing and bidding decisions with clear objectives and constraints
* Building calibrated probability models that hold up under sparse data and changing conditions
* Finding opportunities in product behavior and business performance, and carrying them through to an evaluated outcome

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Make identification assumptions explicit, test their plausibility and explain what the evidence supports
* Quantify uncertainty using scenario analysis and sensitivity checks
* Compare methods against useful baselines and check calibration, bias and stability across segments
* Distinguish predictive performance from evidence about the effect of a decision
* Partner with engineers to ship models, define monitoring and investigate performance changes
* Document assumptions and limitations so others can use models correctly
* Validate the value of new opportunities with stakeholders and define success upfront
* Help analysts and product teams frame testable questions, and explain uncertainty and tradeoffs in practical terms

**Skills and experience:**

* 3–8 years of experience in data science, applied statistics or a related field, with practical experience in causal inference
* Strong grounding in experimental and quasi-experimental design, probability calibration and statistical model evaluation
* A record of using models to inform decisions and evaluate their impact
* Experience developing models for production and working with engineers on deployment and monitoring
* Fluency in SQL and Python
* Practical experience with causal inference and Bayesian modeling, including confounding, selection effects and limited data
* Ability to choose interpretable statistical methods that fit the problem and explain their assumptions
* Experience with cloud platforms for data access, model development and deployment
* Fluency with AI coding and analysis tools, such as Claude Code or Codex, combined with independent statistical judgment
* You spot worthwhile problems without waiting to be assigned, validate why they matter and own the solution through to measurable impact
* You align priorities with stakeholders, then work independently through ambiguity and missing context
* You use AI fluently but own the output: you check generated analysis against the data and challenge a convincing result when the evidence doesn't support it
* You make analyses reproducible and own defects in the models and conclusions you deliver
* You communicate with precision, share knowledge and learn new domains quickly

**Additional Info:**

* Experience with risk or actuarial modeling, insurance analytics or comparable work involving uncertainty and decision consequences is a strong plus
* Travel, pricing, marketplace, ranking or personalization experience is a plus

title: Data & AI Platform Engineer
description:
We’re on a mission to help people discover the real value of travel — to inspire, to give more reasons, to make it easy — for you to go. Our company was founded back in 2005, and since then, we’ve imagined and created some of the most well-loved products for travelers all around the world.

Today, Wego is used by millions of people every month — people who travel for adventure, work, family, and for many other reasons. That’s why we work tirelessly to make your experience of planning & booking flights, hotels, and trips as seamless as possible.

**Team Description:**

You'll join Wego's Data Analytics & Data Science team, which powers analytics, data science and AI tooling across our Flights and Hotels products, from the metasearch marketplace to our OTA business, in markets worldwide.

Our roadmap has more high-impact projects than ever, and we're growing the team to deliver the data ingestion, platform and AI tooling work behind them.

**The Role:**

You will build and operate the ingestion systems and runtime infrastructure that support analytics, data science and AI tools across Wego. Your focus is reliable data movement from source systems and dependable operation of the services that consume it, and you will own pipelines and services through development, deployment and operation.

You'll work closely with analysts, data scientists and engineering teams to find bottlenecks and build practical solutions, and you'll connect AI tools to data and services with clear access boundaries, evaluations and operational ownership.

**What you will be working on:**

* Building reliable batch and streaming pipelines so data moves from source systems without being silently lost or duplicated
* Running pipelines and services on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, with repeatable environments and safe release and rollback paths
* Building the systems that let AI assistants and agents use Wego data and APIs reliably, with evaluations built alongside data scientists
* Improving reliability and cloud cost against agreed service goals
* Finding sources of data loss, operational toil and slow delivery, validating their impact with users and owning the fix end to end

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Data ingestion: Build pipelines from APIs, databases and event sources; handle schema changes, incremental loads and change data capture where needed
* Recovery & data quality: Design retries, deduplication, backfills and replay; monitor freshness and completeness from source to consumer
* Kubernetes & runtime: Deploy and operate containerized pipelines and services; manage resources, configuration, scaling and recovery with platform teams
* DevOps & delivery: Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines; test changes and manage secrets and access
* Observability & operations: Define metrics, logs and alerts; diagnose incidents and fix recurring failures
* AI tooling & model services: Build tool and API integrations, agent loops, context and memory, retrieval, prompts and guardrails; support model serving where needed
* Evaluations: Build test sets, regression checks and monitoring of AI outputs with data scientists

**Skills and experience:**

* 3–8 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering or related infrastructure work
* Experience owning ingestion systems in production, including failures, recovery and source schema changes
* Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes workloads and cloud infrastructure
* Experience with DevOps practices, automated deployments and infrastructure as code
* Fluency in Python and SQL, with practical Linux, networking and container skills
* Experience with APIs, databases and event systems, including batch or streaming ingestion
* Understanding of delivery guarantees, idempotency and schema compatibility, and how they affect downstream data
* Experience with Kubernetes and container tooling such as Docker and Helm
* Experience with a cloud platform such as Google Cloud Platform or AWS, and infrastructure tools such as Terraform
* Practical knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring, alerting and incident diagnosis
* Ability to build AI assistants and agents (tool calling, agent loops, context and memory, retrieval, guardrails) and evaluate them with test sets and regression checks
* You spot worthwhile problems without waiting to be assigned, validate why they matter and own the solution through to measurable impact
* You align priorities with stakeholders, then work independently through ambiguity and missing context
* You use AI fluently but own the output: you test generated code, investigate failure paths and own what you deploy
* You provide tests and operational evidence before calling a change complete, and fix defects after release
* You explain engineering tradeoffs in practical terms and treat analysts, data scientists and product teams as users of what you build

**Additional Info:**

* Experience building AI assistants, agents, evaluations or model services is a plus
* Travel-domain experience is a plus

title: FrontEnd Engineer (3D Web Visualiation)
description:
### **Build your Career with Mitrais!**

**Build your Career with Mitrais!??**

Mitrais has engaged a large Australian software company on an exciting software development project. We're looking for Senior Front-End Developer to be part of the team.

We're looking for an experienced engineer who loves building intuitive, high-performance 3D applications that solve real-world problems. You'll play a key role in creating immersive visual experiences that help users explore and understand complex mining data.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a product, contribute to technical direction, and work with a team that's pushing the boundaries of modern web development and AI-assisted engineering.

**What will you be doing???**

Building Great 3D Experiences

* + You'll be responsible for creating and enhancing a browser-based application that allows users to interact with complex mining datasets, including block models, point clouds, and surface meshes.
  + You'll build rich, interactive 3D experiences that are fast, intuitive, and responsive.
  + Create user-friendly interfaces that help people work with data, not just view it.
  + Develop features, workflows, and tools that make complex information easier to explore and understand.
  + Work with modern web technologies such as React, Three.js, TypeScript, and other contemporary front-end frameworks.

Full-stack (highly desirable)

* + We're looking for someone who enjoys owning outcomes, not just tasks. If you have full-stack experience, you'll have the opportunity to contribute across the entire application, including the APIs and services that support the visualisation platform. While this isn't essential, it's a valuable addition that would allow you to have an even greater impact.

Working with AI-Powered Development Tools

* + Our team embraces agentic engineering and AI-assisted development workflows. You'll work closely with modern engineering tools and agents to accelerate delivery, improve quality, and solve complex problems more effectively.

You''re likely be great if you have

* Demonstrated experience in building 3D modelling / visualisation software in production.
* Proven competence building performant, interactive 3D web applications.
* Proficiency across a range of modern front-end stacks and frameworks
* Experience in agentic engineering and demonstrated ability to do agent orchestration
* Able to work both independently and as part of a team.
* Able to work in a fast-paced environment, shipping features and functionality rapidly.
* A portfolio demonstrating 3D-visualisation-software work. [Must be able to provide link/s]

Nice to have

* Experience in building geological modelling programs for mining is highly desirable
* Full-stack experience — able to own the backend work that directly serves the front end (the APIs and services feeding the visualisation layer), not just the browser layer.
* Experience with large spatial, scientific, geospatial, or volumetric datasets.

What can Mitrais offer you??

* Competitive salary?
* Excellent working environment, with the possibility to relocate to our regional offices and working remotely?
* Free English classes, English is our working language?
* Lots of opportunities to improve your competencies on our technical bootcamps, certification programs and soft skills training courses?
* Hackathons with big prizes!?

title: DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]**

Kami mencari **DevSecOps Engineer** yang tangguh untuk membangun, mengamankan, dan mengotomatiskan jalur rilis serta infrastruktur aplikasi berbasis *container* di PT Mitra Cakra Digital.

Di peran ini, Anda adalah garda terdepan yang memastikan sistem kami beroperasi secara stabil, aman, dan *high-availability*. Hasil kerja Anda—mulai dari *pipeline* CI/CD, otomatisasi GitOps, hingga *observability stack*—akan menjadi fondasi utama yang diandalkan oleh seluruh tim pengembang kami.

**Apa yang akan Anda lakukan:**

* Membangun, mengotomatiskan, dan memelihara *pipeline* CI/CD yang cepat, andal, dan terintegrasi dengan kontrol keamanan.
* Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan infrastruktur *container* serta orkestrasinya menggunakan Kubernetes dan Helm.
* Menerapkan pengelolaan kredensial (*secret management*) dan *security policy* pada jalur rilis untuk mencegah kebocoran data.
* Membangun dan mengelola sistem pemantauan (*observability*), pencatatan *log*, serta *distributed tracing* (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry).
* Mengonfigurasi API Gateway, menyusun kebijakan akses (*access policy*), serta menetapkan *rate limiting* untuk menjaga keamanan dan beban server.

**Yang kami cari (Kualifikasi):**

* Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun di bidang DevOps, DevSecOps, atau *Site Reliability Engineering* (SRE).
* Penguasaan mendalam dalam orkestrasi **Kubernetes** dan pengelolaan **Helm** *charts*.
* Menguasai *tooling* CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, atau setara) dan pendekatan **GitOps** (ArgoCD atau setara).
* *Hands-on* dalam *Secret Management* menggunakan **HashiCorp Vault** (atau setara).
* Menguasai *observability stack*: **Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, dan OpenTelemetry**.
* Mahir dalam **Docker** beserta penerapan praktik *container security hardening*.

**Soft Skill unggulan:** Memiliki kesadaran tinggi bahwa infrastruktur yang dibangun adalah fondasi bagi tim pengembang lain, **tetap tenang dan taktis saat menangani insiden di bawah tekanan**, serta memiliki dorongan alami untuk selalu mendokumentasikan dan mengotomatiskan pekerjaan yang berulang.

**Nilai tambah:**

* Memiliki sertifikasi Kubernetes (CKA/CKAD) atau Cloud Architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure).
* Pengalaman mengintegrasikan *tools* SAST/DAST/Container Scanning (seperti Trivy, SonarQube, Snyk) ke dalam *pipeline*.
* Pengalaman kerja di lingkungan IT Consulting atau *System Integrator*.

**Skema Bekerja:** **On-Site** **(Work From Office)** -- Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Bogor Regency.

**Kenapa MCD?** Kami adalah tim berbudaya kinerja tinggi **GROWTH** — *Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony*. Di sini, tim didorong untuk bereksperimen, selalu mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama.

PT Mitra Cakra Digital adalah pemberi kerja yang berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan. Seluruh kandidat dinilai berdasarkan kompetensi dan kesesuaian dengan peran.

Work Location: In person

title: Principal Data Architect
description:
Aliz is a global solution provider for the Google Cloud Platform (GCP) focusing on Europe and Asia. We are building scalable applications, IT infrastructures, Big Data, and machine learning solutions as a certified Google partner. We have offices in Budapest, Singapore, Berlin, and Jakarta.

We are looking for an experienced
**Principal Data Architect**
colleague in Indonesia who will create an amazing experience for our customers as they build and maintain solutions in the Google Cloud.

**You are looking for us if**

* a
  **dynamic project environment**
  excites you more than painfully slow development.
* **building things from scratch**
  motivates you more than refactoring legacy codes.
* **working with different people**
  on different problems is refreshing for you.
* solely designing complex solutions doesn’t satisfy you because you also want to actively
  **take part in the implementation**
  of your plans.
* **keeping your knowledge up-to-date**
  is just as important to you as sharing it
  **.**

**We are looking for you if you**

* are a software or data architect with hands-on coding experience (preferably in Java/Python and SQL), expecting continued coding involvement, with at least 7 years of expertise.
* have at least 3 years of working experience with Google Cloud Platform (and/or Professional Google Cloud certifications).
* are very comfortable working with BigQuery, Airflow, Dataflow, Dataplex, Looker and dbt Core/Dataform.
* have experience working at an IT service or consultancy company.
* have hands-on, up-to-date knowledge in using agentic AI tools to build software solutions.
* have great professional communication skills in English.
* want to use your technical leadership skills to guide both our engineers and our clients’ engineers on their cloud journey.
* thrive in a collaborative environment, where you can take on a lead role to guide the data team in agile practices.

**Your diverse role will include**

* architecting and creating data pipelines, data platforms, and data warehouses on GCP.
* being a trusted GCP technical consultant and trainer for our clients’ tech teams.
* being part of the clients’ engineering team and implementing relevant new practices.
* communicating efficiently with a conflict resolution and stakeholder management focus while representing a holistic approach to project delivery.
* tech leadership and mentorship.
* being responsible for the end-to-end development lifecycle.
* presales activities and proof-of-concept delivery.

**You will enjoy**

* using cutting-edge technologies and learning from A+ Big Data and Google Cloud experts.
* career development opportunities with regular feedback and the chance to mentor talented juniors and mediors.
* maintaining a healthy work-life balance with financial initiatives to support physical and mental health and green commuting.
* a collaborative working environment with hybrid work opportunities.
* flexible working time to adapt to when you feel most productive.
* employee counseling opportunity with coaches and contracted psychologists.
* extended paternity leave and enjoying 18 annual leave days per year.
* continuous training and learning opportunities with yearly allocated learning hours from working time and dedicated mentorship by experienced colleagues.
* social activities for everyone (team building events, biweekly company-wide knowledge sharing sessions).
* last but not least, a great community. :)

**Keep connected**

Check out our Indonesia team by visiting our career page.

Connect with us on social media (https://www.instagram.com/wearealiz).

description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**
-------------

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage, and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. As an **L3 Technical SME - AI Compute** , you will serve as a senior technical authority for AI infrastructure platforms, providing deep expertise across GPU compute, Linux systems, AI cluster operations, platform reliability, and high-performance infrastructure environments.

  

You will lead the resolution of complex technical challenges that extend beyond standard operational support, partnering with platform engineering, infrastructure, networking, storage, and OEM teams to maintain the reliability, scalability, and performance of mission-critical AI environments. This role combines deep GPU platform expertise with platform engineering, automation, performance optimization, and root cause analysis responsibilities.

  

If you're passionate about solving the most complex AI infrastructure problems and influencing the future of large-scale GPU platforms, this is an opportunity to work on some of the industry's most advanced AI environments.

  
  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Act as the highest level of technical escalation for complex AI compute platform incidents involving GPUs, Linux systems, storage, networking, and distributed AI workloads.

description:
**📌EMPLOYMENT DETAILS**

* Employment type: through 3rd party/ vendor
* Duration: 12 months fixed term (subject to change based on business needs)
* Work setup: Full onsite with dedicated full office hours based in BSD, Tangerang.

**THE ROLE**

***Senior***

* Lead the end-to-end quality assurance strategy across web, mobile, and API platforms, ensuring alignment with engineering and product objectives.
* Strategize and formulate the test automation framework architecture using tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Appium, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Authorize QA standards, testing methodologies, and release readiness criteria for the engineering organization.
* Plan and evaluate test coverage across functional, regression, integration, performance, and UAT test suites.
* Use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully to improve test-case drafting, defect analysis, test data preparation, and automation documentation.
* Lead root cause analysis for critical defects and drive systemic preventive actions to raise overall product quality.
* Synergize with Engineering, Product, and DevOps teams to embed quality practices throughout the SDLC and CI/CD pipelines.
* Negotiate prioritization of defect resolution and quality improvements with Product and Engineering stakeholders.
* Formulate and report on quality metrics including defect density, test coverage, automation rate, and release readiness.
* Recommend tooling upgrades, process improvements, and best practices to continuously evolve the QA practice.
* Mentor and coach mid and junior QA engineers, building team capability and a quality-first engineering culture.
* Control test environment integrity and ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects in JIRA.

***Mid***

* Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases to validate functional and non-functional requirements across web, mobile, and API platforms.
* Analyze business and technical requirements to formulate clear, traceable test scenarios ensuring full coverage and testability.
* Implement and maintain automation frameworks and scripts using tools such as Robot Framework, Selenium, Appium, Cypress, or Playwright.
* Plan and perform end-to-end testing activities including smoke, regression, integration, performance, and UAT.
* Use AI-assisted tools where appropriate to draft test scenarios, analyze logs, summarize failures, or improve automation scripts, validating outputs before use.
* Evaluate defects thoroughly, log them accurately in JIRA, and track resolution through to closure.
* Control test execution cycles, manage test data, and maintain test environment configurations.
* Conduct root cause analysis on defects and recommend preventive actions to improve product quality.
* Monitor and report quality metrics such as defect density, test coverage, and release readiness.
* Collaborate with developers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to resolve issues and align on quality goals.
* Recommend improvements to test processes, coverage strategies, and automation scripts based on findings.

**THE REQUIREMENTS**

***Senior***

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5+ years of hands-on QA experience, with significant depth in test automation and quality strategy.
* Proven expertise in designing and leading automation frameworks using Selenium, Appium, Cypress, Playwright, or Robot Framework.
* Strong proficiency in at least one scripting/programming language: Java, Python, or JavaScript.
* Deep experience in testing across mobile apps (Android/iOS), web applications, and APIs at scale.
* Expert-level knowledge of API testing using Postman or similar tools, including contract and load testing.
* Solid experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and DevOps workflows.
* Strong command of SDLC, STLC, and QA governance processes, including release readiness criteria.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for test generation, failure analysis, documentation, or QA workflow improvements.
* Experience leading QA teams, setting standards, and driving a quality culture across engineering.
* Excellent communication in both Bahasa Indonesia and English (written and spoken), with strong stakeholder management skills.
* Proven track record of managing quality metrics, reporting, and driving data-informed quality improvements.

***Mid***

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 2–4 years of hands-on QA experience, with a strong focus on automation testing.
* Proficiency with automation tools such as Selenium, Appium, Cypress, Playwright, or Robot Framework.
* Basic to intermediate scripting skills in Java, Python, or JavaScript for test development and debugging.
* Experience testing mobile apps (Android/iOS), web applications, and APIs across multiple platforms.
* Hands-on knowledge of API testing using Postman or similar tools.
* Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and software testing methodologies including functional, regression, and integration testing.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and how automated testing integrates into continuous delivery.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for test drafting, debugging, or documentation is an advantage.
* Experience logging, triaging, and tracking defects using JIRA or equivalent tools.
* Strong communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English (written and spoken).
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a cross-functional, agile team environment.

title: Data Scientist
description:
We’re on a mission to help people discover the real value of travel — to inspire, to give more reasons, to make it easy — for you to go. Our company was founded back in 2005, and since then, we’ve imagined and created some of the most well-loved products for travelers all around the world.
  
  
Today, Wego is used by millions of people every month — people who travel for adventure, work, family, and for many other reasons. That’s why we work tirelessly to make your experience of planning & booking flights, hotels, and trips as seamless as possible.
  
  
**Team Description:**
You'll join Wego's Data Analytics & Data Science team, which works across our Flights and Hotels products, from the metasearch marketplace and ad units to our OTA business, in markets worldwide.
  
  
Our roadmap has more high-impact projects than ever, and we're growing the team to deliver the core Flights and Hotels work that needs strong data science and statistical skills.
  
  
**The Role:**
You will build statistical models that guide pricing, bidding and conversion decisions across Wego's metasearch marketplace and our hotel and flight products. Causal inference is central to the role: you'll separate the effect of a decision from changes in users, markets and measurement.
  
  
We value modeling experience from risk, insurance, actuarial or other fields where calibrated probabilities and uncertainty affect real decisions. You'll own the statistical reasoning, validation and interpretation, and partner with engineering to put models into production.
  
  
**What you will be working on:**

* Designing experiments and quasi-experimental analyses that show the real effect of pricing, bidding and conversion decisions
* Estimating price response and gain/loss tradeoffs, and turning them into pricing and bidding decisions with clear objectives and constraints
* Building calibrated probability models that hold up under sparse data and changing conditions
* Finding opportunities in product behavior and business performance, and carrying them through to an evaluated outcome

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Make identification assumptions explicit, test their plausibility and explain what the evidence supports
* Quantify uncertainty using scenario analysis and sensitivity checks
* Compare methods against useful baselines and check calibration, bias and stability across segments
* Distinguish predictive performance from evidence about the effect of a decision
* Partner with engineers to ship models, define monitoring and investigate performance changes
* Document assumptions and limitations so others can use models correctly
* Validate the value of new opportunities with stakeholders and define success upfront
* Help analysts and product teams frame testable questions, and explain uncertainty and tradeoffs in practical terms

**Skills and experience:**

* 3–8 years of experience in data science, applied statistics or a related field, with practical experience in causal inference
* Strong grounding in experimental and quasi-experimental design, probability calibration and statistical model evaluation
* A record of using models to inform decisions and evaluate their impact
* Experience developing models for production and working with engineers on deployment and monitoring
* Fluency in SQL and Python
* Practical experience with causal inference and Bayesian modeling, including confounding, selection effects and limited data
* Ability to choose interpretable statistical methods that fit the problem and explain their assumptions
* Experience with cloud platforms for data access, model development and deployment
* Fluency with AI coding and analysis tools, such as Claude Code or Codex, combined with independent statistical judgment
* You spot worthwhile problems without waiting to be assigned, validate why they matter and own the solution through to measurable impact
* You align priorities with stakeholders, then work independently through ambiguity and missing context
* You use AI fluently but own the output: you check generated analysis against the data and challenge a convincing result when the evidence doesn't support it
* You make analyses reproducible and own defects in the models and conclusions you deliver
* You communicate with precision, share knowledge and learn new domains quickly

**Additional Info:**

* Experience with risk or actuarial modeling, insurance analytics or comparable work involving uncertainty and decision consequences is a strong plus
* Travel, pricing, marketplace, ranking or personalization experience is a plus

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Software Quality Assurance / Testing Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for participating in every phase of the development process to ensure that the design and software adhere to company standards.
  
  
This role collaborates with various stakeholders in the development and execution of exploratory and automated tests to ensure product quality.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Works across multiple teams to ensure the planning, execution, reporting, and successful completion of QA activities for all new development cycles for various releases.
* Contributes to Agile-related user story review meetings and/or work with relevant business stakeholders and developers to understand the new or modified application functionality.
* Networks with the required user community (such as Regions or the Product Owner) to understand business requirements and uphold quality of each release by ensuring a comprehensive end-to-end testing coverage.
* Designs and implements end-to-end test scenarios, as well as debugging and defining corrective actions.
* Contributes to performing and documenting risk analysis and record test progress and results. Performing thorough regression testing when bugs are resolved.
* Works across multiple teams to review requirements, specifications, and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback.
* Creates detailed, comprehensive, and well-structured test plans and test cases.
* Designs, develops, codes, and executes automation scripts
* Works across multiple teams to identify, record, document thoroughly, and track bugs and develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products to meet client needs.
* Develops standards and procedures to determine product quality and release readiness.
* Contributes recommendations that will enable innovation and streamline overall testing processes.
* Works across multiple teams, documenting established QA processes and best practices in Agile Scrum development methodology and influence the continuous improvement of the QA activities.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Seasoned expertise in software QA methodologies, tools, and processes.
* Interpersonal, communication, and organizational skills.
* Team player with good attention to detail.
* Excellent ability to understand and analyze complex systems
* Seasoned understanding of SQL and scripting.
* Seasoned understanding of software development process.
* Seasoned expertise in agile development such as Scrum.
* Seasoned understanding of software integrated development environments.
* Seasoned ability to handle client and customer issues tactfully and professionally.
* Seasoned understanding of object-oriented programming.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field.
* Relevant certifications such as Leading SAFe would be advantageous.

**Required experience:**

* Seasoned hands-on testing experience in AGILE/DevOps Methodology, Continuous Integration, and Continuous Delivery.
* Seasoned work experience in software development.
* Seasoned work experience in software quality assurance.
* Proficient in working in an Agile/Scrum development process.
* Proficiency with performance and/or security testing is a plus.
* Seasoned hands-on experience with automated testing tools.
* Seasoned experience working within a geographically dispersed company is desirable.
