title: Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)
description:
**About UltaHost**
UltaHost is a rapidly growing global web hosting and cloud infrastructure provider delivering high-performance hosting, VPS, dedicated servers, and cloud solutions to customers worldwide. Our mission is to provide reliable, scalable, and innovative infrastructure services while maintaining exceptional customer satisfaction. As our global operations continue to expand, we are looking for talented professionals to join our international team and contribute to our long-term growth.
  
  
**Job Overview**
UltaHost is looking for a highly skilled
**Full-Stack JavaScript Developer (AI-Native)**
to join our Engineering team. This role is ideal for an experienced software engineer who enjoys building modern web applications across the entire technology stack while leveraging AI-assisted development workflows to deliver high-quality software efficiently. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable backend services and modern frontend applications using JavaScript and TypeScript technologies. Working closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers, you will take ownership of features from specification through production while maintaining high standards for code quality, security, and performance.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using Node.js, NestJS, React, Next.js, and TypeScript
* Build secure and maintainable REST APIs, authentication systems, and backend services
* Design and maintain database schemas using Prisma ORM with PostgreSQL,
* MySQL, MongoDB, and Redis where appropriate
* Use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar as part of your daily development workflow
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, QA, and Engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle
* Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, Docker-based development environments, and deployment processes

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
* 4+ years of professional Full-Stack JavaScript development experience
* Strong expertise in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Production experience with Node.js and NestJS
* Strong experience with React and Next.js
* Hands-on experience with Prisma ORM, PostgresSQL/MySQL, MongoDB/Redis
* Experience with Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
* Experience writing unit and integration tests using Jest, Vitest, Supertest, or similar frameworks
* Daily experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex CLI, or similar
* Strong understanding of software architecture, scalability, security, and modern engineering best practices
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience building AI-powered applications using LLM APIs
* Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agent frameworks, or AI automation
* Experience working on SaaS, hosting, cloud, or infrastructure platforms
* Experience with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD platforms
* Experience optimizing application performance and large-scale systems
* Passion for AI-assisted software engineering and continuous improvement

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work in a fast-growing international technology company
* Professional and collaborative engineering environment
* Remote-first work culture
* Career growth and professional development opportunities
* Opportunity to work with modern AI-native development workflows
* Exposure to large-scale cloud infrastructure and global software products
* Dynamic and innovation-driven company culture

-------------------

We intelligently connect our teams globally enabling thinking beyond conventional boundaries. Strategy and Purpose Brand and Innovation

* Supporting the functional operations

* Proficient in written and spoken English
* Strong influencing and interpersonal skills
* Expert in Microsoft Excel, Word & Powerpoint

Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.

Serving as our compass, they navigate every aspect of our path towards A Better Tomorrow™ defining how we innovate, grow, and achieve success while setting high standards for individual achievement and collective progress. title: IT Support
description:
Bertanggung jawab untuk memastikan seluruh infrastruktur teknologi informasi, perangkat keras, perangkat lunak, jaringan komputer, dan sistem operasional perusahaan berjalan dengan baik, aman, dan optimal.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Memberikan dukungan teknis serta melakukan identifikasi, analisis, dan troubleshooting terhadap permasalahan perangkat keras, perangkat lunak, komputer, printer, dan perangkat IT lainnya untuk memastikan kelancaran operasional perusahaan.
* Melakukan monitoring, pemeliharaan, dan troubleshooting terhadap infrastruktur jaringan komputer, termasuk LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, internet, router, switch, access point, dan perangkat jaringan lainnya untuk memastikan konektivitas yang stabil di seluruh area operasional
* Melakukan pendataan, pencatatan, pemantauan, dan pengelolaan seluruh aset IT perusahaan, memastikan setiap perangkat memiliki informasi inventaris yang akurat, berada dalam kondisi baik, serta melakukan pemantauan terhadap kebutuhan perbaikan, penggantian, dan pemeliharaan perangkat.
* Memastikan keamanan perangkat, jaringan, dan sistem informasi perusahaan melalui pemantauan antivirus, pembaruan sistem, pengelolaan hak akses pengguna, serta pelaksanaan backup data secara berkala untuk menjaga keamanan, kerahasiaan, dan ketersediaan informasi perusahaan.
* Melaksanakan pemeriksaan dan pemeliharaan rutin terhadap seluruh perangkat dan infrastruktur IT guna mencegah terjadinya kerusakan atau gangguan operasional, serta membuat dokumentasi terkait aktivitas maintenance, permasalahan teknis, tindakan perbaikan, dan laporan kondisi perangkat IT.
* Memberikan panduan dan edukasi kepada karyawan terkait penggunaan perangkat dan aplikasi IT, berkoordinasi dengan seluruh departemen dalam memenuhi kebutuhan teknologi informasi, serta memastikan setiap permintaan bantuan dan keluhan teknis ditangani secara profesional, responsif, dan berorientasi pada pelayanan.

**Job Requirements**

* Memahami dasar-dasar keamanan informasi, antivirus, backup data, pengelolaan user account, hak akses pengguna, serta prosedur perlindungan data dan sistem informasi perusahaan.
* Memiliki pemahaman mengenai sistem POS, ticketing, reservation, payment system, CCTV, dan aplikasi operasional lainnya.
* Memiliki kemampuan dalam melakukan instalasi, konfigurasi, pemeliharaan, serta troubleshooting sistem menjadi nilai tambah.

Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan interpersonal yang baik, mampu bekerja sama dengan berbagai departemen, serta dapat menjelaskan permasalahan dan solusi teknis kepada pengguna dengan bahasa yang mudah dipahami.

* Pendidikan Diploma III (D3) atau Sarjana (S1) jurusan Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Teknologi Informasi, Teknik Komputer, atau bidang pendidikan lain yang relevan.
* Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk akhir pekan dan hari libur nasional sesuai kebutuhan operasional Taman Safari Bali, serta bersedia memberikan dukungan teknis di seluruh area operasional perusahaan. Memiliki pengalaman 1–2 tahun sebagai IT Support atau posisi sejenis menjadi nilai tambah. Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar.
* Pengalaman di industri hospitality atau pariwisata lebih diutamakan.

description:
Org. Setting and Reporting

In its resolution A/RES/72/279, the United Nations General Assembly endorsed the transformation of the Development Coordination Office (DCO) into a stand-alone coordination office within the United Nations Secretariat. DCO exercises managerial and oversight functions over the Resident Coordinator system, under the collective ownership of the members of the United Nations Sustainable Development Group (UNSDG). The position is located in the United Nations Development Coordination Office (DCO) Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific, based in Bangkok, and forms part of DCO's Data, Digital and Innovation (DDI) function. The Regional Office supports Resident Coordinators (RCs) and United Nations Country Teams (UNCTs) in advancing sustainable development priorities, strengthening development coordination and accelerating progress towards the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). Working closely with the Regional Office, Resident Coordinator Offices (RCOs), UNCTs and relevant DCO headquarters teams, the Data Analyst provides technical expertise and analytical support to strengthen evidence-based decision-making, strategic planning and the delivery of development results. This includes supporting data-driven analysis of regional and country-level development trends, contributing to strategic foresight and anticipatory analysis to identify emerging risks, opportunities and longer-term development trajectories, and informing Common Country Analyses, United Nations Sustainable Development Cooperation Frameworks and other strategic planning and coordination processes. The Data Analyst develops and applies data analytics, visualisation and related tools to translate complex information into actionable and forward-looking insights for regional and country-level decision-making. The incumbent also supports stronger data capabilities across RCOs and UNCTs, promotes collaboration with relevant UN entities and regional mechanisms, and facilitates access to corporate and regional data, digital and innovation expertise in response to country needs. The incumbent establishes and maintains relationships with relevant technical specialists, data owners and subject matter experts across the United Nations system and other partner organisations to support data quality, analytical coherence, knowledge exchange and the development of fit-for-purpose data products. The incumbent reports to the Head of the Regional Office. The Chief of the Data, Digital and Innovation Section in DCO New York serves as an additional reporting officer to facilitate matrixed collaboration, technical coherence and alignment with DCO-wide standards and priorities.

Responsibilities

Within delegated authority, the Data Analyst will be responsible for the following: Development of products/tools • Develop and implement databases, data collection systems, data analytics and other strategies that optimize statistical efficiency and quality. • Identify, analyze, and interpret trends or patterns, using statistical methods to identify relevant features and variables in structured and unstructured sources of information and data. • Develop and implement various analysis, reporting and quality control capabilities; identify appropriate data sources for analytics projects; locate and define new data analysis process improvement opportunities. • Develop reports, dashboards or other tools to effectively summarize findings and convey information to management. • Create interactive and static data visualizations and employ advanced features of data visualization tools to aid decision-making and communications of analysis outputs. • Lead production of data products such as reports or newsletters related to data analysis activities. Collaboration/ Coordination • Establish communication and cooperation with other parts of the organization to request data and express data needs. • Collaborate with data engineers and data scientists to improve data flows, data quality, etc. Research/ Study • Keep abreast of the current and emerging trends and developments in data analytics best practices, technologies and tools, and update management with findings and suggestions. Training • Conduct activities aimed at building capacity of staff on data analytics, including trainings for staff members and other personnel. Implementation • Support projects execution by conducting robust data analysis and collaborate with other team members to ensure that projects adhere to work plan objectives.

Competencies

PROFESSIONALISM: Knowledge of foundational concepts in data manipulation and data analysis such as data structures, statistical methods, etc.; Ability to perform quality assurance of data analysis outputs; Ability to assess data accuracy and consistency by performing data validation; Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions; Analytical thinking. Shows pride in work and in achievements; demonstrates professional competence and proficiency in subject matter; is conscientious and efficient in meeting commitments, observing deadlines, and achieving results; is motivated by professional rather than personal concerns; shows persistence when faced with difficult problems or challenges; remains calm in stressful situations. Takes responsibility for incorporating gender perspectives and ensuring the equal participation of women and men in all areas of work; demonstrates knowledge of strategies and commitment to the goal of gender balance in staffing. ACCOUNTABILITY: Takes ownership of all responsibilities and honors commitments; delivers outputs for which one has responsibility within prescribed time, cost, and quality standards; operates in compliance with organizational regulations and rules; supports subordinates, provides oversight, and takes responsibility for delegated assignments; takes personal responsibility for his/her own shortcomings and those of the work unit, where applicable. TEAMWORK: Works collaboratively with colleagues to achieve organizational goals; solicits input by genuinely valuing others’ ideas and expertise; is willing to learn from others; places team agenda before personal agenda; supports and acts in accordance with final group decision, even when such decisions may not entirely reflect own position; shares credit for team accomplishments and accepts joint responsibility for team shortcomings.

Education

An advanced university degree (Master’s degree or equivalent) in computer science, data science, analytics, statistics, applied mathematics, information management, data management, information systems, information science or a related quantitative field is required. A first-level university degree (Bachelor’s degree or equivalent) in combination with two additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of the advanced university degree.

Job - Specific Qualification

Not available.

Work Experience

A minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in Data Analysis, Data Engineering or Data Science, is required. Knowledge of foundational concepts in data manipulation and data analysis such as data structures, statistical methods, etc is required. Knowledge of data life cycle including data collection, data wrangling, analysis, visualization, deployment, monitoring, and reporting is required. Knowledge in database management to extract, transform, and load data from various sources is required. Skills in relational databases (SQL) and programming languages (Python, R) is required. Skills in data storytelling and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, and R is required. Ability to assess data accuracy and consistency by performing data validation is desirable. Skills to communicate complex and technical matters to diverse audiences is desirable.

Languages

English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat. For this job opening, English is required. title: Data Center Manager
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**
-------------

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage, and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. As a **Data Center Manager** , you will lead the day-to-day operations of a high-density AI and GPU data center environment, ensuring the reliability, availability, and performance of the critical infrastructure that powers next-generation AI workloads.

  

You will be responsible for the safe and efficient operation of mission-critical facilities, including electrical power systems, HVAC infrastructure, liquid cooling environments, CDUs, environmental monitoring platforms, and supporting facilities operations. Working closely with infrastructure engineering, AI platform teams, vendors, and OEM partners, you will lead operational excellence across a 24x7 environment while ensuring the highest standards of safety, compliance, and service delivery.

  

This is a leadership role for an experienced data center professional who thrives in highly available environments and is passionate about building resilient operations that support cutting-edge AI technologies.

  
  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

* Lead the 24x7 operations of mission-critical AI and GPU data center facilities, ensuring infrastructure availability, reliability, and operational excellence.
* Oversee critical electrical, mechanical, HVAC, CDU, liquid cooling, and environmental monitoring systems supporting high-density computing environments.
* Manage and develop facilities operations teams, providing leadership, coaching, performance management, and operational direction.
* Lead incident management, escalation response, service restoration activities, and post-incident reviews to minimize business impact and drive continuous improvement.
* Manage preventive maintenance programs, change management activities, operational readiness reviews, and infrastructure lifecycle planning.
* Monitor and manage power, cooling, and space utilization while maintaining appropriate capacity, redundancy, and growth planning strategies.
* Coordinate with GPU operations teams, infrastructure engineering teams, OEM vendors, facilities partners, and service providers to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Drive compliance with operational procedures, environmental standards, safety requirements, regulatory obligations, and industry best practices.
* Manage vendor performance, service-level agreements (SLAs), contracts, and operational deliverables to ensure business and customer expectations are met.
Identify operational risks, develop mitigation strategies, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen service resilience and operational efficiency.  

  
  

**Your Future at Kyndryl**
--------------------------

  

At Kyndryl, your career path is yours to define. As a Data Center Manager supporting AI infrastructure, you will help shape the future of large-scale GPU environments and next-generation technology platforms.

  

You'll work alongside industry-leading engineers, technology partners, and operations leaders while gaining exposure to advanced AI infrastructure, liquid cooling technologies, high-performance computing environments, and hyperscale operational practices. Whether your future goal is site leadership, regional operations management, service delivery leadership, or infrastructure management, Kyndryl provides the opportunities, learning, and support to help you grow.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important, you have a growth mindset and are keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused, someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless, naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  
  

**Required Skills and Experience**
----------------------------------

  

* Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Facilities Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Data Center Management, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum **7-10 years of experience** in mission-critical data center, facilities, or critical infrastructure operations.
* Minimum **3 years of experience leading data center operations, facilities management, or service delivery teams** within a 24x7 operational environment.
* Strong knowledge of critical electrical infrastructure, including UPS systems, generators, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, ATS/STS, and power distribution systems.
* Strong knowledge of critical mechanical and cooling infrastructure, including chillers, CRAH/AHU systems, pumps, heat exchangers, cooling loops, CDUs, and liquid cooling technologies.
* Experience managing mission-critical incidents, change management processes, maintenance programs, operational risk, and capacity planning initiatives.
* Experience overseeing vendor management, contractor performance, service delivery metrics, and operational governance processes.
* Understanding of redundancy architectures, high-availability environments, failover planning, and business continuity requirements.
* Experience leading root cause analysis (RCA) investigations and implementing corrective and preventive actions.
* Knowledge of operational procedures including SOPs, MOPs, EOPs, permit-to-work processes, and safety management programs.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making capabilities.
English language proficiency required.  

  
  

**Preferred Skills and Experience**
-----------------------------------

  

* Experience supporting AI, GPU, high-performance computing (HPC), or hyperscale data center environments.
* Experience operating high-density liquid-cooled infrastructure and advanced thermal management systems.
* Familiarity with Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) platforms, Building Management Systems (BMS), and environmental monitoring solutions.
* Knowledge of service management frameworks such as ITIL and operational excellence methodologies.
* Experience managing multi-vendor and outsourced service delivery environments.
* Demonstrated experience driving operational transformation, process improvement, and automation initiatives.
* Industry certifications such as CDCP, CDCS, CDCE, Uptime Institute ATS, Facility Management certifications, or equivalent credentials.
Experience supporting large-scale infrastructure deployments, commissioning activities, and capacity expansion projects.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Business Intelligence Developer
description:
**Job Summary**

The Business Intelligence Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining critical data pipelines, dashboards, and analytical solutions that support business operations across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Management teams. This role requires expertise in SQL-based data extraction and transformation, with additional capabilities in dashboard development using Power BI to deliver actionable insights to stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

Data Pipeline Development & Management

* Design, develop, and maintain complex SQL-based data extraction scripts and ETL pipelines to support daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reporting requirements
* Create and manage data pipelines for key performance indicators (KPIs) across Sales, Retail Operations, Postpaid services, and Network domains
* Develop and maintain datasets supporting operational dashboards, management reports, and strategic analysis including Master Trackers, Closing reports, and Territory Hierarchy updates
* Ensure data quality, accuracy, and timely delivery of all data feeds meeting T+1 and end-of-month SLA requirements
* Optimize SQL queries for performance and efficiency in handling large-scale data processing

Dashboard & Visualization Development

* Design and develop interactive dashboards and reports using Power BI to visualize key business metrics for various stakeholders
* Create and maintain dashboards for Postpaid, Retail, Prepaid, FTTH (Home Broadband), Trade operations, and Network KPIs
* Develop specialized reporting solutions including Champion Club tracking, DSE (Direct Sales Executive) performance, Partner Cost & P&L, and Sales incentive dashboards
* Collaborate with business users to understand requirements and translate them into effective visual analytics solutions

Data Analysis & Support

* Respond to ad-hoc data requests from Sales, Operations, Finance, and Management teams with accurate and timely analysis
* Perform data validation, reconciliation, and quality assurance to ensure data integrity across all reporting systems
* Support business initiatives including churn forecasting, RGU (Revenue Generating Unit) analysis, customer segmentation, and A2P (Application-to-Person) traffic monitoring
* Provide technical support and documentation for data-related processes and systems

Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication

* Work closely with Circle teams, Sales teams (SPO), Operations, Finance, Network, and Management to understand data requirements and deliver solutions
* Participate in requirements gathering sessions and provide technical expertise on data capabilities and limitations
* Document technical specifications, data lineage, and business logic for all developed solutions
* Train end-users on dashboard functionality and data interpretation when required

Required Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field

Experience

* Minimum 2-3 years of experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or related role
* Proven experience in developing and maintaining data pipelines in a production environment
* Experience working with large datasets and complex data structures
* Experience in telecommunications or similar industry is preferred

Technical Skills

Required (Must Have)

* **Advanced SQL proficiency:**
  Expert-level ability to write complex SQL queries including joins, subqueries, window functions, CTEs (Common Table Expressions), and query optimization
* **Database knowledge:**
  Strong understanding of relational database concepts, data modeling, and database performance tuning
* **Data transformation:**
  Experience with ETL processes and data pipeline development
* **Data analysis:**
  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail

Preferred (Highly Valued)

* **Power BI:**
  Proficiency in creating interactive dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using Microsoft Power BI
* **DAX:**
  Knowledge of DAX (Data Analysis Expressions) for creating calculated columns and measures
* Experience with other BI tools such as Tableau, Qlik, or similar platforms
* Knowledge of Python or R for data analysis and automation
* Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., Google BigQuery, AWS, Azure)
* Version control systems (Git) experience

Key Competencies

* **Technical Excellence:**
  Demonstrated expertise in SQL and data manipulation with a commitment to writing efficient, maintainable code
* **Attention to Detail:**
  High degree of accuracy in data analysis and reporting with strong quality assurance mindset
* **Time Management:**
  Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and meet strict SLA deadlines (T+1, EOM)
* **Communication:**
  Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders
* **Problem-Solving:**
  Analytical thinking and ability to troubleshoot data-related issues independently
* **Adaptability:**
  Flexibility to handle changing priorities and ad-hoc requests while maintaining quality standards
* **Collaboration:**
  Team player who can work effectively in a cross-functional environment

Typical Work Examples

Examples of work responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

* Creating and managing daily data pipelines for Postpaid and Retail KPI tracking with T+1 SLA
* Developing Power BI dashboards for Sales performance monitoring across multiple channels
* Building SQL scripts for Master Tracker (SSOT - Single Source of Truth) updates
* Maintaining monthly reporting datasets for closing processes and financial reconciliation
* Supporting FTTH (Home Broadband) analytics including installation, payment, and usage tracking
* Generating automated email reports for CVM (Customer Value Management) campaigns and cohort analysis
* Responding to ad-hoc data extraction requests from various business units
* Updating territorial hierarchy and outlet mapping data for sales operations
* Creating datasets for regulatory compliance reporting (e.g., MOCI quarterly reports)
* Developing forecasting models for churn prediction and RGU movement analysis

title: Security Engineer
description:
The Security Engineer is part of the Infrastructure team at Xtremax, responsible for protecting the organization's systems, infrastructure, and customer data against security threats and vulnerabilities. The role focuses on implementing and maintaining security solutions, identifying and mitigating potential risks, and ensuring the security and reliability of Xtremax's IT environment as the business continues to grow.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in infrastructure security, system hardening, vulnerability assessment, security monitoring, and incident response. This role requires strong analytical and problem-solving skills, the ability to work independently and collaboratively, and a proactive approach to identifying security risks and implementing effective solutions.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Infrastructure Security:** Implement, configure, and maintain security controls across IT infrastructure, including servers, operating systems, networks, endpoints, and other systems.
* **Vulnerability Management:** Conduct regular vulnerability assessments, security scans, and penetration testing to identify security weaknesses and recommend appropriate remediation measures.
* **System Hardening and Patch Management:** Perform system hardening, security configuration reviews, and patch management to strengthen infrastructure security and reduce vulnerabilities.
* **Security Monitoring and Incident Response:** Monitor potential security threats, investigate suspicious activities, respond to security incidents, and implement preventive measures to minimize security risks.
* **Security Solutions Management:** Manage and maintain security tools and solutions, including antivirus, endpoint protection, and malware prevention technologies.
* **Data Protection and Recovery:** Implement and maintain data protection, backup, and recovery procedures to safeguard critical information and support business continuity.
* **Security Policies and Controls:** Develop, implement, and maintain security policies, standards, and technical controls aligned with industry best practices and applicable regulatory requirements.
* **Security Assessment and Auditing:** Conduct periodic internal security assessments and reviews to evaluate the effectiveness of security controls, identify gaps, and recommend improvements.
* **Security Documentation:** Maintain technical documentation for security configurations, patching activities, access controls, vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, incident handling, and backup and recovery procedures.
* **Cloud Security:** Implement and maintain security controls for cloud infrastructure and services, ensuring appropriate access management, configuration, and protection of cloud-based resources.
* **Security Collaboration:** Work closely with infrastructure, development, and other technical teams to integrate security best practices into system design, deployment, and maintenance.
* **Security Awareness:** Promote information security awareness by educating employees on security best practices, potential threats, and preventive measures.
* **Continuous Improvement:** Stay up to date with emerging security threats, vulnerabilities, technologies, and industry best practices to continuously improve the organization's security posture.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical work experience.
* Good understanding of information security principles, security systems, and security policies.
* Experience handling sensitive and confidential data and implementing appropriate security measures.
* Familiarity with workstation and endpoint security, system patching, upgrades, and maintenance of applications, services, and infrastructure components.
* Understanding of planning, developing, implementing, and maintaining effective IT security controls.
* Familiarity with system hardening, vulnerability assessment, and penetration testing.
* Experience managing antivirus, endpoint security, and malware protection solutions.
* Familiarity with information security frameworks, particularly ISO 27001.
* Familiarity with Linux and Windows operating systems and their security configurations.
* Understanding of cloud security services and concepts across platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Basic scripting skills in languages such as Bash or Python for security automation and operational tasks.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to learn, evaluate, and adopt new technologies to improve security practices.
* Good communication, documentation, and collaboration skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with security monitoring, threat detection, vulnerability management, or incident response.
* Hands-on experience with cloud security implementation and configuration.
* Familiarity with security monitoring tools, such as Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) or Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) solutions.
* Knowledge of security frameworks and industry best practices, such as ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, or CIS Controls.
* Relevant certifications in information security or cloud security, such as CompTIA Security+, AWS Certified Security – Specialty, Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate, or equivalent qualifications.

  
**Benefits**

By submitting your resume/CV, you consent and agree to allow the information provided to be used and processed by or on behalf of Xtremax Pte Ltd for purposes related to your registration of interest in current or future employment with us and for the processing of your application for employment.

You also represent to us that you have obtained the consent of your referees when you disclose to us their personal data for the purpose of conducting reference checks.

The personal data held by us relating to your application will be kept strictly confidential and in accordance with the PDPA. You may also refer to our Privacy Policy for more details here:

We regret to inform you that should you not consent to providing the necessary data required for us to process your application, your application will be considered void.

**Ready to Secure What We Build?**
**Apply Through Our Official Careers Page**
https://careers.vidio.com/careers/570-senior-devops-engineer-cloud-security-jakarta-indonesia
  
  
Please note that only candidates who complete their application through the link above will be considered. Our recruitment team will contact shortlisted candidates only.
  
  
**About The Role**
At Vidio, we are building and operating a streaming platform that serves millions of users. As our platform continues to scale, security must be embedded into every layer of our infrastructure and engineering ecosystem.
  
  
We are looking for a hands-on
**Senior DevOps Engineer – Cloud Security**
to strengthen our cloud security posture, build preventive security controls, and drive infrastructure security automation across our environment.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
**Requirements**

* Cloud Security & Infrastructure Hardening
* Own and continuously improve cloud security posture across our infrastructure, including configuration assessments against CIS benchmarks, drift detection, and remediation.
* Design and implement cloud security guardrails using Service Control Policies (SCPs), policy-as-code frameworks (OPA/Kyverno), and secure-by-default configurations.
* Develop and maintain reusable Terraform modules to prevent infrastructure misconfigurations before deployment.
* Strengthen Identity and Access Management (IAM) through least-privilege access design, periodic access reviews, secrets management, and key rotation.
* Drive cloud host and server hardening through golden images, CIS-compliant baselines, patch management, and secure bastion/SSH access controls.
* DevSecOps & Security Automation
* Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation workflows.
* Embed security practices into infrastructure-as-code processes to enable preventive rather than reactive security.
* Automate security assessments, compliance checks, and remediation workflows.
* Collaborate with Engineering and DevOps teams to make secure infrastructure practices scalable and easy to adopt.
* Endpoint & Security Operations
* Drive endpoint security hardening across employee devices, including MDM, EDR, disk encryption, and operating system security baselines.
* Partner with IT teams to improve endpoint security management and compliance.
* Support security monitoring, vulnerability management, and incident investigation where required.
* Technical Leadership & Collaboration
* Work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, and Security stakeholders to strengthen security practices across the organization.
* Mentor and support other engineers in adopting secure infrastructure and deployment practices.
* Drive security initiatives that can scale with Vidio's growing platform and millions of users, without slowing down product delivery.

**Cloud Security Expertise (Required)**

* Strong understanding and practical experience in IAM design, least-privilege access, and access governance.
* Experience implementing CIS benchmarks and host/OS hardening baselines.
* Hands-on experience with secrets management and encryption at rest and in transit.
* Practical experience with Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) tools such as Wiz, Prowler, Scout Suite, AWS Security Hub, or GCP Security Command Center.
* Strong understanding of preventive security controls and guardrails-as-code, with a focus on preventing security issues rather than simply identifying and reporting them.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with endpoint management solutions such as Jamf, Microsoft Intune, or Kandji.
* Cloud security certifications such as AWS Security Specialty or Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS).
* Experience with monitoring and alerting tools such as Datadog or Prometheus.
* Experience working with high-traffic platforms, media streaming, or large-scale distributed systems.
* Exposure to security and compliance frameworks such as PCI-DSS and ISO 27001.
* Familiarity with AI/LLM tools to accelerate infrastructure automation, runbook development, and security triage, with sound judgment in handling sensitive data.
extracted_skills: LLM, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, Terraform, CI/CD, Cybersecurity

title: Cyber Security (Microsoft)
description:
We are looking for a Cyber Security Specialist to protect and strengthen our Microsoft-based infrastructure and digital environment. This role is responsible for monitoring security threats, implementing security controls, and ensuring the safety of company systems, networks, and data.

**Responsibilities**

* Monitor, analyze, and respond to cybersecurity incidents across Microsoft environments including Microsoft 365, Azure, Defender, and Active Directory.
* Implement and maintain security policies, access controls, endpoint protection, and threat detection systems.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, security audits, and risk mitigation initiatives to improve overall cybersecurity posture.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cyber Security, or related field.
* Familiar with Microsoft security solutions such as Microsoft Defender, Azure Security Center, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and Intune.
* Strong understanding of network security, firewalls, endpoint security, phishing prevention, and incident response.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, SC-900, AZ-500, CEH, or CISSP are a plus.
* Good analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and ability to work collaboratively.

* Menyusun roadmap pengembangan Holy POS berdasarkan prioritas bisnis, kebutuhan operasional outlet, masukan user, serta integrasi dengan sistem lain seperti inventory, finance, CRM, membership, dan reporting dashboard perusahaan.

* Mengontrol stabilitas sistem Holy POS termasuk monitoring server, database performance, integrasi API, serta memastikan downtime dapat dikan melalui sistem monitoring dan preventive maintenance yang terstruktur.
* Mengelola proses testing (UAT & QA) sebelum rilis fitur baru, termasuk memastikan seluruh modul seperti transaksi penjualan, split bill, refund, discount, pajak, inventory deduction, dan laporan keuangan berjalan akurat dan sesuai SOP outlet.

* Pengalaman minimal 2 - 3 Tahun sebagai Developer Team Lead

title: Software Engineer
description:
**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers to join our team and contribute to software outsourcing projects for clients across various industries.

In this role, you will work on developing, enhancing, and maintaining software solutions based on project requirements and your technical expertise. You will collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional team members to build reliable, scalable, and high-quality applications using modern, industry-standard technologies.

We welcome candidates with strong hands-on experience in modern web frameworks, cloud infrastructure, production databases, and AI service integration who enjoy solving complex technical challenges and delivering practical software solutions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Design, develop, and maintain software applications based on business and technical requirements.
* Build frontend interfaces, backend services, APIs, and system integrations according to project needs.
* Develop and integrate AI-powered features and services where applicable.
* Work with databases, cloud platforms, and third-party services to support application functionality.
* Troubleshoot technical issues and improve application performance, reliability, and scalability.
* Ensure code quality through testing, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
* Collaborate with team members to plan, implement, and deliver software features.
* Participate in technical discussions and contribute to improving system design and development processes.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* Experience: At least 4 years of hands-on software engineering experience in production environments.
* Core Languages & Frameworks: React.js for Frontend and Node.js (NestJS) for Backend.
* Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Docker containerization, and GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
* Databases & Caching: PostgreSQL for relational data and Redis for in-memory caching.
* AI & API Integration: OpenAI API for LLM integration and RESTful APIs for service architecture.
* Practices & Tools: Git, Jest for automated testing, and Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
* Soft Skills & Communication: Good written and spoken English skills for effective collaboration with international clients and distributed teams.
* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Master Data Engineer
description:
**Fitch Group is currently seeking a Engineering & Quality – Master Data Engineer based out of our Jarkarta, Indonesia office.**
As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. With over 100 years of experience and colleagues in over 30 countries, Fitch Group’s culture of credibility, independence, and transparency is embedded throughout its structure, which includes Fitch Ratings, one of the world’s top three credit ratings agencies, and Fitch Solutions, a leading provider of insights, data and analytics. With dual headquarters in London and New York, Fitch Group is owned by Hearst.
  
  
Fitch's Technology & Data Team is a dynamic department where innovation meets impact. Our team includes the Chief Data Office, Chief Software Office, Chief Technology Office, Emerging Technology, Shared Technology Services, Technology, Risk and the Executive Program Management Office (EPMO). Driven by our investment in cutting-edge technologies like AI and cloud solutions, we’re home to a diverse range of roles and backgrounds united by a shared passion for leveraging modern technology to drive projects that matter to our organization and clients. We are also proud to be recognized by Built In as a “Best Place to Work in Technology” 3 years in a row. Whether you're an experienced professional or just starting your career, we offer an exciting and supportive environment where you can grow, innovate, and make a difference.
  
  
Want to learn more about a career in technology and data at Fitch?
  
  
Visit: https://careers.fitch.group/content/Technology-and-Data/
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* Contribute as a member of a high-performing data engineering team, by implementing modern scalable data solutions aligned with business priorities.
* Partner with the CDO team and data product leaders to implement the vision for an AWS-based data platform that enables enterprise-wide self-service, unlocking data for AI, analytics, and innovation.
* Implement architectural decisions and establish best practices for data ingestion, transformation, and distribution frameworks that accelerate time-to-insight for data producers and consumers.
* Champion adoption of emerging technologies such as Agentic AI and Generative AI, integrating advanced capabilities into data workflows to enhance user experience and position the organization as “AI-Ready.”
* Ensure operational excellence and reliability by proactively addressing complex data engineering challenges, implementing robust quality controls, and preventing production incidents.
* Contribute to the design, build, and ongoing maintenance of core master data assets to ensure trusted, consistent, and reusable data across the enterprise.
* Support master data lifecycle activities including onboarding new domains, integrating downstream consumers, and evolving existing models as business needs change.
* Act as the Jakarta site lead and key point of coordination for operations and technology resources across the team locally.

**You May Be a Good Fit If**

* 3-5 years’ experience ‘hands-on’ as a member of a highly technical data-centric software engineers, preferably in financial services, in support of Data Lake houses (e.g. AWS, Databricks, Snowflake), data virtualizations solutions (e.g. Starburst), modern data catalogs & data quality capabilities (e.g. Collibra), and Master Data Management (e.g. Informatica)
* Experience working with master data concepts such as golden records, survivorship, reference data, and data stewardship in large-scale enterprise environments.
* Exposure to building or operating master data pipelines and services that integrate with analytics, operational systems, and APIs.
* Proven AWS expertise (S3, EKS, Lambda, Glue, EMR, Redshift, S3, RDS/Aurora, Valkey/Redis, Step Functions, MSK/Kafka, Event Bridge).
* Experience applying AI/ML to boost engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q).
* Strong Python for data engineering (Pandas, Spark/PySpark) and API Development (FastAPI or similar).
* Design and build high-performance REST/GraphQL APIs with optimized query patterns, pagination, caching, and schema design to ensure low-latency, performant reads at scale.
* Build ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and streaming; Kafka/MSK with schemas (Avro/JSON) and delivery semantics.
* Optimize performance of object-based and relational datastores
* Design applications with microservices and containerization mindset with ‘decoupling’ architectural principles
* Caching with Valkey/Redis: TTL strategies, invalidation, key design.
* CI/CD and IaC with GitHub, Git/GitHub workflows, ArgoCD.
* Security and reliability: IAM, KMS, secrets, VPC networking, observability (OpenTelemetry), SLOs, cost governance.
* Ability to solve complex data-driven requirements and triage towards defects and production bugs
* Technology solutions and tools including data governance and catalog solutions (e.g. Collibra, Alation, data platform and lake(house) (i.e. ‘medallion’ architecture), and data mesh and virtualization tools (e.g. Starburst, Denodo) .

**What Would Make You Stand Out**

* Direct experience building, operationalizing, or scaling master data solutions across multiple domains (e.g., customer, entity, product, reference data).
* Demonstrated ability to balance master data integrity with delivery speed in agile, product-aligned teams.
* Hands-on experience building AI agents (e.g., using LangChain or LlamaIndex), implementing RAG over enterprise data, and enforcing robust guardrails through rigorous testing and evaluation.
* Applying AI/ML to boost engineering productivity (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q) and using agentic AI to automate workflows such as code reviews, test generation, data quality checks, and runbook execution.
* Experience working with AI connection protocols (e.g., MCP, A2A) that ensure secure, interoperable, observable, and vendor-agnostic communication with authenticated, auditable messaging and robust error handling.
* Caching with Valkey/Redis: TTL strategies, invalidation, key design.
* Experience with forming strong partnerships with stakeholders and product teams.
* Great interpersonal and collaboration skills.
* Ability to translate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
* A relevant AWS Certification

**Why Choose Fitch**

* Hybrid Work Environment: 3 days a week in office required based on your line of business and location
* A Culture of Learning & Mobility: Dedicated trainings, leadership development and mentorship programs designed to ensure that your time at Fitch will be a continuous learning opportunity
* Investing in Your Future: Retirement planning and tuition reimbursement programs that empower you to achieve your short and long-term goals
* Promoting Health & Wellbeing: Comprehensive healthcare offerings that enable physical, mental, financial, social, and occupational wellbeing
* Supportive Parenting Policies: Family-friendly policies, including a generous global parental leave plan, designed to help you balance career and family life effectively
* Inclusive Work Environment: A collaborative workplace where all voices are valued, with Employee Resource Groups that unite and empower our colleagues around the globe
* Dedication to Giving Back: Paid volunteer days, matched funding for donations and ample opportunities to volunteer in your community

Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch’s credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interest or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Department Engineering and Technology

LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor)

LocationBangkok

The Engineering and Technology team is at the core of the Shopee platform development. The team is made up of a group of passionate engineers from all over the world, striving to build the best systems with the most suitable technologies. Our engineers do not merely solve problems at hand; We build foundations for a long-lasting future. We don't limit ourselves on what we can or can't do; we take matters into our own hands even if it means drilling down to the bottom layer of the computing platform. * Strong SQL and at least one other analytics tool (Python, R, Tableau, Power BI); comfortable with datasets too large for spreadsheets, and with statistical techniques such as forecasting and regression
* Experience in a highly operational field is a strong plus, as the work needs a deep technical understanding of complex operations
* Professional working proficiency in Thai and English, written and spoken, with both frontline operators and senior executives

title: IT Security and Infrastructure Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

We are seeking a highly skilled
**IT Security and Infrastructure Engineer to take primary ownership of our cloud security posture, identity management, and compliance frameworks, particularly within our Microsoft 365 environment.**
You will ensure that our Microsoft Entra ID and Intune environments operate securely, efficiently, and at scale. In addition, you will leverage your infrastructure expertise to maintain core network and cloud environments while providing advanced support for day-to-day IT operations and escalations.

**The Mindset**

* Security by Design: You understand that effective security is built on robust and automated system configurations, guided by principles such as Zero Trust and Least Privilege, rather than relying solely on security products.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Identity Architecture & MS365 Administration**

* Act as the Global Administrator, managing and scaling Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and the broader MS365 ecosystem.
* Architect and maintain seamless onboarding and offboarding workflows (e.g., auto provisioning M365, Slack, AWS/Azure access) through Intune.
* Design and enforce policies to separate administrative privileges securely.
* Design, implement, and maintain our MDM/MAM environment (Microsoft Intune) to ensure 100% automated provisioning via Windows Autopilot.

**2. Security Engineering, Compliance & Threat Defense**

* Deploy, monitor, and continuously tune Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (MDE) and Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps (MDCA) to reduce false positives.
* Implement advanced security governance, including complex Conditional Access policies, automated access reviews, and Just-In-Time (JIT) privilege escalation.
* Manage Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Data Lifecycle Management via Microsoft Purview.
* Conduct regular vulnerability testing and implement Attack Surface Reduction (ASR) rules.

**3. IT Infrastructure & Operation Support**

* Serve as the escalation point for complex day-to-day IT support and troubleshooting.
* Maintain basic cloud server infrastructure across Azure and AWS.
* Maintain fundamental network infrastructure (routing, switching, and firewall basics).

**4. Process Automation & Web Platform Management**

* Develop and maintain IT automation solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, UiPath, Phyton, etc.
* Design, deploy, and maintain internal collaboration platforms, intranet portals, and websites using SharePoint Online, WordPress, and related technologies.
* Maintain clean, documented, and version-controlled repositories (Git) for all IT scripts, configurations, and automation workflows.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* Experience:
  **Minimum of 3 years of experience in Systems Engineering, IT Operations, Infrastructure Engineering, or a security-focused infrastructure role,**
  with significant exposure to Microsoft 365 security technologies.
* **Identity & Endpoint Management Expertise:**
  Strong hands-on and architectural knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft Intune, and Windows Autopilot.
* **Security Expertise:**
  Practical experience with Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview solutions, with a proven ability to implement Zero Trust and Least Privilege security models.
* **Infrastructure Knowledge:**
  Solid understanding of networking fundamentals and basic cloud infrastructure administration.

**Preferred Certifications (Nice to Have)**

* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate (SC-300)
* Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate (SC-200)
* Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)

title: FDE AI/ Solutions Architect (AI, Python/Data)
description:
Provectus is an **AWS Premier Partner** and an **Anthropic Strategic Partner**, working at the frontier of applied AI. We help enterprises turn Claude, agentic systems, and their own data into measurable business outcomes — through bespoke applications, managed services, and advisory engagements. With offices in North America, LATAM, and EMEA, we partner with clients worldwide.

Our work centers on two verticals — **Financial Services & Insurance** and **Healthcare & Life Sciences** — where we deploy five pre-built AI Blueprints: Submission Flow, Portfolio Lens, Asset Flow, Revenue Flow, and Evidence Lens. Each Blueprint rebuilds a critical business process front to back, shipped from working code and tuned to a client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture.

Our team holds 100+ AWS certifications, is Claude Code certified, and co-delivers Anthropic's Agentic SDLC program, Cowork Activation, and AI Blueprint engagements.

**Where this role sits**
------------------------

You will work in a small, senior pod alongside an FDX; our delivery arc is Sprint Enable Realize:

* Forward Deployed Executive (FDX) owns the commercial relationship and the business outcome. Works alongside the client's leadership or C-suite level to move the client's KPIs — revenue growth, cost reduction, risk reduction.
* Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) embeds with a client to change how that client operates. You own the method; nobody hands you a ticket. You map the client workflow as it actually happens, identify the business problem underneath it, build a working AI solution, present to the client in the language of outcomes, and transfer it. Provectus maintains industry Blueprints — working systems that have already shipped for a client in the same industry — so you begin from running code and tuning it to this client's specific book, regulators, and operating posture. You will be measured on whether the Business Unit's number moved, not on hours or scope delivered.

### **What You’ll Do:**

**Take the seat**

* Sit with the client and the Forward Deployed Executive at the start of an engagement. Learn the function from inside, not from a requirements doc, and redesign the function from first principles.
* Reach working fluency in a new domain — insurance underwriting, healthcare revenue cycle, asset flow.

**Build**

* Design and ship production GenAI systems into the customer’s environment (cloud-native data, LLM-based, and agentic AI solutions). Implement and optimize RAG systems for production use cases
* Build the evaluation harness before you build the feature. Define what working means, instrument it, and let the evals drive the design.
* Write production code across the stack — AI, backend services, data pipelines. We choose tools to fit the customer.
* Take systems to production on AWS (GCP or Azure where the customer requires it): containerised, CI/CD, automated testing, monitoring, and maintainable after we leave. Hand the system over to the client.
* Start from the blueprint, and feed the blueprint. What you learn in the field becomes the baseline the next engagement starts from.
* Lead architecture reviews, produce technical design documents, and contribute to standards. Mentor engineers and share knowledge across the team.

**Own the outcome.**

* Work in a pair with a FDX who carries the Business Unit’s KPIs. Your work is measured against the same number.
* Own the technical direction of technical proposals and scoping. Drive adoption. Change management is part of the engineering job here.
* Be credible with the customer’s engineers and their executives.
* Shape what we commit to before we commit to it.

### **What You’ll Bring:**

**Mindset**

* Proactive and self-directed; identify problems before they're handed to you
* Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. Engagements start underspecified by design. Closing that gap is the job
* B2+ English, comfortable collaborating across distributed, multicultural teams

**Client Engagement**

* You are willing to spend time understanding and doing someone else’s job on the client's side before you write a line of code
* Credible with senior stakeholders — you can hold a redesign conversation with a BU head and a scoping conversation with a CTO, presenting outcomes to them
* You can produce a scoped, phased delivery plan with clear deliverables, dependencies, and risks — and estimate what it will cost to build and to run

**Technical depth**

* 7+ years building and running production systems.
* Solid AI/ML foundations. You understand what the models do well enough to reason about failure modes

* Designed and shipped to production LLM applications and agentic workflows — not demos, not POCs, not notebooks
* Agentic orchestration: multi-step workflows, graph-based orchestration, tool use, state management, and recovery from partial failure
* Experience with LLM APIs (Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, or OpenAI) and agent frameworks.

* Experience building and optimizing RAG systems in production
* Strong engineering fundamentals — dropped into an unfamiliar codebase or language, you’re productive. Python and/or TypeScript proficiency; depth matters more than stack.
* Experience in making and defending architectural trade-off decisions
* Hands-on AWS production depth: Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, ECS, S3, SQS, ECR, or similar. GCP or Azure is a plus
* Cloud-native delivery: containers, ECS or Kubernetes, IaC, and CI/CD applied to AI pipelines
* You evaluate. You have built or owned an eval suite for a non-deterministic system, and you can explain what you measured, how you produced ground truth, and what gated a release
* Model and agent monitoring, drift detection
* Cost and latency discipline: model tiering, caching, and the ability to say what a workload costs to run before it runs
* Hands-on production experience with the Claude ecosystem — Claude Code, CLAUDE.md, hooks, skills files. Spec-driven development — writing the intent, constraints, and acceptance criteria before you let an agent build — is a strong plus
* MCP: you can say why an agent would prefer it to a REST integration. Having authored a server is a plus

### **Nice to have:**

description:
**Operations Manager**
======================

Location:

Bandung, ID, 40256

At Barry Callebaut, we are on a journey to transform the cocoa and chocolate industry. As the world’s leading manufacturer of high-quality chocolate and cocoa products, our actions truly shape the future of our industry. We are a business-to-business company, serving the entire food sector, from the cocoa bean to the finest chocolate product. We are a company with a purpose, we believe in doing well by doing good and reinvesting in the communities we operate. We have a long-standing commitment to sustainability and our goal is to shape a sustainable cocoa and chocolate future. We are headquartered in Zurich, and have more than 12,000 passionate Employees working in more than 40 countries worldwide. We are very proud of who we are and what we do. And of course, we are always looking for talented people to help us have a positive impact on our industry and beyond!

**About the role**
  
The Operations Manager leads and oversees all manufacturing activities to achieve short-, mid-, and long-term production goals, ensuring strong performance across safety, food safety, quality, efficiency, and productivity. This role drives a culture of “Safety, Food Safety First and Quality Always,” ensures regulatory compliance, escalates unresolved issues, and continuously improves operations through lean practices and capability building to deliver best‑in‑class results.

  

**Key responsibilities include**

* Ensure the safety of all employees, be familiar with and implement all relevant regulations related to safety, food safety, environmental protection and always ensure compliance - Monitoring and improving safety, food safety and environmental performance.
* Work with the QA department to implement, execute and maintain the quality management system.
* Lead, direct, and control the day-to-day operational activities of the factory to achieve the quality, operational and financial objectives on short and medium-term in line with the overall master plan.
* Hire and develop people: providing learning, growth, building culture and a strong cross functional collaborative approach.
* Be a leadership role model living Barry Callebaut values and practicing servant leadership
* Support the definition and execution of the budget; monitor the cost and effectiveness of production activities to optimize resources, prioritize spending, and achieve volume, quality, and manufacturing standards.
* Identify and implement process improvements, lean manufacturing initiatives, and new technologies to increase efficiency and reduce waste.
* Manage the infrastructure and assets of the operations areas and ensure the factory remains under hygienic conditions
* Maintenance and equipment management: Overseeing the maintenance and repair of equipment and machinery to minimize downtime and ensure smooth production processes.

**About you**

* Bachelor or Master Degree in Engineering or similar Technical field
* Minimum 5 years experience as Operations Manager, or Production Manager in food manufacturing
* Advanced English
* Knowledgeable in MS Office Suite, SAP Systems and other applications used in manufacturing e.g. scheduling, CMMS, MES, etc.
* Strong technical background supporting continuous improvement work environment
* Proven business and people management skills
* Experience in Leading operational teams and Unions/Works Council context
* Detailed knowledge of plant and manufacturing functional disciplines
* Change Manager seeking Continuous improvement through lean principles and people capabilities development
* Knowledge of latest quality and safety laws / regulations
* Can prove strong focus on procedures (standardizing)
* Good problem-solving abilities
* Willing to be placed in Bandung

At Barry Callebaut, we are committed to Diversity & Inclusion. United by our strong values, we thrive on the diversity of who we are, where we come from, what we’ve experienced and how we think. We are committed to nurturing an inclusive environment where people can truly be themselves, grow to their full potential and feel they belong. **#oneBC - Diverse People, Sustainable Growth.**

If you want to learn more about Barry Callebaut, please find further information here.

title: Solutions Architect (AI)
description:
**Description**
The Solution Architect (AI) designs and delivers end-to-end AI, machine learning, and generative AI solutions that integrate cleanly into the enterprise's existing technology landscape. This role translates business use cases into scalable, secure, and governable solution architectures — evaluating platforms and vendors, defining data and MLOps pipelines, and partnering closely with Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise Architecture, and Product teams to move AI initiatives from proof-of-concept to production.
  
  

* Design end-to-end AI/ML and generative AI solution architectures aligned to business requirements and enterprise architecture standards.
* Translate business use cases into technical solution designs, including LLM integration, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, and ML model deployment.
* Evaluate and select AI/ML platforms, frameworks, and vendors (e.g., Azure AI/OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, GCP Vertex AI, open-source LLMs).
* Define data pipelines and MLOps practices for model training, deployment, monitoring, versioning, and retraining.
* Ensure AI solutions comply with data governance, security, and privacy requirements, and align with responsible AI principles.
* Collaborate with Data Engineering, Data Science, Enterprise Architecture, and Product teams to embed AI capabilities into existing systems.
* Build proofs-of-concept and prototypes to validate AI use cases before committing to full-scale implementation.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to engineering teams implementing AI solutions.
* Track emerging AI/GenAI technologies and advise leadership on adoption strategy and roadmap prioritization.
* Document solution architectures, integration patterns, and key technical decisions for governance and knowledge continuity.

**Requirements**

* 8–12+ years in solution or enterprise architecture roles, including 3+ years focused specifically on AI/ML or generative AI solutions.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG architectures, prompt engineering, and vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector).
* Practical experience with at least one major cloud AI platform: Azure AI/OpenAI Service, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, or GCP Vertex AI.
* Solid understanding of MLOps practices — model versioning, CI/CD for ML, monitoring, and automated retraining pipelines.
* Proficiency in Python and familiarity with core ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Hugging Face).
* Strong grounding in data architecture, APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Working knowledge of responsible AI principles, data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR), and AI governance frameworks.
* Excellent communication skills — able to translate complex AI concepts for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Cloud AI certification (e.g., Azure AI Engineer Associate, AWS Certified Machine Learning – Specialty, Google Cloud Professional ML Engineer).
* Enterprise architecture certification (e.g., TOGAF), especially if the role will interface closely with the broader EA practice.
* Experience standing up an AI Center of Excellence or AI governance framework from scratch.
