title: Head of Data & Analytics (AI Native)
description:
**Who We Are**
Intrepid Asia is a leading Ecommerce and Digital Solutions Provider in South East Asia. We offer end-to-end omni-channel ecommerce management, Livestreaming, Video production & Affiliate Management for Social Commerce, plus full funnel Digital Marketing Services and advanced Market Intelligence, all powered by state-of-the-art in-house Technology to our client base of leading international brands across all key marketplaces and social platforms in all 6 SEA countries. Brands love our regional presence, our excellent data-driven, growth-focused services, enabled by the industry's strongest team, and our advanced marketing and tech capabilities.
  
  
We are growing rapidly, and as the exclusive partner of Flywheel in SEA, we offer many exciting opportunities to work with leading brands across multiple categories and key industry players. By joining us, you will work on the cutting edge of digital and social commerce in SEA, and experience what it takes to drive a successful ecommerce business end-to-end.
  
  
**The team you will be part of**
Our Tech Team is the engine behind our digital capabilities—designing and building the platforms, tools, and systems that power our services across the eCommerce ecosystem. From automation to optimization to data integration, the team turns complex challenges into seamless solutions, enabling scale, speed, and smarter decision-making. With innovation at its core, Tech drives the digital backbone of our business and empowers every function to perform at its best.
  
  
**Our Data & AI Vision**
We are building an AI-native data platform that:
  
  

* Unifies data across ecommerce, marketing, creators, and operations into a real-time, governed data foundation
* Moves beyond dashboards to deliver proactive, predictive, and prescriptive insights
* Enables AI-driven self-serve analytics for business users via natural language, copilots, and agents
* Powers autonomous decision-making and optimization across pricing, campaigns, inventory, and content
* Embeds machine learning and generative AI into core workflows (forecasting, recommendations, anomaly detection, content insights)
* Acts as the intelligence backbone of our internal tech platforms

Our current stack includes Google BigQuery, StarRocks, Airflow, DBT, Cube.dev (semantic layer), Looker Studio, and Apache Superset—and we are evolving this into a modern AI + data platform with real-time, ML, and agentic capabilities.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for a hands-on Head of Data & Analytics to lead the transformation from a traditional BI and data platform into an AI-driven intelligence platform.
  
  
**You will:**

* Own the end-to-end data, analytics, and AI strategy
* Build a platform that shifts the company from reporting → insights → actions → autonomous optimization
* Enable both internal teams and external clients with self-serve, AI-powered decision-making tools
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Business teams to embed intelligence into every workflow

**This role requires someone who is equally comfortable:**

* Defining data + AI strategy at the leadership level
* Designing modern data and ML architectures
* Driving real business impact through insights and automation

**Key Responsibilities**

* Data, Analytics & AI Strategy
* Define and execute the roadmap for an AI-native data platform aligned with Intrepid's product and business strategy
* Evolve the organization from dashboarding → proactive insights → autonomous intelligence systems
* Identify and prioritize high-impact opportunities across ML, GenAI, and agentic workflows in ecommerce, marketing, and social commerce
* Drive adoption of AI-powered self-serve analytics and copilots across business teams
* Data Platform, Architecture & Governance
* Own the design and evolution of the modern data stack, including:

+ Data warehouse/lakehouse (BigQuery, StarRocks)
+ Data pipelines (Airflow, DBT)
+ Semantic layer (Cube.dev)
+ BI tools (Looker Studio, Superset)

* Extend the platform to support:

+ Real-time and streaming data use cases for social commerce
+ Vector databases, MCP, and LLM integration layers

* Establish strong foundations for data governance, privacy, security, quality, lineage, and cataloging
* Ensure platform scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency
* AI, Machine Learning & Intelligent Systems
* Lead the development and deployment of:

+ Anomaly detection and automated insight systems
+ Generative AI use cases (copilots, automated reporting, content insights)
+ Recommendation systems (product, pricing, targeting)
+ Predictive models (forecasting, ROAS optimization, churn, inventory planning)

* Drive adoption of LLM-powered analytics (NL2SQL, conversational BI, insight generation)
* Build foundations for agentic AI systems that can autonomously analyze, recommend, and act
* Business Impact, Self-Serve & Team Leadership
* Transition from pull-based dashboards → push-based, actionable insights
* Enable business teams with:

+ Proactive alerts, recommendations, and decision support tools
+ Scenario simulation and planning capabilities

* Build AI-powered self-serve analytics experiences, reducing dependency on central teams
* Drive semantic layer adoption and metrics standardization across the organization
* Define and track impact metrics (e.g., GMV uplift, marketing efficiency, cost reduction, automation rates)
* Build and lead a high-performing data organization (Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, Data Science, BI)

Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and AI-first thinking, partnering closely with tech and business functions
  
  
**Requirements**
**Experience & Domain Expertise**

* 10+ years in data, analytics, and AI roles, with 3+ years in leadership
* Strong experience in ecommerce, marketplaces, martech, or digital platforms
* Proven track record building modern data platforms and scaling data teams
* Experience working in multi-country / SEA environments is a strong plus

**AI & Data Expertise**

* Deep expertise in the modern data stack:

+ BigQuery, DBT, Airflow, real-time pipelines, semantic layers

* Hands-on experience with:

+ Generative AI / LLMs (RAG, copilots, natural language interfaces)
+ Experimentation frameworks and causal inference
+ Machine learning (forecasting, optimization, recommendations)

* Familiarity with:

+ Feature stores, MLOps, vector databases, and AI orchestration frameworks

* Strong understanding of data modeling, governance, and scalable architecture

**Leadership & Ways of Working**

* Proven ability to build and lead multi-disciplinary data teams
* Strong communication skills; able to translate complex data/AI concepts into business value
* Highly analytical and structured thinker
* Comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments
* Collaborative, pragmatic, and outcome-driven

**Benefits**
**Why Join Intrepid Asia**

* Build the AI-powered intelligence engine for the future of ecommerce and social commerce in SEA
* Move beyond dashboards to autonomous, decision-making systems
* Work on real-world, high-scale data across marketplaces, creators, and marketing
* Be a key leader shaping AI-first transformation across the company
* Collaborate with top brands and platforms across Southeast Asia

If you're excited about building the AI-powered intelligence backbone for the next generation of ecommerce and social commerce in Southeast Asia, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
**In return, you will be getting**

* We are building 'the operating system for digital commerce in South East Asia' covering all key platforms, working with leading international brands, with a breadth and depth of functionalities (Middleware, OMS, Inventory mgmt, Store Ops, CX, MarTech, Data & Analytics) that few in the industry can match
* You get the chance to work on exciting SaaS projects and sophisticated features and functionalities that will make a big impact in the industry, on a top-notch scalable infrastructure
* Our Tech team has been around since 2017, so you will join a well-oiled and stable "machine" (= rockstar expert team), where processes are well established and enterprise-grade. But at the same time, our organisation is non-hierarchical, entrepreneurial and collaborative, and working on cool stuff, so you get the best of both worlds
* Tech is a strategic pillar for intrepid, so you will feel the love and recognition for your work, and will partner closely with business stakeholders, who as internal users of the tech will provide the real-world feedback and inputs which help to take our tech stack to the next level

**We also offer**
Best of Both Worlds
  
  
We are a scale up: the sophistication of a small multinational, with the agility of a start-up. This means you get to work on cutting-edge projects, and besides your 'standard' job description, we love to see you show entrepreneurial initiative and want to see your take on how you can take your role and our company to the next level. Good ideas get implemented. You are the master of your own destiny.
  
  
Culture that Brings Out the Best
  
  
At Intrepid, culture is not just a buzzword, it is what we practice at work every day. We believe in collaboration over competition, transparency over politics, and willingness to learn over ego. You will be part of a team where people genuinely support one another, celebrate wins together, and face challenges head-on as one. We put our all into the work but we balance it with fun, whether that is through team lunches, after-work hangouts, events or shared laughter in the office. This is a place where you can thrive professionally while having a great time.
  
  
Grow Without Limits
  
  
Learning at Intrepid is constant and dynamic. You will have access to formal training through face-to-face sessions, coaching and our very own Intrepid Academy. On top of that, real-world experience such as leading clients, working with advanced tech, and mastering best-in-class processes will accelerate your growth every step of the way. Surrounded by a talented team that raises the bar daily, in a rapidly growing and ever-expanding business, the opportunities for your development are endless.
  
  
Rewarding You Right
  
  
We believe great work deserves great rewards at Intrepid. That's why we offer competitive compensation and generous benefits, including comprehensive insurance and ample leave, to support you both in and out of the workplace. We want you to feel valued, cared for, and empowered to bring your best self to work every day.
  
  
*Note: We will not be accepting any unsolicited resumes or CVs from headhunting or recruitment agencies at this point. Any CVs or profiles shared with us will not be entertained, and in the event of dispute, Intrepid will not be liable for any material compensation to third parties.*

title: Service Representative - Automation
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Service Representative - Automation**

As a Service Representative - Automation, you will be one of Schneider Electric's technical experts at customer sites. You will deliver field services for industrial automation and control systems, helping customers improve equipment availability, process performance, cybersecurity awareness, and operational reliability through commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and lifecycle support.

You will work closely with customers, Services teams, and technical experts to resolve issues effectively and help ensure customer operations continue safely and efficiently.

**What will you do?**

* Install, configure, test, and commission industrial automation and control systems at customer sites.
* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial communication networks, variable speed drives, and related control equipment.
* Diagnose hardware, software, communication, and application issues; identify root causes and implement effective corrective actions.
* Back up, restore, and update system configurations, application programs, firmware, and technical documentation in accordance with approved procedures.
* Conduct functional tests, loop checks, system integration tests, and performance verification.
* Support modernization, migration, retrofit, and upgrade activities for installed automation systems.
* Apply appropriate change-control, access-control, and cybersecurity practices during field interventions.
* Respond to customer breakdowns and urgent technical issues, including escalation to product or application experts when required.
* Complete safety preparation and risk assessment before starting work at customer sites.
* Prepare accurate service reports, configuration records, and customer recommendations after each intervention.
* Maintain accurate work-order, service-activity, and installed-base information.
* Communicate technical findings and next steps clearly to customers and internal stakeholders.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

**Education**
-------------

* Minimum Diploma (D3) in a relevant engineering discipline, such as Electrical, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics, Mechanical, Refrigeration, or a closely related field appropriate to the specialization.
* Bachelor's degree (S1) in a relevant engineering discipline is an advantage.

**Experience**
--------------

* Hands-on experience in industrial automation, control-system commissioning, maintenance, troubleshooting, or field service.
* Experience with PLC, HMI, SCADA, industrial communication protocols, variable speed drives, control panels, and instrumentation is preferred.
* Exposure to Schneider Electric platforms such as Modicon, EcoStruxure Control Expert, EcoStruxure Machine Expert, AVEVA System Platform, or similar industrial automation platforms is an advantage.
* Fresh graduates with strong automation fundamentals and practical laboratory or internship experience may be considered for an entry-level position.

**Technical and Professional Skills**
-------------------------------------

* Strong understanding of industrial automation architecture, control logic, and electrical control systems.
* Ability to read control drawings, wiring diagrams, I/O lists, network architecture, and technical documentation.
* Basic programming and diagnostic capability for PLC, HMI, or SCADA systems.
* Understanding of Ethernet-based and serial industrial communication networks.
* Systematic troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capability.
* Comfortable using engineering software and digital field-service tools.
* Customer-focused communication and the ability to work independently at customer sites.
* Organized and able to manage urgent technical issues while following change-control procedures.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fluent in spoken and written Bahasa Indonesia.
* Working proficiency in English for technical documentation, manuals, training, and communication with technical experts.
* Willing and able to travel frequently to customer sites across Indonesia.
* Willing to work outside normal business hours, including standby, emergency service, weekends, or public holidays when required.
* Willing to work in industrial, commercial, data-center, and other customer-site environments and comply with site-specific HSE requirements.
* A valid Indonesian driving license appropriate to the role's mobility requirements is preferred.
* Relevant automation, industrial networking, cybersecurity, electrical, or HSE certification is an advantage.

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are hiring a
**Senior Machine Learning Engineer**
(SDE3) at Kredivo. This role carries meaningfully more leadership weight than a typical SDE3: beyond individual technical ownership, the successful candidate will mentor engineers, set technical direction within their domain, and influence delivery across teams. We are especially interested in candidates who can bring AI/LLM and agentic systems expertise to bear on real production problems (e.g. chatbots, OCR pipelines, RAG-based tooling) within Kredivo's high-availability fintech environment.
  
  
**About The Job**

* Own system design and architecture decisions for services within your domain, balancing correctness, scalability, and delivery speed.
* Drive code quality through hands-on contribution, thoughtful code review, and enforcement of engineering best practices.
* Mentor and coach engineers at all levels, actively developing the technical skills of the broader team.
* Set technical direction for your area and build consensus across engineering, product, and adjacent teams.
* Represent engineering in cross-team initiatives, influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate team's scope.
* Lead or significantly contribute to the design and delivery of AI-powered systems (LLM-based chat, RAG pipelines, OCR/document processing, agentic workflows).
* Ensure the reliability, availability, and throughput of production systems that operate at fintech scale.
* Use data analysis (SQL, Python) to inform engineering and product decisions, including debugging and root-causing production issues.

**Required Qualifications**

* Track record of leading system design, maintaining high code quality, and reliably delivering complex projects end-to-end.
* Strong leadership skills: demonstrated experience mentoring engineers, setting technical direction, and influencing outcomes across teams.
* Excellent communication skills, able to align stakeholders across engineering, product, and business functions.
* Solid computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and API/service design.
* Preferred Qualifications
* Hands-on exposure to AI/RAG/LLM systems and agentic architectures (e.g. building or operating chatbots, retrieval pipelines, tool-using agents).
* Experience designing and operating high-availability, high-throughput production systems, ideally in fintech or another regulated, latency-sensitive domain.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including for backend services, data pipelines, or AI/ML tooling.
* Strong SQL skills for data analysis. Comfortable querying, profiling, and drawing conclusions from large operational datasets.
* Experience with OCR pipelines or document-processing systems is a plus.

title: Cloud and Data Center Engineer (Surabaya)
description:
**About The Job Cloud And Data Center Engineer (Surabaya)**
**Meratus Group**
is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centers.
  
  
At Meratus, we are committed to digitalization, innovation, and transformation, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our customer-centric approach and agile operations empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.
  
  
We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive workplace, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.
  
  
**Position Overview : ﻿**
We are seeking a highly skilled and strategic
**Cloud and Data Center Engineer**
to design, implement, monitor, and optimize our cloud platforms and data center infrastructure. In this role, you will be instrumental in ensuring the high availability, robust security, scalability, and operational efficiency of our enterprise IT services.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Infrastructure Management: Administer, monitor, and optimize hybrid cloud environments and on-premise data center infrastructure to ensure enterprise services remain highly available and secure.
* Cost Optimization & TCO Management: Proactively identify and implement cloud and data center cost-saving initiatives (rightsizing, resource consolidation, and utilization improvements) without compromising performance or security.
* Financial & Budgetary Oversight: Analyze infrastructure spending trends, manage cloud consumption, and support corporate budget planning through detailed cost reporting and optimization dashboards.
* Lifecycle & Asset Management: Support the lifecycle management of infrastructure assets to maximize technology investment value and reduce total cost of ownership (TCO).
* Innovation & Evaluation: Keep abreast of emerging technologies and infrastructure solutions to continually improve operational efficiency and modernize existing systems.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Proven experience as a Cloud Engineer, Data Center Engineer, System Administrator, or in a similar infrastructure-focused role.
* Strong hands-on experience with major Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) and Hybrid Cloud architectures.
* Strong ability to analyze cloud billing, track infrastructure consumption metrics, and build data-driven cost optimization strategies.
* ﻿Deep understanding of on-premise data center infrastructure, virtualization platforms (e.g., VMware, Hyper-V), storage systems, and backup solutions.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation/orchestration tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible) and disaster recovery (DR) frameworks.﻿
extracted_skills: AWS, Azure, GCP, Terraform, Ansible, Cybersecurity

title: IT Cyber Security Manager
description:
**Description**
We are seeking a seasoned Cyber Security to own the end-to-end cybersecurity posture of the organization. This is a senior leadership role responsible for protecting a complex hybrid-cloud environment and converged IT/OT landscape (including manufacturing, IoT, and SCADA/ICS systems), while building and leading a high-performing security function across people, process, and technology. The role carries direct accountability for translating technical risk into business language for the C-Suite and Board of Directors.
  
  

* Define and lead the enterprise cybersecurity strategy and roadmap, aligning security investment with business risk and budget priorities.
* Build and mature a Zero Trust and SASE architecture, including ZTNA, micro-segmentation, and cloud-native secure access (CASB, FWaaS, SWG).
* Own security for converged IT/OT environments, applying the Purdue Model to segment industrial networks and manage ICS/SCADA security posture.
* Establish and scale an AI-driven Security Operations Center (SOC), integrating UEBA, AI-powered SOAR playbook automation, and proactive threat detection mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.
* Lead identity and endpoint security strategy: self-healing Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), passwordless authentication (FIDO2), and dynamic Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Drive secure software delivery by embedding Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), Kubernetes security, and automated DAST/SAST scanning into CI/CD pipelines.
* Govern enterprise risk and compliance across ISO 27001:2022, NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls v8, PCI-DSS, TISAX, DORA, and applicable privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, Indonesia's PDP Law).
* Report cybersecurity risk, incidents, and program maturity to the C-Suite and Board in clear, quantifiable financial and business terms.
* Recruit, mentor, and lead the security team; manage security budget, vendor relationships, and third-party risk.
* Own incident response planning, crisis management, and post-incident review for security events across IT and OT domains.

**Requirements**

* 12–15+ years of progressive enterprise cybersecurity experience, including significant time in a senior leadership capacity.
* Proven track record leading holistic security transformations spanning budget, people, and technology.
* Deep, hands-on expertise in Zero Trust architecture, SASE, and modern network security controls.
* Practical experience securing IT/OT convergence, manufacturing facilities, IoT, and industrial control systems.
* Strong background in AI-driven SecOps, SOAR automation, and threat intelligence operations.
* Working mastery of global governance frameworks: ISO 27001:2022, NIST CSF 2.0, CIS Controls v8, PCI-DSS, TISAX, DORA, and GDPR.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate technical cyber risk to non-technical executive and Board audiences.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.

**Preferred Certification**

* CISSP — Certified Information Systems Security Professional
* CISM — Certified Information Security Manager
* CISA — Certified Information Systems Auditor
* GICSP — Global Industrial Cyber Security Professional
* CCSP — Certified Cloud Security Professional
* CRISC — Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control
* GIAC GDSA — Defensible Security Architecture
* CEH / OSCP

title: Service Representative - Power
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Service Representative - Power**

As a Service Representative, you will be one of Schneider Electric's technical experts at customer sites. You will help customers maximize the safety, performance, reliability, and lifespan of their electrical installations through commissioning, preventive and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, modernization, and emergency support.

You will work closely with customers, Services teams, and technical experts to resolve issues effectively and help ensure customer operations continue safely and efficiently.

**What will you do?**

* Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on electrical equipment and systems.
* Install, test, and commission low- and medium-voltage electrical equipment up to 36 kV, in line with product scope and authorization.
* Troubleshoot electrical equipment, identify root causes, and implement effective corrective actions.
* Conduct technical inspections, testing, adjustments, diagnostics, and functional checks.
* Carry out modernization, retrofit, and upgrade activities for installed electrical equipment.
* Respond to customer breakdowns and urgent technical issues when required.
* Complete safety preparation and risk assessment before starting work at customer sites.
* Execute field activities in accordance with Schneider Electric safety, quality, and environmental requirements and applicable Indonesian regulations.
* Prepare accurate service reports and technical documentation after each intervention.
* Maintain accurate work-order, service-activity, and customer installed-base information.
* Communicate technical findings, recommendations, and next steps clearly to customers.
* Coordinate with Services teams and technical experts when escalation or additional support is required.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

**Education**
-------------

* Minimum Diploma (D3) in Electrical Engineering, Electromechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related technical discipline.
* Bachelor's degree (S1) in a relevant engineering discipline is an advantage.

**Experience**
--------------

* Hands-on experience in electrical maintenance, commissioning, troubleshooting, or field service in industrial, commercial, infrastructure, data center, utility, or similar environments.
* Exposure to LV/MV electrical distribution equipment, including switchgear, circuit breakers, protection systems, transformers, or related equipment, is preferred.
* Fresh graduates with strong hands-on technical capability may be considered for an entry-level position, depending on business needs.

**Technical and Professional Skills**
-------------------------------------

* Strong understanding of electrical systems and safe working practices.
* Ability to read electrical drawings, schematics, and technical documentation.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capability.
* Comfortable using digital tools for field-service documentation and reporting.
* Customer-focused with good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Able to work independently at customer sites and collaborate effectively with the wider Services team.
* Organized, disciplined, and able to prioritize multiple service activities.
* Able to remain effective when handling urgent customer or equipment issues.

**What We're Looking For**

* Fluent in spoken and written Bahasa Indonesia.
* Working proficiency in English for technical documentation, manuals, training, and communication with technical experts.
* Willing and able to travel frequently to customer sites across Indonesia.
* Willing to work outside normal business hours, including standby, emergency service, weekends, or public holidays when required.
* Willing to work in industrial and customer-site environments and comply with site-specific HSE requirements.
* A valid Indonesian driving license appropriate to the role's mobility requirements is preferred.
* Relevant electrical or HSE competency certification applicable to the assigned scope is an advantage.

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Systems Design / Architecture Engineer is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for participating in defining the architecture for large systems.
  
  
This role assists with conducting system design activities to ensure that architectural solutions meet technical and functional requirements.
  
  
The Systems Design / Architecture Engineer participates in architectural analysis, evaluation, and design of systems that support and seek to solve complex business and technical problems.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Conducts system design activities and reviews detailed application, software, and system components across a variety of technology stacks.
* Ensures that architectural solutions meet technical and functional requirements.
* Reviews existing system architecture and recommends improvements.
* Investigates and scopes change requests to determine the scale of work to be done and estimates the timeframe and input required.
* Determines system loads and volumes as input into infrastructure requirements.
* Ensures that proposed and existing systems architectures are aligned with the company’s goals and strategies.
* Ensures that new systems and solutions conform to current system architecture and/or align to strategic system architectural direction.
* Conducts architectural analysis, evaluation, and design of systems that support and seek to solve complex business and technical problems.
* Enables and ensures that system architecture is delivered in the form of robust and scalable solutions to business problems and needs.
* Identifies, evaluates, and assesses risks in order to mitigate them and eliminate any factor that may interfere or hinder the delivery of the architectural solution and dependent functional requirements.
* Implements processes for integrating architectural solutions.
* Implements architectural governance, standards, metrics for measuring, monitoring and improving architecture.
* Proactively identifies potential problems that could be remediated by more effective architectural solutions.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Business acumen with excellent communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to effectively deal with stakeholders in challenging situations.
* Ability to navigate through complexity and ambiguity.
* Seasoned knowledge of system architecture, design, and delivery.
* Seasoned understanding of regulatory requirements and organizational standards.
* Seasoned knowledge of the system design lifecycle models.
* Seasoned ability to design systems compatible with cloud computing architectures and selection of components.
* Seasoned ability to design and select system components.
* Excellent planning and decision-making skills.
* Excellent ability to use a variety of design tools.
* Seasoned understanding of software development practices, including Agile and CI/CD.
* Seasoned expertise in containerization technologies, such as Docker/Kubernetes.
* Seasoned expertise in data security and privacy best practices.
* Advanced knowledge of clean code concepts, design patterns, test driven (TDD) and behavioral driven development (BDD).

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field.
* Recommended certifications such as Cloud (Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Certified Solutions Architect); TOGAF preferred.

**Required experience:**

* Seasoned experience in similar IT roles, with a focus on system design / architecture engineering.
* Proven working experience in a large-scale organization.
* Seasoned experience, judgment and drive to plan, make decisions and accomplish individual and team goals.
* Seasoned experience with software development lifecycles.
* Seasoned experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
* Seasoned systems and/or software development experience is essential.
* Seasoned understanding of cloud-based architectures, preferably in popular cloud platforms (Azure, AWS).
* Proficiency in designing and implementing scalable, distributed, and high-performance systems.
* Seasoned knowledge of software design and architecture, ideally with experience dealing with large datasets.

**Workplace type:**
On-site Working
  
  
**About NTT DATA**
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.
  
  
**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**
NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters—whether in writing or by phone—in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an
**@nttdata.com**
email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please
*contact us*
.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
PT Bank Neo Commerce Tbk, formerly PT Bank Yudha Bhakti Tbk, is an Indonesia-based company primarily engaged in the banking business. The Company operates as a technology-based bank. The Company serves customers in the Small and Medium Business (SME), Retail (Consumer), and Mass Market segments, through banking products and services embedded in an ecosystem by optimizing technology.

**About this position**

The candidate that will succeed in this position will be able to create all the testing and automation frameworks as required for their projects. Thus, the candidate may have to work on multiple projects once, also working to improve the company's best practices from a testing a standpoint.

**What you will do**

1. Design, develop, and execute test cases for digital banking features.
2. Identify and report defects related to functionality, security, and performance.
3. Perform simulation testing for production defects, both before and after fixes are deployed.
4. Collaborate with the development team to ensure compliance with banking regulations.
5. Handle additional assignments as directed by the Quality Assurance Lead.

**What you will need**

Basic Requirements

1. 2-3 years of experience in software testing, with 1-2 years hands-on experience in automation
2. Experience in regulated or financial services environment
3. Understands payment flows (authorization vs posting, idempotency keys, retries), reconciliation impacts, and failure modes (timeouts, partial success)
4. Has an understanding of data privacy (UU PDP) basics
5. Experience in negative/abuse testing: rate limit, OTP misuse, tamper scenarios, etc.

Technical Skillset

1. Programming: Java/Typescript/Phyton
2. Web UI automation: Selenium WebDriver or Playwright/Cypress
3. Mobile automation: Appium (Android/iOS), device/emulator setup, basic device-farm use
4. API Testing & automation: REST/GraphQL, Postman + Newman or REST-Assured, schema validation (OpenAPI/Swagger), contract testing basics
5. Version control/Git: Branching, PR Reviews, merge strategies, tagging
6. Test design: risk-based testing, boundary/partitioning, state transition, BDD/Gherkin is a plus
7. Data & DB: SQL for validation, test data creation/anonymization
8. Reporting & observability: Grafana for reports, basic log tracing
9. Performance smoke: create lightweight k6/JMeter smoke/perf sanity

Should you be up to the challenge, don't hesitate to click apply!

* Experience handling real-world financial transactions in production environments.
* Understanding of payment security, audit trails, and controls for preventing inconsistent or duplicate financial transactions.
* Experience designing scalable and fault-tolerant systems for high-volume transaction processing.

title: Enterprise Security Engineer (SDE 2)
description:
You will run and maintain our security platforms, remediate vulnerabilities across the fleet, and harden our infrastructure using zero trust and secure-by-default principles. You will work with IT, DevOps and Engineering across Indonesia and internationally, and report to the Enterprise Security Lead.
  
  
**About The Job**
****Endpoint, Vulnerability & Patch Management****

* Deploy, manage and maintain security platforms: EDR, VMDR, DLP, Cloudflare (Zero Trust/WAF) and the Email Security Gateway.
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities in internal systems, and track remediation against SLA.
* Deploy patches and remediation scripts through MDM/RMM tools.
* Check that endpoint security agents are deployed and healthy across the fleet.

****Identity, SaaS & Cloud Hardening****

* Work with IT and DevOps to harden Cloud Directory, Google Workspace, VPN and other SaaS tools.
* Set up and maintain SSO, SCIM provisioning, MFA and access controls.
* Support security configuration reviews of AWS and GCP environments.
* Apply zero trust and secure-by-default practices in day-to-day work.

****Monitoring & Incident Support****

* Monitor internal and external systems for security threats, and triage and respond to alerts.
* Support Cyber Defense with containment actions during incidents.

****Security Awareness & Policy****

* Contribute to and enforce IT and Security policies and procedures.
* Run phishing simulations and support security awareness programs.
* Educate employees on data security, and advise them on securing endpoints, office AV and network infrastructure.

description:
**About us**

VTL Travel is a Singapore-based travel company that operates as the parent brand for a family of niche travel sites, each targeting a distinct segment of the travel market. Under the VTL Travel umbrella sit three focused brands: Holidays From Singapore, which handles leisure travel, nearby getaways, cruises, visa-related services, and corporate trips; Tour Mount Bromo, which specializes in East Java tours covering Mount Bromo, Ijen, waterfalls, and private tour packages; and Batam Ferry Tickets, which focuses on Singapore-to-Batam ferry ticket bookings and promotions.

**About the role**

We're looking for a hands-on web developer to maintain and grow batamferrytickets.com — a custom built site — and to build and manage the API integrations that power our booking, payment, and ferry booking API features. This is a practical, execution-focused role: keeping the site fast, secure, and bug-free, while connecting it reliably to the third-party systems our bookings depend on.

**Key responsibilities**

* Maintain and troubleshoot website, including API Updates and theme updates, performance tuning, and uptime/security monitoring
* Fix bugs, broken forms, layout issues, and mobile responsiveness problems as they arise
* Implement design and content changes from the marketing team without breaking page speed or SEO structure
* Manage staging-to-live deployment workflow to avoid downtime on a revenue-generating site
* Build and maintain the integration between the site and the ferry ticketing/booking system (availability, pricing, seat/ticket confirmation)
* Develop and maintain the hotel-booking module integration for combined ferry+hotel packages (hotel supplier or OTA API/feed)
* Maintain the payment gateway integration (HitPay or Airwallex) and troubleshoot failed or stuck transactions
* Connect and maintain WhatsApp Business API or click-to-WhatsApp flows for enquiry handling
* Set up and maintain GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking (events, server-side tagging where needed) so booking data flows correctly for marketing reporting
* Handle webhook endpoints and scheduled sync jobs (e.g. inventory/price sync) reliably, with logging and error alerts

**About you**

* 2+ years of experience Web Developer (PHP, custom functions, child themes, Payment Gateway Integration)
* Proven experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs, handling JSON, authentication (API keys, OAuth), and webhooks
* Good Practical skillset in API integration
* Experience with payment gateway integrations (HitPay, Stripe, PayNow, or similar)
* Comfortable working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Ads conversion tracking
* Solid understanding of website security (SSL, backups, firewall rules, malware cleanup)
* Familiar with git-based deployment workflows and staging environments
* Able to debug independently and document fixes clearly

Work Location: Remote

title: Project Delivery Manager
description:
Job Description

**Project Delivery Manager**
============================

Job Location: Bangkok

Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country

Req Id: 14310

Posting Start Date: 11/2/26

The Project Delivery Manager is responsible for leading end-to-end delivery of Data, AI, Analytics, and Digital Transformation projects, ensuring successful project execution from requirement discovery through deployment and handover, that involve working closely with our customers on-site.

The role combines project leadership, customer engagement, solution consulting, and hands-on platform delivery. The successful candidate is expected to work closely with customers to understand business challenges, translate requirements into practical solution approaches, and guide delivery teams toward successful implementation outcomes through Agile development .

A key expectation of this role is maintaining strong hands-on capability throughout the project lifecycle. At least over 50% of the role is expected to be hands-on solution exploration and prototyping, especially during discovery, requirement clarification, solution validation, and implementation activities. The candidate must be capable of independently utilizing our platforms, and related technologies to build prototypes, validate concepts, conduct technical experiments, and demonstrate potential solutions based on customer requirements in the course of providing advice and consultation to our customers .

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Hands-on Solution Design & Prototyping through Agile development utilizing LLMs
    
  + Independently conduct exploration analysis and solution validation activities, and consulting that delves deeply into issues to derive solutions.
  + Build prototypes and proof-of-concepts (PoC) to validate solution approaches.
  + Utilize Platforms, and related technologies to transform high-level business requirements into tangible working demonstrations.
  + Provide consulting, advise and create rapid prototypes during requirement discovery workshops to facilitate customer discussions.
  + Validate technical feasibility before implementation activities begin.
  + Develop mock-ups, workflows, ontology concepts, data pipelines, and analytical approaches to support solution discussions.
  + Demonstrate solution concepts directly to customers and project stakeholders.
  + Identify implementation risks and technical constraints through hands-on experimentation.
  + Support technical troubleshooting and design reviews during implementation.
  + Collaborate closely with architects and engineers to refine solution designs.
* Project Delivery Management in Agile Development
    
  + Lead end-to-end project delivery from initiation to closure.
  + Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, resource allocations, and delivery governance.
  + Ensure deliverables are completed on time, within budget, and according to quality standards.
  + Track project progress and proactively resolve project issues.
  + Manage project scope, dependencies, assumptions, and change requests.
  + Ensure project milestones and customer commitments are achieved.
* Risk & Issue Management
  + Identify delivery risks and develop mitigation strategies.
  + Manage project dependencies and escalation paths.
  + Maintain project governance and reporting standards.
  + Escalate delivery-critical issues to management when appropriate.
  + Monitor quality, compliance, and project controls.
* Quality & Customer Success
  + Ensure all deliverables meet customer expectations and contractual requirements.
  + Coordinate testing, deployment, user acceptance testing (UAT), and production release activities.
  + Drive successful transition to operations and support teams.
  + Conduct project retrospectives and lessons learned sessions.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Act as the primary delivery contact for customers throughout the project lifecycle.
* Lead requirement gathering workshops and business discovery sessions.
* Understand customer business challenges and translate them into actionable solution approaches.
* Facilitate alignment between business stakeholders, technical teams, and project sponsors.
* Drive decision-making and issue resolution during project execution.
* Build trusted advisor relationships with customer stakeholders.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* On-time project delivery
* Budget adherence
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Project profitability and margin achievement
* Successful customer adoption
* Risk mitigation effectiveness
* Requirement-to-solution conversion efficiency
* Prototype and solution validation success rate
* Successful deployment and handover

**Desired Experience, Knowledge & Attributes**

* Minimum 5-8 years of experience in IT project delivery, solution consulting, or digital transformation programs.
* Proven experience in user application development projects and delivery.
* Experience in deeply understanding customer's business (Business Processes), organizing and modelling it, and designing and developing it as an IT application
* Experience managing Agile projects, conducting solution validation, prototyping, or proof-of-concept activities in Agile projects.
* Demonstrated experience balancing project management responsibilities with hands-on technical delivery.
* Experience working with prompt engineering, validation, evaluation, and setting up development environments for AI-driven development using LLMs.
* Broad technical understanding of AI (algorithms, data structures, design, security, infrastructure)
* Experience working directly with enterprise customers and senior stakeholders.

Relocation Supported: No

Visa Sponsorship Approved: No

title: Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC) Analyst (English Speaker)
description:
**About BTSE**
BTSE Group is a global leader in fintech and blockchain technology, anchored by three core business pillars: Exchange, Payments, and Infrastructure Development. Serving over 100 corporate clients worldwide, we provide white-label exchange and payment solutions. Our offerings encompass everything from exchange infrastructure hosting and development to custody, wallets, payments, blockchain integration, trading, and more. We are looking for talented professionals in marketing, operations, customer support, and other departments. The roles offered may be on-site, remote, or hybrid, in collaboration with our local partner.
  
  
**About The Opportunity**
We are seeking a Cyber Security Operations Center (CSOC) Analyst with 3-4 years of experience in security monitoring, detection engineering, and incident response to join a lean, high-ownership security team at a cryptocurrency exchange. You will work closely with our MSSP and internal engineering team to close gaps between raw alerting and actual risk reduction — turning threat intel feeds into action, validating that our detections actually work, and helping build out new programs like insider threat monitoring. This is not a pure alert-queue role: you'll be expected to write and improve detection logic, document your work so it survives beyond you, and take ownership of incidents end-to-end rather than handing off after triage.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform triage, analysis, and escalation of security alerts across SIEM, EDR/XDR, WAF, email security, and cloud log sources, coordinating with our MSSP where relevant.
* Own incidents end-to-end — triage through resolution through "what changed afterward" — and turn that work into documented playbooks and updated detection logic, not just closed tickets.
* Develop, tune, and validate SIEM detection rules (ES|QL/EQL/KQL or equivalent), including running detection validation exercises against existing use cases to confirm they actually fire.
* Convert threat intelligence feeds and scheduled hunting queries (e.g., lookalike domain alerts, anomalous auth events) from passive detection into defined, actionable response — closing the loop between "we saw it" and "we did something about it."
* Support the build-out of an insider threat monitoring program, including identity and privileged-access anomaly detection.
* Understand our detection tooling and log source pipelines (maintained day-to-day by our MSSP) well enough to confirm they're onboarded correctly and actually working — you're not expected to build or maintain this tooling yourself, but you need to be able to verify it.
* Track and report CSOC performance metrics (MTTD/MTTR, false-positive rates, MSSP SLA adherence) to support continuous improvement of operations.
* Write and maintain operational documentation, playbooks, and detection rule rationale so institutional knowledge isn't concentrated in one or two people.
* Contribute to automation of repetitive triage and enrichment work (scripting, workflow tools) to reduce manual toil across the team.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders and regional partners, where Chinese language skills may be required.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 3-4 years of experience in a Security Operations Center (SOC) or equivalent security monitoring/detection engineering role.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM tools, including: 1. Detection rule and use case development, and the ability to reason about whether a rule actually detects what it claims to (detection validation mindset, not just rule-writing). 2. Query/rule-writing experience in ES|QL, EQL, KQL, or equivalent. 3. Alert triage, enrichment, and case management with ticketing systems. 4. Comfort reading raw logs (auth events, CloudTrail-style audit logs, process trees) without relying solely on pre-built dashboards.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar scripting for automation, log parsing, or extending existing tooling — enough to pick up and modify scripts someone else wrote, not build from scratch.
* Knowledge of common attack techniques, malware behavior, and network security principles, with familiarity mapping detections to MITRE ATT&CK.
* Familiarity with incident response frameworks (e.g., NIST, SANS) and a track record of writing playbooks or documentation from real incidents.
* Exposure to identity/IAM log analysis or insider threat / UEBA concepts is a strong plus, given active program build-out.
* Good understanding of cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and comfort across varied operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS).

**Nice to Haves**

* Familiarity with atomic-level adversary emulation using Atomic Red Team or equivalent framework, for the purpose of validating that detections fire as expected.
* Effective communication and documentation skills.
* Chinese language proficiency (reading, writing, and/or speaking) is a strong advantage.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CompTIA Security+, CySA+, CEH, or similar) are desirable.

**Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive total compensation package.
* Various team-building programs and company events.
* And many more! Apply and let us tell you more!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: SAMPOERNA ACADEMY - OPERATIONS STAFF
description:
**Company Description**
-----------------------

**SAMPOERNA ACADEMY**

Our teaching philosophy encourages students to inquire, explore, innovate and communicate, providing vital skills required for leadership in Indonesia and abroad. Coupled with internationally-recognized academic credentials, we are equipping our students to compete and succeed at every stage of life. With the advent of the information age available at our finger-tips, our job as a school is to teach our students “to learn how to learn”.

Drawing from the world’s best curricula and American-based STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math) methodologies, we are equipping our students with global exposure and an internationally-recognized academic qualification.

Our environment was created to encourage a culture of innovation and collaboration. Moreover, our integration of communication, multiple language proficiency, and collaboration in team projects set us apart from most other schools in ASEAN.

**Vision**

Sampoerna Academy graduates will assume leadership roles in a global society by being creative, passionate, life-long learners who are able to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing world and who care deeply for their fellow men and the environment.

**Mission**

The mission of Sampoerna Academy is to provide a safe, caring, and collaborative learning environment that is of the highest quality and meets global expectations for student achievement and character development. Our educational foundation is student-centered with a strong emphasis on Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM) which enables students to become mature, confident global citizens with a strong sense of purpose. Our end goal is to prepare students for tertiary education and to make them work-ready and world-ready.

**Core Beliefs**

* Academically, we prioritize the development of cognitive skills and communication skills over rote memorization because we believe that more than acquiring facts, students must be able to apply their knowledge in real situations.
* We seek opportunities to engage all stakeholders to play a part in the success of our students.
* We maintain a strong Asian cultural value system that celebrates social harmony, order, and respect.
* STEAM competency will differentiate our students from those attending other schools.
* Our learning spaces are a platform for hands-on activities, exploration, inquiry and the creation of knowledge and dialogue.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Arranging School daily operation services:

* Room/facilities arrangement for schedule, availability in coordination with Academic
* Managing facility/venue renting procedure with third partied (controlling the schedule and venue availability to maximize revenue)
* Managing outside vendor such canteen and FB vendor on daily basis and on certain event
* School Shuttle Bus arrangement for daily schedule and other needs for school and office
* Operational car & taxi arrangement for schedule based on needs and priority.
* Providing and arranging school and office daily needs ATK, Water, etc.
* Supporting Academic team for providing material needs in every terms.
* Providing and arranging students’ needs daily books, uniform in SASHOP and meals (catering) in coordination with catering vendor.
* Travel Arrangement: arranging airplane & hotel for any business trip requested by academic or under GA Budget.
* Create transaction in Oracle system: Purchase Request, Reimbursement & Cash Advance Request, and Travel Allowance including the realization.
* Other administrative needs and other non-daily services for school & office

Building Facility and Maintenance:

* Maintaining building facilities to provide comfort and appropriateness in coordination with Engineering and vendor.
* Managing cleaner outsource in providing services and making sure the cleanliness of building and facility in standard.
* Managing security cleaner outsource in providing services and making sure the security and safety in standard and making sure all asset safe.
* Managing other outside vendor (pest control, pool, and elevator) to provide service and make sure all the facility maintains and working in accordance with school standards and safety.
* Plan and monitor maintenance schedule is in place in coordination with engineering.
* Doing daily walkaround in all property area to make sure all-in place in accordance with “PATROL” system application and standard and follow up any issue and making sure it will be fixed.
* Resolving complaints, problems, and requests related with building and facilities.

Budget & Inventory Management

* Take good care of stocks, inventory, and other equipment. Maintain inventory and supplies for daily operation.
* Doing Stock Opname process on monthly basis in coordination with finance and make sure stock vs inventory system are balance.
* Controlling budget vs actual on daily operation when creating PR on the system
* Assisting Academic to create PR, RM and CA on the system.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Minimum Diploma/Bachelor in any field.
* Minimum 1 year working experience with educational institutions or comparable organizations.
* Have good communication and positive person, attention to detail, ability to juggle multiple priorities and maintain clear documentation
* Have knowledge and experiences on Operation process and Administration, especially on School Operation process.
* Have skill and knowledge on administration and inventory, and also familiar with the system software of inventory
* Have knowledge and experiences on Building and Facilities Maintenance
* Able to operate Ms. Office (Excel, word)
* Ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem solving environment
* Willing to work together as a team, and minimum supervision when needed

**Additional Information**
--------------------------

**Available to start immediately.**

title: Business Intelligence
description:
**Responsibilities**
**About The Role**
At Tentang Anak, decisions should start from data people trust. You will turn raw organizational data into accurate, actionable insight so teams decide faster and operate better, owning each problem from the first question to the decision it changes.
  
  
Scope: an independent individual contributor who leads analyses end to end and raises the bar for junior analysts. Not a people-manager role.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* ﻿Ship BI that drives decisions: design, build and maintain dashboards that leaders use for strategic and operational calls.
* Turn data into recommendations: partner with stakeholders to frame the question and land a clear “so what.”
* Make teams self-sufficient: build automation and self-service analytics so stakeholders don’t wait on BI.
* Find the bottlenecks: review past operational performance to surface patterns, flag bottlenecks and project future market behavior.
* Keep the numbers trustworthy: run regular data refreshes and audits so business continuity, compliance and logic mapping hold up.
* Move the P&L: identify and track the levers that improve operational efficiency and profitability.
* See the market first: track industry shifts, consumer behavior and competitor moves so the brand acts ahead of trends, not after them.

**Requirements**
**Must-haves**

* 5+ years as a Business Intelligence or Data Analyst.
* A proven track record of turning data into decisions. Show us the decision, not just the dashboard.
* Expert-level SQL for querying and manipulating large, complex datasets.
* The ability to explain complex insight clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Comfort with ambiguous problems; you scope and build custom analyses without a template.
* Strong business acumen, a proactive and results-oriented mindset, and genuine curiosity about how AI and automation can reshape analytics work.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Experience in the FMCG industry.
* Exposure to AI/LLM-assisted workflows, such as prompt engineering, working with AI agents or copilots, or evaluating model and agent outputs.
* Hands-on experience with BigQuery and Looker, or similar tools.

**Senior Software Engineer**

description:
**Data Analyst**

**PT Ayo Indonesia Maju (Ayo)**

**About Ayo**

Ayo is Indonesia's largest sports venue booking and community platform. We connect close to a million players with over 2,100 venue partners across the country — badminton, futsal, padel, tennis, mini soccer and more.

We run two businesses at once: a SaaS product that venues use to manage their operations, and a marketplace where players book courts and join open play sessions.

**Why this role exists**

We have a lot of data, but we're only scratching the surface of what it can tell us.

title: Senior Enterprise Security Engineer (SDE 3)
description:
Kredivo Group is looking for a Senior Security Engineer to lead day-to-day Enterprise Security work. This is a hands-on role. You will own the security of our endpoints, identity, SaaS, network and cloud, and you will guide junior security engineers on the team. You will deploy and run our security platforms, remediate vulnerabilities across the fleet, and harden our corporate environment using zero trust and secure-by-default principles. You will work with IT, DevOps and Engineering across Indonesia, and international, and support Cyber Defense during incidents.  
  
**About the Job**:

Cyber Defense Strategy & Leadership

* Enterprise Security BAU work and projects, and help set the team's roadmap.
* Mentor and coach SDE-1 and SDE-2 engineers, and review their configurations, scripts and remediation work.
* Set priorities by risk, and track and report security posture metrics (patch compliance, EDR coverage, vulnerability SLA, phishing click rate) to the Enterprise Security Lead.
* Write, maintain and enforce IT and Security policies, standards and procedures.

Endpoint, Vulnerability & Patch Management

* Administer and tune the security platforms: EDR, VMDR, WAF and the Email Security Gateway.
* Run vulnerability management end to end: scanning, prioritization (CVSS, CISA KEV, Ransomware), remediation and SLA tracking across Windows, macOS and Linux.
* Build and safely deploy patch and remediation automation through MDM tools.
* Keep endpoint security agents deployed and healthy across the fleet.

Identity, SaaS & Cloud Hardening

* Work with IT and DevOps to harden Cloud Directory, Google Workspace, VPN and other SaaS tools.
* Design and review IAM controls: SSO (SAML, OAuth/OIDC), SCIM provisioning, MFA, conditional access, least privilege and access reviews.
* Apply zero trust and secure-by-default models in architecture decisions for knowledge workers and developers.
* Monitoring & Incident Support, Monitor internal and external systems for threats, triage alerts, and respond to them.
* Support Cyber Defense during incidents with containment actions such as isolation, account suspension and blocking.
* Run phishing simulations and security awareness programs, and measure the results.
* Advise employees on how to keep endpoints, office AV and network infrastructure secure.
* Automate security operations and reporting using Python, Bash or PowerShell.
* Evaluate new security tools, including AI-assisted tools, and support AI Security initiatives.
* Support ISO 27001:2022 and regulatory audits (e.g. OJK) by providing evidence, remediating gaps and maintaining controls.

**About You:**

  

* At least 5 years of cyberdefense security experience, preferably in a startup or fintech environment.
* Hands-on experience deploying and managing EDR, vulnerability and patch management, DLP, network security and phishing simulation tools.
* Strong knowledge of identity and access management frameworks and protocols (SAML, OAuth/OIDC, SCIM).
* Experience securing Google Workspace, directory services, VPN and SaaS platforms.
* Experience with public cloud providers (AWS, GCP).
* Good scripting skills (Python, Bash or PowerShell).
* Knowledge of modern adversary tactics, techniques and procedures (MITRE ATT&CK).
* Experience mentoring engineers or leading small workstreams or projects.
* Good English communication skills.  
    
  #LI-AF1

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description:
**Company Overview**

Wego is an online travel metasearch platform used by millions to find the best flights and hotel deals. We are seeking a talented, agile Marketing Automation & AI Engineer with a strong focus on Agentic AI to join our MarTech team.

**Role Description**

As part of the Marketing Technology (MarTech) team, you will build the next generation of marketing automation - designing and deploying autonomous AI agents that drive insights from digital campaigns and independently optimize marketing operations. You will work daily alongside the Performance Marketing team, deeply understanding their KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates) and how media platforms work, their campaign structures, auction mechanics, and APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Apple Search Ads) to ensure every system you build directly serves campaign performance goals.  
  
Unlike traditional, rigid backend data roles focused solely on static data lakes, this position requires building highly adaptable, configuration-driven automation systems. You will design architectures that allow the Performance Marketing team to quickly pivot campaign strategies, creative assets, and budget pacing without needing structural core code deployments for every minor requirement change.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Campaign Creation & Optimization Automation:** Architect end-to-end automated workflows for campaign creation, audience segmentation, creative assembly, launch, and continuous optimization using AI/ML signals to drive dynamic bidding, budget pacing, and A/B testing across channels.
* **AI-Driven Content Orchestration:** Engineer multi-agent systems to generate and iterate on personalized ad content (ad copy, images, videos) at scale.
* **Agile Data Activation & Automation Infrastructure:** Build and maintain flexible data flows optimized for real-time marketing activation. Ensure data structures are explicitly designed for dynamic content generation and automated campaign adjustment rather than just static reporting or legacy ETL pipelines.
* **Performance Marketing Collaboration:** Partner daily with the Performance Marketing team to translate KPIs and rapidly changing campaign objectives into technical configurations; ensure data integrity, API reliability, and consistent AI agent deployments across all paid channels.
* **Agentic Workflow Development:** Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents using LLMs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) for automated marketing workflows.

**Qualifications**  
  
**Experience & Domain Expertise**

* 3+ years in performance/digital marketing analytics and marketing automation with hands-on experience in AI engineering.
* Deep understanding of paid/performance marketing KPIs, how media platforms work (campaign structure, auction mechanics, targeting, measurement) and their APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok), and MMP tooling (AppsFlyer, Adjust).
* Proven experience building end-to-end campaign automation systems including programmatic campaign creation, ML-driven optimization, and automated actions via ad platform APIs.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced SQL and Python.
* Proven experience building configuration-driven architectures or rules engines (e.g., headless CMS integrations, dynamic creative optimization tools), attribution models, and activation workflows.
* Proficiency building and orchestrating AI agents using foundational LLMs; integrating LLMs and AI agents with external tools and APIs.

**Soft Skills & Mindset**

* Extreme flexibility and comfort with ambiguity: Understands that marketing strategies pivot quickly and intentionally designs technical solutions to accommodate fluid business requirements.
* Strong product mindset: Views the marketing team as your core "users" and builds tools that empower them to self-serve safely.
* Excellent communication skills to seamlessly bridge technical architectures with creative marketing strategies.
