title: IoT Project Engineer
description:
**Company Summary:**  
Since 2002, DVI Solutions has been a leading provider of audio-visual setups to help our clients communicate and collaborate better-whether it's with colleagues across the office, or partners on the other side of the world. We have presence across Japan, Singapore, Thailand, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Philippines, Vietnam, India, Malaysia and Indonesia. Our satisfied clients include corporations, government agencies, schools, retail stores, hotels and many more.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a skilled and hands-on **IoT Project Engineer** to support the deployment, integration, and commissioning of IoT solutions.

In this role, you will work closely with project and installation teams to ensure the successful implementation of IoT sensors and devices across on-premises and cloud environments. You will also collaborate with software development teams to facilitate seamless integration with IoT platforms, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure reliable system performance.

The ideal candidate possesses strong technical knowledge of IoT technologies, practical experience in sensor configuration and commissioning, and excellent project coordination skills.

***Key Responsibilities***

**IoT Deployment & Commissioning**

* Support the installation, configuration, testing, and commissioning of IoT sensors, gateways, and connected devices.
* Work closely with project and installation teams to ensure successful deployment of IoT solutions at customer sites.
* Configure and troubleshoot IoT devices across on-premises and cloud environments.
* Conduct system testing and validation to ensure functionality, connectivity, and performance meet project requirements.
* Provide on-site technical support during deployment, commissioning, and post-installation activities.

**System Integration & Technical Troubleshooting**

* Collaborate with software development teams to integrate IoT devices and sensors with cloud-based or on-premises platforms.
* Support integration using IoT communication protocols, APIs, and networking technologies.
* Diagnose and resolve issues relating to sensor connectivity, data transmission, device configuration, and platform integration.
* Coordinate with internal technical teams and external vendors to troubleshoot and resolve system-related issues.
* Ensure reliable data communication between IoT devices, gateways, and software platforms.

**Project Engineering & Coordination**

* Work closely with project managers, engineers, and installation teams to coordinate IoT implementation activities.
* Review technical drawings, system layouts, and installation requirements using AutoCAD.
* Assist in project planning, resource coordination, scheduling, and progress tracking to ensure timely delivery.
* Participate in site surveys, technical discussions, and project meetings with internal stakeholders and customers.
* Identify potential technical challenges and recommend practical solutions to ensure successful project execution.

**Documentation & Quality Assurance**

* Prepare and maintain technical documentation, including system configurations, installation drawings, commissioning reports, and troubleshooting records.
* Ensure all deployed systems comply with project specifications, technical standards, and customer requirements.
* Support system handover, user training, and post-implementation technical assistance.
* Maintain accurate records of project activities, technical issues, and resolutions.

  
**Requirements**  

* **3+ years of relevant experience** in IoT implementation, system integration and project engineering.
* Proven hands-on experience in deploying, configuring, and commissioning IoT sensors, gateways, and connected devices.
* Practical experience with sensor configuration and commissioning across **on-premises and cloud environments**.
* Proficiency in **AutoCAD** for reviewing, interpreting, and preparing technical drawings.
* Good understanding of **IoT communication protocols** such as MQTT, Modbus, BACnet, TCP/IP, or HTTP.
* Familiarity with **APIs and system integration**, including REST APIs and data communication between IoT devices and software platforms.
* Strong project coordination skills with the ability to work effectively across engineering, installation, and software development teams.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a hands-on, problem-solving mindset.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple project activities in a fast-paced environment.

**Why Join us**

* Opportunities to work on regional projects with global brands.
* Exposure to multinational clients, cross-border teams, and cutting-edge technology.
* Exposure to solutions that include immersive video walls, hybrid meeting tech, collaboration tech, digital transformation, smart workspace integration and much more.
* Involved in custom projects for high-profile clients, DVI offers opportunities to expand your portfolio and build a specialized skill set.
* A booming industry with the rise of hybrid workspaces and smart office solutions.

description:
* Pendidikan minimal S1 Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.
* Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1–2 tahun sebagai IT Project Manager (Junior)
* Memimpin dan mengelola proyek pengembangan solusi Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Generative AI, dan Digital Transformation dari tahap perencanaan hingga implementasi.
* Menyusun dan mengelola Project Charter, Project Plan, timeline, budget, resource plan, serta risk register untuk memastikan proyek berjalan sesuai target.
* Berkolaborasi dengan Product Owner, Business Analyst, Data Scientist, AI Engineer, Data Engineer, Software Developer, dan stakeholder bisnis dalam menentukan kebutuhan serta prioritas proyek.
* Memastikan seluruh hasil pekerjaan proyek memenuhi standar kualitas, keamanan, dan kepatuhan perusahaan.
* Mengelola komunikasi dan hubungan dengan stakeholder internal maupun eksternal, termasuk vendor, partner teknologi, dan manajemen.
* Menyusun laporan perkembangan proyek secara berkala kepada Steering Committee, Executive Management, dan stakeholder terkait.
* Memastikan solusi AI yang dikembangkan sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis, regulasi perusahaan, dan prinsip Responsible AI Governance.
* Melakukan evaluasi setelah implementasi proyek (Post Implementation Review) serta mengidentifikasi lesson learned untuk meningkatkan proses dan pelaksanaan proyek berikutnya.

**Kualifikasi:**

* Menguasai framework Agile seperti scrum, kanban, SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) dan Lean Agile Practices.
* Memiliki pengalaman sebagai Scrum Master, Product Owner, atau Agile Project Manager menjadi nilai tambah.
* Memahami siklus pengembangan perangkat lunak (SDLC) dan DevOps Lifecycle.
* Berpengalaman menggunakan tools manajemen proyek Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Project dan Trello / Asana.
* Memahami konsep Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), dan Generative AI.
* Memiliki pengalaman memimpin implementasi salah satu atau lebih teknologi seperti AI Chatbot, Large Language Models (LLM), Predictive Analytics, Computer Vision, Natural Language Processing (NLP) dan Intelligent Automation.
* Memahami proses AI Project Lifecycle seperti Data Collection, Data Preparation, Model Training, Model Validation, Deployment dan Monitoring & Continuous Improvement.
* Memahami integrasi AI dengan platform cloud seperti Microsoft Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS AI/ML Services dan Google Cloud AI.
* Memiliki kemampuan dalam penyusunan seperti Project Charter, Business Requirement Document (BRD), Functional Specification, Project Plan, Risk Register dan Project Status Report.
* Berpengalaman mengelola proyek dengan anggaran dan tim lintas fungsi (Cross Functional Team).
* Memahami manajemen risiko, kualitas, perubahan (Change Management), serta tata kelola proyek IT.
* Memiliki kemampuan stakeholder management dan executive reporting yang baik.
* Memahami prinsip keamanan informasi, data privacy, dan AI Governance.

Location:

title: Salesforce Developer / Technical Specialist
description:
### **Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Salesforce Developer / Technical Specialist to join our core technical team. In this role, you will take technical ownership in designing, building, and deploying robust Salesforce solutions, with a strong focus on Service Cloud. You will work closely with project leads and enterprise stakeholders to deliver complex business logic, modern user interfaces, and scalable system integrations that drive tangible operational outcomes.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy end-to-end Salesforce solutions aligned with complex business requirements and architectural best practices.
* Develop custom business logic and user interfaces using Apex (classes/triggers), Lightning Web Components (LWC), and advanced Salesforce Flow automations.
* Architect and manage secure, efficient integrations between Salesforce and third-party systems via REST/SOAP APIs.
* Conduct code reviews, debugging, system testing, and performance optimization in full compliance with platform governor limits.
* Manage environment release workflows and deployment cycles across Sandboxes and Production environments.
* Partner with delivery leads, functional consultants, and client stakeholders during technical discovery and delivery phases.
* Produce structured technical design documentation and conduct technical knowledge transfer sessions where required.

### **Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on technical experience within the Salesforce ecosystem across implementation and development lifecycles.
* Strong proficiency in programmatic development (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL) combined with advanced declarative capabilities (Flows, Security Model, Data Architecture).
* Direct experience handling REST/SOAP API integrations and data migration workflows using tools such as Data Loader.
* Demonstrated analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills for complex technical challenges.
* Clear, professional verbal and written communication skills to convey technical trade-offs to stakeholders.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Proven hands-on implementation experience with Salesforce Service Cloud (Case Management, Omni-Channel, Service Console, Knowledge Base).
* Active Salesforce certifications: Platform Developer I (PDI), Platform App Builder, or Salesforce Administrator.
* Familiarity with code management tools (Git) and structured release management.

### **What We Offer**

* Strong technical ownership, with ample opportunities to take initiative, explore ideas, and directly contribute to system architecture, design, and technical solution approaches through collaboration.
* Ongoing encouragement and support for professional development and industry credentials.
* An agile, collaborative, and close-knit environment.

**About Progrez**

Progrez is an IT consulting company specializing in DevOps and ITSM solutions. We are passionate about driving organizations to adapt and unlock new possibilities through innovative technology solutions. By partnering with our customers, we help them streamline their IT operations,enhance efficiency, and achieve their business goals.

At Progrez, we believe in fostering a growth oriented and collaborative environment. We encourage open communication at all levels and empower our employees to contribute their ideas and expertise. As a growing company with a team dedicated professionals, we value teamwork, continuous learning, and a shared passion for technology.

We are committed to staying at the forefront of the IT industry, constantly exploring new technologies and methodologies to deliver cutting-edge solutions to our customers. Our mission is to be a trusted advisor and partner, guiding our customers on their digital transformation journey and helping them achieve sustainable success.

title: [Talent Pool] Forward Deployment Engineer
description:
**Summary**

Sit with the business, and turn a commercial ask into production software on a live consumer journey — in days, not quarters. FDEs are the people who make insourcing real: they take a journey currently delivered by a vendor and stand up an owned, instrumented, agent-ready replacement.

**What you will do**

* Build and extend insourced platforms — commercial catalogue, cross-brand product release, loan and lending, OTT gateway, conversational commerce.
* Own one consumer journey end-to-end: API, service, data contract, front-end surface, dashboards, on-call.
* Work AI-native by default — agentic coding tools for delivery, and agent frameworks with evals inside the product itself.

* Replace vendor-managed flows: reverse-engineer, write the parity test suite, run the dual-run, cut over without customer impact.
* Sit in the business review, not just the sprint review — take the requirement first-hand and push back on it.
* Leave the work operable: runbooks-as-code, SLOs, cost-per-transaction visible before launch.

**Grade expectations**

**FDE1**

Staff Engineer

**SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS :**
One service or journey slice. Makes implementation calls inside an agreed design; escalates contract changes.

**ACCOUNTABLE FOR :**
Shipped, tested, observable code. Their share of the on-call rota. Story-level estimates that hold.

**FDE2**

Senior Staff Engineer

**SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS :**
A journey family across several platforms. Owns the design, sequences the cutover, approves peers' designs, sets the agent and eval pattern for the domain.

**ACCOUNTABLE FOR :**
Journey SLOs and unit cost. A vendor-to-insource cutover delivered without regression. Growth of 3–5 FDEs.

**FDE3**

AVP, Forward Deployment

**SCOPE & DECISION RIGHTS :**
Engineering for a business vertical. Build-vs-buy calls, team shape, tooling standards, spend inside an agreed envelope.

**ACCOUNTABLE FOR :**
Portfolio delivery and build ratio. Capex/opex outcome for the vertical. Hiring and retaining the pod.

**Engineering must-haves**

* Strong production code in at least one of Java, Go, Kotlin, Python or Node/TypeScript.
* API and event design — REST/GraphQL, Kafka, idempotency, backward-compatible contracts.
* Cloud-native on GCP or equivalent: Kubernetes, IaC, CI/CD, progressive delivery.
* Observability as a habit: traces, SLOs, error budgets.
* LLM/agent engineering: tool-calling, retrieval, guardrails, evaluation harnesses.

**Telecom domain must-haves**

* Worked inside telco BSS: CRM, product catalogue, order-to-activate, charging, mediation, or digital channels.
* Understands prepaid economics — balance, validity, top-up, bundles, loans, and why a failed charge is a revenue event.
* Familiar with TM Forum Open APIs / ODA, eSIM, USSD and IN interaction models.
* Has shipped for high-volume consumer traffic with campaign-driven peaks.
* Multi-brand or multi-LOB product structures (mobile, FTTH, FWA, OTT) an advantage.

title: Senior TechOps & Release Automation Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
Our team operates at the intersection of partner experience, platform reliability, and release execution. We manage DevHome and the operational systems that support partner onboarding, access, documentation publishing, and partner-facing product releases across mobile and web surfaces.
  
  
This team focuses on more than feature development. A large part of our work is making sure critical platforms remain stable, secure, and operationally efficient. That means managing incidents, improving deployment safety, maintaining infrastructure, and building automation that removes manual work from daily operations.
  
  
As part of the team, you will work closely with various departments, including Engineering, QA, Release Train, PM, BD, Legal, and Operations. Your collaboration will focus on keeping launches moving and ensuring that partner-facing platforms are reliable at scale.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
As a Senior TechOps & Release Automation Engineer (G4), you will lead the operational health and release readiness of DevHome and related partner-facing platforms. This is a hybrid engineering role for someone who enjoys solving operational problems with code, improving reliability, and taking ownership across the full platform lifecycle.
  
  
You will help keep systems production-safe, supporting partner onboarding and access workflows, managing release execution for Android and iOS, and driving automation across operational processes. You will span application support, infrastructure maintenance, incident response, deployment safety, and internal tooling. You will report to the Tech Support Engineering Manager and onsite in the Jakarta office based.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Manage end-to-end DevHome operations, partner onboarding support, and release execution from intake through post-release verification.
* Manage Android and iOS release activities, including cutoffs, submissions, phased rollouts, cherry-picks, rollback readiness, and release tracking.
* Resolve operational escalations related to partner access, login issues, onboarding blockers, scope or configuration requests, and documentation publishing flows.
* Make safe production changes across Go services, React/Docusaurus surfaces, configurations, secrets, tokens, and developer documentation.
* Maintain Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure, GitLab runners, CI/CD pipelines, and other reliability-critical operational tooling.
* Investigate and respond to production incidents using Datadog, Kibana, and system-level troubleshooting to resolve performance, latency, and partner-helping issues.
* Support infrastructure lifecycle work such as AMI rotation, EC2 and Docklet maintenance, backend scaling, and migration to MEKS.
* Develop automation, scripts, and internal tools that reduce manual effort across release management, approvals, assessment, and partner operations.
* Contribute to on-call readiness, RCA follow-ups, SOP improvements, and runbook maintenance.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders and external partners to unblock launches and keep platform operations moving smoothly.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in TechOps, DevOps, SRE, release engineering, platform support, or similar operational engineering roles.
* Go (Golang) skills, with the ability to safely navigate and modify a large shared monorepo.
* Comfortable working across both application and operations layers, including code, infrastructure, CI/CD, secrets, documentation, and production troubleshooting.
* Experience with release operations, production change management, feature rollouts and mobile app releases.
* Troubleshooting judgment, with the ability to assess growth, identify root causes, and lead issues through to resolution independently.
* Working knowledge of GitLab, Jira, Confluence, and Slack.
* Hands-on experience with Terraform and AWS, including practical knowledge of Route53, Security Groups, runners, compute lifecycle management, and safe infrastructure changes.
* Working knowledge of Kubernetes/EKS, with experience in Helm charts, service-mesh-style networking, namespaces, staged migrations, or MEKS/Kubernetes migration work.
* Trigger, debug, and maintain CI/CD pipelines, including GitLab pipeline troubleshooting, release automation, and deployment workflows such as Conveyor or similar tools.
* Experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), token flows, HMAC, and secret management, especially for partner-facing API platforms.
* Experience with HashiCorp Vault or equivalent secret and token management systems.
* Familiarity with React and Docusaurus to maintain partner portal UI and developer documentation workflows, even if your core strength is in backend or operations engineering.
* Experience investigating operational issues using Datadog, Kibana, logs, and production telemetry.
* Experience building internal admin tools, workflow automation, approval systems, Slack bots, or similar operational tooling.
* Partner management skills and empathy, with the ability to bridge engineering systems and operational needs across BD, Legal, Ops, partner engineering teams, and external developer contacts.
* Experience supporting external-facing partner or developer platforms, including canary or phased rollouts, production hardening, post-mortems, runbook creation, or mentoring team members.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

**About Us:**

description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

The End-to-End Flow Controller is responsible for ensuring the timely availability of raw materials, components, and sub-assemblies to support production plans and customer on-time delivery (OTD). The role manages material replenishment activities, purchase orders, backorders, shortages, and inventory flow across the supply chain while coordinating closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders. The position also ensures compliance with Quality, Safety, Health, and Environment (QSHE) requirements and supports continuous improvement of material flow processes.

**What will you do?**

* Ensure material availability to support production schedules and customer delivery commitments.
* Manage purchase orders, supplier acknowledgements, replenishment backlog, and backorder portfolios.
* Monitor and resolve material shortages, pre-shortages, and supply risks through proactive action and escalation.
* Execute MRP activities, review exception messages, and maintain the balance between supply and demand requirements.
* Coordinate with Planning, Purchasing, Production, Engineering, Quality, Logistics, and suppliers to ensure timely material flow.
* Support the creation and maintenance of material master data and purchasing transactions in SAP.
* Monitor inventory performance and contribute to material flow, backlog, and stock optimization initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with QSHE standards and participate in continuous improvement and operational review activities.

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

* Bachelor's Degree in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience in supply chain, material planning, procurement, inventory management, or manufacturing operations.
* Understanding of MRP/MPS principles, inventory control, and manufacturing supply chain processes.
* Proficiency in SAP (MM module) and Microsoft Excel.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder coordination skills.
* Good command of English, both written and spoken.
* Knowledge of Quality, Safety, Health, and Environment (QSHE) management systems is an advantage.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

As a Site Reliability Engineer, you will be responsible for ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of production systems. You will apply engineering principles to operations, focusing on automation, observability, and continuous improvement to reduce manual effort and enhance system resilience. You will work closely with development teams to build and operate highly reliable services, embedding reliability into the full software lifecycle.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Monitor system reliability and define, implement, and track SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets for production services
* Lead incident response activities, including troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and resolution
* Automate infrastructure processes and reduce operational toil through scripting and tooling enhancements
* Manage and optimize Kubernetes clusters, including resource configurations, manifests, and kustomize overlays
* Maintain and monitor GitOps workflows using ArgoCD to ensure consistent and reliable application deployments
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins Job DSL (Groovy)
* Collaborate with development teams to improve system reliability, scalability, and deployment readiness
* Maintain and upgrade platform tools such as Jenkins, ArgoCD, and container registries
* Develop and maintain runbooks, postmortems, and internal technical documentation

**Requirements**

* 3+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), DevOps, or infrastructure engineering
* Solid understanding of SRE principles, including SLIs, SLOs, and error budget frameworks
* Experience operating and managing systems in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure)
* Strong proficiency in containerization and orchestration technologies, particularly Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automation, and deployment strategies (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions)
* Familiarity with GitOps practices and tools such as ArgoCD or FluxCD
* Hands-on experience with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, logging and alerting systems)
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Bash, Python, Groovy) and Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible)
* Strong foundation in Linux/Unix systems and Git-based version control workflows

description:

Are you a talented Master Data Analyst that would like to take the next step in your career? And do you want to be part of building an ambitious Master Data Management practice in ECCO?
  
  
Then it could be you we are looking for as our new Master Data Analyst.
  
  
Come join us in our Master Data Management & Governance team and get a significant opportunity to shape and impact the future of MDM in ECCO - a key focus area of ECCO’s Digital Transformation.
  
  
**Job profile**
You will be part of our global MDM set-up related to the entire value chain from development and production to sales and retail. We work with multiple different data teams to ensure the quality of our Master Data and that the maintenance of our master data follows global guidelines.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In your new position as our Master Data Analyst, you will have a critical role in the above and you will have the following main responsibilities:
  
  

* Designing and implementing data integration workflows using ETL tools such as Azure data Factory, Airflow, dbt.
* Transforming data to meet the requirements of the target system or data warehouse.
* Loading transformed data into a data warehouse or other storage systems for reporting and analysis purposes.
* Collaborating with Data Analysts to ensure that data integration solutions support the organization's reporting and analysis needs.
* Monitoring and optimizing data integration processes to ensure that data is loaded efficiently and accurately.Ensure effective communication and collaboration across cross-functional teams involved in data projects.
* Contribute to documentation, standards, and policy development while coordinating testing and validation efforts.

**Person profile**
You enjoy diving into master data, and you do so with a structured and detail-oriented approach. Furthermore, you are a fast learner, team player, you like collaborating with others and you are innovative and able to suggest new approaches or solutions to improve our services. As your team is located at multiple locations, you need to be able to work independently and feel comfortable using TEAMS and similar online tools. You have a strong drive and ability to deliver within deadlines.
  
  
Many different roads lead to this position, but we imagine that you have:
  
  

* A Computer Science or equivalent education.
* Strong experience in data modelling.
* Know-how in working on development using languages as SQL and Python.
* Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and technologies, like Snowflake.
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (like AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data services.
* Hands-on experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI.
* Solid knowledge of advanced Excel (formulas, pivot tables, charts).
* Understanding of business KPIs, metrics, and dashboard/report creation.
* Be a proactive member of master data management team, ensuring alignment with the organization's strategic goals and objectives.
* Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in data architecture and engineering and apply this knowledge to improve the organization's data capabilities.
* Expertise in driving compliance, risk mitigation, and high-quality IT solutions.
* Knowledge in working in agile environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills to coordinate between technical and business teams.
* Strong analytical and organizational abilities.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills.
* knowing SAP or D365 would be helpful.
* Fluency in English (both written and spoken).

At ECCO, you become part of a meaningful, developing and multicultural workplace. You join a global family of more than 25,000 people who are proud to create the footprints of tomorrow.
  
  
Headquartered in Denmark, we are a family-owned company that offers international opportunities. Our offices and facilities have an informal culture and relaxed dress code – our shoe code is slightly stricter.
  
  
Join us and we guarantee lifelong learning – the speed of progress is up to you. So, if you’re curious, passionate and ready to make an impact, you’ll fit right in.

title: Software Engineer
description:
***\*\*Candidates must reside in Indonesia and have existing authorisation to work there\*\****

**About Us**

Revalue is a carbon credit development platform focused on one of the planet’s most critical but complex challenges - seeing nature regenerated at a planetary scale.

Our mission is to design the most cutting-edge and trusted nature credits for our planet.

We are bringing together a world-class team - forestry experts, ecologists, applied AI scientists, software engineers, geospatial analysts, commercial specialists, economists, and more - to create the unique DNA required to reimagine nature credits.

**About the role**

We are looking for a
**Software Engineer**
to join our Engineering team within Platform Intelligence.

Platform Intelligence develops the data infrastructure, machine learning, geospatial pipelines, and technical systems behind Revalue's nature and carbon intelligence products. We turn scientific and analytical work into repeatable, reliable outputs: ingesting and validating Earth observation datasets, producing the analyses and baselines that underpin our carbon methodologies, designing monitoring systems, and running the cloud platform underneath.

This role is about moving from analytical and ML prototypes to production-grade systems. You will work closely with engineers, data scientists, and analysts to build data pipelines, productionise models, and improve reproducibility, making workflows maintainable, observable, and usable by others.

Some of the most important work is deciding what to build, how to model it, and where to draw boundaries. You will work with domain experts to make those decisions rather than simply implementing predefined specifications.

It is a hands-on role at the boundary between software engineering, data science, geospatial engineering, and cloud infrastructure. You will not be expected to lead scientific model development, but you will make sure the models run reliably in production.

**Who we are looking for**

Please note: Candidates must have existing authorisation to work in Indonesia.

A strong mid-level or senior individual contributor who can own delivery independently and turn complex technical workflows into stable production systems.

**Key skills:**

* Strong software engineering background. Design, interface, contract, data and domain modeling.
* Scientific programming background in any domain: geospatial, remote sensing, ML, signal/audio/vision, quant, simulation, bioinformatics. We care more about the pattern of experience rather than the specific domain: translating messy, abstract, real-world structures into correct data representations and transformations.
* Comfortable across stacks and tools: generalist disposition, able to pick up new languages/frameworks as our needs shift.
* Familiar with modern SWE practices and product-engineering: discovery, scoping, iterative and incremental delivery, comfortable operating in ambiguity.

**Hard skills:**

* Good engineering practice: testing, code review, CI/CD, modular design, documentation.
* Experience productionising analytical, data science, or ML workflows: turning exploratory code into reliable systems, with a working understanding of batch processing, reproducibility, monitoring, and deployment.
* Day-to-day work is in scientific Python. However, we weigh fundamentals and data aptitude above prior Python experience: if you have done this kind of work in C++, Scala, … , that counts.
* Cloud engineering experience, ideally on GCP and AWS, including designing and operating cloud-based data systems.
* A pragmatic mindset: knowing when to build carefully, when to simplify, and when to avoid unnecessary complexity.

**Soft skills:**

* Comfortable with high-visibility, shared-ownership, collaborative work: pairing on decisions, small trunk-based commits, and real-time feedback on work in progress.
* Comfortable running discovery sessions with domain experts before building.
* Strong communication, including presenting technical solutions to colleagues and non-technical stakeholders.
* Advanced proficiency in written and spoken English.

**Nice to have:**

Experience in any of these would be valuable, though we do not expect all of them:

* Geospatial data, raster/vector processing, Earth observation, or remote sensing.
* Data quality checks, lineage, observability, or reproducibility tooling.
* Full-stack experience: a backend and frontend you have maintained or owned.
* Applying AI tools to improve engineering, developer, or analytical workflows.
* Tools such as Docker, GitHub Actions, Dagster, Terraform, Postgres, DuckDB, Dask, xarray, rasterio, or geopandas.
* Scientific computing, climate, nature, carbon, or environmental data.
* Improving an existing platform, on a team where data scientists and analysts contribute code.

**What you will do**

* Make design and data-modelling calls: what a manifest has to guarantee, where a boundary sits, what belongs in a shared library and what stays out, when to defer rather than build.
* Build and maintain the geospatial data pipelines behind our datasets: syncing sources, validating and ingesting them, and exporting project-aligned outputs for analysis.
* Turn notebooks, prototypes, and research code into tested, modular production code, and keep it that way as requirements change.
* Productionise our modelling pipelines and the orchestration they run on: partitioned assets, schedules, and concurrency.
* Make runs reproducible and observable: manifests, pinned dataset versions, deterministic outputs, and monitoring that tells us when something breaks.
* Build new data and monitoring products, including proper cataloging for our datasets.
* Performance tuning: profiling real runs, concurrency within memory bounds, and keeping runtime/cost predictable.
* Work on the backend (Kotlin/Spring, Postgres) and frontend (React/Remix) where results reach customers.
* Own cloud infrastructure in Terraform across GCP and AWS: batch jobs, storage, IAM, CI/CD, and alerting.
* Run discovery with scientists and analysts.
* Contribute to dev tooling: ship/release scripts, agent skills that encode our engineering procedures, and repo instructions.

**What success looks like**

In the first few months, you will get to know our platform, cloud setup, and data workflows, and start owning productionisation work. Over time you will help build clearer patterns, more reliable pipelines, and better reproducibility and monitoring.

You will be doing well if analyses are easier to run and repeat, if analysts and scientists depend less on manual processes, if pipelines are predictable in runtime and cost, and if fewer critical systems rely on one person to keep them moving.

**What We Offer**

* The opportunity to shape the future of nature-based climate finance
* A mission-driven organisation with shared purpose, culture, and values
* A diverse team of colleagues, partners and clients based all around the world
* Meaningful equity in an early-stage startup with a growing and trusted brand
* Flexible working environment with a team deeply committed to impact
* Generously enhanced, gender-neutral parental leave policy
* Wellbeing support, including company-funded access to therapy

🌱 If you’re ready to build our Engineering function and care about driving real impact - we’d love to meet you!

title: Senior Product Analyst — Fintech
description:
At inDrive, we're not just building a ride-hailing app — we're building a financial platform at global scale. Our lending product is one of the fastest-growing verticals in the company. We're looking for a Senior Product Analyst who thrives where data work directly drives product and revenue decisions.

This is a rare combination: the stability of a well-funded global company with the speed and ownership of an early-stage product. If you want your analysis to shape a product used by millions, we'd love to talk.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define the metrics that matter — design, calculate, and monitor KPIs for new product features and initiatives across the credit funnel
* Drive funnel optimization — identify where users drop off, why, and which levers move conversion at each stage
* Surface growth opportunities — dig into data to find product directions worth betting on
* Assess business value — model expected profit from new projects and features before launch, and track actual vs. forecast after
* Run A/B experiments end-to-end — from hypothesis and test design through statistical analysis to rollout decisions
* Define pricing strategy — run tests and analyze how rate, term, and eligibility settings affect conversion, default rates, and portfolio health
* Build the analytics foundation — maintain documentation, create data marts, and partner with the Data team to ensure clean, reliable product data
* Translate findings into decisions — deliver crisp recommendations to product and business teams so insights actually change what gets built

**Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

* 3+ years in product analytics or data science, with a track record of influencing product decisions — not just reporting numbers
* Strong statistical foundation: A/B testing, causal inference, time series
* Advanced SQL — comfortable writing and optimizing complex queries across large datasets
* Python proficiency — pandas, numpy, and the rest of the standard data stack
* Experience with BI and visualization tools: Redash, Tableau, or similar
* Structured thinking and a product mindset — you balance analytical rigor with business pragmatism
* Bonus: background in fintech, lending, or marketplace products at scale
* English: Professional Working Proficiency

**Why join us**

* Help us challenge injustice by creating fair choices for millions of people across 1100+ cities in 47 countries
* Develop your professional skills with access to mentoring, career consulting, and learning programs
* Collaborate with teams around the world and gain international experience through our Global Talent Exchange Program
* Engage in company-wide challenges, awards, sports activities, employee-led social impact and volunteering projects
* Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow
* Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs

Final benefits may vary depending on the location.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Fullstack - Merchant Experience
description:
**Company Description**

**About Grab and Our Workplace**

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

 **Job Description**

**Get to Know the Team**

The Merchant App Flutter team builds and maintains the core merchant app for businesses using Grab. Whether you're supporting small local vendors or scaling for international franchises, the team focuses on creating tools to empower merchants. You'll join a close-knit group of passionate engineers committed to elevating the merchant experience and delivering impactful solutions

**Get to Know the Role**

Reporting to the Software Engineering Manager, you will focus on both feature development and engineering optimization for the Grab merchant app. With this role, you will take direct responsibility for delivering high-quality technical solutions, scaling tools for merchants, and taking ownership of impactful engineering contributions. This role is an onsite role based in Jakarta

**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* You will develop and enhance app features to improve merchant workflows, ensuring the app is efficient, responsive, and user-friendly.
* You will design clear, scalable programming solutions using best practices such as dependency injection or MVVM.
* You will analyze and optimize app performance to address issues like response time, battery use, and storage impact.
* You will write robust unit tests, integration tests, and collaborate with QA engineers to maintain quality standards during app releases.
* You will maintain current features, resolve bugs, and enhance code functionality while ensuring technical consistency and long-term performance goals.
* You will serve in the on-call rotation for critical mobile issues, balancing rapid fixes with logical troubleshooting.

  
**Qualifications**

**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* 6+ years of experience in software engineering, with a focus on **Fullstack Development**
* Proven track record of building and scaling distributed systems in a high-growth environment.
* Deep expertise in backend languages (preferably **Go**) and modern frontend frameworks (**React**) or mobile (**Flutter**).
* A Product Engineer mindset which makes you care as much about the user's "Latency to Book" as you do about the cleanliness of the code.
* The ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders clearly and persuasively.
* Solid understanding of database technologies, including MySQL and NoSQL databases like AWS DynamoDB
* You proactively automate CI/CD pipelines and regression testing to ensure that high-quality code reaches production faster and safer.
* A disciplined approach to quality. You are proficient in the Testing Pyramid—from lightning-fast unit tests to comprehensive integration and end-to-end (E2E) suites.

  
**Additional Information**

**Life at Grab**

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

* We have your back with **Term Life Insurance** and comprehensive **Medical Insurance.**
* With **GrabFlex,** create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through **Parental** and **Birthday leave**, and give back to your communities through **Love-all-Serve-all (LASA)** volunteering leave
* We have a confidential **Grabber Assistance Programme** to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Product Engineer
description:
**About the Role**

As a Product Engineer, you will be fully responsible for developing and maintaining innovative digital solutions that support clinic operations, commercial activities, Supply Chain, and support functions such as HR and Finance. This role requires direct involvement from uncovering and understanding user pain points, building architecture and data integration, to ensuring systems run reliably while prioritizing enterprise data security and confidentiality.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Uncover operational problems by collaborating directly with users, Business Systems Managers, and business process owners to design targeted technical solutions.
* Build and develop applications, interfaces, backends, and automations for various business functions such as clinic service registration, sales management, and internal HR and Finance workflows according to priorities.
* Integrate systems connecting service applications, payment portals, warehousing (supply chain), and third-party systems via APIs, focusing on failure handling and duplicate transaction prevention.
* Maintain data integrity and security by implementing role-based access control (RBAC), input validation, identity management, and access log recording for audit purposes.
* Conduct comprehensive technical testing (testing and debugging), demo work results, and support the UAT process with users to ensure the smooth operation of critical business workflows.
* Prepare and release system changes to production, complete with operational monitoring setups, rollback plan preparation, and recovery procedures in the event of an incident.
* Maintain continuous system functionality, track and resolve bug findings, and periodically evaluate application utilization benefits with the business team and process owners.

**Requirements**

* Strong background and experience as a Full-stack Software Engineer, Backend Engineer, Business Applications / ERP Engineer, or Integration Engineer.
* Proficient in cross-layer application development (frontend and backend) as well as Database and SQL management, including designing data structures and maintaining data schema integrity.
* Advanced expertise in API engineering and system integration covering authentication, webhook management, retry processes, and system protection against traffic spikes.
* Solid understanding of software security, particularly in restricting the visibility of sensitive data and managing credential secrets.
* Sharp understanding of business process workflows covering clinic administration services, order transaction and stock inventory management, or approval system logic in internal environments.
* Accustomed to implementing engineering collaboration practices such as utilizing version control, conducting code reviews, and writing comprehensive technical documentation.
* Proven experience in operational continuity covering normal workflow and exception anomaly testing, up to the rapid execution of service recovery.

title: Mechanical Maintenance
description:
**Shape Production Excellence as a Workshop Machinist**
=======================================================

  

Are you passionate about precision manufacturing and machine operations? Join a hands-on role where your work directly impacts safety, quality, efficiency, and reliable production performance. You will operate and maintain workshop machinery, manufacture and repair components to established standards, and help ensure products are delivered according to production schedules, quality requirements, and operational targets. This is an opportunity to apply your technical expertise, contribute to continuous operational excellence, and support a safe and productive workshop environment.

  

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* Operate machines and production equipment safely and according to established procedures and standards.
* Manufacture and repair components in line with production specifications, schedules, quality standards, and operational targets.
* Load materials into production machines efficiently to support smooth workflow and productivity.
* Remove, sort, and pack raw materials and finished products accurately and safely.
* Maintain a safe working environment by collecting and disposing of waste according to recycling and waste-management procedures.
* Clean machinery, equipment, and work areas to meet health, safety, and operational requirements.
* Perform lathe operations, roll grinding activities, and basic mechanical maintenance tasks.
* Monitor machine condition and maintain machinery and process equipment in reliable working order.
* Ensure built-in quality at every stage of the manufacturing process and perform all work to high quality standards.
Follow Quality, Health, Safety, Environmental, and company management system requirements while supporting the Workshop Supervisor and Manager with assigned tasks.  

  

**Expectations from you**
-------------------------

* Associate Degree (Diploma) in a Technical or Engineering field with a minimum of 2 years of relevant experience, or a Bachelor's Degree in a Technical or Engineering field.
* Broad knowledge of workshop operations, machinery, production processes, and maintenance practices.
* Ability to read and understand technical drawings.
* Basic knowledge of machine maintenance.
* Familiarity with measurement devices and inspection tools.
* Computer literacy in MS Office; knowledge of CAD/CAM software is an advantage.
* Ability to communicate in English.
* Strong communication skills and willingness to learn.
* Open-minded approach with a collaborative team-player mindset and commitment to excellence.
Willingness to work in shifts.  

  

**To succeed in this role**
---------------------------

Success in this role requires a strong commitment to safety, quality, and operational efficiency in every task you perform. You bring practical experience operating workshop machinery, an understanding of technical drawings and measurement equipment, and the ability to maintain machinery in reliable working condition. You are comfortable working under limited supervision, solving non-routine challenges through analysis, and supporting and guiding less experienced colleagues while consistently delivering work to established standards.

  

We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviors that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together:

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value  

  

**We offer**
------------

You will join a workshop environment focused on safe, high-quality, and efficient manufacturing operations. The team is responsible for machine operation, component manufacturing and repair, equipment maintenance, product quality, and adherence to health, safety, environmental, and operational standards. Working closely with the Workshop Supervisor and fellow team members, you will contribute to reliable production performance while helping maintain workshop equipment and processes in optimal condition. The role offers opportunities to expand your technical capabilities across machining, roll grinding, mechanical maintenance, and production operations. You will also have the opportunity to share your knowledge by supporting and assisting less experienced colleagues.

  

Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities for professional growth and development. We value our employees and provide modern tools, learning opportunities, and a collaborative work environment where individuals can contribute and succeed together.

  

**When everything works together**
----------------------------------

*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.*

  

*At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.*

  

*Join the team – and lead the way with us!*

  

*www.valmet.com/careers*

description:
Location Tanah Abang DKI Jakarta R, Indonesia Category Research & Development Job Id R000162199 Job Type Full time Experienced Professionals

  

**Job Location**

JAKARTA GENERAL OFFICE

**Job Description**

**Overview of Role**

Personal Health Care (PHC) is an exciting and fast paced business that contributes to a significant component of P&G’s global profits and sales in Health care sector. This role provide hands-on Measurement Sciences leadership and analytical execution for the regional Personal Healthcare business. The role converts business and technical questions into fit-for-purpose measurement plans, generates reliable and compliant data, and turns results into clear recommendations that enable innovation, product qualification, claims support, business continuity, and lifecycle stewardship. The role combines strong procedural execution with growing application capability: rigorous experimentation, method development and validation, technical problem-solving, data interpretation, and collaboration across R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Product Supply, Procurement, external laboratories, and contract manufacturers.

**Your team**

This role will be located at Jakarta PHC Plant. The role will be part of the Measurement sciences team supporting Health Care organization and reports to Director, AMA PHC Measurement Science. You will have the opportunity work in multi-functional teams (local, regional and global), engage with both internal and external partners.

**How success looks like**

* You will ensure a reliable, decision-ready analytical evidence is delivered at the speed and rigor needed by the business.
* You will ensure methods are fit for purpose, reproducible, transferable, compliant, and supported by complete technical documentation.
* You will ensure technical risks, unexpected results, and quality signals are identified early, investigated scientifically, and translated into actionable recommendations.
* You will ensure regional project teams receive strong Measurement Sciences partnership across innovation and base-business priorities.
* You will ensure External capability and digital workflows are leveraged responsibly to improve learning speed, capacity, and data integrity
* You will be responsible for deploying measurement strategies to internal and external partners

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with MFT project teams to frame clear technical problem statements, hypotheses, critical measures, acceptance criteria, and learning plans.
* Select appropriate analytical approaches from the existing toolbox and recommend new or modified methods when an outage exists.
* Connect measurement outputs to product performance, stability, quality, mechanism of action, claims, and business decisions.
* Independently execute established chemical and physical methods and progressively develop or adapt methods for tablets, capsules, liquids, semi-solids, and other relevant dosage forms.
* Apply appropriate techniques such as HPLC, GC, UV/Vis, AAS, ICP, dissolution, physical characterization, and other fit-for-purpose methods relevant to the personal healthcare portfolio.
* Plan and execute method development, validation or qualification, robustness, equivalence, transfer, and troubleshooting activities with coaching where required.
* Own instrument readiness, calibration, maintenance, repair coordination, and qualification activities within assigned scope, ensure safe sample handling, precise preparation, reliable measurement, complete traceability, and data integrity.
* Recognize anomalous, out-of-trend, or unexpected results; investigate root causes and propose scientifically sound next steps, apply foundational statistics and effective visualization to interpret results and distinguish signal from variability.
* Summarize conclusions, risks, and recommendations in concise technical reports and project updates.
* Execute and coordinate stability, quality monitoring, qualification, troubleshooting, and business-continuity testing.
* Contribute to investigations, change controls, method or specification updates, and lifecycle documentation within assigned scope.
* Maintain inspection-ready records, protocols, reports, SOPs, and controlled analytical documentation.
* Work effectively with Product Development, Product Research, Process, Packaging, QA, Regulatory, GPS, Product Supply, Procurement, external laboratories, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.
* Collaborates with Quality Control team to deploy methods, build capabilities and synergies across processes to enable smooth transition from R&D to QC.
* Coordinate external testing and capability, including clear briefs, technical oversight, data review, and timely delivery, while protecting confidential information and intellectual property.
* Build an internal and external technical network, seek the right expertise for complex problems, and share learning across projects.
* Use approved digital systems for experiment documentation, data capture, analysis, visualization, collaboration, and knowledge reuse.
* Identify opportunities to simplify methods, automate repeatable steps, improve throughput, and strengthen touchless data flow without compromising quality.
* Recommend and implement practical improvements to laboratory methods, test designs, supplies, and work processes.

**Job Qualifications**

**Role Requirements**

  

* Advanced degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Analytical Chemistry, Chemistry, or a closely related discipline. A **PhD** with relevant analytical experience, or a **Master’s degree** with substantial hands-on analytical experience, is preferred.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in analytical method development, validation or qualification, transfer, stability testing, and laboratory troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of chromatographic and spectroscopic techniques, with the ability to connect analytical results to product or material behavior.
* Experience working under regulated laboratory practices and quality systems, with strong understanding of data integrity and good documentation.
* Ability to communicate technical findings clearly in English. Bahasa Indonesia capability is strongly preferred for local stakeholder and partner engagement.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, collaborate across functions, and work with increasing independence.

**Preferred experience**

* Experience in consumer health, pharmaceutical, OTC, medical-device, food-supplement, or other regulated product environments.
* Experience with Indonesian or regional product requirements, pharmacopeial methods, local external laboratories, contract manufacturers, or technology transfer.
* Exposure to claims support, product qualification, stability strategy, OOS/OOT investigations, CAPA, change control, and audit readiness
* Practical use of statistical tools and digital data systems such as LIMS, Excel, Power BI, chromatography data systems.
* Evidence of technical curiosity, external focus, continuous improvement, and responsible handling of confidential information and intellectual property.

**About us**  
  
We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide. Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor

**Job Schedule**

Full time

**Job Number**

R000162199

**Job Segmentation**

Experienced Professionals

description:
**Hiring: Senior QA Automation Engineer | Fully Remote**

We’re looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join an agribusiness client on a 12-month rolling contract.

* Setup: Fully Remote
* Initial Project Duration: 12 months rolling contract
* Working hours: Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–6:00 PM GMT+4

You’ll own the test strategy, tooling, and quality standards for an agricultural ERP platform spanning a web application, backend APIs, and a React Native mobile field application. This role suits someone who enjoys building automation frameworks and ensuring complex business calculations and permissions are accurate.

Key responsibilities:

* Design, build, and maintain web test automation using Playwright and TypeScript.
* Automate mobile testing across iOS and Android, including offline capture, synchronization, and real-device behaviour.
* Develop API and integration tests, including role-based access verification.
* Validate business calculations against reference datasets using advanced SQL across PostgreSQL and Microsoft SQL Server.
* Manage test data, fixtures, seed scripts, and isolated environments.
* Integrate reliable automated suites into CI/CD pipelines, keeping execution fast and minimizing flaky tests.
* Partner with engineers to improve Vitest coverage and code testability.
* Own defect reporting, triage, release sign-off, and quality reporting.

What we’re looking for:

* At least 5 years of software QA experience, including 3+ years focused primarily on automation.
* Strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills, with experience building frameworks using Playwright or Cypress.
* Hands-on iOS and Android test automation experience.
* Strong API automation and advanced SQL skills.
* Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, Docker, version control, and code reviews.
* Experience testing data-intensive ERP, finance, or planning systems where calculations, aggregations, and permissions are critical.
* Confidence defining and explaining a test strategy to technical and business stakeholders.
* Professional written and spoken English.

Agribusiness knowledge, particularly the fresh-fruit chain from orchard to market, and experience with ERP implementations or large-scale business system rollouts would be advantageous.

If this opportunity isn’t for you but you know someone suitable, referrals are welcome.

description:

Founded in 2004, Packet Systems Indonesia (PSI) is one of Indonesia's most trusted ICT systems integrators headquartered in Jakarta — delivering secure, scalable, and mission-critical technology solutions across networking, cybersecurity, cloud, and managed services.
  
  
As part of Logicalis Asia Pacific — the Architects of Change™ — PSI offers the best of both worlds: deep local expertise and agility, backed by global standards, international best practices, and a network of 7,000+ professionals across 30 territories.

Indonesia's digital transformation is accelerating. Be one of the Architects of Change who leads it.
  
  
Role Description
  
  

* Responsible for the validation and analysis of investigations passed up from Tier 1 Analysts.

**Responsibilities**

* Recognizes successful intrusions and compromises through review and analysis of relevant event detail information.
* Investigates potential security incidents - recognizes attacks based on techniques, tactics and procedures and differentiates false positives from true intrusion.
* Follows up and tracks investigations to resolution.
* Further validates, classifies incidents and updates security incident cases.
* Alerts system and information owners of intrusions and potential intrusions and compromises to their network infrastructure

* Provides assistance during remediation of security incidents.
* Manages security services including finetuning security use cases and reducing false positives.
* Maintains and provides data required to calculate the SecOps services SLAs, KPIs and Goals Setting.
* Provide feedback to updates SecOps processes and procedures as necessary.
* Follows and implements the customer’s change management process.
* Publishes regular reports to internal teams.
* Conducts regular information security awareness sessions to the general community of the organization.

Interested applicants are invited to apply via our careers portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.

At PSI, we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

title: AI Engineer – IS/IT International
description:
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. AI Solution Development & Deployment**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy AI applications, including generative AI assistants, knowledge search solutions, workflow automation, and machine learning use cases.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and working solutions, from proof of concept through production deployment.
* Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, approved AI platforms, APIs, and business data sources.
* Implement evaluation methods to assess accuracy, relevance, reliability, and business suitability.
* Develop reusable components and deployment practices that support adoption across regions.

**2. Business Engagement & Value Delivery**

* Work with business stakeholders to identify challenges and assess where AI can deliver practical benefits.
* Evaluate use cases based on business value, feasibility, data readiness, cost, and risk.
* Define success criteria and track outcomes such as time saved, improved quality, adoption, and operational efficiency.
* Support demonstrations, user testing, training, and adoption.
* Act as an accessible IS/IT partner, helping business teams navigate AI opportunities and use approved capabilities.

**3. IS/IT AI Vision & Regional Roadmap**

* Contribute to a shared AI vision and roadmap for AMEWA, Asia, and India.
* Assess existing initiatives, capabilities, and business needs across the three regions.
* Identify opportunities to reuse solutions, share knowledge, and coordinate related initiatives.
* Align regional delivery with Group AI strategy, architecture, and approved platforms.
* Collaborate with the AI Champions program to communicate business needs and connect them with relevant Group capabilities.

**4. Production Operations & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor deployed AI solutions for availability, performance, output quality, usage, and cost.
* Troubleshoot incidents and maintain reliable integrations and data flows.
* Implement version control, automated testing, and CI/CD practices for AI applications.
* Establish operational documentation, support procedures, and clear ownership before production release.
* Improve solutions based on user feedback, evaluation results, and changing business requirements.

**5. Security, Governance & Knowledge Sharing**

* Work with cybersecurity, data protection, architecture, and relevant governance teams throughout delivery.
* Apply appropriate access controls, data handling practices, human oversight, and safeguards against misuse.
* Document solution designs, data dependencies, evaluation results, limitations, and operating procedures.
* Share practical guidance and reusable approaches with IS/IT colleagues and business teams.

**Requirements Technical Skills**

**Must Have**

* Strong proficiency in Python and software engineering practices.
* Hands-on experience developing AI or machine learning applications and deploying them into production.
* Practical experience with large language models, prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and vector search.
* Experience integrating applications through REST APIs and connecting AI solutions to enterprise data sources.
* Experience with cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure and enterprise AI services.
* Solid understanding of SQL, data preparation, and data quality.
* Experience with Git-based source control, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of AI evaluation, monitoring, security, and responsible AI principles.
* Ability to assess trade-offs between solution quality, latency, scalability, and cost.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Azure AI services, Azure Machine Learning, or comparable enterprise AI platforms.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and enterprise AI assistant capabilities.
* Experience with containerization, infrastructure automation, and MLOps or LLMOps practices.
* Experience with document processing, enterprise knowledge management, or workflow automation.
* Familiarity with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow and delivery tools such as Jira and GitLab.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a practical focus on business outcomes.
* Ability to explain AI capabilities, limitations, and technical choices to nontechnical stakeholders.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate across functions, cultures, and time zones.
* Sound judgment when balancing innovation, operational reliability, and security.
* A continuous learning mindset and willingness to share knowledge.
* Professional fluency in English; French is a plus.

**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related role, including hands-on AI solution delivery.
* Experience taking solutions from business requirements and prototyping through deployment and operational support.
* Experience working with business stakeholders to deliver measurable improvements.
* Experience working in Agile delivery environments.
* Experience collaborating in multinational organizations, preferably across multiple regions.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.
