title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Next.js)
description:
**About us**
============

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

**About the role**
==================

We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users.

This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

### **Feature Development**

* Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements
* Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions
* Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale
* Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks

### **Quality & Reliability**

* Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects
* Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour
* Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues
* Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size

### **Security & Observability**

* Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets
* Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling

### **Collaboration**

* Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release
* Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes
* Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing
* Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers

**Qualifications**
==================

### **Must-Have Experience**

* 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript
* Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals
* Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, MUI, or shadcn/ui
* Experience with a code-first headless CMS on PostgreSQL (Payload, Strapi, Directus, or equivalent) — collections, access control, generated types, migrations
* Testing and delivery discipline: e2e tests (Cypress or Playwright) and unit/integration tests (Vitest or Jest), Git flow, code review, working with CI
* Daily use of AI development tools (Claude Code or equivalents), including configuring them for a project — context, instructions, rules, MCP/integrations — with full ownership of the quality, security, and correctness of generated code
* English — B1+

### **Leadership Attributes**

* Owns the outcome — takes a task from requirement to production without waiting to be pushed, and stays accountable for the result and the area it touches
* Maximally autonomous and involved — needs a goal, not step-by-step instructions, and cares how the product performs, not just whether the ticket is closed
* Verifies before trusting — treats AI output, third-party responses, and your own code as unproven until tested
* Structured communicator — surfaces risks, blockers, and estimate changes early, in writing, in a remote team
* Knows the edge of their scope — escalates architectural and security decisions instead of improvising them
* Learns from incidents — fixes the root cause, not just the symptom

**Location**
============

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

**Benefits**
============

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

* **Remote Work Environment:** Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
* **Unlimited PTO:** Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.
* **Paid National Holidays:** Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.
* **Company-provided MacBook:** Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.
* **Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement:** Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1\_mni\_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

**Interview Process**
=====================

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

* Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)
* Technical Interview (60 minutes)

**Life at Ruby Labs**
=====================

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

Fully Remote

Midshift

Full-time | 12-Month Rolling Contract

to lead the development of a mobile application for an innovative agricultural technology platform.

, building an offline-first solution for field teams operating in environments with limited or no internet connectivity.

**React Native, TypeScript, Node.js, React, and PostgreSQL**

  Design local storage, background synchronization, retry mechanisms, conflict resolution, and offline data management.
* **Maps & Device Integration:**

* **Backend Engineering:**
  Design and develop APIs, database models, authentication, and permissions using Node.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.
* **Web Development:**
  Build and enhance React 19 / TanStack Start applications, sharing business logic and validation across platforms.
* **DevOps & Quality:**

title: Tender Architect
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Tender Architect**

**What will you do?**

**Tender Management**

* Lead end-to-end tender preparation activities from RFQ/RFP receipt until submission.
* Analyze customer specifications, commercial requirements, and technical documentation.
* Develop winning bid strategies in collaboration with Sales and Business Units.
* Coordinate tender schedules and ensure timely proposal submission.

**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Define and architect optimal Schneider Electric solutions based on customer requirements.
* Select suitable products, systems, and services from Schneider Electric portfolios including:
* + Medium Voltage & Low Voltage Solutions
  + Protection and Control Systems
  + Energy Management Systems
  + EcoStruxure Solutions
  + Data Center Solutions
  + Industrial Automation Solutions
* Ensure technical compliance with customer specifications and international standards.

**Commercial & Costing**

* Prepare cost estimations, pricing calculations, and profitability analysis.
* Optimize solution design to achieve targeted margins while maintaining competitiveness.
* Identify commercial risks and recommend mitigation plans.
* Support internal approval processes and pricing reviews.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the central focal point between:
* + Sales Teams
  + Application Engineers
  + Product Managers
  + Supply Chain
  + Finance
  + Legal
  + Operations Teams
* Engage customers during clarification meetings and technical discussions.

**Risk & Compliance Management**

* Review contractual terms and conditions.
* Identify technical, commercial, operational, and delivery risks.
* Ensure tenders comply with Schneider Electric governance, ethics, and approval processes.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain tender documentation and proposal templates.
* Capture lessons learned from won and lost opportunities.
* Drive process improvements to increase tender quality and efficiency.

(External) English Qualifications:

**What’s in it for me?**

* Global Family Leave
* Comprehensive medical coverage for employee and dependents
* Worldwide Employee Stock Ownership
* Hybrid work arrangement (New Ways of Working)
* …and more!

Local Benefits (English):

The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country-specific programs and initiatives may be available.

When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.

IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.

We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.

Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

€40 billion global revenue  
+9% organic growth  
150 000+ employees in 100+ countries

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled.

title: AI Application Full Stack Engineer
description:
Mekari is Indonesia's no. 1 Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company. With our ecosystem of software solutions—including Mekari Jurnal, Mekari Talenta, Mekari Qontak, and Mekari Flex, we aim to facilitate entrepreneurs and leaders as they accelerate the digital transformation of their businesses.
  
  
In our 10+ years of journey we have reached over 3 Million platform users, and we're not planning to stop any time soon. We need more people like you: builders and owners with calculated ambition who are ready to
**#ElevateThroughImpact**
and raise Indonesia's software standard.
  
  
**How The Role Ships End-to-End**

* Platform Shipping: Build and run secure, observable inference APIs, routing policies, tenant controls, metering, and operator control surfaces.
* Intelligence Supply: Deliver versioned agent drivers, task-specific small models, prompts, tools, and retrieval pipelines for product integration.
* Evaluation & Feedback: Use production data, benchmarks, quality gates, and cost metrics to continuously improve models, routing, and guardrails.

**Core Responsibilities**

* API & Platform Architecture: Design high-concurrency REST/streaming APIs, handle auth (OAuth2), RBAC, tenant isolation, fallbacks, metering, and PostgreSQL data modeling.
* Model & Agent Delivery: Integrate provider/self-hosted models, maintain versioned capability catalogues, and build lightweight, task-specific models and agent drivers.
* Routing & Optimization: Run policy-aware routing, run benchmarks across prompt/output variations, and optimize throughput, latency, and token economics.
* Evaluation & Safety: Partner with experts to curate task datasets, set release thresholds, run baseline comparisons, and deploy shadow/staged releases safely.
* Operations & Governance: Maintain observability dashboards, alerts, runbooks, cost controls, tenant data privacy, clear technical documentation, and code quality.

**Typical Deliverables**

* Production inference APIs, web control surfaces, tenant quota controls, and accurate usage metering.
* Versioned model integrations, fallback execution rules, capacity plans, and performance benchmarks.
* Task-specific model endpoints and agent drivers with clear contracts, owners, and versioning.
* Evaluation datasets, release gates, regression checks, and observability runbooks.
* Technical design notes detailing model selection, routing logic, trade-offs, and unit economics.

**Success Measures**

* Adoption & Usability: Growing adoption across product teams through a single governed, reusable platform path.
* Quality & Safety: Higher task success rates alongside strict adherence to safety, quality, and tenant policy boundaries.
* Economic & Performance Efficiency: Lower cost and latency per completed task, driven by smaller models and optimized routing.
* Reliability & Agility: Reversible, progressive releases with early detection of regressions, anomalies, or capacity bottlenecks.

NEWLAB+ is a fast-growing FMCG company in Indonesia specializing in beauty, health, and wellness products. At NEWLAB+, we are committed to elevating confidence through innovative and effective beauty solutions. With a strong focus on quality, accessibility, and innovation, we continuously strive to develop products that meet the evolving needs of our customers. Our goal is to become the leading company in the industry, setting new standards and shaping the future of beauty and wellness.

We're seeking an
**AI Process Automation Engineer**
who is passionate about leveraging AI and automation to transform business processes. You have a strong analytical mindset and enjoy designing intelligent workflows that improve operational efficiency and enhance productivity across the organization. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and continuously explore emerging AI technologies to deliver impactful business solutions.

What You'll Do:

* Identify business processes that can be automated to improve operational efficiency and productivity.
* Design, develop, and implement workflow automation using platforms such as n8n, Make.com, Zapier, Microsoft Power Automate, or similar tools.
* Build and maintain AI Agents and AI Assistants to support business operations across multiple departments.
* Integrate various business systems through APIs, including ERP, CRM, HRIS, marketplaces, Google Workspace, WhatsApp, email platforms, and databases.
* Develop and implement AI-powered solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs) such as OpenAI GPT, Claude, Gemini, or other AI technologies.
* Monitor, troubleshoot, optimize, and continuously improve existing automation workflows to ensure reliability and performance.
* Create technical documentation, SOPs, and provide knowledge sharing or training to end users regarding automation solutions.
* Stay up to date with the latest AI and automation trends, evaluating and proposing innovative solutions that create business value.

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree (S1) in Computer Science, Information Systems, Informatics Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in Software Engineering, AI Development, Process Automation, Process Improvement, or a related role.
* Hands-on experience with at least one automation platform such as n8n, Make.com, Zapier, Microsoft Power Automate, or similar workflow automation tools.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON, and system integration concepts.
* Proficient in Python or JavaScript for developing and supporting automation solutions.
* Experience working with AI APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or other Generative AI platforms.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Passionate about AI, automation, and continuously learning emerging technologies.
* Open to working full-time from our office in West Jakarta (WFO).

*Our vibrant culture, embodied by the mottos #FLYUPTheExtraMiles and #LegacyInMotion, fosters creativity, collaboration, and relentless improvement. Seize the opportunity to grow with NEWLAB+ Group, where your ambition and innovation are celebrated and rewarded. Join us and be a part of a legacy of excellence and transformation.*

description:
* Location: Ho Chi Minh city/ Hanoi/ Indonesia
* Department: Engineering
* Report to: DevOps Lead

**About Us**

ELSA is a global leader in AI-powered English communication training, dedicated to transforming how people learn and speak English with confidence. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in San Francisco, we operate across the U.S., Vietnam, Portugal, Indonesia, Brazil and Japan.

Powered by proprietary speech-recognition technology and generative AI, ELSA delivers real-time, hyper-personalized feedback to help learners improve pronunciation, fluency, and overall communication effectiveness. With over 50 million learners and 1 billion hours of anonymized speech data, ELSAs depth of language training intelligence is unmatched in the industry.

Our B2B flagship platforms ELSA Enterprise and ELSA Schools empower organizations and educational institutions to elevate communication capabilities and unlock personal and professional opportunities for their people. We design engaging, bite-sized learning experiences that adapt to each learner's goals and context, ensuring measurable improvement and lasting confidence.

Our vision is to become the global standard for real-time English communication training, enabling 1.5 billion language learners worldwide to speak clearly, be understood, and share their stories with the world.

Backed by world-class investors including Googles Gradient Ventures, Monks Hill Ventures, and SOSV, ELSA has been recognized among the top global AI innovators:

* Forbes Top 4 Companies Using AI to Transform the World
* Research Sniper Top 5 Best AI Apps
* ASU+GSV EdTech 150
* CB Insights Top 100 AI Companies

Join us in shaping the future of language learning and empowering millions to unlock opportunity through confident communication.

**Role Summary**

We are seeking a proactive Senior DevOps Engineer to join our elite engineering team in Vietnam. You will play a pivotal role in scaling our cutting-edge AI product, ensuring high availability, and optimizing our infrastructure using the latest technologies.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Automation & CI/CD: Implement and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines. Actively leverage AI tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to optimize scripting and automate repetitive operational tasks.
* Infrastructure & K8s Management: Manage the lifecycle of AWS infrastructure and EKS clusters, including version upgrades, node group migrations, and ensuring zero-downtime operations.
* Observability & Performance: Implement and manage monitoring, logging, and APM solutions to trace transactions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure system health.
* Database & Data Integrity: Manage cloud databases (RDS, DynamoDB), ensuring high availability, automated backup strategies, and disaster recovery readiness.
* Security & DevSecOps: Proactively improve system security by managing IAM policies, performing vulnerability scanning, and implementing security best practices across the stack.
* Collaboration & Support: Partner with developers to optimize workflows and troubleshoot issues with a supportive, open-minded approach.
* Documentation: Maintain clear and comprehensive technical documentation for internal knowledge sharing.

**What You Will Have**

**Technical Requirements**

* 3-5 years of hands-on DevOps experience in production environments.
* Kubernetes Expertise: Deep understanding of EKS, Helm charts, and ArgoCD. Experience with K8s version upgrades is a strong advantage.
* Cloud & IaC: Proficiency in AWS services and Terraform.
* Observability: Working knowledge of APM tools (Signoz/Sentry/New Relic) and monitoring stacks (Prometheus/Grafana).
* Database Management: Experience in managing and scaling AWS RDS (Aurora/PostgreSQL) and DynamoDB.
* Security Mindset: Familiarity with Network security, IAM, Secret Management, and container security scanning.
* Scripting: Strong abilities in Bash or Python for automation.
* AI Fluency: Demonstrated ability or high interest in using AI tools to solve complex technical problems and increase productivity.
* Can-do Attitude: A proactive problem-solver who brings solutions, not just problems.
* Low Ego & Openness: You value the best idea over being "right," embrace feedback, and share knowledge generously.
* Collaborative & Adaptable: Strong communication skills and comfortable in a fast-paced, evolving startup environment.

**What We Offer**

* Flexible work setup: Remote-first for Singapore, India, Indonesia, Malaysia; hybrid model for Vietnam.
* Comprehensive employee well-being benefits.
* Free ELSA Premium courses to polish your language skills
* Collaborative, international team culture.
* Opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing, well-funded Silicon Valley startup with global impact.

title: Senior Backend Engineer I - Platform
description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
  
  
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Backend Engineer I in the Platform team, you build and maintain the shared backend services that every Ajaib product depends on, such as authentication, notifications, configuration and API gateways. You deliver well-defined features with high quality, learn how to design services that many teams rely on, and help keep the foundations stable and secure.
  
  

* Design, build and maintain shared backend services and APIs used by many product teams
* Deliver features from technical design to production, with tests, monitoring and alerting
* Keep APIs stable and backward compatible, and communicate changes clearly to the teams that use them
* Build secure services that protect user identity, sessions and personal data
* Write clear documentation and examples so other engineers can use your services without asking for help
* Write clean, well-tested code and take an active part in code reviews
* Investigate production issues, find root causes and help ship lasting fixes
* Improve the performance and reliability of the services your team owns
* Work with product engineering teams, Security and Infrastructure to turn requirements into reliable solutions

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Experience: 4+ years of professional backend engineering, including running services in production
* Languages: Strong in Java, Go or another modern backend language
* System Design: Good understanding of microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven design and reliability basics
* Data & Messaging: Hands-on with relational databases (query tuning), caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka)
* Security: Working knowledge of authentication and authorization (OAuth2, JWT) and secure coding
* Infrastructure: Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), containers and CI/CD
* Mindset: Ownership mindset, clear communication and a service attitude toward internal users. Experience in fintech or another regulated environment is a plus

**Benefits**

* Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
* Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
* Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
* Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
* Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
* Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
* Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
* Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users

description:
Summary
  
  
The people here don’t just build products — they create the kind of technology and experiences that can change entire industries. It is the diversity of our people and their ideas that drives the innovation behind everything we do. Join us and help leave the world better than we found it. At Apple we work with some of the most ambitious organizations in the world. We help customers rethink how their people work, how technology can improve their business, and how our platforms and ecosystem can become part of that journey. The Technology Strategist is a trusted technical advisor to some of Apple’s most strategic enterprise customers in Southeast Asia. You will work with business and technology leaders to turn organizational ambition into a clear technical vision, architecture, and adoption roadmap. The role combines enterprise architecture, executive advisory, and hands-on technical leadership. You will help customers understand emerging technologies, simplify complex decisions, modernize their technology environments, and create secure, scalable experiences with Apple at their core.
  
  
Description
  
  
Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and senior business leaders, becoming a strategic advisor on technology and innovation. Help customers define a multi-year technical vision that connects their business ambition with their enterprise architecture, operating model, workforce strategy, and investment priorities. Assess the customer’s current technology landscape across identity, security, device management, networking, cloud services, applications, data, AI, and support operations. Translate that assessment into a practical roadmap, identifying architectural dependencies, integration requirements, technical debt, security considerations, and opportunities for simplification. Develop reference architectures and integration patterns for Apple platforms within complex, heterogeneous enterprise environments. Apply well-architected principles across security and privacy, reliability and resilience, operational excellence, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. Help customers rationalize their technology and application portfolios, understand architectural trade-offs, and make informed decisions based on business value, risk, user experience, and total cost of ownership. Lead executive briefings, technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, and design reviews. Demystify complex and emerging technologies—including AI—and explain their implications clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with Apple sales, engineering, product, security, services, and partner teams to remove technical barriers and move customers from vision to scaled adoption. Maintain a clear technical account plan with agreed priorities, milestones, success measures, risks, and owners. Represent the voice of the customer within Apple, providing insight into enterprise requirements, technology trends, and opportunities for innovation. * Strong technical depth across enterprise architecture, cloud and hybrid environments, identity and access management, cybersecurity, endpoint management, networking, application integration, and lifecycle operations.
* Strong knowledge of identity and security concepts, including federation, SSO, MFA, conditional access, Zero Trust, PKI and certificates, endpoint security, data protection, and security governance.
* Experience designing solutions that integrate devices and platforms with identity providers, MDM or UEM platforms, security tools, cloud services, SaaS applications, APIs, and line-of-business systems.
* Strong consultative skills and the ability to uncover customer needs, challenge assumptions constructively, and connect technology decisions to business outcomes.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to make complex technology understandable without oversimplifying it.
* Confidence engaging senior executives while maintaining credibility with architects, security teams, engineers, and operations teams.
* Ability to influence across complex organizations and coordinate multiple internal, customer, and partner stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or equivalent practical experience.

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Experience deploying and integrating Apple platforms in large enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of macOS, iOS, iPadOS, Apple Business Manager, automated device enrollment, declarative device management, Platform SSO, and Apple platform security.
* Enterprise architecture, cloud, identity, security, or device-management certifications.
* Experience working in regulated industries or complex multinational organizations.
* Understanding of AI architectures, including cloud, hybrid, private, and on-device approaches.
* Experience developing business cases using adoption outcomes, risk reduction, employee experience, and total economic impact.

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace

title: Project Implementation Assistant
description:
***Consultant as Project Implementation Assistant - Cities Program***

***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.***

**Program Overview**

Under the support of the Climate and Clean Air Coalition (CCAC), WRI Indonesia is supporting the establishment and operationalization of the Indonesia Super Pollutant Unit to strengthen Indonesia’s capacity to design, coordinate, and implement policies and actions to reduce super pollutants, including short-lived climate pollutants (SLCPs). WRI Indonesia serves as the administrator of the Unit.

This institutional arrangement is designed to enable sustained engagement with senior government leadership while strengthening operational coordination across key technical directorates, including Waste Management, Climate Change, Air Quality, and Monitoring, Reporting, and Verification (MRV). Acting as Indonesia’s national coordination platform for super pollutant mitigation, the Unit will convene relevant ministries, along with state-owned enterprises, development partners, and subnational governments. Through this platform, the Unit will promote coherent policy development, strengthen integrated data and knowledge systems, mobilize financial and technical resources, and mainstream super pollutant mitigation into Indonesia’s national development and climate policy frameworks.

**Job Highlight**

The Project Implementation Assistant will provide administrative, operational, and coordination support to the Indonesia Super Pollutant Unit to facilitate the effective delivery of its projects and activities. The position will primarily focus on providing and coordinating administrative and operational support including , maintaining project documentation, track implementation progress and deliverables, and facilitate stakeholder engagement activities by preparing materials, documenting key results and follow-up action, and preparing materials to support project report..

The role also requires a good understanding of super pollutant issues and the Unit’s program priorities to effectively support the preparation of briefing notes, meeting materials, presentations, and other documents requiring technical or substantive inputs. Working closely with the Technical Unit Senior Lead and relevant technical experts, the Project Implementation Assistant will help consolidate technical inputs, organize relevant information, and ensure that program materials are accurate, consistent, and aligned with the Unit’s priorities., The role will also support follow up on agreed actions and outstanding tasks to facilitate smooth program coordination and implementation.

The Project Implementation Assistant will report directly to the SLCP Technical Unit Senior Lead and coordinate with relevant WRI Indonesia teams, government counterparts, technical experts, and development partners as required to support the implementation of the Unit’s activities.

This position is based in Jakarta with flexible working arrangements and domestic and international travel as required. In support of WRI's commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI), this position is expected to actively integrate equity and inclusive practices into program implementation, stakeholder engagement, and organizational culture.

**What You Will Do**

**Project Implementation Support (50%)**

* Provide administrative and operational support for program implementation under the direction of the SLCP Technical Unit Senior Lead.
* Assist in maintaining project work plans, activity trackers, deliverable records, and other project documentation to support implementation monitoring and follow-up.
* Support the preparation of terms of reference, briefing notes, presentations, progress updates, and other administrative and program materials as required.
* Assist in compiling and consolidating program updates, technical inputs, activity summaries, and supporting information for progress reports, donor reporting, and other internal and external reporting requirements.
* Maintain an organized repository of program documents, meeting records, correspondence, and other relevant materials.
* Track progress against the annual work plan, deliverables, and agreed targets, flagging delays, outstanding decisions, and implementation challenges to the SLCP Senior Lead.
* Support the preparation of periodic report in accordance with CCAC reporting requirement and the guidance of the SLCP Technical Unit Senior Lead.

**Stakeholder Engagement and Coordination Support (50%)**

* Support the planning, preparation, and implementation of stakeholder meetings, technical discussions, workshops, consultations, and other project activities.
* Prepare and distribute meeting invitations, agendas, participant lists, briefing materials, presentations, and other supporting documents.
* Coordinate communication and logistical coordination with relevant government institutions, technical experts, development partners, and other stakeholders.
* Prepare minutes of meetings documenting key discussion points, decisions, and agreed follow-up actions.
* Maintain follow up matrix to tract commitments and agreed action involving government counterparts, technical experts and development parters.
* Documenting stakeholder engagements and program activities for internal reporting and knowledge management.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor’s degree in environmental studies, environmental science, public policy, international development, social sciences, business administration, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience in project administration, program coordination, project support, or a related field.
* Familiarity with climate change, air quality, environmental policy, or super pollutant issues is an advantage.
* Experience supporting donor-funded programs, multi-stakeholder initiatives, or projects involving government institutions and development partners is an advantage.
* Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining attention to detail.
* Ability to provide administrative and coordination support, maintain systematic documentation, , and track activity progress and follow-up actions.
* Strong writing and information synthesis skills, with the ability to prepare clear and well-structured meeting minutes, briefing notes, presentations, progress updates, and other program documents
* Effective written and verbal communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams, government counterparts, technical experts, and development partners.
* Proactive, dependable, and detail-oriented, with a strong sense of responsibility and a willingness to learn and take initiative.
* Ability and willingness to travel as assigned
* Legally authorized to work in Indonesia.

**Duration**

The position is expected to start immediately with a 6 (six) month initial contract period with possibility of extension up to 31 December 2027 subject to individual performance evaluation, budget availability, and project needs.

**Deliverable**

1. A complete and up-to-date set of program documentation, including work plans, activity trackers, deliverable records, and supporting documents.

2. Meeting and program activities documentation packages, including terms of reference, agendas, invitations, presentations, briefing notes, and other relevant materials are prepared in a timely manner.

3. Consolidated records of stakeholder engagement capturing key discussions points, decisions, commitments, and follow-up action trackers

4. Periodic project progress report consolidating implementation updates, , technical inputs, activity summaries, and key achievements.

5. Regular work progress and achievement report outlining completed assignments, ongoing activities, and outstanding follow-up items.

**Terms of Payment**

Daily rate-based consultant with a maximum of 18 (eighteen) working days per month

**How to Apply:**

* Please submit a resume with a cover letter by **17 November 2026**. You must apply through the WRI Careers portal to be considered. We may close for applications sooner if we receive a high volume of applications from qualified candidates.
* Must have authorization to work in Indonesia to be eligible for this position.
* Final candidates might be required to take a certain test and/or to produce/share writing samples when needed.
* This is a locally engaged position, Indonesian nationals are encouraged to apply.

**What we offer:**

* Consultant rate that is commensurate with experience and skill.
* Travel insurance for both domestic and international for any travel duty as assigned by WRI Indonesia
* Access to the WRI global network with the opportunity to exchange with and learn from passionate colleagues working at the cutting edge of their fields.
* A workplace that strives to put diversity and inclusion at the heart of our work
* The opportunity to join and get involved in different working groups and affinity groups to shape the future of WRI
* Commitment to hybrid working model with flexible working hours

**About Us:**

World Resources Institute works to improve people’s lives, protect and restore nature and stabilize the climate. As an independent research organization, we leverage our data, expertise and global reach to influence policy and catalyze change across systems like food, land and water; energy; and cities. Our 2,000+ staff work on the ground in more than a dozen focus countries and with partners in over 50 nations.

**Our mission and values:**

WRI’s mission is to move human society to live in ways that protect Earth’s environment and its capacity to provide for the needs and aspirations of current and future generations.

Our values are shared ideals that bind us together: Independence, Integrity, Impact, Partnership, and Care.

**Our culture:**

WRI is committed to advancing gender and social equity for human well-being in our mission including equal opportunities in employment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, caste, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, disability, or protected Veteran status.

Our Human Resources Team carefully reviews all applications.

description:
**About this role**

We are seeking a senior CloudOps Engineer to operate and improve Azure production services for APAC customer environments. The role provides regional CloudOps capability during APAC business hours, supports production go-lives and hypercare, and coordinates incident resolution with SL2 and the European CloudOps team.

**Your responsibilities**

* Operate, monitor and maintain Azure production environments during APAC business hours
* Support customer go-lives, production releases and hypercare, including deployment validation and rollback readiness
* Monitor service health, capacity, availability and alerts; investigate incidents and coordinate resolution with SL2, European CloudOps, application teams and relevant third parties
* Support Azure platform components, including AKS, networking, Azure Front Door/WAF, API Management, databases, storage, Key Vault and monitoring services
* Implement approved infrastructure and configuration changes in accordance with change-management, security and operational procedures
* Contribute to root-cause analysis, preventive actions and improvements to production reliability
* Improve operations through scripting, infrastructure as code, runbooks and appropriate automation
* Maintain accurate documentation for production environments, operating procedures and customer-specific configurations
* Contribute to observability and alerting improvements using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Grafana and OpenTelemetry-based telemetry where applicable

**Your qualifications, skills and experience**

* At least 5 years of hands-on CloudOps, DevOps, infrastructure or production-operations experience, including senior-level ownership of operational tasks
* Practical experience operating production workloads on Microsoft Azure
* Experience with several of the following: AKS/Kubernetes, Azure networking, Azure Front Door/WAF, API Management, Azure SQL, storage, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and Log Analytics
* Experience with incident management, production troubleshooting, change control and release support
* Familiarity with infrastructure as code and automation, such as Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, PowerShell, Bash or Python
* Ability to interpret monitoring and telemetry data to investigate service degradation and operational alerts
* Experience with .NET, ASP.NET (MVC, Web API), Web Services, SQL, RabbitMQ, Redis
* Strong documentation, communication and coordination skills across time zones and teams; professional fluency in English
* A careful, risk-aware approach to production changes, a strong sense of ownership, and an automation-oriented mindset
* The role provides APAC-hours coverage

**Location**

Jakarta, Indonesia

**We offer you**

* An open-minded, international and fast-paced environment where decisions are made quickly, ideas are welcomed and people are encouraged to make a real impact
* A meritocratic culture built on ownership, performance and continuous feedback, where ambition is recognized and contribution matters
* The opportunity to influence decisions, challenge the status quo and shape better ways of working, while collaborating across teams and functions
* A strong commitment to continuous learning and professional development, with support to grow your expertise, capabilities and career
* A values-driven culture where we Care by building trust and lasting relationships, Commit by taking ownership and delivering on our goals, Collaborate by bringing the right people and expertise together, and Challenge ourselves to raise the bar and achieve stronger outcomes

title: Data Platform & Integration Solution
description:
Responsible for designing, building, and managing an enterprise data platform that integrates real-time and batch data, shapes enterprise data models, and provides data and services through APIs and application serving layers to support operational, analytical, and digital business needs.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Data Platform Architecture:**

* Design a scalable, secure, and resilient enterprise data platform architecture.
* Define data integration standards for real-time, near-real-time, and batch processing needs.
* Develop a data platform blueprint aligned with the company's technology roadmap and business needs.

**Real-Time Data Integration**

* Design and implement CDC-based data ingestion (Change Data Capture).
* Develop an event streaming architecture using Kafka and Flink.
* Ensure near-real-time data flows meet established SLAs, reliability, and data consistency.

**Batch Data Integration**

* Integrate batch data sources from BigQuery and other systems.
* Design an efficient and scalable ETL/ELT process.
* Optimize data processing performance and costs.

**Enterprise Data Modeling**

* Design conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
* Develop data marts, canonical models, and data products that can be used across various business domains.
* Ensure data governance, metadata, and data quality standards are implemented across all platforms.
* Data Serving & API Enablement
* Design and manage an API Gateway as a single entry point for data and service consumption.
* Develop a service layer using Cloud Run or other container platforms.
* Provide secure, documented, and easy-to-use APIs and data services for internal and external applications.
* Cloud Platform & Engineering
* Manage the implementation of cloud-native solutions based on Google Cloud Platform.
* Build CI/CD, monitoring, logging, and observability for all platform components.
* Ensure platform security, availability, scalability, and cost optimization.

**Governance & Collaboration**

* Collaborate with application teams, data engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders.
* Develop architectural standards, best practices, and technical documentation.
* Provide technical guidance to engineers and vendors involved in platform development.

description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.
  
  
**Your day at NTT DATA**
The Associate Data Engineer is an entry level role within the Data Engineering job family. This role is, tasked with assisting with the transformation of data into a structured format that can be easily analyzed in a query or report.
  
  
This role is responsible for supporting with the development of structured data sets that can be reused or complimented by other data sets and reports.
  
  
This role analyzes the data sources and data structure and will design and develop data models to support the analytics requirements of the business which includes management / operational / predictive / data science capabilities.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**

* Supports the creation of data models in a structured data format to enable analysis thereof.
* Assists with the design and development of scalable extract, transform and loading (ETL) packages from the business source systems and the development of ETL routines to populate data from sources.
* Participates in the transformation of object and data models into appropriate database schemas within design constraints. Interpret installation standards to meet project needs and produce database components as required.
* Takes direction from various stakeholders to create test scenarios and be responsible for participating in thorough testing and validation to support the accuracy of data transformations.
* Assists with running data migrations across different databases and applications, for example, MS Dynamics, Oracle, SAP and other ERP systems.
* Supports the definition and implementation of data table structures and data models based on requirements.
* Takes part in analysis, and development of ETL and migration documentation.
* Receives detailed instructions from various stakeholders to evaluate potential data requirements.
* Assists with the definition and management of scoping, requirements, definition, and prioritization activities for small-scale changes and assist with more complex change initiatives.
* Takes direction from various stakeholders, contributing to the recommendation of improvements in automated and non-automated components of the data tables, data queries and data models.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Knowledge of the definition and management of scoping requirements, definition and prioritization activities.
* Understanding of database concepts, object and data modelling techniques and design principles and conceptual knowledge of building and maintaining physical and logical data models.
* Knowledge of Microsoft Azure Data Factory, SQL Analysis Server, SAP Data Services, SAP BTP.
* Understanding of data architecture landscape between physical and logical data models.
* Analytical mindset with good business acumen skills.
* Problem-solving aptitude with the ability to communicate effectively, both written and verbal.
* Ability to build effective relationships at all levels within the organization.
* Programing languages (Perl, bash, Shell Scripting, Python, etc.).

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or a related field.
* Relevant certifications preferred such as SAP, Microsoft Azure etc.
* Certified Data Engineer, Certified Professional certification preferred.

**Required experience:**

* Basic experience as a data engineering, data mining within a fast-paced environment.
* Familiarity with building modern data analytics solutions that delivers insights from large and complex data sets with multi-terabyte scale.
* Basic experience with architecture and design of secure, highly available and scalable systems.
* Familiarity with automation, scripting and proven examples of successful implementation.
* Familiarity with scripts using scripting language (Perl, bash, Shell Scripting, Python, etc.).
* Basic experience with big data tools like Hadoop, Cassandra, Storm etc.
* Basic experience in any applicable language, preferably .NET.
* Familiarity with working with SAP, SQL, MySQL databases and Microsoft SQL.
* Basic experience working with data sets and ordering data through MS Excel functions, e.g. macros, pivots.

On-site Working

year in R&D.

title: Head of Technology & Data Business - Indonesia
description:
**ABOUT IIX GLOBAL**

IIX (Impact Investment Exchange) is a Singapore-headquartered pioneer in impact investing, connecting capital markets with sustainable development. For over a decade, IIX has been building the infrastructure for impact — structuring innovative financial instruments, running donor-funded development programs, and developing digital platforms that serve impact investors, enterprises, and communities across Asia and beyond.

Our work spans impact-linked securities, blended finance, gender-lens investing, and climate finance — always with the goal of mobilizing private capital for social and environmental good. Over 17 years, IIX has:

* Mobilized nearly $500M in private-sector capital
* Positively impacted over 160 million lives
* Avoided over 1.9 million metric tons of carbon
* Collected over 90,000+ data points on sustainable MSMEs

We are a lean, mission-obsessed team. Everyone here wears multiple hats, moves fast, and cares deeply about the work. If that energizes you, you'll thrive at IIX.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

IIX is seeking a Head of Technology & Data Business to turn IIX's data, platforms, and impact expertise into standalone, revenue-generating technology products. This is a business leadership role, not a traditional technology lead: you will own the commercial success of technology and data at IIX, not just the delivery of platforms and projects.

IIX Fintech brings together IIX Values™ (impact measurement and ESG data), Impact Partners™ (enterprise and investor connectivity), and IIX Intelligence (data and analytics). You will lead commercial strategy, monetization, the product portfolio, data strategy, partnerships, and the unit's P&L.

You inherit a live pipeline. Two priority pilots are in development: **Proofloop**, the next generation of IIX Values impact verification, and **Capital OS**, the next generation of Impact Partners investor matching. A flagship launch is targeted for the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027. Success means a product-led, tech-led business unit with paying institutional customers and a repeatable process for finding, building, and taking new products to market.

**YOUR TEAM**

You will lead a distributed team across Indonesia, India, the Philippines, and Sri Lanka:

* **Product Leadership —** discovery, roadmap, requirements, prioritization, and design partners (pilot clients).
* **Data Product —** methodology, models, datasets, analytics, and rapid prototyping.
* **Engineering —** architecture, APIs, systems of record, delivery, and reliability.
* **Sales & Monetization —** a new [VP] role you will hire, driving pipeline development and sales execution.
* **UX/UI Design —** a new role you will hire, owning user flows and interface design.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Commercial Strategy & P&L**

* Own overall commercial outcomes for IIX Fintech: P&L, revenue targets, budget, pricing, and unit economics
* Set commercial strategy, targets, and pricing; the Sales & Monetization lead drives pipeline development and sales execution against them
* Build and execute a 3–5 year growth strategy that positions IIX as a technology-driven player in impact finance
* Lead closing of strategic contracts with institutional clients, investors, and partners
* Scan the market continuously — strategy meetings, industry conferences, competitor tracking — to identify white spaces where IIX has a defensible value proposition

**2. Product Portfolio & Go-to-Market**

* Take Proofloop and Capital OS from pilot to paying customers, including the flagship launch at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027
* Run a product-led process: customer discovery first, then build — working backwards from customer problems, not internal specifications
* Require evidence of willingness to pay (such as design partner commitments, letters of intent, or paid pilots) before committing significant development resources
* Manage the product roadmap and prioritization with the Product Lead; recruit design partners to test new products
* Define pricing, packaging, and positioning for institutional buyers — investors, financial institutions, corporates, and development finance institutions

**3. Data Strategy & Monetization**

* Build a shared data foundation (90,000+ MSME data points, impact verification data) that enables multiple products across IIX Fintech
* Pursue external data monetization only where there is a validated customer need
* Oversee methodology, models, and datasets with the Data Product team; ensure data privacy and compliance standards are met

**4. Embedding Product Thinking Across IIX**

* Work with business unit leads to identify and package their own products and pilots, so product-led thinking is distributed across IIX
* Partner with Asset Management and Advisory to embed data and analytics into investment strategies, client reporting, and advisory solutions
* Engage IIX Institute as an integration partner on certification and training linked to IIX Values scoring

**5. Team Leadership**

* Lead a distributed team spanning product, data, engineering, sales, and design
* Hire the Sales & Monetization lead and UX/UI Designer, and build the team as products scale
* Set team KPIs, operating rhythm, and a culture of rapid iteration, ownership, and learning from failure
* Balance support for existing platforms with protected capacity for new product development
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent aligned with IIX's mission and PREM values

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* **First 90 days:** Take over Proofloop and Capital OS; validate pricing with at least 3 target customers; hire the Sales & Monetization lead and UX/UI Designer; agree team KPIs and roadmap with leadership.
* **6 months:** At least 2 design partners live on a priority product; sales pipeline built against agreed lead, pipeline-value, and conversion targets.
* **12 months:** First signed revenue contracts; flagship product launched at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027; repeatable product discovery process adopted by business units.

Targets are indicative and will be finalized with the line manager on joining.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**Experience & Skills**

* Typically 15+ years across fintech, digital platforms, financial services, or technology businesses; we prioritize demonstrated commercial ownership, product execution, and technical fluency over tenure
* Proven track record of taking technology products to market and generating revenue, with P&L or revenue ownership; founder, co-founder, or Chief Product Officer experience is a strong advantage
* A blend of structured corporate experience and startup or venture-building experience
* Hands-on understanding of the product and software development life cycle: discovery, roadmap, prototyping, release, and iteration
* B2B or enterprise sales to institutional buyers such as financial institutions, investors, DFIs, or governments
* Emerging markets experience in Southeast Asia, South Asia, or Africa, including navigating regulatory environments
* Experience leading distributed, multi-country teams
* Product management and go-to-market strategy, including pricing and packaging
* Data strategy and data product design; working familiarity with analytics tools (e.g., Python, SQL, BI tools) and AI/ML applications
* Strong grasp of UX/UI principles and user-centered design
* Understanding of financial markets and ESG/impact measurement preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master's is an advantage

**The Person**

* Commercial owner — measures success by revenue and customer adoption, not projects delivered
* Builder — comfortable creating products and teams from an early stage with limited resources
* Customer-obsessed — talks to customers before building
* Relationship-led — credible with investors, institutions, and senior internal stakeholders
* Bridges cultures — brings tech ways of working into a structured organization and brings leadership along
* Deep alignment with IIX's mission of inclusive finance, gender equality, and climate action

**HOW THIS TEAM WORKS**

* **Product-led —** we talk to customers first and work backwards to what we build
* **Rapid iteration —** small pilots, fast feedback, and permission to fail as we find the winners
* **Protected capacity —** a defined share of engineering and product capacity is reserved for commercial pilots, so new products are not displaced by platform support
* **Autonomy with decision rights —** clear revenue and adoption KPIs, and clear authority over product priorities, pilot go/no-go, and pricing within the agreed budget
* **Distributed, but together —** the team meets in person for a working sprint each quarter in the region

**THE PREM FRAMEWORK**

Every IIX team member is a PREM professional. We look for these qualities in everyone we hire:

**P** **- Passionate**

Mission-driven & purpose-led

**R** **- Resilient**

Thrives under pressure & ambiguity

**E -** **Equitable**

Champions fairness & inclusion

**M -** **Maverick**

Bold, entrepreneurial thinker

**WHY IIX**

* Build IIX's technology business at the moment it moves from pilots to market, with a flagship launch at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027
* Work at the intersection of finance, technology, and impact — with UN agencies, investors, and top-tier financial institutions
* High-trust, lean team environment — minimal bureaucracy, maximum ownership
* Opportunity to drive global change in gender equality and climate action
* A culture that takes PREM values seriously — you will be seen, heard, and valued

**HOW TO APPLY**

To apply, please send your CV and a brief cover note to jobs@iixglobal.com. In your cover note, tell us about a technology product or business you took to market — the problem, what you built, how you found your first paying customers, and the commercial result. Please also highlight any experience in data products, institutional sales, or impact/ESG.

IIX is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team that reflects the communities we serve.

* **UX/UI Design —** a new role you will hire, owning user flows and interface design.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Commercial Strategy & P&L**

* Own overall commercial outcomes for IIX Fintech: P&L, revenue targets, budget, pricing, and unit economics
* Set commercial strategy, targets, and pricing; the Sales & Monetization lead drives pipeline development and sales execution against them
* Build and execute a 3–5 year growth strategy that positions IIX as a technology-driven player in impact finance
* Lead closing of strategic contracts with institutional clients, investors, and partners
* Scan the market continuously — strategy meetings, industry conferences, competitor tracking — to identify white spaces where IIX has a defensible value proposition

**2. Product Portfolio & Go-to-Market**

* Take Proofloop and Capital OS from pilot to paying customers, including the flagship launch at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027
* Run a product-led process: customer discovery first, then build — working backwards from customer problems, not internal specifications
* Require evidence of willingness to pay (such as design partner commitments, letters of intent, or paid pilots) before committing significant development resources
* Manage the product roadmap and prioritization with the Product Lead; recruit design partners to test new products
* Define pricing, packaging, and positioning for institutional buyers — investors, financial institutions, corporates, and development finance institutions

**3. Data Strategy & Monetization**

* Build a shared data foundation (90,000+ MSME data points, impact verification data) that enables multiple products across IIX Fintech
* Pursue external data monetization only where there is a validated customer need
* Oversee methodology, models, and datasets with the Data Product team; ensure data privacy and compliance standards are met

**4. Embedding Product Thinking Across IIX**

* Work with business unit leads to identify and package their own products and pilots, so product-led thinking is distributed across IIX
* Partner with Asset Management and Advisory to embed data and analytics into investment strategies, client reporting, and advisory solutions
* Engage IIX Institute as an integration partner on certification and training linked to IIX Values scoring

**5. Team Leadership**

* Lead a distributed team spanning product, data, engineering, sales, and design
* Hire the Sales & Monetization lead and UX/UI Designer, and build the team as products scale
* Set team KPIs, operating rhythm, and a culture of rapid iteration, ownership, and learning from failure
* Balance support for existing platforms with protected capacity for new product development
* Recruit, mentor, and retain top talent aligned with IIX's mission and PREM values

* **First 90 days:** Take over Proofloop and Capital OS; validate pricing with at least 3 target customers; hire the Sales & Monetization lead and UX/UI Designer; agree team KPIs and roadmap with leadership.

* Understanding of financial markets and ESG/impact measurement preferred
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Administration, or a related field; a Master's is an advantage

* Commercial owner — measures success by revenue and customer adoption, not projects delivered
* Builder — comfortable creating products and teams from an early stage with limited resources
* Customer-obsessed — talks to customers before building
* Relationship-led — credible with investors, institutions, and senior internal stakeholders
* Bridges cultures — brings tech ways of working into a structured organization and brings leadership along
* Deep alignment with IIX's mission of inclusive finance, gender equality, and climate action

* **Rapid iteration —** small pilots, fast feedback, and permission to fail as we find the winners
* **Protected capacity —** a defined share of engineering and product capacity is reserved for commercial pilots, so new products are not displaced by platform support
* **Autonomy with decision rights —** clear revenue and adoption KPIs, and clear authority over product priorities, pilot go/no-go, and pricing within the agreed budget
* **Distributed, but together —** the team meets in person for a working sprint each quarter in the region

Every IIX team member is a PREM professional. We look for these qualities in everyone we hire:

**P** **- Passionate**

Mission-driven & purpose-led

**R** **- Resilient**

Thrives under pressure & ambiguity

**E -** **Equitable**

Champions fairness & inclusion

**M -** **Maverick**

Bold, entrepreneurial thinker

**WHY IIX**

* Build IIX's technology business at the moment it moves from pilots to market, with a flagship launch at the Singapore Fintech Festival 2027
* Work at the intersection of finance, technology, and impact — with UN agencies, investors, and top-tier financial institutions
* High-trust, lean team environment — minimal bureaucracy, maximum ownership
* Opportunity to drive global change in gender equality and climate action
* A culture that takes PREM values seriously — you will be seen, heard, and valued

**HOW TO APPLY**

To apply, please send your CV and a brief cover note to jobs@iixglobal.com. In your cover note, tell us about a technology product or business you took to market — the problem, what you built, how you found your first paying customers, and the commercial result. Please also highlight any experience in data products, institutional sales, or impact/ESG.

IIX is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team that reflects the communities we serve.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. title: Senior Security Engineer, Cyber Defence Operations
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
You'll join Grab Cyber Defence, whose mission is to defend Grab and Grabbers from external and internal threat actors. We detect, hunt and respond to threats, rehearse our defences by emulating attackers, and share what we learn with stakeholders.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
As a Senior Security Engineer in Jakarta, you will report to the Senior Manager, Cyber Defence Operations. You lead our response to cybersecurity incidents and turn what we learn into better detections, automation and AI-assisted workflows that cut our time to respond. You will be part of our 24/7 on-call rotation.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Lead cybersecurity incidents: coordinate responders, guide containment and remediation, and lead post-incident reviews.
* Join a 24/7 on-call rotation.
* Triage security alerts from network, EDR and cloud sources, and handle escalations from complex cases.
* Run deep-dive forensics across cloud, network, host and application layers.
* Tune detections and hunt for threats using log and data analytics.
* Build automation (Python, SOAR playbooks) and lead the use of AI and agentic workflows in triage and response.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* 5+ years in a Security Operations Centre, incident response or digital forensics role, including leading incident response.
* Hands-on SIEM and EDR experience (for example Splunk, Sentinel, CrowdStrike).
* Forensics skills across cloud (AWS preferred), network and host (Windows, Linux, macOS) environments.
* Python scripting and security automation experience.
* Practical application of AI and LLM tools in security operations.
* Knowledge of MITRE ATT&CK and NIST Incident Response frameworks.
* Experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development.
* Mentoring or coaching experience.
* Certifications such as GCIH, GCFA or AWS security certifications.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

title: IT Security Access Management
description:
**Why Join:**

Be the Guardian of OCBC’s most critical credentials. In the banking sector, privileged access is the gateway to the crown jewels. You will play a pivotal role in safeguarding our most sensitive systems and data. This is not just a monitoring role; it is a strategic position in our Zero Trust security architecture.

**How You Succeed:**

Providing solution recommendations in line with industry standards, collaborating with the project team in the solutioning process. You will also conduct research on new technologies, establish governance and standards related to system architecture, and facilitate the dissemination of standard documents. Additionally, you will be involved in planning and coordinating with various squads for piloting and implementation.

**What You Do:**

* Maintain the Access Management solution (e.g., CyberArk) to manage privileged accounts for servers, databases, network devices, and applications.
* Monitor privileged sessions in real-time to detect and respond to anomalous activities.
* Participate in the 24/7 security operations rotation, handling alerts, tickets, and incidents related to privileged access violations or failures.
* Investigate potential security breaches involving privileged accounts and collaborate with the broader SOC (Security Operations Center) and IT teams for remediation.
* Collaborate with system administrators and development squads to integrate access management solutions with existing ITIL processes, SIEM, and IAM platforms.
* Develop and maintain automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, etc.) to streamline onboarding, password rotation, and reporting tasks.
* Support the onboarding of new applications and infrastructure into the access management framework during deployment cycles.

**Who You Are:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in IT Security, with a specific focus on Privileged Access Management (PAM).
* Solid background in System Administration (Linux/Unix and Windows Server) and strong knowledge of Operating System internals.
* Strong knowledge of security policies, risk management frameworks, and compliance standards relevant to the financial sector.
* Understanding of vulnerability management and patching processes in relation to privileged accounts.
* Must be willing and able to work rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays, as required by the 24/7 security operations model.

**You’ll be Part of:**

Group Operations and Technology co-creates products and solutions. We build the underlying technology applications and services. And manage the Group’s IT operations & cyber defense. 24/7. 365. End-to-end transaction fulfillment services. For the whole Group. With singular focus. Delivering exceptional customer experience. At the forefront of our digital transformation journey. Relentless innovation. Pushing boundaries. And it’s all powered by serious investment in your development.

**About OCBC:**

At PT Bank OCBC NISP Tbk (OCBC), we don’t just serve customers, but we walk alongside them being a trusted partner to enrich the quality of their lives. Since 1941, we have been committed to helping individuals and businesses navigate their financial journey with solutions that grow alongside their evolving needs.

By combining deeply rooted Indonesian values with the comprehensive global capability of the OCBC Group, we offer meaningful, relevant financial services, from daily banking to long-term planning, all delivered with care, understanding, and responsibility.

We are always looking for bright, driven individuals who are curious, collaborative, and eager to grow. At OCBC, you will find a workplace that respects your journey, supports your development, and gives you space to contribute meaningfully–because your Opportunity Starts Here!

**What We Offer:**

OCBC offers a competitive compensation & benefit, including a comprehensive suite of flexible benefits that fit your lifestyle and livelihood, community engagement programs, industry-leading learning, and professional development opportunities in the banking sector. We genuinely care about your well-being, growth, and aspirations−just as much as we care about our customers' needs. By joining our team, you will not only thrive personally and professionally but also contribute to become a Trusted Partner to Improve Quality of Life.
