title: Specification Engineer Intern (Software Requirements & Testing)
description:
**Specification Engineer Intern (Software Requirements & Testing)**

* **Location:** Yogyakarta, Indonesia
* **Work Arrangement:** Full-time, On-site
* **Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 08:00–17:00 WIB

**About the Role**  
Zettabyte is looking for a **Specification Engineer Intern** who is passionate about software technology, analytical thinking, and technical documentation.  
In this role, you will work closely with our engineering team to understand software requirements, analyze technical documentation, identify inconsistencies, and support software quality assurance activities.  
**This is a software and IT-focused position, not a civil, mechanical, or industrial engineering specification role.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* Read, analyze, and organize software requirements and technical documentation, primarily written in English.
* Prepare and maintain structured software specifications, functional requirements, and technical documentation.
* Develop test scenarios, test cases, and checklists based on software requirements.
* Identify inconsistencies, missing information, and potential issues in specifications or software functionality.
* Support software testing, bug reporting, and documentation of test results.
* Collaborate with Specification Engineers and Developers, using AI-assisted tools when appropriate.

**Required Qualifications**

* Final-year undergraduate student majoring in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, or a closely related software-focused discipline**.
* **Fluent English communication skills**, particularly reading technical documentation, understanding written requirements, and explaining technical information verbally.
* Good understanding of software development concepts, software requirements, and basic testing principles.
* Strong analytical thinking, logical reasoning, and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent attention to detail, accuracy, and consistency when reviewing information.
* Comfortable working with structured documentation and AI tools such as ChatGPT.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Familiarity with software testing, bug reporting, or QA processes.
* Basic understanding of programming, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or API concepts.
* Experience with software-related academic projects, technical documentation, or requirement analysis.

**Ideal Working Style**  
We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Enjoy analyzing complex information and identifying small details that others may overlook.
* Prefer structured, accurate, and well-organized work.
* Are comfortable reading extensive technical documentation in English.
* Can explain findings clearly and communicate with technical team members.
* Demonstrate curiosity, discipline, and a commitment to producing high-quality work.

**Recruitment Process**  
Shortlisted candidates will undergo English communication screening, technical assessments, and interviews to evaluate their suitability for the role.

**How to Apply**

If you’re passionate about technology, detail-oriented, and ready to learn from a global QA team, we’d love to meet you!

Send your CV and application to **internship@zettabyte.life** with the subject line:

**Application – Specification Engineer Intern**

**Ready to develop your skills in software requirements and quality assurance? Apply and grow with Zettabyte!**

title: DevOps Engineer (Contract Basis)
description:
**Description**
**📌 EMPLOYMENT DETAILS**

* Employment type: through 3rd party/ vendor
* Duration: 24 months fixed term (subject to change based on business needs)
* Work setup: Full onsite with dedicated full office hours based in BSD, Tangerang.

**THE ROLE**
**Senior**

* Lead the design, provisioning, and scaling of cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) across multiple product lines.
* Strategize the DevOps roadmap in partnership with Engineering leadership by defining standards, tooling choices, and long-term infrastructure direction.
* Authorize technical decisions on infrastructure architecture, CI/CD pipeline design, and automation frameworks.
* Synergize efforts across development, security, and platform teams to ensure reliable, secure, and scalable deployments.
* Negotiate trade-offs between reliability, cost, security, and delivery speed, providing clear recommendations to stakeholders.
* Lead incident response and root-cause analysis for critical production issues, driving long-term remediation.
* Enable safe AI-assisted engineering workflows by improving test execution, environment reproducibility, access controls, and documentation.
* Evaluate emerging DevOps tools and platforms; recommend adoption where they meaningfully improve reliability, security, or velocity.
* Formulate and enforce security best practices, compliance standards, and disaster recovery strategies across infrastructure.
* Lead the strategy for infrastructure-as-code governance, versioning, and configuration management.
* Mentor and grow mid and junior engineers through structured feedback, pairing, and technical guidance.
* Plan and control infrastructure delivery milestones, proactively surfacing risks and coordinating resolution across teams.

**Mid**

* Plan and build CI/CD pipelines and automation scripts to support consistent, repeatable deployments.
* Control the quality and reliability of infrastructure changes through thorough testing, monitoring, and adherence to team standards.
* Evaluate and implement Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or similar) for provisioning and configuration management.
* Formulate and document runbooks, monitoring dashboards, and alerting rules aligned with team practices.
* Collaborate closely with Developers, QA, and Security teams to streamline releases and troubleshoot issues.
* Recommend improvements to deployment processes, tooling, or system performance based on day-to-day experience.
* Participate in on-call rotations and incident response, escalating appropriately and documenting learnings.
* Use AI-assisted tools where appropriate for scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and runbook improvements, validating changes carefully before use.
* Plan and execute containerization and orchestration tasks (Docker, Kubernetes) under guidance from senior engineers.
* Contribute to security hardening tasks including patching, access reviews, and basic vulnerability remediation.
* Stay current with DevOps trends and evaluate new tools or techniques relevant to the team's work.

**Requirements**
**Senior**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure roles, with a demonstrable track record of running production-grade systems at scale.
* Deep expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), including multi-account and multi-region architecture.
* Proven mastery of Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation) and configuration management at scale.
* Extensive experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo CD, or equivalent).
* Strong command of containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) in production environments.
* Deep experience with observability i.e monitoring, logging, and tracing (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar).
* Proven ability to design and maintain highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure infrastructure.
* Experience leading security governance: vulnerability management, access control, and compliance frameworks.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and the security considerations around code, logs, secrets, and automation access.
* Strong scripting/programming skills (Bash, Python, or Go) for automation and tooling.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with incident management, on-call leadership, and post-mortem processes.
* Good communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

**Mid**

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Infrastructure roles.
* Solid proficiency with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and core services (compute, networking, storage).
* Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation).
* Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Working knowledge of scripting languages (Bash, Python, or Go).
* Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or similar).
* Familiarity with AI-assisted tools for scripting, debugging, documentation, or workflow automation is an advantage.
* Understanding of networking fundamentals, system security, and performance optimization.
* Experience using Git and collaborative development workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews).
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and willingness to learn.
* Good communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

title: Software Developer Lead
description:
We are looking for a Software Developer Lead to guide a team building and running system-integration products. You will turn business requirements into production outcomes by shaping architecture, making and communicating technical decisions, and helping engineers deliver and improve continuously.

We want someone who stays hands-on and technically credible, while raising the quality of decisions across the team and working well with other teams, external partners, and non-technical stakeholders.  
  
**Responsibilities:**  
  
**1. System Design and Architecture**

* Translate business requirements into technical solutions, defining components, service boundaries, APIs, data flows, and data models.
* Choose between synchronous and asynchronous communication patterns and evaluate architectural trade-offs.
* Consider scalability, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability from the start.

**2. System Integration**

* Design and oversee integrations with internal services and external or third-party systems (REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven flows).
* Define how the system behaves under timeouts, retries, duplicate requests, partial failures, and inconsistent data, including idempotency and reconciliation.
* Own API contracts, versioning, authentication and authorization, and data ownership across system boundaries.

**3. Technical Leadership**

* Make and document technical decisions, including the alternatives considered and the reasons for the choice.
* Set technical direction, resolve technical disagreements, and constructively challenge proposals.
* Guide, mentor, and unblock engineers, and establish engineering practices within the team.
* Identify technical risks early and escalate appropriately.

**4. Technical Execution**

* Take part in code reviews, design reviews, technical planning, and testing strategy.
* Debug and troubleshoot production issues, and identify and manage technical debt.
* Move between architecture, service design, API and data model, implementation, and production concerns.

**5. Communication and Collaboration**

* Explain technical concepts, risks, and trade-offs clearly to engineers, product, and management.
* Collaborate with other Tech Leads, teams, and external partners, and raise problems proactively.
* Produce clear technical documentation.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 7+ years of professional software engineering experience.
* Strong software engineering fundamentals and proven hands-on experience building production systems.
* Strong system design skills, able to independently design a moderately complex system and explain its components, data flow, API boundaries, data model, failure scenarios, and scalability considerations.
* Real-world experience integrating multiple systems, including external or third-party ones, and handling unavailable dependencies, timeouts, duplicate requests, partial failures, and data inconsistencies.
* Solid understanding of APIs and service communication: REST, API contracts, versioning, authentication and authorization, rate limiting, and webhooks.
* Understanding of data modelling, data ownership, consistency, and reliability.
* Demonstrated ability to make technical decisions, provide direction, guide engineers, and explain trade-offs.
* Ability to review designs and implementations, and to troubleshoot production problems.
* Clear verbal and written communication, with the ability to adapt the message for technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ownership mindset and proactive, cross-team collaboration.
* Coming from Top University will be a plus consideration

**Nice-to-have experience:**

* Experience with distributed systems and event-driven architecture.
* Experience with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or Pub/Sub.
* Cloud experience (AWS, GCP, or Azure), plus Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
* Familiarity with Go, Java, .NET, or React/Next.js. Equivalent experience is welcome, since we value transferable fundamentals over a specific stack.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL data stores, advanced observability, and security architecture.
* Domain exposure to payment systems, ERP/CRM, enterprise integration, or government and third-party integrations.
* Experience with large-scale systems, architecture governance, engineering standards, or influencing multiple teams.

  
**Benefits**

title: Senior Test Automation Engineer*
description:
**Unternehmensbeschreibung**
Bei uns zählt, wer du bist. Mit all deinen Fähigkeiten, Ideen und Möglichkeiten.
  
  
In der IT der BarmeniaGothaer entwickelst du Plattformen und Lösungen, die Kund\*innen und Kolleg\*innen spürbar weiterbringen. Du verbindest Menschen und Technologien. Mit Rückhalt in einem Team aus 7.500 Kolleg\*innen und Raum, neue Wege zu gehen. Als Top-10 Versicherer in Deutschland handeln wir als Versicherungsverein auf Gegenseitigkeit (VVaG). Gemeinsam sind wir für Menschen da, die uns vertrauen.
  
  
Für uns bist du nicht irgendjemand. Du bist jemand, der zählt. Weil du wichtig bist.
  
  
**Stellenbeschreibung**

* In deinem Verantwortungsbereich bist du für den Aufbau, die Weiterentwicklung und den Betrieb unserer Testautomatisierungslandschaft zuständig.
* Darüber hinaus entwickelst und optimierst du automatisierte Tests sowie bestehende Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks – insbesondere auf Basis von Robot Framework.
* Du etablierst Standards, Best Practices und Qualitätsrichtlinien für die Testautomatisierung.
* Zudem integrierst du automatisierte Tests in CI/CD-Pipelines und entwickelst unsere Automatisierungsprozesse auf Basis von GitHub kontinuierlich weiter.
* Du berätst Entwicklungs- und Projektteams bei der Einführung und Skalierung automatisierter Testverfahren, führst Reviews durch, teilst dein Knowhow aktiv im Team und förderst den Ausbau der Testautomatisierungskompetenz.
* Nicht zuletzt evaluierst du neue Technologien, insbesondere KI-gestützte Lösungen und entwickelst unsere Testinfrastruktur und Testumgebungen weiter.

**Qualifikationen**

* Du zeichnest dich durch eine analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke sowie sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse aus.
* Mit deiner Expertise im Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung von Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks, idealerweise mit Robot Framework, kannst du überzeugen.
* Ergänzend hast du Erfahrung mit Git-basierter Versionsverwaltung sowie CI/CD-Prozessen, vorzugsweise im GitHub-Umfeld.
* Du besitzt gute Kenntnisse in Python, TypeScript, PowerShell, SQL oder vergleichbaren Technologien und konntest bereits Erfahrung im Testen von APIs und Schnittstellen (REST, GraphQL) sammeln.
* Zudem hast du eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung Foundation Level.
* Idealerweise verfügst du über Praxiserfahrung im Umgang mit Testmanagement- und Testautomatisierungswerkzeugen wie Xray, OpenText UFT, OpenText ALM oder vergleichbaren Lösungen.
* Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in der Testautomatisierung komplexer Softwarelösungen runden dein Profil ab.

**Zusätzliche Informationen**

* Menschlich miteinander: Du erlebst ein wertschätzendes, offenes, vielfältiges Miteinander - echt, kompetent und mit dem Blick füreinander und für unsere Kund\*innen.
* Flexibel & familienfreundlich: 60 bis 80 % mobiles Arbeiten (abhängig vom Team), flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, 30 Urlaubstage, die Option auf bis zu sechs Monate Sabbatical und individuelle Unterstützung für Familien, weil Leben und Arbeit zusammengehören.
* Gesund & gut versorgt: Ein starkes Gesundheitsmanagement, Betriebsrestaurants und Barista-Kaffeebars, Sport- und Präventionsangebote sowie unser vertrauliches und anonymes Beratungsangebot, wenn du berufliche oder private Unterstützung brauchst.
* Passioniert lernen & wachsen: Seminare, Programme, Sprachkurse sowie E-Learnings, damit du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln und Neues ausprobieren kannst.
* Unternehmerisch vorsorgen & absichern: Teilarbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Altersvorsorge ab dem ersten Tag, arbeitgeberfinanzierte betriebliche Krankenversicherung, Gruppenunfallversicherung und Vergünstigungen, zum Beispiel Sonderkonditionen und Corporate Benefits.
* Moderne Ausstattung: Hardware, Tools und Entwicklungsumgebungen, damit du entwickeln, testen und deployen kannst.
* Nachhaltig & zukunftsorientiert: Deutschland-Ticket für rund 25 Euro im Monat, Bike-Leasing, E-Ladesäulen und Möglichkeiten, Nachhaltigkeit aktiv mitzugestalten.
extracted_skills: Python, SQL, TypeScript, GraphQL, CI/CD, Git

title: Senior Backend Engineer II - Platform
description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
  
  
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Backend Engineer II in the Platform team, you own shared backend services that every Ajaib product depends on, such as identity, notifications, configuration and API gateways, from design to production. You design for many users and many teams, keep services reliable and secure under real traffic, and mentor engineers around you.
  
  

* Design, build and run scalable, secure shared backend services and APIs used by many product teams
* Own larger services end to end, including monitoring, alerting, on-call follow-up and support for the teams that use them
* Design APIs that stay stable: clear contracts, versioning, backward compatibility and safe deprecation
* Build and improve identity and access features, such as sign-in, sessions, tokens, permissions and account security
* Make shared services resilient: rate limiting, graceful degradation, isolation between consumers and safe rollouts
* Improve observability with useful metrics, logs and traces, and set service level objectives with the teams that depend on you
* Lead design reviews and give thoughtful code reviews
* Investigate production incidents, run root cause analysis and ship lasting fixes
* Mentor mid-level engineers and share knowledge within the team
* Work with product engineering teams, Security, Infrastructure and Architecture to turn requirements into reliable solutions
* Design and scale centralized event streaming and asynchronous messaging platforms (Kafka) that power org-wide notifications and async workflows
* Build and manage high-throughput, low-latency API Gateways and WebSocket infrastructure that serve as the front door for all Ajaib clients
* Develop and maintain robust feature flagging solutions that allow product teams to safely deploy, canary test, and roll back features dynamically

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Experience: 5+ years of professional backend engineering, with a track record of owning production services used by other teams or high traffic
* Languages: Strong in Java, Go or another modern backend language
* System Design: Solid understanding of microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven design, and reliability and observability practices
* Data & Messaging: Hands-on with relational and NoSQL databases (query tuning), caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka)
* Security: Strong knowledge of authentication and authorization (OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT) and secure coding
* Infrastructure: Experience running services on cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), with containers and CI/CD
* Mindset: Ownership mindset, clear communication and a service attitude toward internal users. Experience in fintech or another regulated environment is a plus
* Experience transitioning legacy monolithic auth to centralized identity providers (IdP) or implementing Zero Trust patterns across microservices is a strong plus

**Benefits**

* Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
* Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
* Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
* Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
* Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
* Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
* Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
* Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users

title: Senior Data Analyst – Operations
description:
**Location:** Bali in office  
  
  
**About us:**  
  
TyrAds is a leading tech-driven loyalty and rewards platform that partners with businesses to create meaningful and rewarding experiences for their customers. With millions of users across our platforms, we specialize in innovative AdTech solutions powered by big data, machine learning, and deep learning technologies.
  
Our systems process over 10,000 events per second, delivering real-time insights at scale. We build seamless user experiences across web, Android, and iOS, while leveraging ML/AI to power personalization and advertising effectiveness.
  
  
We are a team of 90+ employees worldwide and growing, guided by values of transparency, ownership, learning from mistakes, and respect for diverse cultures. Our product development follows Agile methodologies with weekly releases and collaboration tools such as GitHub, Jira, and Slack.
  
  
TyrAds is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to lead analytics for our Operations, Finance and Customer Support teams. You'll also own the company-wide business metrics and data dictionary, so every team measures the business the same way.

  

Job requirements: What we're looking for  
  
5+ years in data or business analytics, supporting operations or finance teams.  
A track record of defining company-wide KPIs or building a data dictionary.  
Expert SQL and advanced Tableau.  
Strong finance fundamentals (revenue, margin, reconciliation).  
The ability to influence senior stakeholders and explain data clearly to non-technical audiences.  
Nice to have  
  
Databricks, dbt, ClickHouse or Airflow.  
Data catalogue or governance tools (e.g. OpenMetadata).  
Python.  
* An AdTech, gaming or rewards background.

  

Job responsibilities: What you'll do  
  
Act as the senior analytics partner to the Operations, Finance and Customer Support leads, and turn their questions into analyses and recommendations.  
Support Finance with revenue reporting, partner reconciliation and month-end close.  
Build and own Tableau dashboards for key operational and financial KPIs.  
Define and govern company-wide business metrics, and get agreement on definitions across teams.  
Build and maintain the company's data dictionary.  
Work with data engineering to build certified metrics into the data platform.  
* Monitor data quality on critical datasets and mentor junior analysts.

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose**

We are looking for a Data Analyst with strong analytical and applied machine learning capabilities who can turn data into actionable insights and simple predictive solutions that drive business decisions. This role is not just about reporting, it is about understanding business problems, analyzing data end-to-end, and building practical models that improve decision making speed and accuracy.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Data Analysis & Insights**

* Perform end-to-end data analysis to answer business questions.
* Identify trends, patterns, and key drivers behind business performance.
* Translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders.
* Conduct root cause analysis to support better decision-making.

**Reporting & Dashboarding**

* Build and maintain dashboards and KPI tracking using BI tools.
* Ensure consistency, accuracy, and clarity of business metrics.
* Automate recurring reporting processes where possible.
* Support leadership with reliable, timely reporting.

**Data Preparation & Exploration**

* Extract, clean, and transform data using SQL and Python.
* Work with large datasets to ensure data is analysis-ready.
* Perform exploratory data analysis to uncover opportunities and issues.

**Applied Machine Learning**

* Build basic predictive models for business use cases such as: Forecasting, Segmentation, and Classification (e.g., behavior prediction).
* Perform feature engineering and model evaluation.
* Work with the Data Lead to improve and operationalize models.
* Focus on real world application, not research or complex algorithm development.

**Collaboration & Problem Solving**

* Work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business needs.
* Translate problems into structured analytical or ML solutions.
* Present insights in a simple, clear, and decision ready format.
* Support ad-hoc analysis and deep dive investigations.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or related fields.
* 2+ years of experience in data analysis, BI, or analytics roles.
* Strong SQL skills and good Python proficiency.
* Familiar with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Looker, etc.).
* Exposure or strong interest in machine learning / predictive analytics.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Bangkok, Thailand, Khon Kaen, Thailand

Full-time

Permanent employee

  

**What We Need**
----------------

Oivan is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the platform that runs our internal technology, including the AI agents we build and operate for ourselves. You will report directly to the CTO and shape how Oivan ships, runs and secures its own systems.  
  
This is an internal technology role, not a client delivery position. You will build and run the platform behind Oivan's own products and internal systems, the pipelines, clusters, cloud infrastructure and observability that everything else depends on.  
A large part of the work is deploying and operating AI agents. Oivan builds AI into its own operations, and you will be the engineer who takes those agents from a working prototype to something that runs reliably in production, with the model endpoints, orchestration, data stores, guardrails and monitoring that requires.  
You report directly to the CTO, which means you have a real say in platform direction, technology choices and build-versus-buy decisions. We are looking for someone who is comfortable owning a problem end to end rather than waiting for a ticket.  
  
We are offering relocation to **Khon Kaen** for people interested.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Design, build and operate the CI/CD pipelines and deployment platform for Oivan's internal applications and services.
* Deploy, run and monitor AI agents and LLM-backed services in production, model endpoints, orchestration layers, vector stores, evaluation and the guardrails around them.
* Own our Kubernetes clusters end to end: provisioning, upgrades, autoscaling, networking, ingress, secrets and workload management.
* Manage cloud infrastructure, with clear cost visibility and sensible guardrails.
* Build observability that people actually use, metrics, logs, traces, alerting and dashboards.
* Automate everything repeatable with Infrastructure as Code.
* Harden the platform: identity and access, secrets management, network policy, patching and vulnerability management.
* Support the internal front-ends and the services behind them through build, release and runtime.
* Work with the CTO on platform roadmap, tooling decisions and where we build versus buy.
* Act as the escalation point for internal platform incidents, and drive the follow-up that stops them recurring.

**What You Have**
-----------------

Must have

* 5+ years in DevOps, platform engineering or SRE, operating at strong medior to senior level.
* Hands-on Kubernetes in production, GKE, EKS or on-premise. Not just deploying to a managed cluster, but owning it
* CI/CD ownership — designing and running pipelines, not only using them.
* Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent.
* Cloud platform experience at production scale.
* Linux administration and scripting — Bash and Python.
* Containers and registries — Docker, image hygiene, supply chain basics.
* Observability — Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging and alerting.
* Secrets management and identity across services and environments.
* Networking fundamentals — DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls.
* Advanced English and strong communication. You will work directly with the CTO and across teams, and you will be expected to explain technical decisions clearly to non-specialists.
* Based in Thailand, able to work from Khon Kaen. Bangkok is also a possibility for the right candidate.

Good to have

* Deploying and operating AI agents or LLM-backed services in production — this is the fastest way to make an impact here.
* Google Cloud Platform specifically — GKE, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, Cloud Build.
* Angular — enough to support front-end build and release pipelines and to work with the front-end team.
* GitOps — Argo CD, Flux or Rancher Fleet.
* Service mesh or API gateway experience.
* Building reusable Terraform modules and platform abstractions.
* Cost optimisation and FinOps practice.
* DevSecOps tooling and security certifications

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive compensation and flexible annual leave from 12 up to 22 days per annum. In addition, there are 15 days of paid annual leave and sick leaves. We support our staff to be with family at the most important time. (Partners with a newborn baby can have additional holidays)
* Healthcare package and annual check-ups
* Opportunities for growth and enrichment through Grow with Oivan, our internal learning and development departments (2.5 hours per week)
* Top of the line devices Mac or PC
* Team building activities, movie nights, events, etc.
* Company paid weekly lunch – we have team lunch on Mondays
* An international workforce to learn from and grow with
extracted_skills: LLM, Python, Angular, Docker, Containerization, Kubernetes, GCP, Terraform, IaC, CI/CD, Linux, Cybersecurity

title: Identity Management Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

**About Grab and Our Workplace**

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

 **Job Description**

**Get to Know the Team**

Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to out-serve Grabbers with positive, personalised IT experiences. We are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric and innovative values to join our growing team

The Identity Management team is responsible for managing identities and privileged access across Grab's enterprise infrastructure. The team maintains core identity and access solutions, helping to secure Grab's privileged access landscape.

**Get to Know the Role**

In this position, you'll be supporting Grab's enterprise infrastructure with an emphasis on Identity and Privileged Access Management. The Identity Management team at Grab is committed to overseeing access to Grab's enterprise applications and safeguarding access to vital systems and sensitive data. Our mission is “Empowering Grabbers with secure, seamless access to systems and data; simplifying productivity and creating time for what matters”.

Our responsibilities include ongoing monitoring, auditing, and regular reviews to uphold a robust access control environment. A mindset geared towards optimisation and automation is essential, along with the ability to work independently and foster relationships with stakeholders throughout Grab. If you believe you have what it takes, we'd love to hear from you!

**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

**Privileged Access Management & Engineering**

* Implement and operate **CyberArk solutions** including **Privilege Cloud, Secure Web Sessions (SWS), Remote Access, Conjur and Secure Cloud Access.**
* Configure safes, platforms, credential rotation, session monitoring and access workflows to enforce **least privilege and secure privileged access**.
* Onboard applications, infrastructure and cloud environments into CyberArk, ensuring alignment with PAM standards.

**Integration, Automation & Governance**

* Develop **automation - scripts or integrations** to improve onboarding, credential management and overall PAM efficiency.
* Support **audits and compliance** by providing access evidence, logs and ensuring controls are operating effectively.
* Proactively identify gaps in privileged access coverage and drive improvements across the environment.
* **Identity Operations**
  + Manage incidents and service requests related to Identity services, ensuring timely resolution and minimal disruption to operations.
  + Configure, support, and maintain the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform, ensuring stability, performance, and security.
  + Provision and deprovision privileged access in accordance with the principles of least privilege, segregation of identities, and separation of duties.
  + Drive periodic access reviews for privileged accounts within CyberArk, ensuring ongoing compliance and appropriate access levels.
  + Develop custom plugins and integrations within CyberArk to extend functionality and enable interoperability with other enterprise systems and platforms.
  + Support audits and forensic investigations by supplying compliance evidence, access logs, and other relevant data.
  + Manage and monitor ticket queues, develop and track KPIs/KRIs to provide insights, and identify opportunities for operational improvements.
  + Develop and maintain documentation, including best practices, technical guides, and standard operating procedures.

  
**Qualifications**

**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* **4–6 years of strong hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM/PAM)**, with a primary focus on Privileged Access Management.
* **Proven, deep hands-on experience with CyberArk (not just familiarity or exposure)**, including:
  + Privilege Cloud
  + Secure Web Sessions (SWS)
  + Remote Access
  + Conjur (Secrets Management)
  + Experience configuring safes, platforms, policies, credential rotation and session monitoring
  + Use of CyberArk APIs for plugins, automations and integrations.
* Demonstrated experience **implementing, onboarding and operating CyberArk across applications, infrastructure and cloud environments**.
* Hands-on experience with a leading Identity platform such as **JumpCloud (preferred), Okta, Azure AD or similar**.
* Strong understanding of **PAM principles** (least privilege, just-in-time access, credential vaulting, session monitoring, segregation of duties).
* Solid foundation in **IAM concepts** including identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorisation, SSO and access governance.
* Experience working with **security, risk and compliance teams**, including supporting audits and interactions with auditors.
* Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to **automate and troubleshoot using scripting** (Python, Bash, PowerShell or similar).
* Experience contributing to **IAM/PAM implementations or transformation initiatives**, from design through execution.
* Strong ownership mindset — **proactive, self-driven, and willing to take responsibility end-to-end**.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working with **globally distributed, cross-functional teams**, and the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

  
**Additional Information**

**Life at Grab**

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

* We have your back with **Term Life Insurance** and comprehensive **Medical Insurance.**
* With **GrabFlex,** create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through **Parental** and **Birthday leave**, and give back to your communities through **Love-all-Serve-all (LASA)** volunteering leave
* We have a confidential **Grabber Assistance Programme** to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

The Identity Management team at Grab is committed to overseeing access to Grab's enterprise applications and safeguarding access to vital systems and sensitive data. Our mission is “Empowering Grabbers with secure, seamless access to systems and data; simplifying productivity and creating time for what matters”.

Our responsibilities include ongoing monitoring, auditing, and regular reviews to uphold a robust access control environment. A mindset geared towards optimisation and automation is essential, along with the ability to work independently and foster relationships with stakeholders throughout Grab. If you believe you have what it takes, we'd love to hear from you!

**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

**Privileged Access Management & Engineering**

* Implement and operate **CyberArk solutions** including **Privilege Cloud, Secure Web Sessions (SWS), Remote Access, Conjur and Secure Cloud Access.**
* Configure safes, platforms, credential rotation, session monitoring and access workflows to enforce **least privilege and secure privileged access**.
* Onboard applications, infrastructure and cloud environments into CyberArk, ensuring alignment with PAM standards.

**Integration, Automation & Governance**

* Develop **automation - scripts or integrations** to improve onboarding, credential management and overall PAM efficiency.
* Support **audits and compliance** by providing access evidence, logs and ensuring controls are operating effectively.
* Proactively identify gaps in privileged access coverage and drive improvements across the environment.

  + Configure, support, and maintain the CyberArk Privileged Access Management (PAM) platform, ensuring stability, performance, and security.
  + Provision and deprovision privileged access in accordance with the principles of least privilege, segregation of identities, and separation of duties.
  + Drive periodic access reviews for privileged accounts within CyberArk, ensuring ongoing compliance and appropriate access levels.
  + Develop custom plugins and integrations within CyberArk to extend functionality and enable interoperability with other enterprise systems and platforms.
  + Support audits and forensic investigations by supplying compliance evidence, access logs, and other relevant data.
  + Manage and monitor ticket queues, develop and track KPIs/KRIs to provide insights, and identify opportunities for operational improvements.
  + Develop and maintain documentation, including best practices, technical guides, and standard operating procedures.

* **4–6 years of strong hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management (IAM/PAM)**, with a primary focus on Privileged Access Management.
* **Proven, deep hands-on experience with CyberArk (not just familiarity or exposure)**, including:
  + Privilege Cloud
  + Secure Web Sessions (SWS)
  + Remote Access
  + Conjur (Secrets Management)
  + Experience configuring safes, platforms, policies, credential rotation and session monitoring
  + Use of CyberArk APIs for plugins, automations and integrations.

* Experience contributing to **IAM/PAM implementations or transformation initiatives**, from design through execution.
* Strong ownership mindset — **proactive, self-driven, and willing to take responsibility end-to-end**.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working with **globally distributed, cross-functional teams**, and the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About The Role**

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team architects, builds, and maintains the rock-solid infrastructure that applications rely on. At the Senior Level, you own reliability, performance, and cost outcomes for the systems under your area end-to-end, not just executing well-defined tasks, but deciding between tradeoffs, scoping ambiguous problems, and driving process and system improvements that span teams. You'll work closely with development, security, and product teams, and mentor other engineers as a technical point of reference for the team.

**What You Will Do**

* Own the availability, performance, scalability, and security of production systems end-to-end, across cloud (AWS/GCP) and on-premises environments.
* Design and evolve Kubernetes deployment strategy for production workloads.
* Own CI/CD and GitOps pipelines in production (ArgoCD or equivalent) and the Terraform that provisions the infrastructure behind them.
* Diagnose and resolve database performance issues.
* Build and maintain observability that surfaces problems before they become incidents.
* Seek out and implement process and system improvements affecting performance and security, coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
* Scope and lead medium-to-large infrastructure initiatives: gather requirements, prioritize by business impact, and communicate impact to stakeholders.
* Negotiate technical tradeoffs with stakeholders to meet business SLAs.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to peers and junior engineers; promote best practices and standards across the team.
* Maintain documentation and process discipline for the systems and incidents you own.
* Lead structured incident investigation, isolating server, database, and application layers with a metrics-first approach, including on-call during high-traffic events.

**What Are We Looking For**

* At least 5 years of experience in either SRE, DevOps, MLOps, or platform engineering, including senior-level scope at a high-traffic company.
* Deep expertise in one major cloud provider (preferably AWS), with a proven ability to ramp up on the other quickly.Production experience & expertise with Kubernetes & Linux fundamentals
* CI/CD & GitOps (ArgoCD or other equivalent stacks)
* Database performance analysis & monitoring (MySQL, Postgres)
* Observability tooling & standards (Datadog, OpenTelemetry)
* Infrastructure as Code (Terraform)
* Strong working English, verbal & written communication. Strong documentation and process discipline.
* On-call & incident handling experience during high-traffic events.
* Comfortable negotiating with stakeholders to propose technical compromises that meet business SLAs.
* Demonstrated growth mindset and proven ability to own ambiguous scope.

title: Marketing Manager| 100% Remote EU
description:
**Please be informed that Foxelli Group hires exclusively in-house and doesn't work with any external recruitment agencies. Any company or individual claiming to recruit on behalf of Foxelli Group is not affiliated with us.**

At Foxelli, we’re building more than e-commerce brands - we’re building a tribe of thoughtful humans: AI enthusiasts, curious builders, and ambitious minds who care about doing meaningful work together. Ten years in, our D2C brands reach millions and generate over $20M annually. Our focus stays simple: create products customers love and a team that actually enjoys building them.

If you love to learn, experiment, think boldly, make decisions, and build things that matter -you’ll feel at home with us.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We’re on the hunt for a Marketing Manager who can think big, move fast, and actually make things happen. This is not a “just run ads and wait” role.
  
  
You will coordinate all the marketing initiatives, create new marketing angles, offers, and landing pages, manage the creative department, and brief Facebook ads.  
  
This is a full-stack marketing playground where you own projects from the first spark of an idea to seeing real sales roll in.

You’ll be the glue between marketing, design, and development - turning customer insights into landing pages, funnels, and campaigns that people *actually want to click, read, and buy from*.

If you love:

* mixing strategy with execution
* testing ideas
* improving funnels
* and making pretty things convert

…and you’ve played with AI tools to move faster, build smarter, or test better ideas, you might be our person

**WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING**
------------------------

### **Strategy & Growth Stuff**

* Build and run marketing strategies that support real business goals (not just vibes).
* Dig into customer research and market trends to find new growth opportunities.
* Analyze what’s working (and what’s not) and turn data into smart next steps.
* Come up with fresh ideas to scale our funnels and campaigns.
* Manage marketing projects from idea launch improvement.

### **Creative & Content Magic**

* Write copy for ads, landing pages, and funnels that sounds human and sells.
* Review design work and give feedback so it looks on-brand *and* converts.
* Guide the creation and optimization of ad creatives with our design team.

### **Landing Pages & Website Optimization**

* QA landing pages like a detective: checking UX, flow, and functionality.
* Run A/B tests to improve conversion rates.
* Work closely with developers to roll out website updates and improvements.

### **Team Glue (Cross-Functional Hero)**

* Be the bridge between marketing, design, and development.
* Create clear briefs so everyone knows what to build and why.
* Track project progress and keep stakeholders in the loop.

### **Customer Research & Insights**

* Collect and analyze customer feedback and data.
* Identify pain points and opportunities for improvement.
* Use insights to scale sales and improve acquisition.

### **AI Tools & Smarter Execution**

* Bring AI into our workflow as a competitive edge. Use GPT, image/video generators, and automation platforms to compress timelines, run more experiments, and beat our own ideas.

**WHAT YOU BRING**
------------------

You’re probably someone who:

* Has experience as a Marketing Manager or full-stack marketer in e-commerce.
* Have hands-on experience building with AI tools - vibe coding, workflow automations, etc.
* Understands digital marketing and performance marketing deeply.
* Can write clear, persuasive, not-boring copy.
* Knows CRO and website optimization.
* Loves looking at data and asking: “What actually sells?”
* Is organized and good at managing projects.
* Has worked with designers and developers before.
* Can manage your own time and work remotely.
* Cares about customers and research.
* Gets excited about e-commerce growth.

**BONUS POINTS IF YOU:**
------------------------

* Have used marketing automation tools.
* Know your way around heatmaps, ad managers, and analytics tools.
* Enjoy experimenting, testing, and improving things nonstop.

**WHY FOXELLI?**
----------------

We’re not into boring corporate marketing.  
We like:

* smart ideas
* quirky personality
* strong execution
* and people who take ownership

You’ll have space to think, test, build, and grow with us - and actually see the impact of your work.

**THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS**
---------------------------

Apply - A simple form that helps us know who’s stepping into our world.  
Ribbon AI Interview - Ribbon is a short, guided video step that helps us understand your thinking style in a calm, private space.  
Interview -A conversation with your manager to feel the work chemistry, get to know each other, and explore what we could build together.

**FIXED SERVICE FEE**

**€2,000 - €2,800** after taxes, depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience.

Please note that this role is based on a contract/freelance agreement.

**PERKS & BENEFITS**

* Full flexibility with your schedule in a fully remote setting, while Hubstaff ensures transparency and fairness.
* Complimentary gym memberships and company-sponsored outdoor adventures for your strength and to keep your physical well-being in check.
* A personal development budget is at your disposal for your personal and professional growth to ensure you keep growing continuously.
* Generous paid time off, including parental leave and vacation days, to recharge and rejuvenate and ensure you’re well-rested.
* A budget for your home office setup so you’re comfortable working how you like and where you like.
* Strong company culture and a network of unique individuals that celebrate you.

**ELIGIBILITY & LOCATION REQUIREMENTS**

This role is 100% remote.

* Our tribe works primarily in the Eastern European Time Zone (EET — UTC+2/UTC+3). We also use Revolut for payments, so we are open to hiring candidates in countries where Revolut payments are supported.
* For full-time roles, we ask that you’re available for at least 5 hours during typical EET working hours — it keeps collaboration smooth and communication easy.  
  (This doesn’t apply to part-time roles.)

Currently, **we are hiring in** Albania, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Croatia, Czech Republic, Estonia, Greece, Georgia, Kosovo, Latvia, Lithuania, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Malta, Slovenia, Serbia, Cyprus, Bulgaria, Hungary, Netherlands, the United Kingdom, and South Africa.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's Degree in Informatics Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 1-5 years' experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) or Cyber Security, particularly in security incident investigation and response.
* Understanding of Cybersecurity concepts, Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, and security incident management.
* Familiarity with TCP/IP, Windows, Linux, databases, and cloud computing environments.
* Hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, NDR, Firewall, WAF, Threat Intelligence, Vulnerability Management, and Cloud Security tools.
* Knowledge of security monitoring, alert analysis, incident investigation, threat hunting, digital forensics, and incident response.
* Familiarity with the MITRE ATT&CK framework and SIEM detection engineering is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively under pressure and handle security incidents effectively.
* Willing to work on a shift basis when required.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Perform continuous security monitoring of IT infrastructure, networks, and applications.
* Monitor and analyze security alerts and events from SIEM, EDR/XDR, NDR, Firewall, and other security platforms.
* Conduct initial alert triage, incident classification, investigation, and escalation based on incident severity.
* Investigate cyberattacks, malware, phishing, unauthorized access, ransomware, and other security threats.
* Correlate and analyze logs across servers, endpoints, networks, databases, cloud environments, and identity systems.
* Perform proactive and advanced threat hunting using the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Execute incident response activities, including incident escalation and coordination of containment and eradication.
* Conduct digital forensics and investigate advanced threats, including Advanced Persistent Threats (APT).
* Develop and maintain SIEM detection rules, correlation rules, detection use cases, and incident response playbooks.
* Prepare incident reports, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and provide remediation and security improvement recommendations.
* Evaluate the effectiveness of existing security controls and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with Infrastructure, Network, Application, Cloud, and Cybersecurity teams to resolve security incidents and strengthen the organization's security posture.

**Security Tools:**

Experience with the following tools and technologies is highly desirable:

* **SIEM:**
  CrowdStrike SIEM
* **EDR:**
  Kaspersky, SentinelOne, and CrowdStrike Falcon
* **NDR:**
  Vectra AI
* **Firewall:**
  FortiGate and Cloudflare
* **WAF:**
  FortiWeb and Cloudflare
* **Threat Intelligence:**
  Recorded Future
* **Vulnerability Management:**
  Tenable
* **Cloud Security:**
  AWS CloudTrail and Google Cloud Armor

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Job Description

  

Technical Project Manager

  
  

Role Overview

  
  

We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to lead complex, large-scale cloud migration, cloud deployment, application development and modernization programs in regulated-industry environments.

  
  

The role combines disciplined project and program management with strong technical understanding of cloud platforms, software delivery, DevSecOps, security, governance and operational readiness.

  
  

The successful candidate will manage initiatives from discovery and planning through solution design, application development, migration, testing, production deployment, cutover, stabilization and operational handover. The role coordinates multidisciplinary teams and ensures that solutions are delivered securely, compliantly and in alignment with business outcomes.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Project and Program Delivery

* Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale cloud migration, application development, cloud deployment and modernization programs.

* Develop and maintain integrated plans covering scope, schedule, budget, resources, milestones, deliverables, assumptions, dependencies, risks and issues.

* Manage multiple workstreams across applications, infrastructure, architecture, data, integration, security, networking, testing, operations and change management.

* Establish governance forums, reporting cadence, decision processes, quality gates and escalation paths.

* Coordinate release planning, cutover, rollback, hypercare, knowledge transfer and transition to support.
  

  

**2. Application Development Management**

* Manage the complete application delivery lifecycle from requirements, estimation and solution design through build, integration, testing, release and production support.
* Coordinate product owners, business analysts, architects, developers, testers, UX teams, security specialists and operations teams.
* Manage application backlogs, sprint or release plans, acceptance criteria, technical dependencies and delivery commitments.
* Oversee system integration, API development, data migration, environment readiness and non-functional requirements.
* Ensure appropriate software engineering practices, code quality controls, peer reviews, test automation, defect management and release governance are applied.
* Support delivery using Agile, Scrum, Waterfall or hybrid methodologies, selecting controls appropriate to project and regulatory requirements.
  

  

**3. Cloud Migration and Modernization**

* Manage assessment, planning, readiness, migration, validation and optimization of enterprise workloads.
* Coordinate migration strategies including rehost, replatform, refactor, rebuild, replace and retire.
* Lead migration-wave planning, workload sequencing, dependency mapping, production cutover and business validation.
* Coordinate modernization involving cloud-native services, containers, microservices, managed databases, APIs and serverless platforms.
* Ensure migration designs address availability, disaster recovery, performance, security, compliance and business continuity.
  

  

**4. DevSecOps and Deployment Management**

* Lead adoption and governance of DevSecOps practices across application and cloud delivery.
* Coordinate CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, vulnerability scanning and policy validation.
* Ensure security controls are integrated across planning, coding, build, testing, release, deployment and operations.
* Manage environment promotion, deployment approvals, segregation of duties, secrets management, artifact controls and rollback procedures.
* Work with engineering and security teams to track vulnerabilities, remediation actions and approved exceptions.
  

  

**5. Regulated-Industry Delivery and Compliance**

description:
Location Tanah Abang DKI Jakarta R, Indonesia Category Brand Management/Marketing Job Id R000161875 Job Type Full time Experienced Professionals

  

**Job Location**

JAKARTA GENERAL OFFICE

**Job Description**

**Role Overview**

Do you enjoy solving tough business questions using consumer insights, data and analytical thinking? Do you have a passion for building tools for a sharper and more efficient digital full-funnel marketing, and the curiosity to understand how technology and innovation can transform the way brands grow? Are you a strategic thinker who combines strong business acumen with a passion for operational excellence and rigor? If this sounds like you, P&G Indonesia would love to have you join our team as a Digital Product Analytics Manager!

We are looking for a Digital Product Analytics Manager who can translate complex platform and consumer data into clear choices and build practical data products that help P&G Indonesia win. We are seeking a business-minded digital product leader who understands how to leverage digital platforms across the full funnel — including TikTok/TikTok Shop, Meta (incl. CPAS), Shopee, YouTube and Performance Marketing. Success comes from finding the shared logic across platform data, algorithms, experimentation, content, assortment, placement and measurement, then turning that logic into scalable solutions and sharper business decisions. The role reflects the strong linkage between platform algorithms, awareness-building media and full-funnel business outcomes.

**Candidate Profile**

The strongest candidate is likely to come from a DCommerce or media role in a fast-growing tech company; an analytics or planning role in a DCommerce/media agency; or a marketing, analytics or product role within a platform. **The target profile is a builder and problem solver, not primarily an account-management, client-relationship profile, or traditional profile of media operator.**

**What Success Looks Like**

As a Digital Product Analytics Manager, you will own how P&G Indonesia decodes and wins on priority digital platforms — going beyond a traditional media operations role to build the analytics products, playbooks and capabilities that sharpen full-funnel decisions. You will be at the heart of our digital ecosystem, building the right analytics tools and connecting business priorities, consumer understanding, media, data, technology and execution to deliver superior business results.  
  
In this role, you will be accountable for maximizing business growth by decoding the algorithms and growth mechanics of priority platforms such as TikTok/TikTok Shop, Shopee, Meta and other relevant ecosystems. You will define what P&G needs to win across content, assortment, placements, activation, measurement and platform execution; build repeatable playbooks, experiments, products, decision frameworks and analytics capabilities that improve the speed, reliability and quality of decision making across the full funnel; and create trusted, usable data products for DCommerce, Category/Brand and Operations teams that translate daily platform signals into action. This includes strengthening mental availability through metrics such as TOMA and UBA, ultimately contributing to penetration growth in both online/offline business, while driving excellence in media effectiveness and efficiency.

**What we offer you:**

* Meaningful Work from Day 1: Work on iconic brands that touch billions of lives, making a tangible impact on our business and consumers.
* Continuous Learning & Development: Access to world-class training programs, mentorship, and opportunities to grow your career within a global organization.
* Global Career Opportunities: Potential for career progression and exposure across various brands, functions, and geographies.
* Dynamic and Respectful Work Environment: Be part of a diverse, inclusive, and high-performing team where collaboration and innovation are celebrated. We live our Purpose, Values, and Principles daily and we value every individual and encourage initiatives promoting agility and work/life balance.

**Your team**

You will report to the Brand Operation Director and serve as the Digital Product and Analytics subject matter expert for P&G Indonesia.

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams across DCommerce/Ecommerce, Category, Brand Marketing, IT/Engineering, regional media partners, platform partners and full-funnel media agencies to shape and execute winning digital strategies.

You will play a critical role in connecting business ambition, consumer understanding, Digital Media strategy and operational excellence to enable P&G Indonesia’s brand growth.

**Responsibilities of the Role (**We need someone who can:)

1. **Decode full-funnel platform algorithms:**

* Investigate how priority platform algorithms respond to content, assortment, campaign structure, placements, audience signals, bidding and conversion inputs.
* Translate platform mechanics into testable hypotheses and practical recommendations that improve business outcomes across awareness, consideration and conversion.
* Establish platform-specific playbooks that clearly define the inputs, thresholds, operating signals and interventions required to win.

2. **Own the product vision and roadmap:**

* Translate internal user and business needs into valuable, feasible and usable user stories, personas, user journeys and workflows.
* Set priorities for internal digital products, define the product roadmap and guide partners on what should be built and why.
* Own and prioritize the product backlog with business, engineering, analytics and platform partners.
* Ensure solutions are adopted, sustained and improved based on user feedback and business impact.

3. **Build trusted data products and architecture:**

* Design and guide trusted data-product architecture across relevant platform, commerce and media data sources.
* Oversee data collection, integration, quality, governance and reliability so reporting and optimization decisions are based on accurate information.
* Use data engineering methods and APIs to automate repeatable analysis, reduce manual work and create scalable decision support.
* Diagnose data or workload issues, define validation controls and ensure solutions are efficient, maintainable and fit for business use.

4. **Run experiments and translate analytics into business choices:**

* Make data-driven decisions in complex, multivariable environments and convert technical findings into clear business choices.
* Develop and run governed experiments, including A/B tests, to validate or disprove concepts and quantify impact.
* Extract daily insights from digital commerce metrics, including TikTok Seller Center and related platform data, and recommend specific actions to improve funnel productivity and GMV.
* Partner with DCommerce, Category, Brand and other stakeholders to co-create solutions rooted in end-to-end business and Sales Fundamentals.

5. **Strengthen attention-led media analytics:**

* Analyze media performance data to identify trends, opportunities and execution challenges across attentive reach, quality of placement, frequency and content.
* Connect media analytics with brand outcomes such as TOMA, UBA and penetration.
* Support execution of the agreed media strategy by incorporating consumer, platform and performance insights into measurement and optimization.
* Contribute to the next generation of Attention-Led Media measurement, experimentation and capability building across the organization.

**Ways of Working and Collaboration**

* Operate with a business ownership mindset, understanding how DCommerce works end to end and how technology, media and Sales Fundamentals connect.
* Influence across Brand, DCommerce, Category, Product, Engineering, Analytics, agency and platform teams without relying on formal authority.
* Communicate complex technical findings in simple, decision-ready language for stakeholders without deep technical backgrounds.
* Share knowledge, build capability and establish sustainable practices across teams.

**Job Qualifications**

**Role Requirements**

  

Must Have

* 3–5 years of demonstrated experience in digital product management, data engineering, advanced analytics, digital commerce or a closely related field.
* Hands-on proficiency in SQL and Python, data integration or API implementation, and modern data platforms such as Databricks. This is a non-negotiable, a technical interview will be conducted. Please do not apply if you don’t have this skill.
* Experience translating customer or user needs into product requirements, roadmaps, backlogs and measurable outcomes.
* Strong understanding of experimentation, data quality, validation and business performance analysis in complex environments.
* Working knowledge of digital commerce and full-funnel platform mechanics, ideally across TikTok/TikTok Shop, Shopee, Meta or comparable ecosystems.
* Strong business acumen, stakeholder influence, communication and project management skills; experience with Scrum or Agile ways of working.
* Bachelor’s degree or above in a relevant discipline, or equivalent applied experience.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

* Experience in ecommerce, consumer technology, platform analytics, media analytics or an analytics/planning role within an agency.
* Exposure to UI/UX design thinking and visualization tools such as Power BI.
* Experience bridging product, engineering, commercial and media stakeholders.
* Evidence of applied IT depth across more than one job profile or diverse technical experiences.

**About Us**

We produce globally recognized brands and we grow the best business leaders in the industry. With a portfolio of trusted brands as diverse as ours, it is paramount our leaders are able to lead with courage the vast array of brands, categories and functions. We serve consumers around the world with one of the strongest portfolios of trusted, quality, leadership brands, including Always®, Ariel®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Herbal Essences®, Oral-B®, Pampers®, Pantene®, Tampax® and more. Our community includes operations in approximately 70 countries worldwide.

Visit http://www.pg.com to know more.

Our consumers are diverse and our talents - internally - mirror this diversity to best serve it. That is why we’re committed to building a winning culture based on Inclusion and our ideal candidate is passionate about the same principle: you will join our daily effort of being “in touch” so we craft brands and products to improve the lives of the world’s consumers now and in the future. We want you to inspire us with your unrivaled ideas.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, color, gender, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, citizenship, disability, veteran status, HIV/AIDS status, or any other legally protected factor.

**Job Schedule**

Full time

**Job Number**

R000161875

**Job Segmentation**

Experienced Professionals

* Mencatat dan memperbarui laporan harian produksi (*Daily Production Report*), termasuk jumlah *output*, penggunaan bahan baku, jam kerja line produksi, dan data *downtime* mesin.

* Membuat dan mendistribusikan *Work Order* (WO), *Surat Perintah Kerja* (SPK), serta dokumen pengeluaran/penerimaan barang dari gudang ke area produksi.

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
At Xtremax, we believe great developers aren’t just coders — they’re thinkers, problem-solvers, and collaborators. If you have **strong technical fundamentals**, a curious mind, and the drive to grow fast, this program is designed to accelerate your journey. You’ll work alongside experienced mentors, contribute to real projects, and develop the skills to become a future tech leader.

We are looking for a Software Engineer who is not only strong in web development, but has proven experience solving real-world problems using Generative AI.

You are someone who:

* Has built or shipped solutions where GenAI was a core part of the system, not just a demo
* Uses AI to automate manual processes and save significant time
* Actively experiments with new tools, frameworks and models
* Enjoys end-to-end ownership — from design to deployment

You’ll be part of a cross-functional team that values quality, automation, experimentation and user experience.

### **Responsibilities**

Core Engineering Responsibilities

* Design and develop modern web frontend and backend (primary) applications
* Develop backend APIs and databases supporting applications
* Write automated unit and functional tests
* Design and develop applications leveraging cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Assist in build and release automation with DevOps practices
* Participate in pair programming and code reviews
* Work closely with Business Analysts, Quality Engineers and UX Designers to deliver user-centric features

GenAI & Innovation Responsibilities

* Design and implement features leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and other Generative AI technologies
* Build AI-powered automation tools to reduce manual operational effort
* Integrate LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, etc.) into production systems
* Implement prompt engineering, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), or agent-based workflows where applicable
* Evaluate new GenAI tools/frameworks and assess production-readiness
* Prototype rapidly and translate experiments into production-ready systems

Collaboration & Delivery

* Work closely with Product/Project Managers, Architects, Business Analysts, Quality Engineers, UX Designers, and fellow engineers.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies and iterative delivery
* Communicate clearly with onshore stakeholders despite offshore setup
* Produce technical documentation and support knowledge transfer where required

  
**Requirements**

Core Engineering

* Experience with frontend frameworks such as React.js / Next.js
* Experience with server-side development using Node.js
* Experience with relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data models
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Familiar with JavaScript testing frameworks such as Jest or Mocha
* Familiar with Agile and Continuous Integration/Delivery practices
* Experience using Git for version control

GenAI Experience

* Demonstrated experience building systems that:

* + Use LLMs or other GenAI models as part of the core solution
  + Automate workflows or significantly reduce manual effort
* Experience with:

* + Prompt engineering
  + Vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch, etc.) or semantic search
  + RAG architectures or AI agent workflows
  + Evaluating model output quality and reliability
* Ability to explain trade-offs in model selection, latency, cost, and safety considerations

Preferred

* Minimum 4 years of software development experience
* Strong fundamentals in JavaScript & TypeScript
* Familiarity with building reusable web components
* Familiarity with how search engine components work (crawl, index, search)
* Familiar with TDD / BDD practices
* Experience with Docker and containerization
* Experience designing AI systems with observability, evaluation, and guardrails
* Collaborative team player with strong communication and presentation skills
* Passion for exploring emerging technologies and sharing knowledge with the team

Nice-to-Have

* Experience with government, regulated, or enterprise systems
* Exposure to microservices or distributed systems
* Experience working in offshore or distributed teams
* Prior work involving audit, documentation, or structured governance

### **Why Join Us**

* **Meaningful impact** — contribute to digital projects that serve government and enterprise clients.
* **Culture of learning** — we value curiosity, open communication, and taking ownership.

  
**Benefits**

By submitting your resume/CV, you consent and agree to allow the information provided to be used and processed by or on behalf of Xtremax Pte Ltd for purposes related to your registration of interest in current or future employment with us and for the processing of your application for employment.

You also represent to us that you have obtained the consent of your referees when you disclose to us their personal data for the purpose of conducting reference checks.

The personal data held by us relating to your application will be kept strictly confidential and in accordance with the PDPA. You may also refer to our Privacy Policy for more details here:

We regret to inform you that should you not consent to providing the necessary data required for us to process your application, your application will be considered void.

title: Full Stack
description:
**About Nex Entertainment**

Nex Entertainment is a TikTok-native agency operating across the US, Indonesia, and Thailand. We partner with leading brands and creators to accelerate growth across TikTok Shop, TikTok GO, and TikTok Live. We engineer our own proprietary tech stack for creator sourcing, community programs, CRM, recruitment, and AI-driven content engines.

As part of a high-impact, agile engineering team, you will take full ownership of real products from day one.

**What You Will Do**

* **End-to-End Development:**
  Architect, build, and deploy full-stack web applications from concept to production (React, Vite, TypeScript, and Firebase).
* **Backend & Cloud Architecture:**
  Develop Cloud Functions (Node.js/TypeScript) for internal APIs, automated scheduled workloads, and Firestore reactive triggers.
* **Database & Security:**
  Design scalable Firestore data models, maintain clean indexing, and write strict security rules to ensure speed and data integrity.
* **System Integrations:**
  Connect third-party services and APIs, including TikTok Data APIs, Lark/Feishu, Mailgun, and Google Workspace.
* **Internal Tooling:**
  Deliver mission-critical dashboards and workflows utilized daily by our operations, recruitment, and sales teams.
* **AI-Augmented Engineering:**
  Leverage modern AI tools (Claude) to accelerate development velocity and embed AI features into our product suite.
* **Project Ownership & Monitoring:**
  Autonomously lead multi-stream technical initiatives, maintain deployment pipelines on GCP/Firebase, and monitor production health.

**Requirements**

**Must-Have:**

* 3+ years of professional full-stack development experience with shipped production web apps.
* Strong proficiency in modern JavaScript and TypeScript.
* Solid hands-on experience with React, Vite, and Tailwind CSS.
* Practical mastery of Google Cloud Platform / Firebase (Firestore data modeling, Cloud Functions, Hosting, Cloud Run, and IAM fundamentals).
* Active daily workflow with AI coding assistants (particularly Claude), with strong prompt engineering and critical code-verification skills.
* Professional working proficiency in English (written and spoken) for daily team syncs, documentation, and chat.
* Self-starter mindset: proactive problem solver, comfortable with fast-paced pivots, and capable of managing multiple priorities independently.

**Nice-to-Have:**

* Experience with Next.js, Node.js (Express), or React Router.
* End-to-end automation or scraping experience (Playwright, Puppeteer).
* Automated testing suites (Vitest, Jest).
* Hands-on integrations with Lark/Feishu API or Mailgun.
* Experience with 3D/animation libraries (Three.js, GSAP).
* Domain knowledge in TikTok Shop, creator economy platforms, or social commerce.
* Architecture experience for multi-region platforms (handling multiple locales, currencies, and time zones) or Android/WebView wrappers.

**What We Offer**

* **Direct Impact:**
  Build end-to-end products and systems, not isolated support tickets.
* **Modern Tooling:**
  Full access to top-tier AI dev tools and infrastructure.
* **Flat & Agile Culture:**
  Fast decision cycles without bureaucratic red tape.
* **Competitive Compensation:**
  Rp 10.000.000 - Rp 15.000.000

**How to Apply**

Submit your application by sharing:

1. Your updated CV / LinkedIn profile.
2. Links to 2–3 live products, demos, or public repositories you built (GitHub, live site, or case study).
3. A short note (2–3 sentences) highlighting how you integrate AI coding tools into your development workflow.

**How to Apply**

Click the
**Easy Apply**
button on this post, or send an email directly to
**recruitment@nexentertainment.live**
with the subject line:

Full-Stack Developer – [Your Full Name]
