title: Back End Developer
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend applications and microservices using Go (Golang).
* Build, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs, including HTTP routing, middleware, request validation, and error handling.
* Develop and manage database integrations using PostgreSQL, including SQL queries, transactions, data consistency, and query optimization.
* Implement caching mechanisms and data management strategies using Redis.
* Develop concurrent applications using Goroutines, Channels, Context, and other Go concurrency patterns.
* Implement authentication, authorization, and application security best practices to protect backend services and sensitive data.
* Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and efficient code following software engineering best practices.
* Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging, and code reviews to ensure software quality and reliability.
* Monitor application performance, troubleshoot production issues, and optimize memory and CPU utilization.
* Implement logging, monitoring, and observability practices to ensure system stability and availability.
* Manage background jobs, queue processing, third-party API integrations, and external service connectivity.
* Participate in system architecture discussions, technical documentation, deployment processes, and CI/CD implementation.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including frontend developers, QA engineers, DevOps engineers, and technical stakeholders.

Technical Requirements

* Strong proficiency in Go (Golang), including syntax, data types, structs, interfaces, methods, pointers, and memory management.
* Hands-on experience in backend development and REST API implementation.
* Good understanding of HTTP protocols, middleware, routing, and API integration.
* Experience working with PostgreSQL, including database integration, SQL queries, transactions, and query optimization.
* Familiarity with Redis and caching strategies.
* Strong understanding of concurrency concepts, including Goroutines, Channels, race conditions, and deadlock prevention.
* Knowledge of error handling, panic recovery, context management, and timeout handling.
* Experience implementing unit testing, integration testing, and debugging practices.
* Understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, and secure configuration management.
* Familiarity with Git, dependency management, code review, and clean code principles.
* Understanding of logging, observability, application performance optimization, and production troubleshooting.
* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, deployment processes, background jobs, and queue processing.
* Good problem-solving, analytical thinking, and communication skills.

Additional Qualifications

* Experience designing and developing scalable backend architectures and distributed services.
* Experience handling production incidents, performance bottlenecks, and reliability challenges.
* Understanding of fault tolerance, system resilience, and high-availability application design.
* Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineering teams, and continuously improve technical solutions.

What We Are Looking For:

We welcome candidates across
**Junior, Middle, and Senior levels**
, with responsibilities and technical expectations aligned with their experience and proficiency.

* **Junior:**
  Able to develop reliable CRUD APIs, perform standard SQL queries, implement validations, and write basic automated tests with guidance.
* **Middle:**
  Able to independently manage backend modules, develop system integrations, handle concurrency, and troubleshoot production issues.
* **Senior:**
  Able to lead backend architecture and reliability decisions, resolve complex production incidents, establish engineering standards, and mentor other developers.

* Actively listen, ask questions to check understanding, and clearly express ideas.

* Learn and apply professional and technical standards (e.g. refer to specific PwC tax and audit guidance), uphold the Firm's code of conduct and independence requirements.

* Assisting in the design, configuration, and implementation of SAP solutions tailored to client needs.

* Participating in system testing, issue resolution, and performance tuning.
* Providing end-user support and training to ensure successful adoption.
* Contributing to project documentation, reporting, and knowledge sharing.

* Staying informed on SAP innovations and industry best practices.

* A growth mindset and proactive approach to learning.
* Respect for diverse perspectives and effective collaboration.
* Strong communication skills—listening actively and expressing ideas clearly.
* Analytical thinking and the ability to identify patterns and solve problems.
* Openness to feedback and continuous improvement.
* Interest in understanding business operations and developing commercial awareness.
* Commitment to learning and applying professional and technical standards, including PwC’s methodologies and values.\

* Final year students and/or fresh graduates with Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Accounting, or a related field.

PT Media Sarana Data merupakan perusahaan swasta yang bergerak di bidang teknologi informasi dan komunikasi. Berdiri pada bulan januari 2009 di kota Yogyakarta, dan seiring meningkatnya permintaan di beberapa kota maka saat ini kami telah mempunyai kantor cabang di Solo, Pemalang, Purwokerto, Padang, Samarinda, Bandung dan Jakarta, dengan cangkupan area layanan seluruh Indonesia. Memberi kesempatan kepada para profesional di bidangnya yang terampil dan dinamik untuk bergabung dan berkembang menjadi bagian tim kami pada posisi :

**Data Analyst**

Kualifikasi :

* Mengumpulkan dan mengolah data operasional (keluhan, coverage, pemetaan langganan, dll).
* Mengidentifikasi masalah (bottleneck/titik kendala, selisih data, inefficiency).
* Membuat laporan harian, mingguan, bulanan.
* Melakukan cross-check dan rekonsiliasi data operasional.
* Minimal D3/S1 Statistik.

* Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik.

* Sales: 1 year (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Data Analyst
description:
**Job Description:**

1. Melakukan pengumpulan, pengolahan, dan analisis data bisnis untuk mendukung evaluasi kinerja serta pengambilan keputusan strategis perusahaan.

2. Melakukan analisis terhadap pencapaian target bisnis, produktivitas, pertumbuhan portofolio, dan indikator kinerja utama (Key Performance Indicators/KPI).

3. Mengidentifikasi tren, pola, peluang, serta potensi permasalahan bisnis berdasarkan hasil analisis data.

4. Menyusun laporan analisis kinerja bisnis secara berkala maupun insidental sebagai bahan evaluasi dan pertimbangan manajemen.

5. Mengembangkan dashboard dan visualisasi data untuk memantau perkembangan serta pencapaian kinerja bisnis.

6. Melakukan analisis terhadap efektivitas strategi dan program bisnis serta memberikan rekomendasi perbaikan berbasis data.

7. Melakukan monitoring terhadap perkembangan kinerja bisnis dan mengidentifikasi potensi risiko maupun area yang memerlukan peningkatan.

8. Berkoordinasi dengan unit kerja terkait dalam pemenuhan kebutuhan data, penyusunan laporan, dan pendalaman hasil analisis bisnis.

9. Mengembangkan metode analisis dan pengolahan data guna meningkatkan efektivitas monitoring serta kualitas pelaporan bisnis.

**Kualifikasi:**

1. Pendidikan minimal S1 dari jurusan Statistika, Matematika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Informatika, Ekonomi, Manajemen, atau bidang lain yang relevan.

2. Memiliki kemampuan berpikir analitis, strategis, kritis, dan terbuka terhadap ide maupun perspektif baru (open-minded).

3. Adaptif, inovatif, proaktif, serta mampu mengidentifikasi permasalahan dan memberikan solusi berbasis data.

4. Memiliki kemampuan dalam pengolahan data, analisis statistik, interpretasi data, serta penyusunan laporan analisis.

5. Menguasai bahasa pemrograman dan tools pengolahan data, seperti Python, R, SQL, Microsoft Excel, atau tools sejenis.

6. Mampu menggunakan tools visualisasi data seperti Tableau, Power BI, atau tools sejenis.

7. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi data yang baik (data storytelling), termasuk menyajikan hasil analisis dan insight secara informatif serta mudah dipahami.

8. Memiliki integritas, ketelitian, dan tanggung jawab yang tinggi dalam mengelola data.

9. Mampu bekerja secara multitasking, mengelola waktu dan skala prioritas, serta melakukan monitoring pekerjaan dengan baik.

10. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan presentasi yang baik serta percaya diri dalam menyampaikan ide, gagasan, dan hasil analisis di depan umum.

title: Release Engineer - Indonesia
description:
About us

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries
  
  
The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.
  
  
NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Release Engineer to join our Engineering team and help build, operate, coordinate, and continuously improve the processes used to reliably deliver software into production. 
  
  
This role combines hands-on Release Engineering operations with program management. You will build and improve release planning and operations while coordinating releases across Engineering, QA, DevOps/SiteOps, Product, and Production Support.
  
  
You will help ensure that release scope, dependencies, risks, readiness, and timelines are visible across teams, while progressively automating the underlying release process.
  
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and cross-functional release coordination — troubleshooting a failed pipeline one moment and facilitating a release-readiness discussion the next.

**Location**
– Hybrid, Indonesia (2 days per week in the office)

**What You’ll be Doing**

**Release Program Management**

* Coordinate the end-to-end release program across Engineering, QA, Product, DevOps/SiteOps, and Production Support.

Join Terralogiq, a leading Google Cloud Premier Partner in Asia, and be part of a team that is redefining what's possible with technology. Established in 2013, PT Terralogiq Integrasi Solusi is the market leader in Indonesia for location intelligence, geospatial solutions, and cloud services. As part of a global technology family with over 16 years of experience, we combine the agility and local expertise of a market leader with the resources and stability of a global enterprise.

Our mission is to empower businesses to thrive in the digital age. We are the first and only Google Maps Premier Partner in Indonesia, and our expertise in Google Cloud has enabled over 250 clients—from innovative startups to major state-owned enterprises—to transform their operations. We build solutions that matter, powering everything from nationwide logistics to smart city applications and disaster management platforms. At Terralogiq, you won’t just be building infrastructure; you'll be engineering the future of digital Indonesia.

**The Opportunity: Contribute to a Landmark Cloud Transformation**

We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Cloud Engineer to join one of our most significant current engagements: the end-to-end migration of a major enterprise client's entire on-premises infrastructure to the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is not just a "lift and shift" project; it is a complete modernization initiative that will set a new standard for performance, scalability, and security.

As the ideal candidate, you are a hands-on professional who thrives on complex challenges. You will be a key contributor to the migration lifecycle—from design and planning to implementation and post-migration optimization. This is a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on a high-visibility project and grow your expertise in large-scale cloud transformation.

**Your Impact: Core Responsibilities**

**Migration & Implementation**

Contribute to the design, planning, and execution of the migration strategy from on-premises data centers to GCP.

Deploy and configure scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform.

Collaborate with customer teams to assess their existing environment, applications, and dependencies.

Manage data migration, ensuring integrity and minimal downtime.

Technical Support & Enablement

Act as a key technical point of contact for the customer during and post-migration.

Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues related to networking, virtual machines, databases, and containerization.

Provide expert guidance and support to ensure a smooth transition and user adoption.

Monitor the health, performance, and security of the new cloud environment using tools like Google Cloud's operations suite.

Proactively identify opportunities for performance tuning, cost optimization, and automation.

Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for application deployments.

Ensure the infrastructure remains up-to-date and compliant with industry best practices.

**Foundational Skills: Required Qualifications (Must-Haves)**

Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect Certification

Level L2 IT Engineer with a minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in cloud operations

Hands-on experience contributing to a large-scale on-premises to cloud migration project.

Strong, hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

Solid understanding and practical experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, preferably GKE).

Strong scripting skills for automation using Python or Bash.

Strong knowledge of cloud networking, security principles, and identity access management (IAM).

Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a customer-facing role.

description:

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries.

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a highly analytical and motivated Data Analyst to join our team in Bandung, Indonesia. In this role, you’ll support our data operations and reporting needs by working closely with teams across the business. You’ll help deliver accurate insights, improve data quality, and support data-driven decision-making.

**Location**
– Hybrid, Indonesia (2 days per week in the office)

**What You’ll be Doing**

* Understand business requirements and translate them into scalable reporting frameworks that provide clear, actionable insights.
* Collect data from multiple sources, maintain data quality, identify discrepancies, and help resolve data issues.
* Build dashboards and reports based on defined business logic.
* Validate data consistency across multiple reports.
* Analyze reports and identify insights that help measure the company’s key performance indicators (KPIs).
* Work with stakeholders to define KPIs, interpret performance drivers, and recommend actions based on data.
* Analyze trends and notify key users when KPI results appear incorrect or unusual.
* Provide data and analysis to stakeholders as needed.
* Work with the Data Engineering team to report missing or incorrect data and support improvements.
* Maintain a list of activities and improvements, and support basic project coordination.
* Communicate changes and new developments to business users.

**About You**

* 5–7 years of experience in data analysis and reporting.
* Mandatory: Proficiency in Excel, SQL, Power BI, and Tableau.
* Proven ability to analyze large volumes of data, identify actionable insights, and communicate findings to stakeholders—not just build dashboards and reports.
* Experience integrating data across BI platforms, data warehouses, and operational tools, such as Sales Operations systems, while ensuring data consistency and integrity
* A strong business-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect data to commercial context and focus on outcomes.
* Experience working with stakeholders.
* Good English communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* A collaborative, dependable, trustworthy, customer-focused, and solution-oriented approach.
* A big plus if you have
* Experience with Databricks, particularly developing SQL dashboards.
* Familiarity with data warehouse concepts, including Medallion Architecture and Star Schema.
* Experience supporting commercial or operational reporting in SaaS or subscription-based businesses.

**What You’ll Love**

* We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community
* We prioritise your work/life balance offering a hybrid work environment and free in-office lunches throughout the week
* We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement
* Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally
* Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
* Receive competitive compensation
* Collaborate with an amazing international workforce

**Additional Information**

Applicants must hold valid working rights in Indonesia at the time of application. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

We are an equal opportunity employer in accordance with Indonesia's Manpower Law. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment regardless of nationality, gender, age, disability, or background. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace for all employees.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.

When you apply, NinjaOne collects and uses your personal information to review your application and manage the hiring process. To learn how we use, store, and protect your data, and what your rights are, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy at https://www.ninjaone.com/candidate-privacy-policy.

title: Performance Marketing Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
  
  
*Job ID: MJ000311*
**About The Team**
We are building a performance marketing organization where every dollar of spend is justified by evidence, not intuition. As an Analyst, you will support our Metasearch channel across APAC markets and help decide where we put our growth budget.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Metasearch is different from other performance channels. We sell inventory, not ads. Results depend on pricing, inventory and the full funnel, so you will work closely with business units, not only with marketers.
  
  
You will turn data into decisions: tracking performance, running tests to measure incremental impact, and giving the team clear recommendations. You will own specific problems and see them through, not only report numbers.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Own your analysis. Take ownership of defined problems in the Metasearch portfolio, such as bid efficiency, market performance and funnel drop-off. Follow them through to a recommendation and the result.
* Support experimentation. Help design, run and read tests (A/B, geo holdouts, audience splits, lift studies). Check that results are sound before they inform a decision.
* Connect the funnel. Track performance from traffic through to bookings and margin. Flag where pricing, inventory or availability is limiting results.
* Partner with the business. Work with commercial, supply and pricing teams to understand constraints and bring those insights into channel decisions.
* Be data-fluent. Frame the right questions, use SQL or AI-assisted queries to get answers, and validate the output yourself.
* Build the reporting rhythm. Maintain dashboards and regular reporting. Identify manual work that should be automated and work with analytics and engineering to fix it.
* Communicate clearly. Turn analysis into short narratives that managers and non-marketers can act on.

**Job Requirements**

* 2 to 4 years of experience in an analytically demanding role. Relevant backgrounds include business analysis, growth, performance marketing (in-house preferred), product, revenue management and pricing.
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (STEM preferred), or strong demonstrated quantitative ability in another discipline.
* Working knowledge of analytical techniques such as regression, incrementality testing, split testing and holdouts, and the ability to apply them to real business problems.
* Evidence of owning a business problem over time, not only producing analysis on request.
* Understanding of the end-to-end funnel and how channel activity ties to business output.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including presenting findings to senior stakeholders.

**Strong Plus**

* Exposure to Metasearch (Skyscanner, Kayak, Trivago, Google Hotel Ads) or other paid channels.
* Experience working with pricing, inventory or supply team
* Familiarity with incrementality measurement or causal inference.
* Background in travel, hospitality, e-commerce, marketplace or another high-volume transactional business.
* Hands-on SQL, BI tool fluency (Tableau, Looker, Data Studio) or scripting (Python, R).
* Multi-market or APAC regional experience.

description:
**About Business Automation**

At Business Automation, we believe that meaningful progress begins when people are empowered to do their best work. Our purpose is to transform complex, time-consuming processes into seamless, intelligent systems that enable teams to operate with greater clarity, speed, and confidence. By reducing manual effort, we create room for ideas to grow, innovation to thrive, and people to truly excel in what they do best.

We don’t aim for simple process improvement—we strive to reshape the way the organization works. Through smart automation, data-driven insights, and thoughtful design, we unlock new levels of efficiency and capability. Whether it’s accelerating decision-making, simplifying workflows, or enabling smarter business operations, our focus is on delivering solutions that create real, measurable impact.

To us, automation is more than just technology—it is about collaboration, curiosity, and continuous growth. We are driven by the joy of solving real problems, exploring new possibilities, and creating solutions that truly make a difference. Ultimately, we take pride in empowering teams across the organization to work smarter, achieve more with less friction, and experience greater satisfaction in what they do every day.

**About the role**

Own end-to-end quality assurance for merchant products, from payment flows to merchant-facing apps, so that every release is reliable, secure, and compliant at high transaction volume. Lead test strategy and automation, and raise the quality maturity of the squad.

**You'll be working on:**

* Define and own the test strategy (functional, regression, integration, performance, and security) for merchant product.
* Design, build, and maintain automated test frameworks for API, mobile (Android/iOS), and web, integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
* Validate money-movement correctness, including transaction status, idempotency, refunds, settlement, and reconciliation, with a focus on edge cases like timeouts, retries, and partial failures.
* Run performance and load testing for peak-traffic scenarios such as campaigns, payday, and Ramadan, and partner with engineering on bottlenecks.
* Work with PM, engineering, and design from the requirement stage (shift-left) to define acceptance criteria and catch gaps before development starts.
* Track and report quality metrics such as defect leakage, automation coverage, flaky test rate, and escaped bugs.

**Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of software QA experience.
* Strong hands-on automation skills in at least one language (Java, Kotlin, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript).
* Experience with automation tools such as Appium, Espresso/XCUITest, Selenium/Playwright, and REST Assured or Postman/Newman.
* Solid API testing skills (REST, JSON, authentication, contract testing) and comfort writing SQL to validate backend data.
* Experience integrating tests into CI/CD (Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) and working in Agile/Scrum teams.
* Strong analytical skills for designing test cases around complex business rules and failure scenarios.
* Clear written and verbal communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English.

title: Supplier Quality Engineering Intern
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

As a Supplier Quality Engineering Intern, you will support supplier quality activities related to incoming material quality, supplier performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives. You will work closely with the Supplier Quality team to ensure supplier quality issues are addressed effectively and quality metrics are accurately tracked.

**What will you do?**

* Support Incoming Quality Control (IQC) inspections by assisting in the investigation of material quality concerns and inspection findings.
* Coordinate and monitor quarantined materials, including follow-up with internal stakeholders and suppliers regarding disposition and corrective actions.
* Track supplier non-conformances (NCRs), issue reminders, and monitor supplier containment actions as well as 8D corrective and preventive action reports.
* Consolidate and analyze quality data, including PPM, rejection rates, and 8D performance, to support monthly KPI reporting and dashboard creation.
* Assist in supplier quality programs and audits, including Layered Process Audits, PFMEA reviews, Quality Basic assessments, and Continuous Improvement initiatives.
* Lead or contribute to a structured improvement project using problem-solving methodologies, with final project presentation at the end of the internship.

**What qualifications will make you successful?**

**Mandatory Qualifications**

* Currently pursuing a Bachelor's Degree (S1) or Diploma (D4) in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Materials/Metallurgical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field.
* Minimum GPA of 3.00/4.00.
* Available for a full-time internship for 6 months.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions, and data visualization/charts.
* Good written English communication skills, particularly for professional email correspondence.
* Detail-oriented, proactive, and comfortable working with data and follow-up activities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to Quality Control, Statistical Quality Control, or Industrial Statistics coursework.
* Basic understanding of 7 QC Tools, 8D Problem Solving, and ISO 9001 principles.
* Ability to read technical drawings and use measurement tools such as calipers and micrometers.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Power Automate, Python, or similar data analytics tools.
* Active involvement in student organizations or extracurricular activities.
* Based in Batam or willing to relocate during the internship period.

**Preferred Skills**

* Analytical thinking and problem-solving.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Effective communication and stakeholder follow-up.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.

title: Business Development Associate (B2B Sales) - Indonesia
description:
**DIGITAL BUSINESS DEVELOPER**

*B2B Learn2SaaS & Enterprise Business | 2–3 Years Experience | Reports to: Enterprise & Learn2SaaS Lead*

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a driven and analytical Digital Business Developer to support the growth of our B2B Learn2SaaS and enterprise partnerships across the region. Working closely with and reporting to the Enterprise & Learn2SaaS Lead, you will help identify, engage and nurture corporate clients — HR leaders, L&D heads and enterprise decision-makers — as part of a coordinated enterprise sales strategy.

This role combines lead generation, pipeline management and data-driven sales support. You will execute day-to-day outreach, qualification and reporting activities that enable the Enterprise & Learn2SaaS Lead to focus on strategic account development and closing.

**Job Mission**

As a Digital Business Developer, you will support the Enterprise & Learn2SaaS Lead in driving new business growth for our B2B Learn2SaaS offering — helping enterprises across ASEAN adopt AI-powered digital skilling and workforce transformation solutions. You will own lead generation and pipeline management, using data and AI tools to sharpen targeting and reporting, while the Lead guides overall account strategy and key client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Generate and qualify B2B leads through outbound prospecting, inbound follow-up, events, partner referrals and digital channels, under the direction of the Enterprise & Learn2SaaS Lead
* Build and maintain a structured enterprise sales pipeline, ensuring accurate and timely tracking of leads, opportunities and follow-ups in the CRM
* Support the Lead in preparing for and following up on consultations with HR/L&D decision-makers, capturing workforce skilling needs and organisational learning goals
* Assist in developing tailored B2B proposals and materials, mapping enterprise SaaS/digital learning solutions to client business outcomes
* Help nurture relationships with enterprise clients and corporate partners between key touchpoints led by the Enterprise & Learn2SaaS Lead
* Use PowerBI to build and maintain dashboards and reports tracking pipeline health, conversion rates and lead source performance
* Leverage AI tools to support prospecting, lead scoring, outreach personalisation and sales reporting efficiency
* Coordinate with marketing and partnerships teams, under the Lead's guidance, to refine lead generation campaigns and messaging for enterprise audiences
* Participate & represent the company at B2B events, industry forums and networking sessions to generate new business opportunities
* Provide the Enterprise & Learn2SaaS Lead with regular, data-backed updates on pipeline status, targets and conversion performance

**Requirements**

* 2–3 years of experience in B2B sales, business development, account management, channel development & management or partnerships — preferably within Learning & Development, HR Tech, EdTech and/or SaaS
* Demonstrated experience in enterprise lead generation and pipeline management (CRM proficiency required)
* Working proficiency in PowerBI data visualisation/BI tools for sales reporting and pipeline analysis
* Comfortable using AI tools (e.g. for prospecting, outreach, content drafting or data analysis) to improve sales productivity
* Strong communication and coordination skills, comfortable supporting a Lead across multiple concurrent accounts
* Consultative mindset — able to understand client business challenges and help position solutions accordingly
* Analytical and detail-oriented, with strong attention to pipeline hygiene and reporting accuracy
* Self-motivated, organised and comfortable operating in a fast-paced enterprise sales cycle
* Prior exposure to the digital skilling, EdTech or workforce transformation space is a strong advantage

**What You'll Gain**

* Direct mentorship from the Enterprise & Learn2SaaS Lead, with exposure to enterprise account strategy and closing
* Hands-on experience in data-driven B2B sales using PowerBI and AI-powered sales tools
* A clear growth pathway toward greater account ownership within enterprise and Learn2SaaS business lines
* A role with direct impact on organisational workforce transformation outcomes for major regional employers

Ability to commute/relocate:

* Jakarta: Reliably commute or planning to relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Experience:

* B2B Sales: 2 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Location:

* Jakarta (Required)

Willingness to travel:

* 50% (Required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jakarta

description:
**Job Description**

● Build and maintain production-grade React applications using TypeScript, React Router v7, and a shared monorepo.

● Collaborate with designers and backend engineers to deliver features that are robust, testable, and aligned with Figma and Storybook specs.

● Write and maintain strict, explicit types and domain models in shared packages.

● Implement and enforce separation of concerns: logic hooks, UI components, and service functions.

● Handle all states (loading, error, empty, success) in UI and data fetching flows.

title: Mobile Engineer (1-year Contract)
description:
**Job Description**
  
  
*Job ID: MJ000439*
**About Traveloka**
Traveloka is Southeast Asia's leading travel and lifestyle super-app. We connect tens of millions of travellers across the region with flights, hotels, experiences, financial services, and more — all from a single platform. Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region.
  
  
We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that.
  
  
**About The Team**
Financing Engineering builds the systems that make travel more accessible — the credit, instalment, and pay-later experiences that decide a price is never the barrier between a traveller and their trip. You will engineer real-time credit decisioning, instalment flows, and payment journeys that hold up across Southeast Asia's wildly different markets, where regulation, credit infrastructure, and consumer readiness are never the same twice.
  
  
This is product engineering with real stakes: every checkout you ship moves money and trust. You will own services end to end across backend, web, and mobile, design for resilience and compliance from the first line of code, and watch your work convert into trips taken by millions. If you want to build fintech at consumer scale — and write the playbook for a region the textbooks ignore — this is the team.
  
  
**About The Job**
As a Mobile Engineer in Traveloka's Financing Engineering team, you are a competent individual contributor who independently delivers features in our iOS or Android app — directly shaping how travellers across markets discover and book the right property at the right price.
  
  

* Independently design, build, test, and ship features across Financing
* Own the technical quality of your work: well-modularized and secure components
* Ensure your components are reliable, diagnosable, monitored, and reusable
* Make sound implementation decisions and choose appropriate architecture patterns (MVVM-C or equivalent) for the problem at hand
* Optimise for performance, memory, and crash-free experience in a high-traffic app under real-world network conditions
* Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues in production, and contribute to incident postmortems with clear root-cause analysis
* Drive engineering hygiene through thorough code review, unit and integration testing, and architectural design reviews

**Job Requirements**

* You have at least 1 year building production mobile apps, or you have built equivalent depth in practice.
* Android: You write clean Kotlin (and Java where needed) and build native features with the Android SDK, with a sound grasp of the activity/fragment lifecycle, Jetpack, and the platform's UI model.
* iOS: You write clean Swift (and Objective-C where needed) and build native features with the iOS SDK, with a sound grasp of the view-controller lifecycle, UIKit/SwiftUI, and the platform's UI model.

**About Sea Labs Indonesia**
Sea Labs is at the core of the Sea platforms development, supporting diverse business lines from e-commerce, supply chain, games, payment and finance, among many others. The strong growth and unique positioning of Sea's e-commerce business, Shopee, spurred the launch of Sea Labs Indonesia. Since its inception, the group of passionate engineers have charted the course to drive the best experience for our users in Indonesia, many of which solutions are even adapted to other markets in the region.
  
  
Sea's hyper-growing business scale has transformed most "innocent" problems into huge technical challenges, and there is no better place to experience world-class projects first-hand if you love technologies as much as we do. Together with our passionate and driven teams, you'll get to develop your skills, build on industry knowledge and collaborate with global teams in a dynamic space. Browse our Sea Labs Indonesia team openings to see how you can make an impact with us.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our R&D team works across Indonesia, Singapore, and China. We provide secure and reliable financial products and payment services for millions of merchants and users across Southeast Asia, Latin America, and other markets. Our systems support e-commerce, food delivery, digital payments, and a wide range of financial services.
  
  
Together, we aim to reach the forefront of cashless payment technology by providing a more accessible, secure and reliable payment network that empowers individuals as well as micro, small and medium enterprises around the globe.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer, you will work with some of the most talented minds in the world, collaborating with fellow Developers, Product Managers, User Experience Designers and Operation Engineers to design, test and safeguard availability, performance and usability of our business-critical functionalities that delight both internal business and external end-users.
  
  
You will collaborate with experienced engineers across countries and functions, solving complex distributed-systems and payment-platform challenges at significant scale. This role offers strong opportunities to deepen your expertise in QA & AI technology.
  
  
**Job Description:**

* Design and execute test plans for payment/financial products, APIs, integrations, and financial workflows.
* Perform functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and production validation testing.
* Test critical scenarios such as payment success and failure, retries, timeouts, duplicate requests, reversals, refunds, and reconciliation.
* Develop and maintain automated tests for APIs and backend services.
* Identify, investigate, and track defects; work with engineers to drive issues to resolution.
* Participate in release quality assessment, incident investigation, and root-cause analysis.
* Improve test coverage, QA processes, automation frameworks, and CI/CD quality gates.
* Collaborate with local/regional teams to deliver reliable payment services across multiple markets.

**Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2+ years of experience in QA, software testing, test engineering, or quality assurance.
* Experience testing backend services, REST APIs, microservices, or distributed systems.
* Familiarity with API testing tools such as Postman, Swagger, REST Assured, or similar tools.
* Basic to intermediate SQL skills for data validation and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience in UI and Mobile Automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, or WebdriverIO.
* Strong programming/scripting skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Understanding of software testing principles, defect lifecycle, and Agile development practices.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work with international, cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to learn AI, use AI to facilitate and enhance quality .

title: Head of Capital Markets, Indonesia
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  
Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  
Head of Capital Markets Indonesia
  
  
JLL (Jones Lang LaSalle) is a leading global professional services firm specializing in real estate and investment management. With over 3,500 capital markets professionals worldwide—including more than 600 across Asia Pacific—JLL delivers best-in-class advisory services across the full spectrum of real assets. In Indonesia, we combine deep local market expertise with global reach to provide innovative, tailored transaction strategies that support clients throughout the entire investment lifecycle.
  
As cross-border and domestic capital flows evolve amid shifting macroeconomic conditions, JLL is expanding its leadership team to drive growth, excellence, and client impact in one of the world’s most dynamic real estate markets.
  
  
As Head of Capital Markets – Indonesia, you will serve as the strategic leader responsible for shaping and executing JLL’s capital markets vision across Indonesia. You will lead a high-performing team of investment professionals, originate and close complex transactions across all major asset classes—including office, industrial & logistics, retail, hospitality, and alternatives (e.g., data centers, life sciences, multifamily)—and position JLL as the undisputed advisor of choice for institutional investors, developers, private equity firms, family offices, and high-net-worth individuals.
  
This role carries full P&L accountability and requires a proven track record of scaling profitable businesses, cultivating C-suite relationships, and delivering integrated, cross-functional solutions in alignment with JLL’s APAC and global strategic priorities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Develop and implement a comprehensive, multi-year business strategy to grow JLL’s capital markets franchise in Indonesia—driving revenue, profitability, market share, and talent development.
  
Originate and execute landmark investment sales, acquisitions, joint ventures, and portfolio transactions across all real estate sectors.
  
Serve as the foremost subject matter expert on Indonesia’s capital markets landscape, providing actionable insights on pricing, investor appetite, regulatory shifts, and emerging trends.
  
Cultivate and steward long-term relationships with top-tier domestic and international capital partners, including sovereign wealth funds, pension funds, REITs, private equity firms, developers, and ultra-high-net-worth families.
  
Lead end-to-end transaction processes—from mandate acquisition and due diligence to financial modeling, marketing, negotiation, and closing—ensuring flawless execution and client satisfaction.
  
Drive cross-selling opportunities by collaborating closely with JLL’s Leasing, Valuation, Project & Development Services, Debt Advisory, and Research teams to deliver holistic client solutions.
  
Manage P&L performance, including budgeting, forecasting, resource allocation, and headcount planning, with a focus on sustainable, high-margin growth.
  
Recruit, mentor, and retain top-tier talent while fostering an inclusive, high-performance culture aligned with JLL’s values and DEI commitments.
  
Represent JLL externally at industry forums, media engagements, and client events to enhance brand visibility and thought leadership.
  
Provide regular performance reporting and strategic updates to APAC and global leadership
  
  
Required Qualifications & Experience
  
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or advanced degree preferred.
  
Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in real estate investment sales, capital markets, or private equity, with significant focus on the Indonesia market.
  
Demonstrated success in originating and closing large-scale, complex transactions across multiple asset classes.
  
Proven P&L ownership and experience scaling a professional services or advisory business in Indonesia.
  
Extensive, active network among institutional investors, developers, and financial intermediaries in Greater Indonesia and internationally.
  
Deep understanding of Indonesia’s real estate regulatory environment, foreign investment policies, and capital controls.
  
Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English (written and spoken); additional Asian languages are a plus.
  
  
Key Competencies
  
Strategic thinker with strong analytical rigor and commercial acumen
  
Exceptional client relationship and negotiation skills
  
Inspirational leadership with a track record of building high-performing teams
  
Resilient, agile, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, results-driven environment
  
Commitment to integrity, collaboration, and continuous learning
  
Passion for innovation and delivering exceptional client outcomes
  
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  
Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:
  
  
JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  
About JLL –

NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries

The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work.

NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years.

**About the Role**

We're currently hiring Software Engineers with a strong background in scalable backend development to join our global product engineering team.

This is an exciting opportunity to work on our data backup and recovery platform, a core part of our SaaS offering. In this role, you'll focus on delivering robust features across backup, archive, restore, and download services used by our partners worldwide.

You'll be collaborating closely with our highly skilled Software Engineers, Data Engineer and Technical Leads, contributing to new feature development, product enhancements, and ongoing support for our production systems.

If you're passionate about building resilient, high-performing applications and want to be part of a mission-driven team that values innovation and quality, we’d love to hear from you.

**Location –**
Hybrid | Bandung, Indonesia (at least 2 days per week in the office)

**What You’ll be Doing**

* Developing and testing software
* Write efficient, bug-free, robust and testable code that performs efficiently in production
* Strong in adapting shift-left testing process
* Work on the Backup product and play a key role in the maintenance of the product
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues in an evolving code base
* Work with a scrum team and participate in scrum ceremonies.
* Share status updates with accuracy
* Delivering high impact solutions with a high degree of independence.
* Research new areas and documented it in clear and detailed manner
* Create detailed technical design documentations.

**About You**

* About 3+ years of experience in Software Development
* Experience with Ruby and/or JAVA
* Experience with Front end technologies: React, Typescript, Slim Templates will be a huge plus
* Experience with Big Data, SQL Tuning and ETL will be a huge plus
* Experience with Kafka and data streaming will be a huge plus
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related field
* Knowledge of Operating systems like Linux and Windows
* Knowledge of Relational Databases, SQL and Cloud
* Good interpersonal skills, oral and written skills, with the ability to present ideas
* Values that are aligned with us being a team of experts, problem solvers and collaborators, who are highly customer focused, dependable and trustworthy
* Working experience with Global teams outside Indonesia will be a huge plus
* High Adaptability with rapid changes

**What You’ll Love**

* We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community
* We prioritise your work/life balance offering a hybrid work environment and free in-office lunches throughout the week
* We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement
* Grow personally and together with one of the fastest growing companies globally
* Develop your skills through our renowned training platform
* Receive competitive compensation
* Collaborate with an amazing international workforce

**Additional Information**

Applicants must hold valid working rights in Indonesia at the time of application. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role.

We are an equal opportunity employer in accordance with Indonesia's Manpower Law. All applicants will receive fair consideration for employment regardless of nationality, gender, age, disability, or background. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace for all employees.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We are committed to providing an inclusive and diverse work environment.

When you apply, NinjaOne collects and uses your personal information to review your application and manage the hiring process. To learn how we use, store, and protect your data, and what your rights are, please read our Candidate Privacy Policy at https://www.ninjaone.com/candidate-privacy-policy.

title: Vibe Coder - Website
description:
PT. Fivehoster Karya Bangsa

Sistem kerja

Sehari-hari remote, dengan kewajiban hadir di kantor di Malang satu kali setiap bulan untuk evaluasi.

Fivehoster mencari Vibe Coder – Website untuk membangun website klien menggunakan React dan Next.js. Kamu akan menggunakan AI di setiap tahap, dari menerjemahkan brief dan merancang tampilan hingga menulis kode, menguji, merevisi, dan memublikasikan website.

Kami mengutamakan kandidat yang bisa membuat website modern dengan animasi yang halus dan interaksi yang terasa natural. Kami ingin melihat bagaimana kamu menggunakan motion untuk mengarahkan perhatian pengunjung dan memperkuat identitas visual klien, sambil menjaga website tetap nyaman digunakan di HP.

Tanggung jawab

• Menerjemahkan brief klien menjadi struktur halaman, arah visual, dan spesifikasi fitur yang jelas untuk dikerjakan dengan AI.

• Membangun website responsif dengan React dan Next.js serta meninjau kode hasil AI agar mudah dipelihara dan direvisi.

• Membuat animasi saat scroll, transisi halaman, dan interaksi pada tombol atau menu sesuai kebutuhan proyek.

• Menguji tampilan, fungsi, dan performa di desktop maupun HP, termasuk untuk pengguna yang memilih pengaturan reduced motion.

• Memublikasikan website dan mengerjakan revisi berdasarkan masukan klien atau tim.

Kualifikasi

• Pernah membangun website React atau Next.js dengan bantuan AI dan bisa menunjukkan demo atau portofolio. Proyek pribadi boleh disertakan.

• Terbiasa menggunakan Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, atau alat sejenis untuk membuat, menguji, dan memperbaiki website.

• Memahami dasar React, Next.js, serta JavaScript atau TypeScript agar bisa membaca dan memperbaiki kode hasil AI.

• Peka terhadap layout, tipografi, dan timing animasi. Aktif mengikuti perkembangan desain web, motion, dan alat pengembangan AI.

• Bersedia hadir di kantor satu kali setiap bulan untuk evaluasi.

Pengalaman menggunakan Motion (Framer Motion), GSAP, atau animasi CSS menjadi nilai tambah, terutama jika hasilnya berjalan lancar di HP.

Cara melamar

Lamar melalui tombol Apply di LinkedIn. Sertakan tautan website React atau Next.js terbaikmu, terutama proyek yang menampilkan animasi atau interaksi buatanmu. Ceritakan singkat bagaimana kamu menggunakan AI dan menguji hasilnya di HP.

title: Order Management
description:
Job Description:

In Schneider Electric, everything we do is geared towards advancing progress and sustainability for all—our colleagues, customers, partners, and the communities and societies we serve.

Whether it's through our products, software, and services that propel the digital transformation of energy management and automation, or through our corporate citizenship and volunteer activities, we make a meaningful impact by empowering people and organizations to become more resilient, electric, and digital.

Which is where you come in. Working at Schneider Electric means working toward a cleaner, better world. You're part of a global team built on inclusion, mastery, purpose, action, curiosity, and teamwork, turning sustainability ambitions into actions.

**The Role: Order Management**

**Company:** Schneider Electric  
**Location:** Batam, Indonesia

We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused **Order Management** professional to manage customer orders from order entry through production coordination and final delivery.

In this role, you will work closely with **Customers, Supply Chain, Planning, Production, Logistics, Sales, and Customer Service teams** to ensure orders are processed accurately and delivered according to customer expectations.

You will play an important role in connecting **customer demand with manufacturing execution**, proactively managing order priorities, delivery risks, and changes while maintaining clear communication with internal and external stakeholders.

**What will you do?**

**Order Management & Execution**

* Manage customer orders from order receipt and confirmation through production and delivery.
* Ensure order information, quantities, requested delivery dates, and other requirements are accurately maintained in the system.
* Monitor open orders and proactively follow up on order status and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate changes related to order quantities, priorities, schedules, or delivery requirements.
* Identify issues that may affect order fulfillment and drive timely resolution with relevant teams.

**Customer & Stakeholder Coordination**

* Serve as a key coordination point for order status and delivery-related matters.
* Maintain clear and proactive communication regarding **order confirmation, delivery status, changes, shortages, and potential delays**.
* Work closely with Sales and Customer Service teams to understand customer priorities and requirements.
* Coordinate internally to address urgent orders, delivery escalations, and changing customer demand.
* Build effective working relationships with cross-functional stakeholders to support customer satisfaction.

**Manufacturing & Supply Chain Coordination**

* Work closely with **Production Planning, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, and Logistics** teams to align customer orders with production and delivery capabilities.
* Monitor production readiness, material availability, and shipment schedules that may impact customer orders.
* Support order prioritization based on customer requirements and manufacturing constraints.
* Escalate supply, production, or logistics risks that could impact committed delivery dates.
* Facilitate cross-functional follow-up to resolve issues affecting order fulfillment.

**Delivery & Logistics Coordination**

* Coordinate with Logistics and Warehouse teams to support timely shipment and delivery.
* Monitor shipment readiness against customer requirements and committed delivery schedules.
* Follow up on delivery issues and coordinate corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.
* Ensure appropriate order and shipment information is available to support smooth delivery execution.

**Order Performance & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor **order fulfillment, delivery performance, backlog, and order-related issues**.

title: Operations Analyst (Data & Automation)
description:
**Responsibilities**
The Operations Analyst (Data & Automation) is the Logistics team's in-house builder of data tools and automation. They turn business needs into small, reliable systems: data transformation (ETL) flows, dashboards and reports, data-entry tools for scattered operational data, and AI-assisted workflows. They also support the Business Analyst with requirement gathering, SOP documentation and reporting, and work closely with the Logistics team to drive improvement.
  
  

* Build and maintain data transformation (ETL) flows that produce deterministic, verifiable output, reconciled against source data.
* Build internal web tools to capture operational data that is not available via API, with input validation and audit trails.
* Design and maintain database schemas for data owned by these tools, using constraints and validation to keep data clean (no duplicates, no orphaned records).
* Build dashboards and reports on top of the existing data platform.
* Build AI-assisted workflows where they fit, with checks on the AI's output.
* Write tests from known-input and expected-output cases agreed with the requester.
* Reuse and extend existing live tools as templates, and document each tool shipped (purpose, inputs and outputs, how to deploy, how to test).
* Use AI coding tools in daily work and be able to explain any code shipped.
* Work with Logistics team members to understand their daily processes, collect feedback after each launch, and improve tools based on how they are used.
* Support requirement gathering, SOP documentation, and ad hoc reporting for the logistics team.

**Requirements**
**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data or related field.

**Experience**

* 0–2 years of experience
* Fresh graduates are welcome if they have relevant internship, freelance, or part-time experience.
* Has built at least one project end-to-end that other people used (internship, work or personal).
* Experience with AI coding assistants, and the judgment to check their output.

**Skills**

* Python and SQL: able to read, write and debug both independently.
* Relational database fundamentals: table design, primary and foreign keys, constraints, joins, indexes and transactions; hands-on experience with a relational database such as PostgreSQL, MySQL or SQL Server.
* Working knowledge of Git and basic automated testing.

**Attributes**

* Clear written communication, and comfortable taking requirements from non-technical colleagues.
* Genuine interest in business operations (e.g., logistics or supply chain) and willingness to learn how the logistics team works.
* Able to work from the office when required.

title: Cloud Engineer - PCA Certification (must have)
description:
About Terralogiq:

Pioneering Geospatial Intelligence and Cloud Innovation in Asia

Join Terralogiq, a leading Google Cloud Premier Partner in Asia, and be part of a team that is redefining what's possible with technology. Established in 2013, PT Terralogiq Integrasi Solusi is the market leader in Indonesia for location intelligence, geospatial solutions, and cloud services. As part of a global technology family with over 16 years of experience, we combine the agility and local expertise of a market leader with the resources and stability of a global enterprise.

Our mission is to empower businesses to thrive in the digital age. We are the first and only Google Maps Premier Partner in Indonesia, and our expertise in Google Cloud has enabled over 250 clients—from innovative startups to major state-owned enterprises—to transform their operations. We build solutions that matter, powering everything from nationwide logistics to smart city applications and disaster management platforms. At Terralogiq, you won’t just be building infrastructure; you'll be engineering the future of digital Indonesia.

The Opportunity: Contribute to a Landmark Cloud Transformation

We are seeking a skilled and forward-thinking Cloud Engineer to join one of our most significant current engagements: the end-to-end migration of a major enterprise client's entire on-premises infrastructure to the Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is not just a "lift and shift" project; it is a complete modernization initiative that will set a new standard for performance, scalability, and security.

As the ideal candidate, you are a hands-on professional who thrives on complex challenges. You will be a key contributor to the migration lifecycle—from design and planning to implementation and post-migration optimization. This is a unique opportunity to make a tangible impact on a high-visibility project and grow your expertise in large-scale cloud transformation.

Your Impact: Core Responsibilities

Migration & Implementation

* Contribute to the design, planning, and execution of the migration strategy from on-premises data centers to GCP.
* Deploy and configure scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform.
* Collaborate with customer teams to assess their existing environment, applications, and dependencies.
* Manage data migration, ensuring integrity and minimal downtime.
* Technical Support & Enablement
* Act as a key technical point of contact for the customer during and post-migration.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure issues related to networking, virtual machines, databases, and containerization.
* Provide expert guidance and support to ensure a smooth transition and user adoption.
* Monitor the health, performance, and security of the new cloud environment using tools like Google Cloud's operations suite.
* Proactively identify opportunities for performance tuning, cost optimization, and automation.
* Implement and manage CI/CD pipelines for application deployments.
* Ensure the infrastructure remains up-to-date and compliant with industry best practices.

Foundational Skills: Required Qualifications (Must-Haves)

* Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect Certification
* Level L2 IT Engineer with a minimum of 1 year of hands-on experience in cloud operations
* Hands-on experience contributing to a large-scale on-premises to cloud migration project.
* Strong, hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
* Solid understanding and practical experience with containerization technologies (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes, preferably GKE).
* Strong scripting skills for automation using Python or Bash.
* Strong knowledge of cloud networking, security principles, and identity access management (IAM).
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a customer-facing role.

title: Staff Engineer (Backend) - Platform
description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
  
  
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Staff Engineer (Backend) in the Platform team, you set the technical direction for the shared foundations that every Ajaib product runs on: identity, core services, API standards, observability and developer tooling. You treat the platform as a product whose customers are other engineers, solve the hardest cross-team problems, and make engineers across the company stronger. You stay hands-on where it matters most.
  
  

* Define the technical direction and architecture for platform systems that span many teams
* Lead the design of scalable, secure, multi-tenant services and review critical designs from other teams
* Set API and contract standards across the company: versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation and documentation
* Lead the architecture of identity and access: authentication, authorization, token handling and service-to-service security
* Design for reliability: service level objectives, rate limiting, isolation between consumers, graceful degradation and disaster recovery
* Build the golden paths that make good engineering the easy path: service templates, shared libraries, CI/CD standards and observability defaults
* Architect and execute seamless, zero-downtime structural migrations across many teams, with clear timelines, tooling and support. E.g., identity providers, gateway layers across the organization using the Strangler pattern and backward-compatible proxying
* Identify technical risks early, weigh trade-offs and drive decisions that fit business and regulatory needs
* Lead investigations and root cause analysis for complex production incidents, and drive lasting improvements
* Partner with Engineering Managers, Product, Security, Infrastructure and Architecture on cross-team initiatives
* Mentor Senior Engineers and help grow technical leadership across the company
* Stay hands-on with implementation for critical components and complex problems
* Design and implement highly resilient, low-latency API Gateways that standardize authentication, routing, and rate-limiting across hundreds of microservices
* Drive the evolution of our identity platform (OAuth2, OIDC, Zero Trust) to support seamless, highly secure access patterns for millions of retail investors and internal services

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Experience: 8+ years of professional software engineering, with a proven record of designing and running platform or shared services used by many teams, and leading technical work across teams
* Languages: Highly proficient in Java, Go or another modern backend language
* System Design & Architecture: Strong expertise in microservices, event-driven architectures, multi-tenant design, reliability engineering, observability and performance optimization
* Security: Deep knowledge of authentication and authorization (Keycloak / Ory Stack, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS) and secure system design
* Data & Messaging: Deep practical experience with Kafka, Redis, and relational and NoSQL databases, including query tuning and data consistency
* Infrastructure: Experience designing and operating applications on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS) and Kubernetes
* Mindset: Product mindset toward internal users. Strong communication, with the ability to influence technical decisions without direct authority. Experience in fintech or another regulated environment is a plus
* Proven experience migrating live, high-traffic consumer systems to modern identity providers (like Keycloak or Ory) without user disruption is a strong plus

**Benefits**

* Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
* Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
* Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
* Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
* Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
* Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
* Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
* Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users

title: Senior Web Engineer II - Platform
description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
  
  
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Web Engineer II in the Platform team, you build the web foundations that every Ajaib product team builds on: the design system and component library, shared packages, sign-in and session handling in the browser, and the build and release tooling. You own these foundations from design to production, treat other engineers as your customers, and help the engineers around you do better work.
  
  

* Design, build and maintain shared web foundations: component library, design system, shared packages and the application shell
* Own features end to end: technical design, implementation, testing, release and support for the teams that use them
* Keep shared packages stable: clear APIs, semantic versioning, changelogs, migration guides and safe deprecation
* Build accessible, themeable, well-documented components that product teams can adopt without custom work
* Build and improve secure sign-in, session and token handling on the web, working with backend and Security teams
* Improve build speed, CI/CD pipelines, monorepo tooling and release automation for all web teams
* Set and measure performance budgets and quality standards, such as Core Web Vitals, bundle size and accessibility checks
* Write maintainable, well-tested code and give thoughtful code reviews
* Investigate production issues from error monitoring and feedback from product teams, and ship lasting fixes
* Mentor mid-level engineers and share good web practices across teams
* Own the integration of our centralized identity platform (OAuth2/OIDC) into all web properties, ensuring zero-trust session management and protecting against modern web vulnerabilities
* Establish and enforce company-wide frontend instrumentation standards. Build the core telemetry packages (logging, tracing, error boundaries) that product teams use to monitor their apps in production

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Experience: 5+ years of professional web engineering, including building shared libraries, design systems or tooling used by several teams
* Languages & Frameworks: Strong in TypeScript and JavaScript; deep experience with React and a modern framework such as Next.js (deep knowledge in App Router / Pages Router is a must); strong component design
* Architecture & Tooling: Experience with monorepos, bundlers, package publishing and build performance.
* Quality: Solid experience with unit, integration, visual and end-to-end testing, CI/CD and error monitoring
* Performance & Security: Strong in browser performance profiling, accessibility and web security, including authentication on the web. Deep understanding of browser mechanics, HTTP headers (CSP, CORS), cookie security policies, and token lifecycles
* Mindset: Ownership mindset, clear communication and a service attitude toward internal users. Experience in fintech or another regulated, high-traffic consumer product is a plus

**Benefits**

* Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
* Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
* Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
* Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
* Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
* Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
* Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
* Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users

title: Senior Security Consultant - L3
description:
Are you passionate about helping organizations securely adopt cloud technologies?

Do you enjoy designing cloud security solutions, advising technical stakeholders, and translating complex risks into practical recommendations?

Would you like to shape security strategies across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services, and hybrid cloud environments?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations embrace cloud technologies securely by combining deep technical expertise with practical security, governance, and risk management capabilities. We are looking for a Security Consultant to help customers design, implement, and strengthen security architectures across cloud and hybrid environments while enabling business transformation and innovation.

As a Security Consultant, you will work closely with customers, cloud architects, engineers, application teams, and security stakeholders to assess risks, design security architectures, and implement effective security controls. You will provide strategic guidance while ensuring cloud solutions remain secure, compliant, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Designing secure architectures across Microsoft 365, Microsoft Azure, AWS, and hybrid cloud environments covering IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS solutions.
* Assessing business and technical requirements, identifying security risks, and recommending cloud-native security controls and architectural best practices.
* Conducting security architecture reviews, threat modeling workshops, risk assessments, and design evaluations for new and existing cloud solutions.
* Advising customers on identity and access management, application security, network security, data protection, cryptography, key management, and system hardening practices.
* Collaborating with business stakeholders, application owners, cloud teams, and security leaders to develop security roadmaps and strategic initiatives.
* Leading customer workshops, documenting recommendations, presenting findings, and promoting security awareness and best practices across customer and internal teams.

**Job Requirements**

* Experience designing or implementing security solutions across Microsoft 365, Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud environments.
* Strong understanding of cloud security architecture and security controls across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS platforms.
* Knowledge of identity and access management, application security, data protection, vulnerability management, cryptography, network security, firewalls, and IDS/IPS technologies.
* Experience performing security assessments, threat modeling exercises, design reviews, or technical risk evaluations.
* Understanding of cloud-native security and governance technologies, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, security automation, cloud governance, and configuration management.
* Strong consulting, communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and senior business stakeholders.

**Company description**


SoftwareOne and Crayon have come together to form a global, AI-powered software and cloud solutions provider with a bold vision for the future. With a footprint in over 70 countries and a diverse team of 13,000+ professionals, we offer unparalleled opportunities for talent to grow, make an impact, and shape the future of technology. At the heart of our business is our people. We empower our teams to work across borders, innovate fearlessly, and continuously develop their skills through world-class learning and development programs. Whether you're passionate about cloud, software, data, AI, or building meaningful client relationships, you’ll find a place to thrive here. Join us and be part of a purpose-driven culture where your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your career can go global.
