title: Senior Security Engineer, Red Team & Threat Intel
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
Join Grab's Red Team & Threat Intel team, which helps improve the security posture of Grab's products, platforms, cloud environments, AI systems, and enterprise technology across Southeast Asia.
  
  
The team partners with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and business teams. This partnership enables the team to emulate real-world adversaries, identify the highest-impact risks, and help Grab strengthen its preventive, detective, and response capabilities. The Threat Intel function brings external incident trends, adversary behaviours, and internal improvement opportunities into Grab's security priorities. This helps the team plan intelligence-led Purple Team exercises, advise leadership, and support risk prioritisation with the Vulnerability Management team. We work with curiosity, technical depth, and responsibility, using offensive security techniques and threat intelligence to make Grab safer for our users, partners, and Grabbers.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
You will report to the Red Team & Threat Intel team leader and perform complex red team operations across cloud, CI/CD, endpoint, identity, application, and AI environments. You will design realistic attack simulations, develop offensive tooling, apply threat intelligence to Purple Team planning, and turn findings into practical improvements for engineering and security teams.
  
  
This role is based in Jakarta, Indonesia. You will help shaping Grab's Red Team and Threat Intel capabilities, and influence how we use AI and automation to scale offensive security work responsibly. If you enjoy building tools, testing assumptions, and helping defenders get sharper, we will give you the platform to make a regional impact.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* You will lead end-to-end red team operations, and intelligence-led Purple Team exercises with the Blue Team. These exercises will emulate realistic adversary behaviour across multiple environments, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, identity systems, endpoints, and applications.
* You will develop command-and-control tooling, implants, payload delivery mechanisms, and operator workflows for authorised security exercises.
* You will red team AI systems, including internal copilots, agentic workflows, AI-assisted operational tools, and MLOps environments.
* You will use AI tools to improve research, automation, payload development, reporting, operational planning, and analysis of defensive coverage.
* You will translate red team findings and threat intelligence into clear engineering actions. You will partner with defenders, platform teams, and the Vulnerability Management team to improve detection, response, hardening, security architecture, and risk prioritisation.
* You will work with other team members on offensive security tradecraft, tool development, operational safety, documentation, and responsible execution of adversary simulations.
* You will contribute to the Red Team and Threat Intel roadmap. Your contributions will involve identifying the latest attack techniques and evaluating new tooling.
* You will produce Threat Intel assessments from security incidents observed in the wild or improvement opportunities identified internally. Additionally, you will advise leadership on likely impact, priority, and next actions.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* Min. Bachelor's degree
* You will have 4 or more years of experience in offensive security, red teaming, security engineering, exploit development, cloud security, or adjacent technical security roles.
* You will have hands-on experience developing command-and-control tooling, implants, loaders, payloads, or offensive automation.
* You will have practical experience assessing CI/CD systems, source control platforms, build pipelines, artefact repositories, secrets handling, and deployment workflows.
* You will have firm knowledge of cloud environments, including identity, networking, logging, container platforms, and common privilege escalation paths.
* You will have experience assessing AI-enabled products, internal AI platforms, or agentic systems in adversarial scenarios, and using AI tools to improve security research, workflows, and output quality.
* You will have experience producing or using Threat Intel to connect external incident trends, adversary tradecraft, and internal security signals to practical security decisions.
* Knowledge of the major 3 operating systems (Windows/Linux/macOS), endpoint internals, enterprise management, and defensive controls would be an added value

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Lead Engineer (Platform & Infrastructure)
description:
**About Hadl**

Hadl is an AI lab building the future data products and services for biology, manufacturing and aquaculture. We build agentic systems, data and diagnostic tools for our industry partners, working with the leading companies in our industries of focus to change the fabric of how work and decisions are made tomorrow.

Our team are engineers, industry experts, computer vision scientists and data passionate people, with cornerstone products that help farmers, processors, and companies building technology at the edge of the frontier.

Our work sits at the intersection of biology, data, and real world operations. We move fast, test often, and focus on practical impact. You will work closely with engineers, biologists, and product teams to turn complex data into reliable systems.

We collaborate openly, learn continuously, and value ownership. No rigid hierarchies. Curious people solving hard problems together.

**About the Role**

We are building the future of seafood supply chains with an industry-leading seafood company. You will be developing and owning architecture, infrastructure, integrations and data models.

This is a hands-on role. You will write code, set the standards and problem solve, as one of a small team of senior builders shipping a platform that more companies can plug into without a rewrite.

**What You'll Do**

* Design and build the architecture and data model for a multi-client platform, with a full audit trail and each client's data kept separate.
* Build integrations with the systems a business already runs, connecting before replacing, with clear error handling and alerting. No silent failures.
* Build roadmap features from design through to production.
* Own the infrastructure: cloud environments, CI/CD, networking, access control, security, monitoring and backups.
* Mentor and learn alongside passionate colleagues, and document what you build so the work never depends on one person.

**What We're Looking For**

* 4+ years of software engineering, building and shipping production systems.
* Experience designing, building and running production systems end to end: architecture, data model, deployment and operations.
* Strong in a typed backend language (TypeScript, Go or Python) and in SQL with PostgreSQL or similar.
* Experience building integrations with third-party systems through APIs, webhooks or file exchange.
* Experience owning cloud infrastructure on GCP or AWS: environments, CI/CD, containers, monitoring, security and access.
* Experience with multi-tenant design and audit trails.
* High standards for code quality, testing and review, including AI-assisted code.
* Fluent written and spoken English, and able to explain technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical people.
* Able to work from Surabaya for up to 2 weeks in every 6.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in supply chain, logistics, retail or fintech.
* Shipped LLM-based features to production.
* Infrastructure as code (for example Terraform).
* Client-facing, consulting or agency experience.
* Fluent Bahasa Indonesia.

**What We Offer**

* Technical ownership of a new platform from day one.
* Real operations, real data, and users who rely on what you build every day.
* A small team of senior builders, with no layers between you and the problem.
* Fast iteration and direct impact on how an entire sector works.
* Equity participation for the right candidate.

Salary: 15 to 40 million IDR per month

Equity: Available

Role: Full time

Location: Kuningan, Jakarta, with up to 2 weeks in Surabaya every 6 weeks (travel and accommodation covered)

title: Sr. Backend Engineer I - US Stocks
description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
  
  
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Sr. Backend Engineer I in the US Stocks team, you build and maintain the backend services that let Indonesian investors trade US stocks: orders, balances, market data, portfolio and corporate actions. You deliver well-defined features with high quality, grow quickly in system design, and help keep the platform accurate and reliable, including during US market hours. This role is designed for growth. You will be closely mentored by Tech Leads and Staff Engineers, with a clear trajectory toward Senior II, taking on increasingly complex architectural challenges and cross-team influence.
  
  

* Design, build and maintain backend services and APIs for US stock trading, funding and portfolio features
* Deliver features from technical design to production, with tests, monitoring and alerting
* Integrate with US brokerage and custody partners, and make those integrations handle failures, delays and duplicate messages safely
* Make sure money, quantities, prices and currency conversion are handled accurately, with clear audit trails
* Support reconciliation between our records and our partners' records, and help fix mismatches at the root
* Write clean, well-tested code and take an active part in code reviews
* Investigate production issues, find root causes and help ship lasting fixes
* Work with Product, Operations and Compliance to turn requirements into reliable solutions
* Learn to build and scale Smart Order Routing (SOR) logic, integrating with multiple Liquidity Providers (e.g., Alpaca) and handling complex order lifecycles and partial fills across different venues
* Handle real-time market data streaming and manage strict rate limits across concurrent external partner APIs

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Experience: 4+ years of professional backend engineering, including running services in production
* Languages: Strong in Java or Go
* System Design: Good understanding of microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven design and reliability basics
* Data & Messaging: Hands-on with relational databases (query tuning), caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka)
* Infrastructure: Experience with cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), containers and CI/CD
* Mindset & Domain: Ownership mindset and clear communication. Experience in brokerage, trading, payments, cross-border money movement or another regulated environment is a strong plus
* A fierce appetite for learning complex domain logic. Familiarity with modern API-first brokerages (e.g., Alpaca, DriveWealth) or the FIX protocol is a plus, but a proven ability to learn these systems quickly is required

**Benefits**

* Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
* Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
* Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger
* Learning & Development - Company-sponsored training, courses, and professional certifications
* Hybrid Work Arrangement - Enjoy the flexibility of working both remotely and from the office
* Career Growth - Work closely with experienced leaders and take on meaningful ownership as we scale
* Employee Perks - Enjoy exclusive discounts, partnerships, and lifestyle perks
* Collaborative & High-Ownership Culture - Work with smart, driven people in cross-functional teams, take ownership, and make a meaningful impact for our users

* Conducting a service satisfaction survey.

* *Facilitate and work closely with resource acquisition team providing the technical rigor and using evidence base for proposal development and project activities in the area of office building, asset and security.*

* Improving the capacity of the office building team at the national office in office safety management in accordance with global standards.

* Experience coordinating with security, janitorial, maintenance, and other outsourced service providers.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and computerized reporting systems.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and customer service orientation.
* Ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders and manage multiple operational tasks.
Willingness to be based at the National Office and support organizational events and operational requirements.

Local Applicants Only

title: Welding Engineer
description:
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

  

**Welder Performance**: Prepare, maintain, and update welder performance records under the guidance of the Senior Welding Engineer and Management Team.

  

**Welder Competency Management**: Develop, maintain, and monitor welder competency matrix including certifications and qualifications.

**Welder Performance Monitoring**: Monitor welding quality metrics (e.g., rejection/repair rates, NDT results), ensure adherence to WPS requirements and good welding practices, and identify improvement actions. Support training and implementation of corrective actions arising from root cause analysis (RCA).

  

**Training & Qualification**: Plan and conduct welder training, qualification tests (WQT), and recertification programs.

**Compliance & Standards**: At weld shop, ensure adherence to applicable welding codes (e.g., ASME, AWS, ISO) and internal QMS.

  

**Consumables:** Ensure consumables storage, handling and use is always as per standards and procedures.

  

**Welding equipment:** Ensure appropriate welding equipment are used for the job and are well maintained, including calibration.

  

**Inspection & Quality Coordination**: Work with QA/QC and NDT teams to ensure weld quality and inspection is in conformance with requirements.

  

**Weld Eye System Management:** Support migration of legacy WPS and PQR documents into Weld Eye and assist with data entry and system updates.

  

**Project Welding Support**: Review project requirements and ensure qualified welders, WPS, welding machines, correct consumables and materials are assigned accordingly. Assist with expanding capacity to meet project requirements.

  

**Continuous Improvement**: Identify and implement improvements in welding processes, consumables, and techniques.

  

**Documentation & Records**: Maintain accurate welding records, traceability, and documentation in compliance with ISO requirements.

  

**Quality Meetings & RCA**: Participate in weld quality meetings and support root cause analysis using tools such as 5 Whys and Fishbone Diagrams.

  

**Technical Reporting:** Prepare technical reports on welding performance, quality improvements, and preventive maintenance activities.

  

**Additional Duties:** Perform other duties as assigned by the Senior Welding Engineer or Management, including participation in supplier audits and qualification activities.

  

**Audit Participation**: Participate in internal, client, API, and third-party audits as required.

  

Ensure compliance with OIL STATES INDUSTRIES HSE Policies and HSE Management System.

  

Ensure compliance with OIL STATES INDUSTRIES Quality Policies and Quality Management System.

  

**Part 3: Qualification Requirements**

**Formal Education & Certification**

  

Degree or Diploma in Engineering or equivalent discipline.

Professional certifications (e.g., CSWIP, AWS, IWE, IWT) are preferred.

**Knowledge & Experience**

Minimum 2 years of experience as a Welding Engineer.

Proven track record as a Welding Engineer.

Minimum 1 years of experience working in a Manufacturing environment, preferably in the Oil & Gas Industry.

Minimum **2–5 years of experience** in welding engineering or fabrication environment

Strong knowledge of welding processes (SMAW, GTAW, GMAW, FCAW, SAW, Hot wire TIGetc.).

Experience with welding codes and standards (ASME, AWS, ISO).

Hands-on experience in welder qualification (WQT), WPS/PQR development.

Familiarity with NDT methods (RT, UT, PT, MT).

Applied knowledge of welding activities for all types of steels including carbon steel, stainless steel, high and low alloy steel.

Knowledge of international codes such as API 1104, API 5L, API 6A, API 16A, API 16R, API 16C, ASME sect IX and AWS D1.1.

Experience with welding management systems (e.g., **Weld Eye**) is an advantage

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and training skills.

**Personal Attributes**

Strong English written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work under pressure while maintaining high quality standards.

Capable of working independently with minimal supervision as well as in a team environment.

Detail-oriented with strong organizational and documentation skills.

description:
At
**Acclime**
, technology is at the heart of how we deliver exceptional professional services across Asia Pacific. As we continue to strengthen our digital capabilities, we are looking for a passionate
**Cybersecurity Engineer**
to join our regional Technology team based in Jakarta.

In this role, you will help protect our global technology landscape by designing, implementing, and operating enterprise cybersecurity solutions across cloud and on-premise environments. Working closely with colleagues across multiple countries, you will play a key role in safeguarding our business, enabling secure digital transformation, and strengthening cyber resilience throughout the region.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Monitor daily security operations and respond to emerging cyber threats.
* Configure, manage, and optimize enterprise security technologies, including Endpoint Security, Firewalls, ZTNA/SASE, WAF, DLP, Cloud Security, and AI Security controls.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, security audits, and coordinate penetration testing activities.
* Investigate and respond to cybersecurity incidents while driving continuous improvements to detection and response capabilities.
* Support the implementation of cybersecurity governance, risk management, and compliance initiatives.
* Develop and maintain cybersecurity documentation, standards, and operational procedures.
* Promote security awareness and cybersecurity best practices across the organization.
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to implement consistent security controls and support Acclime's Cybersecurity Strategy.
* Demonstrated experience in secure software development, secure coding, and DevSecOps environments.
* Strong understanding of AI-related security risks, including data leakage, prompt injection, model poisoning, unauthorized access, and AI governance requirements.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
* At least
  **3 years of international experience**

* Endpoint Security
* Firewall Administration
* ZTNA / SASE
* WAF & DLP
* SIEM Platforms
* Cloud Security (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud)
* Identity & Access Management (IAM)
* Good understanding of Network Security, Cloud Security, Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Risk Management, Compliance, and AI Security.

* Experience working in multinational or regional organizations will be highly regarded.

* CEH
* OSCP
* CPT
* CCSK
* Cloud+
* GCSA
* CCSP
* AWS Certified Security – Specialty

title: Security Operations Lead
description:
We're looking for a
**Security Operations Lead**
to strengthen and lead our security operations capabilities at Stockbit & Bibit.
  
  
In this role, you'll take ownership of our security operations function, driving proactive threat detection, vulnerability management, and incident response while building and developing a high-performing security team.
  
  
You'll work closely with Engineering, Infrastructure, and other stakeholders to strengthen our security posture, improve operational resilience, and ensure our systems remain protected against evolving cyber threats.
  
  
If you're passionate about cybersecurity, enjoy solving complex security challenges, and have the leadership mindset to build and scale security operations, we'd love to hear from you!
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Security Operations Leadership & Team Development
* Lead, mentor, and develop the security operations team, establishing clear priorities, responsibilities, and performance expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement of security operations capabilities, processes, and overall team effectiveness.
* Provide technical guidance, coaching, and resource prioritization to ensure effective execution of security initiatives.
* Vulnerability Management
* Own the end-to-end vulnerability management lifecycle, from assessment and risk-based prioritization to remediation tracking and validation.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Infrastructure, and application owners to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed based on severity, exploitability, and business impact.
* Monitor vulnerability exposure and remediation progress, escalating critical risks and overdue remediation when necessary.
* Security Monitoring & Threat Detection
* Oversee security monitoring and detection capabilities across endpoints, networks, identities, applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments.
* Enhance threat detection through SIEM and EDR/XDR optimization, threat hunting, threat intelligence, and detection engineering.
* Identify security visibility gaps and continuously improve monitoring coverage, alert quality, and investigation capabilities.
* Incident Response
* Lead the response to significant security incidents, covering investigation, containment, remediation, recovery, and root cause analysis.
* Establish and maintain incident response procedures, playbooks, escalation paths, and communication protocols.
* Conduct post-incident reviews and ensure corrective actions are implemented to prevent recurrence.
* Security Processes, Automation & Reporting
* Establish and optimize security operations procedures, automation, and workflows to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Define and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure security operations effectiveness, incident response performance, and vulnerability remediation progress.
* Provide management with clear reporting on security incidents, vulnerability exposure, operational performance, and improvement priorities.

What We're Looking For
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity, with substantial hands-on experience in security operations, vulnerability management, incident response, or threat detection.
* Proven experience leading security operations activities, managing security risks, and coordinating cross-functional remediation efforts.
* Practical knowledge of vulnerability assessment, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, and validation.
* Strong technical understanding of SIEM, EDR/XDR, security monitoring, detection engineering, and incident response methodologies.
* Solid understanding of threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, common attack techniques, and security investigation practices.
* Experience improving security operations through process optimization, automation, threat hunting, or detection tuning.
* Strong leadership, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to prioritize risks and make decisions under pressure.

Nice to Have
  
  

* Experience leading a security operations team within technology, fintech, financial services, or other mission-critical environments.
* Experience with security monitoring and vulnerability management in GCP or AWS environments.
* Familiarity with SOAR platforms, security automation, and incident response orchestration.
* Experience in digital forensics, malware analysis, or advanced threat hunting.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCFA, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Customer Service Analyst
description:
**Customer Service Analyst**
============================

**Date:** Nov 3, 2026

**Location:** Kab. Bogor, ID, 16912

**Company:** Perfetti Van Melle

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**
--------------------

The **Customer Service Analyst** is responsible for supporting the business in delivering targeted service to customers through order processing, identifying issues, and providing timely resolutions to ensure customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

  

* **Ensure accurate and timely sales order processing:**
  + Process customer orders accurately and in a timely manner according to established guidelines.
  + Analyze order reasons and loss reasons and escalate issues when needed for resolution

* **Coordinate with internal team to support order fulfillment:**
  + Liaise with Sales teams regarding order fulfillment, pending issues, and other service-related matters.
  + Coordinate with Logistics, Finance, and Planning to ensure smooth processes and execution.

* **Support process and operational improvements:**
  + Contribute to projects and support the delivery of project goals and cost-to-serve initiatives.
  + Continuously improve the effectiveness of daily operations, including administration, order management, and communication processes.

* **Manage reporting and information accuracy:**
  + Provide scheduled reports through SAP data extraction and Excel updates.
  + Monitor and ensure the validity of information related to SKUs, customers, and planning updates.

* **Ensure compliance with established processes:**
  + Execute processes according to applicable compliance requirements, including Order Validation, Release Timing, Requested Arrival Dates, and reverse logistics.
  + Escalate non-compliant processes when required and support CAPA execution and sustainability.
  + Facilitate the development of SOPs and Work Instructions (WI) to standardize new and existing processes.

**OUR PERFECT CANDIDATE**
-------------------------

* Minimum 1 year of work experience in a similar or relevant position.
* Bachelor’s degree in Management, Engineering, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication skills, including negotiation, influencing, presentation, active listening, feedback and clarity.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a cross-functional environment and build effective stakeholder relationships.
* Good understanding of project management, business financials, and operational processes.

description:
**Who We Are Is What We Do.**
Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.
  
  
Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.
  
  
**Why should you be part of our success story?**
As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.
  
  
Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator's top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.
  
  
Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.
  
  
We are seeking an Information Security Engineer to serve as a technical leader in designing, implementing, and optimizing our core security platforms. This role is crucial for advancing our defense-in-depth capabilities, ensuring adherence to global regulatory frameworks, and protecting sensitive data within our remote-first, global environment. The ideal candidate will own the entire lifecycle of multiple security solutions, translating best practices and compliance requirements into actionable technical controls.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) tools/process including optimizing configurations/policies, developing custom threat detection rules, and proactively improving Deel’s overall security posture for remote endpoints (Mac and Windows) and cloud assets (Eg, VMs).
* Configure, manage, and tune the full suite of security policies within SWG, CASB and ZTNA. Assist our remote colleague with seamless experience through troubleshooting end user issues as needed.
* Continuously improve SaaS security posture with SSPM tools and processes around it. Collaborate with diverse application owners, understand security control and resolve configuration drifts for our wide range of SaaS applications from baseline.
* Develop a rigorous review, approval, policy enforcement and auditing for browser extensions, third party OAuth applications for SaaS applications such as Google Workspace, GitHub, Jira etc to meet security and privacy standards.
* Design, implement, and audit security policies related to enterprise browsers (Eg, Island, Chrome Enterprise etc) including controlling access to sensitive web apps, and data loss prevention (DLP) configuration, ZTNA, secure web browsing experience but not limited to.
* implement and manage DLP policies across Endpoint, Network, SaaS Applications and Cloud assets, directly supporting the "Crawl-Walk-Run" program phases. Ensure DLP policies meet diverse data sovereignty, privacy (GDPR, CCPA, etc.), and national regulatory requirements.
* Run vulnerability management programs for endpoints and servers and ensure they are patched according to the policy in collaboration with stakeholders.

**Job Requirements**

* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity
* Handson experience with security tools like EDR, SWG, CASB, ZTNA, SSPM and DLP
* Experience managing technical vulnerability of OS and applications for endpoints using tools like CrowdStrike Spotlight, InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and best practices, such as MITRE, NIST, CIS, ISO27001, SOC and others.
* Experience in collaborating with internal stakeholders to rollout enterprise security solutions.
* Understanding and having the ability to utilize Cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure to host security tooling. Having experience in utilizing SIEM to query security telemetry is a plus.
* Experience managing secure email gateway is a plus.
* Excellent English in both verbal and written.
* On call schedule for weekends, activates for P1s.

**Advantages**

* CISSP, and AWS/GCP cloud engineer (associate/professional)

**Total Rewards**
Our workforce deserves fair and competitive pay that meets them where they are. With scalable benefits, rewards, and perks, our total rewards programs reflect our commitment to inclusivity and access for all.
  
  

* Our salary range reflects gross base salary. For commercial roles with commission eligibility, this figure represents On-Target Earnings (OTE), inclusive of base salary and target commission.
* Salary ranges are quoted in USD as a consistent global reference. Your offer will be localized to your country's currency using a market-aligned conversion.
* Final pay is based on objective, job-related criteria including experience, skills, and location.
* We don't ask about salary history. Offers are based on the role and what you bring to it.

**Some things you'll enjoy**

* Stock grant opportunities dependent on your role, employment status and location
* Additional perks and benefits based on your employment status and country
* Optional flexible working office membership, with IWG

At Deel, we're an equal-opportunity employer that values diversity and positively encourage applications from suitably qualified and eligible candidates regardless of race, religion, sex, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, pregnancy or maternity or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

*deel.com*
*and other acquired company emails like @*
*payspace.com*
*and @*
*paygroup.com*
*. You can view the most up-to-date job listings at Deel by visiting*
*our careers page*
*.*
Deel welcomes persons with disabilities to apply to any of our open roles. We will provide application and/or interview accommodations on request throughout the recruitment, selection and assessment process for applicants with disabilities or other needs. If you require application and/or interview accommodations, please inform our Talent Acquisition Team via email (recruiting@deel.com) and a team member will be in touch to ensure your equal participation.
  
  
As part of our hiring process, we primarily rely on interviews and role-related assessments. In limited cases, we may also consider informal background information relevant to the role, in line with our privacy and fairness obligations.
  
  
This application process may utilise Automated Employment Decision Tools (AEDT) and AI systems to assist in evaluating candidates based on experience level, technical skills and qualifications. This processing is conducted in compliance with applicable Data Protection, AI Governance and Labour Laws. We ensure human oversight is maintained in all final hiring decisions. title: Unity Software Engineer
description:
**Who are we?**
**Tripledot**
**Studios**
is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world.
  
  
We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios.
  
  
Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users.
  
  
Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others.
  
  
We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who
**LOVE**
making games.
  
  
Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**The role is working within our studio: Ludios**
**About Ludios**
Ludios takes its name from the Latin, it means "The Game People". Led by Eyal, one of the co-founders of Tripledot Studios, and some of the most experienced people in mobile games, we are a studio that makes and publishes our own casual, free-to-play mobile games. Our team is based across APAC, with the majority of our development happening in Jakarta and Melbourne. We are data-driven, creative, and genuinely passionate about the industry we work in. Right now, we are working on a number of exciting projects, including one built around a globally recognised IP, alongside several original titles we are equally excited about. If crafting games and reaching millions of players is what gets you out of bed, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a Unity Software Engineer to join our team!
  
  
At Tripledot we work collaboratively in a productive, Agile team environment. You will be working primarily in Unity, collaborating with our product and design team to add new and exciting game features, build tools and help to maintain good health of the game on both IOS and Android.
  
  

* Implement gameplay features in Unity.
* Develop new titles, features and support live operations.
* Optimize code & memory for high performance on iOS and Android.
* Design and plan architecture, implement maintainable code.
* Review code and write unit tests..

**Required Skills, Knowledge And Expertise**

* Strong architectural, design pattern and OOP experience. Understanding of SOLID Principles is a must.
* At least 5+ years of experience working with Unity and C# as a programmer
* A “Can Do” mentality that drives improvement and meeting deadlines.
* Strong mobile gaming and liveops system background is a plus.
* Experience with prototyping but also extending a large legacy project.
* Experience with Deep Profiler, Frame Debugger, Memory Profiler.
* Experience with Unity UI and gameplay programming.
* Experience with Git or other source control systems.
* Experience in working with existing code bases.
* Experience with GLSL/HLSL and ShaderGraph is a plus.
* Excellent English skills, both written and verbal

Working at Tripledot
  
  

* Hybrid Working: We work in the office 4 days a week, Monday to Thursday.
* 20 days fully remote working: Work from anywhere in the world, 20 days of the year.
* Regular company events and rewards: Join in regular events and rewards that celebrate cultural events, our achievements and our team spirit.
* Breakfast & Lunch: Relish daily provided breakfast and lunch to keep you fueled and focused.
* BPJS HEALTH: Elevate your well-being and peace of mind, ensuring robust health security with seamless enrolment in BPJS Health!
* BPJS SOCIAL: Secure your employment rights with BPJS Social.
* Festivity Allowance: Celebrate festive occasions with an additional festive allowance.
* Health Insurance: Stay covered with comprehensive health insurance for you and your loved ones.
* Employee Assistance Program: Anytime you need it, tap into confidential, caring support with our Employee Assistance Program, always here to lend an ear and a helping hand.

title: Senior Android Engineer II - Platform
description:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.
  
  
To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
As a Senior Android Engineer II in the Platform team, you build the Android foundations that every Ajaib product team builds on: the app architecture, design system, shared libraries and SDKs, secure sign-in and device security, and the build and release tooling. You own these foundations from design to release, treat other engineers as your customers, and help the engineers around you do better work.
  
  

* Design, build and maintain shared Android foundations: app architecture, modules, design system and shared libraries
* Own features end to end: technical design, implementation, testing, release and support for the teams that use them
* Keep shared libraries stable: clear APIs, semantic versioning, changelogs, migration guides and safe deprecation
* Build accessible, themeable Jetpack Compose components that product teams can adopt without custom work
* Build and improve secure sign-in, token storage, biometric and device security features, working with backend and Security teams
* Improve build speed, modularization, CI/CD pipelines and release automation for all Android teams
* Set and measure quality standards, such as crash-free rate, ANR rate, startup time and app size
* Write maintainable, well-tested code and give thoughtful code reviews
* Investigate production issues from crash reports and feedback from product teams, and ship lasting fixes
* Mentor mid-level engineers and share good Android practices across teams

**Requirements**

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience
* Experience: 5+ years of professional mobile engineering, including building shared libraries, SDKs or tooling used by several teams in consumer Android apps with a large user base
* Languages & Frameworks: Strong in Kotlin and the Android SDK; experience with Jetpack Compose, Coroutines/Flow and modern architecture patterns (MVVM, clean architecture)
* Architecture & Tooling: Experience with multi-module apps, Gradle, build performance and library publishing
* Quality: Solid experience with unit and UI testing, CI/CD, crash monitoring and performance profiling
* Security: Working knowledge of secure storage, authentication on mobile and device security
* Mindset: Ownership mindset, clear communication and a service attitude toward internal users. Experience in fintech or another regulated, high-traffic consumer product is a plus

**Benefits**

* Performance Bonus - Get rewarded for the impact you make
* Private Insurance - Comprehensive health coverage for you
* Paid Time Off - Take the time you need to recharge and come back stronger

title: Senior Data Engineer (Azure, Databricks & MLOps)
description:
Ben jij een Senior Data Engineer die complexe datavragen oplost, moderne cloud-data-platformen, data-en ML pijplijnen bouwt én het voortouw neemt bij klanten en teams?
  
  
Dit bieden wij jou
  
  

* Een senior rol met inhoudelijk invloed en verantwoordelijkheid:
* Een salaris passend bij je ervaring en rol
* Een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur
* 24 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband met de mogelijkheid om 6 dagen (naar rato) bij te kopen;
* Hybride werken met veel flexibiliteit in werkplek en -tijden
* Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden via o.a. de VINCI Energies Academy, het Axians Institute en online leerplatforms.
* Doorgroeimogelijkheden richting bijvoorbeeld lead consultant, business consultant of strategisch adviseur
* Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, laptop en smartphone
* Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, waaronder pensioenregeling en aandelenprogramma
* Een open, inclusieve en collegiale werkomgeving

Hier krijg jij energie van
  
  
Als Senior Data Engineer bij Axians werk je aan het ontwerpen, bouwen en optimaliseren van schaalbare data‑ en ML‑platformen voor klanten binnen onder andere de financiële sector én de publieke sector. Je werkt in multidisciplinaire teams samen met collega‑engineers, data scientists, analisten en stakeholders aan uitdagende datavraagstukken.
  
  
Je combineert diepgaande technische kennis met een leidende rol: je helpt klanten en collega’s vooruit door richting te geven, best practices te introduceren en inhoudelijk het voortouw te nemen in ontwerp- en implementatiekeuzes.
  
  
Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:
  
  

* Het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van schaalbare data pipelines en ML‑pijplijnen op productieniveau
* Het modelleren en structureren van data voor analytics en reporting
* Het bouwen, optimaliseren en doorontwikkelen van data‑platformen in de cloud
* Het integreren van verschillende databronnen in robuuste architecturen
* Het verbeteren van datakwaliteit, performance en betrouwbaarheid
* Het adviseren van klanten over data‑architectuur, modellering en best practices
* Het bouwen en onderhouden van ML‑workflows, inclusief training, validatie, deployment en monitoring
* Het toepassen van CI/CD en automatisering voor data‑ en ML‑workflows
* Het actief meenemen en coachen van collega’s en klantteams in technische keuzes en werkwijzen

Je maakt daarbij gebruik van moderne data‑engineering tooling en cloudomgevingen zoals Azure, Databricks en (waar relevant) Snowflake.
  
  
Technologie & stack
  
  
Je werkt onder andere met:
  
  

* Databricks (PySpark en SQL), inclusief Databricks voor ML‑workloads
* Python (gedegen programmeervaardigheden) en SQL (complexe queries en performance‑optimalisatie)
* Spark of vergelijkbare grootschalige verwerkingsframeworks
* ML‑experimenttracking en modelbeheer (bijv. MLflow of gelijkwaardig)
* Azure Data Factory voor orkestratie en integratie
* dbt voor transformeren en modelleren van data volgens software‑engineering best practices
* CI/CD, Git en DevOps‑principes voor data‑ en ML‑workflows
* Datamodellering en architectuurprincipes zoals Kimball en Data Vault
* Cloudomgevingen zoals Azure (ervaring met AWS of GCP is ook waardevol)

Hier herken jij jezelf in
  
  

* Senior ervaring als Data Engineer
* Sterke kennis van data‑ én ML‑pijplijnen in productie
* Goede beheersing van AI/ML‑fundamenten
* Ervaring met het implementeren van ML‑modellen in cloudomgevingen
* Je kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen aan zowel engineers als business stakeholders
* Je neemt eigenaarschap en pakt een leidende rol in de verdere ontwikkeling van de onderwerpen in onze Business Unit en onze klant
* Ervaring in de financiële sector is een pré
* Ervaring in de publieke sector is eveneens zeer welkom
* HBO of WO werk-‑ en denkniveau
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal

Dit is jouw team
  
  
Axians is een internationale netwerkorganisatie bestaande uit gespecialiseerde en zelfsturende IT units. In deze rol ga je aan de slag voor het expertisegebied Data & AI. Binnen Data & AI zijn 5 Business Units actief die elk verschillende marktsegmenten bedienen en verschillende proposities hebben.
  
  
De engineers die binnen het expertisegebied Data & AI werken, hebben elk hun eigen specialisme en standplaats. Als engineer werk je nauw samen in een multidisciplinair team bestaande uit zowel klant als directe collega's. In deze rol is jouw standplaats de Business Unit in Laren (NH), maar uiteraard krijg jij alle ruimte om jouw werkweek en werklocatie zelf in te delen.
  
  
*Over Business Data & AI in Laren*
De Axians locatie in Laren (NH) is gespecialiseerd in Data & AI. Met zo’n 40 collega’s werken we samen om onze klanten te helpen en adviseren met hun datavraagstukken. Onze klanten zijn grote, innovatieve organisaties als ABN AMRO verzekeringen, Stichting Philadelphia zorg, Zeeman en PGGM. Onze werkwijze is gebaseerd op onze Axians kernwaarden: autonomie, verantwoordelijkheid, ondernemerschap, vertrouwen & transparantie en solidariteit.
  
  
*Betrokkenheid en een goede werksfeer*
De Business Unit bestaat uit betrokken collega's die ook een gezellige werksfeer belangrijk vinden. We vieren onze successen en helpen elkaar door mindere periodes heen. Regelmatig worden er borrels, uitjes met collega's en andere leuke activiteiten georganiseerd.
  
  
*Leren en ontwikkelen*
We kijken naar wat je al kan, maar ook wat je nog kan leren. We zijn er namelijk van overtuigd dat de juiste omgeving jou in staat stelt om alles uit jezelf te halen. En daar helpen we je bij. Want groeien doe je samen. Onze slogan is hier treffend; ICT with a Human Touch.

title: Oracle Administrator
description:
**SoftwareSeni** is a Software Development Company based in Yogyakarta & Sydney, Australia. We have been designing and developing phone apps, websites, and mobile experiences. We love solving tough problems – from user experience to design and code. We build enterprise web-based solutions for clients all over the world, from Australia, Indonesia, Europe, Africa, and America. Our clients from Indonesia: Astra International, Traveloka, Angkasa Pura, and Peduli Anak Foundation. Our clients from Australia: Bike Exchange, Downsizing, Red Balloon, Sectara, and many more.

**What will you get?**

**Competitive Salary**. We believe that salary is one of the main factors that keep employees in the company, therefore, we can guarantee a competitive salary for our Staff.

**Career Development & Training**. We have a wonderful onboarding process where we help new team members get familiar with how we work.

**Reasonable & Flexible Schedules**. We are encouraging a culture where people can have a good work-life balance. Our schedules are pretty flexible. Need to run an errand in the middle of the day? Totally cool.

**English Class**. Working in SoftwareSeni means that you will get massive improvement in your English, both spoken and written, guaranteed!

**Annual Leave Entitlement**. 12 working days, which can be taken after 3 months of joining.

**Performance Review**. We will review your performance twice annually in December and June. So, you can focus on your work and improve your performance every day.

**Relocation Allowance**. We provide a relocation allowance if you do not live in Yogyakarta. The allowance will cover moving costs for you and your family.

**Staff Engagement Activities**. We provide fun icebreaker activities in the middle of our working hours to chill and build relationships with all the staff. Sounds fun, right?

**Birthday Leave**. We also want to celebrate our staff's happiest day by giving them a half-day leave on their birthday.

**Requirements**:

* Minimum 3 years of experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud administration, application support, IT helpdesk, or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience administering Oracle Fusion Cloud across HCM, ERP, and Finance modules is preferred.
* Experience providing first-level application or IT helpdesk support in an enterprise environment.
* Experience managing Oracle security, user access, roles, permissions, and identity management (including SSO).
* Experience coordinating Oracle quarterly updates, regression testing, production deployments and post-release validation is preferred.
* Experience using ticketing systems and managing requests within agreed service levels (SLAs).
* Experience liaising with Oracle Support, implementation partners, or external vendors is an advantage.
* Familiarity with automation tools and workflows to reduce manual processing and improve operational efficiency is a plus.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
* Knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud configuration, environment management, and release management.
* Understanding of Oracle security model, including roles, permissions and data access.
* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, user account management, devices, printers and connectivity troubleshooting.
* Understanding of IT service management practices such as incident, request, and change management (ITIL Foundation is an advantage).
* Oracle Cloud certification (HCM, ERP or Financials) is an advantage.

**Responsibilities**:

Oracle Platform Administration

* Administer Oracle Fusion Cloud environments across HCM, ERP, and Finance, including configuration and routine application administration.
* Maintain configuration standards, administration procedures and platform documentation.
* Monitor platform issues, risks and control concerns, and coordinate resolution with the relevant functional or technical teams.

Release & Environment Management

* Coordinate Oracle quarterly updates, release schedules, and related implementation activities.
* Support regression testing with functional administrators and business users, and track defects through to resolution.
* Coordinate production deployments, perform post-release validation, and maintain release and change-control documentation.

Helpdesk & User Access Support

* Provide first-level support for Oracle, Microsoft 365, user accounts, devices, printers, connectivity, and standard business applications.
* Triage, troubleshoot, and manage incidents and service requests, escalating complex issues to IT teams, functional administrators, or vendors.
* Handle user onboarding/offboarding, password resets, Single Sign-On, application access and permission changes.
* Maintain accurate ticket records and ensure requests are resolved within agreed service levels.

Enterprise Support & Automation

* Work with HCM, Finance and ERP functional administrators to investigate application issues and support root-cause analysis.
* Liaise with Oracle Support, implementation partners and integration providers to resolve complex issues.
* Assist in designing, implementing, and maintaining automation solutions to reduce manual work.
* Support the handover of new functionality, system changes, and automations into day-to-day operations.

* **Note: This position requires fluency in English, as most communication will be conducted in English. If you're confident (or eager to grow) in using English at work, this position could be a great fit.**

**Disclaimer**: By submitting your application, you consent to PT Software Services Indonesia collecting and processing your information for recruitment purposes. **Please submit only your CV/resume at this stage; do not attach additional personal identification or sensitive documents**. Your details will be treated with strict confidentiality and used solely to evaluate your application for current or future employment opportunities with us.

description:

**About UOB**
United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in ASEAN with a global network in Southeast Asia, Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. Operating through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, we have a global network of about 430 branches and offices in 19 markets. At the heart of UOB is our culture, shaped by the UOB Way and anchored on our four values – Honourable, Enterprising, United and Committed. For more than 90 years, these values have guided how we do right by our customers, collaborate with one another and create long-term value for the communities we operate in. As One Bank, we are committed to helping our colleagues build sustainable careers grounded in purpose, supported by strong values, and enriched with meaningful opportunities to grow.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**

* Responsible for developing, maintaining, and validation of IFRS9 models to support credit risk and performance management across the regional markets.
* Partner with regional credit risk modelers to drive model validation & model development; and provide justification / explain the validation results to various stakeholders.
* Work closely with various stakeholders in Group and regional countries to support credit risk analytics for IFRS9 models usage and optimization.
* Keep up to date on changes to regulatory requirements and minimum standards of model development (Basel II, Basel IV, FRS9), including compliance to regulatory ethics standards (FEAT).
* Provide business requirement document, support UAT, and deployment of models, as well as datamart enhancement initiatives.
* Provide regular and ad-hoc analyses and reports to senior management, regulators, and other key stakeholders.
* Present models to senior management and stakeholders, obtain model signoffs, and where relevant, seek regulator’s approval for new models

**Requirements**

* > 8 years of experience in IFRS9 model development/validation, or similar analytic roles, preferably in a business banking (i.e. Retail SME) environment.
* Ability to clearly communicate technical model performance metrics in an easy-to-understand manner and tailoring them to different audiences
* Ability to handle multiple projects with minimal supervision.
* Team player who can work well with cross functional teams in Group and regionally, good communication skills (verbal and written) and self-motivated.
* Strong computing skills: SAS - Programming, Enterprise Guide, Enterprise Miner; SQL and database familiarity; MS Office applications, including advanced spreadsheet functionalities. Competency in R, Python and VBA will be an added advantage
* A good degree in Banking & Finance, Financial Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, or equivalent

Develop (Competency), Engage (Competency), Execute (Competency), Strategise (Competency)
  
  
Be a Part of the UOB Family

We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Full Stack Developer to join our team growing in tech. You will play a key role in driving the full software development life cycle, from conception and design to testing, deployment, and continuous improvement.

* **Documentation:** Write clean, structured, and comprehensive technical documentation for all developed systems.

* Solid experience with Back end frameworks and languages (e.g., Node.js, Python, or PHP).
* Experience building and managing databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB).

title: Principal AI Engineering Lead - ID26012
description:

We are looking for a hands-on Principal AI Engineering Lead to drive engineering transformation and guiding the adoption of defined and scalable AI engineering practices that improve delivery quality, security, maintainability, and team maturity across the Indonesian tech team, while leading the end-to-end engineering execution of automation workflows and mini apps within Aura, Acclime's AI-powered automation platform being deployed across 18 APAC markets.

This is not a traditional management role. You will need to hands-on with the code (writing and reviewing), design solutions, lead a team of developers, translate business processes into working software and can see the big picture and thrives in the details. You will bridge the gap between process analysts who understand the 'what' and developers who build the 'how.'

**Key Responsibilities**

Hands-On Technical Leadership

* Hands-on with the code — leading by example, not from the sidelines
* Leverage reusable AI engineering patterns, evaluation frameworks, model integration standards, and observability practices for production-grade AI solutions.
* Establish coding standards, review processes, and technical best practices across the team
* Embed secure-by-design and responsible AI practices across solution design, data handling, model usage, deployment, and ongoing operations.

Solution Design & Process Mapping

* Translate business process maps into technical specifications and system designs
* Work with process analysts to understand each mini-app workflow's business logic and edge cases
* Create technical documentation, decision records, and architecture diagrams
* Map dependencies between workflows and identify reusable components

* Partner closely with DevSecOps, QA, Product, and Project Management functions to improve release governance, engineering hygiene, dependency management, and delivery predictability.

Stakeholder & Business Translation

* Present technical progress, risks, and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
* Participate in programme committee meetings with clear, outcome-focused updates
* Convert business requirements into achievable technical roadmaps
* Support change management by explaining technical capabilities and limitations to country teams

Must Have

* 8+ years software engineering experience with at least 3 years in a technical lead or engineering manager role where you continued coding
* Proven experience leading enterprise-scale AI engineering initiatives, including AI solution design, experimentation, evaluation, integration, deployment, and support

* Strong engineering governance experience covering secure SDLC, code review practices, CI/CD, automated testing, environment management, release readiness, and operational support
* Working knowledge of AI/ML integration — prompt engineering, API orchestration, document AI/OCR, embedding models
* Experience with cloud platforms (Azure and GCP preferred)
* Track record of translating business processes into technical solutions in a services or enterprise context
* Demonstrated ability to lead and grow development teams (4-10 people)
* Strong communication skills — able to explain technical concepts to business stakeholders

Highly Desirable

* Experience in corporate services, professional services, or regulated industries across multiple markets
* Team transformational leadership experience is highly desirable, including engineering maturity uplift, operating model transformation, coaching, organisational change management, and adoption of new ways of working across distributed teams
* Experience implementing secure SDLC practices, application security controls, vulnerability management, cloud security governance, and DevSecOps operating models
* Experience with private equity-backed growth environments and delivery pace expectations
* Understanding of APAC business environments and multi-market deployment challenges

**Tech Stack You'll Work With**

* Automation: workflow orchestration platforms, custom integrations
* AI/ML: Azure AI Foundry, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini — multi-model approach
* Cloud: Microsoft Azure (primary)
* Data: Document AI, OCR pipelines, structured data extraction
* Tools: Git, CI/CD, project management tooling

**What Success Looks Like**

First 60 Days

* Complete an engineering maturity assessment covering software delivery, DevSecOps practices, AI governance, release management, and team operating model effectiveness
* Establish a transformation roadmap to guide adoption of newly developed engineering standards, quality assurance, security controls, and AI engineering governance
* Deep understanding of all active automation mini-app workflows and their business context
* Established working relationships with process analysts, project managers, and country stakeholders
* Shipping code and leading the team through at least one full sprint cycle

First 6 Months

* New development structure consistently adopted by the Indonesia-based engineering team with measurable improvements in delivery quality, engineering discipline, and release governance
* Production deployment of multiple automation workflows across target markets
* AI engineering standards established and adopted across Aura and future AI-enabled products
* Measurable improvement in team velocity and code quality

title: AI Systems Engineer
description:
**About Hadl**

Hadl is an AI lab building the future data products and services for biology, manufacturing and aquaculture. We build agentic systems, data and diagnostic tools for our industry partners, working with the leading companies in our industries of focus to change the fabric of how work and decisions are made tomorrow.

Our team are engineers, industry experts, computer vision scientists and data passionate people, with cornerstone products that help farmers, processors, and companies building technology at the edge of the frontier.

Our work sits at the intersection of biology, data, and real world operations. We move fast, test often, and focus on practical impact. You will work closely with engineers, biologists, and product teams to turn complex data into reliable systems.

We collaborate openly, learn continuously, and value ownership. No rigid hierarchies. Curious people solving hard problems together.

**About the Role**

We are building the future of seafood supply chains with an industry-leading seafood company. You will be developing and owning the AI layer: agents that watch operational data, email and documents, flag issues to the right person and draft actions for people to approve.

This is a hands-on role. You will write code, ship agents and problem solve, as one of a small team of senior builders. Agents propose and people approve until the error rate is proven, then we automate. Every agent you ship has an evaluation set, a measured error rate and a known cost.

**What You'll Do**

* Turn business problems into AI use cases with clear success measures.
* Build multi-step agents that monitor operations, flag risks and draft follow-ups for approval.
* Process email, documents and meeting records with LLMs: extraction, summaries and commitments logged for follow-up.
* Set up evaluation for every agent (test sets, error and approval rates, human review loops and regression checks) before it goes live.
* Build and run the AI infrastructure: model serving, LLM providers, vector stores and pipelines.
* Track quality, drift and cost in production, and report AI cost per use case.
* Connect agents to forecasts and data where they drive actions.
* Mentor and learn alongside passionate colleagues.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years of software or ML engineering, including agentic workflows running in production.
* Experience building multi-step agents: prompting, tool use, retrieval, structured output and human approval steps.
* Experience evaluating AI systems: test sets, error metrics, review loops and regression checks.
* Experience processing unstructured business data with LLMs: email, documents or transcripts.
* Strong Python, plus working SQL and a backend language such as TypeScript or Go.
* Experience running AI infrastructure in production, with cost and latency under control.
* Responsible handling of sensitive business data: access control, data separation and personal data.
* Fluent written and spoken English, and able to explain what a model can and can't do to non-technical users.
* Able to work from Surabaya for up to 2 weeks in every 6.

**Nice to Have**

* Forecasting or predictive models on business data.
* MLOps: model and prompt versioning, drift monitoring.
* Experience in supply chain, logistics or retail.
* Open-source or self-hosted models.
* Fluent Bahasa Indonesia.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of the AI layer of a new platform, from prototype to production.
* Real operational data and users who give feedback the same day.
* The latest AI models and tooling to build with.
* Fast iteration and learning cycles.
* Equity participation for the right candidate.

Salary: 12 to 40 million IDR per month

Equity: Available

Role: Full time

* Location: Kuningan, Jakarta, with up to 2 weeks in Surabaya every 6 weeks (travel and accommodation covered)

description:
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
  
  
The
**Senior Specialist, Business Insights & Analytics**
(BIA) is a strategic analytics partner supporting commercial, marketing, and omnichannel decision-making across priority therapeutic areas.
  
  
This role transforms complex internal and external data into
**clear, actionable insights**
that shape brand strategy, customer engagement, sales effectiveness, and business performance.
  
  
Acting as a
**data translator**
, the Senior Specialist BIA bridges business needs with analytics, data science, market research, and technology teams.
  
  
The role contributes actively to a
**data-driven culture**
, ensures alignment with global analytics frameworks, and may mentor junior analysts while collaborating within the international BIA community.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Business & Commercial Insights
* Analyze current and historical performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and risks across brands, campaigns, customers, and channels.
* Provide fact-based recommendations to support marketing strategy, sales execution, forecasting, and omnichannel effectiveness.
* Translate complex analytics into clear narratives tailored to senior and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Deliver ad-hoc analyses to support strategic and operational decision making.
* Performance Measurement & Reporting
* Contribute to the design of dashboards and standard reports tracking KPIs related to brand performance, sales force effectiveness, and customer engagement.
* Ensure consistency, equity, and robustness of KPIs across therapeutic areas and functions.
* Monitor campaign, brand, and omnichannel performance, highlighting insights and opportunities.
* Continuously improve reporting processes in collaboration with IT, global teams, and external partners.
* Advanced Analytics & Synthesis
* Leverage advanced analytics outputs (e.g. forecasting, segmentation, spend optimization) to enrich insights and recommendations.
* Partner closely with Data Science teams to contribute to or interpret predictive models when relevant.
* Support business planning and forecasting accuracy through analytical input and scenario analysis.
* Identify and integrate new data sources such as primary or secondary Market Research.
* Partner with IT, Data Stewards, and external providers to ensure data quality, integrity, and governance.
* Support compliant data usage in line with local and global policies (e.g. GDPR, market research standards).
* AI-Enabled Productivity & Insights
* Embraces AI as a core capability and proactively identifies opportunities to apply AI solutions to business challenges and operational processes.
* Champions the responsible adoption of AI, balancing innovation with governance, compliance, and ethical considerations.
* Uses AI tools to augment analysis, decision-making, content development, and workflow execution, improving team productivity and business impact.
* Contributes to and supports the design and implementation of AI-enabled solutions that deliver measurable value and accelerate business outcomes.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Enablement
* Act as a trusted analytics partner to Marketing,  Sales and DHH Capabilities Enablement teams.
* Collaborate within the global BIA community to share best practices and ensure strategic alignment.
* Contribute to data literacy initiatives and mentor junior analysts where applicable.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Master’s degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or related field
* 5+ years in analytics or data analysis (regulated industry preferred)
* Commercial, marketing, or sales support experience required; pharma/healthcare a plus
* Advanced skills with Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI; Python/R knowledge is beneficial
* Working knowledge of AI and GenAI technologies, including responsible and compliant use within a business environment.
* Experience leveraging AI tools to improve productivity, analysis, content development, and decision-making.
* Ability to interpret complex data, deliver actionable insights, and communicate effectively
* Strategic problem solver with strong business acumen and storytelling skills
* Collaborative team player experienced across business and technical teams
* Adaptable and willing to learn new tools and approaches
* Professional English for global collaboration is required; fluency in local language is preferred

title: Forensics Consultant
description:
**Responsibilities**  

* Lead and support digital forensic investigations and compromise assessments across client environments.
* Conduct an in-depth analysis of digital evidence from endpoint, server, cloud, and network sources to uncover signs of unauthorized activity or policy violations.
* Perform malware reverse engineering, evasion technique analysis, and threat actor behavior profiling.
* Execute forensic acquisition and preservation of data using industry-standard tools and maintain chain-of-custody integrity
* Analyze logs, memory dumps, registry files, file metadata, and other artifacts to identify the scope and impact of an incident.
* Translate technical findings into clear, actionable reports tailored for both technical and executive stakeholders.
* Collaborate directly with client teams to ensure forensic activities align with their business objectives and regulatory frameworks.
* Support the development and refinement of forensic methodologies, tools, templates, and internal playbooks.
* Mentor junior consultants through peer reviews, technical coaching, and project support.

  
**Requirements**  

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics, or a related field.
* 3-5 years in digital forensics, incident response, or related security roles.
* Solid understanding of forensic processes, data recovery, and evidence handling.
* Awareness of relevant best practice, standards and regulations (NIST, GDPR, local data privacy laws).
* Familiarity with various attack vectors and forensic artifacts (e.g., logs, registry, memory).
* Proficiency with open-source and commercial forensic tools (e.g., Plaso, Volatility, ELK, EnCase, FTK, X-Ways).
* Ability to parse data and create clear, actionable client reports.
* Understanding of chain-of-custody documentation.
* Analytical mindset and investigative skills.
* Clear communication with clients, able to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences.
* Collaborative and adaptive approach to client delivery.
* Having relevant certifications (e.g. GCFA, GCFE, EC-CEH, ECIH, CHFI) is an advantage.

  
**About PT ITSEC Asia Tbk**

ITSEC is one of the leading cybersecurity companies in the APAC region, listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange (IDX), with over 300 employees across five countries. We deliver end-to-end cybersecurity services and solutions, including Consulting Services, Security Solutions Integration, and Managed Security Services. ITSEC provides continuous IT infrastructure protection against multiplying cybersecurity threats and ensures compliance with increasingly demanding data protection and critical infrastructure regulations. Our expertise has been built over a decade of delivering thousands of high-quality cybersecurity projects, providing cutting-edge solutions in collaboration with world-class technology partners across financial, telecommunications, energy, transportation, manufacturing, and other critical industry sectors. We also have extensive experience in helping our customers with fraud prevention, Operational Technology (OT), and Industrial IoT (IIoT) security.
