title: Data Scientist (Forecasting & Analytics)
description:
**About Hadl**

Hadl is an AI lab building the future data products and services for biology, manufacturing and aquaculture. We build agentic systems, data and diagnostic tools for our industry partners, working with the leading companies in our industries of focus to change the fabric of how work and decisions are made tomorrow.

Our team are engineers, industry experts, computer vision scientists and data passionate people, with cornerstone products that help farmers, processors, and companies building technology at the edge of the frontier.

Our work sits at the intersection of biology, data, and real world operations. We move fast, test often, and focus on practical impact. You will work closely with engineers, biologists, and product teams to turn complex data into reliable systems.

We collaborate openly, learn continuously, and value ownership. No rigid hierarchies. Curious people solving hard problems together.

**About the Role**

We are building the future of seafood supply chains with an industry-leading seafood company. You will be developing and owning forecasting and analytics: demand and inventory forecasts, the root cause of losses, and the numbers that show whether what we build is working.

This is a hands-on role. You will write code, build models and problem solve, as one of a small team of senior builders. Every forecast is kept and checked against what actually happened, and we pick the approach that fits the data and the decision, not the most complex one.

**What You'll Do**

* Start from a business question, then explore the data for patterns, trends, seasonality and anomalies.
* Compare forecasting approaches against a simple baseline, validate them on held-out data and choose the one that fits.
* Build demand and inventory forecasts, and monitor their accuracy every cycle.
* Classify losses such as stock-outs and overstock by cause, and report what drives them and what they cost.
* Turn findings into clear recommendations: what to change, the expected impact and how confident we are.
* Baseline success metrics and build reports and dashboards on the shared data platform, not one-off spreadsheets.
* Mentor and learn alongside passionate colleagues, including where forecasts feed agents and products.

**What We're Looking For**

* 2+ years of data science or applied analytics on business data, with work that was used in real decisions.
* Experience building and comparing time-series forecasting approaches, validating them on held-out data and monitoring them against actual outcomes.
* Experienced with EDA, model experimentation and translating findings into actionable business recommendations, not just reporting numbers.
* Strong Python for data work (pandas or polars, scikit-learn, statsmodels).
* Strong SQL on relational databases.
* Strong exploratory and root-cause analysis: you explain why a metric moved, not only that it moved.
* Experience defining metrics and building reports or dashboards that people use.
* Careful with data quality: you check assumptions and say how far results can be trusted.
* Fluent written and spoken English, and able to explain results and uncertainty to non-technical users.
* Able to work from Surabaya for up to 2 weeks in every 6.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in supply chain, retail or demand planning.
* BI tools (Power BI, Looker or Metabase).
* dbt or similar data transformation tools.
* Used LLMs in data work, such as extracting data from documents.
* Fluent Bahasa Indonesia.

**What We Offer**

* Ownership of forecasting and analytics on a new platform.
* Real commercial data, where your recommendations change what the business does.
* A small team of senior builders, with no layers between you and the problem.
* Fast iteration and learning cycles.
* Equity participation for the right candidate.

Salary: 7 to 20 million IDR per month

Equity: Available

Role: Full time

* Location: Kuningan, Jakarta, with up to 2 weeks in Surabaya every 6 weeks (travel and accommodation covered)

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**About Artajasa**

PT Artajasa Pembayaran Elektronis (ATM Bersama) is one of Indonesia's leading payment infrastructure providers, delivering secure, reliable, and high-availability transaction services for banks and financial institutions. As a key enabler of the national payment ecosystem, Artajasa operates mission-critical platforms that support interbank connectivity, fund transfers, switching, clearing, and settlement services across Indonesia. Through continuous innovation and technology advancement, Artajasa is committed to building scalable and resilient payment solutions that support the future of digital finance.

**About the Role**

We are seeking Senior Data Scientist to develop data-driven solutions that support business growth, operational efficiency, and innovation across the payment ecosystem. This role will work with large-scale transaction data to develop advanced analytics, predictive models, and machine learning solutions that generate actionable business insights.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, build, and deploy data models that turn company data assets into new products, services, and revenue streams (e.g. scoring models, data products, APIs, insights as a service).
* Identify and evaluate opportunities to create business value from data, in collaboration with product, business, and engineering teams.
* Develop end-to-end ML/statistical pipelines: data exploration, feature engineering, model development, validation, and deployment.
* Translate business requirements into measurable modeling objectives and success metrics (e.g. revenue impact, model accuracy, adoption).
* Monitor and maintain model performance in production; retrain or improve models as needed.
* Ensure data quality, governance, and compliance (privacy, security) throughout the modeling lifecycle.
* Communicate findings and model results clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Work independently with minimum supervision, able to plan, prioritize, and execute projects end to end.
* Mentor junior data scientists/analysts as needed (for senior-level candidates).

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in data science/machine learning roles, with a track record of deploying models into production.
* Strong proficiency in Python and/or R, SQL, and ML frameworks (scikit-learn, XGBoost, TensorFlow/PyTorch, etc.).
* Solid understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning algorithms, and model evaluation techniques.
* Experience working with large-scale/big data tools (Spark, Hadoop, cloud platforms such as AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus.
* Experience building data-driven products or revenue-generating models is strongly preferred.
* Fraud modeling/fraud detection experience is a strong plus (anomaly detection, risk scoring, transaction monitoring).
* Proven ability to work independently, take ownership of projects, and deliver results with minimum supervision.
* Strong business acumen, with the ability to connect technical modeling work to business and revenue outcomes.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

The **CRM Business Strategist** acts as a key analytics partner connecting Brand, Marketing, and Data teams to optimize the end-to-end customer lifecycle. * **Strategic Business & Analytics Partnership:** Partner with Brand and Marketing teams to identify business challenges and translate complex data into actionable recommendations supporting strategic decisions.

* **Analytics Roadmap Ownership:** Own and drive the CRM analytics roadmap, prioritizing high-impact data solutions, system integrations, and automated workflows aligned with company KPI targets.

title: Supply Chain Management & Customer Service Lead
description:
Job Description
  
  
This role should not operate as a back-office logistics coordinator; it must function as the cross-functional owner of the Integrated Business Planning (IBP / SOP) cadence, possessing operational authority to validate sales projections and tying compensation directly to forecast accuracy (MAPE) and on-time fulfillment (OTIF).
  
  
**Role Profile Organizational Scope:**  
Reporting Line
  

* Managing Director

Team Size
  

* Direct oversight of 3 personnel (Demand Planning, Logistics, Order Fulfillment)

Primary Mission
  
Align commercial demand with operational capacity to drive cost efficiency and achieve85% forecast precision
  
  
Functional Pillar
  
Strategic Priority
  
Primary Accountabilities
  

* Demand Planning Forecast Accuracy

Volatility reduction
  

* Design and lead the monthly consensus forecasting process using statistical baseline models combined with commercial pipeline inputs. Enforce accountability on sales variance.
* Commercial Operations Alignment
* Commercial enablement
* Partner with Sales and Marketing to model promotional lifts, establish minimum order quantities (MOQs), and manage customer service-level expectations to prevent stock-outs.
* Supply Chain Efficiency Logistics
* Cost-to-serve reduction
* Direct third-party logistics (3PL) partners, optimize carrier freight spend, streamline warehouse throughput, and systematically lower end-to-end landed costs.
* Integrated Business Planning (SOP)

Enterprise visibility
  

* Chair monthly cross-functional SOP reviews reconciling commercial projections, inventory levels, production constraints, and financial budget targets.
* Inventory Working Capital Optimization

Calculate and continuously tune safety stock parameters, manage product lifecycles (NPI through SKU rationalization), and minimize obsolete inventory write-offs.
  

* Channel Distributor Operations

Channel pipeline transparency
  

* Implement distributor management protocols to track sell-in versus actual sell-out data. Eliminate channel stuffing at quarter-end and audit distributor holding days to maintain accurate market demand signals.
* Sales Enablement Pipeline Cadence

Pipeline velocity conversion
  

* Own CRM hygiene and lead-to-order workflow enforcement. Partner with Sales Directors during weekly pipeline reviews to pressure-test deal stages, close probabilities, and delivery timelines against supply capacity.
* Revenue Allocation Order Prioritization
* Strategic customer retention

Design and enforce commercial rationing rules during supply-constrained periods. Allocate inventory based on strategic customer tiers, net customer margin contribution, and contractual service agreements.
  

* Order-to-Cash (O2C) Optimization
* Frictionless customer fulfillment

Streamline commercial handoffs between sales contract execution, customer credit approvals, order booking, and warehouse fulfillment to eliminate billing disputes and order cycle delays.
  
  
Competency Area
  
Mandatory Requirements
  
Preferred Differentiators
  
Professional Track Record
  
  

* 7 years combining supply chain planning with commercial operations or SOP leadership
* Prior mid-market leadership experience executing rapid inventory or systems turnarounds
* Process Governance
* Proven background instituting formal SOP or IBP workflows from early-stage to maturity
* Direct experience transitioning planning from fragmented spreadsheets to automated workflows
* Systems Analytics
* Expert proficiency in ERP environments (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Dynamics 365) and BI suites (Power BI, Tableau)
* Working knowledge of advanced demand planning software or statistical forecasting engines

Credentials Education
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics, Engineering, or Business Administration
* APICS / ASCM certification (CSCP or CPIM) or Lean Six Sigma Green/Black Belt

Commercial Acumen
  
  

* Demonstrated ability to challenge sales assumptions constructively using empirical order history
* Experience managing inventory across multi-warehouse or hybrid direct-to-customer/B2B models

**Required Skills:**  
Adaptability, Analytical Thinking, APICS CPIM, Budgeting, Change Control Management, Data Analysis, Demand Forecasting, Detail-Oriented, Inventory Management, Logistics Management, Order Management, Personal Initiative, Production Scheduling, Supply Chain Operations, Vendor Management

EY, a global leader operating in more than 150 countries delivers unparalleled service in Consulting and assists clients to transform and upskill their capabilities.
  
  
We serve our clients to build a better working world, helping them to create long-term value for people and society and build trust in the capital markets. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we work towards our ambition to be the best employer.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

* Provide technical expertise and guidance in Azure and Azure AI to team members.

* Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop solutions.

* Maintain ethical standards and open communication.

* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs

If you can demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
The Data Intelligence team is the backbone of Grab's Business Growth Analyst organization, driving data accuracy, actionable insights, and strategic decision-making. We work with Sales Operations, Sales Compensation, and Sales Enablement to empower sales teams across all territories. Our mission is to ensure data-driven strategies that align with Grab's business objectives and fuel sustainable growth.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
As a Data Intelligence Specialist, you will analyze data to drive strategic initiatives, optimize sales processes, and boost operational efficiency. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you will build and deliver dashboards, reports, and actionable insights to inform key business decisions. We seek a detail-oriented analyst who excels at translating complex data into effective strategies. This is a full-time, on-site role reporting to the Manager.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Data Management & Dashboard Creation: Gather and organize data from multiple sources to build dashboards for churn monitoring, sales performance tracking, and market analysis.
* Insights: Analyze sales trends, market dynamics, and performance metrics to deliver actionable insights that inform Go-To-Market strategies and sales programs.
* Collaboration: Work with Business Growth Analysts, Sales Leads, and Key Account Managers to provide data-driven solutions and address on-ground challenges.
* Monitor and Reporting: Monitor sales performance, campaign outcomes, and operational metrics, delivering regular reports to stakeholders for alignment and improvement.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* Education & Experience: Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Data Science, Statistics, CS) with 3+ years of experience in data analysis or business intelligence. Experience in tech or sales operations is an added value.
* Technical Skills: Proficiency in SQL and BI tools (Tableau, Power BI) for building dashboards. Experience with Python or R is advantageous.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to obtain actionable insights, and opportunities from complex datasets.
* Collaboration & Communication: Ability to work with cross-functional stakeholders (e.g., Sales, Business Growth) and present strategic recommendations.
* Attention to Detail: Meticulous approach to ensure high levels of accuracy in all reports and analyses.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

You will play a pivotal role across both internal products and client-facing platforms, working with a modern, scalable tech stack that includes Laravel, Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap 5, and Filament CMS.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining, and optimizing APIs, CMS systems, user dashboards, and complex backend architectures for high-traffic environments.

* Develop robust, scalable backend systems using PHP and the Laravel Framework.
* Build and maintain Laravel Filament CMS panels for internal operational tools.
* Implement responsive and consistent UI styling using Tailwind CSS and Bootstrap 5.
* Optimize databases, APIs, and server-side logic for maximum speed and scalability.

* Experience integrating 3rd-party APIs (Stripe, Firebase, etc.).

* Exposure to Vue.js or Alpine.js for frontend reactive components.

description:
### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan**

Kamu akan berperan sebagai Infrastructure Engineer yang bertanggung jawab atas keandalan (reliability), keamanan (security), dan otomatisasi (automation) infrastruktur serta pipeline pengembangan aplikasi.

  
  

Kamu akan terlibat langsung dalam perencanaan arsitektur, implementasi CI/CD, pengelolaan infrastruktur cloud, serta penerapan security by design di seluruh lifecycle aplikasi. Selain itu, kamu akan melakukan monitoring, incident response, hardening sistem, serta memastikan compliance terhadap standar keamanan informasi.

**Kualifikasi**

* Minimal 3 tahun pengalaman di bidang DevOps, SRE, Infrastruktur, atau Security Engineer.
* Pengalaman hands-on dengan cloud AWS dan/atau GCP.
* Pengalaman membangun dan mengelola CI/CD pipeline (GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, dsb).
* Menguasai konsep jaringan, firewall, IDS/IPS, VPN, dan protokol keamanan.
* Familiar dengan container dan orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Pengalaman menggunakan tools keamanan (Nmap, Wireshark, OpenVAS, Metasploit, dsb).
* Memahami praktik hardening OS (Linux/Windows), aplikasi, dan cloud environment.
* Terbiasa membuat dokumentasi teknis dan laporan insiden.
  

  

**Nilai Tambah:**

* Pengalaman dengan observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, SIEM).
* Pengalaman dengan secret management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, dsb).
* Sertifikasi: AWS/GCP Associate, CEH, CompTIA Security+, Kubernetes, ISO 27001, dsb.

  

Fulltime

Surabaya, Jawa Timur

Rp 6.000.000 - Rp 15.000.000

description:
To own the architecture, acceptance and operational integrity of the AI Business platform end to end, from customer-facing front ends to core gateway, orchestration, routing and metering, ensuring vendor-delivered work meets XLSmart performance, cost, security and PDP obligations.

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
We are hiring a
**Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer**
to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an “automation-first” senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive the success with those leveraging Ubuntu and open source products. If you have experience of IT operations automation, Infrastructure as Code and a passion for technology, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The IS team at Canonical supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services. The team is in charge of running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users.
  
  
As an Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you’ll be in a unique position to drive operations automation to the next level, both in our own private clouds as well as in the public clouds. We do this by utilizing the best of open source infrastructure as code software, software development practices such as CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products for software operation automation.
  
  
In addition to defining the infrastructure as code, you will improve Canonical products and the open-source technologies they’re based on by providing critical feedback to developers on how their products operate at scale. This is done by submitting bugs (and sometimes writing pull requests) and collaborating on design and implementations with other teams within the company.
  
  
You’ll be part of a global team of SREs that work together and support each other to provide the best possible services to our company, Canonical’s customers and the Ubuntu Community.
  
  
**As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will**

* Drive the development of automation, Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
* Closely collaborate with the IS architect to align your solutions with the IS architecture vision
* Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
* Apply your experience of IaC to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS by constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
* Automate software operations for re-usability and consistency across private and public clouds, taking into consideration the complexities of distributed systems
* Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical’s core services, networks, and infrastructure
* Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation, Setting up, maintaining and using observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design, implement and maintain monitoring and alerting for various systems and services

description:
Department Product Management

LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor)

LocationJakarta

The Product Management team at Shopee is the key focal point between the business, engineering and design teams. The team is responsible for implementing strategy, road maps and features, while adhering to business goals. It covers all functions including but not limited to Financial Services, Supply Chain, Search, Recommendation, Advertising, Order, Promotion, User, Anti-Fraud, Seller Service. Join us to own a product that is impacting millions of lives in Southeast Asia and Taiwan.

Job Description:

* Define and execute the product and growth strategy for Shopee Games within the project period, setting priorities based on user engagement metrics and key business objectives
* Gather, evaluate, and prioritize functional requests from business and local teams, converting them into structured product requirements and operational specifications
* Lead cross-functional collaboration with regional Product Managers, Engineering, Design, Data, and Business teams to launch new game features, mechanics, and campaign games
* Manage and execute campaign games for major e-commerce events, overseeing budget allocation, prize economics, and post-campaign performance analytics
* Monitor and optimize game operations processes, including the AI agent workflow for automated game setup, to continuously enhance operational efficiency
* Conduct market landscape research and competitor benchmarking to identify innovative game mechanics and strategic growth opportunities

Requirements:

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field
* 1 to 4 years of professional experience in product management, business product management, or product operations, preferably within e-commerce, consumer mobile applications, or the gaming industry
* Prior experience in defining product metrics and driving key business outcomes such as Gross Merchandise Value (GMV), user growth, and operational cost efficiency
* Demonstrated experience in budget planning, prize economics design, and campaign tracking for large-scale user engagement initiatives
* Hands-on experience or familiarity with AI tools, LLMs, and automated workflow agents to streamline operational processes
* Proficiency in oral and written English and Bahasa Indonesia to facilitate cross-border collaborations and stakeholder communications across regional offices

title: Junior Engineer (SEA)
description:
First Circle is an SME-focused, credit-centric, and multi-product NeoBank in SE Asia which is fast-growing (>100%), profitable, and internationalising soon.

We started life as an SME lender in the Philippines in 2016 to solve the SME credit gap by using technology to systemise underwriting, deliver exceptional UX, and automate away delivery costs. We’ve delivered our clients the fastest, cheapest, most flexible credit line available to businesses anywhere in Southeast Asia. We’ve been rewarded with both fast growth and exceptional unit economics, a rare combination in our space.

Over the past two years we’ve expanded our product range to include business bank accounts & payments, e-Invoices, corporate credit cards, rooftop solar, and most recently deposits catalysed by securing a full bank charter in the Philippines. In 2027, we’ll expand our geographical coverage to include at least two new markets in APAC.

Our excellent track record results from our people & culture. We combine high standards & intensity with a collegiate environment. Our barometers of success are the rate of personal growth of our people, how long high performers choose to stay, and ensuring we we raise the bar with every hire.

We are now hiring junior developers to grow with us during our most ambitious year of growth to date. You’ll work on real production systems from day one, with regular mentorship from senior engineers who have built software all over the world.

Building in developing markets like the Philippines presents unique challenges, given the state of digital infrastructure. We are building virtually everything in-house, which is not easy, but it’s a lot of fun. We have a track record of solving seemingly impossible problems that defeated many other start-ups, and the opportunity ahead remains enormous.

 **Requirements**  

* Hands-on experience with at least one of **C#**, **Kotlin**, or **Java**, gained through work, internships, or substantial personal projects. **React** experience is a plus.
* Solid fundamentals: writing clean, readable code; working with relational databases and **SQL**; building and consuming **REST APIs**; and using Git.
* Up to one year of professional experience is ideal, but not essential. What you’ve built matters most to us.
* A **degree** in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.
* An understanding of why tests matter and a willingness to write them.
* A creative, problem-solving mindset and a love of critical thinking. You won’t be expected to get everything right, but you should be able to explain your thinking.
* Eagerness to learn quickly, ask questions, and act on feedback.
* Good written and spoken **English**. You’ll work with colleagues across Europe and Southeast Asia.
* **Curiosity about AI** and experience using AI tools to learn and work more effectively.
* Previous experience with fintech, payments, or banking is nice to have.

**What you’ll do**

* Build and improve backend services and APIs, and where relevant, frontend features in React.
* Start with well-scoped tasks and quickly take ownership of larger features, from first idea to production.
* Write tests, take part in code reviews, and learn how to keep production systems reliable.
* Help investigate and fix issues in production, alongside senior engineers.
* Work with product, design, and business teams to understand real customer needs and turn them into working software.

  
**Benefits**  

* No fixed budget, we hire globally and adjust offers based on experience and market rate.
* Flexibility around working hours and location.
* Macbooks, private health insurance, training budgets and more!
* Opportunity to travel

description:
About the Company

Our client is an emerging technology company specializing in AI-driven solutions and cybersecurity innovation. The company focuses on developing intelligent technology solutions to help businesses strengthen their digital capabilities, improve operational efficiency, and address complex security challenges.

They are currently looking for a
**Lead Software Engineer**
to lead software development initiatives, drive technical excellence, and contribute to building innovative AI-powered products and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Lead and oversee the end-to-end software development lifecycle, from system design and architecture to development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Design, develop, and implement scalable, reliable, and high-performance software applications.
* Lead the technical direction of software engineering projects, ensuring solutions align with business objectives and technical requirements.
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders to integrate AI capabilities into software applications.
* Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and code reviews to software engineers, ensuring coding standards and best practices.
* Evaluate and implement appropriate technologies, frameworks, and development methodologies.
* Troubleshoot complex technical issues and continuously improve system performance, scalability, and security.
* Work across multiple projects and contribute to developing innovative technology solutions for different business needs.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in software engineering or software development, with proven experience leading technical projects or engineering teams.
* At least
  **2–3 years of hands-on experience working with AI-related projects, technologies, or applications**
  .
* Strong software engineering fundamentals, including system design, software architecture, clean code principles, and application development.
* Experience developing and deploying AI-powered applications or integrating AI/ML models into software products.
* Proficiency in modern programming languages and frameworks, with the ability to work across different technology stacks.
* Previous experience working at a
  **software house, system integrator (SI), or technology consulting company**
  is highly preferred, particularly in environments involving multiple projects, clients, and technology solutions.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and technical decision-making skills.
* Proven ability to lead engineering teams, manage technical priorities, and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience handling end-to-end software development projects across different industries or business domains.
* Exposure to Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, machine learning, or other AI-driven technologies.
* Experience with cloud platforms, API integrations, microservices, and scalable system architecture.
* Experience working in a fast-paced technology environment with diverse project requirements.

title: Order Management Administrator
description:
**Make an impact with NTT DATA**  
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Order Management Administrator has relevant basic experience and is responsible for assisting with customer orders and coordinating with various cross functional teams to ensure smooth order fulfilment.  
  
This role may be required to process invoices to ensure accurate billing.  
  
This role requires attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and effective communication.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Reviews and processes orders, ensuring compliance with guidelines and rules set in place.
* Tracks and reports status of all orders to sales teams, updating in a timely manner.
* Receives and reviews customer orders to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Enters orders into the system and track their progress throughout the fulfilment process.
* May be required to generate invoices based on approved orders, ensuring accuracy of pricing, discounts, and terms.
* May be required to verify billing information and addresses discrepancies if needed.
* Ensures that customer orders (and if required invoices) align with contractual terms and pricing agreements.
* Communicates with customers or relevant internal stakeholders regarding order status.
* Addresses customer and/or internal stakeholder inquiries and resolve concerns in a timely manner.
* May work with internal stakeholders to update customer profiles and relevant information in the system.
* Enters order details accurately into the system and update relevant databases.
* Ensures all necessary information is captured for accurate reporting.
* Conducts quality checks on orders to prevent errors and discrepancies.
* Ensures all documents and data are complete and accurate.
* Performs any other related task as required.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Attention to detail and accuracy in processing orders.
* Familiarity with order management software or systems.
* Strong communication skills for interacting with customers and cross-functional teams.
* Problem-solving abilities to address order discrepancies.
* Organizational skills to manage multiple orders and tasks simultaneously.
* Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel.
* Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to providing excellent service
* Adaptability to changing priorities and a fast-paced environment
* Possess a proactive and systematic approach to work

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent qualification.

**Required experience:**

* Some demonstrated experience in order fulfilment administration or related roles.
* Some demonstrated experience gained within a global IT services organization is advantageous.
* May require basic billing experience as part of an order fulfilment administration or related role.

**Workplace type****:**

On-site Working

**About NTT DATA**  
NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

year in R&D.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**  
NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

**Third parties fraudulently posing as NTT DATA recruiters**

NTT DATA recruiters will never ask job seekers or candidates for payment or banking information during the recruitment process, for any reason. Please remain vigilant of third parties who may attempt to impersonate NTT DATA recruiters whether in writing or by phone in order to deceptively obtain personal data or money from you. All email communications from an NTT DATA recruiter will come from an **@nttdata.com** email address. If you suspect any fraudulent activity, please *contact us*.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Unstoppable starts with people.** The future of payments is being built today, and at **Paymentology**, we are looking for people who want to help shape it. We power card issuing for leading banks, fintechs and digital brands across the globe, and as we continue to grow, we are looking for curious, ambitious people who thrive on solving complex challenges, embrace innovation and want to make a tangible impact at global scale.

Our Engineering culture values autonomy, excellence, ownership, and curiosity. We encourage engineers to lead solutions end-to-end, mentor others, and continuously improve how we build and operate software. If you’re excited by solving complex global payments challenges and enjoy working with smart, kind, mission-driven people, this is the place for you.

**What you get to do**

We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer based in the APAC region to build and operate the software, automation, and infrastructure that keep our global payments services reliable, scalable, observable, and resilient. You’ll own complex reliability improvements in your domain, guide product teams, and turn production experience into lasting engineering improvements.

* Design, build, and operate reliable software, cloud infrastructure, and reusable automation.
* Own reliability improvements end-to-end, from investigation and design through delivery and follow-up.
* Identify recurring operational problems and deliver durable solutions that improve reliability, scalability, and performance.
* Contribute to design and code reviews, raising reliability, security, and operability risks early.
* Improve metrics, logs, traces, alerts, deployment safeguards, and recovery automation.
* Partner with product engineering teams to improve service health and adopt safe self-service capabilities.
* Participate in the 24/7 on-call rotation for business-critical services and lead technical response in your area.
* Lead or contribute to incident reviews and complete follow-up actions that reduce recurrence and impact.
* Share knowledge, improve runbooks, and mentor engineers in reliability practices.
* Automate client onboarding, deployments, and disaster recovery execution

**Requirements: Experience**

* 3+ years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering or a closely related role.
* Strong understanding of cloud networking, distributed systems, and service architecture.
* Experience writing tested, maintainable production code in Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, Scala, or a comparable language.
* Hands-on experience with AWS, Docker, GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Kubernetes, ECS, or EKS.
* Experience with observability, CI/CD, production automation, and infrastructure as code.
* Understanding of cloud security and identity management, including AWS IAM and Active Directory.
* Experience applying SLIs, SLOs, and SLAs to assess service health and guide engineering priorities.
* Ability to troubleshoot complex systems and turn operational problems into maintainable software or automation.
* A degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Most importantly, a desire to learn, grow, and collaborate with a thoughtful engineering team.

**What you can look forward to**

* Remote role with a distributed team across multiple time zones but you will be covering APAC primarily.
* Work closely with engineering teams on services that support global payments.
* Meaningful ownership of reliability improvements from discovery through production.
* Support for your ongoing career growth and development.
* A diverse, collaborative, mission-driven engineering culture.

At **Paymentology**, we believe that making a difference starts with the people behind the work. You will be part of a diverse, global team of Paymentologists who are united by a shared mission to advance the world through payments.  
This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful work, collaborate across markets and functions, and help shape the future of a business with global reach and real impact.

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on any unlawful ground, including race, colour, ethnicity, sex, gender, pregnancy, marital status, family responsibility, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, language or HIV status.

Paymentology will never request any form of payment from applicants at any stage of our recruitment process, including for applications, interviews, training or job placements. If anyone asks you for money while claiming to act on behalf of Paymentology, please treat this as fraudulent and do not make any payment. All legitimate Paymentology vacancies are advertised via our official careers page, and our recruitment emails are sent only from official Paymentology domains.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
**About ClubTech Global**

ClubTech Global builds the booking engine and multi-tenant hospitality ecosystem trusted by clubs and venues around the world. Data is at the heart of how we operate – it drives our reporting, our marketing, and the decisions our team and clients make every day. We're looking for an Analytics Engineer to build the data models, dashboards, and reporting systems behind all of it.

**About the Role**

The Analytics Engineer owns the data infrastructure behind our client analytics, reporting, and marketing tracking. You'll sit at the intersection of data engineering and analytics – turning raw, messy data into clean, tested, well-documented datasets that our team and clients can trust.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role. You'll take full responsibility for client analytics onboarding, recurring reporting, marketing tracking, data validation, and billing operations. As we grow, you'll shape the dimensional model that supports multi-tenant reporting at scale.

﻿

**What You'll Do**

* **Client Dashboard Development —**

  Design, build, and maintain tenant-facing and internal dashboards across unified data sources, with clear, consistent metric definitions.
* **Client Analytics Onboarding & Instrumentation —**

  Implement and maintain analytics tracking across client properties, including data layers and purchase/event tracking.
* **Reporting Pipelines —**

  Own our recurring client reporting and revenue automations end-to-end, ensuring accurate, on-time delivery.
* **Marketing Tracking & Attribution —**

  Maintain tracking and attribution across Google, Meta, and TikTok Ads, including conversion tracking, pixels, and ROAS reporting.
* **Data Validation —**

  Continuously validate data accuracy across pipelines, dashboards, and reports, catching issues before they reach stakeholders.

**What You'll Bring**

* Strong SQL skills (CTEs, joins, aggregations, optimisation) on large datasets.
* A track record of building dashboards and recurring reports in Looker, Superset, Power BI, Tableau, or similar.
* Comfort with Git and CI/CD practices for analytics code.
* Experience with dbt or a similar data transformation framework.
* Some hands-on experience implementing marketing analytics tracking with PostHog, GA4, GTM, and Meta Conversion API (CAPI).
* Experience building and maintaining ELT/ETL pipelines (Airflow, Dagster, or similar).
* Working proficiency in Python/Javascript/React/NextJS/Laravel/PHP.
* A solid understanding of data warehousing, dimensional modelling, and pipeline design.
* Comfortable communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
* Professional-level English, spoken and written.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience in agency, multi-client, or multi-tenant SaaS environments.
* Experience modeling marketing and ad platform data, such as Google Ads, Meta, or TikTok.
* Experience with billing or ops data processing.
* Familiarity with MLOps or ML feature pipelines.
* Experience with GCP (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, or similar).

**What we offer**

* Full-time role (Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM).
* Hybrid setup (4 days WFO / 1 day WFH)
* Company laptop provided (or option to use your own).
* Comprehensive leave benefits: 12 days Annual Leave and 16 days Public Holidays.
* BPJS coverage provided.
* Exclusive Perk: 50% F&B discount at Finns Beach Club

title: GoTo Financial - Lead Data Scientist - Lending
description:
**About The Role**
In this role, you will be an integral player within Data Science team based on Jakarta. You will take the wheel in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models for a variety of consumer and merchant lending products GoPay offers in Indonesia. Your responsibilities will include enhancing our credit risk models by leveraging innovative and cutting-edge algorithms on GoTo data and third-party data vendors. Most importantly, your efforts will work to bring wider financial inclusion to more people in the region and beyond.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own end-to-end modeling modeling initiatives and business outcomes / metrics.
* Work with the business/product team in defining, prototyping, and implementing data science models and other supporting DS initiatives.
* Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing data science team, fostering a culture of collaboration and innovation.
* Oversee the development of consumer credit risk models and statistical analyses to optimize decision-making and business outcomes.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor degree or above in science and engineering related majors such as statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, etc.
* At least 6-7 years of hands-on experience in building, evaluating, and monitoring risk models.
* Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
* Comfortable using Python, SQL, and UNIX Shell.
* Understand business concerns and formulate them as technical problems that can be solved using data and math/stats/ML.
* Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a strong sense of ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Good communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
* Able to write model documentation clearly and concisely and support recommendations with research and data.

**About The Team**
Our team leverages big data from the GoTo universe, as well as external data, to build various predictive models to support the risk strategy team in real-time credit underwriting and management of the customer lifecycle Cicil (BNPL) and Pinjam (cash loans) products. As our model scores are key inputs to risk decisioning (e.g. approval/rejection of loans, credit limit adjustments), we are also able to see the direct impact of our models on the business and our customers.
  
  
We are a growing team and are constantly looking for opportunities to use data science to enhance our credit and fraud risk management capabilities. We are focused on growth and efficiency. We are all about open knowledge sharing and self-improvement. We believe that “Data Science is a team sport.”
  
  
**About GoTo Group**
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
  
  
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.
  
  
**About Gojek**
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.
  
  
**About GoTo Financial**
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.
  
  
*GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.*

title: Lead Revenue Optimization & Pricing Scientist
description:
**Lead Revenue Optimization & Pricing Scientist (FINNS Bali)**

FINNS Bali is seeking an exceptional, data-driven Lead Revenue Optimization & Pricing Scientist to design, deploy, and manage our algorithmic dynamic pricing engine for luxury beach club inventory.

Unlike traditional hotel revenue management—where booking windows span weeks and rooms are priced in isolation—our environment requires real-time, intra-day yield optimization across physical assets (daybeds, cabanas) and high-margin Food & Beverage (F&B) revenue streams.

You will bridge the gap between econometrics, machine learning, and hospitality operations. You will build and refine models that balance real-time walk-in velocity, weather forecasts, spatial inventory dynamics, and guest spend behavior to maximize Total Revenue Per Available Daybed (RevPAD) while protecting brand equity.

FINNS World's Best Beach Club is not just a beach club; it's a destination where dreams come alive! We pride ourselves on creating exhilarating entertainment, vibrant energy, and unforgettable F&B experiences. Nestled along the breathtaking Bali coastline, we provide a one-of-a-kind party atmosphere that leaves our guests craving for more.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Algorithmic Pricing & Yield Engine Strategy**

* Total Guest Value (TGV) Optimization: Design dynamic pricing and minimum spend models that maximize joint contribution margin across daybed rental fees and F&B consumption.
* Ratio & Split Tuning: Programmatically optimize the split between non-refundable upfront rental fees and pre-paid F&B credits based on lead time, channel, and guest spend profiles.
* Spatial & Attribute Pricing: Implement discrete choice models (e.g., Multinomial Logit) to price prime inventory (e.g., front-row oceanfront) dynamically against secondary deck or pool zones.
* Overflow & Queue Management: Develop pricing models for general admission / "skip-the-queue" entry passes when inventory reaches capacity, incorporating overflow metrics into unconstrained demand estimates.

**2. Advanced Data Science & Econometric Modeling**

* Unconstrained Demand Forecasting: Build censored regression models (Tobit, Survival Analysis) to estimate true latent demand during peak, capacity-constrained sell-out periods.
* Causal Elasticity Estimation: Apply Causal Machine Learning (Double ML, Instrumental Variables) to isolate true price elasticity from confounding variables (weather, local events, holiday spikes).
* Continuous Experimentation: Implement Contextual Multi-Armed Bandits (e.g., Thompson Sampling) to continuously explore guest willingness-to-pay while minimizing lost revenue ("regret").

**3. Operational Integration & Guardrails**

* Real-Time Guardrails: Establish automated circuit breakers, smoothing filters, and soft floors/ceilings to prevent algorithmic price spikes or panic rate-dropping.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with VIP Hosts, Front Desk teams, and POS operators to align algorithmic recommendations with real-world execution at the host stand.
* Business Intelligence & Reporting: Build executive dashboards tracking RevPAD, F&B capture rates, demand pace, denial/regret rates, and algorithmic yield lift.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Operations Research, Econometrics, Quantitative Economics, Industrial Engineering, or Revenue Management.
* 5+ years in dynamic pricing, revenue management, or yield optimization.
* Proven track record in hospitality pricing (Hotels, Resorts, Short-Term Rentals, Airlines) OR high-frequency experiential venues (Theme Parks, Nightclubs, Ticketing).
* Hands-on experience working with censored data, multi-product revenue streams, or capacity-constrained assets.
* Capable to use Python/R, Causal ML & Optimization solvers (Gurobi/OR-Tools), Multi-Armed Bandits, Advanced SQL, and real-time streaming/POS data pipelines.
* Deep understanding of capacity constraints, lead-time decay curves, perishable inventory, and customer perception of price fairness.
* Ability to model cost of goods sold (COGS), basket size distributions, and net contribution margins across mixed revenue streams.
* Proficiency in Causal Inference, Synthetic Controls, and Time-Series Interleaved Testing (knowing why traditional A/B testing fails on adjacent physical assets).
* Fluency in English is required.

**Job Benefits**

* An opportunity to work in a world-renowned beach club
* Growing your skills and the possibility of growing within the company
* Fast growing company
* Competitive salary package
* FINNS Bali Membership
* BPJS and insurance Mandiri healthcare

title: Senior Specialist, Fisheries Traceability
description:
**Location**
------------

Jakarta, Indonesia

**Duration**
------------

This is a 1-year fixed term position with full benefits and the possibility of extension.

**Application Instructions**
----------------------------

Please include a cover letter indicating your interest in this role.

**Program Overview**
--------------------

The ocean is the lifeblood of our planet. It moderates the climate, is foundational to the livelihoods and wellbeing of billions, and is key to global food security and nutrition. Yet climate change and overexploitation are rapidly threatening the ocean’s ability to act as a foundational system for a thriving world, and these pressures are accelerating faster than existing policies and management systems can respond, putting at risk the ocean’s ability to sustain both people and the planet.

That’s why EDF Oceans creates transformative, incentive-aligning solutions that leverage a vibrant ocean to support people and nature. By harnessing policy and market-based tools that reward stewardship and sustainable use, our interdisciplinary team of scientists, economists, policy experts, and practitioners work to revolutionize ocean systems at scale and improve the health of the planet and the lives of billions of people. From advancing ocean-based climate innovations to supporting ocean-reliant communities in building long-term resilience to reforming fisheries management worldwide, we apply rigorous science and pragmatic economics to advance durable policies, market-based tools, and forward-looking strategies that unlock large-scale impact — ensuring a vibrant ocean is the cornerstone of a healthy planet and resilient communities.

**Overall Function**
--------------------

The Senior Specialist, Fisheries Traceability, is responsible for strengthening EDF’s partnership with private-sector stakeholders to support sustainable management of Indonesia’s fisheries. With a focus on the Blue Swimming Crab (BSC) fishery, they will work with stakeholders to build and strengthen end-to-end traceability systems; ensure compliance with industry quality standards and national and international regulations; and optimize fisheries supply chain governance. They will foster collaboration among industry stakeholders, fishers, government agencies, and certification bodies to incentivize environmentally responsible and sustainable fishing practices. The Senior Specialist reports to the Director, Indonesia Fisheries & Oceans.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Develop and implement a traceability system for BSC fishery that covers the entire supply chain, from the point of capture (fishers/vessels) and landing sites to mini-plants, fish processing units (UPI), and export channels.
* Integrate digital traceability standards to ensure transparency and compliance with domestic and international market regulations.
* Work with participating companies and plants to help them ensure that the entire BSC supply chain complies with export regulations and standards.
* Provide technical assistance and training to business operators, fishers, facilitators, mini-plants, and processing units on procedures for maintaining catch quality.
* Establish and maintain effective communication and coordination with relevant government agencies, including the Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries and provincial and regency marine and fisheries offices, as well as industry partners, associations, fisher community groups and other stakeholders to support effective program implementation..
* Facilitate programs to strengthen local institutions and develop productive partnerships with relevant players in the BSC supply chain.
* Periodically monitor the effectiveness of the traceability system and BSC supply chain operations.
* Prepare comprehensive reports on program performance and achievements, analyze field-level challenges, and provide strategic recommendations for improvement to management and relevant stakeholders.
* Represent EDF Indonesia in technical meetings, workshops, and stakeholder forums.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal teams to support successful project implementation.
* Share technical knowledge and lessons learned with colleagues and partners to strengthen implementation capacity and promote continuous improvement.
* Provide technical input to project proposals and reports as needed.
* Apply innovative problem-solving to complex programmatic, technical, and implementation challenges that may not have clear precedent, identify solutions and make recommendations for adjusting strategy as conditions evolve.
* Participate in advancing EDF’s organizational effectiveness and culture goals in which people from all backgrounds and experiences feel connected, included, and empowered to address the environmental and organizational challenges in alignment with EDF values.
* Perform other related duties as assigned in support of EDF Indonesia's fisheries program.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* A minimum of a bachelor’s degree (S1) in marine science, fisheries, or a related field, with at least 4 years of relevant professional experience in fisheries traceability and the fisheries industry. A Master's degree may substitute for up to 2 years of relevant experience.
* In-depth understanding and hands-on experience in BSC fishery management across the supply chain—from fishers and mini-plants to fish processing units (UPI)—and fisheries certifications strong preferred.
* Proficiency in digital and manual supply chain record-keeping systems, including those based on the principles of the Seafood Import Monitoring Program (SIMP).
* Knowledge of national and international fisheries regulations and fish-processing quality standards.
* Experience developing digital fisheries traceability systems.
* Competence in fisheries data analysis, quality management, and value-chain mapping.
* Strong leadership skills, the ability to coordinate effectively with stakeholders, and excellent communication and reporting skills.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex projects, determine appropriate implementation approaches, and make sound decisions within organizational priorities, policies, and donor requirements.
* Demonstrated success establishing and managing partnerships with government agencies, implementing partners, academic institutions, community organizations, private sector actors, and other key stakeholders.
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to advise, influence, and engage diverse audiences, deliver formal presentations, and facilitate technical and programmatic discussions with senior stakeholders.
* Demonstrated self-awareness, cultural competency and inclusivity, and ability to work with colleagues and stakeholders across all cultures and backgrounds.
* Highly organized and adaptable, with strong attention to detail and the ability to prioritize effectively under changing conditions and deadline pressure.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook); experience with project management or data management tools is an asset.
* Willingness and ability to travel (up to 30% time) within Indonesia and internationally as needed.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Ben jij een data engineer met enkele jaren ervaring die wil groeien? En ben je in je opdrachten ook altijd op zoek naar de vraag achter de vraag? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!
  
  
Dit bieden wij jou
  
  

* Bruto salaris van € 3.500,- tot € 4.500,- per maand;
* Een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur;
* 24 vakantiedagen op basis van een fulltime dienstverband met de mogelijkheid om 6 dagen (naar rato) bij te kopen;
* Een hybride werkomgeving met de mogelijkheid tot gedeeltelijk thuiswerken;
* Goede opleidingsmogelijkheden aan de VINCI Energies Academy, het Axians Institute en via het online platform Good Habitz;
* Doorgroeimogelijkheden die passen bij jouw ambities;
* Een leaseauto/mobiliteitsbudget, smartphone en laptop;
* Prima secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden met o.a. een gunstige pensioenregeling, mogelijkheid deel te nemen aan de collectieve ziektekostenverzekering en de mogelijkheid om aandelen te kopen tegen een gereduceerd tarief;
* Een prettige en informele werksfeer met fijne collega’s: diversiteit en inclusie vinden wij van groot belang in onze organisatie en wij streven er daarom naar om ons personeelsbestand een afspiegeling te laten zijn van de maatschappij.

Hier krijg jij energie van
  
  
Zelfstandig werken bij klanten in één van onze samengestelde teams van Axians medewerkers en klant collega's. Wij maken op maat data platformen, zowel in de cloud (Snowflake, Microsoft, Databricks) als On Premises (Microsoft, Kubernetes) waarbij data minimalisatie door hergebruik en data virtualisatie(Denodo en Data Virtuality) een uitgangspunt is. We kijken naar meer dan techniek. Om onze projecten te laten slagen moet het data gebruik aansluiten op de strategie van de klant, moet de organisatie en data governance processen (Collibra en Microsoft) bij de klant gefaciliteerd en ingericht worden, en is het van belang dat gebruikers data bedreven worden.
  
  
Hier herken jij jezelf in
  
  

* HBO werk- en denkniveau
* Passie voor data vraagstukken
* Goede SQL kennis
* Ervaring in één of meerdere data tools
* Ervaring met data concepten
* Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal is een pré
* Bij voorkeur woonachtig in onze regio of binnen een straal van 60 kilometer

Dit is jouw team
  
  
Axians is een internationale netwerkorganisatie bestaande uit gespecialiseerde en zelfsturende IT units. In deze rol ga je aan de slag voor het expertisegebied Data & AI. Binnen Data & AI zijn 5 Business Units actief die elk verschillende marktsegmenten bedienen en verschillende proposities hebben.
  
  
De engineers die binnen het expertisegebied Data & AI werken, hebben elk hun eigen specialisme en standplaats. Als engineer werk je nauw samen in een multidisciplinair team bestaande uit zowel klant als directe collega's. In deze rol is jouw standplaats de Business Unit in Laren (NH), maar uiteraard krijg jij alle ruimte om jouw werkweek en werklocatie zelf in te delen.
  
  
*Over Business Data & AI in Laren*
De Axians locatie in Laren (NH) is gespecialiseerd in Data & AI. Met zo’n 40 collega’s werken we samen om onze klanten te helpen en adviseren met hun datavraagstukken. Onze klanten zijn grote, innovatieve organisaties als ABN AMRO verzekeringen, Stichting Philadelphia zorg, Zeeman en PGGM. Onze werkwijze is gebaseerd op onze Axians kernwaarden: autonomie, verantwoordelijkheid, ondernemerschap, vertrouwen & transparantie en solidariteit.
  
  
*Betrokkenheid en een goede werksfeer*
De Business Unit bestaat uit betrokken collega's die ook een gezellige werksfeer belangrijk vinden. We vieren onze successen en helpen elkaar door mindere periodes heen. Regelmatig worden er borrels, uitjes met collega's en andere leuke activiteiten georganiseerd.
  
  
*Leren en ontwikkelen*
We kijken naar wat je al kan, maar ook wat je nog kan leren. We zijn er namelijk van overtuigd dat de juiste omgeving jou in staat stelt om alles uit jezelf te halen. En daar helpen we je bij. Want groeien doe je samen. Onze slogan is hier treffend; ICT with a Human Touch.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
We are looking for a hands-on Senior Full-Stack Security Engineer to build secure, reliable products for our cryptocurrency platform. This is not a security-operations-only role. You will work across backend services, web and mobile applications, cloud infrastructure, and developer tooling—shipping production code while strengthening security throughout the engineering lifecycle. You will use AI-assisted development and security tools to improve delivery speed, investigation, testing, and code quality, while independently verifying outputs for correctness and safety. Because our products involve customer funds, identity, payments, and trading, you will help establish strong controls for financial integrity, access management, monitoring, incident response, and recovery.
  
  
**What Will You Do**

* Design, build, test, deploy, and operate secure features across frontend, backend, APIs, data stores, and cloud infrastructure.
* Lead secure architecture reviews, threat modeling, and risk assessments for new and existing systems.
* Implement security controls in application code, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, containers, and Kubernetes.
* Strengthen authentication, authorization, secrets management, encryption, audit trails, and data protection.
* Identify and remediate vulnerabilities in web, mobile, API, and infrastructure components.
* Build automated security tests, dependency and container scanning, secure deployment checks, and release guardrails.
* Develop monitoring and alerts for suspicious activity, abnormal financial behavior, access violations, and system failures.
* Lead or support incident investigation, containment, remediation, reconciliation, and post-incident improvement.
* Use AI tools for software development, code review, test generation, threat analysis, documentation, and investigation.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with substantial responsibility for application or infrastructure security.
* Strong backend development skills in at least one production language such as Go, Java, TypeScript, Python, or a comparable language.
* Experience building modern web applications and integrating frontend clients with secure APIs.
* Strong knowledge of API design, relational databases, distributed systems, and asynchronous processing.
* Practical experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure, plus Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code.
* Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, OWASP risks, encryption, secrets management, network security, and secure SDLC practices.
* Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, observability, vulnerability management, and incident response.
* Experience using AI coding assistants or agentic development tools in real engineering workflows.
* Ability to identify hallucinations, insecure code, missing edge cases, and weak assumptions in AI-generated output.
* Strong problem-solving, ownership, communication, and technical mentoring skills.
* Experience in cryptocurrency, fintech, trading, payments, wallets, or other high-integrity financial systems is a plus.
* Knowledge of blockchain systems, smart-contract risks, custody, wallet security, and transaction monitoring is a plus.
* Familiarity with NIST, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, SOC 2, or comparable security frameworks is a plus.
* Experience with SIEM, SAST, DAST, CSPM, vulnerability scanners, penetration testing, and security automation is a plus.
* Experience designing controls for idempotency, reconciliation, balance integrity, progressive rollout, and recovery is a plus.
* Contributions to security tooling, open-source projects, technical writing, or responsible vulnerability disclosure are a plus.

title: Incident Responder
description:
**SOC Incident Responder (DFIR Specialist)**

We are looking for an Incident Responder to join our Security Operations Center (SOC) and lead the response when a security breach occurs. In this role, you will investigate major, complex incidents escalated from Tier-2 analysts, contain active threats, and ensure attackers are fully eradicated from enterprise environments.

**Job Description**

• Lead security incidents from initial confirmation through successful remediation, executing rapid-containment playbooks under time pressure

• Plan and execute targeted eradication, including removing web shells, persistence mechanisms, rogue admin accounts, and malware payloads

• Partner with IT Infrastructure and Disaster Recovery teams to guide safe, verified restoration of business systems after a breach

• Perform forensic collection on Windows, Linux, and macOS endpoints (memory captures, MFT extraction, and other system artifacts)

• Reconstruct multi-stage attack timelines by correlating telemetry across cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), identity, network firewall, and application layers

• Conduct behavioral malware analysis to identify IoCs, C2 infrastructure, and attacker capabilities

• Author Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and Post-Incident Reports (PIR) for executive leadership and compliance auditors

• Turn findings from real incidents into automated response playbooks in the SOAR platform

• Maintain strict chain-of-custody and evidentiary standards to support regulatory disclosures, insurance claims, or legal actions

• Participate in the critical incident on-call rotation

**Qualifications**

• Minimum 4–6+ years of technical cybersecurity experience, including at least 2–3 years dedicated to Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR)

• Proven experience as a primary responder on major incidents (e.g., ransomware, data exfiltration, business email compromise, cloud tenant hijacking)

• Hands-on experience with forensic tools such as KAPE, Velociraptor, Volatility, FTK Imager, EnCase, or X-Ways Forensics

• Advanced experience with EDR/XDR platforms (CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Cortex XDR) for threat hunting, triage collection, and remote isolation

• Strong log analysis skills using Splunk (SPL), Microsoft Sentinel (KQL), or Elastic Security

• Scripting skills in Python, PowerShell, or Bash

• Solid understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and NIST SP 800-61

• Ability to stay calm under pressure, make decisions independently, and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders

• Disciplined in following playbooks and documenting every step in ticketing systems

• Preferred certifications: GCIH, GCFA, GCFE, GCDA, or CSIH

title: Controls Engineering Specialist – Power Generation
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

Technical Solutions Director

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**
----------------------------------

In this role, you will have the opportunity to lead the design, migration, implementation, and commissioning of advanced control systems for power generation facilities across the region. Acting as the technical bridge between ABB engineering teams and customers, you will own application-specific control solutions from concept through commissioning while ensuring safe, reliable, and high-performance plant operations.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite.

  

You will be mainly accountable for:

* Developing application-specific control solutions for gas turbines, steam turbines, generators, balance-of-plant, and auxiliary systems.
* Preparing control philosophies, functional design specifications, control narratives, logic diagrams, and I/O lists to meet customer and project requirements.
* Configuring, programming, and testing DCS and PLC systems, HMI graphics, alarm management functions, and historians.
* Leading migration projects from legacy or competitor control systems to ABB platforms, including ABB Ability™ Symphony Plus, System 800xA, AC 800M, and Freelance.
* Performing control system audits, gap analyses, risk assessments, and migration planning activities.
* Translating and re-engineering control logic, sequences, interlocks, and protection schemes into ABB architectures while maintaining or enhancing plant performance.
* Developing cutover and commissioning strategies that minimize operational risk and plant outage durations.
* Leading site commissioning activities including system energization, loop checks, functional testing, protection testing, control tuning, startup support, and performance verification.
* Coordinating commissioning teams, subcontractors, and vendor specialists to ensure project objectives are achieved safely, on schedule, and to quality standards.
* Troubleshooting and resolving complex hardware, software, networking, and system integration issues in field environments.
* Serving as the primary technical contact for customers during project execution, commissioning, and post-commissioning support.
* Delivering technical training, documentation, and system handover support to customer operations and maintenance teams.
* Supporting ABB's commitment to health, safety, environmental compliance, and continuous improvement.

You will join a supportive and high-performing team of controls and automation professionals, where collaboration, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence are valued. Together, we deliver complex power generation projects while helping each other grow and succeed.

**Qualifications for the role**
-------------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 8-12+ years of controls engineering experience within power generation environments.
* Proven experience implementing and commissioning DCS, PLC, or turbine control systems, including loop checks, functional testing, startup support, and performance verification.
* Strong understanding of industrial control system architectures, industrial networking, SCADA systems, HMI development, and instrumentation fundamentals.
* Ability to interpret P&IDs, electrical single-line diagrams, control narratives, and logic diagrams.
* Experience with ABB Ability™ Symphony Plus, System 800xA, AC 800M, Freelance, or ABB Advant platforms is highly desirable.
* Experience migrating GE, Siemens, Emerson, Honeywell, or Woodward control systems is advantageous.
* Familiarity with turbine control systems such as GE Mark V/VI/VIe, Siemens SPPA-T3000, and Woodward NetCon/MicroNet is beneficial.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound engineering decisions in demanding site environments.
* Demonstrated ability to lead site activities and effectively engage with customers and multidisciplinary project teams.
* Willingness to travel regularly and undertake extended site assignments in line with project and commissioning schedules.
* Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity principles and standards such as NERC CIP is an advantage.
* ABB certifications, PMP certification, FE/PE licensure, or other relevant industry certifications are preferred.

**More about us**
-----------------

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models.
