title: Product Builder
description:
**Responsibilities**

* Build the VidioGen product surface end to end: prompt composition, waiting states, result gallery, iteration, share and export. Both the design and the implementation.
* Design the prompting experience for people who don't know how to write prompts: presets, templates, examples, and repair patterns. Raising the first-attempt success rate is the core metric of this role.
* Integrate and orchestrate the video models: handling asynchronous jobs, queues, timeouts, retries, and partial failures in ways that stay honest with the user.
* Build evaluations that are simple but real, so that "did this change make the output better" is a question we answer with evidence rather than instinct.
* Own the cost and latency numbers. Know what a generation costs, where quota leaks, and how to trade quality against speed and margin.
* Work with legal and content operations to build the trust and safety path: prompt and output moderation, likeness and copyright handling, provenance, and Indonesian regulatory compliance.
* Instrument the product and read the data yourself: the funnel from first open to first shared result, retry rates, and the point where people give up waiting.
* Build rough prototypes fast to settle arguments. When the team is stuck between two directions, you build both and let the results talk.
* Bring user signals back into the roadmap, not just complaints, but the patterns in where people stumble and what would unlock the next stage of adoption.

**Requirements**

* 4+ years building digital products, and you're strong in at least two of these three: product design, product management, engineering.
* You write production code for product surfaces: TypeScript, React or Next.js, genuinely careful HTML/CSS, and you're comfortable with asynchronous patterns like jobs, polling, webhooks, and streaming.
* You've built on top of a foundation model API before, in any modality, and you've dealt with rate limits, failures, and per-call cost as product problems rather than someone else's problems.
* You use AI coding tools daily and have shaped your own workflow around them and you can explain every line you send to production.
* You have an eye for moving images. You can look at two generations and articulate why one is publishable and the other isn't.
* You care about the states most people skip: waiting, failing, empty, half-finished, and queued.
* You have a view on when AI shouldn't be used inside the product and inside your own process.
* You can walk through at least two things you shipped end to end: what the problem was, what you cut, and what happened.
* You're comfortable in a fast-moving problem space with no template to copy, and you'd rather ship something small this week than something complete next quarter.
* You treat product abuse as a design problem, not another team's problem.

title: Data Center - L3 Support Engineer
description:
**About Nebius:**

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

### **The role**

We are building our L3 Support Line from scratch to serve as the datacenter center of expertise for servers, firmware (BIOS/BMC), and deep Linux diagnostics across APAC.

This is a senior technical role focused on deep investigations, cross-site pattern detection, and driving permanent fixes with R&D and ODM vendors. You will turn complex incidents into scalable solutions and elevate L1/L2 capabilities through strong technical enablement.

### **Your responsibilities will include:**

**Deep Technical Investigation (Primary Focus)**

* Lead root cause analysis beyond L2 depth (GPU failures, firmware issues, Linux-level faults, HW/SW interactions).
* Detect recurring patterns across sites and convert findings into durable fixes.
* Own technical workstreams during high-severity incidents.

**Vendor & R&D Collaboration**

* Build evidence packs and drive escalations with ODM and R&D.
* Push for firmware, component, and platform-level resolutions.
* Track outcomes and ensure knowledge flows back to operations.

**Firmware & Platform Readiness (BIOS/BMC)**

* Support validation and rollout of firmware updates (risk assessment, staging, rollback planning).
* Help operationalize platform standards across datacenters.

**Knowledge & Enablement**

* Create scalable runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and error catalogs.
* Turn investigations into playbooks that elevate L1/L2 teams.

**Hands-on Support (As Needed)**

* Travel to datacenters for complex troubleshooting, new platform readiness, or incident containment.

**We expect you to have:**

* Strong hands-on experience with datacenter servers and deep Linux troubleshooting.
* Ability to diagnose across hardware, BIOS/BMC firmware, and Linux (logs, drivers, storage basics, performance triage).
* Structured incident response experience and clear communication under pressure.
* Experience driving evidence-based escalations with vendors/R&D.
* Fluent English (written and spoken).

**It will be** **an added bonus** **if you have:**

* Strong familiarity with GPU server platforms and tooling (for example: nvidia-smi, dcgmi, Linux logs correlation).
* Experience with ipmitool and Redfish workflows, firmware lifecycle, and staged rollouts.
* Scripting skills (bash and basic Python) for log collection, triage automation, and simple reliability analysis.
* Exposure to OCP-based platforms and ODM manufacturing ecosystems.
* Experience supporting enterprise bare metal customers under contractual SLAs.

**Benefits & Perks:**

* Competitive compensation
* Career growth and learning opportunities
* Flexibility and ownership
* Collaborative and innovative culture
* Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
* International environment and talented teams

**What's it like to work at Nebius:**

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

**Equal Opportunity Statement:**

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer - Indonesia
description:
**About the Job**

**Experience Required:**
1-4 years of hands-on experience in engineering, prompt engineering, conversational AI, solutions engineering or a similar role. Strong freshers with proof of work are welcome. Native or near-native Bahasa Indonesia is a must.

**About the Role**

Arrowhead builds enterprise voice AI agents that hold real conversations with customers at scale: sales, onboarding, renewals, collections and support calls for banks, lenders, insurers, edtech and consumer brands.

As a Forward Deployed Engineer (Bahasa Indonesia), you’ll build, launch and improve these agents for our clients. You sit between the client and the platform: you understand the business goal, design the conversation, build it on Arrowhead’s stack, and own whether it converts once it’s live. This is an engineering role with a strong product edge. You’ll be judged on the quality and outcomes of the agents you ship, not on how many you ship.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Join client discovery calls to understand the use case, the customer journey and the target metric (usually conversion)
* Listen to real call recordings and turn them into requirements: what customers ask, how they object, where calls drop
* Write and structure prompts, conversation flows, transitions and function calls on Arrowhead’s platform
* Write agent dialogue in Bahasa Indonesia that sounds like a real person on the phone, in the tone customers actually use
* Handle the hard parts of live voice: interruptions, silence, hold requests, misheard numbers, dates and names, off-script questions and early hang-ups
* Integrate client APIs and data (lead details, eligibility checks, payment links, CRM updates) with support from the platform team
* Choose and tune voices, pronunciation and pacing for the audience
* Test agents end to end with the QA team before go-live, against real customer scenarios
* Debug live calls using transcripts, flow logs and event logs. Find the root cause and fix it
* Track call outcomes and conversion, spot patterns in failed or dropped calls, and iterate on the flow
* Work directly with client teams on reviews and change requests, and push back with reasons when a request would hurt the customer experience or the metric
* Feed product gaps and platform issues back to the product and engineering teams

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 1-4 years in engineering, prompt engineering, conversational AI, solutions engineering or a similar hands-on role (strong freshers with proof of work welcome)
* Native or near-native Bahasa Indonesia, spoken and written. You can tell when a sentence sounds translated, and you fix it so it sounds like everyday conversation
* Strong written and spoken English
* Technical foundation: comfortable reading and writing basic code (Python or JavaScript), and working with JSON, APIs and logs
* Hands-on with LLMs: you’ve built something with prompts or AI agents and can explain why you designed it that way
* Problem solving: you can take a vague failure (“the bot sounds weird”, “conversions dropped”) and find the cause
* Attention to detail: a wrong number format or an awkward greeting matters to you
* High ownership: you follow a problem through to the fix, including the unglamorous parts

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with voice AI, speech-to-text or text-to-speech systems
* Familiarity with BFSI, lending, insurance, edtech or e-commerce customer journeys
* Experience in sales, telecalling, customer support or another client-facing role
* A portfolio, GitHub, demo or write-up of something you’ve built

**What We’re Looking For**

* Someone who starts from the user and the outcome, not the feature. We care most about whether your agents sound human in Bahasa Indonesia and actually convert, so strong language instinct and ownership matter more to us than years on paper.

**Apply here:**

title: Android Developer
description:
We are looking for a skilled Android Developer to join the technology team of a leading Online Travel Agency (OTA) with a strong presence in the travel industry.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing, enhancing, and maintaining high-quality Android applications that deliver seamless booking experiences to customers. This role requires a strong understanding of mobile application development, performance optimization, and building scalable applications that support high volumes of users and transactions.

**Please note:**
This is a fully remote position. The selected candidate will work remotely from their current country of residence and will not be required to relocate.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain high-quality Android applications using Kotlin and modern Android development frameworks.
* Build and enhance mobile features supporting flight, hotel, and other travel-related booking services.
* Develop seamless and user-friendly experiences throughout the customer journey, from searching and booking to payment and post-booking services.
* Integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services to support application functionality.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers, backend developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to deliver reliable mobile solutions.
* Optimize application performance, responsiveness, scalability, and stability.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues and bugs.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code, following industry best practices.
* Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure application security, data protection, and compatibility across different Android devices and versions.
* Contribute to the continuous enhancement of the mobile application based on customer feedback, business needs, and evolving technology trends.

**Job Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* 2-4 years of professional experience in Android application development.
* Strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java.
* Solid knowledge of Android SDK, Android Studio, and modern Android development practices.
* Experience with Jetpack Compose and/or XML-based UI development.
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, JSON, and third-party integrations.
* Experience with MVVM architecture, clean architecture principles, and dependency injection.
* Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.
* Knowledge of application testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
* Understanding of mobile application security and best practices.
* Experience publishing and maintaining applications on Google Play.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a distributed, multicultural team.

title: Business Analyst
description:
**(\*\_**Job Description**\_\*):**

* Menganalisis pencapaian penjualan (*actual sales vs target sales*) di seluruh gerai dan brand F&B SNN secara harian, mingguan, dan bulanan.
* Melakukan analisis akar masalah (*root cause analysis*) untuk gerai atau brand yang mengalami penurunan performa/profitabilitas.
* **Pengendalian Biaya & Profitabilitas (*****Cost Control*****):**
* Memantau dan mengevaluasi rasio biaya utama (*Food Cost*, *Labor Cost*, *Rent Cost*, dan *Operating Expenses*) agar sesuai dengan batas *budget* perusahaan.
* Menganalisis laporan Laba Rugi (*P&L*), *COGS*, *sales mix*, serta variansi persediaan (*waste & inventory variance*).
* **Evaluasi Program Promo & Pemasaran:**
* Menganalisis efektivitas dan keuntungan dari program promosi/diskon (*incremental sales* & *contribution profit*) guna memastikan promo berdampak positif pada *bottom-line* laba bersih.
* **Rekonsiliasi & Audit Data:**
* Melakukan validasi dan rekonsiliasi data antara tim *Finance* dan *Operation* (terkait data *food cost*, transaksi, dan persediaan) sebelum disajikan ke tingkat Direksi.
* **Dukungan Kelayakan Ekspansi (*****Feasibility Study*****):**
* Menyusun proyeksi *sales* & profit, analisis titik impas (*Break-Even Point / BEP*), dan *payback period* untuk pembukaan gerai baru.
* **Pelaporan Strategis:**
* Menyajikan dasbor performa, laporan analitis berkala, serta memberikan rekomendasi bisnis strategis kepada Manajemen & Direksi.

**Kualifikasi (*****Requirements*****):**

* **Pendidikan:** Minimal S1 Statistika, Matematika, Teknik Industri, Akuntansi, Keuangan, Manajemen Bisnis, atau bidang terkait.
* **Pengalaman Kerja:** Minimal 1–2 tahun pengalaman sebagai Business Analyst, Cost Controller, atau Financial Analyst (diutamakan dari industri **F&B,** ***Retail*****, atau** ***Multi-Outlet***).
* **Keahlian Teknis (*****Hard Skills*****):**
* Mahir dalam analisis laporan Laba Rugi (*P&L*), *COGS*, *Sales Mix*, dan margin kontribusi.
* Penguasaan Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut (Pivot Table, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, *Data Modeling*).
* Terbiasa dengan sistem POS restoran, ERP F&B, dan *tools visualisasi data* (Power BI, Tableau, atau Looker Studio).

**Keahlian Interpersonal (*****Soft Skills*****):**

* Memiliki pola pikir analitis dan kemampuan pemecahan masalah berbasis data (*data-driven mindset*).
* Kemampuan komunikasi dan presentasi yang baik kepada pihak operasional maupun Direksi.
* Detail, jujur, teliti, serta mampu bekerja dengan tenggat waktu yang ketat.

**Benefit & Fasilitas:**

* Gaji Pokok & Tunjangan Kompetitif
* BPJS Ketenagakerjaan & BPJS Kesehatan (Kelas 1)
* Fasilitas Kerja Pendukung (Laptop Perusahaan)
* Lingkungan Kerja Dinamis & Peluang Pengembangan Karier Terstruktur

* Apakah Usia anda maksimal 35 th ?

description:
**About The Job Cybersecurity Operations Centre (Jakarta)**
**Meratus Group**
is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centers.
  
  
At Meratus, we are committed to digitalization, innovation, and transformation, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our customer-centric approach and agile operations empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.
  
  
We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive workplace, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.
  
  
**Position Overview**
﻿﻿We are seeking a detail-oriented SOC Officer to defend our digital perimeter. You will monitor real-time event telemetry, perform threat hunting, and investigate anomalous behaviors to contain and neutralize potential cybersecurity threats before they impact operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* ﻿﻿Security Monitoring: Perform continuous monitoring and triage of security events and alerts generated by SIEM, EDR, NDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, and cloud security environments.
* Incident Investigation & Triage: Investigate suspected cybersecurity alerts, conduct root-cause analysis, and initiate incident response playbooks for containment, eradication, and recovery.
* Threat Hunting & Intelligence: Actively hunt for hidden adversaries, analyze indicators of compromise (IOCs), and integrate real-time threat intelligence feeds into detection systems.
* Detection Engineering: Create, maintain, and test security monitoring use cases, detection rules, and automated SOAR response playbooks.
* Reporting & Drills: Prepare detailed incident reports, compile operational security metrics for dashboards, and actively participate in cyber simulation drills and forensics.

**Requirements**

* ﻿﻿Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Information Security, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience working within an enterprise Security Operations Center (SOC).
* Hands-on experience configuring and analyzing SIEM logs (Splunk, QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, etc.), EDR solutions, and firewall rule behaviors.
* Solid understanding of network protocols, operating system forensics (Windows/Linux), and the MITRE ATT&CK framework.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and script writing skills (Python, Bash, or PowerShell).﻿

title: Senior SRE
description:
**POSITION SUMMARY:**

AccelByte is building a 24x7 operations team for AAA multiplayer video games. In this position, we need a driven Site Reliability Engineer who can actively participate in the day-to-day combat by maintaining high reliability of our service and drive prioritization in fixing what may be broken today, as well as able to envision, design, and implement processes and technologies to improve the ability to identify, isolate, correlate, and mitigate service impacting problems in the system. The Site Reliability Engineer must also know some coding to automate routine tasks in service metrics gathering, correlating, organizing, and presenting, in addition to detail and in-depth root cause analysis

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES:**

The Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) is accountable for the following functions and responsibilities:

* Design, build and maintain high-performance backend services, tools, and control planes to automate operations and improve system reliability.
* Architect, implement and maintain a highly scalable deployment framework and tooling that improves our products' stability, reliability, and availability.
* Build and run service deployment using K8s and other CNCF projects
* Provide a secure, high-scalable, and cost-effective cloud platform
* Construct and build effective systems to monitor the health of our system/applications, and to handle outages
* Solve problems occurring in all our environments and create solutions to prevent them from happening again
* Produce automation and innovative tools to assist the product development teams and to deliver operational excellence
* Create and maintain infrastructure-related documentation and SRE runbooks
* Collaborate with other stakeholders to provide cost-effective, operational excellence, and performance-efficient infrastructure solutions to improve our products.
* Identify technology, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement
* Liaise, communicate, and work directly with our clients
* Perform any other design-related duties as required
* Envision, design, and implement AIOps solutions to enhance operational efficiency and predictive maintenance.
* Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code (primarily in Go/Python) for core platform components.

**QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED**

* 5+ years Cloud Engineering or DevOps experience with AWS, 2+ years Kubernetes, Certification in AWS preferred
* Degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Deep knowledge of cloud service providers and best practices around implementation and configuration, preferably managing AWS and Kubernetes
* Familiarity with infrastructure management and operations lifecycle concepts and ecosystem, deep understanding of IaC and GitOps
* Proven track record of building infrastructure as code (Terraform is a must), configuration management, and package manager (eg: Helm Chart)
* Experience in delivering products against a plan in a fast-paced, multi-disciplined, and often ambiguous environment
* Experience working independently to design, plan, and execute technical projects
* Demonstrated deep knowledge of technical program management and engineering best practices
* Innovative thinking balanced with a strong customer and quality and cost efficiency focus
* Comfort and experience with cross-organizational communication; excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Working experience with some of the following technologies and tools: Docker, Kubernetes, git, Redis, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch, GitLab CI, Nexus, SonarQube, Terraform, Helm, Prometheus, ELK/EFK, Grafana, CloudWatch
* Solid security best practices
* Strong proficiency in Go, including the ability to conduct high-quality code reviews. Experience with Python and Bash is also required.
* Keen problem-solving skills with the ability to work under pressure (during a production event)
* Flexibility in working with people with different timezones
* Experience with AIOps and building/harnessing AI tools to automate and optimize operational tasks.

**QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE PREFERRED**

* Previous experience working in the game industry
* Working experience with one or more of the following: Emissary, Linkerd, Istio, Nomad, Kafka, Flux, ArgoCD, GitOps, DevSecOps
* Familiar with web services patterns/architectures, e.g. REST, SOAP, etc.
* Experience working with auto-scaling workloads both in containers and VMs
* Experience with other cloud technologies and infrastructure: GCP, Azure
* Experience with Confluence, Jira, and BitBucket
* IT standards, methodologies, Cryptographic key management regulations, and audit experience would be asset(s).

description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Role**
As a Data Engineer in the Lending Data Engineering team, you will collaborate with a diverse group of stakeholders across Southeast Asia. This group includes data modelers, product analysts, product managers, software engineers, and business leaders. You will design and manage scalable, end-to-end data solutions across acquisition, storage, processing, and consumption. These solutions will utilize technologies like Flink, Airflow, Spark, Kafka, and Trino. You will report directly to the Data Engineering Manager, with a full-time onsite working arrangement in our Jakarta Office.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Build and maintain scalable batch, real-time, and event-driven ETL pipelines using core AWS services (Glue, Redshift, Athena, Lambda, S3, EMR, Kinesis, MSK).
* Design and deploy modern data lifecycle frameworks supporting streaming, API-based, serverless, and batch consumption directly on the data lake.
* Establish robust data checks, automated cleansing routines, and governance best practices using tools like AWS Glue DataBrew to ensure high data reliability.
* Monitor, maintain, and optimize data platform infrastructure to guarantee high availability, low latency, and accurate, timely delivery of key business metrics.
* Master and leverage in-house data platform tools alongside native AWS technologies to streamline pipeline setup, execution, and real-time metric tracking.
* Collaborate across engineering teams to translate real-time data availability into actionable business definitions, driving data-informed decision-making.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* 6+ years building scalable, fault-tolerant, and mission-critical data pipelines.
* Proficiency in Python, Scala, or Java; strong SQL, schema design, and data modeling skills.
* Expertise in big data frameworks (Flink, Spark, Trino, Airflow, Kafka) across SQL, NoSQL, and Columnar databases.
* Hands-on experience with AWS services (S3, EMR, Redshift, Athena, Glue, Kinesis) and event-driven architectures (SNS, SQS, Lambda).
* Experience for analytical. Experience communicating updates and resolutions to customers and other partners with a drive to learn and innovate.
* Degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Solid grasp of Data Structures, Algorithms, or Machine Learning concepts.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

description:
At Paystone, we build technology that helps businesses strengthen customer relationships and drive sustainable growth. Our integrated suite of payment and software solutions brings together payment processing, loyalty, gift cards and reputation marketing, supporting thousands of merchants across North America.
  
  
As part of Paystone’s suite of products,
**DataCandy**
powers gift card and loyalty programmes for thousands of merchants. Every activation, redemption and top-up generates valuable data that can be transformed into meaningful insights about client performance, customer engagement and growth opportunities.
  
  
We are looking for an
**Analytics Engineer**
to bring this data together and turn it into trusted, actionable insights that help our Customer Success and Account Management teams make informed decisions, identify opportunities and better support our clients.
  
  
The Role
  
  
This is a hands-on, build role, where you will help establish and own DataCandy’s customer data foundation. You will centralise product, client, commercial and lifecycle data in Databricks, develop consistent business metrics, and surface meaningful insights through Salesforce to help teams identify opportunities, risks and priorities.

title: Software Asset & License Management Analyst
description:
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.

The primary purpose of the role:

Assure RUN activities related to software licenses.

Key Responsibilities & Tasks:

* Process requests for software license provisioning and/or activation keys (for end users (Desktop/Workstations), but also for Tribe/Squad IS-IT for infrastructure and application licenses)
* Follow up with requesters if information is incomplete or inconsistent

* Trigger the relevant license procurement activities as needed
* Determine the licenses required
* Request quotations from publishers or distributors
* Perform the first level review/verification of quotations
* Initiate purchase requests
* Manage the related actions/activations on the publisher portals
* Record the corresponding allocations
* Track orders placed with suppliers - Follow up as necessary
* Receive deliveries in the ERP
* Record the license assets/entitlements acquired by IS-IT
Monitor key asset milestones (e.g., renewals)* alert PO(s) and collect renewal decisions
* Manage the software reference catalog for end-user workstations
* Register new references
* Update (including bulk updates) the reference catalog to reflect changes/reorganization of workstation environments
* Manage obsolescence in the reference catalog
* Maintain the standardization reference (raw inventory findings mapped to normalized versions)
* Document and update operating procedures
* Produce periodic service reports /KPI

***Skills Required***

**Professional Experience**

* Experience in handling IT requests (ideally in supply chain of software licenses or IT components)

**Technical Skills**

* Ability to manipulate data (recording, querying, analytics, etc.) in an asset management tool and/or CMDB
* Ability to understand the nature of the request and identify inconsistencies
* Knowledge of the main licensing metrics is required
* Ability to handle the sequencing/workflow of an IT request (set the right values to ensure the correct processing path)
* Advanced proficiency in an analytics tool (e.g., Power BI)

**Soft Skills**

* Autonomy in a time-zone-shifted management (while staying within the guidelines).
* Ability to interact with counterparts remotely.
* Ability to escalate appropriately (strong analytical and problem-solving skills).
* Ability to produce concise reporting.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to effectively manage relationships with resellers, vendors, and external service providers.

Educational Qualification

* Junior - Master’s or engineering degree.

Values & Behaviors

* Good organizational abilities and Good interpersonal skills
* We also attach great importance to Soft skills, adaptability, openness and continuous improvement.
* Your autonomy and your taste for teamwork, your rigor and curiosity are all qualities that we value every day.

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: PPIC Supervisor / Senior PPIC Specialist
description:
**POSITION PURPOSE**

The PPIC Supervisor / Senior PPIC Specialist is the operational control tower of the factory. This role owns production scheduling, material planning, inventory accuracy, and cross-functional coordination across Engineering, Purchasing, Warehouse, Production, and QC. The incumbent translates customer orders and project requirements into executable production plans, ensures material and capacity readiness before work orders are released, and drives on-time delivery performance through daily control of the production floor status.

This is a high-accountability role that requires both analytical discipline and leadership presence. The PPIC Supervisor must operate with complete system discipline, managing all production and inventory data in Katana MRP, tracking open actions in Asana, and maintaining controlled documents in SharePoint. No production movement, material commitment, or schedule change may occur outside these systems.

**CORE RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Production Planning & Scheduling**

* Translate confirmed customer orders and project timelines into detailed, time-phased Master Production Schedules (MPS) in MRP system.
* Verify BOM readiness with Engineering before releasing any production work order; block release if drawings or route sheets are incomplete.
* Confirm machine capacity with Maintenance and labor availability with the Production Manager before scheduling workloads.
* Issue and monitor Work Orders through Katana; track status by production stage (roughmill, assembly, finishing, packing).
* Publish and update the daily production plan; communicate schedule changes to all affected departments with written notice in Asana.
* Prioritize production sequences based on container loading dates, client deadlines, and project criticality.

**2. Inventory Control**

* Maintain real-time inventory accuracy in Katana across all stock categories: raw materials, WIP, finished goods, and hardware/consumables.
* Establish and monitor reorder points for all materials; initiate purchase requests to Purchasing when stock reaches trigger levels.
* Conduct or oversee scheduled physical cycle counts; reconcile variances against Katana records and report discrepancies within 24 hours.
* Prevent stockouts and overstocking; balance material availability against production demand and cash flow constraints.
* Coordinate with Warehouse on inbound receipt, bin assignment, and staging accuracy; ensure Katana reflects actual floor movements in real time.

**3. Material Readiness & Purchasing Coordination**

* Run MRP checks in company sofware for each active project; identify material gaps and communicate purchase requirements to Purchasing with lead time and quantity specifics.
* Monitor supplier delivery ETAs; escalate delays to Operations Management when material arrival threatens the production schedule.
* Validate incoming material quantities and item accuracy against open purchase orders before confirming receipt in Katana.
* Work with Purchasing to align vendor lead times with production start dates; flag mismatches immediately.

**4. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering, Purchasing, Warehouse, Production, Maintenance, and QC.
* Confirm BOM and drawing completeness with Engineering before each new production batch.
* Coordinate with Maintenance on planned and unplanned machine downtime; adjust the production schedule and communicate impact to stakeholders.
* Liaise with QC on inspection hold status; track rework orders in Katana and adjust delivery forecasts accordingly.
* Update the Project Manager / Sales on production progress, estimated completion dates, and any confirmed delays.

**5. Daily Production Control**

* Run a structured daily PPIC review covering: production output versus plan, material ETA, WIP status, QC hold items, and shipping readiness.
* Maintain and distribute the daily production status report; all updates must be reflected in Katana and Asana by end of business each day.
* Identify bottlenecks early; propose and implement corrective actions without waiting for escalation.
* Track container-fill progress; coordinate with Warehouse and Shipping to confirm packing readiness and container loading sequence.

**6. System Discipline & Documentation**

* Company MRP is the system of record for all production and inventory data. All work orders, material receipts, BOM changes, and inventory adjustments must be executed in Current MRP system.
* Asana is the task management platform. All open action items, cross-functional follow-ups, schedule change notifications, and approvals must be documented in Asana.
* SharePoint is the controlled document repository. Approved production schedules, work order records, SOP revisions, and handover documents must be filed in SharePoint.
* No production or procurement action may be taken outside these designated systems. Verbal-only or WhatsApp-only approvals are not acceptable.

**7. Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Prepare weekly PPIC performance reports covering on-time production rate, inventory accuracy, WIP aging, and purchase order fulfillment rate.
* Identify recurring planning failures, material shortages, or scheduling conflicts and propose process corrections with root cause analysis.
* Support capacity planning reviews with production throughput data and constraint analysis.
* Participate in new product development reviews to assess production feasibility, cycle time estimates, and material planning requirements.

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

**KPI**

**Target**

On-Time Production Rate (vs. MPS)

≥ 90% monthly

Inventory Record Accuracy (Katana vs. Physical)

≥ 98% per cycle count

Work Order Release Lead Time (from BOM clearance)

≤ 1 business day

Material Stockout Events (production-stopping)

0 per month

Daily Production Report Completion (Katana + Asana)

100% by end of business daily

Container Fill Rate (shipped units vs. planned)

≥ 95% per container

QC Hold Backlog Resolution

≤ 3 business days per hold item

Cycle Count Discrepancy Reporting

100% reported within 24 hours

**INTERNAL COORDINATION RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Function**

**PPIC Coordination Point**

**Engineering**

BOM and drawing readiness confirmation; ECO notification; route sheet receipt before work order release

**Purchasing**

Material requirements with lead times; purchase request initiation; delivery ETA monitoring

**Warehouse**

Inbound receipt validation; inventory bin accuracy; staging and packing readiness for shipping

**Production**

Work order issuance; daily output tracking; bottleneck identification and schedule adjustment

**Maintenance**

Machine capacity confirmation; downtime notification; schedule impact communication

**QC**

Inspection clearance status; rework order tracking; hold resolution timeline

**Project Manager / Sales**

Production progress updates; delivery date commitments; confirmed delay notification

**QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS**

**Education**

* Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Management, or a closely related field.
* Equivalent combination of education and demonstrated professional experience will be considered.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3 years of progressive experience in a PPIC, production planning, or operations coordination role within a manufacturing environment.
* Experience in furniture, wood products, or custom-order manufacturing is strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working with MRP or ERP systems in a production setting. Katana MRP experience is a significant advantage.
* Exposure to export-oriented or container-loading production environments is preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in MRP/ERP system operation (Katana preferred); ability to create and manage work orders, BOMs, and inventory records.
* Intermediate Microsoft Excel capability; able to build and maintain production trackers, material requirement summaries, and KPI dashboards.
* Working knowledge of BOM structures, route sheets, and manufacturing process flows.
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and production specifications.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* High ownership orientation: this role sets the operational tempo for the factory. The incumbent must be proactive, not reactive.
* Analytical and detail-oriented; able to identify material and schedule risks before they become production stoppages.
* Clear, direct communicator; comfortable delivering difficult updates to Production, Purchasing, and Management without delay.
* Disciplined system user; does not route-around designated platforms or maintain shadow tracking outside Katana and Asana.
* Growth mindset; actively identifies process gaps and proposes structured improvements without being prompted.

Experience:

* PPIC in Furniture Manufacturing: 10 years (Required)
* Managerial in Furniture Manufacturing: 10 years (Required)

Language:

* English (Required)

Work Location: In person

-----------------------

* Merencanakan, mengoordinasikan, dan melakukan verifikasi atas pelaksanaan stock opname rutin maupun mendadak di seluruh unit usaha, termasuk memastikan prosedur perhitungan berjalan sesuai SOP serta melakukan validasi atas hasil perhitungan fisik dibandingkan data sistem.
* Menganalisis selisih stok, tingkat shrinkage, waste percentage, serta pergerakan barang secara mendalam untuk mengidentifikasi pola ketidaksesuaian, potensi fraud, kesalahan operasional, atau kelemahan kontrol internal yang memerlukan tindakan korektif.
* Menyusun, mengevaluasi, serta memperbarui Standard Operating Procedure terkait penerimaan barang, penyimpanan, pengeluaran, transfer antar outlet, retur, serta disposal barang guna memastikan proses inventory berjalan terstandarisasi dan terdokumentasi dengan baik.
* Melakukan analisis terhadap aging stock, slow moving item, dan dead stock melalui perhitungan inventory turnover ratio serta memberikan rekomendasi optimalisasi stok guna menjaga efisiensi modal kerja dan menghindari potensi penurunan nilai persediaan.
* Berkolaborasi dengan tim Finance dalam rekonsiliasi nilai persediaan dan COGS, dengan Purchasing dalam perencanaan pembelian berbasis data konsumsi aktual, serta dengan tim operasional untuk memastikan forecasting kebutuhan barang lebih akurat.
* Melakukan investigasi terhadap transaksi tidak wajar, perbedaan signifikan antar periode, atau pola pergerakan barang yang mencurigakan melalui analisis data dan pengecekan lapangan guna mendukung sistem pengendalian internal perusahaan.
* Mengawal implementasi dan penggunaan sistem ERP atau inventory management tools secara optimal, memastikan input data dilakukan secara disiplin, serta memberikan rekomendasi peningkatan sistem untuk mendukung akurasi dan efisiensi pelaporan.

title: Account Manager (Full-time, Remote)
description:
**Company Description**

Kata.ai is an Indonesian Conversational Artificial Intelligence company with a focus on creating technology to enhance the understanding of human conversations, improving the way humans collaborate with machines. Kata.ai’s Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology powers MultiPurpose chatbots (virtual customer service / virtual friend) for major corporations in Indonesia across different kinds of industries such as Unilever (FMCG), Telkomsel (Telco), Bank BRI (Financial Services), and Alfamart (Retail).

The company’s proprietary Kata Bot Platform can be leveraged to create feature-rich chatbots on top of Kata.ai’s robust and scalable AI technology platform, ensuring company of any size can easily build their own chatbot on any messaging platform. With this platform, it is now possible for the business to focus on designing engaging interaction for their customers, while Kata.ai handles all the technology aspects of the chatbots.

Established in 2015, the company has become a trusted partner for major corporations such as Microsoft, Accenture, and Line. In 2020, the company received Series-B funding from TransPacific Technology Fund and MDI Venture.

 **Job Description**

We're looking for a driven **Account Manager** to own and grow a portfolio of key enterprise clients. You'll be at the forefront of our commercial growth — building long-term partnerships, navigating complex sales cycles, and delivering real business impact across industries including FMCG, Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare, and Pharmaceuticals.

This isn't a transactional sales role. You'll work consultatively with VP and C-suite stakeholders, translate our AI-powered solutions into measurable business value, and become a trusted strategic partner to clients who rely on us to help them grow.

 **Qualifications**

**Experience**

* Minimum 7–10 years of proven experience in Account Management, Sales Executive, or a client-facing commercial role
* Demonstrated track record of consistently meeting or exceeding individual revenue targets
* Direct industry experience in one or more of the following is strongly preferred: Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG), Banking & Financial Services, Healthcare & Pharmaceutical Solutions
* Proven track record of managing relationships at VP+ level in enterprise or mid-market B2B settings
* Experience navigating long sales cycles (6–18 months) with multiple senior stakeholders across complex organizations
* Demonstrated experience running Monthly Business Reviews (MBR) or Executive Business Reviews (EBR) with key accounts
* Background in consultative or solution selling environments is a plus

**Qualifications & Education :**

* Bachelor's degree (BSc/BA) in Business Administration, Sales, Marketing, or a related discipline (required)
* Master's degree or postgraduate qualification is an advantage
* Professional certifications in Sales, CRM, or Account Management are a plus (e.g., Salesforce Certified, HubSpot Sales, Strategic Account Management – SAMA)

**Technical Skills :**

* AI Productivity Tools (ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI assistants)
* MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
* CRM Software (Salesforce, HubSpot, or equivalent)
* Sales pipeline management & revenue forecasting
* Data analysis & commercial reporting
* Market research & competitive landscape analysis
* Presentation & proposal tools (Canva, Google Slides, PowerPoint)

**Skills & Competencies :**

* Executive Communication : Comfortable presenting business cases, ROI frameworks, and strategic reviews to executive audiences; able to translate technical solutions into business value language that resonates with non-technical decision-makers
* Communication & Presentation : Able to craft and deliver compelling, tailored narratives to diverse audiences including C-suite and technical stakeholders
* Relationship Management : Builds and sustains trust-based, long-term partnerships with clients at all levels
* Negotiation : Skilled in structuring and closing commercial agreements that create mutual value while protecting company margin
* Business Acumen : Understands market dynamics, client business models, industry trends, and revenue drivers
* Problem Solving : Proactively identifies client issues and proposes practical, client-centered solutions with a sense of urgency
* Organizational Skills : Manages multiple accounts, priorities, and deadlines simultaneously with high attention to detail
* Resilience & Drive : Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to sustain high performance under commercial pressure
* Stakeholder Management : Adept at managing expectations and navigating complex organizational structures both internally and externally

**What We Offer**

* Competitive base salary + performance-based commission & incentive scheme
* Health & medical insurance
* Annual leave & paid time off
* Remote working arrangement *(with regular client visits)*

**This is a remote-friendly role, but we're looking for someone based in Jakarta to stay close to our clients and show up when it matters.**

 **Additional Information**

**We value a flexible working hour for our employees.**

**The most important is we provide a learning experience in Conversational AI Industry.**

title: HSE Specialist
description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

HSE Manager, Southeast Asia

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities**  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to improving Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) performance in your assigned area of responsibility to cultivate a high-performance culture with a strong focus on HSE. Each day, you will support the business by applying in-depth HSE knowledge and offering solutions and advice. You will also showcase your expertise by ensuring effective risk management through HSE excellence along the ABB value chain.  
  
The work model for the role is: #LI-Onsite  
  
This role is contributing to the Automation Energy Industries in Indonesia.

You will be mainly accountable for:

* Reporting HSE incidents to the management and relevant stakeholders and taking appropriate actions.
* Facilitating, assisting, and providing guidance on incident investigations to learn better ways for mitigating risks.
* Providing feedback to the management and employees on lessons learned and best practices from within their own unit and across ABB.
* Supporting and driving behavioral change through the local implementation of group-wide and business-specific performance improvement programs and practices.

*Our team dynamics*  
Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 3-5 years of HSE experience in industrial automation, energy, oil & gas, power, process industries, or related sectors.
* Strong knowledge of Indonesian HSE regulations, ISO 45001, ISO 14001, and risk management practices.
* Experience conducting HSE audits, risk assessments, incident investigations, and implementing corrective actions.
* Familiarity with project and site-based HSE management, including contractor and permit-to-work systems.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and training facilitation skills.
* Professional certification such as AK3 Umum, SMK3 Auditor, NEBOSH, or equivalent is preferred.

**What's in it for you?**  
We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.  
  
**More about us**

The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Testing & Quality Manager

**Your role and responsibilities**  
  
In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of Medium Voltage Switchgear products through testing, commissioning, and Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) activities. You will support manufacturing operations by performing electrical testing, configuring protection and automation systems, and driving continuous improvement initiatives in a safe and efficient working environment.  
  
**The work model for the role is: #LI-On-site**  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* You will be mainly accountable for Lead Testing and Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) operations for Medium Voltage Switchgear in compliance with IEC 62271 standards, including routine testing, protection relay programming, functional verification, and preparation of test documentation and procedures.
* Conduct Low, Medium, and High Voltage testing using relay test sets, HV, CT, VT, contact resistance, and insulation resistance equipment.
* Perform commissioning, troubleshooting, and validation of protection systems in accordance with IEC and ANSI standards.
* Analyze electrical systems and interpret schematic, single-line, and logic diagrams.
* Manage and support SCADA systems by configuring HMI interfaces, system communications, alarm management, data acquisition, and troubleshooting using protocols such as Modbus, IEC 60870, DNP3, and IEC 61850. Configure, commission, and maintain RTU systems for remote monitoring and control applications, including I/O mapping, signal validation, communication network integration, protocol management, and SCADA connectivity.

**Qualifications for the role**

* Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in MV switchgear testing, FAT, and commissioning. Knowledge of LV, MV, and HV testing, including protection relay testing and troubleshooting.
* Ability to read and interpret schematic, single-line, and logic diagrams. Experience with protection relay programming and IEC/ANSI standards.
* Familiarity with SCADA and RTU systems, including communication protocols such as IEC 61850 and Modbus.
* Strong leadership, problem-solving, and English communication skills.

**What’s in it for you?**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

ABB's Distribution Solutions Division facilitates the efficient and reliable distribution, protection and control of power by improving electric power quality while strengthening the resilience of the grid. title: Senior IT Quality Assurance
description:
**Main Responsibilities**

Lead test strategy, automation and evidence-based quality judgment across core enterprise platforms. Report to the CTO and work with Product, engineers and business experts. You are a hands-on quality lead, with no direct reports at hire. Independent approval requires CTO-recorded lane qualification; an eligible nonauthor approver decides until then. Work you author, including comparators and test infrastructure, receives independent review.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Test strategy and planning**

* Define test plans, entry and exit criteria, environments, test-data needs and execution plans for each assigned scope.
* Align validation priorities with Product, engineering and business experts, making risks and dependencies visible before build.

**Coverage and test design**

* Map every approved requirement revision to test cases, evidence or an explicit gap, blocker or justified exclusion.
* Design positive, negative, boundary, authorization and invariant cases as applicable; return untestable requirements before affected build proceeds.
* Maintain traceability from requirement revision through test evidence and disposition.

**Automation and quality controls**

* Build and improve automated suites, pipeline checks, comparators and replay tools.
* Keep meaningful passing regression tests; document any removal with its reason, replacement or accepted risk.
* Verify AI-generated assertions against sources and record the method used.

**Execution and independent judgment**

* Direct test execution, maintain run records, judge evidence within the qualified approval lane and escalate exceptions through the defined control.
* Arrange independent review of QA-authored approval evidence and keep failed or inconclusive evidence visible.

**Reporting and improvement**

* Investigate failures with reproducible steps, relevant logs and expected versus actual results; coordinate defect triage, verify fixes and add regression coverage for confirmed defects.
* Explain defects, evidence, coverage and open risks clearly to technical and business readers.
* Improve repeatable quality practices, tools and reporting based on defects and delivery evidence.

**Requirements**

* At least 5 years of relevant quality-engineering, test-automation or software-engineering experience, including building and shipping production software.
* Test design from written specifications, including ambiguous, negative, authorization and failure cases.
* Ownership of automated regression in continuous integration and ability to read code and specifications together.
* Hands-on ability to test APIs, data integrity and integration workflows, and to prepare repeatable test data and environments.
* Ability to investigate failures, produce reproducible defect reports and distinguish product defects from test or environment failures.
* Clear written and spoken communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English for technical and business audiences.
* Practical AI proficiency with source verification and documented methodology.
* Judgment that protects necessary quality, security and reconciliation checks under pressure.

**Preferred**

* 7+ years of relevant quality-engineering, test-automation or software-engineering experience.
* Financial-industry experience.
* Security testing or evidence delivery in regulated environments.

**About the team**

Indivara Group is building a small, senior AI-native engineering team for core enterprise platforms. People define and verify the requirements; AI helps build from approved, testable specifications.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
  
  
**We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability Engineer**
Next-gen operations at scale, with pure Python infra-as-code, from bare metal to containers and applications. Our goal is to perfect enterprise infrastructure devops.
  
  
We run hundreds of private cloud, Kubernetes, and application clusters for customers across physical and public cloud estate, and we are raising the bar on what's possible with automation by embracing a universal operator pattern and model-driven operations.
  
  
To succeed in this role you need to believe in automation as a pure software engineering problem, not a hack-it-till-it-works-for-me problem. You need to be interested in the scientific approach to operations at scale, driven by metrics and code, and you need to be able to learn the entire stack, from bare metal networking and kernel up to serverless and open source applications.
  
  
Location: Globally remote role
  
  
**The role entails**
Our cloud operations engineers bring Python software-engineering skills and rigour to the operations domain. We practise devsecops from bare metal to application. We architect and run OpenStack, Kubernetes and software defined storage, and we enable devsecops for applications running on that infrastructure too.
  
  
To become a member of this team, you need to be a software engineer fluent in Python, you need a genuine interest in the full open source infrastructure stack from metal to containers, and you need the ability to work in a high pressure operations environment with mission-critical services for global brand name customers.
  
  
As a member of the team you will gain experience in a broad range of cloud technologies. We evolve our offerings as the state of the art improves, so you get to stay current with the latest capabilities in open source infrastructure. We drive upgrades to keep our customers on the latest, best solutions.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For In You**

* Degree in Software Engineering or Computer Science
* Experience with Linux and familiarity with Linux networking and storage
* Python software development expertise
* Operational experience
* Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
* Ability to travel internationally twice a year, for company events up to two weeks long

**Nice-to-have Skills**

* Experience with OpenStack or Kubernetes deployment or operations
* Familiarity with public or private cloud management

**What We Offer Colleagues**
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
**Canonical is an equal opportunity employer**
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: CE Field Service Engineer
description:
**Overview**

**Business Function Overview:**

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a **CO+I CE Field Service Engineer** (FSE).

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I FSE, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

 **Responsibilities**

As a successful CO+I CE Field Service Engineer, **your success will be measured by:**

***Data Center Operations***

* Ensures compliance with data center business units and service-level policies.
* Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects.
* Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.
* Demonstrates conscientiousness on cost adheres to budget requirements; keeps costs reasonable and contributes to staying within budget.
* Follows and adheres to safety and security policies and procedures. Reports immediately any safety or security issues or concerns.
* Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate.

***Service Delivery***

* Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency
* Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters (MOP/SOP/EOP review, RCAs, FMEAs, change governance, and risk mitigation)
* Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year
* Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives
* Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters
* Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed
* Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring
* Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs)
* Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio

***Data Center Work Environment***

* Shares best practices; assists others in learning role, process, procedures.
* Provides mentorship across data centers for specific expertise.
* Seeks training opportunities that meet the interest of the business as well as own career goals and objectives.
* Suggests ways for reducing risk of performing maintenance; works with others to accommodate scheduling needs.
* Suggests improvements in implementation based on depth of understanding.
* Contributes to a positive team environment by learning and adopting best practices.
* Contributes constructively during team meetings and in cross-disciplinary collaborations within the service team.

***Ownership***

* In alignment with management priorities, holds self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service).
* Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

  
**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent AND 2+ year(s) industry experience in a datacenter or other critical environment facility,
  + OR 3+ years industry experience and college course work.

**Background Check Requirements:**

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

* Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

While not required, we also look for the following***Preferred Qualifications:***

* 3+ years’ experience in Critical Environment infrastructures (e.g., UPS, Generator, AHU)
* Bachelor’s Degree or Technical College certification in mechanical or electrical engineering and/or services
* Experience working on large scale CE projects
* Experience with the operation of IT infrastructure (Servers, SANs, Networking, etc.)

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process**.**

title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
description:
The Canonical Security Operations team is hiring for a Senior or Staff engineer. The Security Operations team is responsible for designing, building, and operating a world-class Security Operations Center, and the successful candidate will provide leadership, mentorship, expertise, and outstanding individual contributions towards those ends.
  
  
**This Role Involves Aspects Of**

* Traditional SOC duties - security monitoring, threat hunting, and response.
* Security engineering - assessing and protecting Canonical platforms and products.
* Software engineering - building custom tools and platforms.
* Site reliability engineering - deploying, maintaining, and automating security tools.

We are looking for individuals with engineering and security experience, as well as a history of remarkable achievement. Senior security operations personnel with engineering experience and senior developers with security experience are equally well-suited to this role.
  
  
Beyond securing Canonical’s digital estate, this position represents a unique opportunity to contribute to the open source ecosystem. Team members may present at industry conferences, share threat intelligence with the wider community, or publish open source security software.
  
  
*Junior positions are also available for less-experienced individuals with a compelling academic or professional background.*
**In This Role, You Will**

* Provide operational and engineering leadership.
* Implement and evolve Canonical’s Security Operations Center.
* Design and develop security software and platforms.
* Monitor for, identify, respond to, and remediate security incidents.
* Assess and improve Canonical’s security controls.
* Mentor early-career Security Operations engineers.
* Plan and deliver work within Canonical's agile engineering framework.
* Contribute to open source security.
* Publish blog posts, whitepapers and conference presentations.

**We Are Looking For**

* An exceptional academic track record.
* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path.
* 10+ years of relevant professional experience
* Professional cybersecurity experience, preferably working or leading a Security Operations Center.
* Professional engineering experience.
* An eagerness to contribute to open source security.
* Proficiency in common scripting languages, such as Python and Bash.
* Knowledge of Git, GitOps, Infrastructure-as-Code, and common orchestration platforms (e.g., Kubernetes)

**Though Optional, We Value**

* Familiarity with security frameworks such as the NIST CSF, CIS CSC, and ISO 27001
* Knowledge of security architecture and market-leading security tools.
* Experience in a security operations team or a security operations center.
* Experience in offensive or defensive security teams with hands-on ability.
* Experience with advanced persistent threats.
* Proficiency in additional programming languages, such as Golang.

**What We Offer You**
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  
  

* Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
* Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
* Annual compensation review
* Recognition rewards
* Annual holiday leave
* Maternity and paternity leave
* Employee Assistance Programme
* Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
* Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

**About Canonical**
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
  
  
**Canonical is an equal opportunity employer**
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.
