title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Insurance
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
At Financial Services, we empower the people of Southeast Asia, from consumers and drivers to every-day entrepreneurs, by ensuring financial inclusion for the underserved. The team is building solutions by enabling our partners (i.e. drivers and merchants) to get access to financial services (lending and insurance) products for their everyday needs.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
You will report to the Engineering Manager, Insurance, based in Indonesia and will develop the complex backend systems powering the many end-to-end user journeys across all Insurance products available in multiple Grab apps. We're looking for candidates that embody ownership, display a hunger for learning and improvement, excel in autonomy, and have the desire to go above and beyond expectations.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* You will develop high-quality and scalable backend applications
* You will write clean, efficient, and maintainable code to solve challenging problems in the InsurTech domain
* You will collaborate with diverse teams to design, and ship new features
* You will participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and share knowledge
* Your comprehensive understanding to troubleshoot, debug complex issues, and provide quick resolutions
* You will contribute to the architectural decisions and technical direction of the projects
* You will participate in On-Call rotations to ensure the reliability of services

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* Years of relevant experience in software development, with proficiency in one of the major programming languages, e.g., Golang (preferred) and Java, relational databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle and code versioning systems like Git
* Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures, and capability to recognise when to use them
* Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, e.g., AWS
* Experience with the clean architecture principles and ability to write extensible code for complex projects following SOLID principles
* Expertise in writing clean, efficient, maintainable code and documentations

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Are you passionate about building scalable data solutions and working with modern cloud technologies? Do you enjoy developing efficient data pipelines, optimizing data workflows, and finding better ways to manage and process complex datasets?

We're looking for a
**Data Engineer**
to join ATI Business Group. In this role, you'll design, develop, and maintain our
**Global Supply data platform**
using
**Databricks and Microsoft Azure**
, building reliable data pipelines and reusable engineering frameworks to support efficient and well-governed data operations.

We're looking for someone with strong hands-on experience in
**Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Azure data services**
, particularly in production environments, who is keen to contribute to the development and continuous improvement of modern data engineering solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines to ingest, transform, and process data from internal and external sources using
  **Databricks**
  and
  **Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, and Gold).**
* Build and manage data ingestion, storage, and orchestration workflows across cloud environments, preferably using
  **Azure Data Factory (ADF)**
  ,
  **Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS)**
  , and
  **Delta Lake**
  .
* Develop and maintain production-ready ETL processes using
  **PySpark, Python, and SQL**
  , ensuring data quality, reliability, and efficient processing.
* **Optimize data pipelines, Spark workloads, and storage solutions**
  to improve performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
* Design and develop
  **reusable, metadata-driven engineering frameworks**
  to standardize data ingestion, transformation, error handling, logging, and data quality processes.
* Implement and maintain
  **CI/CD pipelines**
  , version control, and automated deployment processes using
  **Azure DevOps and Git**
  .
* Collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to understand data requirements, address engineering challenges, and continuously improve data platform capabilities.

**Is this you?**

* Bachelor's degree in
  **Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering**
  , or a related technical field.
* At least
  **3 years of relevant experience**
  in Data Engineering, particularly in developing and maintaining production data pipelines.
* Strong, hands-on experience with
  **Databricks**
  , including
  **Apache Spark, PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog**
  .
* Experience working with cloud platforms such as
  **Microsoft Azure, AWS, or GCP**
  , with Azure experience being highly preferred.
* Familiarity with cloud-based data services and ETL tools, particularly
  **Azure Data Factory (ADF) and Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2 (ADLS)**
  .
* Strong programming skills in
  **Python and SQL**
  , with the ability to develop, troubleshoot, and optimize data processing solutions.
* Experience with
  **Git and CI/CD practices**
  , including version control, branching strategies, and automated deployment of data solutions.
* Good understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and Lakehouse architecture, including
  **Medallion Architecture.**
* Experience designing reusable, metadata-driven data engineering frameworks, with an understanding of modular development, testing, logging, and error handling, is a plus.
* Familiarity with
  **Databricks Lakeflow**
  , including
  **Declarative Pipelines, Jobs, or Connect, is an advantage**
  .
* Exposure to
  **Lakebase, Databricks Apps, or Genie (AI/BI)**
  , or an interest in exploring emerging Databricks technologies, is a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams and stakeholders.

**Be Part of ATI's Journey**

At ATI Business Group, we bring unparalleled knowledge of the travel and hospitality industry to every aspect of our clients' businesses. Through operational expertise, innovative technology, and exceptional talent, we deliver solutions that optimize operations, elevate customer experiences, and accelerate business growth.

Since 2002, we've grown into a global team of 2,000+ professionals, partnering with leading travel and hospitality organizations worldwide. Our people are at the heart of everything we do, helping businesses scale, adapt, and grow while creating meaningful career opportunities along the way.

Join us and help shape the future of travel and hospitality.

title: Data Engineer Senior Associate - Group Service
description:
**Our Company**
Founded in 2020, Seven Retail is a House of Brands focused on making quality lifestyle services more accessible. With over 200 centers and growing, we operate across F&B, Education, Healthcare, and Lifestyle Services.
  
  
We are on a mission to make increasingly higher quality, premium lifestyle services accessible to everyone, helping people get more out of their paycheck so everybody can experience a higher standard of living.
  
  
Ready to take the next step in your career? Join us as a
****Data Engineer Senior Associate - Group Service****
and discover what you can achieve at Seven Retail. Read on to learn more!
  
  
****Your Day-to-Day****

* Architect, deploy, and manage scalable data models and storage structures using Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery.
* Design, develop, and optimize resilient ETL/ELT pipelines to integrate data from CRM systems, LMS, Google Sheets, and advertising platforms such as TikTok Ads, Meta Ads, and Google Ads.
* Build automated workflows to enable reliable real-time or near-real-time data integration across platforms.
* Establish and maintain data standards covering quality, security, privacy, and compliance throughout the data lifecycle.
* Optimize BigQuery query performance, data partitioning, and storage costs to improve infrastructure efficiency.
* Collaborate with Analytics teams to build production-ready data marts and support data visualization best practices using tools such as Apache Superset.
* Drive engineering best practices through CI/CD, version control, automated testing, and technical documentation.

**Who We’re Looking For**

* Minimum 3 years of experience in Data Engineering, Cloud Architecture, or related data platform roles.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Google Cloud Platform (GCP), particularly BigQuery.
* Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, with experience using orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow and transformation frameworks such as Dataform or dbt.
* Advanced knowledge of BigQuery schema design, data warehousing methodologies (Kimball/Inmon), and large-scale data processing.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and developing custom data connectors.
* Strong understanding of data testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, version control, and containerization tools such as Docker.
* Strong ownership and initiative, with the ability to independently drive data engineering projects from architecture to production and guide technical decisions.
* Adaptable and proactive, with the ability to navigate evolving business needs and continuously improve data infrastructure.

title: Senior FinOps Optimization Engineer
description:
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.

FinOps Engineering  
  
You will analyze cloud and platform usage, identify savings opportunities, develop scalable optimization tools, and work directly with IT squads to turn recommendations into measurable results. This role requires a strong combination of cloud engineering, data analytics, automation, financial reasoning, and stakeholder communication.

We are looking for someone who can go beyond dashboards: someone who can explain why an optimization is technically safe, demonstrate how its value was calculated, support its implementation, and verify that the expected benefit was achieved.

If you have hands-on experience with cloud cost optimization, Python or SQL, cloud billing data, automation, and engineering collaboration, we would like to hear from you.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

**Identify optimization opportunities**

Analyze cloud usage, billing, configuration, metrics, and business data to detect opportunities such as:

**Develop optimization tooling and automation**

Design, develop, and maintain tools that identify, prioritize, and track savings opportunities.

**Produce actionable recommendations**

Convert analytical findings into implementation-ready recommendations for users and IT squads

**Explain and defend recommendations**

Present optimization proposals to both technical and non-technical audiences. The key points are the identification and evidences of each recommendation. It is crucial to assess and describe what are the potential impacts and how performance is protected. Then taken decisions facilitated by explanations must be recorded.

**Partner with service or product teams**

Act as a FinOps partner to application, infrastructure, data, AI, and platform teams

**Measure and report optimization outcomes**

Establish transparent metrics and reporting for the optimization lifecycle is the foundation to bring confidence in the decision process.

**Required qualifications**
---------------------------

**Technical experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, finance, data analytics, or a comparable field, or equivalent professional experience
* Typically **10 or more years** of experience in cloud engineering, FinOps, DevOps, cloud architecture, infrastructure operations, data engineering, or technology cost management
* At least **3 years of hands-on experience** identifying and delivering cloud cost optimization opportunities
* Strong practical knowledge of at least one major public cloud platform (Google Cloud Platform, TP-S3NS, Microsoft Azure)
* Practical understanding of cloud pricing, billing, discounts, reservations, commitments, and consumption models
* Ability to analyze large billing and usage datasets using SQL, Python, or comparable technologies
* Experience building automation, analytical tools, dashboards, or data pipelines
* Understanding of Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, APIs, source control, and modern cloud operations
* Ability to interpret operational metrics such as CPU, memory, storage, I/O, latency, throughput, and request volume
* Experience quantifying the financial impact of technical changes
* Understanding of cost allocation, tagging, ownership, shared-cost distribution, showback, and chargeback concepts

**Analytical capabilities**

* Strong data-investigation and root-cause-analysis skills
* Distinguish correlation from a technically actionable cost driver
* Build and validate financial models
* Strong attention to data quality and reconciliation
* Prioritize opportunities based on value, confidence, effort, and risk
* Work with incomplete data and explicitly document assumptions
* Challenge automated recommendations when they conflict with operational reality

**Communication capabilities**

* Professional fluency in written and spoken English
* Produce clear technical and executive-level documentation
* Confidence presenting recommendations to engineers, architects, product owners, managers, procurement, and finance stakeholders
* Explain complex cloud-pricing and architecture concepts in practical business terms
* Facilitate discussions and obtain agreement across teams without direct authority
* Strong listening, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills
* Collaborate effectively with geographically distributed teams, mainly Europe.

**Preferred qualifications**

* Certifications
  + FinOps Certified Practitioner certification
  + FinOps Certified Professional, FinOps Certified Engineer, or FOCUS Analyst
  + Cloud architecture or cost-management from Microsoft or Google Cloud
* Experience about
  + large international, industrial, regulated, or matrix organization
  + multi-cloud cost management
  + optimizing Kubernetes, data platforms, AI workloads, GPUs, or SaaS consumption
  + enterprise tools such as Cloudability, CloudHealth, Flexera, Apptio, ServiceNow, Power BI, or equivalent solutions
  + native services such as Google Cloud Billing, Google Cloud FinOps Hub, Azure Cost Management or Azure Advisor
  + implementing cost controls in Terraform plans or CI/CD pull requests
  + operating in Agile, product-oriented, DevOps
* Knowledge of
  + unit economics and product-level cost attribution
  + software licensing and enterprise agreements
  + sustainability metrics related to technology consumption

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: DevOps Senior RF Systems Engineer
description:
**About Us**
At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space.
  
  
We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
An experienced individual contributor within P&CSE, the Senior RF Systems Engineer delivers complex hands-on technical work across the satellite ground station engineering lifecycle with a high degree of autonomy. This is a purely technical role with no people management responsibilities and no direct reports. The postholder designs, integrates, and tests earth station RF systems; contributes to DiFi (VITA 49) and RFoIP programmes; deploys cloud-based (AWS / GCP) signal processing workloads; maintains DevOps pipelines and IaC modules; and applies AI tools to engineering workflows. The role includes participation in the P&CSE oncall rota. Candidates must be willing and able to fulfil this requirement as a condition of employment.
  
  
**The day-to-day**

* Perform detailed RF system design and analysis: link budgets, G/T, EIRP, linearity, antenna system characterisation across L/S/C/Ku/Ka/Q/V bands.
* Plan, execute, and document FAT, SAT, and IOT test campaigns for new and upgraded earth station RF systems.
* Contribute to DiFi (VITA 49) digitiser chain design, validation, and interoperability testing.
* Contribute to RFoIP encapsulation, QoS, PTP synchronisation, and SDR modem integration activities.
* Develop and maintain CI/CD pipeline stages, IaC modules (Ansible/Terraform), and automated RF test scripts.
* Deploy and support containerised RF signal processing workloads on AWS EKS or GCP GKE.
* Contribute to cloud RF data pipelines using AWS Kinesis / GCP Pub/Sub and post-pass analysis via Athena / BigQuery.
* Apply AI/ML tools to engineering workflows: LLMs for documentation, anomaly detection on RF telemetry, AI-assisted simulation.
* Provide third-line RF support to Operations and NOC, including on-call rota participation.
* Produce and maintain engineering documentation (ICDs, test plans, acceptance reports) to P&CSE quality standards.
* Travel to earth station sites and supplier facilities as required by programme activities.

**What You'll Need**

* 8-12 years ground station system design, integration, and test experience.
* Degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering or Telecommunications.
* Proven hands-on RF expertise across multiple frequency bands with strong link budget and test skills.
* Working knowledge of DiFi/VITA 49, RFoIP, DevOps CI/CD, AWS/GCP, and AI engineering tools.
* Seeking a technical individual contributor role with no people management responsibility.

**What Will Help You On The Job**

* Fully available for P&CSE on-call rota and international travel. Based in or able to commute to London.

**EEO Statement**
Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. If you would like to request an accommodation on the basis of disability for completing this on-line application, please click here.

*Job ID: MJ000451*

  
  

**About the Role**

Traveloka is seeking a Product Operations Specialist to help travellers discover relevant offers and travel packages through accurate execution, performance monitoring and continuous improvement.

Your primary focus will be Cross Sell merchandising, alongside operational support for Bundling Travel Packages. You will manage daily operations, analyze results and test improvements to the customer experience. As you develop familiarity with our products and tools, you will take greater ownership of operational modules and improvements, with guidance from Product Managers and collaboration with Design, Engineering and Data.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**

title: Lead QA
description:
JOB SUMMARY:
  
This job holder must conduct daily factory in-line and final furniture inspections at his assigned factory location. In addition, he must perform any required in-line furniture tests. His/her goal is to ensure proper production controls are being enforced by the vendor’s own QA team; and to correct and trouble shoot any manufacturing, production problems found. He/she must also insure he has adequate staff coverage within each factory.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Must be fair and sound in handling issues while dealing with subordinates.
* Must understand the business, the goals and expectations of the company to its vendors and employees.
* Adapt to AQL inspection my assuring that products are shipped with the same quality level as expected.
* Understand the QA processes of the factory and establish a technical and business rapport with the vendor’s factory production team and line staff.
* Execute daily furniture in-line and final inspections in accordance with WSI procedures.
* Provide accurate and timely quality control reports to your immediate supervisor.
* Keep the QAM well informed of any potential issues that will affect quality or delivery.
* Must have control on references (MCS and MCP’s) or documents (PDS-Product data sheet or weekly production schedule) and make sure the QA team has the latest references and documents.
* Must review the approved reference from the DCP (as signed by finishing engineer or finishing staff), call out any issues of variation and discoloration.
* Must provide full cooperation with the director’s assistant in terms of inputs and information for documentation purposes.
* Must have the right tools to perform the job;
  + Lead a factory QA team and provide a good example.
  + Must be fair and sound in handling issues while dealing with subordinates.
  + Train and coach junior staff to perform their assigned tasks.
  + Cross check production loading and schedules with the vendor’s production team on daily basis in order to ensure adequate WSI QC staffing.
  + Ensure QC staff is properly deployed within the factory to give the best coverage.
  + Assist the QA manager to determine daily/weekly QC manpower arrangements.
  + Ensure required documents/MCS/MCP/Test Reports maintained at the factory level atall times.
  + Follow up on any quality corrective or preventive action plans proposed by WSI or thefactory/vendor and produce verification documents once the process is fixed.
  + Conduct ISTA in-house package drop testing and in-house construction test whenrequired.
  + Attend product handover meetings and pilot runs conducted by the furniture technical team.
  + Understand wood species / glue specifications/board requirements and MC controls.
  + Know how to calibrate your MC pin tester properly.
  + Ensure the testing tools, equipment are properly issued and return.
  Evaluate any direct reports on quarterly and annual basis.

DESIRABLE QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES:

Basic Skills required

* Understand furniture quality control processes and systems.
* Minimum of 3-5 years of wooden furniture manufacturing experience or technica lsupervisory role with proven responsibility for over 2 technical/QC staff working under his/her supervision.
* Able to read and understand engineering drawings with some skills in Auto Cad.
Knowledge of testing tools and furniture production equipment applications.  

General Skills Required

* Effective communication & report writing skills in English communication skill is essential but not necessary.
* Good interpersonal skills.
* Excellent analytical abilities in solving production problem.
* Good eyesight.
* Good leadership capabilities to lead small group of QA team.
* Able to develop and train Quality team.
* Good Initiative, able to work under high pressure working environment
* Team Player, excellent initiative and responsible person

This role will be based in Surabaya/Malang/other East Java area

  

Founded in 1956, Williams-Sonoma, Inc. is the premier specialty retailer of home furnishings in the United States, Canada, Puerto Rico, Australia, United Kingdom and the rest of the world with franchise partnerships. Our family of brands are Williams-Sonoma, Pottery Barn, Pottery Barn Kids, PBteen, West Elm, Williams-Sonoma Home, Rejuvenation, and Mark and Graham. Our passion for high-quality products, functional design, outstanding customer service, enhancing the lives of our customers and the communities remains as our core values.

  

Today, we are a USD 5 billion company, with a multi-brand, multi-channel, global enterprise supported by state-of-the-art technology and some of the most talented teams in retailing - and we're always looking for new energy and ideas.

The South East Asia team is an inclusive employer where we recruit and provide employees with fair opportunities on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status and family responsibilities, or disability.

title: Sales Analytics
description:
**Overview**
The Sales Analytics Specialist is responsible for transforming sales, customer, distribution, and market data into actionable insights to drive business growth and improve commercial performance. This role partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Category Management, Revenue Management, and Supply Chain teams to monitor business performance, identify growth opportunities, and support strategic decision-making through data-driven analysis, reporting, and visualization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyze sales performance across channels, customers, regions, and product categories to identify trends, growth opportunities, and business risks.
* Monitor key commercial KPIs, including net revenue, sales volume, distribution, market share, pricing, promotional performance, and customer profitability.
* Develop and maintain dashboards, executive scorecards, and recurring performance reports using Power BI, Tableau, or similar visualization tools.
* Automate reporting processes and ensure data accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of business insights.
* Analyze point-of-sale (POS), shipment, retailer, distributor, and syndicated market data to evaluate customer performance, pricing, assortment, distribution, and promotional effectiveness.
* Assess trade promotions and marketing initiatives to measure effectiveness and return on investment (ROI).
* Translate complex data into actionable insights and recommendations to improve sales effectiveness, commercial performance, and revenue growth.
* Partner with Sales, Category Management, Revenue Management, Marketing, and Supply Chain teams to support business reviews, annual planning, forecasting, and commercial strategy development.
* Extract, transform, validate, and reconcile data from multiple sources using SQL and other analytical tools.
* Continuously improve reporting processes, maintain KPI definitions and business rules, and support data-driven decision-making across the organization.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in Sales Analytics, Commercial Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Analytics, preferably within FMCG, consumer goods, retail, or food and beverage industries.
* Strong SQL skills and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
* Hands-on experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar data visualization and reporting tools.
* Experience analyzing sales, customer, distribution, pricing, and promotional performance data.
* Familiarity with Nielsen, Circana (IRI), POS data, distributor data, or CRM data is an advantage.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable business insights.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced business environment.
* Knowledge of Python, R, Azure, Databricks, or cloud-based analytics platforms is an advantage.
* Understanding of revenue management, trade promotion analytics, and sales forecasting is preferred.

title: Data Scientist
description:
**Location:**
Jakarta, Indonesia
  
  
**Working Pattern:**
On-site
  
  
At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’ve transformed our business and are building our future on one clear purpose—to deliver a smoke-free future.
  
  
With huge change comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.
  
  
We are looking for a Full Stack Data Science and Analytics professional to connect advanced statistical modeling with agile product growth. You will manage the end-to-end data lifecycle, build predictive models, and lead experimentation that improves user engagement and business efficiency.
  
  
Impact You’ll Own
  
  

* Turn complex data into actionable insights that support business decisions.
* Improve product engagement through rigorous experimentation and user behavior analysis.
* Strengthen forecasting and planning through predictive and prescriptive analytics.
* Automate manual workflows using Generative AI solutions.
* Communicate clear, practical recommendations to senior leaders.

What You’ll Do
  
  

* Build predictive models, statistical reports, and analytical methods to identify trends in large, complex datasets.
* Apply analytics across market economics, supply chain, marketing, advertising, and scientific research.
* Forecast business outcomes using predictive and prescriptive methods, probabilities, and defined confidence levels.
* Design and analyze A/B tests and multivariate experiments, including hypotheses, sample sizes, and statistical significance.
* Use Google Analytics 4 and Looker to map user journeys, identify drop-offs, and recommend product improvements.
* Apply Generative AI to improve business processes and automate manual workflows.
* Translate complex findings into actionable recommendations for senior leadership.

**Skills & Capabilities**
Must-Haves
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or another quantitative field.
* At least five years of experience in Data Science, Product Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
* Advanced SQL skills, including common table expressions and window functions.
* Strong Python skills, including Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Statsmodels.
* Expert proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Looker, or similar product analytics tools.
* Deep knowledge of A/B testing and Frequentist or Bayesian experimental design.
* Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, complex formulas, and data manipulation.
* Experience with time-series analysis using methods such as Prophet and ARIMA.
* Experience with growth modeling, including S-curves.
* Strong product mindset and ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical executive audiences.

Nice-to-Haves
  
  

* Experience applying Generative AI to business processes.
* Ability to move between long-term research and fast-paced experimentation.

Application Process
  
  
Apply online and submit your updated resume. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next stage of the recruitment process.
  
  
Equal Opportunities Statement
  
  
We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential.

title: Environment, Health & Safety and Security Operations Lead - AVP
description:
**Job Description:**
--------------------

**Details of the Division and Team:**

The focus of the role is implementing and executing the global Environment, Health & Safety and operational security standards to ensure employee safety, security, asset protection and leading risk management practices in line with the vision and strategy set by the Global Head of Corporate Security. The Corporate Security Environment, Health & Safety and Security Operations Lead (Indonesia and Malaysia) will develop strong relationships within the business, infrastructure and country management teams to achieve a trusted advisor status. This role will drive operational excellence of the Environment, Health & Safety function, guarding service, Corporate Security risk and security survey programs by developing standards based on best practices and ensuring robust execution by the vendor service delivery teams through close oversight and management as appropriate.

  

**What we will offer you:**

A healthy, engaged and well-supported workforce is better equipped to do their best work and, more importantly, enjoy their lives inside and outside the workplace. That’s why we are committed to providing an environment with your development and wellbeing at its center.

**You can expect:**

* Comprehensive Medical Insurance Coverage for Employee and Family

* Life Insurance Coverage

* Additional Pension Scheme (DPLK) on top of Statutory Contribution

* EAP – free and confidential counseling, online work-life resources

* Staff Loan including Housing Loan, Car Loan and Personal Loan

* Hybrid work arrangement

* Comprehensive leave benefits

Annual health checkup – cost borne by company (once a year; conditions apply)  

  
  

**Your key responsibilities:**

  

**EHS**
=======

  

The candidate will be responsible for EHS programs and process at sites in their region, while working closely with Regional EHS Leader. Provide leadership and technical support to ensure compliance with applicable DB and regulatory requirements, while minimizing the risk of potential adverse EHS events, but not limited to :

* Responsible for leading all related EHS activities to support DB Group Indonesia.
* Leads and participates in EHS inspections and audits. Presents performance findings to management and prepares applicable reports. Follow- up on any corrective action plans
* Liaise with Safety Officers over the full range of their duties and responsibilities.
* Ensure continued competence of any EHS champions/officers.
* Issue a monthly EHS performance report on EHS activities within the country.
* Acts as the Occupational Safety and Health Committee (P2K3) Secretary
* Manage DB EHS data management requirements; including periodic maintenance, reporting and verification of accuracy of data entered into the system and in particular reviewing incident investigation reports.
* Ensure country DB EHS management system remains in compliance with DB requirements by analysing the need for defining new or updating existing procedures, forms, training material, etc.
* Follow trends in the development of the EHS management system, identify and roll-out opportunities to further improve country EHS management system.
* Develops and deploys EHS policies and procedures / KODs, training, internal and external communications in accordance with DB and regulatory requirements. Partners with business leaders and employees to continuously improve the EHS culture, EHS awareness and accountability.
* Evaluate risk associated with business opportunities and contractual obligations.
* Supports incident investigation activities, root cause analysis, corrective action identification and closure. Works closely with concerned teams to measure and communicate EHS performance. Monitors trends and champions injury/illness reduction. Directs the organization in management of emergency conditions and containment actions.
* Implements environmental management processes, including management of chemicals, wastes, and pollution prevention.
* Where required, coordinates industrial hygiene programs, exposure assessments, and works closely with the local management teams to assure implementation of medical surveillance requirements.
* Implements EHS risk review and contractor/vendor management processes.
* Implement EHS tasks pertaining to Cafeteria operations.
* Serves as liaison with third-party vendors and regulatory agencies.
* Maintain HS Legal register for the country.
* Ensure no Audit / Regulatory findings or observations are identified / reported.
* Ensure compliance with all local regulatory requirements and applicable international EHS standards.
* Submit regulatory report on P2K3 activities quarterly.
* Build and maintain an EHS effective team committed to organizational goals, foster collaboration among team members and between teams.
* Develop strong relationships with country management so as ensure effective implementation of EHS across the country Identify and advocate EHS improvements and Best Practice sharing.
* Annually develop, track and manage an EHS budget based on local country EHS requirements as well as the annual goals and objectives.
Ensure in consultation with country management appropriate EHS staffing levels such that EHS programs meet the company goals as well as legislative requirements.  

  
  

**Corporate Security**
======================

  

The candidate will be responsible for the development, communication and implementation of Regional Corporate Security standards as well as other tasks including, but not limited to:

  

* The role holder will act as a brand ambassador for the bank and the CSO-Corporate Security organisation at all times and therefore the role is expected to be fulfilled with the utmost attention to professionalism and integrity at all times so not to compromise the bank or CSO-Corporate Security
* Be the primary security point of contact for delivery of security related services managed by others (eg Global Real Estate (FM/Engineering/Client Services/Security and Health & Safety) Tier 1 Vendors; confidential waste management; HR security content of training material; information protection, etc)
* Oversee the delivery of guarding contracts, ensuring accurate invoicing, the standards expected of the service are adhered to, the measurements and KPIs are implemented including monthly documented management meetings.
* Primary response to local incidents and/or crisis situations, managing the tactical response and key stakeholder in the role geographies whilst keeping the Corporate Security regional management informed and updated throughout.
* Deliver strategic initiatives once agreed, by developing short- and long-term plans – track and report progress and escalate issues when required.
* Resolve delivery obstacles and seek resource requirements to ensure success.
* When requested, own strategic initiatives and manage these to expectations of regional and global Corporate Security leadership team.
* Own responsibility for Indonesia and Malaysia building Security Concepts and Surveys
* Drive efficiencies where possible and propose innovative solutions both technical and physical.
* Develop and maintain stakeholder relationships to leverage engagement for the benefit of the organisation.
* Respond to Audit and Regulatory engagement activities, develop and implement action plans as required.
* Represent the Regional function when requested .
* Partner with HR Employee Relations teams and other stakeholders as required to perform investigations of employee misconduct, demonstrating the highest levels of integrity and sound judgement throughout all such cases.
* Events security management - partner strongly with Corporate Social Responsibility teams and Global Travel with respect any onsite or offsite events or volunteering engagements; similarly, with Corporate Communications teams and Regional/Country Management as required where senior leadership hosted events may occur.
* Planning, delivery, execution and management of the Executive and Event Protection function in conjunction with the Regional EEP Lead for adhoc Management Board Member visits to Indonesia and Malaysia
* Review, update and develop Corporate Security Travel Security Plans as necessary to ensure travel security guidance is current and reflects the applicable threat environment of the country locations in-scope.
Keeping abreast of regional threats and risks which may impact the bank and partnering closely with the Threat Intelligence function to perform regular detailed risk assessment reviews.  

  

**Your skills and experience:**

  

**EHS**
=======

* S-1 (Bachelor) Degree or Diploma Degree (3yrs) in Industrial / Occupational Safety or Engineering or equals with the following conditions:
  + S-1 (Bachelor) with work experience relevant to its expertise at least 2yrs

title: Operations Intern - Power BI & Manufacturing Improvement (Karawang)
description:
**Power BI & Manufacturing Improvement Intern**
===============================================

**Location:** Karawang, Indonesia  
**Working Pattern:** Onsite  
**Target Join Date:** 15 December 2026

At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’ve transformed our business and are building our future on one clear purpose—to deliver a smoke-free future.

With huge change comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.

Join our SPP Production team and support the transformation of operational data into practical insights. During this four-month internship, you will assist with dashboard development, production-loss analysis, and a structured changeover improvement study.

**Impact You’ll Own**
---------------------

* Support a standardized Power BI view of uptime, losses, changeovers, and key production indicators.
* Help identify uptime opportunities using baseline data, trends, and Pareto analysis.
* Contribute to a Single-Minute Exchange of Die study for selected machine changeovers.
* Support production teams in using reliable data during performance reviews.
* Help document changeover improvements and potential uptime gains.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Support the consolidation, cleaning, validation, and standardization of production data.
* Assist with Power BI data models, Power Query transformations, DAX measures, and dashboards.
* Support the analysis of uptime, production losses, and changeover performance.
* Assist with shop-floor time and motion studies on selected equipment.
* Help document changeover activities and update standard procedures.
* Support the preparation of user guides and training materials.
* Assist with summarizing findings and recommendations for stakeholder presentations.

**Skills & Capabilities**
-------------------------

**Must-haves**

* Final-year bachelor’s student in Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or another relevant engineering discipline.
* Familiarity with Power BI, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, and dashboard design.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, and data consolidation.
* Analytical problem-solving skills and basic statistical knowledge.
* A structured and detail-oriented approach to data and documentation.
* Clear communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Willingness to support activities on the manufacturing shop floor.

**Nice-to-haves**

* Knowledge of Lean methods such as SMED, standard work, time and motion studies, or basic value-stream mapping.
* Interest in manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, and equipment uptime.

**Rewards & Benefits**
----------------------

Internship allowance, benefits, facilities, and applicable support will be shared during the recruitment process.

**Application Process**
-----------------------

* Digital interview and online assessment
* HR interview
* User interview

**Equal Opportunities Statement**
---------------------------------

We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential.

We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and provide reasonable accommodations to ensure an accessible recruitment process. If you need support or adjustments during your application, let us know—we’re here to help you succeed.

In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors.

Data Engineering

PROFILE:

* Bachelor's degree in computer science or related fields
* Fluent in English

* Experience in gathering prescriber requirements and writing the corresponding low-level requirements
* Experience in designing, developing and deploying analytics / PKI solutions

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced knowledge in algorithms, development in Python, Visual Basic, M language (Power Query in Power BI ) as well as ETL
* Advanced proficiency in an analytics tool (e.g., Power BI) è design and build reports with UX considerations

**Soft Skills**

* Autonomy in a time-zone-shifted management (while staying within the guidelines).
* Ability to interact with counterparts remotely and produce concise reporting
* Ability to escalate appropriately (strong analytical and problem-solving skills).
* Strong verbal and written communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Ability to effectively manage relationships with prescribers and end-user of the application

**LIFE AS A THALES DATA ENGINEERING ROLE**  
  
As a Data Engineering Role within Thales, you will:
  
  

* Write / consolidate detailed specifications in collaboration with the Service Owner (IS-IT SwAM team)

* Identify and design the underlying data model
* Identify the relevant data sources, coordination with the teams responsible for the data sources (data lake/warehouse)
* Establish a development / delivery schedule, keeping it updated, report on progress, and raise alerts if necessary
* Implement / develop the monitoring / KPI solutions (applying internal guidelines, development best practices)

Document the implementation and operating procedures / user guide  
  
YOUR CAREER AT THALES
  
  
Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your competences in different areas:
  
  
Room and attention to personal development
  
Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution
  
Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path
  
Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group

title: Customer Service Technician
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Performs technical, mainly pre-defined tasks for accomplishing defined service delivery work for customer equipment.

* You will perform mainly pre-defined, technical tasks (for example, basic commissioning of products and systems, integration of components to a system, basic engineering, maintenance jobs) and work packages on-site and remotely.
* You will schedule PMI/PMP following documented procedures, escalate issues, and complete service documentation.
* You will coordinate PMI appointments with FSE and customers to minimize disruption to clinical operations.
* You will support customers remotely and onsite and provide 2nd and 3rd level user support when issues arise.
* You will coordinate and accomplish defined basic service operations and/or resolve basic product issues for customers' equipment.
* You will support the generation of sales leads for pre-defined service offers and contribute to planning activities.
* You will adhere to defined processes and applicable regulations.

To find out more about the specific business, have a look at https://www.varian.com/

**Minimum Required Skills and Knowledge**

* You hold a vocational diploma, bachelor's or master's degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, VLSI/Microelectronics, or a similar field.
* You have knowledge of and professional experience with electronic and electro-mechanical engineering, as well as testing equipment used for verification, checkout, and calibration of electronic equipment. You also have knowledge of and professional technical experience with microcomputers/PC-based systems.
* You have a customer-focused attitude.
* You are articulate and skilled in interpersonal communication.
* You are fluent in the local language and in English, both written and spoken.

* You have other desired skills and knowledge, including basic computer usage and debugging skills, fundamental knowledge of networks and networking techniques, and a basic understanding of imaging systems.
* You obtain and complete the LMS training plan specific to your assigned responsibilities.
* For the Oncology Systems business only, you meet all Vendor Credentialing requirements necessary to gain VMS client site access, unless prohibited by law. These requirements vary by client and may include, but are not limited to, proof of valid identification (photo, driver's license, SSN), criminal background checks, drug screens, immunizations (Hep B, MMR, Varicella, Influenza, Tetanus), annual TB testing, and healthcare training.
* You are familiar with business tools such as email, Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. You ideally have experience with HCM (e.g., Workday) or an equivalent ERP product and productivity software.

**Who we are**: We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways.

**How we work**: When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here.

As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

**Data Privacy**: We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started.

**Beware of Job Scams:** Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site.

**To all recruitment agencies**: Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

description:
**About The Role**
In this role, you will be an integral player within Data Science team based on Jakarta. You will take the wheel in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models for a variety of consumer and merchant lending products GoPay offers in Indonesia. Your responsibilities will include enhancing our credit risk models by leveraging innovative and cutting-edge algorithms on GoTo data and third-party data vendors. Most importantly, your efforts will work to bring wider financial inclusion to more people in the region and beyond.

* Drive End-to-End Impact: Take complete ownership of the machine learning lifecycle. You will conceptualize, build, deploy, and monitor data models that directly influence key business metrics and bottom-line results.
* Innovate Credit Risk Strategy: Lead the development of advanced consumer credit risk models. Apply rigorous statistical analysis and ML techniques to optimize lending decisions, balance risk, and fuel sustainable business growth.
* Partner with Product & Business: Act as a strategic bridge between data and business strategy. Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into scalable, production-ready data science solutions.
* Champion Technical Excellence: Set the standard for robust model evaluation and clear documentation. You will advocate for data science best practices and distill complex technical concepts into actionable insights for non-technical leadership.

**What You Will Need**

* Bachelor degree or above in science and engineering related majors such as statistics, mathematics, physics, computer science, etc.
* At least 3 years of hands-on experience in building, evaluating, and monitoring credit risk models.
* Excellent understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms.
* Comfortable using Python, SQL, and UNIX Shell.
* Understand business concerns and formulate them as technical problems that can be solved using data and math/stats/ML.
* Self-driven and entrepreneurial with a strong sense of ownership, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
* Good communication skills and ability to present technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
* Able to write model documentation clearly and concisely and support recommendations with research and data.

**About The Team**
Our team leverages big data from the GoTo universe, as well as external data, to build various predictive models to support the risk strategy team in real-time credit underwriting and management of the customer lifecycle Cicil (BNPL) and Pinjam (cash loans) products. As our model scores are key inputs to risk decisioning (e.g. approval/rejection of loans, credit limit adjustments), we are also able to see the direct impact of our models on the business and our customers.
  
  
We are a growing team and are constantly looking for opportunities to use data science to enhance our credit and fraud risk management capabilities. We are focused on growth and efficiency. We are all about open knowledge sharing and self-improvement. We believe that “Data Science is a team sport.”

GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

title: Supply Chain Modelling & Optimization Consultant
description:
A great opportunity to join and shape a new entrepreneurial team focused on providing data-driven solutions and advisory to our clients. Haskoning is a highly respected 140+ year old engineering consultancy company that designs & builds industrial assets such factories and logistics centers for many leading organizations. In 2022, we’ve joined forces with Districon, a leading supply chain analytics and logistics consultancy with 45 years’ experience developing strategies and solving issues for supply chain management and integrated logistics.
  
  
Our new joint team forms the Supply Chain & Logistics Centre of Excellence within Haskoning. We provide top-tier logistics & supply chain advisory as well as digital supply chain advanced analytics services on top of Haskoning's traditional engineering and consultancy domain knowledge. Supply chain is our DNA, engineering and analytics our key focus and interest. We believe that applying the right technology enables our clients to improve their supply chain processes and planning. And, as a consequence, improve their business: better results, build resilience and be sustainable.
  
  
What will you do
  
  
What is strategically the optimal supply network? What is tactically the optimal balance between demand, supply and capacity? What is the optimal order batching and picking sequence in a warehouse? What is the optimal production schedule in manufacturing environment? What is the optimal fleet utilization of an ocean, air, rail, or road carrier? And any other supply chain optimization challenge.
  
  
As a
**Supply Chain & Optimization Consultant**
you solve these challenges by modelling optimization & simulation applications for our clients, that enable them to make data driven, scenario base, decisions. You apply your operations research skills and work together with the team to collect and validate the data, to connect the application with the core systems, to design a user interface, to train and support users.
  
  

* You participate in or lead the developments, testing and implementation of new applications, guide the project team and the client’s team.
* You participate in or lead the support and maintenance of the applications: updating applications, identifying and solving bugs, and continuously improving applications by developing new functionalities.
* You participate in or lead regular sprint meetings, connecting the business challenges with the solution requirements.

Next to the project work, you will also get responsibilities in business development. Think about setting up and giving demos, preparing material for conferences, and talking to potential clients. As we work project-based it is important for us to get new clients and keep on generating work.
  
  
We work a lot with the mathematical optimization platform AIMMS, simulation software WITNESS Horizon, and SQL, Python, and PowerBI.
  
  
Where you will work
  
  
This role is based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Candidates are required to have valid work permits for the place of work (no sponsorship). The role offers flexibility to work partly at home and partly in the office. Travel to client sites across APAC for project work is occasionally required.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
A strong interest for complex puzzles in the supply chain domain. You have an affinity with programming and connecting data sets. You are critical, accurate and show courage, you like to create your own opportunities.
  
  
Furthermore, as
**Supply Chain Modeling & Optimization Consultant**
you are:
  
  

* Analytically strong: capable of understanding and explaining complex processes.
* Good at mathematics: you can easily draw the right conclusions from a large amount of data.
* Pragmatic: you apply a creative approach, and, not always the most complex mathematical solution will help our client.
* Technology driven: you have an interest in collecting, optimizing, connecting and structuring data from multiple sources.
* A bit headstrong: you think further than necessary and also give unsolicited advice.

**As a Basis, You Bring Along**
  
  

* A completed academic master’s degree in Operations Research, (Applied) Mathematics, Industrial Engineering or a related study.
* Some work experience or interest in supply chain, logistics or ICT, gained during or after your studies.
* (Demonstrated) experience or interest in mathematical optimization software programs, simulation software (Witness), SQL, Python, R, PowerBI or Qlik.

+ Experience with AIMMS is nice to have, as most of our application we support have been developed using AIMMS software.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Fluent in English – excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Can work independently on projects, but is as well a powerful team player who wants to work on a wide variety of projects.
* Willingness to travel, both for incidental trips to our offices in Singapore and The Netherlands, or to APAC clients.
* We welcome both starters as consultants with 0-3 years of relevant working experience.

What we offer you
  
  
At Haskoning we offer a great working atmosphere in which organizational and personal development take central stage. Our assessment and rewarding process will always be based on your personal competences. We offer you a wide range of projects in which you can participate and gain experience. You will learn from working with experienced consultants and get a glimpse of the various areas of expertise we have on offer. Learn and experience in order to map out your own career path.
  
  
**Furthermore, We Offer**

* Open and respectful environment
* A great work-life balance and flexible hours
* Flexibility to work partly at home and partly in the office
* Variety of exciting and challenging projects with a diverse range of clients
* Participation in the multi-year development program that consists of coaching and training of practical skills and your consulting skills
* Vacation days for time off
* A competitive primary salary

Are you our new colleague?
  
  
If this role sounds like the right challenge, we are interested in hearing from you! We will share more about us and the benefits of coming to work together in our small but quickly growing team and the wider Haskoning & Districon cultures and work benefits during our interview process.
  
  
Please apply with your CV and feel free to connect directly with our team directly on LinkedIn for any questions.

**EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS** |**Introduction**

Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go-to-market specialist that provides partners and end-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization.

Our best-in-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit www.exclusive-networks.com.

At Exclusive Networks, we are passionate about making a difference. That means delivering the best to our ecosystem, shaping a prosperous and trusted digital world, and helping our people to realize their full potential.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** |**About the role**

The Pre-Sales Engineer is a trusted cybersecurity advisor responsible for driving technical sales engagements and supporting the growth of Palo Alto Networks solutions across enterprise, commercial, and public sector customers.

This role requires strong cybersecurity expertise, excellent presentation and communication skills, and the ability to design business-driven security architectures that address customer challenges. The successful candidate will work closely with sales teams, channel partners, customers, and Palo Alto Networks to develop opportunities and accelerate digital transformation initiatives

The role reports to the Pre-Sales Manager.

**As the Pre-Sales Engineer, You will**:

  

* Provide pre-sales technical leadership and subject matter expertise on Palo Alto Networks solutions.
* Partner with Account Managers to identify customer business challenges and develop cybersecurity strategies aligned with customer objectives.
* Conduct discovery workshops to understand customer environments, security maturity, compliance requirements, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Design and position integrated cybersecurity solutions across:
  + Network Security (NGFW, Advanced Threat Prevention, DNS Security)
  + Secure Access Service Edge (Prisma Access)
  + Cloud Native Security (Prisma Cloud)
  + Security Operations (Cortex XDR, XSOAR, XSIAM)
  + Zero Trust Architecture
* Deliver compelling technical presentations, executive briefings, solution demonstrations, and workshops.
* Lead Proof of Concept (PoC), Proof of Value (PoV), and technical evaluations.
* Assist customers and partners in developing cybersecurity roadmaps and architecture recommendations.
* Respond to RFI/RFP requirements, including solution design, compliance mapping, technical clarifications, and competitive positioning.
* Work closely with Palo Alto Networks field teams to align technical strategies and go-to-market initiatives.
* Provide technical enablement and training sessions for channel partners, sales teams, and internal engineering teams.
* Support strategic opportunities and large-scale cybersecurity transformation projects.
* Stay current with cybersecurity trends, threat landscapes, AI-driven security technologies, and Palo Alto Networks product innovations.
* Maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, and vendor stakeholders.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** |**About you**

**The ideal Pre-Sales Engineer**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 2-5 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Network Security, Cybersecurity Engineering, or Security Consulting.
* Strong understanding of enterprise security architectures, networking, and cybersecurity technologies.
* Knowledge of one or more security domains:
  + Network Security (NGFW, VPN, IPS, DNS Security)
  + SASE / SSE
  + Endpoint Security (EDR/XDR)
  + Cloud Security (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  + Security Operations (SIEM, SOAR, XDR)
* Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and modern cybersecurity frameworks.
* Experience conducting customer presentations, technical workshops, solution demonstrations, and Proof of Concept (PoC) engagements.
* Understanding of routing, switching, TCP/IP, DNS, Active Directory, virtualization, and cloud technologies.
* Knowledge of scripting or automation tools such as Python, PowerShell, or APIs is an advantage.
* Industry certifications such as PCNSA, PCNSE, CISSP, CCNA/CCNP Security, AWS, or Azure Security certifications are preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Self-motivated, team-oriented, and passionate about learning new cybersecurity technologies.
* Good command of written and spoken English.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco Security, CrowdStrike, Microsoft Security, Zscaler, or other enterprise security solutions.

description:
**Location:**
San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
  
  
**Start Date:**
ASAP
  
  
**Languages:**
English
  
  
**Team:**
Engineering
  
  
**About The Role**
Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.
  
  
We are looking for a
**Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization**
to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines — protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.
  
  
This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.
  
  
This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70–80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.
* Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.
* Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.
* Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.
* Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.
* Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

**What We're Looking For**

* Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.
* Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.
* Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.
* An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data — and when each is appropriate.
* High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.
* Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.
* Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.
* Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.
* Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

**Why This Role Matters for You**

* Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.
* Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.
* From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.
* Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.
* San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70–80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

**What You'll Do**

* Work with subject-matter experts to create synthetic tasks for training AI agents across a range of professional and technical domains.
* Design synthetic task-generation methods that produce diverse, realistic and learnable tasks.
* Build systems and tooling to mutate, validate and improve synthetic tasks.
* Analyse model and agent performance on synthetic tasks to understand what the tasks are teaching and where they fail.
* Develop metrics to quantify and understand synthetic task diversity, realism, learnability and related qualities.
* Take synthetic data pipelines from early research through to reliable systems, including in areas where the roadmap is not fully prescribed.

* Proficiency in Python, Docker and Linux environments.
* Experience with synthetic data research methods — please be ready to describe this in your application.

* Experience building synthetic data pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.
* Experience working on environments, evals or benchmarks.
