title: Senior Data Analyst, Compliance
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
The Enterprise Data Analytics (EDA) team, part of Grab's Analytics function, owns the data behind Grab's regulatory obligations across Southeast Asia. We build and run the data pipelines that produce regulatory reports for financial regulators, including OJK and Bank Indonesia, Bank Negara Malaysia, the Monetary Authority of Singapore, Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas and the Bank of Thailand. We also support AML transaction monitoring and regulatory audits, working closely with Country Compliance, AML and Fraud, Risk, Finance and Engineering. Our numbers go to regulators, so accuracy, traceability and on-time delivery come first.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
As the Senior Data Analyst, you will be the analytics owner of regulatory reporting for Grab's e-money, payments and P2P lending businesses in Indonesia. You will take each report end to end, from interpreting the regulation to delivering a validated output to Compliance for submission, and be the go-to person when Compliance, auditors or regulators ask how a number was produced. You will report into the Analytics Manager, Compliance, and work onsite at our Jakarta office.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* You will take end-to-end ownership of daily, weekly and monthly regulatory reports for OJK, Bank Indonesia and industry bodies, such as SLIK, Pusdafil, APOLO and fintech data centre reporting, delivering them accurately and on time.
* You will translate new and changed regulations into documented data requirements, definitions and pipeline changes, agreeing the interpretation with Compliance before go-live.
* You will reconcile regulatory outputs against Finance records and across related reports, find the root cause of discrepancies, and automate data-quality checks to replace manual reconciliation.
* You will build and maintain reliable, reproducible reporting pipelines on Airflow and Spark, and resolve failures and source-data changes before submission deadlines.
* You will assess the reporting impact of product launches, system migrations and source-data changes, and partner with Engineering to test them before cut-over.
* You will provide traceable, transaction-level analysis for regulatory audits, regulator data requests and AML transaction monitoring.
* You will communicate data issues and their impact to mid-to-senior Compliance, Finance and Risk partners, and mentor junior analysts on reporting best practices.
* You will build AI tools and self-serve solutions that speed up report development and validation, while keeping confidential data protected.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* You have at least 4 years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence or Data Science in regulatory reporting, compliance or risk at a FinTech company or Financial Institution.
* You have a Bachelor's Degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering or related fields.
* You are proficient in writing advanced SQL queries (Presto, Spark SQL or Hive) on large datasets, and in Python for automating analysis and data pipelines.
* You have hands-on experience building and operating scheduled data pipelines with Airflow or a similar orchestrator.
* You have a strong track record of reconciliations and data-quality controls, and can trace a discrepancy across systems to its source.
* You have working knowledge of Indonesian financial regulation and reporting (OJK, Bank Indonesia or AFPI) or of AML/CFT data.
* You can turn regulatory text into clear data logic and explain it to non-technical partners such as compliance officers and auditors.
* Full professional working proficiency in English is required, on top of fluency in Bahasa Indonesia.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Business Intelligence
description:
**About Business & Market Intelligence**

The Business & Market Intelligence Department plays a critical role in supporting data-driven decision-making across the organization. The team is responsible for gathering, analyzing, and interpreting data related to market trends, industry developments, competitor activities, and customer behavior. By transforming complex data into actionable insights, the department enables stakeholders to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and formulate effective business strategies. In addition, the team continuously monitors market dynamics and provides strategic recommendations to enhance business performance, strengthen competitive positioning, and drive sustainable growth.

**About the role**

As a Business Intelligence, you will act as a strategic business partner, bridging the gap between deep data infrastructure and business unit operations. You will empower the business team by building dedicated data marts, intuitive dashboards, and delivering deep-dive insights that directly drive core business metrics.

**You'll be working on:**

* Business Partnership: Serve as the dedicated data partner for the business unit, developing a deep understanding of their workflow, challenges, and strategic goals.
* Datamart Creation & Architecture: Design and build optimized datamarts specifically tailored for efficient, ongoing business analysis.
* Dashboard Development: Create, maintain, and scale interactive data visualizations and dashboards (primarily using Tableau) to track key performance indicators.
* Deep-Dive Analysis: Conduct rigorous, end-to-end data analysis to uncover root causes, identify growth opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations to business users.

**Qualifications:**

* Minimum 2 years of proven professional experience working as a Business Intelligence Analyst or Data Analyst.
* Strong, hands-on proficiency in SQL to manipulate complex datasets, merge distinct data sources, and build production-ready analytics tables.
* Solid experience building impactful, user-friendly dashboards in data visualization tools (with a strong preference for Tableau).
* Demonstrated capability in business analysis—the ability to look past the numbers to understand the actual business mechanics and user needs.
* Exceptional problem-solving skills, with a structured approach to tackling ambiguous business questions.
* Highly comfortable and proactive in leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and modern AI tools to optimize daily analytics workflows and coding.
* Foundational knowledge of, or experience in, experimentation framework setup and A/B testing methodologies.
* Familiarity with Python for advanced data processing, scripting, and analysis

title: Cloud Engineer (AWS & GCP)
description:
**Job Description**

* Design, deploy, manage, and optimize scalable, highly available, and fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, or Deployment Manager to automate environment provisioning.
* Build, configure, and manage CI/CD pipelines to streamline application deployment and infrastructure updates across multi-cloud environments.
* Configure and maintain cloud networking components, including VPCs, subnets, routing tables, load balancers, VPNs, and hybrid cloud connectivity.
* Enforce cloud security best practices, Identity and Access Management (IAM) policies, encryption standards, and compliance controls (utilizing services like AWS CloudTrail, IAM, GCP Cloud Armor, and Security Command Center).
* Monitor system health, performance, and resource utilization using cloud-native observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Cloud Monitoring, Prometheus, Grafana) and respond to infrastructure alerts.
* Manage containerized workloads and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (EKS / GKE) and Docker.
* Implement backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity strategies while optimizing cloud resource consumption and cost efficiency (FinOps).
* Collaborate closely with DevOps, Backend, Security, and Network engineering teams to troubleshoot production issues and support architecture scaling.
* Document cloud architectures, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and configuration guidelines.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Computer Science, Informatics Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field.
* Minimum of 2 to 4 years of professional hands-on experience working as a Cloud Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or DevOps Engineer.
* Proven practical experience architecting, administering, and troubleshooting production environments on both AWS (e.g., EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, IAM, EKS, Lambda) and GCP (e.g., Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, VPC, GKE, BigQuery).
* Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, particularly Terraform and/or Ansible.
* Hands-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies (Docker, Kubernetes / EKS / GKE).

**Sr. Data Scientist**

**Working Location: Site Based - West Sumbawa**

**Working Schedule: Regular working days 5:2 (Monday-Friday)**

Sr. Data Scientist builds the analytical and machine-learning solutions that help the Mining product team solve its priority problems, such as fleet and mine-plan performance, equipment reliability and grade control. The role frames problems with mining operations, analyses the data, and builds, validates and deploys models that run in production.

The role is part of the Mining squad and reports to the Manager - Digital Product. It follows the modelling standards of the data science and machine-learning centre of excellence and the engineering standards set by the Lead Digital Engineering, and works with the squad's Solution Architect, Digital Delivery and Digital Change & Adoption.

The role uses AI agents to accelerate analysis, feature engineering and evaluation, and keeps human judgement over the data, the assumptions and the model's use in the operation.

**Some of your duties will include:**

**Analyse Mining problems**

* Frame priority Mining problems with operations and the Product Manager, and define the outcome a solution must improve.
* Analyse fleet, geological, production and sensor data to find causes, opportunities and measurable value.
* Present findings and options clearly to operational leaders.

**Build and deploy models**

* Engineer features, and select, train and validate statistical, machine-learning and optimisation models.
* Design the experiments and tests that show whether a solution works before it reaches the operation.
* Deploy models into production with Platforms & Data, using the centre of excellence's MLOps practice.

**Run and improve models in operation**

* Monitor live models for accuracy and drift, and retrain or retire them as the operation changes.
* Work with the Change & Adoption Lead so solutions are used in daily operations.
* Measure the value delivered and report it to the Product Manager.

**Build capability**

* Apply the centre of excellence's modelling standards and contribute reusable approaches across domains.
* Guide and review the work of supplier data scientists in the Mining squad.
* Use AI agents to speed up analysis, code and evaluation, with human review.

**What skills and experience do you need?**

* Minimum Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mining Engineering or another quantitative discipline. A relevant postgraduate qualification is preferred
* Minimum 8 years in applied data science and machine learning, with strong Python, including models that run in production and are monitored once live.
* Experience with mining, fleet, geological, sensor or operational data in mining or another asset-intensive industry is strongly preferred, as is experience framing problems directly with operations.

**Technical Competencies in:**

* Programming: strong Python and SQL for data science.
* Machine learning, statistics and optimisation: feature engineering, model selection, training and validation.
* Mining and operational data: fleet management, dispatch, drill and blast, geology, maintenance and sensor data, and their limits.
* Experiment design and value measurement against operational outcomes.
* MLOps: deployment, experiment tracking, monitoring for accuracy and drift, and retraining.
* Responsible AI: validating models for bias, reliability, safety and fit before production.
* AI-augmented practice with human judgement held over the data and conclusions.
* Clear written and verbal communication in Bahasa Indonesia and English

*Please be aware of certain frauds or misinformation regarding recruitment advertising on behalf of amman.co.id. We never ask for any payments from applicants or candidates during the recruitment process. We never ask applicants or candidates to use specific travel agent services to make arrangements for transportation and accommodation during the recruitment process.*

description:
**Company Description**

Kata.ai is an Indonesian Conversational Artificial Intelligence company with a focus on creating technology to enhance the understanding of human conversations, improving the way humans collaborate with machines. Kata.ai’s Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology powers MultiPurpose chatbots (virtual customer service / virtual friend) for major corporations in Indonesia across different kinds of industries such as Unilever (FMCG), Telkomsel (Telco), Bank BRI (Financial Services), and Alfamart (Retail).

The company’s proprietary Kata Bot Platform can be leveraged to create feature-rich chatbots on top of Kata.ai’s robust and scalable AI technology platform, ensuring company of any size can easily build their own chatbot on any messaging platform. With this platform, it is now possible for the business to focus on designing engaging interaction for their customers, while Kata.ai handles all the technology aspects of the chatbots.

Established in 2015, the company has become a trusted partner for major corporations such as Microsoft, Accenture, and Line. In 2020, the company received Series-B funding from TransPacific Technology Fund and MDI Venture.

 **Job Description**

Support the drafting, review, and management of standard commercial contracts and legal documentation across Kata.ai’s SaaS and enterprise AI business, under the guidance of a superior, so that commercial operations run smoothly and legal risks are escalated early.

 **Qualifications**

**Experience**

* Minimum 2 years in commercial or corporate legal (law firm or in-house).
* Experience with SaaS, technology, or digital platform contracts is a plus.
* Prior work at a technology company, startup, or SaaS business is a plus.
* Exposure to corporate secretarial work is a plus.

**Qualifications & Education :**

* Bachelor’s degree in Law (S.H.) from an accredited institution.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in commercial or corporate legal (the detail lives in the Experience section).
* Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken.
* Nice to have: contract drafting certification (e.g., CCD), exposure to Indonesian SaaS, technology, or digital economy legal matters, or a PERADI license or Master’s degree.

**Technical Skills :**

* Contract Management: End-to-end drafting, redlining, negotiation, and execution of SaaS agreements, MSAs, NDAs, SOWs, and vendor contracts
* Compliance: Indonesian regulatory compliance, UU PDP (data privacy), OJK (if applicable), and corporate governance
* Investment & Corporate: Support for investment-related legal documentation and corporate secretary coordination
* Tools: Google Workspace / Microsoft Office; experience with contract management tools (e.g., DocuSign, Ironclad, or equivalent) is a plus
* Language: Professional legal drafting proficiency in both Bahasa Indonesia and English

**Skills & Competencies :**

* Strong commercial legal acumen — able to identify, assess, and mitigate legal risks in complex SaaS and enterprise technology agreements
* Deep understanding of Indonesian contract law, manpower regulation, and data privacy regulations (UU PDP)
* High attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple contracts simultaneously under tight deadlines
* Clear and professional communication in both Bahasa Indonesia and English — able to negotiate contract terms and explain legal positions to non-legal stakeholders
* Proactive in identifying compliance gaps, contractual risks, and process improvements
* Able to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment with minimal supervision
* Discretion and integrity in handling confidential commercial and legal information
* Strong stakeholder communication: able to liaise with internal teams and external parties in a professional, timely, and clear manner, in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.

**What We Offer**

* Health & medical insurance
* Annual leave & paid time off
* Remote working arrangement
* Collective leave (*cuti bersama*) that does not deduct from your annual leave

  
**Additional Information**

**We value a flexible working hour for our employees.**

**The most important is we provide a learning experience in Conversational AI Industry.**

title: Risk Analytics Sr Analyst
description:
Amartha is a technology company focused on creating shared prosperity by developing digital financial solutions for the grassroots economy. Founded in 2010 as a microfinance institution, Amartha connects rural, women-led micro-enterprises with affordable capital. Amartha is expanding as a tech company, building a microfinance ecosystem that connects to the growing digital economy through capital, investment, and payment services. By boosting the competitiveness of micro and small entrepreneurs, Amartha empowers women-led MSMEs, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive economic growth.

**About the team**

Amartha is actively expanding its digital risk management team as part of our strategic commitment to digital transformation in 2025. We aim to enhance our capabilities in managing digital lending risks to support the growth of our digital financial product portfolio. To that end, we are seeking a highly skilled Risk Analytics Senior Analyst to join our team. This role will be instrumental in supporting risk management strategies for our digital lending platforms by developing robust forecasting models. The ideal candidate will contribute to ensuring that we continue delivering secure, data-driven, and effective financial solutions to our customers.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* + Risk Modeling & Analysis – Develop, implement, and improve statistical and predictive models to assess credit risk, predict default probabilities, and measure portfolio risk.
  + Data Analysis & Insights – Analyze large datasets to identify risk patterns, trends, and potential early warning indicators. Perform data extraction, transformation, and feature engineering to improve model accuracy.
  + Portfolio Monitoring – Monitor lending portfolio performance, assess risk trends, and identify potential credit quality issues through data analysis and predictive insights.
  + Model Validation & Scenario Analysis – Conduct model testing, back-testing, and performance evaluation. Perform scenario and sensitivity analysis to assess the impact of economic changes and portfolio factors on credit risk.
  + Cross-functional Collaboration & Governance – Work closely with Risk Strategy, Product, Data, and Technology teams to translate analytical findings into actionable risk strategies. Ensure proper model documentation, governance, regulatory compliance, and reporting.

  
**Requirements**  

* Minimum 7+ years of relevant experience in risk modeling, credit analytics, or a similar quantitative risk role.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, Finance, or a related quantitative field.
* Strong proficiency in statistical modeling and machine learning techniques (e.g., logistic regression, random forest, etc.).
* Solid understanding of credit risk principles, including PD/LGD modeling (IFRS9, PSAK71), and portfolio risk management.
* Ability to design, validate, and optimize models based on business goals and risk appetite.
* ⁠Have analytical skills (moderate to advanced level using SQL) especially on forecast analysis, risk performance.
* Experience in digital lending, consumer finance, or fintech risk environments is highly desirable.
* SQL and Python skill is required.
* Fluent in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.

*At Amartha, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, ensures equity, and fosters inclusion. We believe that diverse perspectives—shaped by factors such as gender, age, race, ethnicity, education, culture, and life experiences—drive innovation and growth.*

*We actively welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us in building an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities and foster a sense of belonging that enables our employees to thrive and make meaningful contributions.*

PT IDstar Cipta Teknologi (IDstar) is an Indonesia-based IT consulting and digital transformation company, trusted by over 30 enterprise clients across Asia, Oceania, North America, and Africa. Supported by ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certifications, IDstar has delivered more than 1,000 successful projects by combining strong local insight with global execution standards. With a network of over 900 pre-screened IT professionals and partnerships with leading technology providers such as UiPath, IBM, and Josys, the company focuses on IT talent solutions, Intelligent Automation (RPA), and SaaS support. The company promotes a collaborative, growth-oriented environment for technology professionals who want to contribute to impactful innovation.

**Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and maintain secure CI/CD pipelines to integrate security practices throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Implement and manage security testing tools, including SAST, DAST, Software Composition Analysis (SCA), and container scanning.
* Integrate automated security checks and security gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Manage and enhance cloud security configurations, including IAM policies and access controls across AWS/GCP environments.
* Support container security and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes (EKS/GKE).
* Implement and maintain Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, identify security risks, and support vulnerability remediation.
* Collaborate with development, infrastructure, and security teams to ensure secure application delivery and deployment.

* Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or DevSecOps.
* Strong knowledge of AWS/GCP cloud security and IAM best practices.
* Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools such as GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or GitHub Actions.
* Experience implementing SAST, DAST, SCA, container scanning, and security gates.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Knowledge of OWASP Top 10, vulnerability management, and secure coding practices.
* Hands-on experience with security tools such as SonarQube, Trivy, Burp Suite, or equivalent tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, automation, and collaboration skills.
* AWS or GCP certification is a plus.
* Short notice period or no notice period (available to join immediately).

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About Us**

Founded in 2011, PT Data Sinergitama Jaya, Tbk (now known as “Elitery”) is an IT-managed service company specializing in cloud and cybersecurity services. With a strong corporate reputation, Elitery is trusted by leading global cloud service providers, including Google Cloud, as a go-to-market partner in Indonesia.

**Why Join Us?**

Elitery is an exceptional place to work, offering the flexibility of a hybrid work environment. We foster a collaborative and innovative culture, alongside competitive benefits and more. The company places a strong emphasis on career development, ensuring employees have opportunities for growth. Elitery also adheres to global standards like ISO 9001 and ISO 27001, with a focus on credibility, competency, a commitment to quality, continuous improvement, and customer focus.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) to ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of our enterprise systems. This role focuses on managing and integrating Cloud Infrastructure and On-Premises Infrastructure, providing advanced application support, and actively leveraging AI technologies to optimize automation and improve day-to-day operational efficiency.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree (S1) in Computer Engineering, Informatics Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
* At least 5 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Cloud Infrastructure, System Administration, or Enterprise IT Operations.

Technical Skills :

* Cloud & Virtualization: Hands-on experience with OpenStack, ZStack, VMware vSphere, Huawei FusionSphere, or public cloud platforms (OCI/AWS/GCP).
* AI Tooling & Adaptability: Strong motivation and proven ability to leverage AI tools (e.g., Copilot, LLM prompting, and AIOps platforms) to improve daily operational efficiency.
* On-Premises Infrastructure & Storage: Knowledge of enterprise server architecture (HPE/Dell/Cisco) and storage systems (CEPH, OceanStor/SAN/NAS).
* Application Support & Operating Systems: Experience supporting middleware (Tomcat, Apache, IIS), databases (PostgreSQL, MSSQL), and advanced Linux (RHEL/Ubuntu) and Windows Server administration.
* Automation & Tools: Proficiency in scripting (Bash/Python), Zabbix, and Wazuh, along with a fundamental understanding of networking and infrastructure security.

Certifications (Preferred)

* Cloud certifications (OCI, AWS, VMware, ZStack), Red Hat Certified Engineer (RHCE), or relevant SRE/DevOps/AI tooling certifications.

**Special Requirements**

* **Must be willing to work fully onsite in Bandung.**
* Must demonstrate a strong willingness and ability to learn, adapt, and integrate AI into daily workflows.
* Must be willing to participate in on-call standby schedules and perform maintenance activities outside regular working hours, including weekend maintenance windows, when required.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Cloud & On-Premises Infrastructure Engineering

* Manage, maintain, and optimize hybrid infrastructure, including cloud platforms (OpenStack, ZStack, OCI, VMware vSphere, Huawei FusionSphere) and on-premises infrastructure (HPE/Dell/Cisco Enterprise Blade Servers, OceanStor/CEPH Storage).
* Perform capacity planning, proactive system health monitoring and maintenance, and high-availability architecture design.

2. AI Adoption & Operational Efficiency

* Actively adopt and implement AI tools and technologies (Generative AI, LLMs, or AI-driven Automation) in daily operations to accelerate troubleshooting, documentation, log analysis, and operational task automation.
* Explore and implement AIOps (Artificial Intelligence for IT Operations) solutions for anomaly detection and proactive incident mitigation.

3. Application Support & Production Operations

* Collaborate closely with Application Support teams and developers throughout the integration, UAT, Pre-Production, and Production deployment cycles.
* Lead incident response, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), and end-to-end troubleshooting across application, operating system, and infrastructure layers.
* Manage Live Verification (LV) and ensure system stability following application releases or maintenance activities.

4. Automation & Monitoring

* Develop automation scripts (Bash/Python) for daily operational tasks, system efficiency improvements, and CI/CD workflows.
* Configure and optimize monitoring and logging systems such as Zabbix, Wazuh, and other APM/SIEM tools to enable real-time incident detection.

5. Change & Release Management

* Prepare technical documentation, including Method of Procedure (MoP) documents and change implementation guidelines.
* Coordinate Change Requests (CRs) and lead execution during maintenance windows to minimize downtime and service disruption.

6. Vulnerability & System Security (Basic)

* Ensure basic patching compliance and system hardening across operating systems (Linux/Windows) and middleware (Apache, Tomcat, Nginx) in accordance with enterprise security policies.

title: Graduate Analyst - Summer 2027
description:
**Do you want to challenge yourself as an analyst in one of the world’s leading energy knowledge houses?**

Rystad Energy is a leading global independent research and energy intelligence company dedicated to helping clients navigate the future of energy. By providing high-quality data and thought leadership, our international team empowers businesses, governments and organizations to make well-informed decisions.

Our extensive portfolio of products and solutions covers all aspects of global energy fundamentals, spanning every corner of the oil and gas industry, renewables, clean technologies, supply chain and power markets. Headquartered in Oslo, Norway, with an expansive global network, our data, analysis, advisory and education services provide clients a competitive edge in the market.

For more information, visit www.rystadenergy.com.

We are looking for analysts to strengthen our growing global team of researchers in our Jakarta office.

The analyst department consists of five groups: Oil and Gas, Renewable and Power, Commodity Markets, Energy Services, and Energy Transition. Rystad Energy is looking for motivated candidates with a strong academic track record and an analytical mindset to fulfill the growing demand of our research across these groups.

Analysts are the backbone of the company and are responsible for our databases and reports, which are used by clients around the world. We need more people to gather, analyze and present our research to our clients. As an analyst you will collaborate frequently with consultants, programmers, and sales and marketing people.

We are seeking candidates who are graduating with a bachelor or master’s degree in the fall of 2026 or spring of 2027 that want to join a leading energy intelligence research firm.

**Tasks**

* Gather, process, analyze and synthesize information from multiple sources
* Develop, maintain, and optimize energy data collection and processing workflows
* Develop new forecast models and processes to analyze our data
* Contribute and write client commentaries and reports
* Participate in external and internal presentations
* Contribute to sales and business development over time
* Engage with clients to demonstrate our research and analyses
* Travel when needed for research trips, client engagement, and business development support

**Requirements / Skills**

* Strong academic track record in relevant education field (e.g. engineering, finance, economics, math, data science)
* Desire to work with both the technical and financial aspects of the energy market.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with a hands-on attitude
* Outstanding ability to synthesize data and information coming from multiple sources (quantitative and qualitative)
* Solid proficiency in Excel and Power Point; knowledge of other programming languages will be advantageous
* Strong communication skills, both verbal and written
* Strong interest in or direct work experience in the energy sector
* Fluent in English; other languages are a plus

**We offer**

* Flexible career path given competence and interests
* Hands-on mentorship with an experienced analyst
* A diverse, dynamic and highly skilled working environment
* Competitive compensation and benefits

**Application deadline**: 18 December 2026. No feedback will be available until the applications close.

**Please submit all resumes and cover letters in English**

title: Software Engineer Intern
description:
**About Komander**

Komander.ai builds AI agents for construction companies in Indonesia. Our agents watch cost, schedule and cash flow on live projects and message the right person on WhatsApp when something drifts. We're part of the Antler Indonesia cohort and run pilots with contractors and developers in Jabodetabek.

**What you'll work on**

Komander Build turns house plans, specs and drawings into a bill of quantities (BoQ), a RAB and tender documents. Today it gets about 75% of quantities right. Your job is to help push that towards 95%+, working with our developer and our in-house quantity surveyor.

Day to day you'll:

- Build and improve the pipeline that reads drawings and PDFs and pulls out quantities
- Compare the system's output with the QS's corrections and fix what it gets wrong
- Turn QS feedback into test cases so accuracy can be measured, not guessed
- Ship features in the Komander Build app, in Indonesian and English

**You'll do well here if you**

- Are a final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Informatics or a related field
- Write solid Python
- Have used LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic or similar) on a real project, even a side project
- Like messy real-world data and don't mind digging into why a number is wrong

**Nice to have**

- Experience with PDF parsing, OCR or computer vision (e.g. PyMuPDF, OpenCV)
- Familiarity with CAD files (DXF, DWG) or IFC
- JavaScript or TypeScript for front-end work
- Any exposure to construction, civil engineering or RAB/BoQ. A family business counts.

**What you get**

- A paid internship with an above-average allowance for Jakarta
- A clear path to a full-time role: interns who hit their agreed goals and pass our end-of-internship review will be offered a full-time position
- 2-3 days a week at our office in Lippo Thamrin, Jakarta, and the rest remote
- Work directly with the founders on a product that's already in front of real contractors
- Real ownership: what you build ships to clients

**Details**

- Duration: 4-5 months
- Start: 23 November 2026
- Goals for the internship are agreed in your first week, with a check-in at the midpoint and a full review at the end.
- You'll need to be based in Jakarta or able to commute to Thamrin.

**How to apply**

Apply by 19 November. Send your CV and a link to something you've built (GitHub, a demo, anything) to melwani@komander.ai with the subject "Komander Build Intern". Tell us in two or three lines what you'd try first to improve accuracy.

**The role**

We’re looking for a generalist engineer who ships quickly using AI. You’ll build the internal tools that run our business and help grow our website into a real sales channel. You’ll work directly with the founder and our Tech Lead. You’ll own projects end to end: understanding the problem, building, deploying and improving. A lot of your code will be written with Claude Code. Your value is in knowing what to build, directing the AI well, and making sure what ships actually works.

- Proficient with Claude Code or similar AI coding agents in daily work. You can show us projects you built this way.

- A generalist mindset: happy to jump from a dashboard to an API integration to a landing page in the same week.
- Strong judgment: you can tell when AI output is wrong, insecure or overcomplicated.
- Clear communication with non-technical colleagues.
- A track record of staying in roles and finishing what you start.

- Experience with e-commerce or marketplace integrations (Shopee, TikTok Shop, Tokopedia).
- Shopify, WordPress or website SEO and performance work.
- Building agents or automations with LLM APIs.
- Interest in smart home, IoT or consumer electronics.

**Why join**

- Ship things that are used the same week, by a team that relies on them.
- Work directly with the founder and see your impact on revenue.
- Use the latest AI development tools with full support.

title: Software Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
The Quality Assurance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications through comprehensive manual and automated testing. This role works closely with Business Analysts, Developers, and Project Managers to define testing strategies, develop and execute test cases, identify defects, and drive continuous quality improvements throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The engineer will also champion QA best practices, test automation initiatives, and CI/CD quality processes to ensure the delivery of high- quality solutions that meet business and client requirements. Responsibilities:

Review and analyze user stories to develop, document and maintain test cases from business requirements

Design automated test scripts and deploy these using automation software, where appropriate

Execute and evaluate manual or automated test cases and report test results.

Drive the adoption of QA best practices through the whole team.

Create test data as required and participate in the identification and implementation of continuous improvement in QA processes, DevOps, and Agile Dev standards for the entire team.

Support other test areas including performance, load, security.

Help set and fulfill the QA staffing plan, including sourcing, screening and interviewing.

Requirements :

- Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in automated and manual testing in website and web apps.

- Highly skilled in automated test tools for web, mobile and server-side software, including scripting in Selenium Webdriver.

- Strong Java development skills

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Expert understanding of software QA, including best practices, CI/CD processes and various types of testing.

- Experience in using TestNG and Jmeter

title: Partnership & Product Marketing Manager (Full-time, Remote)
description:
**Company Description**

Kata.ai is an Indonesian Conversational Artificial Intelligence company with a focus on creating technology to enhance the understanding of human conversations, improving the way humans collaborate with machines. Kata.ai’s Natural Language Processing (NLP) technology powers MultiPurpose chatbots (virtual customer service / virtual friend) for major corporations in Indonesia across different kinds of industries such as Unilever (FMCG), Telkomsel (Telco), Bank BRI (Financial Services), and Alfamart (Retail).

The company’s proprietary Kata Bot Platform can be leveraged to create feature-rich chatbots on top of Kata.ai’s robust and scalable AI technology platform, ensuring company of any size can easily build their own chatbot on any messaging platform. With this platform, it is now possible for the business to focus on designing engaging interaction for their customers, while Kata.ai handles all the technology aspects of the chatbots.

Established in 2015, the company has become a trusted partner for major corporations such as Microsoft, Accenture, and Line. In 2020, the company received Series-B funding from TransPacific Technology Fund and MDI Venture.

 **Job Description**

To develop and execute strategic partnerships, product marketing initiatives, and go-to-market strategies for the company's AI products and solutions by identifying market opportunities, building strategic alliances, strengthening product positioning, and enabling commercial teams to drive revenue growth, market penetration, and sustainable business expansion.

 **Qualifications**

**Experience**

* Minimum 5–7 years of professional experience in Strategic Partnerships, Business Development, Product Marketing, Go-to-Market Strategy, or related commercial roles.  
  Experience working in the technology industry, particularly AI, SaaS, cloud computing, enterprise software, or digital solutions.
* Proven track record in developing and managing strategic partnerships, technology alliances, or ecosystem collaborations.
* Experience in developing and executing product marketing strategies, product launches, and go-to-market initiatives.
* Experience engaging with enterprise clients, technology partners, system integrators, and senior-level stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to translate technology capabilities into business opportunities, commercial propositions, and measurable market outcomes.
* Experience working in B2B and/or B2G environments is highly preferred.
* Experience in managing cross-functional projects and driving initiatives from strategy development through execution.

**Qualifications & Education :**

* Bachelor's degree (S1) in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Information Technology, Communication, or other relevant fields.
* Master's degree (S2) in Business, Management, Marketing, Technology Management, or related disciplines is an advantage.
* Strong understanding of B2B business models, enterprise technology ecosystems, and commercial strategies.
* Familiarity with AI, Applied AI, SaaS, cloud computing, digital transformation, and enterprise technology solutions is highly preferred.

**Technical Skills :**

* Understanding of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), AI Agents, and enterprise AI applications.
* Familiarity with SaaS business models, cloud infrastructure, API-based solutions, and enterprise software ecosystems.
* Knowledge of product marketing frameworks, including product positioning, value proposition development, market segmentation, and go-to-market strategy.
* Ability to conduct market research, competitive analysis, industry mapping, and business opportunity assessments.
* Proficiency in developing business proposals, partnership decks, product presentations, commercial proposals, and strategic business plans.
* Familiarity with CRM platforms, sales pipeline management, project management tools, and data analysis tools.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office / Google Workspace, particularly PowerPoint / Slides and Excel / Sheets.

**Skills & Competencies :**

* Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop partnership strategies, identify market opportunities, and translate business objectives into actionable initiatives.
* Business Acumen: Strong understanding of B2B commercial models, revenue generation, business development, and enterprise sales cycles.
* Strategic Negotiation: Ability to establish, manage, and negotiate strategic partnerships with senior stakeholders and external business partners.
* Relationship Management: Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities across internal and external ecosystems.
* Product Marketing: Ability to develop product positioning, value propositions, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.
* Communication & Presentation: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technology solutions into clear business value.
* Analytical & Problem-Solving: Ability to analyze market trends, business opportunities, competitive landscapes, and commercial performance.
* Cross-functional Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Executive Management teams.
* Ownership & Execution: Proactive, results-oriented, and capable of managing multiple strategic initiatives independently.

**What We Offer**

* Health & medical insurance
* Annual leave & paid time off
* Remote working arrangement
* Collective leave (*cuti bersama*) that does not deduct from your annual leave

 **Additional Information**

**We value a flexible working hour for our employees.**

**The most important is we provide a learning experience in Conversational AI Industry.**

title: AVP-Data Integration
description:
**Role**
Responsible for leading the definition, development, continuous improvement, and delivery of enterprise data integration capabilities across Data Analytics platforms. The role acts as a senior individual contributor and technical platform owner for data integration, ensuring that data solutions are reliable, scalable, secure, cost-efficient, and aligned with business outcomes.
  
  
Responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining data integration architecture, data pipelines, data warehouse interfaces, data marts, and data exchange mechanisms between operational systems, analytical platforms, cloud platforms, and reporting/BI solutions.
  
  
**Qualification**
Minimum Bachelor’s degree (S1) in Telecommunication, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or other relevant technical disciplines. Master’s degree or relevant professional certification in cloud/data engineering is an advantage.
  
  
**Experience**

* Minimum 5–8 years of total experience in data engineering, data integration, Big Data, Data Warehouse, cloud data platform (GCP), or digital technology delivery.
* Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in data integration architecture, ETL/ELT development, cloud data platform implementation (GCP), DWH/data mart development, or large-scale data pipeline delivery.
* Strong experience in managing end-to-end project delivery for telecom operator, enterprise data platform, or complex digital technology environment.
* Experience working with Agile delivery and/or structured project management methodology, including planning, estimation, risk management, delivery tracking, and production readiness.
* Experience with data governance, data quality, metadata, lineage, security/privacy, observability, and cost optimization / FinOps practices is preferred.

Working knowledge of AI/ML, advanced analytics, and real-time analytics use cases is an advantage.
  
  
**Skills**
The role is expected to have sufficient hands-on technical depth to review, guide, and challenge engineering implementation, while primarily focusing on architecture ownership, technical governance, delivery assurance, and continuous improvement of enterprise data integration capabilities.
  
  
**General Skillset**

* Strong understanding of telecommunications business processes, enterprise IT landscape, data-driven business operations, and the role of data platforms in supporting commercial, finance, network, customer, digital, and regulatory use cases.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving capability to translate business problems into data integration requirements, architecture decisions, delivery plans, risks, dependencies, and measurable outcomes.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, negotiation, and communication skills to work effectively with business users, BI teams, data governance, enterprise architects, IT project owners, security, operations, vendors, consultants, and system integrators.

**Must-have Skillset And Technology Expertise**

* Data Integration Architecture: Strong capability in integration pattern selection, batch/incremental/near-real-time pipeline design, interface specification, data exchange mechanism, orchestration design, dependency management, resiliency pattern, and production readiness review.
* ETL/ELT and Data Engineering: Hands-on experience designing, developing, reviewing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines using GCP Platform, SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, shell scripting, Talend, IBM DataStage, Apache Nifi, DBT, and/or equivalent enterprise data integration tools.
* Cloud Data Platform and BigQuery: Strong knowledge of GCP data services, especially BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Composer / Apache Airflow, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Dataproc, IAM, service account management, monitoring, logging, and cloud networking concepts relevant to data platforms.
* Data Warehouse and Data Mart: Strong understanding of enterprise DWH, ODS, staging layer, data mart, dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schema, historical data handling, slowly changing dimensions, aggregation, semantic layer, reconciliation, and BI/reporting consumption patterns.
* SQL, Programming, and Troubleshooting: Strong capability in SQL, Python, PySpark/Spark, API integration concepts, code review, transformation logic assessment, query/job optimization, failure analysis, root cause investigation, and development standard definition.

title: Product Manager - Merchant Experience
description:
**About The Role**

As Product Manager for Merchant Operations and Experience in Enterprise Merchant team, you’ll own the roadmap to improve and develop solutions for our merchants to scale up their onboarding, reporting and experience in using our services, while also building the internal tools that help our operations teams turn around merchant requests faster, partnering with engineering and business leads to break down complex problems and ship solutions that scale.

### **What You Will Do**

* Own the product roadmap and strategy for Merchant Operations and Experience, aligned with company goals, and drive execution.
* Grow the business by building valuable value added service and a reliable operations stack for our merchants - from reporting, reconciliation, onboarding, and support
* Scale our internal ops tooling that determines how fast operations teams can serve merchants
* Represent Merchant Operations in cross-functional and leadership forums, and negotiate scope and priority with senior stakeholders
* Set and own key results for your problem area: customer satisfaction, usability, on-time delivery, and other metrics that matter to the business
* Build trusted relationships with engineering, business, and stakeholder leads to keep product delivery moving
* Turn complex, ambiguous operational problems into a roadmap other people can execute against

### **What You Will Need**

* At least 4-5 years of product management experience delivering highly successful and innovative operations and experience-related products, owning a problem area end-to-end, from discovery to go-to-market, with measurable business impact: cost savings, efficiency gains, higher activation, or faster turnaround. Have handled at least one of these products - reporting, internal tooling, onboarding, or support.
* Payments, fintech, or another regulated, high-compliance industry background is a plus.
* A strong sense of agency: you create clarity in ambiguity and break complex problems into concrete use cases and solutions, without waiting for a fixed playbook
* Enough grounding in data, design, research, and software engineering to partner with those teams without needing a translator
* Strong analytical skills: you use data and metrics to decide what to build, and to prove it worked afterward. SQL familiarity helps
* Experience presenting to and negotiating with senior or executive stakeholders, and the ability to turn strategy and priorities into a story that lands at every level of the org
* Familiarity with GenAI or building products with GenAI is a plus.

**About The Team**

The Enterprise Merchant team sits within GoPay Merchant, which includes Midtrans, Indonesia's largest payment gateway, and GoTo's enterprise product suite.

You've used Midtrans and GoPay already, even if you didn't know it: we power payments at your favorite ecommerce store, furniture site, or fast food chain. That reach keeps growing. We're building toward becoming the largest payment and financial services group in Southeast Asia.

Merchant Operations is the team inside Midtrans that solves merchants' and partners' operational pain points around accepting payments and transfers, for their own business or their clients'. We only grow if our merchant partners do. This team owns the roadmap for merchant operations and reporting, and executes it end-to-end.

**About GoTo Group**

GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.

The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

**About Gojek**

Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

**About GoTo Financial**

GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

*GoTo and its business units, including Gojek and GoToFinancial ("GoTo") only post job opportunities on our official channels on our respective company websites and on LinkedIn. GoTo is not liable for any job postings or job offers that did not originate from us. You should conduct your own due diligence to prevent being victims of any fake job scams, if they did not originate from GoTo's official recruitment channels.*

*#LI-ONSITE*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. * Experience implementing security controls in DevOps / CI/CD environments, cloud-native platforms (AWS/GCP), and AI/automated systems.
* Experience managing ISO 27001 and PCI-DSS certifications, as well as compliance with OJK, Bank Indonesia (BI), and UU PDP regulations.
* Experience partnering with engineering, product, and business stakeholders to implement security controls.
* Fluent in English and Bahasa Indonesia (written and spoken).
* Security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, or equivalent are preferred.

title: AVP-Telco Cyber Security Operation Expert
description:
Role purpose
  
  
The primary purpose of the AVP Telco Cyber Security Operation Expert is to lead and oversee the continuous monitoring, detection, and response to cyber threats targeting the organization's Telco infrastructure, applications, and digital assets. This role is responsible for ensuring operational excellence in cyber defense by driving incident response strategy, coordinating cross-functional collaboration, and strengthening threat detection capabilities across multiple technology domains.
  
  
The incumbent will lead the entire incident lifecycle — from initial triage, forensic analysis, and containment to post-incident review and improvement. They are also expected to provide expert insights into emerging threat landscapes, develop proactive defense mechanisms, and recommend technology and process enhancements to mitigate cyber risks.
  
  
This role aims to ensure the resilience, integrity, and continuity of the Telco ecosystem by minimizing business disruptions, preventing data compromise, and aligning security operations with corporate and regulatory standards.
  
  
Scope of Work
  
  
**Area Of Responsibilities**
**Key Activities**
Continuous security monitoring and management
  
  
Ensure the continuous monitoring and proactive management of security risks within the organization's Telco environments, applications, and Telco infrastructure to promptly identify and mitigate any malicious activities.
  
  
Lead the optimization of detection capabilities, SIEM rules, and alert correlation for improved incident visibility
  
  
Incident Detection and response Operation
  
  
Take charge of the entire process of containing, eliminating, and recovering from Telco security incidents by following well-established guidelines.
  
  
Forensic Analysis
  
  
Perform forensic data collection and analyze threats to ascertain the extent and root cause of incidents, enabling effective recovery and preventing future occurrences.
  
  
**Threat Intelligence Analysis**
Stay informed about the latest cyber threats through threat intelligence sources. Use threat intelligence to enhance proactive detection capability for any anomaly for any potential security incidents
  
  
SLA monitoring
  
  
Implement security operational metrics to assess the effectiveness of incident response and track the progress in restoring the integrity of infrastructure and business services following security events.
  
  
**Requirements**
Qualification:
  
  

* Minimum bachelor’s degree in relevant field (Information Technology / Electrical Engineering /Telecommunication Engineering, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Communications, Information Security or a related field).
* Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in Cyber Security Operations, specifically within the telecommunications industry.
* Proficiency in using forensic tools and analysist techniques
* Strong knowledge in Application Security. Have in-depth understanding related with application security concepts, principles, and best practices.
* Proficiency in security protocols, cryptography, authentication, authorization, security vulnerabilities, and remediation techniques. Familiarity with programming languages and frameworks is a plus.
* Proficient in: LINUX, Windows Servers, Unix.
* Ability to analyze and identify actions to be taken.
* Excellent time management skills and ability to multi-task and priorities work
* Working well under pressure
* Good communication and influence skill
* Strong understanding of all Information Security Domains
* Sound understanding of businesses supported and security principles and policies
* Knowledge of network, system, and application monitoring technologies

**Related Experience**

* Demonstrated experience in information security and proficiency in configuring and managing security technologies such as firewalls, IDS/IPS, proxy, email-GW, AV for Servers, APT
* Experience in Cyber Security Operations, specifically within the telecommunications industry.
* Proven track record of successfully managing and mitigating security threats in a Telco environment.
* Proficient in using and configuring Telco-specific security tools and platforms.
* Strong knowledge of network security protocols and technologies relevant to telecommunications systems.
* In-depth understanding of telecommunications infrastructure, protocols, and technologies.
* Familiarity with the unique security challenges and threats faced by Telco operators.
* Incident Response Experience. Practical experience in developing and executing incident response plans, including system/devices forensics and post-incident reporting.
* Familiarity with integrating threat intelligence feeds into security solutions for proactive threat detection
* Have strong communication skills, one can effectively convey complex security concepts to both non-technical individuals and leaders.

**Skills**

* Information System Management
* Operational Management
* Enterprise Risk Management
* Software Engineering
* ICT Security Management
* Telco Knowledge
* Strong verbal and written communication skills (fluency in English is required)
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with a proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT, Security, Compliance, and Legal.
* Strong analytical skills to identify security risks, assess their potential impact, and devise effective solutions.
* Good communication skill both writing and verbally to be able to work together with all employees in the company.
* Ability to convey message in clear, concise and simple way to various employees in the company.
* Ability to deliver and develop presentation in front of different audience and answering their questions.
* Have integrity, confidentiality, and independence.
* Collaboration and Teamwork: Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, especially with development and Telco teams, to integrate security into the software development life cycle.
* Project Management: Project management skills to plan, execute, and monitor security initiatives effectively.

description:
**Description**
**📌 EMPLOYMENT DETAILS**

* Employment type: through 3rd party/ vendor
* Duration: 24 months fixed term (subject to change based on business needs)
* Work setup: Full onsite with dedicated full office hours based in BSD, Tangerang.

**The Role**
***Senior***

* Lead the architecture, development, and delivery of scalable, high-performance web applications across multiple product lines.
* Strategize the frontend roadmap in partnership with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership by defining standards, tooling choices, and long-term technical direction.
* Authorize technical decisions on frontend architecture, component system design, state management patterns, and build infrastructure.
* Synergize efforts across frontend, backend, design, and QA teams to ensure seamless, end-to-end user experiences.
* Negotiate trade-offs between design fidelity, performance, accessibility, and delivery timelines, providing clear recommendations to stakeholders.
* Lead code reviews, set engineering standards, and drive adoption of best practices across the frontend engineering team.
* Evaluate emerging frontend technologies and frameworks; recommend adoption where they meaningfully improve quality, performance, or developer experience.
* Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully for component implementation, refactoring, testing, and documentation while preserving accessibility and design fidelity.
* Formulate and enforce frontend performance budgets, accessibility standards, and cross-browser compatibility requirements.
* Lead the strategy for dependency management, package upgrades, security patches, and shared library maintenance.
* Mentor and grow mid and junior engineers through structured feedback, pairing, and technical guidance.
* Plan and control frontend delivery milestones, proactively surfacing risks and coordinating resolution across teams.

*Mid*

* Plan and develop UI components and features by translating designs and wireframes into clean, maintainable, and reusable code.
* Control the quality of your own work through thorough testing, debugging, and adherence to team coding standards.
* Evaluate and implement responsive, cross-browser compatible layouts across desktop, tablet, and mobile breakpoints.
* Formulate and document component-level solutions that align with the team's frontend architecture and design system.
* Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, Backend Engineers, and QA to deliver cohesive user experiences.
* Recommend improvements to code quality, component reusability, or development tooling based on day-to-day experience.
* Participate in code reviews, incorporating feedback constructively to improve personal and team output.
* Use AI-assisted coding tools where appropriate for UI implementation, debugging, test generation, and documentation, validating all output before delivery.
* Plan and execute frontend optimizations for performance, accessibility, and SEO under guidance from senior engineers.
* Contribute to dependency maintenance tasks including package upgrades and basic compatibility checks.
* Stay current with frontend trends and evaluate new tools or techniques relevant to the team's work.

**Requirements**
***Senior***

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in frontend engineering, with a demonstrable track record of shipping production-grade web applications at scale.
* Deep expertise in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3, with strong understanding of browser internals and rendering performance.
* Proven mastery of React.js (preferred) or Vue.js / Angular, including advanced patterns such as server-side rendering, code splitting, and micro-frontends.
* Extensive experience with state management solutions (Redux, Zustand, Pinia, or equivalent) and frontend data-fetching strategies.
* Strong command of frontend build tooling (Webpack, Vite, Rollup) and CI/CD pipelines for frontend applications.
* Deep experience with performance optimization like Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, caching strategies, and bundle analysis.
* Proven ability to design and maintain scalable component libraries and design system integrations.
* Experience leading dependency governance: package upgrade strategies, compatibility management, and vulnerability remediation.
* Strong command of testing practices, unit, integration, and end-to-end testing (Jest, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools and the ability to review generated UI code for accessibility, responsiveness, maintainability, and design fidelity.
* Demonstrated ability to influence technical decisions and communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with RESTful and GraphQL API integration, including error handling and data normalization strategies.
* Good communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

***Mid***

* 2–4 years of hands-on experience in frontend development, with at least one project delivered in a professional or academic setting.
* Solid proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3, with a good understanding of how browsers render pages.
* Hands-on experience with React.js, Vue.js, or Angular; familiarity with component-based architecture and props/state patterns.
* Basic experience with state management libraries (Redux, Zustand, Vuex, or equivalent).
* Familiarity with RESTful API integration and working with JSON data in frontend applications.
* Experience using Git and collaborative development workflows (branching, pull requests, code reviews).
* Understanding of responsive design principles and CSS frameworks (e.g., Tailwind CSS, Bootstrap, or similar).
* Familiarity with AI-assisted coding tools for UI development, testing, debugging, or documentation is an advantage.
* Familiarity with frontend build tools and package managers (Webpack, Vite, npm, or yarn).
* Basic awareness of web performance principles and browser developer tools for debugging.
* Understanding of package management, including installing dependencies and identifying outdated or vulnerable packages.
* Strong problem-solving mindset with attention to detail and willingness to learn.
* Good communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English, written and spoken.

Professional Service Engineer - Thailand - InfobloxBangkokFull time

**EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS** | **Introduction**

Exclusive Networks is the global cybersecurity go-to-market specialist that provides partners and end-customers with a wide range of services and product portfolios. With offices in over 45 countries and the ability to serve customers in over 170 countries, we combine deep local expertise with the scale and delivery of a single global organization.

Our best-in-class vendor portfolio is carefully curated with all leading industry players. Our services range from managed security to specialist technical accreditation and training and capitalize on rapidly evolving technologies and changing business models. For more information visit www.exclusive-networks.com.

At Exclusive Networks, we are passionate about making a difference. That means delivering the best to our ecosystem, shaping a prosperous and trusted digital world, and helping our people to realize their full potential.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** |**About the role**

The **Professional Services & Support Engineer (Security Solutions)** is responsible for delivering implementation, integration, technical support, and lifecycle management services for cybersecurity solutions across enterprise, commercial, and public sector customers.

The role focuses primarily on **Infoblox DNS, DDI, and DNS Security solutions**, while also supporting other strategic cybersecurity technologies including **Saviynt Identity Security**, **Netskope SASE/SSE**, and additional vendor solutions within the company portfolio.

The successful candidate will work closely with customers, partners, vendors, project managers, and internal teams to ensure successful deployment, adoption, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction.

The role reports to the **Post-Sales Manager / Services Manager**.

**As the Professional Services & Support Engineer, You Will:**

**Professional Services & Implementation**

* Deliver implementation, migration, upgrade, integration, and optimization services for Infoblox and other cybersecurity solutions.
* Perform installation, configuration, system integration, testing, validation, and production deployment activities.
* Develop and execute implementation plans, migration strategies, and cutover activities.
* Prepare technical documentation including:
  + High-Level Design (HLD)
  + Low-Level Design (LLD)
  + Method of Procedure (MOP)
  + Test Plans
  + As-Built Documentation
  + Operational Runbooks
* Conduct customer onboarding, knowledge transfer, and administrator training sessions.

**Support & Escalation Management**

* Provide post-sales technical support and troubleshooting for customer environments.
* Diagnose and resolve product, integration, performance, and operational issues.
* Manage technical escalations and coordinate with vendor support teams when required.
* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) and provide recommendations for long-term service improvements.
* Ensure cases are managed and resolved within agreed service level agreements (SLA).

**Solution Delivery & Technical Expertise**

Support and deliver solutions across one or more of the following domains:

**Primary Focus**

* Infoblox DDI (DNS, DHCP, IPAM)
* Infoblox DNS Security
* Infoblox BloxOne Platform
* DNS Infrastructure Modernization
* Network Automation and DDI Management

**Secondary Focus**

* Saviynt Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)
* Privileged Access Governance
* Identity Security & Compliance
* Netskope Security Service Edge (SSE)
* Secure Access Service Edge (SASE)
* Cloud Security & Data Protection
* Zero Trust Security Architecture

**Customer Success & Service Excellence**

* Conduct health checks, system assessments, and best-practice reviews.
* Support preventive maintenance and platform lifecycle management activities.
* Recommend optimization opportunities and service improvements.
* Participate in quarterly service reviews and customer success engagements.
* Build trusted advisor relationships with customer operations, security, and infrastructure teams.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Work closely with project managers, sales teams, and solution consultants to ensure successful service delivery.
* Collaborate with vendor technical teams on escalated support cases and complex deployments.
* Participate in technical workshops, internal training, and certification programs.
* Develop automation and operational efficiencies using APIs, scripting, and workflow automation tools.
* Stay current with cybersecurity technologies, emerging threats, cloud security, identity security, and network security trends.

**QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE** |**About you**

**The Ideal Professional Services & Support Engineer**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum 3-7 years of experience in Professional Services, Technical Support, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity Engineering, or Security Operations.
* Hands-on experience implementing and supporting enterprise cybersecurity or network infrastructure solutions.
* Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills in enterprise environments.
* Experience delivering customer-facing projects and post-sales support services.

**Technical Knowledge**

Strong understanding of:

* DNS, DHCP, and IP Address Management (DDI)
* TCP/IP Networking
* Routing and Switching
* Active Directory
* LDAP
* Windows and Linux Administration
* Cloud Platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
* Identity and Access Management (IAM)
* SASE / SSE Architecture
* Security Operations and Incident Management

**Preferred Technical Experience**

Experience with one or more of the following:

* Infoblox DDI and BloxOne
* Saviynt IGA Platform
* Netskope SSE/SASE
* Microsoft Entra ID
* CyberArk
* SailPoint
* Cisco, Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, or Check Point
* Cloud Security Platforms

Additional Skills

* Experience using ticketing and service management platforms.
* Knowledge of scripting and automation tools such as PowerShell, Python, REST APIs, or Ansible.
* Strong documentation and technical writing skills.
* Strong customer communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and support activities simultaneously.
* Self-motivated, service-oriented, and passionate about learning new technologies.
* Good command of written and spoken English.

**Preferred Certifications**

**Infoblox**

* Infoblox Core DDI Administrator
* Infoblox DDI Advanced Administrator
* Infoblox BloxOne Certifications

**Identity & Security**

* Saviynt Certified Engineer
* Netskope Certified Cloud Security Administrator
* Microsoft Security Certifications
* CyberArk Certifications

**General Infrastructure & Security**

* CCNA / CCNP
* AWS or Azure Certifications
* CISSP

**WHO ARE EXCLUSIVE NETWORKS?** | **Why work for us**

We are people focused and strongly believe that talent empowers us to continue our dynasty of disruption and growth in the future. Our Mission is to drive the transition to a totally trusted digital world for all people and organizations. Visit our website www.exclusive-networks.com.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to the recruitment and hiring of individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences, as we believe this strengthens our ability to develop superior solutions, make informed decisions, and better serve our valued customers. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, disability status, or any similar characteristic. Employment decisions are made solely on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need. Please click here to review our Diversity and Inclusion Policy for further information.

We care about your data: please click here to read our Recruitment Data Protection Policy prior to applying, and therefore sharing your data with us.

**WORKING CONDITIONS**

**Our benefits include:**

* Group Insurance
* Provident Fund
* Incentive
* Well Being Leave

Our people make all the difference in our success.
