title: Software Development Engineer In Test
description:
**About the role​**

Traveloka’s QA organization is transforming through shift-left testing, stronger developer testing practices, and AI adoption. We are looking for a Senior SDET who combines strong software engineering skills with business testing judgment and the ability to lead technical decisions for test strategy and tooling.​You will shape the testing approach for your scope, design reusable test solutions, and align developers, product managers, QA engineers, and platform teams around clear quality goals and responsibilities. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that includes business testing of critical journeys. You will help teams apply AI to improve testing efficiency and strengthen DevTest—the testing developers perform while building and changing software.​

**What you will do​**

- Own test strategy and technical decisions. Define risk-based coverage across unit, component, API, contract, integration, and end-to-end tests. Decide what to automate, where checks should run, and which quality signals should gate delivery. Explain trade-offs in coverage, speed, reliability, maintenance effort, and business impact, and document important decisions.​
- Lead test-tooling architecture and development. Evaluate build-versus-adopt options, design reusable frameworks and tools, and guide implementation through design and code reviews. Define integration contracts, test data and environment approaches, observability, and ownership so solutions can be maintained and adopted across teams.
- Drive cross-team communication and alignment. Work with engineering leads, product, QA, and platform teams to agree on testing responsibilities, priorities, interfaces, and rollout plans. Resolve dependencies and conflicting needs, communicate release risks clearly, and drive adoption of shared practices through influence and technical credibility.
- Develop production-quality test code. Build and maintain API, integration, contract, and end-to-end tests. Improve test frameworks, reusable components, test data, and environmental tooling.​
- Own business testing for your scope. Understand customer journeys and business rules, challenge ambiguous requirements, and perform functional, exploratory, and risk-based regression testing.​
- Drive shift-left practices. Participate in requirement refinement and technical design reviews. Identify edge cases, dependencies, and failure scenarios before implementation, and define clear acceptance criteria with the team.​•Strengthen developer testing. Partner with developers to improve unit and integration coverage, testability, mocking, and local validation. Help teams choose the right test level and obtain useful feedback before code merges.​
- Apply AI to improve engineering efficiency. Use coding assistants and agent workflows for test design, test implementation, change-impact analysis, failure investigation, and test maintenance. Validate generated code and assertions against actual requirements and system behavior.​
- Make automation trustworthy. Integrate tests into CI/CD, investigate failures, reduce flakiness, and keep feedback fast and actionable. Maintain clear ownership and traceability for critical coverage.​
- Lead practical improvements. Identify testing bottlenecks, pilot improvements, measure their impact, and help teammates adopt effective engineering practices.

**What We Are Looking For**

- Demonstrated experience leading test strategy or test-engineering initiatives across teams, making technical decisions, and explaining the trade-offs and measurable outcomes. This should include hands-on implementation, not only coordination.
- Experience designing or evolving reusable test frameworks, developer tools, or testing platforms, with attention to architecture, extensibility, reliability, maintainability, and integration with engineering workflows.
- Strong cross-team communication and stakeholder alignment skills. You can translate business risks into technical proposals, build agreement on priorities and ownership, resolve technical disagreements constructively, and mentor engineers in testing practices.
- Strong hands-on programming skills in at least one language, such as Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript, with sound knowledge of debugging, code design, Git, and code review.
- Experience developing maintainable automated tests and test infrastructure, particularly for APIs, distributed services, and integration flows.
- Strong business testing skills: translating requirements into scenarios, prioritizing by risk, designing test data, executing exploratory tests, and investigating defects across service and data boundaries.
- Experience introducing or improving shift-left testing practices through collaboration with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
- Practical experience using AI tools in software development or testing, with the ability to explain where they improved efficiency, how outputs were validated, and where human judgment remained necessary.
- Working knowledge of CI/CD, SQL, HTTP, service dependencies, logs, and other tools used to diagnose application behavior.
- The ability to balance delivery speed with business risk, communicate findings clearly, and drive improvements beyond individual test execution.
- A collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership of both engineering work and hands-on business validation.

title: Lead Data Scientist (Analytics) - Digital Marketing
description:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
The Growth Data Science team is a key component of our regional growth strategy. We focus on creating and implementing innovative approaches to drive growth through performance marketing automation, machine learning models, geospatial insights, user lifecycle and funnel optimisation, behavioural forecasting, and other advanced analytics methods. Our work spans across transportation, food, fintech, logistics, and platform services.
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
We are seeking Data Scientist with deep expertise in paid marketing measurement, AI-driven analytics, and operations to join our growing team. In this role, you'll collaborate with marketing leaders, analytics teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to solve complex digital marketing challenges using advanced measurement science, artificial intelligence, and data-driven approaches. You'll work on end-to-end paid marketing analytics initiatives.
  
  
You will directly report to the Senior Manager. You will be based onsite.
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* Partner with marketing stakeholders to align measurement strategies with business goals, channels, and data constraints.
* Select and apply attribution, incrementality, and causal inference methods, explaining trade-offs and recommendations.
* Design and run experiments—including A/B tests, holdouts, matched markets, and geo-lift studies—to measure campaign impact.
* Build and maintain Media Mix Models (MMM) to assess channel effectiveness, guide budget allocation, and forecast performance.
* Develop AI and machine learning solutions to improve campaign targeting, bidding, experimentation, and measurement workflows.
* Build scalable data pipelines integrating paid media, conversion, and internal data using SQL, Spark, and cloud technologies.
* Create analytics tools and dashboards to track campaign performance, acquisition costs, and marketing ROI.
* Conduct exploratory analysis and statistical modeling; validate models and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
* Manage project plans, document methodologies, and communicate insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Collaborate across marketing, analytics, product, and engineering teams; mentor junior analysts and data scientists.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* 6+ years in data science and analytics, including 3+ years in paid marketing measurement and operations.
* Expertise in attribution modeling, including multi-touch, algorithmic, and rule-based approaches.
* Experience designing incrementality studies, A/B tests, holdout analyses, and geo-lift studies.
* Strong background in Media Mix Modeling (MMM) or marketing mix optimization.
* Hands-on experience building, optimizing, and deploying machine learning models for marketing.
* Proficiency in Python, SQL, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and Spark; familiarity with causal inference tools such as CausalML, DoWhy, or EconML.
* Experience with cloud data platforms, marketing datasets, ad platform APIs, and ETL pipelines.
* Familiarity with generative AI and LLMs for automating insights and reporting.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

* We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
* With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
* Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
* We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

* Collect, clean, validate, and analyze data to generate actionable business

insights.
  
  

* Develop dashboards and reports using BI tools.
* Translate business requirements into analytical questions, KPIs, and

recommendations.
  
  

* Present findings through clear visualizations and concise reports.
* Collaborate with Data Engineers, Data Scientists, and project teams to

deliver client solutions.
  
  
**Requirements**
**Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree (S1) in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science,

Computer Science, Information Systems, or related fields.
  
  

* Fresh graduates are welcome; relevant internship or project experience is

a plus.
  
  

* Basic to intermediate SQL and Excel skills.
* Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, or Looker is preferred.
* Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, and

willingness to learn.
  
  

* Internship or project experience in data analytics or business intelligence.

subqueries/CTEs, and window functions.
  
  

* Hands-on experience using at least one BI/visualization tool, such as

* Good understanding of data analysis, statistics, data mining, and data

visualization.
  
  

* Familiarity with Python, R, or other programming languages for data

analysis is a plus.
  
  

* Basic understanding of databases, data management, Big Data, and

cloud platforms is an advantage.
  
  

* Ability to clean, transform, analyze, and interpret data to generate

meaningful insights.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to

detail.
  
  

* Able to translate data into meaningful business insights and

actionable recommendations.
  
  

* Strong interest in data and analytics, with a willingness to understand

different business domains.
  
  

* Able to communicate analytical findings clearly to both technical and

non-technical stakeholders.

* Proactive, curious, and learning-oriented, with a strong willingness to

develop new technical and business skills.
  
  

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
* Able to work effectively independently and collaboratively as part of a

team.
  
  

* Strong work ethic, ownership, and commitment to delivering quality

work.
  
  

* Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic

environment.
  
  

* Good written and verbal English communication skills.

Want to see how a warehouse network keeps running when things go wrong? * Comfortable working with data in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Clear English communication, organised and detail-oriented.
* Proactive and happy to visit warehouse sites when needed.

description:
**Description**

* Lead the development and implementation of financing analytics models (credit scoring, risk rating, and behavioral scoring) to support data-driven decision making.
* Oversee financing portfolio analysis to monitor asset quality, debtor performance, and risk trends in support of mitigation strategies.

* Minimum 5 years of experience in data analytics, risk management, or credit scoring model development within the financial services, banking, or fintech industry.

* Experience in regularly monitoring and evaluating model performance, as well as proposing enhancements to ensure model reliability.
* Experience working in a multidisciplinary environment and collaborating with cross-functional teams such as Risk, Finance, and IT to generate actionable analytical insights.
* Hands-on experience in implementing ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes to collect, process, and manage financing risk-related data.

title: Software Development Engineer In Test
description:
**Job Description**
  
  
*Job ID: MJ000453*
**About The Role**
Traveloka’s QA organization is transforming through shift-left testing, stronger developer testing practices, and AI adoption. We are looking for a Senior SDET who combines strong software engineering skills with business testing judgment and the ability to lead technical decisions for test strategy and tooling. You will shape the testing approach for your scope, design reusable test solutions, and align developers, product managers, QA engineers, and platform teams around clear quality goals and responsibilities. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that includes business testing of critical journeys. You will help teams apply AI to improve testing efficiency and strengthen DevTest—the testing developers perform while building and changing software.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

- Own test strategy and technical decisions. Define risk-based coverage across unit, component, API, contract, integration, and end-to-end tests. Decide what to automate, where checks should run, and which quality signals should gate delivery. Explain trade-offs in coverage, speed, reliability, maintenance effort, and business impact, and document important decisions.
- Lead test-tooling architecture and development. Evaluate build-versus-adopt options, design reusable frameworks and tools, and guide implementation through design and code reviews. Define integration contracts, test data and environment approaches, observability, and ownership so solutions can be maintained and adopted across teams.
- Drive cross-team communication and alignment. Work with engineering leads, product, QA, and platform teams to agree on testing responsibilities, priorities, interfaces, and rollout plans. Resolve dependencies and conflicting needs, communicate release risks clearly, and drive adoption of shared practices through influence and technical credibility.
- Develop production-quality test code. Build and maintain API, integration, contract, and end-to-end tests. Improve test frameworks, reusable components, test data, and environmental tooling.
- Own business testing for your scope. Understand customer journeys and business rules, challenge ambiguous requirements, and perform functional, exploratory, and risk-based regression testing.
- Drive shift-left practices. Participate in requirement refinement and technical design reviews. Identify edge cases, dependencies, and failure scenarios before implementation, and define clear acceptance criteria with the team.
- Strengthen developer testing. Partner with developers to improve unit and integration coverage, testability, mocking, and local validation. Help teams choose the right test level and obtain useful feedback before code merges.
- Apply AI to improve engineering efficiency. Use coding assistants and agent workflows for test design, test implementation, change-impact analysis, failure investigation, and test maintenance. Validate generated code and assertions against actual requirements and system behavior.
- Make automation trustworthy. Integrate tests into CI/CD, investigate failures, reduce flakiness, and keep feedback fast and actionable. Maintain clear ownership and traceability for critical coverage.
- Lead practical improvements. Identify testing bottlenecks, pilot improvements, measure their impact, and help teammates adopt effective engineering practices.

**What We Are Looking For**

- Demonstrated experience leading test strategy or test-engineering initiatives across teams, making technical decisions, and explaining the trade-offs and measurable outcomes. This should include hands-on implementation, not only coordination.
- Experience designing or evolving reusable test frameworks, developer tools, or testing platforms, with attention to architecture, extensibility, reliability, maintainability, and integration with engineering workflows.
- Strong cross-team communication and stakeholder alignment skills. You can translate business risks into technical proposals, build agreement on priorities and ownership, resolve technical disagreements constructively, and mentor engineers in testing practices.
- Strong hands-on programming skills in at least one language, such as Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript, with sound knowledge of debugging, code design, Git, and code review.
- Experience developing maintainable automated tests and test infrastructure, particularly for APIs, distributed services, and integration flows.
- Strong business testing skills: translating requirements into scenarios, prioritizing by risk, designing test data, executing exploratory tests, and investigating defects across service and data boundaries.
- Experience introducing or improving shift-left testing practices through collaboration with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
- Practical experience using AI tools in software development or testing, with the ability to explain where they improved efficiency, how outputs were validated, and where human judgment remained necessary.
- Working knowledge of CI/CD, SQL, HTTP, service dependencies, logs, and other tools used to diagnose application behavior.
- The ability to balance delivery speed with business risk, communicate findings clearly, and drive improvements beyond individual test execution.
- A collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership of both engineering work and hands-on business validation.

title: Network Engineer Staff
description:
PT Digdaya Duta Digital is seeking a skilled **Network Engineer Staff** to join our Network & IT Operations team. This is a full-time position based in Setiabudi, Jakarta.

In this role, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing the company's enterprise network infrastructure, including **LAN, WAN, routing, switching, firewall,** and **VPN systems.**

Your focus will be to **ensure** reliable, secure, and high-performance network connectivity across the organization's IT infrastructure.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams, ISPs, and vendors to maintain network availability, resolve connectivity issues, and support the company's ongoing IT operations and digital initiatives.

**Requirements :**

1. Diploma (D3) or Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Network Engineering, or a related field.
2. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in Network Engineering or a similar position.
3. Strong understanding of enterprise network infrastructure, including LAN, WAN, VLAN, routing, switching, and firewall technologies.
4. Good knowledge of network protocols such as TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, STP, and LACP.
5. Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls, ACL, NAT, VPN, network security configurations, troubleshooting, and performance monitoring.
6. Understanding of network redundancy, high availability, disaster recovery concepts, and load balancing technologies such as HAProxy or equivalent solutions.
7. Proficiency in network troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, tcpdump, traceroute, MTR, and iPerf3.
8. Familiarity with network monitoring tools such as Zabbix, Grafana, SNMP, and Syslog.
9. Basic knowledge of network automation using Python, Ansible, or equivalent tools, as well as network configuration backup, security hardening, and capacity planning.
10. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
11. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
12. Relevant professional certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, or equivalent would be an advantage.

**Key Responsibilities :**

1. Design, configure, implement, and maintain LAN, WAN, VLAN, routing, switching, firewall, VPN, and enterprise network infrastructure.
2. Manage network security, traffic segmentation, routing protocols, and connectivity across servers, data centers, and external networks.
3. Implement and maintain network redundancy, high availability, load balancing, and ISP failover mechanisms.
4. Monitor network performance, bandwidth utilization, latency, packet loss, and network availability using monitoring tools.
5. Perform advanced network troubleshooting, incident resolution, root cause analysis (RCA), and preventive maintenance.
6. Develop and maintain network architecture documentation, topology diagrams, IP addressing plans, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and change management procedures.
7. Implement network configuration backup, automation, security hardening, and network capacity planning.
8. Coordinate with ISPs, vendors, and internal teams to maintain network service availability and resolve network-related incidents.

description:

The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team architects, builds, and maintains the rock-solid infrastructure that applications rely on. We work closely with development teams to ensure scalability, reliability, and efficiency. This collaboration empowers us to deliver exceptional customer experiences while enabling developers to focus on building great features.

- Deploy, automate, maintain, and manage various cloud-based and on-premises production systems.
- Understanding the high-level overview of our architecture, and possessing the ability to systematically document new and existing requirements to ensure a smooth project delivery without miscommunication.
- Work closely with the Information security and infrastructure team in ensuring that we are adopting security best practices.

- Troubleshoot and resolve system issues across platform and application domains.
- Suggest architectural improvements and recommend process optimizations.
- Evaluate new technologies to enhance the infrastructure stack.
- Ensuring system security policies are properly remediated.
- Drive and implement automated provisioning and scaling of servers, along with testing and compliance checks using automation tools.
- Handle operational tasks, including on-call duties, alerts, and incident management.

- At least 2 years of engineering experience.
- Bachelor's or Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., IT, Computer Science) or a proven track record in DevOps.
- A strong willingness to continuously upgrade skills and stay up-to-date with the latest DevOps trends.
- Experience with cloud-native tools (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, Nginx, OpenTelemetry) is a plus.
- Experience managing cloud servers (AWS, GCP).
- A desire to transition into engineering management is a valued addition.
- Experience with on-premises physical servers, databases, and storage solutions (MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis) is a plus, as well as familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools (Terraform, Pulumi).

description:
We run **BIOTA**, a fast-growing Indonesian smart home and pet tech brand, and **Matrix,** a leading set-top box brand. We sell through Shopee, TikTok Shop, Tokopedia, our own website and an offline sales team. We’re a lean team that moves fast, and we build most of our own tools.

**The role**

We’re looking for a generalist engineer who ships quickly using AI. You’ll build the internal tools that run our business and help grow our website into a real sales channel. You’ll work directly with the founder and our Tech Lead. You’ll own projects end to end: understanding the problem, building, deploying and improving. A lot of your code will be written with Claude Code. Your value is in knowing what to build, directing the AI well, and making sure what ships actually works.

**What you’ll do**

- Build and maintain internal tools: dashboards, customer service live chat, sales and inventory reporting, and automations that save the team hours each week.
- Develop and improve our website: product pages, performance, SEO, checkout and conversion tracking.
- Connect our systems: marketplace and courier APIs, spreadsheets, databases, WhatsApp and analytics.
- Use Claude Code and other AI tools as your daily workflow, and help set good AI development practices for the team.
- Talk directly with users inside the company (CS, marketing, sales, operations), understand their problems, and turn them into simple working tools.
- Review, test and secure AI-generated code before it goes live.

### Requirements

- 2+ years of building and shipping real software end to end: frontend, backend and databases.
- Proficient with Claude Code or similar AI coding agents in daily work. You can show us projects you built this way.
- Comfortable across the stack, e.g. JavaScript/TypeScript, React or Next.js, Node or Python, SQL, REST APIs, Git, and deploying to the cloud.
- A generalist mindset: happy to jump from a dashboard to an API integration to a landing page in the same week.
- Strong judgment: you can tell when AI output is wrong, insecure or overcomplicated.
- Clear communication with non-technical colleagues.
- A track record of staying in roles and finishing what you start.

**Nice to have**

- Experience with e-commerce or marketplace integrations (Shopee, TikTok Shop, Tokopedia).
- Shopify, WordPress or website SEO and performance work.
- Building agents or automations with LLM APIs.
- Interest in smart home, IoT or consumer electronics.

**Why join**

- Ship things that are used the same week, by a team that relies on them.
- Work directly with the founder and see your impact on revenue.
- Use the latest AI development tools with full support.

title: Software Development Engineer In Test
description:
Job Posting Date2026.11.13

Job TypeRegular

TeamEngineering & IT

Location

BSD City, Indonesia

About TravelokaTraveloka is Southeast Asia’s leading all-in-one travel platform connecting millions globally with trusted, world-class experiences. With over 140 million app downloads and more than 40 million monthly active users, Traveloka stands as one of the most popular travel apps in the region.

# **Job Description**

*Job ID: MJ000453*

  
  

**About the role**

Traveloka’s QA organization is transforming through shift-left testing, stronger developer testing practices, and AI adoption. We are looking for a Senior SDET who combines strong software engineering skills with business testing judgment and the ability to lead technical decisions for test strategy and tooling.You will shape the testing approach for your scope, design reusable test solutions, and align developers, product managers, QA engineers, and platform teams around clear quality goals and responsibilities. This is a hands-on technical leadership role that includes business testing of critical journeys. You will help teams apply AI to improve testing efficiency and strengthen DevTest—the testing developers perform while building and changing software.

  

**What you will do**

- Own test strategy and technical decisions. Define risk-based coverage across unit, component, API, contract, integration, and end-to-end tests. Decide what to automate, where checks should run, and which quality signals should gate delivery. Explain trade-offs in coverage, speed, reliability, maintenance effort, and business impact, and document important decisions.
- Lead test-tooling architecture and development. Evaluate build-versus-adopt options, design reusable frameworks and tools, and guide implementation through design and code reviews. Define integration contracts, test data and environment approaches, observability, and ownership so solutions can be maintained and adopted across teams.
- Drive cross-team communication and alignment. Work with engineering leads, product, QA, and platform teams to agree on testing responsibilities, priorities, interfaces, and rollout plans. Resolve dependencies and conflicting needs, communicate release risks clearly, and drive adoption of shared practices through influence and technical credibility.
- Develop production-quality test code. Build and maintain API, integration, contract, and end-to-end tests. Improve test frameworks, reusable components, test data, and environmental tooling.
- Own business testing for your scope. Understand customer journeys and business rules, challenge ambiguous requirements, and perform functional, exploratory, and risk-based regression testing.
- Drive shift-left practices. Participate in requirement refinement and technical design reviews. Identify edge cases, dependencies, and failure scenarios before implementation, and define clear acceptance criteria with the team.•Strengthen developer testing. Partner with developers to improve unit and integration coverage, testability, mocking, and local validation. Help teams choose the right test level and obtain useful feedback before code merges.
- Apply AI to improve engineering efficiency. Use coding assistants and agent workflows for test design, test implementation, change-impact analysis, failure investigation, and test maintenance. Validate generated code and assertions against actual requirements and system behavior.
- Make automation trustworthy. Integrate tests into CI/CD, investigate failures, reduce flakiness, and keep feedback fast and actionable. Maintain clear ownership and traceability for critical coverage.
- Lead practical improvements. Identify testing bottlenecks, pilot improvements, measure their impact, and help teammates adopt effective engineering practices.
  

  

**What We Are Looking For**

- Demonstrated experience leading test strategy or test-engineering initiatives across teams, making technical decisions, and explaining the trade-offs and measurable outcomes. This should include hands-on implementation, not only coordination.
- Experience designing or evolving reusable test frameworks, developer tools, or testing platforms, with attention to architecture, extensibility, reliability, maintainability, and integration with engineering workflows.
- Strong cross-team communication and stakeholder alignment skills. You can translate business risks into technical proposals, build agreement on priorities and ownership, resolve technical disagreements constructively, and mentor engineers in testing practices.
- Strong hands-on programming skills in at least one language, such as Java, Python, or JavaScript/TypeScript, with sound knowledge of debugging, code design, Git, and code review.
- Experience developing maintainable automated tests and test infrastructure, particularly for APIs, distributed services, and integration flows.
- Strong business testing skills: translating requirements into scenarios, prioritizing by risk, designing test data, executing exploratory tests, and investigating defects across service and data boundaries.
- Experience introducing or improving shift-left testing practices through collaboration with developers, product managers, and other stakeholders.
- Practical experience using AI tools in software development or testing, with the ability to explain where they improved efficiency, how outputs were validated, and where human judgment remained necessary.
- Working knowledge of CI/CD, SQL, HTTP, service dependencies, logs, and other tools used to diagnose application behavior.
- The ability to balance delivery speed with business risk, communicate findings clearly, and drive improvements beyond individual test execution.
- A collaborative mindset and willingness to take ownership of both engineering work and hands-on business validation.
extracted_skills: Python, SQL, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, CI/CD, Git

title: Data Scientist (Remote)
description:
*Reimagine access. Reimagine ownership. Build the future with Cinch.*
Cinch is Southeast Asia's leading circular tech subscription company, redefining how people and businesses access technology. Instead of adding to the growing e-waste crisis, we enable affordable, sustainable access to devices through subscriptions that maximize reuse and extend their lifecycle.
  
  
We operate across B2C, B2B, and B2B2C channels, including major partnerships with global leaders like Samsung. Our model sits at the intersection of powerful mega trends—sustainability, embedded finance, and the shift from ownership to access—creating a massive opportunity to reshape the future of tech consumption.
  
  
At Cinch, we are builders with high standards, a bias for action, and a shared mission to create a generational company that outlasts us. Freshly funded by leading institutional investors and growing rapidly, we're creating an environment where ambitious people can do the best work of their careers—and where the work has real, lasting impact.
  
  
**The Role**
We are looking for a Data Scientist to build the credit models that decide who Cinch lends to, on what terms, and how we collect. Every subscription at Cinch is a customer relationship and a credit exposure on a physical device, so your models directly shape growth, losses and asset returns.
  
  
You will own credit and risk models end to end: from data exploration and feature design through validation, deployment and monitoring. You will work with SQL and Python, partner with Data, Product and Engineering teams, and turn model outputs into decisions the business can act on. You are expected to be AI-literate and comfortable working with Claude. We expect responsible AI use, and the correctness of all work submitted remains the author's own responsibility.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Risk and credit modelling**

- Build, validate and maintain credit scoring models for new and repeat subscribers - A Score and B Score models.
- Develop early-warning and delinquency models, and support collections strategy and prioritisation
- Run experiments and champion/challenger tests to prove a model improves approval rates, losses or recovery before it scales
- Track model performance over time (stability, drift, bias) and retrain when it degrades

**Data and features**

- Collect and blend data from multiple sources (applications, payments, devices, bureau and alternative data) into clean, documented feature sets
- Work with data analysts and engineers on dimensional models and data pipelines so features stay consistent between training and production
- Define and track the risk KPIs the business relies on (approval rate, default rate, loss per cohort, recovery rate)

**Decisioning and partnership**

- Turn model outputs into clear decision rules and recommendations to guide credit policy at Cinch.
- Present findings and trade-offs to leadership in plain language, including what the model cannot tell us
- Partner with Risk & Data leadership on credit policy and regulatory expectations in each market

**Standards, AI and mentoring**

- Document models so another data scientist can reproduce and audit them
- Use AI tools (Claude Desktop, Claude Code) to speed up exploration, coding and documentation, and set the standard for responsible use with sensitive customer data

**Qualifications**
**Must-haves**

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field (or equivalent experience)
- 3-6 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics, including building models that went into production
- Strong SQL and Python (including familiarity with all the relevant frameworks and packages such as pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost or similar) for data manipulation and modelling
- Solid grounding in statistics and machine learning for classification and risk: logistic regression, gradient boosting, calibration, cross-validation, and evaluation metrics such as AUC, KS and Gini
- Experience with model validation, monitoring and documentation, and explaining model results to non-technical stakeholders
- Working knowledge of dimensional modelling and data pipelines, and the ability to work with analysts and engineers on feature data
- Working proficiency with AI tools

**Nice-to-haves**

- Experience in fintech, lending, consumer credit, e-commerce or subscription businesses
- Credit scorecard development, collections analytics or fraud detection
- Experience with cloud data warehouses and modern data stack tools (for example BigQuery, dbt, SQLMesh)
- Experience with BI tools such as Apache Superset or Looker
- Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n, and with deploying models to production
- Familiarity with regulatory expectations for credit data and model use in Indonesia or other Southeast Asian markets
extracted_skills: Python, Scikit-Learn, Machine Learning, Data Science, Pandas, SQL, Airflow, BigQuery

description_clean:
**Company Description**
**About Grab and Our Workplace**
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Get to Know the Team**
The Merchant App Flutter team builds and maintains the core merchant app for businesses using Grab. Whether you're supporting small local vendors or scaling for international franchises, the team focuses on creating tools to empower merchants. You'll join a close-knit group of passionate engineers committed to elevating the merchant experience and delivering impactful solutions
  
  
**Get to Know the Role**
Reporting to the Software Engineering Manager, you will focus on both feature development and engineering optimization for the Grab merchant app. With this role, you will take direct responsibility for delivering high-quality technical solutions, scaling tools for merchants, and taking ownership of impactful engineering contributions. This role is an onsite role based in Jakarta
  
  
**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

- You will develop and enhance app features to improve merchant workflows, ensuring the app is efficient, responsive, and user-friendly.
- You will design clear, scalable programming solutions using best practices such as dependency injection or MVVM.
- You will analyze and optimize app performance to address issues like response time, battery use, and storage impact.
- You will write robust unit tests, integration tests, and collaborate with QA engineers to maintain quality standards during app releases.
- You will maintain current features, resolve bugs, and enhance code functionality while ensuring technical consistency and long-term performance goals.
- You will serve in the on-call rotation for critical mobile issues, balancing rapid fixes with logical troubleshooting.

**Qualifications**
**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

- 5+ years of Flutter/Mobile engineering experience designing, launching, and optimizing mobile applications using Flutter and Dart. Must demonstrate the ability to work fluently with Flutter-specific tools and libraries.
- Comfortable structuring code using clean approaches like MVVM or state management using reactive paradigms.
- Familiarity with app metrics (performance tools, crash analytics, debugging solutions) and experience optimizing factors such as API use, storage allocation, and battery drain.
- Practical knowledge of writing testable code, creating end-to-end unit tests, designing APIs, and applying automation techniques.
- Experience managing a technical feature or significant app area, owning end-to-end functionality, from concept through release.
- An eagerness to stay updated on mobile development trends, mentor teammates, and scale the impact of your work to millions of users.

**Additional Information**
**Life at Grab**
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
  
  

- We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
- With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
- Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
- We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
- Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For At Grab**
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Climatology Scientist (Riau)
description:
Currently, we are looking for a new talented researcher as Climate Scientist to support some research programs in our research institute.
  
  
Job Descriptions:
  

* Manage climate monitoring equipment both manual and automatic (Cimel, Davis, HOBO, Campbell), and make sure the coverage, installation, calibration, operation, spare part and maintenance.
* Responsible for routine data collection, QC, and make sure the update and quality of climate data in the database.
* Initiative to provide comprehensive analysis in term of basic monitoring trend and climate variability, and forecasting in all estates as part of decision support system for research and plantation operation.
* Make some research to investigate the impacts of climate variability to oil palm operations: replanting period, transplanting period, proper period for fertilizer application, El-nino, water conservation, haze effects, etc
* Lead the team, and manage the budget for research and operational needed to support the activities

Qualifications:
  

* Minimum S2 in Meteorology/Geophysics/Environmental Science/Hydrology, Fresh graduates are welcome
* Have a good communication in English (oral and written)
* Experience to use and maintain variety of different climate instruments
* Have a good statistical analysis knowledge with the implementation to the climatology data
* Have a good competency in R programming language and SQL database
* Experience in the use of remote sensing products and GIS software for climate monitoring is a plus
* Good thinking, personality, analytical, communication skill, and able to work as team
* Naturally curious, analytical, detail-oriented, and has a high interest to participate and to conduct research
* Willing to be placed in our main research station in Kandis, Riau

title: Android/IOS Developer
description:
* **Education:**
  Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
* **Experience:**
  Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with
  **Android Jetpack, Retrofit, Flow, Coroutines**
  , and Dependency Injection (
  **Dagger Hilt**
  ).
* **Core Technical Skills:**
* Strong understanding of
  **Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)**
  concepts.
* Deep understanding of
  **Single Activity Architecture**
  (Multiple Fragments),
  **MVVM**
  design patterns, and
  **Reactive Programming**
  .
* Solid knowledge of
  **Clean Architecture**
  and
  **SOLID**
  principles.
* Proven experience in developing custom view components, view binding, and building robust applications.
* **Tools & Methodologies:**
  Familiarity with
  **CI/CD, DevOps, Docker, Jira, Confluence, Figma**
  , and
  **Git Flow**
  .
* **Responsibilities:**
  Actively contribute to deployment, troubleshooting, and continuous tech stack improvements/updates.

**Preferred / Additional Skills:**

* Experience working on
  **Multi-Module Architecture**
  projects.
* Proven track record of deploying applications to the
  **Google Play Store**
  .
* Experience integrating
  **Firebase SDK**
  .
* Strong knowledge of
  **XML ViewGroup**
  components (e.g.,
  *CoordinatorLayout, ConstraintLayout, LinearLayout, FrameLayout, ScrollView, NestedScrollView*
  ).
* Knowledge of code obfuscation using
  **R8 or ProGuard**
  , including creating custom obfuscation rules.

**Education:**
Bachelor's Degree (S1) in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.

**Experience:**
Minimum 3 years of experience in iOS development using
**Swift**
.

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong proficiency in
  **Xcode**
  , Interface Builder, and Xcode debugging tools (Instruments).
* Hands-on experience with
  **UIKit**
  and
  **RESTful APIs**
  .
* Proven experience with architectural patterns such as
  **MVC, MVVM, and VIPER**
  , as well as
  **Core Data**
  and managing API interactions (JSON/REST).
* Experience in building and packaging applications into
  **IPA**
  (iOS App Store Package) files.

**Tools & Methodologies:**
Familiarity with
**Docker, Jira, Confluence, Figma, Git Flow**
, and dependency managers like
**SPM (Swift Package Manager)**
and
**CocoaPods**
.

**Responsibilities:**
Actively involved in deployment, troubleshooting, and tech stack improvements.

title: Data Analyst (Operations)
description:
**Data Analyst (Operations) – Embodied AI Data Collection**

**Location:** Yogyakarta  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, fixed-term contract (PKWT)  
**Salary:** IDR 3,000,000 – 4,200,000/month (gross)  
**Start Date:** ASAP

**About the Role**  
We are looking for a Data Analyst to turn our project data into clear performance reports. You will work with the Project Managers, QC team, and BD team to track how every collector, QC member, and team is performing, and how our site pipeline is converting.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Generate daily, weekly, and monthly data reports for Project Managers
- Analyze recorded video data to track performance of each data collector and each team
- Report on overall QC performance, each QC team’s performance, and each QC member’s individual performance
- Build and maintain the BD pipeline report, from leads and meetings through to signed deals and conversion rates
- Spot trends, issues, and risks in the data and flag them to the relevant teams
- Keep data records accurate, organized, and up to date

**Requirements**

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience (Data, Statistics, IT, Business, or related fields preferred)
- Experience in data analysis, reporting, or operations analytics
- Strong skills in Excel or Google Sheets (formulas, pivot tables, dashboards)
- Able to turn raw data into clear, easy-to-read reports
- Detail-oriented, accurate, and consistent with deadlines
- Good English for reading and writing reports
- Based in Yogyakarta, or willing to work there

**Nice to Have**

- Experience with SQL, Looker Studio, Power BI, or similar tools
- Experience with QC, operations, or sales pipeline reporting
- Exposure to data collection, AI, or video review projects
